# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Path,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content
    )

    $encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        $encoding
    )
}

function Get-GoFunctionSignature {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$FunctionName
    )

    $pattern = "func\s*\([^)]*\)\s+" +
               [regex]::Escape($FunctionName) +
               "\s*\("

    $match = [regex]::Match(
        $Content,
        $pattern
    )

    if (-not $match.Success) {
        throw "Go method '$FunctionName' was not found."
    }

    $openParen = $match.Index + $match.Length - 1

    $depth = 1
    $closeParen = -1

    for (
        $i = $openParen + 1;
        $i -lt $Content.Length;
        $i++
    ) {
        $char = $Content[$i]

        if ($char -eq '(') {
            $depth++
        }
        elseif ($char -eq ')') {
            $depth--

            if ($depth -eq 0) {
                $closeParen = $i
                break
            }
        }
    }

    if ($closeParen -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not parse parameters of '$FunctionName'."
    }

    $parameterText = $Content.Substring(
        $openParen + 1,
        $closeParen - $openParen - 1
    ).Trim()

    $braceIndex = $Content.IndexOf(
        "{",
        $closeParen + 1
    )

    if ($braceIndex -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not parse return type of '$FunctionName'."
    }

    $returnText = $Content.Substring(
        $closeParen + 1,
        $braceIndex - $closeParen - 1
    ).Trim()

    return @{
        Parameters = $parameterText
        Returns    = $returnText
    }
}

function Split-GoParameters {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$ParameterText
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ParameterText)) {
        return @()
    }

    $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    $start = 0
    $parenDepth = 0
    $bracketDepth = 0
    $braceDepth = 0

    for (
        $i = 0;
        $i -lt $ParameterText.Length;
        $i++
    ) {
        $char = $ParameterText[$i]

        switch ($char) {
            '(' { $parenDepth++ }
            ')' { $parenDepth-- }
            '[' { $bracketDepth++ }
            ']' { $bracketDepth-- }
            '{' { $braceDepth++ }
            '}' { $braceDepth-- }

            ',' {
                if (
                    $parenDepth -eq 0 -and
                    $bracketDepth -eq 0 -and
                    $braceDepth -eq 0
                ) {
                    $items.Add(
                        $ParameterText.Substring(
                            $start,
                            $i - $start
                        ).Trim()
                    )

                    $start = $i + 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if ($start -lt $ParameterText.Length) {
        $items.Add(
            $ParameterText.Substring(
                $start
            ).Trim()
        )
    }

    return $items.ToArray()
}

function Get-GoParameterNames {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Parameter
    )

    $match = [regex]::Match(
        $Parameter,
        "^(?<names>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\s*,\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*)\s+.+$"
    )

    if (-not $match.Success) {
        throw "Cannot parse Go parameter: $Parameter"
    }

    return (
        $match.Groups["names"].Value -split "\s*,\s*"
    )
}

function Get-GoStructBody {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$StructName
    )

    $pattern = "type\s+" +
               [regex]::Escape($StructName) +
               "\s+struct\s*\{"

    $match = [regex]::Match(
        $Content,
        $pattern
    )

    if (-not $match.Success) {
        throw "Go struct '$StructName' was not found."
    }

    $openBrace = $Content.IndexOf(
        "{",
        $match.Index
    )

    $depth = 1
    $closeBrace = -1

    for (
        $i = $openBrace + 1;
        $i -lt $Content.Length;
        $i++
    ) {
        $char = $Content[$i]

        if ($char -eq '{') {
            $depth++
        }
        elseif ($char -eq '}') {
            $depth--

            if ($depth -eq 0) {
                $closeBrace = $i
                break
            }
        }
    }

    if ($closeBrace -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not parse struct '$StructName'."
    }

    return $Content.Substring(
        $openBrace + 1,
        $closeBrace - $openBrace - 1
    )
}

function Get-GoStructFieldName {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$StructBody,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string[]]$Candidates
    )

    foreach ($candidate in $Candidates) {

        $pattern = "(?m)^\s*" +
                   [regex]::Escape($candidate) +
                   "\s+"

        if (
            [regex]::IsMatch(
                $StructBody,
                $pattern
            )
        ) {
            return $candidate
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-FirstExistingAuthSource {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string[]]$Files
    )

    foreach ($file in $Files) {
        if (Test-Path $file) {
            return $file
        }
    }

    return $null
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Validate files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$sessionServicePath = Join-Path $authDir "session_service.go"
$sessionRepositoryPath = Join-Path $authDir "session_repository.go"
$sessionHandlerPath = Join-Path $authDir "session_handler.go"

foreach ($file in @(
    $sessionServicePath,
    $sessionRepositoryPath,
    $sessionHandlerPath,
    $mainPath
)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
        throw "Required file not found: $file"
    }
}

Write-Host "[OK] Required files found."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read source files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$serviceContent = Get-Content `
    -Path $sessionServicePath `
    -Raw

$repositoryContent = Get-Content `
    -Path $sessionRepositoryPath `
    -Raw

$handlerContent = Get-Content `
    -Path $sessionHandlerPath `
    -Raw

$mainContent = Get-Content `
    -Path $mainPath `
    -Raw

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Safety checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (
    $serviceContent -match "(?m)^\s*func\s+\(.*\)\s+Refresh\s*\("
) {
    throw "SessionService.Refresh already exists. Nothing was changed."
}

if (
    $handlerContent -match "(?m)^\s*func\s+\(.*\)\s+Refresh\s*\("
) {
    throw "SessionHandler.Refresh already exists. Nothing was changed."
}

if (
    $mainContent -match '/api/v1/auth/refresh'
) {
    throw "Refresh route already exists. Nothing was changed."
}

if (Test-Path $refreshGoPath) {
    throw "File already exists: $refreshGoPath"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Detect SessionService repository field
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$serviceStruct = Get-GoStructBody `
    -Content $serviceContent `
    -StructName "SessionService"

$repositoryFieldMatch = [regex]::Match(
    $serviceStruct,
    "(?m)^\s*(?<field>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+\*SessionRepository\b"
)

if (-not $repositoryFieldMatch.Success) {
    throw "Could not find *SessionRepository field in SessionService."
}

$repositoryField =
    $repositoryFieldMatch.Groups["field"].Value

Write-Host "[OK] SessionService repository field: $repositoryField"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Detect SessionHandler service field
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$handlerStruct = Get-GoStructBody `
    -Content $handlerContent `
    -StructName "SessionHandler"

$serviceFieldMatch = [regex]::Match(
    $handlerStruct,
    "(?m)^\s*(?<field>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+\*SessionService\b"
)

if (-not $serviceFieldMatch.Success) {
    throw "Could not find *SessionService field in SessionHandler."
}

$handlerServiceField =
    $serviceFieldMatch.Groups["field"].Value

Write-Host "[OK] SessionHandler service field: $handlerServiceField"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Locate Session struct
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$sessionFiles = Get-ChildItem `
    -Path $authDir `
    -Filter "*.go" `
    -File

$sessionStructBody = $null

foreach ($file in $sessionFiles) {

    $text = Get-Content `
        -Path $file.FullName `
        -Raw

    if (
        $text -match "type\s+Session\s+struct\s*\{"
    ) {
        $sessionStructBody = Get-GoStructBody `
            -Content $text `
            -StructName "Session"

        break
    }
}

if ($null -eq $sessionStructBody) {
    throw "Could not locate type Session in internal/auth."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Detect required Session fields
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$userIDField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "UserID"
    )

if (-not $userIDField) {
    throw "Session.UserID field was not found."
}

$sessionIDField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "ID",
        "SessionID"
    )

if (-not $sessionIDField) {
    throw "Session ID field was not found."
}

$revokedAtField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "RevokedAt"
    )

if (-not $revokedAtField) {
    throw "Session revoked field was not found."
}

$refreshExpiresField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "RefreshExpiresAt",
        "RefreshTokenExpiresAt"
    )

if (-not $refreshExpiresField) {
    throw "Session refresh-expiration field was not found."
}

Write-Host "[OK] Session fields detected:"
Write-Host "     User ID       : $userIDField"
Write-Host "     Session ID    : $sessionIDField"
Write-Host "     Revoked At    : $revokedAtField"
Write-Host "     Refresh Expiry: $refreshExpiresField"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse Create method
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$createSignature = Get-GoFunctionSignature `
    -Content $repositoryContent `
    -FunctionName "Create"

$createParams = Split-GoParameters `
    -ParameterText $createSignature.Parameters

$createReturns = $createSignature.Returns

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($createReturns)) {
    throw "SessionRepository.Create has no return type."
}

# Require exactly two return values:
# result + error
$returnBody = $createReturns.Trim()

if (
    $returnBody.StartsWith("(") -and
    $returnBody.EndsWith(")")
) {
    $returnBody =
        $returnBody.Substring(
            1,
            $returnBody.Length - 2
        ).Trim()
}

$returnParts = Split-GoParameters `
    -ParameterText $returnBody

if ($returnParts.Count -ne 2) {
    throw "SessionRepository.Create must return exactly two values. Actual: $createReturns"
}

$returnResultType = $returnParts[0].Trim()
$returnErrorType = $returnParts[1].Trim()

if (
    $returnErrorType -notmatch "\berror\b"
) {
    throw "Second return value of SessionRepository.Create is not error."
}

Write-Host "[OK] Create return type: $returnResultType, error"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Detect Session metadata fields
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$deviceIDField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "DeviceID"
    )

$deviceNameField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "DeviceName"
    )

$userAgentField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "UserAgent"
    )

$ipAddressField = Get-GoStructFieldName `
    -StructBody $sessionStructBody `
    -Candidates @(
        "IPAddress",
        "IP"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build Create arguments dynamically
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$createExpressions = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

foreach ($parameter in $createParams) {

    $names = Get-GoParameterNames `
        -Parameter $parameter

    foreach ($name in $names) {

        switch -Regex ($name) {

            '^ctx$' {
                $createExpressions.Add("ctx")
                continue
            }

            '^userID$' {
                $createExpressions.Add("session.$userIDField")
                continue
            }

            '^deviceID$' {
                if (-not $deviceIDField) {
                    throw "Create requires deviceID but Session has no DeviceID field."
                }

                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "session.$deviceIDField"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^deviceName$' {
                if (-not $deviceNameField) {
                    throw "Create requires deviceName but Session has no DeviceName field."
                }

                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "session.$deviceNameField"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^userAgent$' {
                if (-not $userAgentField) {
                    throw "Create requires userAgent but Session has no UserAgent field."
                }

                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "session.$userAgentField"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^(ipAddress|ip)$' {
                if (-not $ipAddressField) {
                    throw "Create requires IP address but Session has no IP field."
                }

                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "session.$ipAddressField"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^(accessTTL|accessTokenTTL)$' {
                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "15 * time.Minute"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^(refreshTTL|refreshTokenTTL)$' {
                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "30 * 24 * time.Hour"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^(accessExpiresAt|accessTokenExpiresAt)$' {
                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "time.Now().UTC().Add(15 * time.Minute)"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^(refreshExpiresAt|refreshTokenExpiresAt)$' {
                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "time.Now().UTC().Add(30 * 24 * time.Hour)"
                )

                continue
            }

            '^now$' {
                $createExpressions.Add(
                    "time.Now().UTC()"
                )

                continue
            }

            default {
                throw "Unsupported parameter '$name' in SessionRepository.Create signature: $parameter"
            }
        }
    }
}

if ($createExpressions.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Could not build Create arguments."
}

$createArgumentText =
    $createExpressions -join ",`r`n`t`t"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse Revoke method

$revokeSignature = Get-GoFunctionSignature `
    -Content $repositoryContent `
    -FunctionName "Revoke"

$revokeParams = Split-GoParameters `

            }

            default {
                throw "Unsupported parameter '$name' in SessionRepository.Revoke signature: $parameter"
            }
        }
    }
}

if ($revokeExpressions.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Could not build Revoke arguments."
}

$revokeArgumentText =
    $revokeExpressions -join ",`r`n`t`t"

$refreshGo = @"
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var ErrEmptyRefreshToken = errors.New(
	"refresh token is required",
)

// Refresh validates the current refresh token, revokes the old
// session and creates a new session with rotated tokens.
func (s *SessionService) Refresh(
	ctx context.Context,
	refreshToken string,
) ($returnResultType, error) {

	if s == nil || s.$repositoryField == nil {
		return nil, errors.New(
			"session service is not configured",
		)
	}

	refreshToken = strings.TrimSpace(
		refreshToken,
	)

	if refreshToken == "" {
		return nil, ErrEmptyRefreshToken
	}

	session, err := s.$repositoryField.FindByRefreshToken(
		ctx,
		refreshToken,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrSessionNotFound) {
			return nil, ErrSessionNotFound
		}

		return nil, err
	}

	if session == nil {
		return nil, ErrSessionNotFound
	}

	if session.$revokedAtField != nil {
		return nil, ErrSessionRevoked
	}

	if time.Now().UTC().After(
		session.$refreshExpiresField,
	) {
		return nil, ErrSessionExpired
	}

	// Rotate the session:
	// invalidate the old refresh token before creating
	// the new session.
	if err := s.$repositoryField.Revoke(
		ctx,
		$revokeArgumentText
	); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return s.$repositoryField.Create(
		ctx,
		$createArgumentText
	)
}

// RefreshRequest is the HTTP request body for token refresh.
type RefreshRequest struct {
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
}

// Refresh handles POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.
func (h *SessionHandler) Refresh(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {

	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeRefreshError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)

		return
	}

	var request RefreshRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(
		r.Body,
	).Decode(&request); err != nil {

		writeRefreshError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)

		return
	}

	result, err := h.$handlerServiceField.Refresh(
		r.Context(),
		request.RefreshToken,
	)

	if err != nil {

		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, ErrEmptyRefreshToken),
			errors.Is(err, ErrSessionNotFound),
			errors.Is(err, ErrSessionRevoked),
			errors.Is(err, ErrSessionExpired):

			writeRefreshError(
				w,
				http.StatusUnauthorized,
				"invalid refresh token",
			)

		default:

			writeRefreshError(
				w,
				http.StatusInternalServerError,
				"internal server error",
			)
		}

		return
	}

	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

	if err := json.NewEncoder(
		w,
	).Encode(result); err != nil {
		return
	}
}

func writeRefreshError(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	status int,
	message string,
) {

	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(status)

	_ = json.NewEncoder(
		w,
	).Encode(
		map[string]string{
			"error": message,
		},
	)
}
"@

# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-FileIfNotExists {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path $Directory)) {
        New-Item `
            -ItemType Directory `
            -Path $Directory `
            -Force | Out-Null
    }

    if (Test-Path $Path) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "File already exists:" `
            -ForegroundColor DarkYellow

        Write-Host $Path

        return $false
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Created:" `
        -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host $Path

    return $true
}

package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type EmailRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewEmailRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *EmailRepository {
	return &EmailRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *EmailRepository) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		INSERT INTO user_emails (
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary
		)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		RETURNING
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
	`

	var result UserEmail

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		email.UserID,
		email.Email,
		email.IsPrimary,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.UserID,
		&result.Email,
		&result.IsPrimary,
		&result.IsVerified,
		&result.VerifiedAt,
		&result.CreatedAt,
		&result.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to create user email: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return &result, nil
}

func (r *EmailRepository) GetByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		SELECT
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
		FROM user_emails
		WHERE user_id = $1
		ORDER BY is_primary DESC, created_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := r.db.Pool.Query(
		ctx,
		query,
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to get user emails: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	defer rows.Close()

	var emails []UserEmail

	for rows.Next() {

		var email UserEmail

		err := rows.Scan(
			&email.ID,
			&email.UserID,
			&email.Email,
			&email.IsPrimary,
			&email.IsVerified,
			&email.VerifiedAt,
			&email.CreatedAt,
			&email.UpdatedAt,
		)

		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
				"failed to scan user email: %w",
				err,
			)
		}

		emails = append(
			emails,
			email,
		)
	}

	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to iterate user emails: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return emails, nil
}
'@

package user

import (
	"context"

type EmailService struct {

func NewEmailService(

func (s *EmailService) CreateEmail(
	ctx context.Context,
	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	if email == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"email is required",
		)
	}

	email.UserID = strings.TrimSpace(
		email.UserID,
	)

	email.Email = strings.ToLower(
		strings.TrimSpace(
			email.Email,
		),
	)

	if email.UserID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"user id is required",
		)
	}

	if email.Email == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"email is required",
		)
	}

	if !strings.Contains(
		email.Email,
		"@",
	) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"invalid email address",
		)
	}

	return s.repository.Create(
		ctx,
		email,
	)
}

func (s *EmailService) GetEmailsByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserEmail, error) {

	userID = strings.TrimSpace(userID)

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"user id is required",
		)
	}

	return s.repository.GetByUserID(
		ctx,
		userID,
	)
}

# ============================================================
# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-File {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $Root $Path
    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $FullPath

    New-Item `
        -ItemType Directory `
        -Force `
        -Path $Directory `
        | Out-Null

    if (Test-Path $FullPath) {
        Write-Host "SKIP: $Path already exists" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
        return
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $FullPath,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "CREATE: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT user_phones_user_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_phones_user_id
    ON user_phones(user_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_phones_unique_number

$Repository = @'
package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type PhoneRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewPhoneRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *PhoneRepository {
	return &PhoneRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *PhoneRepository) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	phone *UserPhone,
) (*UserPhone, error) {

	query := `
		INSERT INTO user_phones (
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary
		)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		RETURNING
			id,
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
	`

	var result UserPhone

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		phone.UserID,
		phone.PhoneNumber,
		phone.IsPrimary,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.UserID,
		&result.PhoneNumber,
		&result.IsPrimary,
		&result.IsVerified,
		&result.VerifiedAt,
		&result.CreatedAt,
		&result.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to create user phone: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return &result, nil
}

func (r *PhoneRepository) GetByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserPhone, error) {

	query := `
		SELECT
			id,
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
		FROM user_phones
		WHERE user_id = $1
		ORDER BY is_primary DESC, created_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := r.db.Pool.Query(
		ctx,
		query,
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to get user phones: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	defer rows.Close()

	var phones []UserPhone

	for rows.Next() {

		var phone UserPhone

		err := rows.Scan(
			&phone.ID,
			&phone.UserID,
			&phone.PhoneNumber,
			&phone.IsPrimary,
			&phone.IsVerified,
			&phone.VerifiedAt,
			&phone.CreatedAt,
			&phone.UpdatedAt,
		)

		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
				"failed to scan user phone: %w",
				err,
			)
		}

		phones = append(phones, phone)
	}

	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to iterate user phones: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return phones, nil
}
'@

Write-File `
    "internal/user/phone_repository.go" `
    $Repository

$providerCode = @'
package verification

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

// TestProvider یک Provider داخلی برای تست Verification است.
type TestProvider struct{}

// NewTestProvider یک TestProvider جدید ایجاد می‌کند.
func NewTestProvider() *TestProvider {
	return &TestProvider{}
}

// Name نام Provider را برمی‌گرداند.
func (p *TestProvider) Name() string {
	return "test-provider"
}

// Verify عملیات Verification آزمایشی را انجام می‌دهد.
func (p *TestProvider) Verify(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *ProviderRequest,
) (*ProviderResult, error) {

	if request == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider request is nil")
	}

	if request.UserID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if request.VerificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	default:
	}

	status := VerificationStatusVerified

	if request.Data != nil {
		switch request.Data["test_result"] {
		case "":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "verified":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "rejected":
			status = VerificationStatusRejected

		case "failed":
			status = VerificationStatusFailed

		case "manual_review":
			status = VerificationStatusManualReview

		case "pending":
			status = VerificationStatusPending

		default:
			return nil, errors.New("invalid test result")
		}
	}

	result := &ProviderResult{
		Status:            status,
		ReferenceID:       request.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: VerificationLevelBasic,
	}

	if status == VerificationStatusRejected {
		result.RejectionReason = "test rejection"
	}

	return result, nil
}
'@

# 3. Add ExecuteVerification to Service
# =========================================================

if ($serviceContent -notmatch 'func \(s \*Service\) ExecuteVerification') {

    $executeServiceCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات واقعی Verification را
// از طریق ProviderManager اجرا می‌کند و نتیجه را در PostgreSQL ذخیره می‌کند.
func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	verificationType VerificationType,
	providerName string,
	data map[string]string,
) (*Verification, error) {

	if s == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification service is nil")
	}

	if s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification repository is nil")
	}

	if s.providers == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider manager is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if verificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	if providerName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("provider name is empty")
	}

	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	request := &ProviderRequest{
		UserID:           userID,
		VerificationType: verificationType,
		Data:             data,
	}

	result, err := provider.Verify(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if result == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider result is nil")
	}

	verification := &Verification{
		UserID:            userID,
		VerificationType:  verificationType,
		Provider:          providerName,
		Status:            result.Status,
		ReferenceID:       result.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: result.VerificationLevel,
		RejectionReason:   result.RejectionReason,
	}

	if result.Status == VerificationStatusVerified {
		now := time.Now()
		verification.VerifiedAt = &now
	}

	if err := s.repository.Create(ctx, verification); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return verification, nil
}
'@

    $serviceContent = $serviceContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeServiceCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $serviceFile `
        -Value $serviceContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Service."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Service."
}

    $executeHandlerCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات Verification را اجرا می‌کند.
func (h *Handler) ExecuteVerification(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	if h == nil || h.service == nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusInternalServerError,
			"verification service is unavailable",
		)
		return
	}

	var request ExecuteVerificationRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	verification, err := h.service.ExecuteVerification(
		r.Context(),
		request.UserID,
		request.VerificationType,
		request.Provider,
		request.Data,
	)

	if err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			err.Error(),
		)
		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusOK,
		verification,
	)
}

// ExecuteVerificationRequest بدنه درخواست اجرای Verification است.
type ExecuteVerificationRequest struct {
	UserID           string            `json:"user_id"`
	VerificationType VerificationType `json:"verification_type"`
	Provider         string            `json:"provider"`
	Data             map[string]string `json:"data,omitempty"`
}
'@

    $handlerContent = $handlerContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeHandlerCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $handlerFile `
        -Value $handlerContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Handler."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Handler."
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$repositoryFile = "$authorizationPath\repository.go"

    throw "Authorization repository not found: $repositoryFile"
}

Write-Host "Fixing Authorization Phase 3..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ============================================================
# 1. Replace IsScopeAllowed safely
# ============================================================

Write-Host "Updating scope hierarchy logic..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$repositoryContent = Get-Content $repositoryFile -Raw

$scopeFunctionPattern = '(?s)func\s+\(r\s+\*Repository\)\s+IsScopeAllowed\s*\(.*?\n\}\s*(?=//|var\s*\(|\z)'

$matches = [regex]::Matches(
    $repositoryContent,
    $scopeFunctionPattern
)

if ($matches.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Could not locate exactly one IsScopeAllowed function in repository.go."
}

$newScopeFunction = @'
func (r *Repository) IsScopeAllowed(
	ctx context.Context,
	assignedScopeID *string,
	requestedScopeID *string,
) (bool, error) {

	// No assigned scope means unrestricted access.
	// The authorization service controls where this is valid.
	if assignedScopeID == nil {
		return true, nil
	}

	// A scoped authorization request must contain a scope.
	if requestedScopeID == nil {
		return false, nil
	}

	if err := r.validate(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	// A global assigned scope covers all requested scopes.
	var assignedScopeType ScopeType

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		`
		SELECT scope_type
		FROM authorization_scopes
		WHERE id = $1
		  AND is_active = TRUE
		`,
		*assignedScopeID,
	).Scan(&assignedScopeType)

	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	if assignedScopeType == ScopeTypeGlobal {
		return true, nil
	}

	// Walk upward from the requested scope through its parents.
	//
	// Example:
	//
	// سازمان
	//   └── پروژه
	//       └── دارایی
	//
	// An authorization assigned at the organization level
	// therefore covers its child project and asset scopes.
	query := `
		WITH RECURSIVE requested_scope_tree AS (
			SELECT
				id,
				parent_scope_id,
				is_active
			FROM authorization_scopes
			WHERE id = $1

			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				parent.id,
				parent.parent_scope_id,
				parent.is_active
			FROM authorization_scopes parent
			INNER JOIN requested_scope_tree child
				ON child.parent_scope_id = parent.id
		)
		SELECT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM requested_scope_tree
			WHERE id = $2
			  AND is_active = TRUE
		)
	`

	var allowed bool

	err = r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		*requestedScopeID,
		*assignedScopeID,
	).Scan(&allowed)

	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}

	return allowed, nil
}

'@

$repositoryContent = [regex]::Replace(
    $repositoryContent,
    $scopeFunctionPattern,
    $newScopeFunction,
    1
)

Set-Content `
    -Path $repositoryFile `
    -Value $repositoryContent `
    -Encoding UTF8

		)
	}

	if result.Decision != AuthorizationDecisionAllow {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected user 2 project 1 access to be allowed, got %s (%s)",
			result.Decision,
			result.Reason,
		)
	}

	result, err = service.Authorize(
		ctx,
		AuthorizationRequest{
			UserID:       user2ID,
			Permission:   PermissionProjectUpdate,
			ResourceType: "project",
			ResourceID: stringPointer(
				"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
			),
			ScopeID: stringPointer(project2ID),
		},
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"user 2 project 2 authorization failed: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	if result.Decision != AuthorizationDecisionDeny {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected user 2 sibling project access to be denied, got %s (%s)",
			result.Decision,
			result.Reason,
		)
	}

	// --------------------------------------------------------
	// User 3
	//
	// No role.
	// Explicit ALLOW on project 2.
	// --------------------------------------------------------

	addOverride(
		t,
		ctx,
		pool,
		user3ID,
		permission.ID,
		PermissionEffectAllow,
		project2ID,
	)

	result, err = service.Authorize(
		ctx,
		AuthorizationRequest{
			UserID:       user3ID,
			Permission:   PermissionProjectUpdate,
			ResourceType: "project",
			ResourceID: stringPointer(
				"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
			),
			ScopeID: stringPointer(project2ID),
		},
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"user 3 allow override authorization failed: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	if result.Decision != AuthorizationDecisionAllow {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected explicit allow to grant access, got %s (%s)",
			result.Decision,
			result.Reason,
		)
	}

	t.Log(
		"PostgreSQL Authorization integration tests passed.",
	)
}

func createScope(
	t *testing.T,

			TRUE
		)
		RETURNING id::text

		resourceID,
	).Scan(&scopeID)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to create scope: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	return scopeID
}

		)
	}

	)

function Ensure-Directory {
    param (
        [string]$Path
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null
    }
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if ($directory) {
        Ensure-Directory $directory
    }

    $encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        $encoding
    )
}

function Backup-IfExists {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$BackupRoot
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        return
    }

    $name = Split-Path $Path -Leaf

    Copy-Item `
        $Path `
        (Join-Path $BackupRoot ($name + ".bak")) `
        -Force
}

# 6. Auth repository

$authRepository = @'
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type Repository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewRepository(db *postgres.Client) *Repository {
	return &Repository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *Repository) Register(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *RegistrationRequest,
	passwordHash string,
) (*RegistrationResponse, error) {

	if r == nil || r.db == nil || r.db.Pool == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("auth repository is nil")
	}

	tx, err := r.db.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)

	var userID string
	var status string
	var createdAt string

	userQuery := `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_type
		)
		VALUES ($1)
		RETURNING
			id,
			status,
			created_at::text
	`

	err = tx.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		userQuery,
		request.UserType,
	).Scan(
		&userID,
		&status,
		&createdAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	profileQuery := `
		INSERT INTO user_profiles (
			user_id,
			first_name,
			last_name,
			national_id,
			birth_date,
			father_name,
			address,
			postal_code
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2,
			$3,
			$4,
			$5::date,
			$6,
			$7,
			$8
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		profileQuery,
		userID,
		request.FirstName,
		request.LastName,
		request.NationalID,
		request.BirthDate,
		request.FatherName,
		request.Address,
		request.PostalCode,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	phoneQuery := `
		INSERT INTO user_phones (
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2,
			TRUE,
			FALSE
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		phoneQuery,
		userID,
		request.PhoneNumber,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if request.Email != "" {

		emailQuery := `
			INSERT INTO user_emails (
				user_id,
				email,
				is_primary,
				is_verified
			)
			VALUES (
				$1,
				$2,
				TRUE,
				FALSE
			)
		`

		_, err = tx.Exec(
			ctx,
			emailQuery,
			userID,
			request.Email,
		)

		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	credentialQuery := `
		INSERT INTO auth_credentials (
			user_id,
			password_hash
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		credentialQuery,
		userID,
		passwordHash,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	parsedCreatedAt := timeFromString(createdAt)

	return &RegistrationResponse{
		UserID:        userID,
		UserType:      request.UserType,
		Status:        status,
		PhoneVerified: false,
		CreatedAt:     parsedCreatedAt,
	}, nil
}

func timeFromString(value string) time.Time {
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)

	return parsed
}
'@

$authRepository = $authRepository.Replace(

# 7. Auth service + password hashing
# ============================================================

$authService = @'
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

type Service struct {
	repository *Repository
}

func NewService(repository *Repository) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repository: repository,
	}
}

func (s *Service) Register(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *RegistrationRequest,
) (*RegistrationResponse, error) {

	if s == nil || s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("auth repository is nil")
	}

	if request == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("registration request is required")
	}

	request.UserType = strings.TrimSpace(request.UserType)
	request.NationalID = strings.TrimSpace(request.NationalID)
	request.FirstName = strings.TrimSpace(request.FirstName)
	request.LastName = strings.TrimSpace(request.LastName)
	request.FatherName = strings.TrimSpace(request.FatherName)
	request.BirthDate = strings.TrimSpace(request.BirthDate)
	request.PhoneNumber = strings.TrimSpace(request.PhoneNumber)
	request.Email = strings.TrimSpace(
		strings.ToLower(request.Email),
	)
	request.Address = strings.TrimSpace(request.Address)
	request.PostalCode = strings.TrimSpace(request.PostalCode)

	if request.UserType != "individual" {
		return nil, errors.New(
			"only individual registration is supported in auth v1",
		)
	}

	if !validNationalID(request.NationalID) {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid national id")
	}

	if request.FirstName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("first name is required")
	}

	if request.LastName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("last name is required")
	}

	if request.FatherName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("father name is required")
	}

	if request.BirthDate == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("birth date is required")
	}

	if !validPhone(request.PhoneNumber) {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid phone number")
	}

	if request.Address == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("address is required")
	}

	if !validPostalCode(request.PostalCode) {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid postal code")
	}

	if len(request.Password) < 8 {
		return nil, errors.New(
			"password must be at least 8 characters",
		)
	}

	passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword(
		[]byte(request.Password),
		bcrypt.DefaultCost,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return s.repository.Register(
		ctx,
		request,
		string(passwordHash),
	)
}

func validNationalID(value string) bool {

	if !regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{10}$`).MatchString(value) {
		return false
	}

	allSame := true

	for i := 1; i < len(value); i++ {
		if value[i] != value[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}

	if allSame {
		return false
	}

	sum := 0

	for i := 0; i < 9; i++ {
		sum += int(value[i]-'0') * (10 - i)
	}

	remainder := sum % 11
	check := int(value[9] - '0')

	if remainder < 2 {
		return check == remainder
	}

	return check == 11-remainder
}

func validPhone(value string) bool {
	return regexp.MustCompile(
		`^09[0-9]{9}$`,
	).MatchString(value)
}

func validPostalCode(value string) bool {
	return regexp.MustCompile(
		`^[0-9]{10}$`,
	).MatchString(value)
}
'@

Write-Utf8NoBom `
    -Path ".\internal\auth\service.go" `
    -Content $authService

$authHandler = @'
package auth

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		service: service,
	}
}

func (h *Handler) Register(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	if h == nil || h.service == nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusInternalServerError,
			"auth service is unavailable",
		)
		return
	}

	var request RegistrationRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(
		r.Body,
	).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	result, err := h.service.Register(
		r.Context(),
		&request,
	)

	if err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			err.Error(),
		)
		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusCreated,
		result,
	)
}

func writeJSON(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	statusCode int,
	data any,
) {
	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(statusCode)

	_ = json.NewEncoder(
		w,
	).Encode(data)
}

func writeJSONError(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	statusCode int,
	message string,
) {
	writeJSON(
		w,
		statusCode,
		map[string]string{
			"error": message,
		},
	)
}
'@

Write-Utf8NoBom `
    -Path ".\internal\auth\handler.go" `
    -Content $authHandler

# ============================================================
# HELPER
# ============================================================

function Find-Line {
    param(
        [string[]]$Content,
        [string]$Text
    )

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Content.Count; $i++) {

        if ($Content[$i].Trim() -eq $Text) {
            return $i
        }
    }

    return -1
}

# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Removing old authHandler initialization" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$authHandlerStart = Find-Line `
    -Content $lines `
    -Text 'authHandler := auth.NewHandler('

if ($authHandlerStart -lt 0) {
    throw "authHandler initialization not found."
}

$authHandlerEnd = -1

for (
    $i = $authHandlerStart + 1;
    $i -lt $lines.Count;
    $i++
) {

    if ($lines[$i].Trim() -eq ")") {
        $authHandlerEnd = $i
        break
    }
}

if ($authHandlerEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "Could not find end of authHandler initialization."
}


$newLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

    if (
        $i -ge $authHandlerStart -and
        $i -le $authHandlerEnd
    ) {
        continue
    }

    $newLines.Add($lines[$i])
}

$lines = $newLines.ToArray()

Write-Host "[OK] Old authHandler removed." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 2
# FIND VERIFICATION SERVICE
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Locating verificationService" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$verificationStart = Find-Line `
    -Content $lines `
    -Text 'verificationService := verification.NewService('

if ($verificationStart -lt 0) {
    throw "verificationService initialization not found."
}

$verificationEnd = -1

for (
    $i = $verificationStart + 1;
    $i -lt $lines.Count;
    $i++
) {

    if ($lines[$i].Trim() -eq ")") {
        $verificationEnd = $i
        break
    }
}

if ($verificationEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "Could not find end of verificationService initialization."
}

Write-Host "[OK] verificationService found." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 3
# CREATE LOGIN BLOCK
# ============================================================
#
# IMPORTANT:
# All strings below are SINGLE-QUOTED PowerShell strings.
# Therefore backticks are NOT interpreted.
# ============================================================

$loginBlock = @(
    ''
    "`t// ========================================================="
    "`t// Auth Login"
    "`t// ========================================================="
    ''
    "`tloginRepository := auth.NewLoginRepository("
    "`t`tpostgresClient,"
    "`t)"
    ''
    "`ttrustedDeviceRepository := auth.NewTrustedDeviceRepository("
    "`t`tpostgresClient,"
    "`t)"
    ''
    "`tsessionRepository := auth.NewSessionRepository("
    "`t`tpostgresClient,"
    "`t)"
    ''
    "`tauthAuditRepository := auth.NewAuthAuditRepository("
    "`t`tpostgresClient,"
    "`t)"
    ''
    "`tloginService := auth.NewLoginService("
    "`t`tloginRepository,"
    "`t`tverificationService,"
    "`t`ttrustedDeviceRepository,"
    "`t`tsessionRepository,"
    "`t`tauthAuditRepository,"
    "`t`t" + '"' + "test-provider" + '"' + ","
    "`t)"
    ''
    "`tauthHandler := auth.NewHandler("
    "`t`tauthService,"
    "`t`tloginService,"
    "`t)"
)


# ============================================================
# STEP 4
# INSERT LOGIN BLOCK
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Adding Login dependencies" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$result = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

    $result.Add($lines[$i])

    if ($i -eq $verificationEnd) {

        foreach ($loginLine in $loginBlock) {
            $result.Add($loginLine)
        }
    }
}

$lines = $result.ToArray()

Write-Host "[OK] Login dependencies added." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 5
# ADD LOGIN ROUTE
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Adding Login route" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$loginRouteExists = $false

foreach ($line in $lines) {

    if ($line.Trim() -eq '"/api/v1/auth/login",') {
        $loginRouteExists = $true
        break
    }
}

if ($loginRouteExists) {

    Write-Host "[INFO] Login route already exists." -ForegroundColor Gray

}
else {

    $registerHandlerIndex = Find-Line `
        -Content $lines `
        -Text 'authHandler.Register,'

    if ($registerHandlerIndex -lt 0) {
        throw "Registration route handler not found."
    }

    $registerRouteEnd = -1

    for (
        $i = $registerHandlerIndex + 1;
        $i -lt $lines.Count;
        $i++
    ) {

        if ($lines[$i].Trim() -eq ")") {
            $registerRouteEnd = $i
            break
        }
    }

    if ($registerRouteEnd -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not find end of Registration route."
    }

    $loginRoute = @(
        ''
        "`tmux.HandleFunc("
        "`t`t" + '"' + "/api/v1/auth/login" + '"' + ","
        "`t`tauthHandler.Login,"
        "`t)"
    )

    $result = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        $result.Add($lines[$i])

        if ($i -eq $registerRouteEnd) {

            foreach ($routeLine in $loginRoute) {
                $result.Add($routeLine)
            }
        }
    }

    $lines = $result.ToArray()

    Write-Host "[OK] Login route added." -ForegroundColor Green
}


# ============================================================
# STEP 6
# WRITE FILE
# ============================================================

Set-Content `
    -Path $mainFile `
    -Value $lines `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[OK] main.go written." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 7
# CHECK FOR ILLEGAL CONTROL CHARACTERS
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Checking for illegal control characters" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$rawBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($mainFile)

$illegalFound = $false

foreach ($byte in $rawBytes) {

    # UTF-8 BOM is allowed.
    # Tab = 9
    # LF  = 10
    # CR  = 13
    # Other ASCII control chars are not allowed.
    if (
        $byte -lt 32 -and
        $byte -ne 9 -and
        $byte -ne 10 -and
        $byte -ne 13
    ) {

        $illegalFound = $true

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[ERROR] Illegal control character detected: $byte" -ForegroundColor Red

        break
    }
}

if ($illegalFound) {

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Restoring main.go..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

    Copy-Item `
        -Path $safetyBackup `
        -Destination $mainFile `
        -Force

    exit 1
}

Write-Host "[OK] No illegal control characters found." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 8
# GOFMT
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Running gofmt" -ForegroundColor Yellow

Push-Location $projectDir

try {

    gofmt -w .\cmd\server\main.go

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[ERROR] gofmt failed." -ForegroundColor Red

        Copy-Item `
            -Path $safetyBackup `
            -Destination $mainFile `
            -Force

        exit 1
    }

}
finally {

    Pop-Location
}

Write-Host "[OK] gofmt passed." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 9
# SOURCE VALIDATION
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Validating Login integration" -ForegroundColor Yellow

$finalText = Get-Content `
    -Path $mainFile `
    -Raw


$finalChecks = @(
    "auth.NewLoginRepository(",
    "auth.NewTrustedDeviceRepository(",
    "auth.NewSessionRepository(",
    "auth.NewAuthAuditRepository(",
    "auth.NewLoginService(",
    "verificationService",
    "auth.NewHandler(",
    "loginService,",
    '"/api/v1/auth/login"',
    "authHandler.Login,"
)

foreach ($check in $finalChecks) {

    if ($finalText.IndexOf(
        $check,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    ) -lt 0) {

        Write-Host "[ERROR] Missing: $check" -ForegroundColor Red

        Copy-Item `
            -Path $safetyBackup `
            -Destination $mainFile `
            -Force

        exit 1
    }

    Write-Host "[OK] $check" -ForegroundColor Green
}


# ============================================================
# EXACTLY ONE AUTH HANDLER
# ============================================================

$handlerCount = (
    [regex]::Matches(
        $finalText,
        "authHandler\s*:=\s*auth\.NewHandler"
    )
).Count

if ($handlerCount -ne 1) {

    Write-Host "[ERROR] authHandler count = $handlerCount" -ForegroundColor Red

    Copy-Item `
        -Path $safetyBackup `
        -Destination $mainFile `
        -Force

    exit 1
}

Write-Host "[OK] Exactly one authHandler initialization." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# EXACTLY ONE LOGIN ROUTE
# ============================================================

$loginRouteCount = (
    [regex]::Matches(
        $finalText,
        '/api/v1/auth/login'
    )
).Count

if ($loginRouteCount -ne 1) {

    Write-Host "[ERROR] Login route count = $loginRouteCount" -ForegroundColor Red

    Copy-Item `
        -Path $safetyBackup `
        -Destination $mainFile `
        -Force

    exit 1
}

Write-Host "[OK] Exactly one Login route." -ForegroundColor Green


# ============================================================
# STEP 10
# GO TEST
# ============================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host ">>> Running go test ./..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

Push-Location $projectDir

try {

    go test ./...

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[ERROR] go test ./... FAILED." -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "The Login integration is present but another Go compilation/test issue remains." -ForegroundColor Yellow

        exit 1
    }

}
finally {

    Pop-Location
}

$migration010Path =

$migration010 = @'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trusted_devices (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    device_name VARCHAR(150),

    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trusted_devices_user_id
    ON trusted_devices(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trusted_devices_expires_at
    ON trusted_devices(expires_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trusted_devices_active
    ON trusted_devices(user_id, expires_at)
    WHERE revoked_at IS NULL;
'@

Set-Content `
    -Path $migration010Path `
    -Value $migration010 `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[OK] Migration 010 created." -ForegroundColor Green

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_sessions_user_id

    ON auth_sessions(access_expires_at);

# Authorization Phase 1
# Project: Real-Asset-Management-Platform
# Module: Account Backend
# PowerShell 5.1 compatible
#
# This script:
#   1. Creates Authorization model files
#   2. Creates repository/service interfaces
#   3. Preserves current architecture
#   4. Does NOT modify main.go
#   5. Does NOT implement middleware or business policies
#   6. Runs gofmt
#   7. Runs go test ./...
# ============================================================

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$authorizationPath = ".\internal\authorization"

if (-not (Test-Path $authorizationPath)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $authorizationPath -Force | Out-Null
}

Write-Host ""


# ============================================================
# model.go
# ============================================================

$modelGo = @'
package authorization

import "time"

// AccountType represents the type of user account.
// Account type is intentionally separate from Role.
type AccountType string

const (
	AccountTypeIndividual AccountType = "individual"
	AccountTypeLegal      AccountType = "legal"
)

// RoleType represents the category of a role.
type RoleType string

const (
	RoleTypeManagement    RoleType = "management"
	RoleTypeOperational   RoleType = "operational"
	RoleTypeBase          RoleType = "base"
	RoleTypeSpecialized   RoleType = "specialized"
	RoleTypeGeneral       RoleType = "general"
	RoleTypeSupervisory   RoleType = "supervisory"
)

// ScopeType represents the authorization scope.
type ScopeType string

const (
	ScopeTypeGlobal        ScopeType = "global"
	ScopeTypeOrganization  ScopeType = "organization"
	ScopeTypeProject       ScopeType = "project"
	ScopeTypeAsset         ScopeType = "asset"
	ScopeTypeContract      ScopeType = "contract"
	ScopeTypeSelf          ScopeType = "self"
	ScopeTypeCustom        ScopeType = "custom"
)

// PermissionEffect determines whether a permission is explicitly allowed or denied.
type PermissionEffect string

const (
	PermissionEffectAllow PermissionEffect = "allow"
	PermissionEffectDeny  PermissionEffect = "deny"
)

// AuthorizationDecision represents the final authorization decision.
type AuthorizationDecision string

const (
	AuthorizationDecisionAllow AuthorizationDecision = "allow"
	AuthorizationDecisionDeny  AuthorizationDecision = "deny"
)

// Role represents an authorization role.
type Role struct {
	ID                string
	Code              string
	Name              string
	RoleType          RoleType
	DefaultScopeType  ScopeType
	Description       string
	IsSystemRole      bool
	IsActive          bool
	CreatedAt         time.Time
	UpdatedAt         time.Time
}

// Permission represents a resource + action permission.
type Permission struct {
	ID          string
	Code        string
	Resource    string
	Action      string
	Name        string
	Description string
	IsActive    bool
	CreatedAt   time.Time
	UpdatedAt   time.Time
}

// Scope represents an authorization scope.
type Scope struct {
	ID           string
	ScopeType    ScopeType
	ResourceType *string
	ResourceID   *string
	ParentScopeID *string
	Name         string
	Description  string
	IsActive     bool
	CreatedAt    time.Time
	UpdatedAt    time.Time
}

// AuthorizationRequest represents an authorization check request.
type AuthorizationRequest struct {
	UserID       string
	Permission   string
	ResourceType string
	ResourceID   *string
	ScopeID      *string
}

// AuthorizationResult represents the result of an authorization decision.
type AuthorizationResult struct {
	Decision AuthorizationDecision
	Reason   string
}

// UserRole represents a role assigned to a user.
type UserRole struct {
	ID         string
	UserID     string
	RoleID     string
	ScopeID    *string
	AssignedBy *string
	StartsAt   time.Time
	ExpiresAt  *time.Time
	IsActive   bool
	CreatedAt  time.Time
	UpdatedAt  time.Time
}

// UserPermissionOverride represents an explicit allow/deny override.
type UserPermissionOverride struct {
	ID           string
	UserID       string
	PermissionID string
	Effect       PermissionEffect
	ScopeID      *string
	AssignedBy   *string
	StartsAt     time.Time
	ExpiresAt    *time.Time
	Reason       string
	IsActive     bool
	CreatedAt    time.Time
	UpdatedAt    time.Time
}
'@

Set-Content `
    -Path "$authorizationPath\model.go" `
    -Value $modelGo `
    -Encoding UTF8

# ============================================================
# permission.go
# ============================================================

$permissionGo = @'
package authorization

// Repository is the main PostgreSQL repository for Authorization.

}

// NewRepository creates a new Authorization repository.

	GetByID(roleID string) (*Role, error)
	GetByCode(code string) (*Role, error)

}

// Repository-level contracts for permissions.
type PermissionRepository interface {

	GetByCode(code string) (*Permission, error)

}

// AuthorizationService is the main authorization decision boundary.

		PermissionOverrideRepository: permissionOverrideRepository,

//

//

func (s *AuthorizationService) Authorize(
	request AuthorizationRequest,

# ============================================================
# 1. Create middleware.go
# ============================================================

$middlewareGo = @'
package authorization

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"account-backend/internal/auth"
)

type authorizationContextKey string

const userIDContextKey authorizationContextKey = "authorization.user_id"

// ResourceIDResolver resolves the resource being accessed.
type ResourceIDResolver func(
	r *http.Request,
	userID string,
) *string

// ScopeIDResolver resolves the authorization scope.
type ScopeIDResolver func(
	r *http.Request,
	userID string,
) *string

// Middleware connects authenticated Auth sessions to Authorization.
type Middleware struct {
	sessionService     *auth.SessionService
	authorizationService *AuthorizationService
}

// NewMiddleware creates the Authorization middleware.
func NewMiddleware(
	sessionService *auth.SessionService,
	authorizationService *AuthorizationService,
) *Middleware {
	return &Middleware{
		sessionService:       sessionService,
		authorizationService: authorizationService,
	}
}

// Require applies a permission requirement to an HTTP handler.
func (m *Middleware) Require(
	permission string,
	resourceType string,
	resourceIDResolver ResourceIDResolver,
	scopeIDResolver ScopeIDResolver,
	next http.Handler,
) http.Handler {

	return http.HandlerFunc(
		func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

			if m == nil ||
				m.sessionService == nil ||
				m.authorizationService == nil {

				writeAuthorizationError(
					w,
					http.StatusInternalServerError,
					"authorization middleware is not configured",
				)

				return
			}

			accessToken := extractBearerToken(
				r.Header.Get("Authorization"),
			)

			if accessToken == "" {
				writeAuthorizationError(
					w,
					http.StatusUnauthorized,
					"access token is required",
				)

				return
			}

			sessionResult, err :=
				m.sessionService.ValidateAccessToken(
					r.Context(),
					accessToken,
				)

			if err != nil {

				switch {
				case errors.Is(err, auth.ErrSessionNotFound),
					errors.Is(err, auth.ErrSessionRevoked),
					errors.Is(err, auth.ErrSessionExpired),
					errors.Is(err, auth.ErrEmptyAccessToken),
					errors.Is(err, auth.ErrInvalidToken):

					writeAuthorizationError(
						w,
						http.StatusUnauthorized,
						"invalid access token",
					)

				default:

					log.Printf(
						"authorization session validation error: %v",
						err,
					)

					writeAuthorizationError(
						w,
						http.StatusInternalServerError,
						"internal server error",
					)
				}

				return
			}

			if sessionResult == nil ||
				sessionResult.Session == nil ||
				!sessionResult.Valid {

				writeAuthorizationError(
					w,
					http.StatusUnauthorized,
					"invalid access token",
				)

				return
			}

			userID := sessionResult.Session.UserID

			var resourceID *string

			if resourceIDResolver != nil {
				resourceID = resourceIDResolver(
					r,
					userID,
				)
			}

			var scopeID *string

			if scopeIDResolver != nil {
				scopeID = scopeIDResolver(
					r,
					userID,
				)
			}

			result, err :=
				m.authorizationService.Authorize(
					r.Context(),
					AuthorizationRequest{
						UserID:       userID,
						Permission:   permission,
						ResourceType: resourceType,
						ResourceID:   resourceID,
						ScopeID:      scopeID,
					},
				)

			if err != nil {

				log.Printf(
					"authorization decision error: %v",
					err,
				)

				writeAuthorizationError(
					w,
					http.StatusInternalServerError,
					"internal server error",
				)

				return
			}

			if result.Decision != AuthorizationDecisionAllow {

				writeAuthorizationError(
					w,
					http.StatusForbidden,
					"access denied",
				)

				return
			}

			requestWithIdentity := r.WithContext(
				context.WithValue(
					r.Context(),
					userIDContextKey,
					userID,
				),
			)

			next.ServeHTTP(
				w,
				requestWithIdentity,
			)
		},
	)
}

// RequireSelf protects an endpoint for a user's own resource.
func (m *Middleware) RequireSelf(
	permission string,
	next http.Handler,
) http.Handler {

	return m.Require(
		permission,
		"user",
		func(
			_ *http.Request,
			userID string,
		) *string {

			return &userID
		},
		nil,
		next,
	)
}

// UserIDFromContext returns the authenticated user ID.
func UserIDFromContext(
	ctx context.Context,
) (string, bool) {

	value := ctx.Value(userIDContextKey)

	userID, ok := value.(string)

	return userID, ok
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Bearer token
// ------------------------------------------------------------

func extractBearerToken(
	authorization string,
) string {

	authorization = strings.TrimSpace(
		authorization,
	)

	if authorization == "" {
		return ""
	}

	const prefix = "Bearer "

	if !strings.HasPrefix(
		authorization,
		prefix,
	) {
		return ""
	}

	return strings.TrimSpace(
		strings.TrimPrefix(
			authorization,
			prefix,
		),
	)
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// JSON error
// ------------------------------------------------------------

func writeAuthorizationError(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	status int,
	message string,
) {

	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(status)

	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(
		map[string]string{
			"error": message,
		},
	)
}
'@

Set-Content `
	-Path "$authorizationPath\middleware.go" `
	-Value $middlewareGo `
	-Encoding UTF8


# ============================================================
# 2. Create handler.go
# ============================================================

$handlerGo = @'
package authorization

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// Handler exposes minimal Authorization endpoints.
//
// This endpoint is intentionally small and is used to verify
// that authentication and authorization are connected correctly.
type Handler struct{}

// NewHandler creates an Authorization handler.
func NewHandler() *Handler {
	return &Handler{}
}

// Me returns the authenticated user identity after Authorization
// middleware has successfully approved the request.
func (h *Handler) Me(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {

	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writeAuthorizationError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)

		return
	}

	userID, ok := UserIDFromContext(
		r.Context(),
	)

	if !ok || userID == "" {
		writeAuthorizationError(
			w,
			http.StatusUnauthorized,
			"user identity is missing",
		)

		return
	}

	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(
		map[string]interface{}{
			"authorized": true,
			"user_id":    userID,
			"permission": PermissionUserRead,
		},
	)
}
'@

Set-Content `
	-Path "$authorizationPath\handler.go" `
	-Value $handlerGo `
	-Encoding UTF8

# 3. Create Middleware integration tests
# ============================================================

$middlewareTestGo = @'
package authorization

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
	"account-backend/internal/auth"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

func TestAuthorizationMiddlewarePostgreSQL(
	t *testing.T,
) {

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
		context.Background(),
		20*time.Second,
	)

	defer cancel()

	pool, err := pgxpool.New(
		ctx,
		"postgres://account:[REDACTED]@localhost:5432/account?sslmode=disable",
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to connect to PostgreSQL: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	defer pool.Close()

	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to ping PostgreSQL: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	db := postgres.NewClient(pool)

	sessionRepository := auth.NewSessionRepository(db)
	sessionService := auth.NewSessionService(
		sessionRepository,
	)

	authorizationRepository := NewRepository(db)

	authorizationService := NewAuthorizationService(
		authorizationRepository,
		authorizationRepository,
		authorizationRepository,
		authorizationRepository,
		authorizationRepository,
	)

	middleware := NewMiddleware(
		sessionService,
		authorizationService,
	)

	userID := createAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
		t,
		ctx,
		pool,
	)

	defer cleanupAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
		ctx,
		pool,
		userID,
	)

	role, err := authorizationRepository.GetRoleByCode(
		ctx,
		RoleUser,
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to load user role: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	assignAuthorizationMiddlewareRole(
		t,
		ctx,
		pool,
		userID,
		role.ID,
	)

	accessToken, _, _, err :=
		sessionRepository.Create(
			ctx,
			userID,
		)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to create test session: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	handler := middleware.RequireSelf(
		PermissionUserRead,
		http.HandlerFunc(
			func(
				w http.ResponseWriter,
				r *http.Request,
			) {

				contextUserID, ok :=
					UserIDFromContext(
						r.Context(),
					)

				if !ok ||
					contextUserID != userID {

					t.Errorf(
						"unexpected user id in context",
					)

					http.Error(
						w,
						"identity mismatch",
						http.StatusInternalServerError,
					)

					return
				}

				w.WriteHeader(
					http.StatusOK,
				)
			},
		),
	)

	// --------------------------------------------------------
	// Valid token + valid role = ALLOW
	// --------------------------------------------------------

	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/",
		nil,
	)

	request.Header.Set(
		"Authorization",
		"Bearer "+accessToken,
	)

	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(
		response,
		request,
	)

	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected 200, got %d",
			response.Code,
		)
	}

	// --------------------------------------------------------
	// Missing token = 401
	// --------------------------------------------------------

	request = httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/",
		nil,
	)

	response = httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(
		response,
		request,
	)

	if response.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected 401 for missing token, got %d",
			response.Code,
		)
	}

	// --------------------------------------------------------
	// Revoke session = 401
	// --------------------------------------------------------

	if err := sessionRepository.Revoke(
		ctx,
		getSessionID(
			t,
			ctx,
			pool,
			accessToken,
		),
	); err != nil {

		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to revoke session: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	request = httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/",
		nil,
	)

	request.Header.Set(
		"Authorization",
		"Bearer "+accessToken,
	)

	response = httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(
		response,
		request,
	)

	if response.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected 401 after session revocation, got %d",
			response.Code,
		)
	}

	// --------------------------------------------------------
	// User without role = 403
	// --------------------------------------------------------

	userWithoutRole := createAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
		t,
		ctx,
		pool,
	)

	defer cleanupAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
		ctx,
		pool,
		userWithoutRole,
	)

	accessToken2, _, _, err :=
		sessionRepository.Create(
			ctx,
			userWithoutRole,
		)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to create second test session: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	request = httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/",
		nil,
	)

	request.Header.Set(
		"Authorization",
		"Bearer "+accessToken2,
	)

	response = httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.ServeHTTP(
		response,
		request,
	)

	if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf(
			"expected 403 for authenticated user without permission, got %d",
			response.Code,
		)
	}
}

func createAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
) string {

	t.Helper()

	var userID string

	err := pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		`
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_type
		)
		VALUES (
			'individual'
		)
		RETURNING id::text
		`,
	).Scan(&userID)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to create middleware test user: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	return userID
}

func assignAuthorizationMiddlewareRole(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
	userID string,
	roleID string,
) {

	t.Helper()

	_, err := pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		INSERT INTO authorization_user_roles
		(
			user_id,
			role_id,
			starts_at,
			is_active
		)
		VALUES
		(
			$1::uuid,
			$2::uuid,
			NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute',
			TRUE
		)
		`,
		userID,
		roleID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to assign user role: %v",
			err,
		)
	}
}

func getSessionID(
	t *testing.T,
	ctx context.Context,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
	accessToken string,
) string {

	t.Helper()

	var sessionID string

	err := pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		`
		SELECT id::text
		FROM auth_sessions
		WHERE access_token_hash =
			encode(
				digest($1, 'sha256'),
				'hex'
			)
		`,
		accessToken,
	).Scan(&sessionID)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf(
			"failed to find session id: %v",
			err,
		)
	}

	return sessionID
}

func cleanupAuthorizationMiddlewareUser(
	ctx context.Context,
	pool *pgxpool.Pool,
	userID string,
) {

	_, _ = pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		DELETE FROM authorization_user_permission_overrides
		WHERE user_id = $1::uuid
		`,
		userID,
	)

	_, _ = pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		DELETE FROM authorization_user_roles
		WHERE user_id = $1::uuid
		`,
		userID,
	)

	_, _ = pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		DELETE FROM auth_sessions
		WHERE user_id = $1::uuid
		`,
		userID,
	)

	_, _ = pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		DELETE FROM users
		WHERE id = $1::uuid
		`,
		userID,
	)
}

package auth

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type PasswordRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewPasswordRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *PasswordRepository {
	return &PasswordRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *PasswordRepository) GetPasswordHash(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) (string, error) {
	if r == nil || r.db == nil || r.db.Pool == nil {
		return "", errors.New("password repository is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return "", errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	var passwordHash string

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		`
		SELECT password_hash
		FROM auth_credentials
		WHERE user_id = $1
		`,
		userID,
	).Scan(&passwordHash)

	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to get password hash: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return passwordHash, nil
}

func (r *PasswordRepository) UpdatePassword(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	passwordHash string,
) error {
	if r == nil || r.db == nil || r.db.Pool == nil {
		return errors.New("password repository is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if passwordHash == "" {
		return errors.New("password hash is empty")
	}

	now := time.Now()

	commandTag, err := r.db.Pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		UPDATE auth_credentials
		SET
			password_hash = $2,
			password_changed_at = $3,
			failed_login_attempts = 0,
			locked_until = NULL,
			updated_at = $3
		WHERE user_id = $1
		`,
		userID,
		passwordHash,
		now,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to update password:[REDACTED],
			err,
		)
	}

	if commandTag.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return errors.New(
			"auth credentials not found",
		)
	}

	return nil
}
'@

$passwordServiceContent = @'
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

var (
	ErrCurrentPasswordRequired = errors.New(
		"current password is required",
	)

	ErrNewPasswordRequired = errors.New(
		"new password is required",
	)

	ErrCurrentPasswordIncorrect = errors.New(
		"current password is incorrect",
	)

	ErrNewPasswordTooShort = errors.New(
		"new password is too short",
	)

	ErrNewPasswordSameAsCurrent = errors.New(
		"new password must be different from current password",
	)
)

const minimumPasswordLength = 8

type PasswordService struct {
	repository     *PasswordRepository
	sessionService *SessionService
}

func NewPasswordService(
	repository *PasswordRepository,
	sessionService *SessionService,
) *PasswordService {
	return &PasswordService{
		repository:     repository,
		sessionService: sessionService,
	}
}

func (s *PasswordService) ChangePassword(
	ctx context.Context,
	accessToken string,
	currentPassword string,
	newPassword string,
) error {
	if s == nil ||
		s.repository == nil ||
		s.sessionService == nil {
		return errors.New("password service is nil")
	}

	if currentPassword=[REDACTED] "" {
		return ErrCurrentPasswordRequired
	}

	if newPassword=[REDACTED] "" {
		return ErrNewPasswordRequired
	}

	if len(newPassword) < minimumPasswordLength {
		return ErrNewPasswordTooShort
	}

	if currentPassword=[REDACTED] newPassword {
		return ErrNewPasswordSameAsCurrent
	}

	sessionResult, err := s.sessionService.ValidateAccessToken(
		ctx,
		accessToken,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to validate session: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	if sessionResult == nil ||
		sessionResult.Session == nil ||
		!sessionResult.Valid {
		return ErrSessionNotFound
	}

	userID := sessionResult.Session.UserID

	currentHash, err := s.repository.GetPasswordHash(
		ctx,
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword(
		[]byte(currentHash),
		[]byte(currentPassword),
	); err != nil {
		return ErrCurrentPasswordIncorrect
	}

	newHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword(
		[]byte(newPassword),
		bcrypt.DefaultCost,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to hash new password:[REDACTED],
			err,
		)
	}

	if err := s.repository.UpdatePassword(
		ctx,
		userID,
		string(newHash),
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Security rule:
	// Changing the password invalidates all existing sessions.
	if err := s.sessionService.LogoutAllDevices(
		ctx,
		userID,
	); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to revoke sessions after password change: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return nil
}
'@

Set-Content `
    -Path $passwordServiceFile `
    -Value $passwordServiceContent `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[OK] password_service.go created."
