$passwordHandlerContent = @'
package auth

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

type PasswordHandler struct {
	service *PasswordService
}

func NewPasswordHandler(
	service *PasswordService,
) *PasswordHandler {
	return &PasswordHandler{
		service: service,
	}
}

func (h *PasswordHandler) ChangePassword(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	accessToken := extractBearerToken(
		r.Header.Get("Authorization"),
	)

	if accessToken == "" {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusUnauthorized,
			"access token is required",
		)
		return
	}

	var request ChangePasswordRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	err := h.service.ChangePassword(
		r.Context(),
		accessToken,
		request.CurrentPassword,
		request.NewPassword,
	)

	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, ErrCurrentPasswordRequired),
			errors.Is(err, ErrNewPasswordRequired),
			errors.Is(err, ErrNewPasswordTooShort),
			errors.Is(err, ErrNewPasswordSameAsCurrent):

			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusBadRequest,
				err.Error(),
			)

		case errors.Is(err, ErrCurrentPasswordIncorrect):

			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusUnauthorized,
				"current password is incorrect",
			)

		case errors.Is(err, ErrSessionNotFound),
			errors.Is(err, ErrSessionRevoked),
			errors.Is(err, ErrSessionExpired),
			errors.Is(err, ErrEmptyAccessToken):

			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusUnauthorized,
				"invalid access token",
			)

		default:

			log.Printf(
				"auth password change internal error: %v",
				err,
			)

			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusInternalServerError,
				"internal server error",
			)
		}

		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusOK,
		ChangePasswordResponse{
			Message: "password changed successfully",
		},
	)
}
'@

# ============================================================
# 5A. Add Password Repository / Service / Handler
# ============================================================

$hasPasswordRepository = $false
$hasPasswordService = $false
$hasPasswordHandler = $false

foreach ($line in $lines) {

    if ($line -match 'passwordRepository\s*:=\s*auth\.NewPasswordRepository') {
        $hasPasswordRepository = $true
    }

    if ($line -match 'passwordService\s*:=\s*auth\.NewPasswordService') {
        $hasPasswordService = $true
    }

    if ($line -match 'passwordHandler\s*:=\s*auth\.NewPasswordHandler') {
        $hasPasswordHandler = $true
    }
}

if (
    $hasPasswordRepository -and
    $hasPasswordService -and
    $hasPasswordHandler
) {

    Write-Host "[SKIP] Password dependencies already exist."

}
else {

    # Find SessionHandler initialization.
    $sessionHandlerIndex = -1

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        if (
            $lines[$i] -match
            'sessionHandler\s*:=\s*auth\.NewSessionHandler'
        ) {
            $sessionHandlerIndex = $i
            break
        }
    }

    if ($sessionHandlerIndex -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not find sessionHandler initialization in main.go."
    }

    # Find end of SessionHandler constructor.
    $endIndex = $sessionHandlerIndex

    while ($endIndex -lt $lines.Count) {

        if ($lines[$endIndex] -match '^\s*\)\s*$') {
            break
        }

        $endIndex++
    }

    if ($endIndex -ge $lines.Count) {
        throw "Could not find end of sessionHandler initialization."
    }

    $insert = @(
        ""
        "        passwordRepository := auth.NewPasswordRepository("
        "                postgresClient,"
        "        )"
        ""
        "        passwordService := auth.NewPasswordService("
        "                passwordRepository,"
        "                sessionService,"
        "        )"
        ""
        "        passwordHandler := auth.NewPasswordHandler("
        "                passwordService,"
        "        )"
    )

    $newLines = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        [void]$newLines.Add($lines[$i])

        if ($i -eq $endIndex) {

            foreach ($insertLine in $insert) {
                [void]$newLines.Add($insertLine)
            }
        }
    }

    $lines = @($newLines)

    Write-Host "[OK] Password dependencies added."
}

# ============================================================
# 5B. Add Change Password Route
# ============================================================

$hasPasswordRoute = $false

foreach ($line in $lines) {

    if ($line -match '"/api/v1/auth/password/change"') {
        $hasPasswordRoute = $true
        break
    }
}

if ($hasPasswordRoute) {

    Write-Host "[SKIP] Password route already exists."

}
else {

    # Find Logout All Devices route.
    $logoutAllRouteIndex = -1

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        if (
            $lines[$i] -match
            '"/api/v1/auth/logout-all"'

            $logoutAllRouteIndex = $i
            break
        }

    if ($logoutAllRouteIndex -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not find logout-all route in main.go."
    }

    # Find end of Logout All Devices route.
    $endIndex = $logoutAllRouteIndex

    while ($endIndex -lt $lines.Count) {

        if ($lines[$endIndex] -match '^\s*\)\s*$') {
            break
        }

        $endIndex++
    }

    if ($endIndex -ge $lines.Count) {
        throw "Could not find end of logout-all route."
    }

    $insert = @(
        ""
        "        mux.HandleFunc("
        "                ""/api/v1/auth/password/change"","
        "                passwordHandler.ChangePassword,"
        "        )"
    )

    $newLines = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

            foreach ($insertLine in $insert) {
                [void]$newLines.Add($insertLine)
            }
        }
    }

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 1. Add SessionService
# ============================================================

foreach ($line in $lines) {
    if ($line -match 'sessionService\s*:=\s*auth\.NewSessionService') {
        $hasSessionService = $true
        break
    }
}

if ($hasSessionService) {

    Write-Host "[SKIP] SessionService already exists."

}
else {

    $repositoryIndex = -1

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        if ($lines[$i] -match 'sessionRepository\s*:=\s*auth\.NewSessionRepository') {
            $repositoryIndex = $i
            break
        }
    }

    if ($repositoryIndex -lt 0) {
        throw "Could not find sessionRepository initialization in main.go."
    }

    # Find end of NewSessionRepository(...) call.
    $endIndex = $repositoryIndex

    while ($endIndex -lt $lines.Count) {

        if ($lines[$endIndex] -match '^\s*\)\s*$') {
            break
        }

        $endIndex++
    }

    if ($endIndex -ge $lines.Count) {
        throw "Could not find end of sessionRepository initialization."
    }

    $insert = @(
        ""
        "        sessionService := auth.NewSessionService("
        "                sessionRepository,"
        "        )"
    )

    $newLines = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {

        [void]$newLines.Add($lines[$i])

        if ($i -eq $endIndex) {

            foreach ($insertLine in $insert) {
                [void]$newLines.Add($insertLine)
            }
        }
    }

    $lines = @($newLines)

    Write-Host "[OK] SessionService added."
}

# ============================================================
# 2. Add SessionHandler

# ============================================================
# HTTP API HELPER
# ============================================================

function Invoke-Api {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [ValidateSet("GET", "POST")]
        [string]$Method,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Uri,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
        [object]$Body
    )

    $jsonBody = $null

    if ($null -ne $Body) {

        $jsonBody =
            $Body |
            ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20
    }

    try {

        if ($Method -eq "GET") {

            $response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Method GET `
                -Uri $Uri `
                -UseBasicParsing `
                -Headers @{
                    Accept = "application/json"
                }

        }
        else {

            $response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Method POST `
                -Uri $Uri `
                -UseBasicParsing `
                -ContentType "application/json" `
                -Headers @{
                    Accept = "application/json"
                } `
                -Body $jsonBody
        }

        $parsedBody = $null

        if (
            -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                $response.Content
            )
        ) {

            try {

                $parsedBody =
                    $response.Content |
                    ConvertFrom-Json

            }
            catch {

                $parsedBody =
                    $response.Content
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Body       = $parsedBody
            RawBody    = $response.Content
        }
    }
    catch {

        $statusCode = 0
        $rawBody = ""
        $parsedBody = $null

        if ($null -ne $_.Exception.Response) {

            try {

                $statusCode =
                    [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            catch {

                $statusCode = 0
            }

            try {

                $stream =
                    $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

                if ($null -ne $stream) {

                    $reader =
                        New-Object System.IO.StreamReader(
                            $stream
                        )

                    $rawBody =
                        $reader.ReadToEnd()

                    $reader.Close()
                }
            }
            catch {

                $rawBody = ""
            }

            if (
                -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    $rawBody
                )
            ) {

                try {

                    $parsedBody =
                        $rawBody |
                        ConvertFrom-Json

                }
                catch {

                    $parsedBody =
                        $rawBody
                }
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = $statusCode
            Body       = $parsedBody
            RawBody    = $rawBody
        }
    }
}


# ============================================================
# VALID IRANIAN NATIONAL ID
# ============================================================

function Get-ValidNationalId {

    while ($true) {

        $digits = @()

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $digits +=
                Get-Random `
                    -Minimum 0 `
                    -Maximum 10
        }

        # Reject nine identical digits.
        $allSame = $true

        for ($i = 1; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            if ($digits[$i] -ne $digits[0]) {

                $allSame = $false
                break
            }
        }

        if ($allSame) {
            continue
        }

        $sum = 0

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $sum +=
                $digits[$i] * (10 - $i)
        }

        $remainder = $sum % 11

        if ($remainder -lt 2) {

            $checkDigit = $remainder
        }
        else {

            $checkDigit = 11 - $remainder
        }

        $nationalId =
            ($digits -join "") + $checkDigit

        if ($nationalId -match "^[0-9]{10}$") {

            return $nationalId
        }
    }
}

}

    $lockPhone = Get-TestPhone

$lockRegistrationBody = @{
    user_type    = "individual"
    national_id  = $lockNationalId
    first_name   = "Lock"
    last_name    = "Test"
    father_name  = "TestFather"
    birth_date   = "1995-01-01"
    phone_number = $lockPhone
    address      = "Lock Test Address"
    postal_code  = "1234567890"
    password=[REDACTED]
}

$lockRegistration = Invoke-Api `
    -Method POST `
    -Uri $registerUrl `
    -Body $lockRegistrationBody

if ($lockRegistration.StatusCode -ne 201) {

    Fail-Test "Could not create second user for lock test."

    Write-Host "HTTP: $($lockRegistration.StatusCode)"
    Write-Host "Body: $($lockRegistration.RawBody)"

}
else {

    $lockUserId =
        $lockRegistration.Body.user_id

    Pass-Test "Second test user created for lock test."

    $lockLoginBody = @{
        national_id = $lockNationalId
        password=[REDACTED]
    }

    $lockTriggered = $false

    for (
        $attempt = 1;
        $attempt -le $lockAttempts;
        $attempt++
    ) {

        $lockResponse = Invoke-Api `
            -Method POST `
            -Uri $loginUrl `
            -Body $lockLoginBody

        Info "Lock test attempt $attempt -> HTTP $($lockResponse.StatusCode)"

        if ($lockResponse.StatusCode -eq 423) {

            $lockTriggered = $true

            Pass-Test "Account locked after $attempt failed attempts."

            break
        }

        if ($lockResponse.StatusCode -eq 200) {

            Fail-Test "Wrong password was accepted during lock test."

            break
        }
    }

    if (-not $lockTriggered) {

        Fail-Test "Account was not locked with HTTP 423 after $lockAttempts failed attempts."
    }
}

# ============================================================
# Authorization HTTP End-to-End Test - V2
# Project: Real-Asset-Management-Platform
# PowerShell 5.1 compatible
#
# Tests:
#   1. Health
#   2. Missing token -> 401
#   3. Invalid token -> 401
#   4. Resolve real session -> user
#   5. Temporary user role -> 200
#   6. Explicit DENY -> 403
#   7. Remove DENY -> 200
#   8. Cleanup
#
# Uses:
#   AUTHORIZATION_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN
#
# Does NOT modify source files.
# ============================================================

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$BaseUrl = "http://localhost:8080"

$ContainerName = "account-postgres"

$DbName = "account"

# ============================================================
# Output helpers
# ============================================================

function Write-Section {
    param(
        [string]$Title
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host $Title -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Pass-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    $script:passed++

    Write-Host "[PASS] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function Fail-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    $script:failed++

    Write-Host "[FAIL] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
}


# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL generic command
# ============================================================

function Invoke-Psql {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Sql
    )

    $output = & docker exec `
        $ContainerName `
        psql `
        -X `
        -q `
        -U $DbUser `
        -d $DbName `
        -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 `
        -c $Sql 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

        throw (
            "PostgreSQL query failed:`r`n$Sql`r`n$output"
        )
    }

    return $output
}


# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL scalar command
# ============================================================

function Invoke-PsqlScalar {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Sql
    )

    $output = & docker exec `
        $ContainerName `
        psql `
        -X `
        -q `
        -t `
        -A `
        -U $DbUser `
        -d $DbName `
        -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 `
        -c $Sql 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

        throw (
            "PostgreSQL query failed:`r`n$Sql`r`n$output"
        )
    }

    $lines = @(
        $output |
        ForEach-Object {
            $value = "$_".Trim()

            if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) {
                $value
            }
        }
    )

    if ($lines.Count -eq 0) {
        return ""
    }

    return $lines[0]
}


# ============================================================
# HTTP status helper
# ============================================================

function Get-HttpStatus {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Url,

        [string]$Token = ""
    )

    $headers = @{
        Accept = "application/json"
    }

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Token)) {
        $headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer $Token"
    }

    try {

        $response = Invoke-WebRequest `
            -Method GET `
            -Uri $Url `
            -UseBasicParsing `
            -Headers $headers `
            -ErrorAction Stop

        return [int]$response.StatusCode
    }
    catch {

        if ($null -ne $_.Exception.Response) {

            return [int](
                $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__
            )
        }

        throw
    }
}


function Assert-Status {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [int]$Actual,
        [int]$Expected
    )

    if ($Actual -ne $Expected) {

        throw (
            "$Name failed. Expected HTTP $Expected, " +
            "got HTTP $Actual."
        )
    }

    Pass-Test "$Name -> HTTP $Actual"
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($AccessToken)) {

    throw (
        "AUTHORIZATION_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set."
    )

# ============================================================
# Main test
# ============================================================

try {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Health
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "1. Server Health"

    $healthStatus = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url "$($BaseUrl.TrimEnd('/'))/health"

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Health endpoint" `
        -Actual $healthStatus `
        -Expected 200


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Missing token
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "2. Missing Access Token"

    $status = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url $Endpoint

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Missing access token" `
        -Actual $status `
        -Expected 401


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Invalid token
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "3. Invalid Access Token"

    $status = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url $Endpoint `
        -Token "invalid-access-token-for-test"

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Invalid access token" `
        -Actual $status `
        -Expected 401


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Resolve session
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "4. Resolve Auth Session"

    $sha256 = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()

    try {

        $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(
            $AccessToken
        )

        $hashBytes = $sha256.ComputeHash($bytes)

        $encodedHash =
            [System.Convert]::ToBase64String(
                $hashBytes
            ).
            TrimEnd("=").
            Replace("+", "-").
            Replace("/", "_")
    }
    finally {

        $sha256.Dispose()
    }

    $userId = Invoke-PsqlScalar @"
SELECT user_id::text
FROM auth_sessions
WHERE access_token_hash = '$encodedHash'
  AND revoked_at IS NULL
  AND access_expires_at > NOW()
LIMIT 1;
"@

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($userId)) {

        throw (
            "The supplied access token is not associated " +
            "with an active session."
        )
    }

    Write-Host (
        "Authenticated user resolved: {0}" -f $userId
    ) -ForegroundColor Green


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Resolve role and permission
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "5. Resolve Authorization Data"

    $roleId = Invoke-PsqlScalar @"
SELECT id::text
FROM authorization_roles
WHERE code = '$RoleCode'
  AND is_active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;
"@

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($roleId)) {
        throw "Role '$RoleCode' was not found."
    }

    $permissionId = Invoke-PsqlScalar @"
SELECT id::text
FROM authorization_permissions
WHERE code = '$PermissionCode'
  AND is_active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;
"@

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($permissionId)) {
        throw "Permission '$PermissionCode' was not found."
    }

    Write-Host "Role       : $RoleCode"
    Write-Host "Permission : $PermissionCode"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Temporary role
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "6. Temporary User Role"

    $temporaryRoleId = Invoke-PsqlScalar @"
WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO authorization_user_roles
    (
        user_id,
        role_id,
        scope_id,
        starts_at,
        expires_at,
        is_active
    )
    VALUES
    (
        '$userId'::uuid,
        '$roleId'::uuid,
        NULL,
        NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute',
        NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes',
        TRUE
    )
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT id::text
FROM inserted;
"@

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($temporaryRoleId)) {
        throw "Temporary user role was not created."
    }

    Write-Host (
        "Temporary role assignment: {0}" -f
        $temporaryRoleId
    ) -ForegroundColor Green


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Authorized request
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "7. Authorized Request"

    $status = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url $Endpoint `
        -Token $AccessToken

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Authorized request" `
        -Actual $status `
        -Expected 200


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Explicit DENY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "8. Explicit DENY Override"

    $temporaryOverrideId = Invoke-PsqlScalar @"
WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO authorization_user_permission_overrides
    (
        user_id,
        permission_id,
        effect,
        scope_id,
        starts_at,
        expires_at,
        reason,
        is_active
    )
    VALUES
    (
        '$userId'::uuid,
        '$permissionId'::uuid,
        'deny',
        NULL,
        NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute',
        NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes',
        'HTTP Authorization integration test',
        TRUE
    )
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT id::text
FROM inserted;
"@

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($temporaryOverrideId)) {
        throw "Temporary deny override was not created."
    }

    Write-Host (
        "Temporary deny override: {0}" -f
        $temporaryOverrideId
    ) -ForegroundColor Green


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Denied request
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "9. Request With Explicit DENY"

    $status = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url $Endpoint `
        -Token $AccessToken

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Explicit deny request" `
        -Actual $status `
        -Expected 403


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Remove deny
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "10. Remove Explicit DENY"

    Invoke-Psql @"
DELETE FROM authorization_user_permission_overrides
WHERE id = '$temporaryOverrideId'::uuid;
"@ | Out-Null

    $temporaryOverrideId = $null

    Pass-Test "Explicit deny removed."


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. Authorization restored
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Section "11. Authorization Restored"

    $status = Get-HttpStatus `
        -Url $Endpoint `
        -Token $AccessToken

    Assert-Status `
        -Name "Authorization restored" `
        -Actual $status `
        -Expected 200


    Write-Section "FINAL RESULT"

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Passed: $passed" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Failed: $failed" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "ALL AUTHORIZATION HTTP TESTS PASSED." -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""

}
finally {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Cleanup override
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
        $temporaryOverrideId
    )) {

        try {

            Invoke-Psql @"
DELETE FROM authorization_user_permission_overrides
WHERE id = '$temporaryOverrideId'::uuid;
"@ | Out-Null
        }
        catch {

            Write-Host (
                "Cleanup warning for override: {0}" `
                -f $_.Exception.Message
            ) -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Cleanup role assignment
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
        $temporaryRoleId
    )) {

        try {

            Invoke-Psql @"
DELETE FROM authorization_user_roles
WHERE id = '$temporaryRoleId'::uuid;
"@ | Out-Null
        }
        catch {

            Write-Host (
                "Cleanup warning for role: {0}" `

            ) -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }

func run() error {

			"access token length is %d; expected 43",

func loadAccessToken() (string, error) {
	token := strings.TrimSpace(
		os.Getenv("AUTHORIZATION_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN"),
	)

	if token != "" {
		return token, nil
	}

	path := filepath.Join(
		".tmp",
		"authorization-access-token.txt",
	)

	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "",
			fmt.Errorf(
				"AUTHORIZATION_TEST_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set and %s could not be read: %w",
				path,
				err,
			)
	}

	token = strings.TrimSpace(string(data))

	if token == "" {
		return "",
			errors.New("authorization access token is empty")
	}

	return token, nil
}

func createScope(
	ctx context.Context,
	db *postgres.Client,
	scopeType authorization.ScopeType,
	resourceID string,
	name string,
	description string,
	parentScopeID *string,
) (testScope, error) {

	var result testScope

	err := db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		`
		INSERT INTO authorization_scopes (
			scope_type,
			resource_type,
			resource_id,
			parent_scope_id,
			name,
			description,
			is_active
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2,
			$3,
			$4,
			$5,
			$6,
			TRUE
		)
		RETURNING
			id::text,
			scope_type
		`,
		scopeType,
		scopeResourceType(scopeType),
		nullableResourceID(resourceID),
		parentScopeID,
		name,
		description,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.Type,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return result,
			fmt.Errorf(
				"create scope %s: %w",
				name,
				err,
			)
	}

	result.Resource = resourceID
	result.Name = name

	return result, nil
}

func scopeResourceType(scopeType authorization.ScopeType) any {
	switch scopeType {
	case authorization.ScopeTypeOrganization:
		return "organization"

	case authorization.ScopeTypeProject:
		return "project"

	case authorization.ScopeTypeAsset:
		return "asset"

	default:
		return nil
	}
}

func nullableResourceID(value string) any {
	if value == "" {
		return nil
	}

	return value
}

func updateAssignmentScope(
	ctx context.Context,
	db *postgres.Client,
	assignmentID string,
	scopeID string,
) error {

	_, err := db.Pool.Exec(
		ctx,
		`
		UPDATE authorization_user_roles
		SET
			scope_id = $1,
			updated_at = NOW()
		WHERE id = $2
		`,
		scopeID,
		assignmentID,
	)

	return err
}

func queryString(
	ctx context.Context,
	db *postgres.Client,
	query string,
	args ...any,
) (string, error) {

	var value string

	err := db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		args...,
	).Scan(&value)

	return value, err
}

func queryInt(
	ctx context.Context,
	db *postgres.Client,
	query string,
	args ...any,
) (int, error) {

	var value int

	err := db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		args...,
	).Scan(&value)

	return value, err
}

func expectHTTPStatus(
	client *http.Client,
	url string,
	accessToken string,
	expected int,
	label string,
) error {

	request, err := http.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		url,
		nil,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"%s: create request: %w",
			label,
			err,
		)
	}

	request.Header.Set(
		"Authorization",
		"Bearer "+accessToken,
	)

	response, err := client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"%s: HTTP request failed: %w",
			label,
			err,
		)
	}

	defer response.Body.Close()

	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, response.Body)

	if response.StatusCode != expected {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"[FAIL] %s -> expected HTTP %d, got HTTP %d",
			label,
			expected,
			response.StatusCode,
		)
	}

	fmt.Printf(
		"[PASS] %-32s -> HTTP %d\n",
		label,
		response.StatusCode,
	)

	return nil
}

func cleanupAuthorizationData(
	ctx context.Context,
	db *postgres.Client,
	roleAssignmentID string,
	assetB1ID string,
	assetA1ID string,
	projectBID string,
	projectAID string,
	organizationID string,
	globalID string,
) {

	if roleAssignmentID != "" {
		_, _ = db.Pool.Exec(
			ctx,
			`
			DELETE FROM authorization_user_roles
			WHERE id = $1
			`,
			roleAssignmentID,
		)
	}

	scopeIDs := []string{
		assetB1ID,
		assetA1ID,
		projectBID,
		projectAID,
		organizationID,
		globalID,
	}

	for _, scopeID := range scopeIDs {
		if scopeID == "" {
			continue
		}

		_, _ = db.Pool.Exec(
			ctx,
			`
			DELETE FROM authorization_scopes
			WHERE id = $1
			`,
			scopeID,
		)
	}
}

func newUUIDLike() string {
	data := make([]byte, 16)

	if _, err := rand.Read(data); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	data[6] = (data[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40
	data[8] = (data[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80

	hexValue := hex.EncodeToString(data)

	return fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s-%s-%s-%s-%s",
		hexValue[0:8],
		hexValue[8:12],
		hexValue[12:16],
		hexValue[16:20],
		hexValue[20:32],
	)
}

function Invoke-Refresh {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Token
    )

    $body = @{
        refresh_token=[REDACTED]
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    try {
        Invoke-WebRequest `
            -Method Post `
            -Uri "$baseUrl/api/v1/auth/refresh" `
            -ContentType "application/json" `
            -Body $body `
            -UseBasicParsing `
            -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        if ($_.Exception.Response) {
            return $_.Exception.Response
        }

        throw
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "============================================================"
Write-Host "REFRESH FLOW HTTP TEST"

# 1. Invalid token
$response = Invoke-Refresh -Token "invalid-refresh-token"

if ($response.StatusCode -ne 401) {
    throw "Invalid refresh token: expected 401, got $($response.StatusCode)"
}

Write-Host "[PASS] Invalid refresh token -> HTTP 401"

# 2. Valid refresh
$response = Invoke-Refresh -Token $refreshToken

if ($response.StatusCode -ne 200) {
    throw "Valid refresh token: expected 200, got $($response.StatusCode)"
}

$data = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($data.access_token)) {
    throw "Response does not contain access_token."
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($data.refresh_token)) {
    throw "Response does not contain refresh_token."
}

$newAccessToken = $data.access_token
$newRefreshToken = $data.refresh_token

Write-Host "[PASS] Valid refresh token -> HTTP 200"

# 3. Old refresh token must fail
$response = Invoke-Refresh -Token $refreshToken

if ($response.StatusCode -ne 401) {

function Test-ApiResponse {
    param (
        [string]$Step,
        [int]$ExpectedStatus,
        $Response,
        [int]$ActualStatus
    )

    if ($ActualStatus -ne $ExpectedStatus) {

        Write-Host ""

            Write-Host "Response:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            $Response | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
        }

        throw "API test failed."
    }

    Write-Host "$Step : OK" -ForegroundColor Green
}

# ============================================================
# Helpers

function New-TestUser {

    $body = @{
        user_type = "individual"
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $response = Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri "$baseUrl/api/v1/users" `
        -Method Post `
        -ContentType "application/json" `
        -Body $body `
        -TimeoutSec 10

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($response.id)) {
        throw "User ID was not returned."
    }

    return $response.id
}

function Invoke-Verification {

    param (
        [string]$UserId,
        [string]$VerificationType,
        [string]$TestResult,
        [string]$IdempotencyKey
    )

    $body = @{
        user_id = $UserId
        verification_type = $VerificationType
        provider = "test-provider"
        data = @{
            test_result = $TestResult
        }
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $headers = @{}

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($IdempotencyKey)) {
        $headers["Idempotency-Key"] = $IdempotencyKey
    }

    return Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri $executeUrl `
        -Method Post `
        -Headers $headers `
        -ContentType "application/json" `
        -Body $body `
        -TimeoutSec 10
}

$repositoryContent = @'
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

var ErrNationalIDAlreadyRegistered = errors.New(
	"national id already registered",
)

var ErrPhoneAlreadyRegistered = errors.New(
	"phone number already registered",
)

var ErrEmailAlreadyRegistered = errors.New(
	"email already registered",
)

type Repository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewRepository(db *postgres.Client) *Repository {
	return &Repository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *Repository) Register(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *RegistrationRequest,
	passwordHash string,
) (*RegistrationResponse, error) {

	if r == nil || r.db == nil || r.db.Pool == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("auth repository is nil")
	}

	tx, err := r.db.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)

	var userID string
	var status string
	var createdAt string

	userQuery := `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_type
		)
		VALUES ($1)
		RETURNING
			id,
			status,
			created_at::text
	`

	err = tx.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		userQuery,
		request.UserType,
	).Scan(
		&userID,
		&status,
		&createdAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	profileQuery := `
		INSERT INTO user_profiles (
			user_id,
			first_name,
			last_name,
			national_id,
			birth_date,
			father_name,
			address,
			postal_code
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2,
			$3,
			$4,
			$5::date,
			$6,
			$7,
			$8
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		profileQuery,
		userID,
		request.FirstName,
		request.LastName,
		request.NationalID,
		request.BirthDate,
		request.FatherName,
		request.Address,
		request.PostalCode,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if strings.Contains(
			err.Error(),
			`user_profiles_national_id_key`,
		) {
			return nil, ErrNationalIDAlreadyRegistered
		}

		return nil, err
	}

	phoneQuery := `
		INSERT INTO user_phones (
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2,
			TRUE,
			FALSE
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		phoneQuery,
		userID,
		request.PhoneNumber,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if strings.Contains(
			err.Error(),
			`user_phones_phone_number_key`,
		) {
			return nil, ErrPhoneAlreadyRegistered
		}

		return nil, err
	}

	if request.Email != "" {

		emailQuery := `
			INSERT INTO user_emails (
				user_id,
				email,
				is_primary,
				is_verified
			)
			VALUES (
				$1,
				$2,
				TRUE,
				FALSE
			)
		`

		_, err = tx.Exec(
			ctx,
			emailQuery,
			userID,
			request.Email,
		)

		if err != nil {
			if strings.Contains(
				err.Error(),
				`user_emails_email_key`,
			) {
				return nil, ErrEmailAlreadyRegistered
			}

			return nil, err
		}
	}

	credentialQuery := `
		INSERT INTO auth_credentials (
			user_id,
			password_hash
		)
		VALUES (
			$1,
			$2
		)
	`

	_, err = tx.Exec(
		ctx,
		credentialQuery,
		userID,
		passwordHash,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	parsedCreatedAt := timeFromString(createdAt)

	return &RegistrationResponse{
		UserID:        userID,
		UserType:      request.UserType,
		Status:        status,
		PhoneVerified: false,
		CreatedAt:     parsedCreatedAt,
	}, nil
}

func timeFromString(value string) time.Time {
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)

	return parsed
}
'@

$handlerContent = @'
package auth

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
)

type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		service: service,
	}
}

func (h *Handler) Register(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	if h == nil || h.service == nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusInternalServerError,
			"auth service is unavailable",
		)
		return
	}

	var request RegistrationRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(
		r.Body,
	).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	result, err := h.service.Register(
		r.Context(),
		&request,
	)

	if err != nil {

		switch {
		case errors.Is(
			err,
			ErrNationalIDAlreadyRegistered,
		):
			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusConflict,
				err.Error(),
			)

		case errors.Is(
			err,
			ErrPhoneAlreadyRegistered,
		):
			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusConflict,
				err.Error(),
			)

		case errors.Is(
			err,
			ErrEmailAlreadyRegistered,
		):
			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusConflict,
				err.Error(),
			)

		default:
			writeJSONError(
				w,
				http.StatusBadRequest,
				err.Error(),
			)
		}

		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusCreated,
		result,
	)
}

func writeJSON(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	statusCode int,
	data any,
) {
	w.Header().Set(
		"Content-Type",
		"application/json",
	)

	w.WriteHeader(statusCode)

	_ = json.NewEncoder(
		w,
	).Encode(data)
}

func writeJSONError(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	statusCode int,
	message string,
) {
	writeJSON(
		w,
		statusCode,
		map[string]string{
			"error": message,
		},
	)
}
'@

                verificationHandler.GetVerification,
        )

        $pattern,
        $verificationRoutes + '$1',

    Write-Host "[OK] Verification routes added."
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$Failed = 0

function Write-TestResult {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [bool]$Success
    )

    if ($Success) {
        Write-Host ("[PASS] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Green
        $script:Passed++
    }
    else {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Red
        $script:Failed++
    }
}

function Invoke-Api {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Url,
        [string]$Body = ""
    )

    try {
        if ($Body -ne "") {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -ContentType "application/json" `
                -Body $Body `
                -UseBasicParsing

        }
        else {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -UseBasicParsing
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $true
            StatusCode = [int]$Response.StatusCode
            Body       = $Response.Content
            Error      = ""
        }
    }
    catch {
        $StatusCode = 0
        $ResponseBody = ""

        if ($_.Exception.Response) {
            try {
                $StatusCode = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            catch {
                $StatusCode = 0
            }

            try {
                $Stream = $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

                if ($Stream) {
                    $Reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($Stream)
                    $ResponseBody = $Reader.ReadToEnd()
                    $Reader.Close()
                    $Stream.Close()
                }
            }
            catch {
                $ResponseBody = ""
            }
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $false
            StatusCode = $StatusCode
            Body       = $ResponseBody
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

function Assert-ApiSuccess {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        $Result,
        [int[]]$ExpectedStatusCodes
    )

    $Success = $false

    if ($Result.Success -and
        $ExpectedStatusCodes -contains $Result.StatusCode) {

        $Success = $true
    }

    Write-TestResult $Name $Success

    if (-not $Success) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "  HTTP Status : $($Result.StatusCode)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        if ($Result.Body -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Response:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Body)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        if ($Result.Error -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Error:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Error)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host ""
    }

    return $Success
}

function Write-TestHeader {
    param(
        [string]$Title
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================"
    Write-Host $Title
    Write-Host "============================================================"
}

function Pass-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[PASS] $Message"
    $script:passed++
}

function Fail-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[FAIL] $Message"
    $script:failed++
}

function Get-HttpStatusCode {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {
        if ($null -ne $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return [int]$ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.StatusCode
        }
    }
    catch {
    }

    return 0
}

function Read-ErrorResponseBody {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {

        if ($null -eq $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return ""
        }

        $stream = $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

        if ($null -eq $stream) {
            return ""
        }

        $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)

        try {
            return $reader.ReadToEnd()
        }
        finally {
            $reader.Dispose()
        }

    }
    catch {
        return ""
    }
}

function Invoke-JsonRequest {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    $params = @{
        Method          = $Method
        Uri             = $Uri
        UseBasicParsing = $true
        ErrorAction     = "Stop"
    }

    if ($null -ne $Body) {
        $params.ContentType = "application/json"
        $params.Body = $Body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
    }

    if ($null -ne $Headers) {
        $params.Headers = $Headers
    }

    return Invoke-WebRequest @params
}

function Invoke-JsonRequestSafe {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    try {

        $response = Invoke-JsonRequest `
            -Method $Method `
            -Uri $Uri `
            -Body $Body `
            -Headers $Headers

        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($response.Content)) {

            try {
                $json = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Content    = $response.Content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $null
        }

    }
    catch {

        $content = Read-ErrorResponseBody $_
        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) {

            try {
                $json = $content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = Get-HttpStatusCode $_
            Content    = $content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

function Get-ValidNationalId {

    while ($true) {

        $digits = @()

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $digits += Get-Random `
                -Minimum 0 `
                -Maximum 10
        }

        $sum = 0

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $sum += [int]$digits[$i] * (10 - $i)
        }

        $remainder = $sum % 11

        if ($remainder -lt 2) {
            $checkDigit = $remainder
        }
        else {
            $checkDigit = 11 - $remainder
        }

        $nationalId = ($digits -join "") + $checkDigit

        if ($nationalId -match "^[0-9]{10}$") {
            return $nationalId
        }
    }
}

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

function Write-TestHeader {
    param(
        [string]$Title
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================"
    Write-Host $Title
    Write-Host "============================================================"
}

function Pass-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[PASS] $Message"
    $script:passed++
}

function Fail-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[FAIL] $Message"
    $script:failed++
}

function Get-HttpStatusCode {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {
        if ($null -ne $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return [int]$ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.StatusCode
        }
    }
    catch {
    }

    return 0
}

function Read-ErrorResponseBody {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {
        if ($null -eq $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return ""
        }

        $stream = $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

        if ($null -eq $stream) {
            return ""
        }

        $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)

        try {
            return $reader.ReadToEnd()
        }
        finally {
            $reader.Dispose()
        }
    }
    catch {
        return ""
    }
}

function Invoke-JsonRequest {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    $params = @{
        Method          = $Method
        Uri             = $Uri
        UseBasicParsing = $true
        ErrorAction     = "Stop"
    }

    if ($null -ne $Body) {
        $params.ContentType = "application/json"
        $params.Body = $Body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
    }

    if ($null -ne $Headers) {
        $params.Headers = $Headers
    }

    return Invoke-WebRequest @params
}

function Invoke-JsonRequestSafe {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    try {
        $response = Invoke-JsonRequest `
            -Method $Method `
            -Uri $Uri `
            -Body $Body `
            -Headers $Headers

        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($response.Content)) {
            try {
                $json = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Content    = $response.Content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $null
        }
    }
    catch {
        $content = Read-ErrorResponseBody $_

        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) {
            try {
                $json = $content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = Get-HttpStatusCode $_
            Content    = $content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

# ============================================================
# VALID IRANIAN NATIONAL ID
# ============================================================

function Get-ValidNationalId {

    while ($true) {

        $digits = @()

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $digits += Get-Random `
                -Minimum 0 `
                -Maximum 10
        }

        $sum = 0

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $sum += [int]$digits[$i] * (10 - $i)
        }

        $remainder = $sum % 11

        if ($remainder -lt 2) {
            $checkDigit = $remainder
        }
        else {
            $checkDigit = 11 - $remainder
        }

        $nationalId = ($digits -join "") + $checkDigit

        if ($nationalId -match "^[0-9]{10}$") {
            return $nationalId
        }
    }
}

function Get-TestPhone {

        -Minimum 100000000 `
        -Maximum 999999999

    return "09$suffix"

# ============================================================

function Get-TestEmail {

    $timestamp = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()

    return "password-test-$timestamp@example.com"
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$baseUrl = "http://localhost:8080"
$endpoint = "$baseUrl/api/v1/auth/register"

# =========================================================
# HTTP REQUEST
# =========================================================

function Invoke-RegistrationRequest {
    param(
        [hashtable]$Body
    )

    $json = $Body | ConvertTo-Json

    try {
        $response = Invoke-WebRequest `
            -Uri $endpoint `
            -Method Post `
            -ContentType "application/json" `
            -Body $json `
            -TimeoutSec 10 `
            -UseBasicParsing

        return @{
            StatusCode = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Body       = $response.Content
        }
    }
    catch {
        if ($_.Exception.Response) {

            $httpResponse = $_.Exception.Response
            $statusCode = [int]$httpResponse.StatusCode

            $stream = $httpResponse.GetResponseStream()

            if ($null -ne $stream) {
                $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)
                $responseBody = $reader.ReadToEnd()
                $reader.Close()
            }
            else {
                $responseBody = ""
            }

            return @{
                StatusCode = $statusCode
                Body       = $responseBody
            }
        }

        throw
    }
}

# =========================================================
# ASSERT STATUS
# =========================================================

function Assert-StatusCode {
    param(
        [string]$TestName,
        [int]$Expected,
        [int]$Actual
    )

    if ($Actual -eq $Expected) {
        Write-Host `
            "[PASS] $TestName -> HTTP $Actual" `
            -ForegroundColor Green
        return
    }

    Write-Host `
        "[FAIL] $TestName" `
        -ForegroundColor Red

    Write-Host `
        "       Expected: HTTP $Expected" `
        -ForegroundColor Red

    Write-Host `
        "       Actual:   HTTP $Actual" `
        -ForegroundColor Red

    throw "Test failed: $TestName"
}

# =========================================================
# GENERATE VALID IRANIAN NATIONAL ID
# =========================================================

function New-ValidNationalId {
    param(
        [Int64]$Seed
    )

    $baseNumber = 100000000 + ($Seed % 899999999)

    $base9 = $baseNumber.ToString("D9")

    $sum = 0

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

        $digit = [int]$base9.Substring($i, 1)

        $sum += $digit * (10 - $i)
    }

    $remainder = $sum % 11

    if ($remainder -lt 2) {
        $checkDigit = $remainder
    }
    else {
        $checkDigit = 11 - $remainder
    }

    return "$base9$checkDigit"
}

# ============================================================
# TEST HELPERS
# ============================================================

function Write-TestHeader {
    param(
        [string]$Title
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "============================================================"
    Write-Host $Title
    Write-Host "============================================================"
}

function Pass-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[PASS] $Message"
    $script:passed++
}

function Fail-Test {
    param(
        [string]$Message
    )

    Write-Host "[FAIL] $Message"
    $script:failed++
}

function Get-HttpStatusCode {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {
        if ($null -ne $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return [int]$ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.StatusCode
        }
    }
    catch {
    }

    return 0
}

function Read-ErrorResponseBody {
    param(
        [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]$ErrorRecord
    )

    try {

        if ($null -eq $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response) {
            return ""
        }

        $stream = $ErrorRecord.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

        if ($null -eq $stream) {
            return ""
        }

        $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream)

        try {
            return $reader.ReadToEnd()
        }
        finally {
            $reader.Dispose()
        }

    }
    catch {
        return ""
    }
}

function Invoke-JsonRequest {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    $requestParams = @{
        Method          = $Method
        Uri             = $Uri
        UseBasicParsing = $true
        ErrorAction     = "Stop"
    }

    if ($null -ne $Body) {
        $requestParams.ContentType = "application/json"
        $requestParams.Body = (
            $Body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
        )
    }

    if ($null -ne $Headers) {
        $requestParams.Headers = $Headers
    }

    return Invoke-WebRequest @requestParams
}

function Invoke-JsonRequestSafe {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Uri,
        [hashtable]$Body = $null,
        [hashtable]$Headers = $null
    )

    try {

        $response = Invoke-JsonRequest `
            -Method $Method `
            -Uri $Uri `
            -Body $Body `
            -Headers $Headers

        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($response.Content)) {
            try {
                $json = $response.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = [int]$response.StatusCode
            Content    = $response.Content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $null
        }

    }
    catch {

        $statusCode = Get-HttpStatusCode $_
        $content = Read-ErrorResponseBody $_
        $json = $null

        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) {
            try {
                $json = $content | ConvertFrom-Json
            }
            catch {
                $json = $null
            }
        }

        return @{
            StatusCode = $statusCode
            Content    = $content
            Json       = $json
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

# ============================================================
# VALID IRANIAN NATIONAL ID
# ============================================================

function Get-ValidNationalId {

    while ($true) {

        $digits = @()

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $digits += Get-Random `
                -Minimum 0 `
                -Maximum 10
        }

        $sum = 0

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 9; $i++) {

            $sum += [int]$digits[$i] * (10 - $i)
        }

        $remainder = $sum % 11

        if ($remainder -lt 2) {
            $checkDigit = $remainder
        }
        else {
            $checkDigit = 11 - $remainder
        }

        $nationalId = ($digits -join "") + $checkDigit

        if ($nationalId -match "^[0-9]{10}$") {
            return $nationalId
        }
    }
}

# =========================================================
# 2. Create fresh test user
# =========================================================

function New-TestUser {

    $body = @{
        user_type = "individual"
    } | ConvertTo-Json

    $response = Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri "$baseUrl/api/v1/users" `
        -Method Post `
        -ContentType "application/json" `
        -Body $body `
        -TimeoutSec 10

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($response.id)) {
        throw "User ID was not returned."
    }

    return $response.id
}

# =========================================================
# 3. Test one verification status
# =========================================================

function Test-VerificationStatus {

    param (
        [string]$StatusName,
        [string]$VerificationType,
        [string]$ExpectedStatus
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"
    Write-Host "Testing status: $StatusName"
    Write-Host "Verification type: $VerificationType"
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"

    try {

        # Create a NEW user for every test.
        $userId = New-TestUser

        Write-Host "User ID: $userId"

        $body = @{
            user_id = $userId
            verification_type = $VerificationType
            provider = "test-provider"
            data = @{
                test_result = $ExpectedStatus
            }
        } | ConvertTo-Json

        $result = Invoke-RestMethod `
            -Uri $executeUrl `
            -Method Post `
            -ContentType "application/json" `
            -Body $body `
            -TimeoutSec 10

        Write-Host "[OK] Request completed."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Validate status
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($result.status -ne $ExpectedStatus) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] Status mismatch."
            Write-Host "Expected: $ExpectedStatus"
            Write-Host "Actual:   $($result.status)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] Status response validated."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Non-verified statuses must not expire
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($null -ne $result.expires_at) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] expires_at should be null."
            Write-Host "Actual: $($result.expires_at)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] expires_at is null."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Rejected must have rejection_reason
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($ExpectedStatus -eq "rejected") {

            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.rejection_reason)) {

                Write-Host ""
                Write-Host "[FAILED] rejection_reason is missing."

                return $false
            }

            Write-Host "[OK] rejection_reason exists."
        }

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Final result
        # -------------------------------------------------

        Write-Host "[OK] $StatusName PASSED."
        Write-Host "Verification ID: $($result.id)"

        return $true
    }
    catch {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[FAILED] $StatusName"
        Write-Host "HTTP ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)"

        if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "API RESPONSE:"
            Write-Host $_.ErrorDetails.Message
        }

        return $false
    }
}

# =========================================================
# 4. Run tests
# =========================================================

$passed = 0
$failed = 0

# Rejected
if (Test-VerificationStatus `
    -StatusName "rejected" `
    -VerificationType "contact" `
    -ExpectedStatus "rejected") {

    $passed++
}
else {
    $failed++
}

# Failed
if (Test-VerificationStatus `
    -StatusName "failed" `
    -VerificationType "bank" `
    -ExpectedStatus "failed") {

    $passed++
}
else {
    $failed++
}

# Manual Review

    -StatusName "manual_review" `
    -VerificationType "biometric" `
    -ExpectedStatus "manual_review") {

    $passed++
}
else {
    $failed++
}

# Pending
if (Test-VerificationStatus `
    -StatusName "pending" `
    -VerificationType "document" `
    -ExpectedStatus "pending") {

    $passed++
}
else {
    $failed++
}

# =========================================================
# 5. Final result
# =========================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "========================================"
Write-Host "VERIFICATION STATUS TEST RESULT"
Write-Host "========================================"
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "Failed: $failed"

    Write-Host ""

    exit 0

Write-Host ""

exit 1

# ---------------------------------------------------------

    Invoke-RestMethod `

        -TimeoutSec 5 | Out-Null

    Write-Host "[OK] Backend is running."

    Write-Host "[FAILED] Backend is not reachable." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Start the backend first:"
    Write-Host "go run .\cmd\server"
    Write-Host ""
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ""

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. First verification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host "[2] Creating first verification..."
Write-Host ""

$body = @{
    user_id = $testUserId
    verification_type = "identity"
    provider = "test-provider"
    data = @{
        test_result = "verified"
    }
} | ConvertTo-Json

try {

    $first = Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri $executeUrl `
        -Method Post `
        -ContentType "application/json" `
        -Body $body `
        -TimeoutSec 10

    Write-Host "[OK] First verification completed."
    Write-Host "First Verification ID:"
    Write-Host $first.id
    Write-Host ""

}
catch {

    Write-Host "[FAILED] First verification failed." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message
    exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Validate first verification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($first.id)) {
    throw "First verification ID is empty."
}

if ($first.status -ne "verified") {
    throw "First verification status is not verified."
}

if ($first.user_id -ne $testUserId) {
    throw "First verification user_id mismatch."
}

if ($first.verification_type -ne "identity") {
    throw "First verification type mismatch."
}

Write-Host "[OK] First verification validated."
Write-Host ""

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Second verification request
# ---------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host "[3] Sending second verification request..."
Write-Host ""

try {

    $second = Invoke-RestMethod `
        -Uri $executeUrl `
        -Method Post `
        -ContentType "application/json" `
        -Body $body `
        -TimeoutSec 10

    Write-Host "[OK] Second request completed."
    Write-Host "Second Verification ID:"
    Write-Host $second.id
    Write-Host ""

}
catch {

    Write-Host "[FAILED] Second verification failed." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host $_.Exception.Message
    exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validate second verification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($second.id)) {
    throw "Second verification ID is empty."
}

if ($second.status -ne "verified") {
    throw "Second verification status is not verified."
}

if ($second.user_id -ne $testUserId) {
    throw "Second verification user_id mismatch."
}

if ($second.verification_type -ne "identity") {
    throw "Second verification type mismatch."
}

Write-Host "[OK] Second verification validated."
Write-Host ""

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Verify reuse
# ---------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host "[4] Checking Verification reuse..."
Write-Host ""

if ($first.id -ne $second.id) {

    Write-Host "[FAILED] Verification was NOT reused." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "First ID :  $($first.id)"
    Write-Host "Second ID:  $($second.id)"
    Write-Host ""

    exit 1
}

Write-Host ""

# ---------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host "========================================"

# ------------------------------------------------------------

function Invoke-RoboCopy {
    param(
        [string]$Source,
        [string]$Destination,
        [string]$LogFile
    )

    if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source)) {
        throw "Source directory not found: $Source"
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Destination |
        Out-Null

    & robocopy $Source $Destination `
        /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /R:2 /W:2 /XJ /NP `
        "/LOG:$LogFile"

    $Code = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($Code -ge 8) {
        throw "Robocopy failed with exit code $Code. Log: $LogFile"
    }
}

function Save-DockerInspect {
    param(
        [string]$ContainerName,
        [string]$OutputFile
    )

    $Raw = & docker inspect $ContainerName

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not inspect container: $ContainerName"
    }

    $Objects = ($Raw -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json

    foreach ($Item in $Objects) {
        if ($null -ne $Item.Config.Env) {
            $Item.Config.Env = @(
                foreach ($Entry in $Item.Config.Env) {
                    $Key = ($Entry -split "=", 2)[0]
                    "$Key=<REDACTED>"
                }
            )
        }
    }

    $Objects |
        ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100 |
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $OutputFile -Encoding UTF8
}

function Get-FolderStats {
    param([string]$Path)

    $Files = @(
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Recurse -File -Force `
            -ErrorAction Stop
    )

    $TotalBytes = ($Files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum

    if ($null -eq $TotalBytes) {
        $TotalBytes = 0
    }

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Path = $Path
        FileCount = $Files.Count
        TotalBytes = [long]$TotalBytes
    }
}

    # Save the images required by the running containers.
    $ImageNames = @(

        "postgres:18",
        "redis:8"

    $ImageArchive = Join-Path $Backup "Docker\images\docker-images.tar"

        Out-Null

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    & docker exec account-redis redis-cli SAVE

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Host "`n=== STOPPING DATABASE CONTAINERS ===" -ForegroundColor Yellow

                RelativePath = $_.FullName.Substring($Backup.Length + 1)
                Length = $_.Length
                SHA256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
            }
        }

    $Manifest |
        Export-Csv (Join-Path $Backup "Backup-Report\file-manifest.csv") `

#requires -Version 5.1

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

$ProjectRoot = (Get-Location).Path

$BackupDefault = Join-Path `
    $env:USERPROFILE `
    "Desktop\IGD-PLATFORM-BACKUP\Backup-20261031-101753"

if (!(Test-Path $ProjectRoot)) {
    throw "Project root not found."
}

if (!(Test-Path $BackupDefault)) {
    throw "Existing backup folder not found: $BackupDefault"
}

$BackupRoot = Read-Host "Backup folder [$BackupDefault]"
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($BackupRoot)) {
    $BackupRoot = $BackupDefault
}

$BackupRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BackupRoot)

if (!(Test-Path $BackupRoot)) {
    throw "Backup folder does not exist."
}

$FinalRoot = Join-Path $BackupRoot "Final-Verification"

$Folders = @(
    "Reports",
    "PostgreSQL",
    "Redis",
    "Docker",
    "Development",
    "System",
    "Verification"
)

foreach ($Folder in $Folders) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory `
        -Path (Join-Path $FinalRoot $Folder) `
        -Force | Out-Null
}

$LogFile = Join-Path $FinalRoot "Reports\final-backup.log"

function Write-Log {
    param([string]$Message)

    $Line = "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')  $Message"

    Write-Host $Line
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $Line -Encoding UTF8
}

function Save-Text {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Parent -Force |
        Out-Null

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
}

function Get-FileHashSafe {
    param([string]$Path)

    try {
        return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    }
    catch {
        return "HASH_ERROR"
    }
}

Write-Log "FINAL BACKUP VERIFICATION STARTED"
Write-Log "Project root: $ProjectRoot"
Write-Log "Backup root: $BackupRoot"

# ============================================================
# 1. PROJECT VERIFICATION
# ============================================================

Write-Log "Checking project copies"

$ProjectNames = @(
    "Real-Asset-Management-Platform",
    "Real-Asset-Management-Platform-Git",
    "real-asset-platform-service-service",
    "test"
)

$ProjectResults = @()

foreach ($Name in $ProjectNames) {

    $Source = Join-Path `
        (Split-Path -Parent $ProjectRoot) `
        $Name

    if (!(Test-Path $Source)) {
        Write-Log "PROJECT SOURCE MISSING: $Name"
        $ProjectResults += "MISSING SOURCE: $Name"
        continue
    }

    $Candidates = Get-ChildItem `
        -Path $BackupRoot `
        -Directory `
        -Recurse `
        -Filter $Name `
        -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $Destination = $Candidates |
        Where-Object {
            $_.FullName -notlike "$FinalRoot*"
        } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if (!$Destination) {
        Write-Log "PROJECT COPY NOT FOUND: $Name"
        $ProjectResults += "MISSING BACKUP: $Name"
        continue
    }

    Write-Log "Comparing project: $Name"

    $SourceFiles = @(
        Get-ChildItem $Source -Recurse -File -Force
    )

    $DestinationFiles = @(
        Get-ChildItem $Destination.FullName -Recurse -File -Force
    )

    $SourceBytes = ($SourceFiles |
        Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum

    $DestinationBytes = ($DestinationFiles |
        Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum

    $Missing = 0
    $Different = 0
    $HashErrors = 0

    foreach ($File in $SourceFiles) {

        $Relative = $File.FullName.Substring(
            $Source.Length
        ).TrimStart('\')

        $CopyFile = Join-Path `
            $Destination.FullName `
            $Relative

        if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $CopyFile)) {
            $Missing++
            continue
        }

        $HashSource = Get-FileHashSafe $File.FullName
        $HashCopy = Get-FileHashSafe $CopyFile

        if (
            $HashSource -eq "HASH_ERROR" -or
            $HashCopy -eq "HASH_ERROR"
        ) {
            $HashErrors++
        }
        elseif ($HashSource -ne $HashCopy) {
            $Different++
        }
    }

    $GitDirectory = Join-Path $Destination.FullName ".git"
    $GitExists = Test-Path $GitDirectory

    $Result = [PSCustomObject]@{
        Project          = $Name
        SourceFiles      = $SourceFiles.Count
        BackupFiles      = $DestinationFiles.Count
        SourceBytes      = $SourceBytes
        BackupBytes      = $DestinationBytes
        MissingFiles     = $Missing
        DifferentHashes  = $Different
        HashErrors       = $HashErrors
        GitDirectory     = $GitExists
        BackupPath       = $Destination.FullName
    }

    $ProjectResults += $Result

    if (
        $Missing -eq 0 -and
        $Different -eq 0 -and
        $HashErrors -eq 0
    ) {
        Write-Log "PROJECT VERIFIED: $Name"
    }
    else {
        Write-Log "PROJECT VERIFICATION WARNING: $Name"
    }
}

$ProjectResults |
    ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 |
    Set-Content `
        (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Verification\projects.json") `
        -Encoding UTF8

# ============================================================
# 2. DOCKER STATUS AND METADATA
# ============================================================

Write-Log "Checking Docker"

$DockerAvailable = $false

try {
    $DockerVersion = docker version 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        $DockerAvailable = $true
        Save-Text `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\docker-version.txt") `
            ($DockerVersion | Out-String)
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Log "Docker command failed."
}

if ($DockerAvailable) {

    Write-Log "Collecting Docker metadata"

    docker ps -a --no-trunc |
        Out-File `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\containers.txt") `
            -Encoding UTF8

    docker images --digests --no-trunc |
        Out-File `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\images.txt") `
            -Encoding UTF8

    docker network ls |
        Out-File `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\networks.txt") `
            -Encoding UTF8

    docker volume ls |
        Out-File `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\volumes.txt") `
            -Encoding UTF8

    docker info 2>&1 |
        Out-File `
            (Join-Path $FinalRoot "Docker\docker-info.txt") `
            -Encoding UTF8

    $Containers = @(
        docker ps -aq
    )

    foreach ($ContainerId in $Containers) {

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ContainerId)) {
            continue
        }

        $Info = docker inspect $ContainerId 2>$null

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            $Info |
                Out-File `
                    (Join-Path `
                        $FinalRoot `
                        "Docker\container-$ContainerId.json") `
                    -Encoding UTF8
        }
    }

    $Volumes = @(
        docker volume ls -q
    )

    foreach ($Volume in $Volumes) {

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Volume)) {
            continue
        }

        $Info = docker volume inspect $Volume 2>$null

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            $Info |
                Out-File `
                    (Join-Path `
                        $FinalRoot `
                        "Docker\volume-$Volume.json") `
                    -Encoding UTF8
        }
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. EXPORT DOCKER IMAGES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Log "Exporting Docker images"

    $ImageNames = @(
        "general-market-backend:local",
        "postgres:18",
        "redis:8"
    )

    foreach ($ContainerId in $Containers) {

        $Image = docker inspect `
            --format '{{.Config.Image}}' `
            $ContainerId 2>$null

        if (
            $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and
            ![string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Image)
        ) {
            $ImageNames += $Image.Trim()
        }
    }

    $ImageNames = $ImageNames |
        Sort-Object -Unique

    foreach ($Image in $ImageNames) {

        $Exists = docker image inspect $Image 2>$null

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Log "IMAGE NOT AVAILABLE: $Image"
            continue
        }

        $SafeName = $Image -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]', '_'
        $ImageFile = Join-Path `

        docker image save -o $ImageFile $Image

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $ImageFile)) {
            Write-Log "IMAGE SAVED: $Image"
        }
        else {
            Write-Log "IMAGE SAVE FAILED: $Image"
        }
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. POSTGRESQL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Write-Log "Checking PostgreSQL"

    $PgContainer = "account-postgres"

    $PgState = docker inspect `
        --format '{{.State.Status}}' `
        $PgContainer 2>$null

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {

        if ($PgState -ne "running") {

            Write-Log "PostgreSQL is not running. Trying safe start."

            docker start $PgContainer 2>&1 |

            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb
FROM pg_roles
ORDER BY rolname;
"@

SELECT datname
FROM pg_database
WHERE datistemplate = false
ORDER BY datname;
"@

            $SuperUserQuery = @"
SELECT rolsuper
FROM pg_roles
WHERE rolname = current_user;
"@

            $IsSuper = docker exec $PgContainer `

                $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and
                $IsSuper.Trim() -eq "t"
            ) {

                $DumpFile = Join-Path `
                    $FinalRoot `
                    "PostgreSQL\full-cluster-final.sql"

                docker exec $PgContainer `
                    pg_dumpall -U $PgUser 2>$null |
                    Out-File $DumpFile -Encoding utf8

                if (
                    $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and
                    (Test-Path $DumpFile) -and
                    (Get-Item $DumpFile).Length -gt 0
                ) {
                    Write-Log "Full PostgreSQL dump created."
                }
                else {
                    Write-Log "Full PostgreSQL dump FAILED."
                }
            }
            else {
                Write-Log "PostgreSQL user is not superuser. Full dump skipped."
            }

            docker exec $PgContainer `
                psql -U $PgUser -d postgres -Atc "SHOW data_directory;" 2>&1 |
                Out-File `
                    (Join-Path $FinalRoot "PostgreSQL\data-directory.txt") `
                    -Encoding UTF8
        }
        else {

    else {
