package aggregation

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCommand      = errors.New("invalid aggregation command")
	ErrIncompatibleSource  = errors.New("source is incompatible with aggregate")
	ErrDuplicateSource     = errors.New("duplicate source contribution")
	ErrSourceNotEligible   = errors.New("source is not eligible")
	ErrAggregateNotActive  = errors.New("aggregate is not active")
	ErrAllocationTooLarge  = errors.New("allocation exceeds available quantity")
	ErrBelowMinimum        = errors.New("allocation is below minimum executable quantity")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key reused with different request")
	ErrAllocationNotFound  = errors.New("allocation not found")
	ErrInvalidTransition   = errors.New("invalid aggregate state transition")
	ErrExpired             = errors.New("aggregate has expired")
	ErrRevisionConflict    = errors.New("aggregate revision conflict")
)

type Aggregate struct {
	mu sync.Mutex

	ID             string
	Direction      Direction
	Status         AggregateStatus
	Compatibility  CompatibilityKey
	RuleSetVersion string
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	ExpiresAt      time.Time
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
	Revision       uint64
	Total          specialized.Quantity
	Allocated      specialized.Quantity
	Contributions  []SourceContribution
	Allocations    []Allocation
	Idempotency    map[string]string
}

type CommercialProposal struct {
	ID                string
	AggregateID       string
	Direction         Direction
	Compatibility     CompatibilityKey
	TotalQuantity     specialized.Quantity
	AvailableQuantity specialized.Quantity
	RuleSetVersion    string
	ExpiresAt         time.Time
	SourceReferences  []specialized.Reference
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

// Build creates an immutable source composition for one compatible commodity group.
// It does not create an order, trade, inventory record, or ownership record.
func Build(cmd BuildCommand) (*Aggregate, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AggregateID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.RuleSetVersion) == "" ||
		(cmd.Direction != Supply && cmd.Direction != Demand) ||
		len(cmd.Contributions) == 0 ||
		cmd.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!cmd.ExpiresAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := validateCompatibilityKey(cmd.Compatibility); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sources := append([]SourceContribution(nil), cmd.Contributions...)
	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool {
		return sources[i].SourceID < sources[j].SourceID
	})

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	var total specialized.Quantity

	for i, source := range sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceID) == "" ||
			source.Direction != cmd.Direction ||
			source.Status != SourceValidated ||
			strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceVersion) == "" ||
			source.ValidatedAt.IsZero() ||
			!source.ValidUntil.After(cmd.CreatedAt) ||
			source.ValidatedAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source %q", ErrSourceNotEligible, source.SourceID)
		}

		if _, exists := seen[source.SourceID]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrDuplicateSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		seen[source.SourceID] = struct{}{}

		if err := source.SourceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if source.SourceReference.ResourceID != source.SourceID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference ID mismatch", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
		if source.Compatibility != cmd.Compatibility {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrIncompatibleSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		if err := source.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := source.MinimumExecutable.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum quantity: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if _, err := source.Quantity.Compare(source.MinimumExecutable); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if source.MinimumExecutable.Value > source.Quantity.Value {
			return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
		}
		if source.EvidenceReference != nil {
			if err := source.EvidenceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		if i == 0 {
			total = source.Quantity
		} else {
			var err error
			total, err = total.Add(source.Quantity)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}

	return &Aggregate{
		ID:             cmd.AggregateID,
		Direction:      cmd.Direction,
		Status:         StatusActive,
		Compatibility:  cmd.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      cmd.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      cmd.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       1,
		Total:          total,
		Allocated:      specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: total.Scale, Unit: total.Unit},
		Contributions:  sources,
		Idempotency:    map[string]string{cmd.IdempotencyKey: buildFingerprint(cmd)},
	}, nil
}

func validateCompatibilityKey(k CompatibilityKey) error {
	fields := []string{
		k.CommodityID, k.SpecificationHash, k.Grade, k.Standard,
		k.Unit, k.DeliveryLocation, k.DeliveryWindow, k.Currency,
		k.CommercialTerms, k.ServiceProfile,
	}
	for _, field := range fields {
		if strings.TrimSpace(field) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: compatibility key is incomplete", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func buildFingerprint(cmd BuildCommand) string {
	parts := []string{
		cmd.AggregateID, string(cmd.Direction), cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		fmt.Sprintf("%v", cmd.Compatibility),
	}
	for _, source := range cmd.Contributions {
		parts = append(parts, source.SourceID, source.SourceVersion,
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", source.Quantity.Value, source.Quantity.Scale, source.Quantity.Unit))
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func allocationFingerprint(cmd AllocationCommand) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s|%d|%d|%s|%s",
		cmd.AllocationID, cmd.Quantity.Value, cmd.Quantity.Scale,
		cmd.Quantity.Unit, cmd.ActorID,
	)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (a *Aggregate) Available() specialized.Quantity {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: a.Total.Scale, Unit: a.Total.Unit}
	}
	return available
}

func (a *Aggregate) Allocate(cmd AllocationCommand) (Allocation, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AllocationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := cmd.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	fingerprint := allocationFingerprint(cmd)
	if previous, exists := a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return Allocation{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
			if allocation.IdempotencyKey == cmd.IdempotencyKey {
				return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
			}
		}
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAggregateNotActive
	}
	if !cmd.OccurredAt.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return Allocation{}, ErrExpired
	}
	if _, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(a.Total); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	cmp, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(available)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	if cmp > 0 {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAllocationTooLarge
	}

	lines, err := a.planAllocation(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	nextAllocated, err := a.Allocated.Add(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	allocation := Allocation{
		ID:             cmd.AllocationID,
		IdempotencyKey: cmd.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
		Quantity:       cmd.Quantity,
		Lines:          lines,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		OccurredAt:     cmd.OccurredAt,
	}

	a.Allocated = nextAllocated
	a.Allocations = append(a.Allocations, allocation)
	a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint
	a.Revision++

	if a.Allocated.Value == a.Total.Value {
		a.Status = StatusAllocated
	} else {
		a.Status = StatusPartial
	}

	return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
}

// planAllocation uses deterministic source ordering. It never allocates
// more than the remaining amount of an individual source.
func (a *Aggregate) planAllocation(requested specialized.Quantity) ([]AllocationLine, error) {
	remaining := requested.Value
	lines := make([]AllocationLine, 0, len(a.Contributions))

	used := make(map[string]int64, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		for _, line := range allocation.Lines {
			used[line.SourceID] += line.Quantity.Value
		}
	}

	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		if remaining == 0 {
			break
		}
		sourceAvailable := source.Quantity.Value - used[source.SourceID]
		if sourceAvailable <= 0 {
			continue
		}

		take := sourceAvailable
		if take > remaining {
			take = remaining
		}

		if take < source.MinimumExecutable.Value {
			continue
		}

		lines = append(lines, AllocationLine{
			SourceID: source.SourceID,
			Quantity: specialized.Quantity{
				Value: take,
				Scale: requested.Scale,
				Unit:  requested.Unit,
			},
		})
		remaining -= take
	}

	if remaining != 0 {
		return nil, ErrBelowMinimum
	}
	return lines, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Cancel(actorID, reason string, occurredAt time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(actorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" ||
		occurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusAllocated {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusCancelled
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Expire(now time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusExpired
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Proposal(now time.Time) (CommercialProposal, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusDraft {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrExpired
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return CommercialProposal{}, err
	}

	refs := make([]specialized.Reference, 0, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		refs = append(refs, source.SourceReference)
	}

	return CommercialProposal{
		ID:                a.ID + "-proposal-" + fmt.Sprint(a.Revision),
		AggregateID:       a.ID,
		Direction:         a.Direction,
		Compatibility:     a.Compatibility,
		TotalQuantity:     a.Total,
		AvailableQuantity: available,
		RuleSetVersion:    a.RuleSetVersion,
		ExpiresAt:         a.ExpiresAt,
		SourceReferences:  refs,
		CreatedAt:         now,
	}, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Snapshot() Aggregate {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	copyOf := Aggregate{
		ID:             a.ID,
		Direction:      a.Direction,
		Status:         a.Status,
		Compatibility:  a.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: a.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      a.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      a.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        a.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  a.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       a.Revision,
		Total:          a.Total,
		Allocated:      a.Allocated,
		Contributions:  append([]SourceContribution(nil), a.Contributions...),
		Allocations:    make([]Allocation, len(a.Allocations)),
		Idempotency:    make(map[string]string, len(a.Idempotency)),
	}
	for i, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		copyOf.Allocations[i] = cloneAllocation(allocation)
	}
	for key, value := range a.Idempotency {
		copyOf.Idempotency[key] = value
	}
	return copyOf
}

func cloneAllocation(source Allocation) Allocation {
	result := source
	result.Lines = append([]AllocationLine(nil), source.Lines...)
	return result
}

var (
	ErrInvalidReference = errors.New("invalid external reference")
	ErrInvalidVersion   = errors.New("invalid reference version")

// Reference identifies data owned by another bounded context.
// It deliberately does not copy the referenced service's authoritative data.
type Reference struct {
	Service       string
	ResourceType  string
	ResourceID    string
	Version       string
	CorrelationID string
}

func (r Reference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Service) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: service is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource type is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource ID is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Version) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidVersion
	}
	return nil
}

func (r Reference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Service),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Version),
	}, ":")
}

// SubjectReference identifies the specialized subject of a market offer.
// The market stores this reference and its version, not legal ownership.
type SubjectReference struct {
	Domain       string
	SubjectType  string
	SubjectID    string
	SpecificationVersion string
}

func (s SubjectReference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion) == "" {
		return errors.New("incomplete specialized subject reference")
	}
	return nil
}

func (s SubjectReference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion),
	}, ":")

$Files["internal/specialized/quantity.go"] = @'
package specialized

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"strings"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidQuantity = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrUnitMismatch    = errors.New("quantity unit mismatch")
	ErrScaleMismatch   = errors.New("quantity scale mismatch")
	ErrQuantityOverflow = errors.New("quantity arithmetic overflow")
)

// Quantity stores a fixed-point value.
// Value=12345, Scale=2 means 123.45 units.
// No implicit unit conversion is performed.
type Quantity struct {
	Value int64
	Scale uint8
	Unit  string
}

func NewQuantity(value int64, scale uint8, unit string) (Quantity, error) {
	q := Quantity{Value: value, Scale: scale, Unit: strings.TrimSpace(unit)}
	if err := q.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	return q, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Validate() error {
	if q.Value <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: value must be positive", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Scale > 9 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: scale exceeds supported precision", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Unit == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit is required", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) ValidateNonNegative() error {
	if q.Value < 0 || q.Scale > 9 || strings.TrimSpace(q.Unit) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compatible(other Quantity) error {
	if q.Unit != other.Unit {
		return ErrUnitMismatch
	}
	if q.Scale != other.Scale {
		return ErrScaleMismatch
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Add(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > 0 && q.Value > math.MaxInt64-other.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrQuantityOverflow
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value + other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Subtract(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > q.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value - other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compare(other Quantity) (int, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	switch {
	case q.Value < other.Value:
		return -1, nil
	case q.Value > other.Value:
		return 1, nil
	default:
		return 0, nil
	}
}

func (q Quantity) IsZero() bool {
	return q.Value == 0
}
'@

$Files["internal/commodity/aggregation/aggregation.go"] = @'
package aggregation

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCommand       = errors.New("invalid aggregation command")
	ErrIncompatibleSource   = errors.New("source is incompatible with aggregate")
	ErrDuplicateSource      = errors.New("duplicate source contribution")
	ErrSourceNotEligible    = errors.New("source is not eligible")
	ErrAggregateNotActive   = errors.New("aggregate is not active")
	ErrAllocationTooLarge   = errors.New("allocation exceeds available quantity")
	ErrBelowMinimum         = errors.New("allocation is below minimum executable quantity")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict  = errors.New("idempotency key reused with different request")
	ErrAllocationNotFound   = errors.New("allocation not found")
	ErrInvalidTransition    = errors.New("invalid aggregate state transition")
	ErrExpired              = errors.New("aggregate has expired")
	ErrRevisionConflict     = errors.New("aggregate revision conflict")
)

type Aggregate struct {
	mu sync.Mutex

	ID              string
	Direction       Direction
	Status          AggregateStatus
	Compatibility   CompatibilityKey
	RuleSetVersion  string
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	ExpiresAt       time.Time
	ActorID         string
	CorrelationID   string
	Revision        uint64
	Total           specialized.Quantity
	Allocated       specialized.Quantity
	Contributions   []SourceContribution
	Allocations     []Allocation
	Idempotency     map[string]string
}

type CommercialProposal struct {
	ID                string
	AggregateID       string
	Direction         Direction
	Compatibility     CompatibilityKey
	TotalQuantity     specialized.Quantity
	AvailableQuantity specialized.Quantity
	RuleSetVersion    string
	ExpiresAt         time.Time
	SourceReferences  []specialized.Reference
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

// Build creates an immutable source composition for one compatible commodity group.
// It does not create an order, trade, inventory record, or ownership record.
func Build(cmd BuildCommand) (*Aggregate, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AggregateID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.RuleSetVersion) == "" ||
		(cmd.Direction != Supply && cmd.Direction != Demand) ||
		len(cmd.Contributions) == 0 ||
		cmd.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!cmd.ExpiresAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := validateCompatibilityKey(cmd.Compatibility); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sources := append([]SourceContribution(nil), cmd.Contributions...)
	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool {
		return sources[i].SourceID < sources[j].SourceID
	})

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	var total specialized.Quantity

	for i, source := range sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceID) == "" ||
			source.Direction != cmd.Direction ||
			source.Status != SourceValidated ||
			strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceVersion) == "" ||
			source.ValidatedAt.IsZero() ||
			!source.ValidUntil.After(cmd.CreatedAt) ||
			source.ValidatedAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source %q", ErrSourceNotEligible, source.SourceID)
		}

		if _, exists := seen[source.SourceID]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrDuplicateSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		seen[source.SourceID] = struct{}{}

		if err := source.SourceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if source.SourceReference.ResourceID != source.SourceID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference ID mismatch", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
		if source.Compatibility != cmd.Compatibility {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrIncompatibleSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		if err := source.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := source.MinimumExecutable.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum quantity: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if _, err := source.Quantity.Compare(source.MinimumExecutable); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if source.MinimumExecutable.Value > source.Quantity.Value {
			return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
		}
		if source.EvidenceReference != nil {
			if err := source.EvidenceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		if i == 0 {
			total = source.Quantity
		} else {
			var err error
			total, err = total.Add(source.Quantity)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}

	return &Aggregate{
		ID:             cmd.AggregateID,
		Direction:      cmd.Direction,
		Status:         StatusActive,
		Compatibility:  cmd.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      cmd.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      cmd.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       1,
		Total:          total,
		Allocated:      specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: total.Scale, Unit: total.Unit},
		Contributions:  sources,
		Idempotency:    map[string]string{cmd.IdempotencyKey: buildFingerprint(cmd)},
	}, nil
}

func validateCompatibilityKey(k CompatibilityKey) error {
	fields := []string{
		k.CommodityID, k.SpecificationHash, k.Grade, k.Standard,
		k.Unit, k.DeliveryLocation, k.DeliveryWindow, k.Currency,
		k.CommercialTerms, k.ServiceProfile,
	}
	for _, field := range fields {
		if strings.TrimSpace(field) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: compatibility key is incomplete", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func buildFingerprint(cmd BuildCommand) string {
	parts := []string{
		cmd.AggregateID, string(cmd.Direction), cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		fmt.Sprintf("%v", cmd.Compatibility),
	}
	for _, source := range cmd.Contributions {
		parts = append(parts, source.SourceID, source.SourceVersion,
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", source.Quantity.Value, source.Quantity.Scale, source.Quantity.Unit))
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func allocationFingerprint(cmd AllocationCommand) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s|%d|%d|%s|%s",
		cmd.AllocationID, cmd.Quantity.Value, cmd.Quantity.Scale,
		cmd.Quantity.Unit, cmd.ActorID,
	)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (a *Aggregate) Available() specialized.Quantity {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: a.Total.Scale, Unit: a.Total.Unit}
	}
	return available
}

func (a *Aggregate) Allocate(cmd AllocationCommand) (Allocation, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AllocationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := cmd.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	fingerprint := allocationFingerprint(cmd)
	if previous, exists := a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return Allocation{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
			if allocation.IdempotencyKey == cmd.IdempotencyKey {
				return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
			}
		}
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAggregateNotActive
	}
	if !cmd.OccurredAt.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return Allocation{}, ErrExpired
	}
	if _, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(a.Total); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	cmp, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(available)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	if cmp > 0 {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAllocationTooLarge
	}

	lines, err := a.planAllocation(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	nextAllocated, err := a.Allocated.Add(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	allocation := Allocation{
		ID:             cmd.AllocationID,
		IdempotencyKey: cmd.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
		Quantity:       cmd.Quantity,
		Lines:          lines,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		OccurredAt:     cmd.OccurredAt,
	}

	a.Allocated = nextAllocated
	a.Allocations = append(a.Allocations, allocation)
	a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint
	a.Revision++

	if a.Allocated.Value == a.Total.Value {
		a.Status = StatusAllocated
	} else {
		a.Status = StatusPartial
	}

	return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
}

// planAllocation uses deterministic source ordering. It never allocates
// more than the remaining amount of an individual source.
func (a *Aggregate) planAllocation(requested specialized.Quantity) ([]AllocationLine, error) {
	remaining := requested.Value
	lines := make([]AllocationLine, 0, len(a.Contributions))

	used := make(map[string]int64, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		for _, line := range allocation.Lines {
			used[line.SourceID] += line.Quantity.Value
		}
	}

	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		if remaining == 0 {
			break
		}
		sourceAvailable := source.Quantity.Value - used[source.SourceID]
		if sourceAvailable <= 0 {
			continue
		}

		take := sourceAvailable
		if take > remaining {
			take = remaining
		}

		if take < source.MinimumExecutable.Value {
			continue
		}

		lines = append(lines, AllocationLine{
			SourceID: source.SourceID,
			Quantity: specialized.Quantity{
				Value: take,
				Scale: requested.Scale,
				Unit:  requested.Unit,
			},
		})
		remaining -= take
	}

	if remaining != 0 {
		return nil, ErrBelowMinimum
	}
	return lines, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Cancel(actorID, reason string, occurredAt time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(actorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" ||
		occurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusAllocated {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusCancelled
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Expire(now time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusExpired
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Proposal(now time.Time) (CommercialProposal, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusDraft {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrExpired
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return CommercialProposal{}, err
	}

	refs := make([]specialized.Reference, 0, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		refs = append(refs, source.SourceReference)
	}

	return CommercialProposal{
		ID:                a.ID + "-proposal-" + fmt.Sprint(a.Revision),
		AggregateID:       a.ID,
		Direction:         a.Direction,
		Compatibility:     a.Compatibility,
		TotalQuantity:     a.Total,
		AvailableQuantity: available,
		RuleSetVersion:    a.RuleSetVersion,
		ExpiresAt:         a.ExpiresAt,
		SourceReferences:  refs,
		CreatedAt:         now,
	}, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Snapshot() Aggregate {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	copyOf := Aggregate{
		ID:             a.ID,
		Direction:      a.Direction,
		Status:         a.Status,
		Compatibility:  a.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: a.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      a.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      a.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        a.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  a.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       a.Revision,
		Total:          a.Total,
		Allocated:      a.Allocated,
		Contributions:  append([]SourceContribution(nil), a.Contributions...),
		Allocations:    make([]Allocation, len(a.Allocations)),
		Idempotency:    make(map[string]string, len(a.Idempotency)),
	}
	for i, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		copyOf.Allocations[i] = cloneAllocation(allocation)
	}
	for key, value := range a.Idempotency {
		copyOf.Idempotency[key] = value
	}
	return copyOf
}

func cloneAllocation(source Allocation) Allocation {
	result := source
	result.Lines = append([]AllocationLine(nil), source.Lines...)
	return result
}

function Write-Section {
    param([string]$Message)

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    Write-Host $Message -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
}

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Gray
}

function Write-Success {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[OK] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

    Write-Host "[WARNING] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow

    param([string]$Message)
    throw $Message
}

function Read-Utf8Text {
    param([string]$Path)

    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)

    return $text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
}

function Write-AtomicUtf8 {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force |
            Out-Null
    }

    $temporaryPath = Join-Path $directory (
        "." + [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path) +
        "." + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N") +
        ".tmp"
    )

    $encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

    try {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $temporaryPath,
            $Content,
            $encoding
        )

        Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath `
            -Destination $Path -Force
    }
    finally {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporaryPath) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath -Force
        }
    }
}

function Replace-TextExactlyOnce {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Source,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OldText,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$NewText,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Label
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OldText)) {
        Stop-Script "Empty source anchor is forbidden: $Label"
    }

    # Normalize line endings and indentation for comparison only.
    # The actual source outside the matched region remains unchanged.
    $Normalize = {
        param([string]$Value)

        $Value = $Value.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")

        $Lines = $Value -split "`n"

        $Lines = @(
            foreach ($Line in $Lines) {
                $Line.Trim()
            }
        )

        return ($Lines -join "`n").Trim()
    }

    $NormalizedSource = & $Normalize $Source
    $NormalizedOld = & $Normalize $OldText

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($NormalizedOld)) {
        Stop-Script "Normalized source anchor is empty: $Label"
    }

    $Index = $NormalizedSource.IndexOf(
        $NormalizedOld,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($Index -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "Source anchor not found after normalization: $Label"
    }

    $SecondIndex = $NormalizedSource.IndexOf(
        $NormalizedOld,
        $Index + $NormalizedOld.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($SecondIndex -ge 0) {
        Stop-Script "Source anchor is ambiguous after normalization: $Label"
    }

    # First attempt: exact replacement, preserving original behavior.
    $ExactIndex = $Source.IndexOf(
        $OldText,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($ExactIndex -ge 0) {
        $ExactSecond = $Source.IndexOf(
            $OldText,
            $ExactIndex + $OldText.Length,
            [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
        )

        if ($ExactSecond -ge 0) {
            Stop-Script "Exact source anchor is ambiguous: $Label"
        }

        return $Source.Substring(0, $ExactIndex) +
            $NewText +
            $Source.Substring($ExactIndex + $OldText.Length)
    }

    # If whitespace differs, locate the same logical lines in the
    # original source and replace only their complete line range.
    $SourceLines = $Source -split "`n", 0, "SimpleMatch"
    $OldLines = $OldText.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") -split "`n"

    $Expected = @(
        foreach ($Line in $OldLines) {
            $Line.Trim()
        }
    )

    $Matches = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[int]

    for ($Start = 0; $Start -le ($SourceLines.Count - $Expected.Count); $Start++) {
        $IsMatch = $true

        for ($Offset = 0; $Offset -lt $Expected.Count; $Offset++) {
            if ($SourceLines[$Start + $Offset].Trim() -cne $Expected[$Offset]) {
                $IsMatch = $false
                break
            }
        }

        if ($IsMatch) {
            $Matches.Add($Start)
        }
    }

    if ($Matches.Count -ne 1) {
        Stop-Script "Expected exactly one logical source anchor for '$Label'; found $($Matches.Count)."
    }

    $StartLine = $Matches[0]
    $EndLine = $StartLine + $Expected.Count - 1

    $Before = @()
    $After = @()

    if ($StartLine -gt 0) {
        $Before = @($SourceLines[0..($StartLine - 1)])
    }

    if ($EndLine -lt ($SourceLines.Count - 1)) {
        $After = @($SourceLines[($EndLine + 1)..($SourceLines.Count - 1)])
    }

    $NewLines = $NewText.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") -split "`n"

    return (@($Before) + @($NewLines) + @($After)) -join "`n"
}

function Replace-GoSection {
    param(
        [string]$Source,
        [string]$StartMarker,
        [string]$EndMarker,
        [string]$Replacement,
        [string]$Label
    )

    $start = $Source.IndexOf(
        $StartMarker,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($start -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "Go function not found: $Label"
    }

    $duplicate = $Source.IndexOf(
        $StartMarker,
        $start + $StartMarker.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($duplicate -ge 0) {
        Stop-Script "Duplicate Go function marker: $Label"
    }

    $end = $Source.IndexOf(
        $EndMarker,
        $start + $StartMarker.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($end -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "End boundary not found for: $Label"
    }

    return $Source.Substring(0, $start) +
        $Replacement.TrimEnd() +
        "`n`n" +
        $Source.Substring($end)
}

function Find-ProjectRoot {
    param([string]$InitialPath)

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($InitialPath)) {
        $resolved = Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $InitialPath
        $candidate = $resolved.Path

        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "go.mod")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "internal\application"))
        ) {
            return $candidate
        }

        Stop-Script "ProjectRoot is not a valid General Market project."
    }

    $current = (Get-Location).Path

    while (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($current)) {
        $goMod = Join-Path $current "go.mod"
        $application = Join-Path $current "internal\application"

        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath $goMod -PathType Leaf) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath $application -PathType Container)
        ) {
            return $current
        }

        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current

        if (
            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or
            $parent -eq $current
        ) {
            break
        }

        $current = $parent
    }

    Stop-Script "General Market project root was not found."
}

function Invoke-GoCheck {
    param(
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [string]$Label
    )

    Write-Section $Label

    $output = & go @Arguments 2>&1
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    foreach ($line in $output) {
        Write-Host $line
    }

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Stop-Script "Go command failed: go $($Arguments -join ' ')"
    }

    Write-Success "Command passed."
}

function Get-ProtectedFileHashes {
    param([string]$Root)

    $relativePaths = @(
        "migrations",
        "internal/database",
        "docker",
        "docker-compose.yml",
        "Dockerfile",
        "go.mod",
        "go.sum"
    )

    $result = @{}

    foreach ($relative in $relativePaths) {
        $full = Join-Path $Root $relative

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) {
            continue
        }

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full -PathType Leaf) {
            $hash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256
            $result[$relative] = $hash.Hash
            continue
        }

        $files = @(
            Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $full -File -Recurse -Force
        )

        foreach ($file in $files) {
            $key = $file.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart("\")
            $hash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Algorithm SHA256
            $result[$key] = $hash.Hash
        }
    }

    return $result
}

function Assert-ProtectedFilesUnchanged {
    param(
        [hashtable]$Before,
        [hashtable]$After
    )

    $allKeys = @(
        $Before.Keys + $After.Keys |
            Sort-Object -Unique
    )

    $differences = @()

    foreach ($key in $allKeys) {
        if (-not $Before.ContainsKey($key)) {
            $differences += "Unexpected protected file: $key"
            continue
        }

        if (-not $After.ContainsKey($key)) {
            $differences += "Protected file disappeared: $key"
            continue
        }

        if ($Before[$key] -ne $After[$key]) {
            $differences += "Protected file changed: $key"
        }
    }

    if ($differences.Count -gt 0) {
        Stop-Script (
            "Protected database/infrastructure files changed:`n" +
            ($differences -join "`n")
        )
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 02. ROLLBACK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

function Restore-OriginalFiles {
    Write-Section "ROLLBACK"

    foreach ($relative in $Script:OriginalFiles.Keys) {
        $target = Join-Path $Script:Root $relative
        $backup = Join-Path $Script:BackupRoot $relative

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup -PathType Leaf) {
            $content = Read-Utf8Text $backup
            Write-AtomicUtf8 -Path $target -Content $content

            Write-WarningMessage "Restored: $relative"
        }
    }

    foreach ($relative in $Script:NewFiles) {
        $target = Join-Path $Script:Root $relative

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force
            Write-WarningMessage "Removed generated file: $relative"
        }
    }

    Write-Success "Application changes rolled back."
}

// APPLICATION_PACKAGE_01_HARDENING_V1

const applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength = 200

func validateApplicationContext(ctx context.Context) error {
    if ctx == nil {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    return ctx.Err()
}

func applicationNowUTC(clock Clock) (time.Time, error) {
    if clock == nil {
        return time.Time{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    now := clock.Now()
    if now.IsZero() {
        return time.Time{}, ErrInvalidClock
    }

    return now.UTC(), nil
}

func applicationNewID(
    ctx context.Context,
    generator IDGenerator,
    namespace string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    if generator == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(namespace) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    id, err := generator.NewID(ctx, namespace)
    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" {
        return "", ErrInvalidGeneratedID
    }

    return id, nil
}

func applicationValidateAuditEvent(event marketflow.AuditEvent) error {
    if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf(
            "%w: invalid audit event: %v",
            ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
            err,
        )
    }

    return nil
}

type MarketCatalogueGuard struct {
'@

    $services = Replace-TextExactlyOnce `
        -Source $services `
        -OldText $helperAnchor `
        -NewText $helpers `
        -Label "Application helper insertion"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 08. MARKET / CATALOGUE GUARD
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(
    ctx context.Context,
    offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if g.Markets == nil || g.Categories == nil || g.Mappings == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    market, err := g.Markets.GetMarket(
        ctx,
        marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if market == nil || !market.IsOperational() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    publicCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    specializedCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if publicCategory == nil ||
        specializedCategory == nil ||
        !publicCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        !specializedCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        publicCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindGeneral ||
        specializedCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindSpecialized {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    mapping, err := g.Mappings.GetMapping(
        ctx,
        marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if mapping == nil || !mapping.IsUsable() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    return nil
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(" `
        -EndMarker "type OfferReadiness interface" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "MarketCatalogueGuard.ValidateOffer"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 09. OFFER LIFECYCLE
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd OfferCommand,
    permission string,
    action string,
) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Offers == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Readiness == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.OfferID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, permission); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.Offer

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            offer, err := s.Offers.GetOffer(txctx, cmd.OfferID)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if offer.ID != cmd.OfferID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if offer.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            previousVersion := offer.Version

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            switch action {
            case "submit_for_review":
                if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                    return err
                }

                err = offer.SubmitForReview(now)

            case "approve":
                err = offer.Approve(now)

            case "publish":
                if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                    return err
                }

                err = offer.Publish(now)

            default:
                return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
            }

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Offers.SaveOffer(
                txctx,
                offer,
                previousVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "offer",
                AggregateID:     offer.ID,
                Action:          action,
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: previousVersion,
                NewVersion:      offer.Version,
                OccurredAt:      now,
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = offer
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(" `
        -EndMarker "// Supply request selection." `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "OfferLifecycleService.transition"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. SUPPLY REQUEST / PROPOSAL SELECTION
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *SupplyRequestService) SelectProposal(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd SelectProposalCommand,
) (marketflow.SupplyRequest, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Requests == nil ||
        s.Proposals == nil ||
        s.Validator == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.RequestID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ProposalID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        cmd.ActorID,
        "supply_requests.select_proposal",
    ); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.SupplyRequest

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            request, requestRevision, err :=
                s.Requests.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.RequestID)

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if request.ID != cmd.RequestID || requestRevision == 0 {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if requestRevision != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            proposal, proposalRevision, err :=
                s.Proposals.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.ProposalID)

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if proposalRevision == 0 ||
                proposal.ID != cmd.ProposalID ||
                proposal.RequestID != request.ID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if proposal.State != marketflow.ProposalSubmitted {
                return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
            }

            if err := s.Validator.ValidateProposal(
                txctx,
                request,
                proposal,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := marketflow.SelectProposal(
                &request,
                proposal,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            proposal.State = marketflow.ProposalAccepted

            if err := s.Proposals.Save(
                txctx,
                proposal,
                proposalRevision,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Requests.Save(
                txctx,
                request,
                requestRevision,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if requestRevision == ^uint64(0) {
                return ErrRevisionOverflow
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "supply_request",
                AggregateID:     request.ID,
                Action:          "proposal_selected",
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: requestRevision,
                NewVersion:      requestRevision + 1,
                OccurredAt:      now,
                Metadata: map[string]string{
                    "proposal_id": string(proposal.ID),
                },
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = request
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. ORDER NOTIONAL
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func CalculateOrderNotional(order marketflow.Order) (int64, error) {
    switch order.Side {
    case marketflow.Buy:
        if order.Price <= 0 || order.Quantity <= 0 {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        if order.Price > math.MaxInt64/order.Quantity {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        return order.Price * order.Quantity, nil

    case marketflow.Sell:
        if order.Quantity <= 0 {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        // Sell-side reservation is quantity-based and is handled by
        // My Assets. No monetary notional is sent for this side.
        return 0, nil

    default:
        return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }
}

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 12. ORDER ADMISSION / SAFE RESERVATION COMPENSATION
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd PlaceOrderCommand,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Orders == nil ||
        s.Validator == nil ||
        s.Resources == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    key := strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey)

    if key == "" ||
        len(key) > applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    order := cmd.Order

    if err := order.Validate(); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if order.UserID != cmd.ActorID ||
        order.State != marketflow.OrderPending {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        cmd.ActorID,
        "orders.place",
    ); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    // First idempotency read:
    // a completed order must be replayed without creating a new reservation.
    existing, found, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if found {
        if !sameOrderIntent(existing, order) {
            return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
        }

        return existing, nil
    }

    if err := s.Validator.ValidateOrder(ctx, order); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    notional, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    // External reservation is deliberately outside the DB transaction.
    reservationID, err := s.Resources.ReserveForOrder(
        ctx,
        order,
        notional,
        key,
    )

    if err != nil {
        if errors.Is(err, ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown) {
            return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
                err,
                ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            )
        }

        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(reservationID)) == "" {
        // There is no safe identifier with which to release this reservation.
        // Treat this as a gateway contract violation and require reconciliation.
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            ErrInvalidReservationID,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
        )
    }

    var result marketflow.Order

    txErr := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            // Second idempotency read closes the race between the initial
            // read and the reservation operation.
            current, exists, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(
                txctx,
                key,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if exists {
                if !sameOrderIntent(current, order) {
                    return ErrIdempotencyConflict
                }

                result = current
                return nil
            }

            orderToSave := order

            if err := orderToSave.Open(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            created, err := s.Orders.CreateOrder(
                txctx,
                orderToSave,
                key,
                reservationID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            // A repository must not silently mutate the admitted intent.
            if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid created order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if !sameOrderIntent(created, order) ||
                created.State != marketflow.OrderOpen ||
                created.Version != orderToSave.Version {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "order",
                AggregateID:     created.ID,
                Action:          "placed",
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: order.Version,
                NewVersion:      created.Version,
                OccurredAt:      now,
                Metadata: map[string]string{
                    "reservation_id":  string(reservationID),
                    "idempotency_key": key,
                },
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = created
            return nil
        },
    )

    if txErr == nil {
        return result, nil
    }

    // A commit error may be ambiguous. Releasing the reservation without
    // determining whether the order committed could release live resources.
    if errors.Is(txErr, ErrTransactionOutcomeUnknown) {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
        )
    }

    // Reconcile against the authoritative order repository before compensation.
    // A committed order, even if the caller received a commit error, must retain
    // its reservation.
    persisted, exists, reconcileErr :=
        s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)

    if reconcileErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            fmt.Errorf("order reconciliation read failed: %w", reconcileErr),
        )
    }

    if exists {
        if sameOrderIntent(persisted, order) {
            return persisted, nil
        }

        // The idempotency key belongs to another intent.
        // Do not release a reservation that may belong to that order.
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
    }

    // Compensation is allowed only after a completed transaction failure
    // and a successful authoritative read proving that no order exists.
    releaseErr := s.Resources.ReleaseOrderResources(
        ctx,
        reservationID,
        key,
    )

    if releaseErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationCompensationFailed,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            fmt.Errorf("reservation compensation failed: %w", releaseErr),
        )
    }

    return marketflow.Order{}, txErr
}
'@

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *MatchingService) MatchNext(
    ctx context.Context,
    marketID marketflow.ID,
    offerID marketflow.ID,
) (MatchRecord, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return MatchRecord{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Book == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(marketID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(offerID)) == "" {
        return MatchRecord{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result MatchRecord

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            buy, sell, err := s.Book.LockBestCrossingPair(
                txctx,
                marketID,
                offerID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := buy.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid buy order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if err := sell.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid sell order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if buy.ID == sell.ID ||
                buy.Side != marketflow.Buy ||
                sell.Side != marketflow.Sell ||
                buy.MarketID != marketID ||
                sell.MarketID != marketID ||
                buy.OfferID != offerID ||
                sell.OfferID != offerID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            originalBuyVersion := buy.Version
            originalSellVersion := sell.Version

            match, err := marketflow.MatchOrders(&buy, &sell)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            matchID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "match",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            record := MatchRecord{
                ID:          matchID,
                MarketID:    buy.MarketID,
                OfferID:     buy.OfferID,
                BuyOrderID:  match.BuyOrderID,
                SellOrderID: match.SellOrderID,
                BuyerID:     buy.UserID,
                SellerID:    sell.UserID,
                Quantity:    match.Quantity,
                Price:       match.Price,
                CreatedAt:   now,
            }

            if record.Quantity <= 0 ||
                record.Price <= 0 ||
                record.BuyOrderID != buy.ID ||
                record.SellOrderID != sell.ID ||
                record.BuyerID == record.SellerID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
                txctx,
                buy,
                originalBuyVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
                txctx,
                sell,
                originalSellVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveMatch(
                txctx,
                record,
                "match:"+string(matchID),
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = record
            return nil
        },
    )

    if errors.Is(err, ErrNoCrossingOrders) {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrNoCrossingOrders
    }

    return result, err
}

func (s *TradeWorkflowService) UpdateStatus(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd TradeStatusCommand,
) (marketflow.Trade, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Trades == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result marketflow.Trade

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            trade, err := s.Trades.GetForUpdate(
                txctx,
                cmd.TradeID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if trade.ID != cmd.TradeID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            var currentValue string

            switch cmd.Dimension {
            case DimensionContract:
                currentValue = string(trade.Contract)

            case DimensionServices:
                currentValue = string(trade.Services)

            case DimensionDelivery:
                currentValue = string(trade.Delivery)

            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

            // A repeated command that has already achieved its desired
            // state is a successful no-op, even if its original version
            // is now stale.
            if currentValue == cmd.Value {
                result = trade
                return nil
            }

            if trade.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            switch cmd.Dimension {
            case DimensionContract:
                value := marketflow.ContractState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.ContractPending,
                    marketflow.ContractCreated,
                    marketflow.ContractFailed,
                    marketflow.ContractNotRequired:
                    trade.Contract = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            case DimensionServices:
                value := marketflow.ServiceState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.ServicePending,
                    marketflow.ServiceInProgress,
                    marketflow.ServiceCompleted,
                    marketflow.ServiceFailed,
                    marketflow.ServiceNotRequired:
                    trade.Services = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            case DimensionDelivery:
                value := marketflow.DeliveryState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.DeliveryPending,
                    marketflow.DeliveryConfirmed,
                    marketflow.DeliveryFailed,
                    marketflow.DeliveryNotRequired:
                    trade.Delivery = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

            if trade.Version == ^uint64(0) {
                return ErrRevisionOverflow
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if now.Before(trade.UpdatedAt) {
                return ErrInvalidClock
            }

            trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
            trade.Version++
            trade.UpdatedAt = now

            if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Trades.Save(
                txctx,
                trade,
                cmd.ExpectedVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = trade
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}

        -EndMarker "func RequireSettlementReadiness(" `

    # 15. EXECUTION POLICY GRAPH VALIDATION
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

func ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy) error {
    if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    steps := make(map[string]marketflow.ExecutionStep, len(policy.Steps))
    orders := make(map[int]bool, len(policy.Steps))
    codes := make([]string, 0, len(policy.Steps))

    for _, step := range policy.Steps {
        if strings.TrimSpace(step.Code) != step.Code ||
            step.Code == "" {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        if orders[step.Order] {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        if _, exists := steps[step.Code]; exists {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        orders[step.Order] = true
        steps[step.Code] = step
        codes = append(codes, step.Code)
    }

    // A dependency may appear only once in a step.
    // Every dependency must precede the dependent step.
    for _, step := range policy.Steps {
        dependencies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(step.DependsOn))

        for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
            if _, duplicate := dependencies[dependency]; duplicate {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }

            dependencies[dependency] = struct{}{}

            dependencyStep, exists := steps[dependency]

            if !exists ||
                dependency == step.Code ||
                dependencyStep.Order >= step.Order {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }
        }
    }

    // Deterministic traversal makes failures reproducible.
    sort.Strings(codes)

    state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))

    var visit func(string) error

    visit = func(code string) error {
        switch state[code] {
        case 1:
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph

        case 2:
            return nil
        }

        step, exists := steps[code]
        if !exists {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        state[code] = 1

        dependencies := append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
        sort.Strings(dependencies)

        for _, dependency := range dependencies {
            if _, exists := steps[dependency]; !exists {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }

            if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }

        state[code] = 2
        return nil
    }

    for _, code := range codes {
        if err := visit(code); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }

    return nil
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func ValidateExecutionPolicy(" `
        -EndMarker "type CompleteExecutionStepCommand struct" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "ValidateExecutionPolicy"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 16. EXECUTION PROGRESS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(
    ctx context.Context,
    policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy,
    cmd CompleteExecutionStepCommand,
) error {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Progress == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(cmd.StepCode) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedRevision == 0 {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if !policy.Active {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    return s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            progress, revision, err := s.Progress.GetForUpdate(
                txctx,
                cmd.TradeID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if progress.TradeID != cmd.TradeID {
                return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
            }

            if progress.PolicyID != policy.ID ||
                progress.PolicyVersion != policy.Version {
                return marketflow.ErrConflict
            }

            if revision == 0 {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            stepExists := false

            for _, step := range policy.Steps {
                if step.Code == cmd.StepCode {
                    stepExists = true
                    break
                }
            }

            if !stepExists {
                return marketflow.ErrNotFound
            }

            // Natural idempotency:
            // completing an already-completed step is a no-op.
            // This check intentionally precedes the revision comparison.
            if progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] {
                return nil
            }

            if revision != cmd.ExpectedRevision {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            if err := progress.CanComplete(
                policy,
                cmd.StepCode,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if progress.CompletedSteps == nil {
                progress.CompletedSteps = make(map[string]bool)
            }

            progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] = true

            return s.Progress.Save(
                txctx,
                progress,
                revision,
            )
        },
    )
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(" `
        -EndMarker "// Overflow-safe aggregation." `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "ExecutionProgressService.CompleteStep"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 17. LEGAL EXTERNAL REQUESTS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(
    ctx context.Context,
    actorID marketflow.ID,
    request marketflow.ExternalRequest,
    grantedScopes []string,
) (string, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        actorID,
        "legal.external.submit",
    ); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := request.ValidateAuthorization(grantedScopes); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    trackingID, err := s.Gateway.SubmitAuthorizedRequest(
        ctx,
        request,
    )

    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
        return "", ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown
    }

    return trackingID, nil
}

// GetRequestResult retrieves a previously submitted request using the
// external tracking identifier. It does not create or resubmit a request.
func (s *LegalRequestService) GetRequestResult(
    ctx context.Context,
    actorID marketflow.ID,
    trackingID string,
) (string, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        actorID,
        "legal.external.read",
    ); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    return s.Gateway.GetRequestResult(ctx, trackingID)
}

        -StartMarker "func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(" `
        -EndMarker "// Platform position is deliberately independent" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "LegalRequestService.Submit"
