package aggregation

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCommand      = errors.New("invalid aggregation command")
	ErrIncompatibleSource  = errors.New("source is incompatible with aggregate")
	ErrDuplicateSource     = errors.New("duplicate source contribution")
	ErrSourceNotEligible   = errors.New("source is not eligible")
	ErrAggregateNotActive  = errors.New("aggregate is not active")
	ErrAllocationTooLarge  = errors.New("allocation exceeds available quantity")
	ErrBelowMinimum        = errors.New("allocation is below minimum executable quantity")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key reused with different request")
	ErrAllocationNotFound  = errors.New("allocation not found")
	ErrInvalidTransition   = errors.New("invalid aggregate state transition")
	ErrExpired             = errors.New("aggregate has expired")
	ErrRevisionConflict    = errors.New("aggregate revision conflict")
)

type Aggregate struct {
	mu sync.Mutex

	ID             string
	Direction      Direction
	Status         AggregateStatus
	Compatibility  CompatibilityKey
	RuleSetVersion string
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	ExpiresAt      time.Time
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
	Revision       uint64
	Total          specialized.Quantity
	Allocated      specialized.Quantity
	Contributions  []SourceContribution
	Allocations    []Allocation
	Idempotency    map[string]string
}

type CommercialProposal struct {
	ID                string
	AggregateID       string
	Direction         Direction
	Compatibility     CompatibilityKey
	TotalQuantity     specialized.Quantity
	AvailableQuantity specialized.Quantity
	RuleSetVersion    string
	ExpiresAt         time.Time
	SourceReferences  []specialized.Reference
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

// Build creates an immutable source composition for one compatible commodity group.
// It does not create an order, trade, inventory record, or ownership record.
func Build(cmd BuildCommand) (*Aggregate, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AggregateID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.RuleSetVersion) == "" ||
		(cmd.Direction != Supply && cmd.Direction != Demand) ||
		len(cmd.Contributions) == 0 ||
		cmd.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!cmd.ExpiresAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := validateCompatibilityKey(cmd.Compatibility); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sources := append([]SourceContribution(nil), cmd.Contributions...)
	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool {
		return sources[i].SourceID < sources[j].SourceID
	})

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	var total specialized.Quantity

	for i, source := range sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceID) == "" ||
			source.Direction != cmd.Direction ||
			source.Status != SourceValidated ||
			strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceVersion) == "" ||
			source.ValidatedAt.IsZero() ||
			!source.ValidUntil.After(cmd.CreatedAt) ||
			source.ValidatedAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source %q", ErrSourceNotEligible, source.SourceID)
		}

		if _, exists := seen[source.SourceID]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrDuplicateSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		seen[source.SourceID] = struct{}{}

		if err := source.SourceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if source.SourceReference.ResourceID != source.SourceID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference ID mismatch", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
		if source.Compatibility != cmd.Compatibility {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrIncompatibleSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		if err := source.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := source.MinimumExecutable.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum quantity: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if _, err := source.Quantity.Compare(source.MinimumExecutable); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if source.MinimumExecutable.Value > source.Quantity.Value {
			return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
		}
		if source.EvidenceReference != nil {
			if err := source.EvidenceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		if i == 0 {
			total = source.Quantity
		} else {
			var err error
			total, err = total.Add(source.Quantity)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}

	return &Aggregate{
		ID:             cmd.AggregateID,
		Direction:      cmd.Direction,
		Status:         StatusActive,
		Compatibility:  cmd.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      cmd.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      cmd.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       1,
		Total:          total,
		Allocated:      specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: total.Scale, Unit: total.Unit},
		Contributions:  sources,
		Idempotency:    map[string]string{cmd.IdempotencyKey: buildFingerprint(cmd)},
	}, nil
}

func validateCompatibilityKey(k CompatibilityKey) error {
	fields := []string{
		k.CommodityID, k.SpecificationHash, k.Grade, k.Standard,
		k.Unit, k.DeliveryLocation, k.DeliveryWindow, k.Currency,
		k.CommercialTerms, k.ServiceProfile,
	}
	for _, field := range fields {
		if strings.TrimSpace(field) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: compatibility key is incomplete", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func buildFingerprint(cmd BuildCommand) string {
	parts := []string{
		cmd.AggregateID, string(cmd.Direction), cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		fmt.Sprintf("%v", cmd.Compatibility),
	}
	for _, source := range cmd.Contributions {
		parts = append(parts, source.SourceID, source.SourceVersion,
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", source.Quantity.Value, source.Quantity.Scale, source.Quantity.Unit))
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func allocationFingerprint(cmd AllocationCommand) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s|%d|%d|%s|%s",
		cmd.AllocationID, cmd.Quantity.Value, cmd.Quantity.Scale,
		cmd.Quantity.Unit, cmd.ActorID,
	)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (a *Aggregate) Available() specialized.Quantity {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: a.Total.Scale, Unit: a.Total.Unit}
	}
	return available
}

func (a *Aggregate) Allocate(cmd AllocationCommand) (Allocation, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AllocationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := cmd.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	fingerprint := allocationFingerprint(cmd)
	if previous, exists := a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return Allocation{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
			if allocation.IdempotencyKey == cmd.IdempotencyKey {
				return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
			}
		}
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAggregateNotActive
	}
	if !cmd.OccurredAt.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return Allocation{}, ErrExpired
	}
	if _, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(a.Total); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	cmp, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(available)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	if cmp > 0 {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAllocationTooLarge
	}

	lines, err := a.planAllocation(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	nextAllocated, err := a.Allocated.Add(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	allocation := Allocation{
		ID:             cmd.AllocationID,
		IdempotencyKey: cmd.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
		Quantity:       cmd.Quantity,
		Lines:          lines,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		OccurredAt:     cmd.OccurredAt,
	}

	a.Allocated = nextAllocated
	a.Allocations = append(a.Allocations, allocation)
	a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint
	a.Revision++

	if a.Allocated.Value == a.Total.Value {
		a.Status = StatusAllocated
	} else {
		a.Status = StatusPartial
	}

	return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
}

// planAllocation uses deterministic source ordering. It never allocates
// more than the remaining amount of an individual source.
func (a *Aggregate) planAllocation(requested specialized.Quantity) ([]AllocationLine, error) {
	remaining := requested.Value
	lines := make([]AllocationLine, 0, len(a.Contributions))

	used := make(map[string]int64, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		for _, line := range allocation.Lines {
			used[line.SourceID] += line.Quantity.Value
		}
	}

	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		if remaining == 0 {
			break
		}
		sourceAvailable := source.Quantity.Value - used[source.SourceID]
		if sourceAvailable <= 0 {
			continue
		}

		take := sourceAvailable
		if take > remaining {
			take = remaining
		}

		if take < source.MinimumExecutable.Value {
			continue
		}

		lines = append(lines, AllocationLine{
			SourceID: source.SourceID,
			Quantity: specialized.Quantity{
				Value: take,
				Scale: requested.Scale,
				Unit:  requested.Unit,
			},
		})
		remaining -= take
	}

	if remaining != 0 {
		return nil, ErrBelowMinimum
	}
	return lines, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Cancel(actorID, reason string, occurredAt time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(actorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" ||
		occurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusAllocated {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusCancelled
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Expire(now time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusExpired
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Proposal(now time.Time) (CommercialProposal, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusDraft {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrExpired
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return CommercialProposal{}, err
	}

	refs := make([]specialized.Reference, 0, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		refs = append(refs, source.SourceReference)
	}

	return CommercialProposal{
		ID:                a.ID + "-proposal-" + fmt.Sprint(a.Revision),
		AggregateID:       a.ID,
		Direction:         a.Direction,
		Compatibility:     a.Compatibility,
		TotalQuantity:     a.Total,
		AvailableQuantity: available,
		RuleSetVersion:    a.RuleSetVersion,
		ExpiresAt:         a.ExpiresAt,
		SourceReferences:  refs,
		CreatedAt:         now,
	}, nil
}

// AggregateSnapshot is a detached read model.
// It intentionally contains no mutex and can safely be returned by value.
type AggregateSnapshot struct {
	ID             string
	Direction      Direction
	Status         AggregateStatus
	Compatibility  CompatibilityKey
	RuleSetVersion string
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	ExpiresAt      time.Time
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
	Revision       uint64
	Total          specialized.Quantity
	Allocated      specialized.Quantity
	Contributions  []SourceContribution
	Allocations    []Allocation
	Idempotency    map[string]string
}

func (a *Aggregate) Snapshot() AggregateSnapshot {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	snapshot := AggregateSnapshot{
		ID:             a.ID,
		Direction:      a.Direction,
		Status:         a.Status,
		Compatibility:  a.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: a.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      a.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      a.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        a.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  a.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       a.Revision,
		Total:          a.Total,
		Allocated:      a.Allocated,
		Contributions:  append([]SourceContribution(nil), a.Contributions...),
		Allocations:    make([]Allocation, len(a.Allocations)),
		Idempotency:    make(map[string]string, len(a.Idempotency)),
	}

	for i, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		snapshot.Allocations[i] = cloneAllocation(allocation)
	}

	for key, value := range a.Idempotency {
		snapshot.Idempotency[key] = value
	}

	return snapshot
}

func cloneAllocation(source Allocation) Allocation {
	result := source
	result.Lines = append([]AllocationLine(nil), source.Lines...)
	return result
}

func TestAllocationIsPartialAndIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	aggregate, now := buildTestAggregate(t)
	command := AllocationCommand{
		AllocationID:   "allocation-1",
		IdempotencyKey: "allocate-1",
		Quantity:       specialized.Quantity{Value: 70, Scale: 0, Unit: "kg"},
		ActorID:        "buyer-1",
		CorrelationID:  "corr-2",
		OccurredAt:     now.Add(time.Minute),
	}

	first, err := aggregate.Allocate(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Allocate() error = %v", err)
	}
	second, err := aggregate.Allocate(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("idempotent Allocate() error = %v", err)
	}
	if first.ID != second.ID || first.Quantity.Value != second.Quantity.Value {
		t.Fatal("idempotent replay returned a different allocation")
	}
	if aggregate.Status != StatusPartial {
		t.Fatalf("status = %s, want PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED", aggregate.Status)
	}
	if aggregate.Allocated.Value != 70 {
		t.Fatalf("allocated = %d, want 70", aggregate.Allocated.Value)
	}
}

package aggregation

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

type Direction string

const (
	Supply Direction = "SUPPLY"
	Demand Direction = "DEMAND"
)

type AggregateStatus string

const (
	StatusDraft     AggregateStatus = "DRAFT"
	StatusActive    AggregateStatus = "ACTIVE"
	StatusPartial   AggregateStatus = "PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED"
	StatusAllocated AggregateStatus = "ALLOCATED"
	StatusCancelled AggregateStatus = "CANCELLED"
	StatusExpired   AggregateStatus = "EXPIRED"
)

type SourceStatus string

const (
	SourceValidated SourceStatus = "VALIDATED"
	SourceRejected  SourceStatus = "REJECTED"
	SourceSuspended SourceStatus = "SUSPENDED"
)

// CompatibilityKey contains only attributes that must be identical
// for sources to participate in one aggregate.
type CompatibilityKey struct {
	CommodityID       string
	SpecificationHash string
	Grade             string
	Standard          string
	Unit              string
	DeliveryLocation  string
	DeliveryWindow    string
	Currency          string
	CommercialTerms   string
	ServiceProfile    string
}

func (k CompatibilityKey) Equal(other CompatibilityKey) bool {
	return k == other
}

type SourceContribution struct {
	SourceID          string
	SourceReference   specialized.Reference
	Direction         Direction
	Status            SourceStatus
	Quantity          specialized.Quantity
	MinimumExecutable specialized.Quantity
	Compatibility     CompatibilityKey
	SourceVersion     string
	EvidenceReference *specialized.Reference
	ValidatedAt       time.Time
	ValidUntil        time.Time
}

type BuildCommand struct {
	AggregateID    string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Direction      Direction
	Compatibility  CompatibilityKey
	Contributions  []SourceContribution
	RuleSetVersion string
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	ExpiresAt      time.Time
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
}

type AllocationCommand struct {
	AllocationID   string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Quantity       specialized.Quantity
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
	OccurredAt     time.Time
}

type AllocationLine struct {
	SourceID string
	Quantity specialized.Quantity
}

type Allocation struct {
	ID             string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Fingerprint    string
	Quantity       specialized.Quantity
	Lines          []AllocationLine
	ActorID        string
	CorrelationID  string
	OccurredAt     time.Time
}

type AuditEvent struct {
	ID            string
	AggregateID   string
	EventType     string
	ActorID       string
	CorrelationID string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	Reason        string
}

type AuditSink interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event AuditEvent) error
}

type AggregateRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, aggregateID string) (*Aggregate, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, aggregate *Aggregate, expectedRevision uint64) error
}

type TransactionRunner interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

type AggregateService struct {
	Repository   AggregateRepository
	Transactions TransactionRunner
	Audit        AuditSink
	Clock        func() time.Time
}

package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

type Config struct {
	URL             string
	MaxOpenConns    int
	MaxIdleConns    int
	ConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*sql.DB, error) {
	if cfg.URL == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", cfg.URL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open database: %w", err)
	}

	if cfg.MaxOpenConns > 0 {
		db.SetMaxOpenConns(cfg.MaxOpenConns)
	}
	if cfg.MaxIdleConns >= 0 {
		db.SetMaxIdleConns(cfg.MaxIdleConns)
	}
	if cfg.ConnMaxLifetime > 0 {
		db.SetConnMaxLifetime(cfg.ConnMaxLifetime)
	}

	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := db.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to database: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}

FILE: Real-Asset-Management-Platform\general-market-backend\internal\database\migrate.go
SIZE: 3443 bytes

package database

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/migrations"
)

const migrationLockID int64 = 5270645408566230100

func Migrate(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	if db == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("database is not configured")
	}

	conn, err := db.Conn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration connection: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()

	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(
		ctx,
		"SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)",
		migrationLockID,
	); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration advisory lock: %w", err)
	}

	defer func() {
		unlockCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = conn.ExecContext(
			unlockCtx,
			"SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)",
			migrationLockID,
		)
	}()

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
			version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			checksum TEXT,
			applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("initialize migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		ALTER TABLE schema_migrations
		ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS checksum TEXT
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("upgrade migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	files, err := fs.Glob(migrations.Files, "*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list migration files: %w", err)
	}
	sort.Strings(files)

	for _, file := range files {
		if strings.Contains(file, "..") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid migration path: %s", file)
		}

		content, err := migrations.Files.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", file, err)
		}

		version := strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".sql")
		sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
		checksum := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])

		var stored sql.NullString
		err = conn.QueryRowContext(
			ctx,
			`SELECT checksum FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1`,
			version,
		).Scan(&stored)

		if err == nil {
			if !stored.Valid || stored.String == "" {
				// Existing installations created before checksum support:
				// adopt the currently deployed migration as the baseline.
				_, err = conn.ExecContext(
					ctx,
					`UPDATE schema_migrations
					 SET checksum = $1
					 WHERE version = $2 AND checksum IS NULL`,
					checksum,
					version,
				)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("adopt legacy checksum for %s: %w", version, err)
				}
				continue
			}

			if stored.String != checksum {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"migration checksum mismatch for %s: applied migration file was modified; restore the original file or create a new migration",
					version,
				)
			}
			continue
		}

		if err != sql.ErrNoRows {
			return fmt.Errorf("check migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		tx, err := conn.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if _, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, string(content)); err == nil {
			_, err = tx.ExecContext(
				ctx,
				`INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, checksum)
				 VALUES ($1, $2)`,
				version,
				checksum,
			)
		}

		if err != nil {
			_ = tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

package qualification

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidScheme      = errors.New("invalid eligibility scheme")
	ErrInvalidEvidence    = errors.New("invalid eligibility evidence")
	ErrUnsupportedSubject = errors.New("unsupported subject type")
)

type SchemeID string

type SubjectType string

const (
	SubjectPerson  SubjectType = "person"
	SubjectCompany SubjectType = "company"
)

type CriterionType string

const (
	CriterionDocument     CriterionType = "document"
	CriterionRegistration CriterionType = "registration"
	CriterionLicense      CriterionType = "license"
	CriterionJurisdiction CriterionType = "jurisdiction"
	CriterionExperience   CriterionType = "experience_months"
)

type Criterion struct {
	Code             string
	Name             string
	Type             CriterionType
	Required         bool
	DocumentCode     string
	RegistrationCode string
	LicenseCode      string
	JurisdictionCode string
	MinimumMonths    uint64
}

type Scheme struct {
	ID          SchemeID
	Version     uint64
	Name        string
	Subjects    []SubjectType
	Criteria    []Criterion
	Active      bool
	EffectiveAt time.Time
	ExpiresAt   *time.Time
}

type EvidenceStatus string

const (
	EvidenceSubmitted EvidenceStatus = "submitted"
	EvidenceVerified  EvidenceStatus = "verified"
	EvidenceRejected  EvidenceStatus = "rejected"
	EvidenceExpired   EvidenceStatus = "expired"
)

type DocumentEvidence struct {
	Code      string
	Status    EvidenceStatus
	ExpiresAt *time.Time
}

type RegistrationEvidence struct {
	Code   string
	Status EvidenceStatus
}

type LicenseEvidence struct {
	Code   string
	Status EvidenceStatus
}

type Evidence struct {
	Subject          SubjectType
	Documents        []DocumentEvidence
	Registrations    []RegistrationEvidence
	Licenses         []LicenseEvidence
	Jurisdictions    []string
	ExperienceMonths uint64
}

type ResultStatus string

const (
	ResultEligible   ResultStatus = "eligible"
	ResultIneligible ResultStatus = "ineligible"
	ResultReview     ResultStatus = "needs_review"
)

type Issue struct {
	CriterionCode string
	Code          string
	Message       string
}

type Evaluation struct {
	SchemeID    SchemeID
	Version     uint64
	Subject     SubjectType
	Status      ResultStatus
	Issues      []Issue
	EvaluatedAt time.Time
}

func validCode(s string) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(s) != s {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') &&
			!(r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') &&
			!(r >= '0' && r <= '9') &&
			r != '_' && r != '-' && r != '.' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (s Scheme) Validate() error {
	if !validCode(string(s.ID)) || s.Version == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(s.Name) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidScheme
	}

	if len(s.Subjects) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: no supported subject types", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	subjects := make(map[SubjectType]struct{})
	for _, subject := range s.Subjects {
		if subject != SubjectPerson && subject != SubjectCompany {
			return ErrUnsupportedSubject
		}
		if _, exists := subjects[subject]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate subject type", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
		subjects[subject] = struct{}{}
	}

	criteria := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, c := range s.Criteria {
		if !validCode(c.Code) || strings.TrimSpace(c.Name) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid criterion", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
		if _, exists := criteria[c.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate criterion %s", ErrInvalidScheme, c.Code)
		}
		criteria[c.Code] = struct{}{}

		switch c.Type {
		case CriterionDocument:
			if !validCode(c.DocumentCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: document code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionRegistration:
			if !validCode(c.RegistrationCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: registration code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionLicense:
			if !validCode(c.LicenseCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: license code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionJurisdiction:
			if !validCode(c.JurisdictionCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: jurisdiction code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionExperience:
			if c.MinimumMonths == 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum experience must be positive", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported criterion type", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func containsSubject(subjects []SubjectType, target SubjectType) bool {
	for _, s := range subjects {
		if s == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func verifiedDocument(e Evidence, code string, now time.Time) (bool, bool) {
	for _, d := range e.Documents {
		if d.Code != code {
			continue
		}
		if d.Status == EvidenceVerified {
			if d.ExpiresAt != nil && !d.ExpiresAt.After(now) {
				return false, false
			}
			return true, false
		}
		if d.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
			return false, true
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func verifiedRegistration(e Evidence, code string) (bool, bool) {
	for _, r := range e.Registrations {
		if r.Code == code {
			if r.Status == EvidenceVerified {
				return true, false
			}
			if r.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
				return false, true
			}
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func verifiedLicense(e Evidence, code string) (bool, bool) {
	for _, l := range e.Licenses {
		if l.Code == code {
			if l.Status == EvidenceVerified {
				return true, false
			}
			if l.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
				return false, true
			}
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func hasJurisdiction(e Evidence, code string) bool {
	for _, jurisdiction := range e.Jurisdictions {
		if jurisdiction == code {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func Evaluate(s Scheme, evidence Evidence, now time.Time) (Evaluation, error) {
	if err := s.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Evaluation{}, err
	}

	if !s.Active {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme is inactive", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	if evidence.Subject != SubjectPerson && evidence.Subject != SubjectCompany {
		return Evaluation{}, ErrUnsupportedSubject
	}

	if !containsSubject(s.Subjects, evidence.Subject) {
		return Evaluation{}, ErrUnsupportedSubject
	}

	now = now.UTC()

	if !s.EffectiveAt.IsZero() && now.Before(s.EffectiveAt.UTC()) {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme is not yet effective", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}
	if s.ExpiresAt != nil && !now.Before(s.ExpiresAt.UTC()) {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme has expired", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	issues := make([]Issue, 0)
	reviewRequired := false

	for _, c := range s.Criteria {
		if !c.Required {
			continue
		}

		satisfied := false
		pending := false

		switch c.Type {
		case CriterionDocument:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedDocument(evidence, c.DocumentCode, now)
		case CriterionRegistration:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedRegistration(evidence, c.RegistrationCode)
		case CriterionLicense:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedLicense(evidence, c.LicenseCode)
		case CriterionJurisdiction:
			satisfied = hasJurisdiction(evidence, c.JurisdictionCode)
		case CriterionExperience:
			satisfied = evidence.ExperienceMonths >= c.MinimumMonths
		}

		if satisfied {
			continue
		}

		code := "criterion_not_met"
		message := "required criterion has not been satisfied"

		if pending {
			code = "evidence_pending"
			message = "evidence has been submitted but is not verified"
			reviewRequired = true
		}

		issues = append(issues, Issue{
			CriterionCode: c.Code,
			Code:          code,
			Message:       message,
		})
	}

	sort.Slice(issues, func(i, j int) bool {
		return issues[i].CriterionCode < issues[j].CriterionCode
	})

	status := ResultEligible
	if len(issues) > 0 {
		status = ResultIneligible
		if reviewRequired {
			status = ResultReview
		}
	}

	return Evaluation{
		SchemeID:    s.ID,
		Version:     s.Version,
		Subject:     evidence.Subject,
		Status:      status,
		Issues:      issues,
		EvaluatedAt: now,
	}, nil
}

// A result is only reusable for the exact scheme version that produced it.
func ValidateEvaluationReference(result Evaluation, schemeID SchemeID, version uint64) error {
	if result.SchemeID != schemeID || result.Version != version {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: eligibility scheme version mismatch", ErrInvalidEvidence)
	}
	return nil
}

// Qualification is not legal ownership, identity verification,
// account authorization, or settlement approval.
type QualificationReference struct {
	SchemeID SchemeID
	Version  uint64
	Status   ResultStatus
}

package execution

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidPolicy       = errors.New("invalid execution policy")
	ErrInvalidCommand      = errors.New("invalid execution command")
	ErrWorkflowNotFound    = errors.New("execution workflow not found")
	ErrStepNotFound        = errors.New("execution step not found")
	ErrInvalidTransition   = errors.New("invalid workflow transition")
	ErrRevisionConflict    = errors.New("workflow revision conflict")
	ErrDependencyPending   = errors.New("step dependencies are not completed")
	ErrStepAlreadyRunning  = errors.New("step is already running")
	ErrStepNotRunning      = errors.New("step is not running")
	ErrAttemptMismatch     = errors.New("execution attempt token mismatch")
	ErrAlreadyApplied      = errors.New("command already applied")
	ErrCompensationMissing = errors.New("compensation is not configured")
)

type WorkflowStatus string

	WorkflowDraft        WorkflowStatus = "draft"
	WorkflowRunning      WorkflowStatus = "running"
	WorkflowPaused       WorkflowStatus = "paused"
	WorkflowCompleted    WorkflowStatus = "completed"
	WorkflowFailed       WorkflowStatus = "failed"
	WorkflowCompensating WorkflowStatus = "compensating"
	WorkflowCompensated  WorkflowStatus = "compensated"

	StepPending      StepStatus = "pending"
	StepRunning      StepStatus = "running"
	StepSucceeded    StepStatus = "succeeded"
	StepFailed       StepStatus = "failed"
	StepCompensating StepStatus = "compensating"
	StepCompensated  StepStatus = "compensated"
	StepSkipped      StepStatus = "skipped"
)

type StepKind string

	StepContract   StepKind = "contract"
	StepService    StepKind = "service"
	StepPosition   StepKind = "position"
	StepSettlement StepKind = "settlement"
	StepCustom     StepKind = "custom"
)

type StepDefinition struct {
	Key             string
	Kind            StepKind
	DependsOn       []string
	Required        bool
	MaxAttempts     int
	CompensationKey string
}

type ExecutionPolicy struct {
	ID      string
	Version uint64
	Steps   []StepDefinition
}

type StepExecution struct {
	Key             string
	Kind            StepKind
	Status          StepStatus
	Attempt         int
	MaxAttempts     int
	AttemptToken    string
	ResultReference string
	ErrorCode       string
	ErrorMessage    string
	StartedAt       *time.Time
	CompletedAt     *time.Time
	DependsOn       []string
	Required        bool
	CompensationKey string
}

type HistoryEntry struct {
	Sequence  uint64
	Action    string
	StepKey   string
	Reference string
	Reason    string
	At        time.Time
}

type Workflow struct {
	ID              string
	TradeID         string
	PolicyID        string
	PolicyVersion   uint64
	Status          WorkflowStatus
	Revision        uint64
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	UpdatedAt       time.Time
	Steps           map[string]*StepExecution
	History         []HistoryEntry
	AppliedCommands map[string]struct{}
}

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID        string
	TraceID        string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Now            time.Time
}

func (c CommandContext) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: actor ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.IdempotencyKey) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: idempotency key is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if c.Now.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command time is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	return nil
}

func (p ExecutionPolicy) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(p.ID) == "" || p.Version == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: policy ID and version are required", ErrInvalidPolicy)
	}
	if len(p.Steps) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one step is required", ErrInvalidPolicy)
	}

	definitions := make(map[string]StepDefinition, len(p.Steps))

	for _, step := range p.Steps {
		key := strings.TrimSpace(step.Key)
		if key == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: empty step key", ErrInvalidPolicy)
		}
		if _, exists := definitions[key]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate step key %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		if !validStepKind(step.Kind) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported step kind %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.Kind)
		}
		if step.MaxAttempts < 1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: step %q must allow at least one attempt", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		definitions[key] = step
	}

	for _, step := range p.Steps {
		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
		for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
			if dependency == step.Key {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: step %q depends on itself", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.Key)
			}
			if _, exists := definitions[dependency]; !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: dependency %q of step %q does not exist", ErrInvalidPolicy, dependency, step.Key)
			}
			if _, duplicate := seen[dependency]; duplicate {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate dependency %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, dependency)
			}
			seen[dependency] = struct{}{}
		}

		if step.CompensationKey != "" {
			compensation, exists := definitions[step.CompensationKey]
			if !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: compensation step %q does not exist", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.CompensationKey)
			}
			if compensation.CompensationKey != "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: nested compensation is not supported", ErrInvalidPolicy)
			}
		}
	}

	visiting := make(map[string]bool)
	visited := make(map[string]bool)

	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(key string) error {
		if visiting[key] {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: dependency cycle detected at %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		if visited[key] {
			return nil
		}

		visiting[key] = true
		for _, dependency := range definitions[key].DependsOn {
			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		visiting[key] = false
		visited[key] = true
		return nil
	}

	for key := range definitions {
		if err := visit(key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func validStepKind(kind StepKind) bool {
	switch kind {
	case StepContract, StepService, StepPosition, StepSettlement, StepCustom:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func NewWorkflow(id, tradeID string, policy ExecutionPolicy, now time.Time) (*Workflow, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(tradeID) == "" || now.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: workflow ID, trade ID and creation time are required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	workflow := &Workflow{
		ID:              id,
		TradeID:         tradeID,
		PolicyID:        policy.ID,
		PolicyVersion:   policy.Version,
		Status:          WorkflowDraft,
		Revision:        1,
		CreatedAt:       now,
		UpdatedAt:       now,
		Steps:           make(map[string]*StepExecution, len(policy.Steps)),
		AppliedCommands: make(map[string]struct{}),
	}

	for _, definition := range policy.Steps {
		workflow.Steps[definition.Key] = &StepExecution{
			Key:             definition.Key,
			Kind:            definition.Kind,
			Status:          StepPending,
			MaxAttempts:     definition.MaxAttempts,
			DependsOn:       append([]string(nil), definition.DependsOn...),
			Required:        definition.Required,
			CompensationKey: definition.CompensationKey,
		}
	}

	workflow.addHistory("workflow_created", "", policy.ID, "", now)
	return workflow, nil
}

func (w *Workflow) Start(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	w.Status = WorkflowRunning
	w.commit(ctx, "workflow_started", "", "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(attemptToken) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: attempt token is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepPending {
		if step.Status == StepRunning {
			return ErrStepAlreadyRunning
		}
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !w.dependenciesCompleted(step) {
		return ErrDependencyPending
	}

	step.Status = StepRunning
	step.Attempt++
	step.AttemptToken = attemptToken
	step.StartedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.CompletedAt = nil
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.commit(ctx, "step_started", stepKey, attemptToken, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	resultReference string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning {
		return ErrStepNotRunning
	}
	if step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepSucceeded
	step.ResultReference = resultReference
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.refreshStatus()
	w.commit(ctx, "step_succeeded", stepKey, resultReference, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) FailStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	errorCode string,
	errorMessage string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning {
		return ErrStepNotRunning
	}
	if step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepFailed
	step.ErrorCode = strings.TrimSpace(errorCode)
	step.ErrorMessage = strings.TrimSpace(errorMessage)
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.AttemptToken = ""

	if step.Attempt < step.MaxAttempts {
		w.Status = WorkflowPaused
	} else {
		w.Status = WorkflowFailed
	}

	w.commit(ctx, "step_failed", stepKey, "", step.ErrorCode)
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) RetryStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowPaused {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepFailed || step.Attempt >= step.MaxAttempts {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepPending
	step.AttemptToken = ""
	step.StartedAt = nil
	step.CompletedAt = nil
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.Status = WorkflowRunning
	w.commit(ctx, "step_retry_authorized", stepKey, "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginCompensation(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowFailed {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	hasCompensation := false
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		if step.Status == StepSucceeded && step.CompensationKey != "" {
			hasCompensation = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !hasCompensation {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}

	w.Status = WorkflowCompensating
	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_started", "", "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteCompensation(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepSucceeded || step.CompensationKey == "" {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}

	compensation, exists := w.Steps[step.CompensationKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}
	if compensation.Status != StepSucceeded {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepCompensated
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)

	allCompensated := true
	for _, candidate := range w.Steps {
		if candidate.Status == StepSucceeded && candidate.CompensationKey != "" {
			allCompensated = false
			break
		}
	}

	if allCompensated {
		w.Status = WorkflowCompensated
	}

	w.commit(ctx, "step_compensated", stepKey, step.CompensationKey, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginCompensationStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(attemptToken) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.CompensationKey == "" || step.Status != StepPending {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepRunning
	step.Attempt++
	step.AttemptToken = attemptToken
	step.StartedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)

	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_step_started", stepKey, attemptToken, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteCompensationStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	resultReference string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning || step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepSucceeded
	step.ResultReference = resultReference
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.AttemptToken = ""

	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_step_succeeded", stepKey, resultReference, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) dependenciesCompleted(step *StepExecution) bool {
	for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
		dep, exists := w.Steps[dependency]
		if !exists || dep.Status != StepSucceeded {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (w *Workflow) refreshStatus() {
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		if step.Required && step.Status != StepSucceeded && step.Status != StepSkipped {
			return
		}
	}
	w.Status = WorkflowCompleted
}

func (w *Workflow) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected != w.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) isApplied(key string) bool {
	_, exists := w.AppliedCommands[key]
	return exists
}

func (w *Workflow) commit(
	ctx CommandContext,
	action string,
	stepKey string,
	reference string,
	reason string,
) {
	w.Revision++
	w.UpdatedAt = ctx.Now
	w.AppliedCommands[ctx.IdempotencyKey] = struct{}{}
	w.addHistory(action, stepKey, reference, reason, ctx.Now)
}

func (w *Workflow) addHistory(
	action string,
	stepKey string,
	reference string,
	reason string,
	at time.Time,
) {
	w.History = append(w.History, HistoryEntry{
		Sequence:  uint64(len(w.History) + 1),
		Action:    action,
		StepKey:   stepKey,
		Reference: reference,
		Reason:    reason,
		At:        at,
	})
}

func (w *Workflow) OrderedSteps() []StepExecution {
	result := make([]StepExecution, 0, len(w.Steps))
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		copy := *step
		copy.DependsOn = append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
		result = append(result, copy)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		return result[i].Key < result[j].Key
	})
	return result
}

func (w *Workflow) Clone() *Workflow {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}

	clone := *w
	clone.Steps = make(map[string]*StepExecution, len(w.Steps))
	for key, step := range w.Steps {
		stepCopy := *step
		stepCopy.DependsOn = append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
		if step.StartedAt != nil {
			stepCopy.StartedAt = timePointer(*step.StartedAt)
		}
		if step.CompletedAt != nil {
			stepCopy.CompletedAt = timePointer(*step.CompletedAt)
		}
		clone.Steps[key] = &stepCopy
	}
	clone.History = append([]HistoryEntry(nil), w.History...)
	clone.AppliedCommands = make(map[string]struct{}, len(w.AppliedCommands))
	for key := range w.AppliedCommands {
		clone.AppliedCommands[key] = struct{}{}
	}
	return &clone
}

func timePointer(value time.Time) *time.Time {
	copy := value
	return &copy
}

		t.Fatal(err)

func TestWorkflowCloneIsIndependent(t *testing.T) {
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-clone", "trade-clone", testPolicy(), time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	clone := workflow.Clone()

	clone.Steps["contract"].Status = StepSucceeded
	clone.History[0].Action = "changed"
	clone.AppliedCommands["new"] = struct{}{}

	if workflow.Steps["contract"].Status == StepSucceeded {
		t.Fatal("step mutation leaked into original")
	}
	if workflow.History[0].Action == "changed" {
		t.Fatal("history mutation leaked into original")
	}
	if _, exists := workflow.AppliedCommands["new"]; exists {
		t.Fatal("idempotency mutation leaked into original")
	}
}

package health

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

func (h Handler) Liveness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ok",
	})
}

func (h Handler) Readiness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_not_configured",
		})
		return
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := h.DB.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_unavailable",
		})
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ready",
	})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/catalogue"
)

func New(db *sql.DB) http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/live", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "alive",
		})
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/ready", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if db == nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		ctx, cancel := timeouts(r)
		defer cancel()

		if err := db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "ready",
		})
	})

	catalogue.Handler{DB: db}.Register(mux)

	return securityHeaders(mux)
}

func timeouts(r *http.Request) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	return context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
}

func writeHealthJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, body any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
}

func securityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
		w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// AccessController must validate the actor against the trusted Account
// boundary. Callers must never construct an authorization grant from raw
// client-provided roles or scopes.
type AccessController interface {
	Authorize(
		ctx context.Context,
		principal Principal,
		operation Operation,
		resourceID string,
		provider ProviderID,
	) (AuthorizationGrant, error)
}

type ProviderIdentity struct {
	ID              ProviderID
	DisplayName     string
	ContractVersion string
}

type Provider interface {
	Identity() ProviderIdentity
	Capabilities() ProviderCapabilities
	Invoke(ctx context.Context, envelope Envelope) (ProviderResponse, error)
	Lookup(ctx context.Context, requestID string, externalOperationID string) (ProviderResponse, error)
}

type ProviderRegistry interface {
	Resolve(ctx context.Context, provider ProviderID) (Provider, error)
}

// Begin MUST be atomic across concurrent callers. For the same StorageKey:
//   - absent key: create an in-progress claim and return ACQUIRED;
//   - same fingerprint, completed: return REPLAY and the original response;
//   - same fingerprint, active: return IN_PROGRESS;
//   - different fingerprint: return CONFLICT.
//
// The implementation must persist the claim before returning ACQUIRED.
type IdempotencyStore interface {
	Begin(ctx context.Context, record IdempotencyRecord) (IdempotencyBeginResult, error)
	Complete(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, response ProviderResponse) error
	MarkPending(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, pending PendingOperation) error
	MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, failure FailureRecord) error
}

// PendingRepository must durably persist pending operations and support
// atomic resolution. Save must be idempotent by PendingOperation.ID.
type PendingRepository interface {
	Save(ctx context.Context, pending PendingOperation) error
	Get(ctx context.Context, id OperationID) (PendingOperation, error)
	ListDue(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, limit int) ([]PendingOperation, error)
	Resolve(ctx context.Context, id OperationID, status ResponseStatus, at time.Time) error
}

// IntegrationJournal is an append-only record of external attempts.
// Implementations should reject mutation of previously appended entries.
type IntegrationJournal interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, entry JournalEntry) error
}

// AuditRecorder records security-sensitive decisions and external outcomes.
// A durable implementation should participate in the same local transaction
// as the related state transition whenever possible.
type AuditRecorder interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event AuditEvent) error
}

// RequestSigner signs the canonical request envelope for providers that
// explicitly require cryptographic request authentication.
type RequestSigner interface {
	Sign(ctx context.Context, provider ProviderIdentity, envelope Envelope) ([]byte, error)
}

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// Service-specific operation names. These constants deliberately identify
// operations without transferring ownership of the underlying data.
const (
	ProviderAccount    ProviderID = "ACCOUNT"
	ProviderMyAssets   ProviderID = "MY_ASSETS"
	ProviderContracts  ProviderID = "CONTRACTS"
	ProviderServices   ProviderID = "SERVICES"
	ProviderSettlement ProviderID = "SETTLEMENT"
	ProviderRegulatory ProviderID = "REGULATORY"
)

const (
	OperationIdentityVerify  Operation = "IDENTITY_VERIFY"
	OperationPermissionCheck Operation = "PERMISSION_CHECK"

	OperationBuyingPowerCheck Operation = "BUYING_POWER_CHECK"
	OperationReserveResources Operation = "RESERVE_RESOURCES"
	OperationReleaseResources Operation = "RELEASE_RESOURCES"
	OperationRegisterPosition Operation = "REGISTER_PLATFORM_POSITION"

	OperationCreateContract Operation = "CREATE_CONTRACT"
	OperationGetContract    Operation = "GET_CONTRACT"
	OperationUpdateContract Operation = "UPDATE_CONTRACT"

	OperationRequestService   Operation = "REQUEST_SERVICE"
	OperationGetServiceStatus Operation = "GET_SERVICE_STATUS"
	OperationCancelService    Operation = "CANCEL_SERVICE"

	OperationPrepareSettlement   Operation = "PREPARE_SETTLEMENT"
	OperationFinalizeSettlement  Operation = "FINALIZE_SETTLEMENT"
	OperationGetSettlementStatus Operation = "GET_SETTLEMENT_STATUS"

	OperationRegulatoryInquiry    Operation = "REGULATORY_INQUIRY"
	OperationRegulatorySubmission Operation = "REGULATORY_SUBMISSION"
)

type AccountGateway interface {
	VerifyIdentity(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	CheckPermission(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type MyAssetsGateway interface {
	CheckBuyingPower(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	ReserveResources(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	ReleaseResources(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	RegisterPlatformPosition(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type ContractsGateway interface {
	CreateContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	UpdateContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type ServicesGateway interface {
	RequestService(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetServiceStatus(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	CancelService(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type SettlementGateway interface {
	PrepareSettlement(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	FinalizeSettlement(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetSettlementStatus(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type RegulatoryGateway interface {
	Inquire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	Submit(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

// Gateway implementations are thin typed facades over Executor. They must
// not implement business ownership, balance calculation, contract storage,
// service delivery, or settlement accounting inside General Market.

		return "integration: provider error"
