package lifecycle

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Status string

const (
	StatusDraft     Status = "draft"
	StatusInReview  Status = "in_review"
	StatusApproved  Status = "approved"
	StatusRejected  Status = "rejected"
	StatusPublished Status = "published"
	StatusSuspended Status = "suspended"
	StatusExpired   Status = "expired"
	StatusClosed    Status = "closed"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidOffer          = errors.New("invalid offer")
	ErrInvalidCommand        = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidTransition     = errors.New("invalid offer status transition")
	ErrRevisionConflict      = errors.New("offer revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict   = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrOfferNotExpired       = errors.New("offer has not expired")
	ErrOfferExpired          = errors.New("offer has expired")
	ErrReasonRequired        = errors.New("reason is required")
	ErrInvalidConfiguration  = errors.New("invalid configuration reference")
	ErrInvalidValidityPeriod = errors.New("invalid offer validity period")
	ErrInvalidActor          = errors.New("invalid actor")
	ErrCommandAlreadyApplied = errors.New("command already applied")
)

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string
}

type Draft struct {
	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Title       string
	Description string

	StartsAt time.Time
	EndsAt   time.Time

	Attributes map[string]string
}

type Event struct {
	OfferID string

	From Status
	To   Status

	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string

	Reason string

	At       time.Time
	Revision uint64
}

type Offer struct {
	ID      string
	OwnerID string

	Status Status

	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Title       string
	Description string

	StartsAt time.Time
	EndsAt   time.Time

	Attributes map[string]string

	Revision uint64

	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time

	SubmittedAt *time.Time
	ApprovedAt  *time.Time
	RejectedAt  *time.Time
	PublishedAt *time.Time
	SuspendedAt *time.Time
	ExpiredAt   *time.Time
	ClosedAt    *time.Time

	RejectionReason  string
	SuspensionReason string
	ClosureReason    string

	History []Event
}

func normalizeTime(t time.Time) time.Time {
	return t.UTC()
}

func validateCommand(c CommandContext) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidActor
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(c.CommandID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(c.CorrelationID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: correlation ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateDraft(d Draft) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(d.ConfigID) == "" || d.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidConfiguration
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(d.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: title is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if d.StartsAt.IsZero() || d.EndsAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: start and end timestamps are required", ErrInvalidValidityPeriod)
	}

	if !d.EndsAt.After(d.StartsAt) {
		return ErrInvalidValidityPeriod
	}

	for key := range d.Attributes {
		if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: attribute keys cannot be empty", ErrInvalidOffer)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func cloneAttributes(source map[string]string) map[string]string {
	if source == nil {
		return map[string]string{}
	}

	result := make(map[string]string, len(source))

	for key, value := range source {
		result[key] = value
	}

	return result
}

func cloneTime(source *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if source == nil {
		return nil
	}

	value := *source
	return &value
}

func cloneOffer(source Offer) Offer {
	result := source

	result.Attributes = cloneAttributes(source.Attributes)
	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)

	result.SubmittedAt = cloneTime(source.SubmittedAt)
	result.ApprovedAt = cloneTime(source.ApprovedAt)
	result.RejectedAt = cloneTime(source.RejectedAt)
	result.PublishedAt = cloneTime(source.PublishedAt)
	result.SuspendedAt = cloneTime(source.SuspendedAt)
	result.ExpiredAt = cloneTime(source.ExpiredAt)
	result.ClosedAt = cloneTime(source.ClosedAt)

	return result
}

func NewOffer(
	id string,
	ownerID string,
	draft Draft,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) (Offer, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: offer ID is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(ownerID) == "" {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: owner ID is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return Offer{}, err
	}

	if err := validateDraft(draft); err != nil {
		return Offer{}, err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: creation time is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	offer := Offer{
		ID:      strings.TrimSpace(id),
		OwnerID: strings.TrimSpace(ownerID),

		Status: StatusDraft,

		ConfigID:      strings.TrimSpace(draft.ConfigID),
		ConfigVersion: draft.ConfigVersion,

		Title:       strings.TrimSpace(draft.Title),
		Description: strings.TrimSpace(draft.Description),

		StartsAt: normalizeTime(draft.StartsAt),
		EndsAt:   normalizeTime(draft.EndsAt),

		Attributes: cloneAttributes(draft.Attributes),

		Revision: 1,

		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
	}

	offer.History = []Event{
		{
			OfferID:       offer.ID,
			From:          "",
			To:            StatusDraft,
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      offer.Revision,
		},
	}

	return offer, nil
}

func (o Offer) Snapshot() Offer {
	return cloneOffer(o)
}

func (o Offer) IsTerminal() bool {
	return o.Status == StatusExpired ||
		o.Status == StatusClosed
}

func (o Offer) IsCurrentlyValid(now time.Time) bool {
	if o.Status != StatusPublished {
		return false
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return !now.Before(o.StartsAt) && now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) IsWithinValidityPeriod(now time.Time) bool {
	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return !now.Before(o.StartsAt) && now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) CanBePublished(now time.Time) bool {
	if o.Status != StatusApproved {
		return false
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) Events() []Event {
	return append([]Event(nil), o.History...)
}

func (o Offer) HasCommand(commandID string) bool {
	for _, event := range o.History {
		if event.CommandID == commandID {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

func (o *Offer) UpdateDraft(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	draft Draft,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := validateDraft(draft); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusDraft, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	o.ConfigID = strings.TrimSpace(draft.ConfigID)
	o.ConfigVersion = draft.ConfigVersion

	o.Title = strings.TrimSpace(draft.Title)
	o.Description = strings.TrimSpace(draft.Description)

	o.StartsAt = normalizeTime(draft.StartsAt)
	o.EndsAt = normalizeTime(draft.EndsAt)

	o.Attributes = cloneAttributes(draft.Attributes)

	return o.record(
		StatusDraft,
		command,
		normalizeTime(now),
	)
}

func (o *Offer) SubmitForReview(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusDraft,
		StatusInReview,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Approve(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusInReview,
		StatusApproved,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Reject(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusInReview,
		StatusRejected,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) ReopenRejected(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusRejected,
		StatusDraft,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Publish(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusPublished, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusApproved {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferExpired
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(o.ConfigID) == "" || o.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidConfiguration
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusPublished, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.PublishedAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Suspend(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusPublished,
		StatusSuspended,
		now,
		false,
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := normalizeTime(now)
	o.SuspendedAt = &value
	o.SuspensionReason = command.Reason

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Resume(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusPublished, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferExpired
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusPublished, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Expire(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusExpired, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	switch o.Status {
	case StatusInReview, StatusApproved, StatusPublished, StatusSuspended:
		// These states may expire.
	default:
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferNotExpired
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusExpired, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.ExpiredAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Close(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusClosed, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	switch o.Status {
	case StatusApproved, StatusPublished, StatusSuspended:
		// These states may be closed explicitly.
	default:
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if err := o.record(StatusClosed, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.ClosedAt = &value
	o.ClosureReason = command.Reason

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) transition(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	from Status,
	to Status,
	now time.Time,
	requireReason bool,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if requireReason && strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, to, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != from {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := o.record(to, command, normalizeTime(now)); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	switch to {
	case StatusInReview:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.SubmittedAt = &value

	case StatusApproved:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.ApprovedAt = &value

	case StatusRejected:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.RejectedAt = &value
		o.RejectionReason = command.Reason
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected == 0 || expected != o.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) checkIdempotency(
	command CommandContext,
	target Status,
	reason string,
) error {
	for _, event := range o.History {
		if event.CommandID != command.CommandID {
			continue
		}

		if event.To == target &&
			event.ActorID == command.ActorID &&
			event.Reason == reason &&
			event.CorrelationID == command.CorrelationID {
			return ErrCommandAlreadyApplied
		}

		return ErrIdempotencyConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) record(
	target Status,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	from := o.Status

	o.Status = target
	o.Revision++
	o.UpdatedAt = now

	event := Event{
		OfferID:       o.ID,
		From:          from,
		To:            target,
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      o.Revision,
	}

	o.History = append(o.History, event)

	return nil
}

func testTime() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
}

func testCommand(id string) CommandContext {
	return CommandContext{
		ActorID:       "actor-1",
		CommandID:     id,
		CorrelationID: "correlation-1",
	}
}

func testDraft() Draft {
	return Draft{
		ConfigID:      "config-1",
		ConfigVersion: 3,
		Title:         "Test offer",
		Description:   "Offer lifecycle test",
		StartsAt:      testTime().Add(-time.Hour),
		EndsAt:        testTime().Add(24 * time.Hour),
		Attributes: map[string]string{
			"category": "commodity",
			"quality":  "standard",
		},
	}
}

func newTestOffer(t *testing.T) Offer {
	t.Helper()

	offer, err := NewOffer(
		"offer-1",
		"owner-1",
		testDraft(),
		testCommand("create-1"),
		testTime(),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewOffer failed: %v", err)
	}

	return offer
}

func TestNewOffer(t *testing.T) {
	offer := newTestOffer(t)

	if offer.Status != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("expected draft, got %s", offer.Status)
	}

	if offer.Revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision 1, got %d", offer.Revision)
	}

	if offer.ConfigVersion != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected config version: %d", offer.ConfigVersion)
	}

	if len(offer.History) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one creation event, got %d", len(offer.History))
	}

	if offer.History[0].To != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatal("creation event must lead to draft status")
	}
}

	if len(offer.History) != historyLength {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry created duplicate event")
	}
}

package parameterized

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidInput      = errors.New("invalid input")
	ErrInvalidTransition = errors.New("invalid configuration transition")
	ErrImmutableVersion  = errors.New("published configuration is immutable")
	ErrVersionOverflow   = errors.New("configuration version overflow")
	ErrRevisionOverflow  = errors.New("configuration revision overflow")
	ErrNotFound          = errors.New("configuration not found")
	ErrConflict          = errors.New("configuration revision conflict")
	ErrDependencyMissing = errors.New("required dependency is missing")
	ErrUnauthorized      = errors.New("configuration operation is not authorized")
)

type ConfigurationID string
type CategoryID string
type ParameterCode string
type DocumentCode string
type EligibilitySchemeID string

type ConfigurationStatus string

const (
	StatusDraft     ConfigurationStatus = "draft"
	StatusInReview  ConfigurationStatus = "in_review"
	StatusApproved  ConfigurationStatus = "approved"
	StatusRejected  ConfigurationStatus = "rejected"
	StatusPublished ConfigurationStatus = "published"
	StatusSuspended ConfigurationStatus = "suspended"
)

type DataType string

const (
	DataString  DataType = "string"
	DataInteger DataType = "integer"
	DataDecimal DataType = "decimal"
	DataBoolean DataType = "boolean"
	DataDate    DataType = "date"
	DataEnum    DataType = "enum"
)

type Classification struct {
	ID          CategoryID
	ParentID    CategoryID
	Code        string
	Name        string
	Description string
	Active      bool
}

type ParameterDefinition struct {
	Code        ParameterCode
	Name        string
	Description string
	Type        DataType
	Required    bool

	Unit      string
	MinNumber *float64
	MaxNumber *float64
	MinLength *int
	MaxLength *int
	Pattern   string
	Allowed   []string

	// If true, a value must be supplied by the offer owner.
	OwnerEditable bool
}

type DocumentRequirement struct {
	Code        DocumentCode
	Name        string
	Description string
	Required    bool
	AppliesTo   []string
	// Examples: person, company, both.
}

type Configuration struct {
	ID          ConfigurationID
	Category    Classification
	Name        string
	Description string

	Parameters []ParameterDefinition
	Documents  []DocumentRequirement

	EligibilitySchemeID      EligibilitySchemeID
	EligibilitySchemeVersion uint64

	Version  uint64
	Revision uint64
	Status   ConfigurationStatus

	CreatedAt   time.Time
	UpdatedAt   time.Time
	SubmittedAt *time.Time
	ApprovedAt  *time.Time
	PublishedAt *time.Time

	CreatedBy    string
	ApprovedBy   string
	RejectedBy   string
	RejectReason string
}

type ValidationIssue struct {
	Code      string
	Field     string
	Message   string
	Parameter ParameterCode
}

type ValidationResult struct {
	Valid  bool
	Issues []ValidationIssue
}

func validCode(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') &&
			!(r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') &&
			!(r >= '0' && r <= '9') &&
			r != '_' && r != '-' && r != '.' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validateParameterDefinition(p ParameterDefinition) error {
	if !validCode(string(p.Code)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid parameter code", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(p.Name) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter name is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch p.Type {
	case DataString, DataInteger, DataDecimal, DataBoolean, DataDate, DataEnum:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported parameter type %q", ErrInvalidInput, p.Type)
	}

	if p.MinNumber != nil && p.MaxNumber != nil && *p.MinNumber > *p.MaxNumber {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum exceeds maximum for %s", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
	}

	if p.MinLength != nil && *p.MinLength < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative minimum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if p.MaxLength != nil && *p.MaxLength < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative maximum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if p.MinLength != nil && p.MaxLength != nil && *p.MinLength > *p.MaxLength {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum length exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if p.Pattern != "" {
		if _, err := regexp.Compile(p.Pattern); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid regular expression for %s: %v", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code, err)
		}
	}

	if p.Type == DataEnum && len(p.Allowed) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: enum parameter %s has no allowed values", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
	}
	if p.Type != DataEnum && len(p.Allowed) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: allowed values are only valid for enum parameters", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p.Allowed))
	for _, value := range p.Allowed {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: empty enum value", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate enum value %q", ErrInvalidInput, value)
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
	}

	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) ValidateDefinition() error {
	if !validCode(string(c.ID)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid configuration ID", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !validCode(string(c.Category.ID)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid category ID", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !validCode(c.Category.Code) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid category code", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.Category.Name) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(c.Name) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: category name and configuration name are required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.Version == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: version must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.Revision == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: revision must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.EligibilitySchemeID == "" || c.EligibilitySchemeVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: eligibility scheme and version are required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	parameterCodes := make(map[ParameterCode]struct{}, len(c.Parameters))
	for _, p := range c.Parameters {
		if err := validateParameterDefinition(p); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, exists := parameterCodes[p.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate parameter code %s", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
		}
		parameterCodes[p.Code] = struct{}{}
	}

	documentCodes := make(map[DocumentCode]struct{}, len(c.Documents))
	for _, d := range c.Documents {
		if !validCode(string(d.Code)) || strings.TrimSpace(d.Name) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid document requirement", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if _, exists := documentCodes[d.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate document code %s", ErrInvalidInput, d.Code)
		}
		documentCodes[d.Code] = struct{}{}

		for _, subject := range d.AppliesTo {
			if subject != "person" && subject != "company" && subject != "both" {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported document subject %q", ErrInvalidInput, subject)
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func numericValue(value any) (float64, bool) {
	var n float64

	switch v := value.(type) {
	case int:
		n = float64(v)
	case int8:
		n = float64(v)
	case int16:
		n = float64(v)
	case int32:
		n = float64(v)
	case int64:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint8:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint16:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint32:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint64:
		n = float64(v)
	case float32:
		n = float64(v)
	case float64:
		n = v
	case jsonNumber:
		parsed, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(v), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, false
		}
		n = parsed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}

	if math.IsNaN(n) || math.IsInf(n, 0) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return n, true
}

// jsonNumber is a small explicit wrapper; callers do not need encoding/json.
type jsonNumber string

func validateValue(p ParameterDefinition, value any) error {
	if value == nil {
		if p.Required {
			return fmt.Errorf("required value is missing")
		}
		return nil
	}

	switch p.Type {
	case DataString:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected string")
		}
		if p.MinLength != nil && len([]rune(v)) < *p.MinLength {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is shorter than minimum length")
		}
		if p.MaxLength != nil && len([]rune(v)) > *p.MaxLength {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum length")
		}
		if p.Pattern != "" {
			re, err := regexp.Compile(p.Pattern)
			if err != nil || !re.MatchString(v) {
				return fmt.Errorf("value does not match required pattern")
			}
		}

	case DataInteger:
		n, ok := numericValue(value)
		if !ok || math.Trunc(n) != n {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected integer")
		}
		if p.MinNumber != nil && n < *p.MinNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is below minimum")
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil && n > *p.MaxNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum")
		}

	case DataDecimal:
		n, ok := numericValue(value)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected finite decimal number")
		}
		if p.MinNumber != nil && n < *p.MinNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is below minimum")
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil && n > *p.MaxNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum")
		}

	case DataBoolean:
		if _, ok := value.(bool); !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected boolean")
		}

	case DataDate:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected ISO date string")
		}
		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", v); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("date must use YYYY-MM-DD")
		}

	case DataEnum:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected enum string")
		}
		found := false
		for _, allowed := range p.Allowed {
			if v == allowed {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is not in allowed values")
		}

	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported data type")
	}

	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) ValidateValues(values map[string]any) ValidationResult {
	issues := make([]ValidationIssue, 0)

	known := make(map[string]struct{}, len(c.Parameters))

	for _, p := range c.Parameters {
		code := string(p.Code)
		known[code] = struct{}{}

		value, exists := values[code]
		if !exists {
			value = nil
		}

		if err := validateValue(p, value); err != nil {
			issues = append(issues, ValidationIssue{
				Code:      "invalid_parameter_value",
				Field:     code,
				Message:   err.Error(),
				Parameter: p.Code,
			})
		}
	}

	for key := range values {
		if _, exists := known[key]; !exists {
			issues = append(issues, ValidationIssue{
				Code:    "unknown_parameter",
				Field:   key,
				Message: "parameter is not defined by this configuration version",
			})
		}
	}

	sort.Slice(issues, func(i, j int) bool {
		if issues[i].Field == issues[j].Field {
			return issues[i].Code < issues[j].Code
		}
		return issues[i].Field < issues[j].Field
	})

	return ValidationResult{
		Valid:  len(issues) == 0,
		Issues: issues,
	}
}

func (c *Configuration) SubmitForReview(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if err := c.ValidateDefinition(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusInReview
	c.SubmittedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Approve(actor string, now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusInReview {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(actor) == "" {
		return ErrUnauthorized
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusApproved
	c.ApprovedBy = actor
	c.ApprovedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Reject(actor, reason string, now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusInReview {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(actor) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusRejected
	c.RejectedBy = actor
	c.RejectReason = reason
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Publish(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusApproved {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Version == 0 || c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrVersionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.PublishedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Suspend(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusPublished {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	c.Status = StatusSuspended
	c.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Resume(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) Clone() Configuration {
	out := c

	out.Parameters = make([]ParameterDefinition, len(c.Parameters))
	for i, p := range c.Parameters {
		out.Parameters[i] = p
		out.Parameters[i].Allowed = append([]string(nil), p.Allowed...)

		if p.MinNumber != nil {
			v := *p.MinNumber
			out.Parameters[i].MinNumber = &v
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil {
			v := *p.MaxNumber
			out.Parameters[i].MaxNumber = &v
		}
		if p.MinLength != nil {
			v := *p.MinLength
			out.Parameters[i].MinLength = &v
		}
		if p.MaxLength != nil {
			v := *p.MaxLength
			out.Parameters[i].MaxLength = &v
		}
	}

	out.Documents = make([]DocumentRequirement, len(c.Documents))
	for i, d := range c.Documents {
		out.Documents[i] = d
		out.Documents[i].AppliesTo = append([]string(nil), d.AppliesTo...)
	}

	if c.SubmittedAt != nil {
		v := *c.SubmittedAt
		out.SubmittedAt = &v
	}
	if c.ApprovedAt != nil {
		v := *c.ApprovedAt
		out.ApprovedAt = &v
	}
	if c.PublishedAt != nil {
		v := *c.PublishedAt
		out.PublishedAt = &v
	}

	return out
}

func NewNextDraft(previous Configuration, newID ConfigurationID, now time.Time) (Configuration, error) {
	if previous.Status != StatusPublished && previous.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return Configuration{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !validCode(string(newID)) {
		return Configuration{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if previous.Version == ^uint64(0) {
		return Configuration{}, ErrVersionOverflow
	}

	next := previous.Clone()
	next.ID = newID
	next.Version = previous.Version + 1
	next.Revision = 1
	next.Status = StatusDraft
	next.CreatedAt = now.UTC()
	next.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	next.SubmittedAt = nil
	next.ApprovedAt = nil
	next.PublishedAt = nil
	next.ApprovedBy = ""
	next.RejectedBy = ""
	next.RejectReason = ""

	return next, nil
}

type PublishedSnapshot struct {
	ConfigurationID ConfigurationID
	CategoryID      CategoryID
	Version         uint64
	Configuration   Configuration
	PublishedAt     time.Time
}

func SnapshotOf(c Configuration) (PublishedSnapshot, error) {
	if c.Status != StatusPublished || c.PublishedAt == nil {
		return PublishedSnapshot{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if err := c.ValidateDefinition(); err != nil {
		return PublishedSnapshot{}, err
	}

	return PublishedSnapshot{
		ConfigurationID: c.ID,
		CategoryID:      c.Category.ID,
		Version:         c.Version,
		Configuration:   c.Clone(),
		PublishedAt:     c.PublishedAt.UTC(),
	}, nil
}

// ValidateReference prevents an offer from silently using a different
// configuration version than the one it originally accepted.
func ValidateReference(snapshot PublishedSnapshot, configurationID ConfigurationID, version uint64) error {
	if snapshot.ConfigurationID != configurationID || snapshot.Version != version {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration version mismatch", ErrConflict)
	}
	return nil
}

// Application ports. These are contracts only; no storage adapter is supplied.
type Repository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, id ConfigurationID) (Configuration, uint64, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, configuration Configuration, expectedRevision uint64) error
	SavePublishedSnapshot(ctx context.Context, snapshot PublishedSnapshot) error
}

type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

type AuditEvent struct {
	ActorID     string
	Action      string
	EntityID    string
	OldRevision uint64
	NewRevision uint64
	OccurredAt  time.Time
	Reason      string
}

type AuditAppender interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event AuditEvent) error
}

	}
}

func TestConfigurationLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	if err := c.SubmitForReview(now); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusInReview || c.Revision != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected review state: %+v", c)
	}

	if err := c.Approve("reviewer-1", now.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusApproved {
		t.Fatal("configuration was not approved")
	}

	if err := c.Publish(now.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusPublished || c.PublishedAt == nil {
		t.Fatal("configuration was not published")
	}

	snapshot, err := SnapshotOf(c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := ValidateReference(snapshot, c.ID, c.Version); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := ValidateReference(snapshot, c.ID, c.Version+1); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("expected version conflict")
	}
}

func TestConfigurationCannotSkipReview(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()

	if err := c.Publish(time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTransition) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid transition, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestConfigurationNextDraftDoesNotMutatePublishedVersion(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.PublishedAt = ptrTime(time.Now())
	c.Version = 4

	next, err := NewNextDraft(c, "cfg-next", time.Now())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if next.Version != 5 || next.Status != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected next draft: %+v", next)
	}
	if c.Version != 4 || c.Status != StatusPublished {
		t.Fatal("original published configuration was modified")
	}

	next.Parameters[0].Allowed = append(next.Parameters[0].Allowed, "mutated")
	if len(c.Parameters[0].Allowed) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("clone shares mutable parameter slices")
	}
}

func ptrTime(t time.Time) *time.Time {
	return &t
}

func TestDuplicateParameterCodesRejected(t *testing.T) {

	c.Parameters = append(c.Parameters, c.Parameters[0])

	}
}

package orders

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// AssetReservationRequest asks My Assets to reserve resources.
// The General Market service must not calculate or persist balances.
type AssetReservationRequest struct {
	OwnerID        string
	OrderID        string
	Side           Side
	Quantity       int64
	LimitPrice     int64
	Currency       string
	Unit           string
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  string
	ExpiresAt      *time.Time
}

// AssetReservationPort is an external-service contract.
// Implementations must provide idempotent reserve/release semantics.
type AssetReservationPort interface {
	Reserve(ctx context.Context, request AssetReservationRequest) (Reservation, error)
	Release(ctx context.Context, reservationReference string, idempotencyKey string, correlationID string) error
}

// OrderRepository is a persistence contract, not a storage implementation.
// Save must enforce optimistic revision checks.
type OrderRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, orderID string) (*Order, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, order *Order, expectedRevision uint64) error
}

// OrderTransactionRunner defines the transaction boundary for local
// General Market persistence only. It does not imply a distributed
// transaction with My Assets or any other external service.
type OrderTransactionRunner interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

// OrderBookRepository is a read contract for an order-book projection.
// Implementations must return only visible orders for the requested scope.
type OrderBookRepository interface {
	ListVisible(ctx context.Context, query BookQuery) (BookPage, error)
}

// ReservationReleaseCommand carries an explicit release request.
// The release operation is owned by My Assets.
type ReservationReleaseCommand struct {
	ReservationReference string
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CorrelationID        string
	Reason               string
}

// ReservationReleasePolicy documents when an order workflow should ask
// My Assets to release the remaining reservation.
type ReservationReleasePolicy interface {
	ReleaseAfterTerminalOrder(ctx context.Context, command ReservationReleaseCommand) error
}

package orders

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidOrder              = errors.New("invalid order")
	ErrInvalidSide               = errors.New("invalid order side")
	ErrInvalidStatus             = errors.New("invalid order status")
	ErrInvalidQuantity           = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrInvalidPrice              = errors.New("invalid price")
	ErrInvalidReservation        = errors.New("invalid asset reservation")
	ErrReservationRequired       = errors.New("active reservation is required")
	ErrOrderNotOpen              = errors.New("order is not open")
	ErrOrderNotCancellable       = errors.New("order cannot be cancelled")
	ErrOrderAlreadyClosed        = errors.New("order is already closed")
	ErrRevisionConflict          = errors.New("order revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict       = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrInvalidCommand            = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidExecution          = errors.New("invalid execution")
	ErrDuplicateExecution        = errors.New("execution already applied")
	ErrOverfill                  = errors.New("execution exceeds remaining quantity")
	ErrInvalidTimeInForce        = errors.New("invalid time in force")
	ErrInvalidBookQuery          = errors.New("invalid order book query")
	ErrOrderNotFound             = errors.New("order not found")
	ErrReservationAlreadySet     = errors.New("reservation is already assigned")
	ErrInvalidExpiration         = errors.New("invalid expiration time")
	ErrInvalidReservationRelease = errors.New("reservation release is not permitted")
)

type Side string

const (
	Buy  Side = "buy"
	Sell Side = "sell"
)

type Status string

const (
	StatusPendingReservation Status = "pending_reservation"
	StatusOpen               Status = "open"
	StatusPartiallyFilled    Status = "partially_filled"
	StatusFilled             Status = "filled"
	StatusCancelled          Status = "cancelled"
	StatusExpired            Status = "expired"
	StatusRejected           Status = "rejected"
)

type TimeInForce string

const (
	GTC TimeInForce = "good_till_cancelled"
	GTD TimeInForce = "good_till_date"
)

type ReservationStatus string

const (
	ReservationNone     ReservationStatus = "none"
	ReservationActive   ReservationStatus = "active"
	ReservationReleased ReservationStatus = "released"
)

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
}

func (c CommandContext) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(c.CommandID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(c.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		c.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	return nil
}

type CreateInput struct {
	OrderID         string
	OwnerID         string
	MarketID        string
	InstrumentID    string
	OfferID         string
	ConfigurationID string
	ConfigVersion   uint64
	Side            Side
	Quantity        int64
	LimitPrice      int64
	Unit            string
	Currency        string
	TimeInForce     TimeInForce
	ExpiresAt       *time.Time
	CreatedAt       time.Time
}

type Reservation struct {
	ReferenceID string
	Status      ReservationStatus
	ReservedFor int64
	Currency    string
	ExpiresAt   *time.Time
}

type Event struct {
	EventID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	ActorID       string
	OrderID       string
	Type          string
	FromStatus    Status
	ToStatus      Status
	Quantity      int64
	ExecutionID   string
	Reason        string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	Revision      uint64
}

type CommandRecord struct {
	CommandID   string
	Fingerprint string
}

type ExecutionRecord struct {
	ExecutionID string
	Quantity    int64
	OccurredAt  time.Time
}

type Order struct {
	ID              string
	OwnerID         string
	MarketID        string
	InstrumentID    string
	OfferID         string
	ConfigurationID string
	ConfigVersion   uint64
	Side            Side
	Quantity        int64
	Remaining       int64
	Filled          int64
	LimitPrice      int64
	Unit            string
	Currency        string
	TimeInForce     TimeInForce
	Status          Status
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	UpdatedAt       time.Time
	ExpiresAt       *time.Time
	Revision        uint64
	Reservation     Reservation
	History         []Event
	Commands        []CommandRecord
	Executions      []ExecutionRecord
}

func NewOrder(in CreateInput) (*Order, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(in.OrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.OwnerID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.MarketID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.InstrumentID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.OfferID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.ConfigurationID) == "" ||
		in.ConfigVersion == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.Unit) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.Currency) == "" ||
		in.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidOrder
	}

	if in.Side != Buy && in.Side != Sell {
		return nil, ErrInvalidSide
	}
	if in.Quantity <= 0 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	if in.LimitPrice <= 0 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidPrice
	}
	if in.TimeInForce != GTC && in.TimeInForce != GTD {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTimeInForce
	}
	if in.TimeInForce == GTD {
		if in.ExpiresAt == nil || !in.ExpiresAt.After(in.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidExpiration
		}
	}
	if in.TimeInForce == GTC && in.ExpiresAt != nil {
		return nil, ErrInvalidExpiration
	}

	o := &Order{
		ID:              strings.TrimSpace(in.OrderID),
		OwnerID:         strings.TrimSpace(in.OwnerID),
		MarketID:        strings.TrimSpace(in.MarketID),
		InstrumentID:    strings.TrimSpace(in.InstrumentID),
		OfferID:         strings.TrimSpace(in.OfferID),
		ConfigurationID: strings.TrimSpace(in.ConfigurationID),
		ConfigVersion:   in.ConfigVersion,
		Side:            in.Side,
		Quantity:        in.Quantity,
		Remaining:       in.Quantity,
		LimitPrice:      in.LimitPrice,
		Unit:            strings.TrimSpace(in.Unit),
		Currency:        strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(in.Currency)),
		TimeInForce:     in.TimeInForce,
		Status:          StatusPendingReservation,
		CreatedAt:       in.CreatedAt.UTC(),
		UpdatedAt:       in.CreatedAt.UTC(),
		Revision:        1,
		Reservation: Reservation{
			Status: ReservationNone,
		},
	}

	if in.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := in.ExpiresAt.UTC()
		o.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	return o, nil
}

func (o *Order) Clone() *Order {
	if o == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c := *o
	if o.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := *o.ExpiresAt
		c.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	if o.Reservation.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := *o.Reservation.ExpiresAt
		c.Reservation.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	c.History = append([]Event(nil), o.History...)
	c.Commands = append([]CommandRecord(nil), o.Commands...)
	c.Executions = append([]ExecutionRecord(nil), o.Executions...)
	return &c
}

func (o *Order) record(ctx CommandContext, eventType string, from, to Status, quantity int64, executionID, reason string) {
	o.Revision++
	o.UpdatedAt = ctx.OccurredAt.UTC()

	e := Event{
		EventID:       fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", o.ID, o.Revision),
		CommandID:     ctx.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: ctx.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:       ctx.ActorID,
		OrderID:       o.ID,
		Type:          eventType,
		FromStatus:    from,
		ToStatus:      to,
		Quantity:      quantity,
		ExecutionID:   executionID,
		Reason:        reason,
		OccurredAt:    ctx.OccurredAt.UTC(),
		Revision:      o.Revision,
	}
	o.History = append(o.History, e)
}

func (o *Order) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected != o.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) checkCommand(ctx CommandContext, fingerprint string) (bool, error) {
	if err := ctx.Validate(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, old := range o.Commands {
		if old.CommandID == ctx.CommandID {
			if old.Fingerprint != fingerprint {
				return false, ErrIdempotencyConflict
			}
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

func (o *Order) saveCommand(ctx CommandContext, fingerprint string) {
	o.Commands = append(o.Commands, CommandRecord{
		CommandID:   ctx.CommandID,
		Fingerprint: fingerprint,
	})
}

func (o *Order) AttachReservation(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reservation Reservation) error {
	fp := fmt.Sprintf("attach|%s|%s|%d|%s", o.ID, reservation.ReferenceID, reservation.ReservedFor, reservation.Currency)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusPendingReservation {
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reservation.ReferenceID) == "" ||
		reservation.Status != ReservationActive ||
		reservation.ReservedFor <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if reservation.ReservedFor < o.Quantity {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if o.Side == Buy && !strings.EqualFold(reservation.Currency, o.Currency) {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if o.Reservation.Status != ReservationNone {
		return ErrReservationAlreadySet
	}
	if reservation.ExpiresAt != nil && !reservation.ExpiresAt.After(ctx.OccurredAt) {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Reservation = reservation
	o.Reservation.Currency = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(reservation.Currency))
	o.Status = StatusOpen
	o.record(ctx, "order.opened", from, o.Status, o.Quantity, "", "")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Reject(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reason string) error {
	fp := "reject|" + o.ID + "|" + strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusPendingReservation {
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusRejected
	o.record(ctx, "order.rejected", from, o.Status, 0, "", reason)
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) ApplyExecution(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, executionID string, quantity int64) error {
	executionID = strings.TrimSpace(executionID)
	fp := fmt.Sprintf("execution|%s|%s|%d", o.ID, executionID, quantity)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if executionID == "" || quantity <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidExecution
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		return ErrOrderNotOpen
	}
	for _, old := range o.Executions {
		if old.ExecutionID == executionID {
			return ErrDuplicateExecution
		}
	}
	if quantity > o.Remaining {
		return ErrOverfill
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Remaining -= quantity
	o.Filled += quantity
	if o.Remaining == 0 {
		o.Status = StatusFilled
	} else {
		o.Status = StatusPartiallyFilled
	}
	o.Executions = append(o.Executions, ExecutionRecord{
		ExecutionID: executionID,
		Quantity:    quantity,
		OccurredAt:  ctx.OccurredAt.UTC(),
	})
	o.record(ctx, "order.execution_applied", from, o.Status, quantity, executionID, "")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Cancel(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reason string) error {
	fp := "cancel|" + o.ID + "|" + strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		if o.Status == StatusFilled || o.Status == StatusCancelled || o.Status == StatusExpired || o.Status == StatusRejected {
			return ErrOrderAlreadyClosed
		}
		return ErrOrderNotCancellable
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusCancelled
	o.record(ctx, "order.cancelled", from, o.Status, o.Remaining, "", reason)
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Expire(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64) error {
	fp := "expire|" + o.ID
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.TimeInForce != GTD || o.ExpiresAt == nil || ctx.OccurredAt.Before(*o.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidExpiration
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		if o.Status == StatusFilled || o.Status == StatusCancelled || o.Status == StatusExpired || o.Status == StatusRejected {
			return ErrOrderAlreadyClosed
		}
		return ErrOrderNotOpen
	}
	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusExpired
	o.record(ctx, "order.expired", from, o.Status, o.Remaining, "", "time_in_force_expired")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) IsVisibleInBook() bool {
	return o != nil && (o.Status == StatusOpen || o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled) && o.Remaining > 0
}

func (o *Order) IsExpired(at time.Time) bool {
	return o != nil && o.ExpiresAt != nil && !at.Before(*o.ExpiresAt)
}

func (o *Order) ValidateInvariant() error {
	if o == nil || o.ID == "" || o.OwnerID == "" || o.MarketID == "" ||
		o.InstrumentID == "" || o.OfferID == "" || o.ConfigurationID == "" ||
		o.ConfigVersion == 0 || o.Quantity <= 0 || o.LimitPrice <= 0 ||
		o.Remaining < 0 || o.Filled < 0 || o.Filled+o.Remaining != o.Quantity {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	if o.Side != Buy && o.Side != Sell {
		return ErrInvalidSide
	}
	switch o.Status {
	case StatusPendingReservation, StatusOpen, StatusPartiallyFilled, StatusFilled, StatusCancelled, StatusExpired, StatusRejected:
	default:
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if o.Status == StatusOpen || o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled || o.Status == StatusFilled {
		if o.Reservation.Status != ReservationActive && o.Reservation.Status != ReservationReleased {
			return ErrInvalidReservation
		}
		if o.Reservation.ReferenceID == "" {
			return ErrInvalidReservation
		}
	}
	if o.Status == StatusFilled && o.Remaining != 0 {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	if o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled && (o.Filled <= 0 || o.Remaining <= 0) {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	return nil
}

type BookQuery struct {
	MarketID     string
	InstrumentID string
	Side         Side
	Limit        int
	AfterPrice   int64
	AfterTime    time.Time
	AfterOrderID string
}

type BookPage struct {
	Orders     []*Order
	NextCursor *BookCursor
	HasMore    bool
}

type BookCursor struct {
	Price     int64
	CreatedAt time.Time
	OrderID   string
}

func ValidateBookQuery(q BookQuery) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(q.MarketID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(q.InstrumentID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	if q.Side != Buy && q.Side != Sell {
		return ErrInvalidSide
	}
	if q.Limit < 1 || q.Limit > 500 {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	if q.AfterOrderID != "" && q.AfterTime.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	return nil
}

// SortBook applies price-time priority.
// Buy: higher price first. Sell: lower price first.
// Ties: earlier creation time, then lexicographically smaller order ID.
func SortBook(orders []*Order, side Side) ([]*Order, error) {
	if side != Buy && side != Sell {
		return nil, ErrInvalidSide
	}
	result := make([]*Order, 0, len(orders))
	for _, o := range orders {
		if o == nil || !o.IsVisibleInBook() || o.Side != side {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, o.Clone())
	}
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := result[i], result[j]
		if a.LimitPrice != b.LimitPrice {
			if side == Buy {
				return a.LimitPrice > b.LimitPrice
			}
			return a.LimitPrice < b.LimitPrice
		}
		if !a.CreatedAt.Equal(b.CreatedAt) {
			return a.CreatedAt.Before(b.CreatedAt)
		}
		return a.ID < b.ID
	})
	return result, nil
}

func PageBook(orders []*Order, q BookQuery) (BookPage, error) {
	if err := ValidateBookQuery(q); err != nil {
		return BookPage{}, err
	}
	sorted, err := SortBook(orders, q.Side)
	if err != nil {
		return BookPage{}, err
	}

	filtered := make([]*Order, 0, len(sorted))
	for _, o := range sorted {
		if o.MarketID != q.MarketID || o.InstrumentID != q.InstrumentID {
			continue
		}
		if q.AfterOrderID != "" && !isAfterCursor(o, q) {
			continue
		}
		filtered = append(filtered, o)
	}

	hasMore := len(filtered) > q.Limit
	if hasMore {
		filtered = filtered[:q.Limit]
	}
	page := BookPage{Orders: filtered, HasMore: hasMore}
	if hasMore && len(filtered) > 0 {
		last := filtered[len(filtered)-1]
		page.NextCursor = &BookCursor{
			Price:     last.LimitPrice,
			CreatedAt: last.CreatedAt,
			OrderID:   last.ID,
		}
	}
	return page, nil
}

func isAfterCursor(o *Order, q BookQuery) bool {
	if q.Side == Buy {
		if o.LimitPrice < q.AfterPrice {
			return true
		}
		if o.LimitPrice > q.AfterPrice {
			return false
		}
	} else {
		if o.LimitPrice > q.AfterPrice {
			return true
		}
		if o.LimitPrice < q.AfterPrice {
			return false
		}
	}
	if !o.CreatedAt.Equal(q.AfterTime) {
		return o.CreatedAt.After(q.AfterTime)
	}
	return o.ID > q.AfterOrderID
}

func TestAttachReservationIdempotency(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	o := newTestOrder(t, "o1", Buy, 100, 10, now)
	ctx := testContext("reserve-1", now.Add(time.Second))

		ReferenceID: "r1",
		Status:      ReservationActive,
		ReservedFor: 10,
		Currency:    "IRR",
	}

	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, o.Revision, reservation); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	revision := o.Revision

	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, 1, reservation); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("identical retry should be successful: %v", err)
	}
	if o.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry changed revision")
	}

	changed := reservation
	changed.ReferenceID = "different"
	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, 1, changed); !errors.Is(err, ErrIdempotencyConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected idempotency conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPageBookCursorAndScope(t *testing.T) {

	orders := []*Order{
		newTestOrder(t, "a", Buy, 100, 10, base),
		newTestOrder(t, "b", Buy, 100, 10, base.Add(time.Minute)),
		newTestOrder(t, "c", Buy, 90, 10, base.Add(2*time.Minute)),
	}
	for _, o := range orders {
		openTestOrder(t, o, base.Add(3*time.Minute))
	}
	other := newTestOrder(t, "other", Buy, 200, 10, base)
	other.MarketID = "another-market"
	openTestOrder(t, other, base.Add(3*time.Minute))
	orders = append(orders, other)

	first, err := PageBook(orders, BookQuery{
		MarketID: "market-1", InstrumentID: "instrument-1", Side: Buy, Limit: 2,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(first.Orders) != 2 || !first.HasMore || first.NextCursor == nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first page: %#v", first)
	}

	second, err := PageBook(orders, BookQuery{
		MarketID: "market-1", InstrumentID: "instrument-1", Side: Buy, Limit: 2,
		AfterPrice:   first.NextCursor.Price,
		AfterTime:    first.NextCursor.CreatedAt,
		AfterOrderID: first.NextCursor.OrderID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(second.Orders) != 1 || second.Orders[0].ID != "c" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected second page: %#v", second)
	}
}

# Real-Asset Workflows

## Responsibility

Coordinate market workflows for real assets, including property-related
steps where applicable.
Distinguish a platform position or contractual right from legally registered
ownership. Legal registration remains with the appropriate authoritative
institution or system.

## Architecture constraints

- Keep one authoritative owner for each category of data.
- Validate inputs and state transitions on the server.
- Use explicit service contracts and safe idempotency where operations
  can be retried.
- Add dependencies only when required by a defined responsibility.

## Implementation status

Structural documentation only. Business implementation and automated tests
must be completed and verified separately.

	evidence := EvidenceReference{

		DocumentType: "contract-copy",
		ExternalID:   "doc-100",

		Status:       EvidencePending,
	}

	cmd := command(ActionLinkContract, 1, "idem-1", now.Add(time.Minute))
	cmd.Contract = &contract
	if _, _, err := claim.Apply(cmd); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	cmd = command(ActionAttachEvidence, 2, "idem-2", now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	cmd.Evidence = &evidence
	if _, _, err := claim.Apply(cmd); err != nil {

	}

	cmd = command(ActionSubmit, 3, "idem-3", now.Add(3*time.Minute))

	}

	if _, _, err := claim.Apply(cmd); err != nil {

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)

	if snapshot.Status != RightExternallyAssessed {
		t.Fatalf("expected externally assessed, got %s", snapshot.Status)
	}
	if snapshot.Assessment == nil || snapshot.Assessment.Outcome != AssessmentConfirmed {
		t.Fatal("external assessment was not preserved")
	}
}

func TestRightClaimIdempotencyAndConflict(t *testing.T) {

	cmd.Contract = &ContractReference{
		ContractID:      "contract-1",
		ContractVersion: "v1",
		Role:            "supporting",
	}

	first, replayed, err := claim.Apply(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if replayed {
		t.Fatal("first command cannot be a replay")
	}

	second, replayed, err := claim.Apply(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !replayed {
		t.Fatal("expected idempotent replay")
	}
	if first.Revision != second.Revision {
		t.Fatal("replay changed aggregate revision")
	}

	cmd.Contract.ContractID = "different-contract"
	if _, _, err := claim.Apply(cmd); !errors.Is(err, ErrIdempotencyConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected idempotency conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type PropertyKind string

const (
	PropertyLand         PropertyKind = "land"
	PropertyResidential  PropertyKind = "residential"
	PropertyCommercial   PropertyKind = "commercial"
	PropertyIndustrial   PropertyKind = "industrial"
	PropertyAgricultural PropertyKind = "agricultural"
	PropertyMixedUse     PropertyKind = "mixed_use"
	PropertyOther        PropertyKind = "other"
)

func (k PropertyKind) valid() bool {
	switch k {
	case PropertyLand,
		PropertyResidential,
		PropertyCommercial,
		PropertyIndustrial,
		PropertyAgricultural,
		PropertyMixedUse,
		PropertyOther:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// ExternalPropertyReference is only a pointer to an external registry or system.
// It is not proof of ownership or legal title.
type ExternalPropertyReference struct {
	SystemID string `json:"system_id"`
	Type     string `json:"type"`
	Value    string `json:"value"`
}

func (r ExternalPropertyReference) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(r.SystemID, "reference.system_id", 128); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.Type, "reference.type", 64); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.Value, "reference.value", 256); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ExternalPropertyReference) key() string {
	return strings.Join(
		[]string{
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.SystemID), r.SystemID),
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.Type), r.Type),
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.Value), r.Value),
		},
		"|",
	)
}

type PropertyDescriptor struct {
	Kind               PropertyKind                `json:"kind"`
	CountryCode        string                      `json:"country_code"`
	AdministrativeArea string                      `json:"administrative_area,omitempty"`
	City               string                      `json:"city,omitempty"`
	District           string                      `json:"district,omitempty"`
	Address            string                      `json:"address,omitempty"`
	ParcelNumber       string                      `json:"parcel_number,omitempty"`
	BuildingReference  string                      `json:"building_reference,omitempty"`
	Latitude           *float64                    `json:"latitude,omitempty"`
	Longitude          *float64                    `json:"longitude,omitempty"`
	AreaSquareMeters   int64                       `json:"area_square_meters,omitempty"`
	ExternalReferences []ExternalPropertyReference `json:"external_references,omitempty"`
}

func (d PropertyDescriptor) Validate() error {
	if !d.Kind.valid() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported property kind", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if err := requiredText(d.CountryCode, "country_code", 2); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if len(d.CountryCode) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: country_code must contain two characters", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	for _, ch := range d.CountryCode {
		if ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z' {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: country_code must be uppercase ISO-style code", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
	}

	for _, item := range []struct {
		value string
		field string
	}{
		{d.AdministrativeArea, "administrative_area"},
		{d.City, "city"},
		{d.District, "district"},
		{d.Address, "address"},
		{d.ParcelNumber, "parcel_number"},
		{d.BuildingReference, "building_reference"},
	} {
		if err := optionalText(item.value, item.field, 512); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if d.AreaSquareMeters < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: area_square_meters cannot be negative", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if (d.Latitude == nil) != (d.Longitude == nil) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: latitude and longitude must be supplied together", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if d.Latitude != nil {
		if math.IsNaN(*d.Latitude) || math.IsInf(*d.Latitude, 0) ||
			math.IsNaN(*d.Longitude) || math.IsInf(*d.Longitude, 0) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid geographic coordinates", ErrInvalidInput)
		}

		if *d.Latitude < -90 || *d.Latitude > 90 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: latitude is out of range", ErrInvalidInput)
		}

		if *d.Longitude < -180 || *d.Longitude > 180 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: longitude is out of range", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(d.Address) == "" &&
		strings.TrimSpace(d.ParcelNumber) == "" &&
		strings.TrimSpace(d.BuildingReference) == "" &&
		d.Latitude == nil &&
		len(d.ExternalReferences) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one property locator is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(d.ExternalReferences))

	for _, ref := range d.ExternalReferences {
		if err := ref.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		key := ref.key()
		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate external property reference", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
	}

	return nil
}

type PropertyChange struct {
	Revision      uint64    `json:"revision"`
	ActorID       string    `json:"actor_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
	CorrelationID string    `json:"correlation_id"`
}

type PropertySnapshot struct {
	ID         string             `json:"id"`
	Descriptor PropertyDescriptor `json:"descriptor"`
	Revision   uint64             `json:"revision"`
	CreatedAt  time.Time          `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt  time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
	History    []PropertyChange   `json:"history"`
}

type PropertyIdentity struct {
	mu         sync.Mutex
	id         string
	descriptor PropertyDescriptor
	revision   uint64
	createdAt  time.Time
	updatedAt  time.Time
	history    []PropertyChange
}

func NewPropertyIdentity(
	id string,
	descriptor PropertyDescriptor,
	actorID string,
	correlationID string,
	createdAt time.Time,
) (*PropertyIdentity, error) {
	if err := requiredText(id, "property_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := descriptor.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(actorID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(correlationID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if createdAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: created_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	descriptor = clonePropertyDescriptor(descriptor)

	return &PropertyIdentity{
		id:         id,
		descriptor: descriptor,
		revision:   1,
		createdAt:  createdAt.UTC(),
		updatedAt:  createdAt.UTC(),
		history: []PropertyChange{
			{
				Revision:      1,
				ActorID:       actorID,
				OccurredAt:    createdAt.UTC(),
				CorrelationID: correlationID,
			},
		},
	}, nil
}

type UpdatePropertyCommand struct {
	ExpectedRevision uint64             `json:"expected_revision"`
	Descriptor       PropertyDescriptor `json:"descriptor"`
	ActorID          string             `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID    string             `json:"correlation_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time          `json:"occurred_at"`
}

func (p *PropertyIdentity) Update(cmd UpdatePropertyCommand) error {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()

	if err := validateRevision(cmd.ExpectedRevision, p.revision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := cmd.Descriptor.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateActor(cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(cmd.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() || cmd.OccurredAt.Before(p.updatedAt) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid property update time", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	p.descriptor = clonePropertyDescriptor(cmd.Descriptor)
	p.revision++
	p.updatedAt = cmd.OccurredAt.UTC()
	p.history = append(p.history, PropertyChange{
		Revision:      p.revision,
		ActorID:       cmd.ActorID,
		OccurredAt:    p.updatedAt,
		CorrelationID: cmd.CorrelationID,
	})

	return nil
}

func (p *PropertyIdentity) Snapshot() PropertySnapshot {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()

	return PropertySnapshot{
		ID:         p.id,
		Descriptor: clonePropertyDescriptor(p.descriptor),
		Revision:   p.revision,
		CreatedAt:  p.createdAt,
		UpdatedAt:  p.updatedAt,
		History:    append([]PropertyChange(nil), p.history...),
	}
}

func clonePropertyDescriptor(d PropertyDescriptor) PropertyDescriptor {
	out := d

	if d.Latitude != nil {
		v := *d.Latitude
		out.Latitude = &v
	}
	if d.Longitude != nil {
		v := *d.Longitude
		out.Longitude = &v
	}

	out.ExternalReferences = append([]ExternalPropertyReference(nil), d.ExternalReferences...)

	sort.Slice(out.ExternalReferences, func(i, j int) bool {
		return out.ExternalReferences[i].key() < out.ExternalReferences[j].key()
	})

	return out
}

type RightTerms struct {
	Title             string    `json:"title"`
	Description       string    `json:"description"`
	Scope             string    `json:"scope"`
	EffectiveFrom     time.Time `json:"effective_from"`
	EffectiveUntil    time.Time `json:"effective_until"`
	Exclusive         bool      `json:"exclusive"`
	Transferable      bool      `json:"transferable"`
	SublettingAllowed bool      `json:"subletting_allowed"`
	AreaSquareMeters  int64     `json:"area_square_meters,omitempty"`
	Capacity          int64     `json:"capacity,omitempty"`
	CapacityUnit      string    `json:"capacity_unit,omitempty"`
}

func (t RightTerms) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(t.Title, "right.title", 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(t.Description, "right.description", 4000); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(t.Scope, "right.scope", 2000); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if t.EffectiveFrom.IsZero() || t.EffectiveUntil.IsZero() ||
		!t.EffectiveUntil.After(t.EffectiveFrom) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid right effective period", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if t.AreaSquareMeters < 0 || t.Capacity < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative right quantity", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if t.Capacity > 0 {

		}
	}
	return nil
