type EvidenceStatus string

const (
	EvidencePending  EvidenceStatus = "pending"
	EvidenceAccepted EvidenceStatus = "accepted"
	EvidenceRejected EvidenceStatus = "rejected"
	EvidenceExpired  EvidenceStatus = "expired"
)

type EvidenceReference struct {
	ID           string         `json:"id"`
	ProviderID   string         `json:"provider_id"`
	DocumentType string         `json:"document_type"`
	ExternalID   string         `json:"external_id"`
	Version      string         `json:"version"`
	Status       EvidenceStatus `json:"status"`
	ValidUntil   *time.Time     `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
}

func (e EvidenceReference) Validate() error {
	for _, item := range []struct {
		value string
		field string
		limit int
	}{
		{e.ID, "evidence.id", 128},
		{e.ProviderID, "evidence.provider_id", 128},
		{e.DocumentType, "evidence.document_type", 128},
		{e.ExternalID, "evidence.external_id", 256},
		{e.Version, "evidence.version", 64},
	} {
		if err := requiredText(item.value, item.field, item.limit); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	switch e.Status {
	case EvidencePending, EvidenceAccepted, EvidenceRejected, EvidenceExpired:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid evidence status", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if e.ValidUntil != nil && e.ValidUntil.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid evidence valid_until", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return nil
}

type AssessmentOutcome string

const (
	AssessmentConfirmed    AssessmentOutcome = "confirmed"
	AssessmentNotConfirmed AssessmentOutcome = "not_confirmed"
	AssessmentInconclusive AssessmentOutcome = "inconclusive"
)

type AssessmentScope string

const (
	AssessmentPropertyIdentity AssessmentScope = "property_identity"
	AssessmentRightExistence   AssessmentScope = "right_existence"
	AssessmentRightScope       AssessmentScope = "right_scope"
	AssessmentDocumentValidity AssessmentScope = "document_validity"
)

type ExternalAssessment struct {
	AuthorityID   string            `json:"authority_id"`
	ReferenceID   string            `json:"reference_id"`
	Scope         AssessmentScope   `json:"scope"`
	Outcome       AssessmentOutcome `json:"outcome"`
	AssessedAt    time.Time         `json:"assessed_at"`
	ValidUntil    *time.Time        `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
	CorrelationID string            `json:"correlation_id"`
}

func (a ExternalAssessment) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(a.AuthorityID, "assessment.authority_id", 128); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(a.ReferenceID, "assessment.reference_id", 256); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(a.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if a.AssessedAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment.assessed_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch a.Scope {
	case AssessmentPropertyIdentity,
		AssessmentRightExistence,
		AssessmentRightScope,
		AssessmentDocumentValidity:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid assessment scope", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch a.Outcome {
	case AssessmentConfirmed, AssessmentNotConfirmed, AssessmentInconclusive:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid assessment outcome", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if a.ValidUntil != nil && !a.ValidUntil.After(a.AssessedAt) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment validity must end after assessment time", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return nil
}

type RightStatus string

const (
	RightDraft              RightStatus = "draft"
	RightSubmitted          RightStatus = "submitted"
	RightUnderReview        RightStatus = "under_review"
	RightEvidenceRequired   RightStatus = "evidence_required"
	RightExternallyAssessed RightStatus = "externally_assessed"
	RightRejected           RightStatus = "rejected"
	RightSuspended          RightStatus = "suspended"
	RightWithdrawn          RightStatus = "withdrawn"
	RightExpired            RightStatus = "expired"
)

func (s RightStatus) terminal() bool {
	return s == RightRejected || s == RightWithdrawn || s == RightExpired
}

type RightAction string

const (
	ActionAmendTerms       RightAction = "amend_terms"
	ActionLinkContract     RightAction = "link_contract"
	ActionAttachEvidence   RightAction = "attach_evidence"
	ActionSubmit           RightAction = "submit"
	ActionStartReview      RightAction = "start_review"
	ActionRequestEvidence  RightAction = "request_evidence"
	ActionRecordAssessment RightAction = "record_assessment"
	ActionReject           RightAction = "reject"
	ActionSuspend          RightAction = "suspend"
	ActionResume           RightAction = "resume"
	ActionWithdraw         RightAction = "withdraw"
	ActionExpire           RightAction = "expire"
)

type RightCommand struct {
	Action           RightAction         `json:"action"`
	ExpectedRevision uint64              `json:"expected_revision"`
	IdempotencyKey   string              `json:"idempotency_key"`
	ActorID          string              `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID    string              `json:"correlation_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time           `json:"occurred_at"`
	Reason           string              `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	Terms            *RightTerms         `json:"terms,omitempty"`
	Contract         *ContractReference  `json:"contract,omitempty"`
	Evidence         *EvidenceReference  `json:"evidence,omitempty"`
	Assessment       *ExternalAssessment `json:"assessment,omitempty"`
}

type RightTransition struct {
	Revision      uint64      `json:"revision"`
	Action        RightAction `json:"action"`
	From          RightStatus `json:"from"`
	To            RightStatus `json:"to"`
	ActorID       string      `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID string      `json:"correlation_id"`
	Reason        string      `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time   `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type RightClaimSnapshot struct {
	ID               string              `json:"id"`
	PropertyID       string              `json:"property_id"`
	PropertyRevision uint64              `json:"property_revision"`
	Type             RightType           `json:"type"`
	Terms            RightTerms          `json:"terms"`
	Status           RightStatus         `json:"status"`
	Revision         uint64              `json:"revision"`
	Contracts        []ContractReference `json:"contracts"`
	Evidence         []EvidenceReference `json:"evidence"`
	Assessment       *ExternalAssessment `json:"assessment,omitempty"`
	History          []RightTransition   `json:"history"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time           `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt        time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
}

type RightClaim struct {
	mu                     sync.Mutex
	id                     string
	propertyID             string
	propertyRevision       uint64
	rightType              RightType
	terms                  RightTerms
	status                 RightStatus
	statusBeforeSuspension RightStatus
	revision               uint64
	contracts              []ContractReference
	evidence               []EvidenceReference
	assessment             *ExternalAssessment
	history                []RightTransition
	idempotency            map[string]string
	createdAt              time.Time
	updatedAt              time.Time
}

func NewRightClaim(
	id string,
	propertyID string,
	propertyRevision uint64,
	rightType RightType,
	terms RightTerms,
	actorID string,
	correlationID string,
	createdAt time.Time,
) (*RightClaim, error) {
	if err := requiredText(id, "right_claim_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := requiredText(propertyID, "property_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if propertyRevision == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: property_revision must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !rightType.valid() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported right type", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if err := terms.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(actorID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(correlationID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if createdAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: created_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	now := createdAt.UTC()

	return &RightClaim{
		id:               id,
		propertyID:       propertyID,
		propertyRevision: propertyRevision,
		rightType:        rightType,
		terms:            cloneTerms(terms),
		status:           RightDraft,
		revision:         1,
		idempotency:      make(map[string]string),
		createdAt:        now,
		updatedAt:        now,
		history: []RightTransition{
			{
				Revision:      1,
				Action:        "created",
				From:          RightDraft,
				To:            RightDraft,
				ActorID:       actorID,
				CorrelationID: correlationID,
				OccurredAt:    now,
			},
		},
	}, nil
}

func (r *RightClaim) Apply(cmd RightCommand) (RightClaimSnapshot, bool, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	if err := validateIdempotency(cmd.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(cmd.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: occurred_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	fingerprint, err := rightCommandFingerprint(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}

	if previous, exists := r.idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		return r.snapshotLocked(), true, nil
	}

	if err := validateRevision(cmd.ExpectedRevision, r.revision); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}

	if cmd.OccurredAt.Before(r.updatedAt) {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: command time precedes last update", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if r.status.terminal() {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrTerminalState
	}

	from := r.status
	to := from

	switch cmd.Action {
	case ActionAmendTerms:
		if r.status != RightDraft || cmd.Terms == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Terms.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		r.terms = cloneTerms(*cmd.Terms)

	case ActionLinkContract:
		if r.status != RightDraft || cmd.Contract == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Contract.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		for _, existing := range r.contracts {
			if existing.key() == cmd.Contract.key() {
				return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: contract reference already linked", ErrConflict)
			}
		}
		r.contracts = append(r.contracts, *cmd.Contract)
		sort.Slice(r.contracts, func(i, j int) bool {
			return r.contracts[i].key() < r.contracts[j].key()
		})

	case ActionAttachEvidence:
		if r.status == RightRejected || r.status == RightWithdrawn || r.status == RightExpired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrTerminalState
		}
		if cmd.Evidence == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		if err := cmd.Evidence.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		for _, existing := range r.evidence {
			if existing.ID == cmd.Evidence.ID {
				return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: evidence id already exists", ErrConflict)
			}
		}
		r.evidence = append(r.evidence, cloneEvidence(*cmd.Evidence))
		sort.Slice(r.evidence, func(i, j int) bool {
			return r.evidence[i].ID < r.evidence[j].ID
		})

	case ActionSubmit:
		if r.status != RightDraft {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if len(r.contracts) == 0 {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one Contracts reference is required", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if len(r.evidence) == 0 {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one evidence reference is required", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		to = RightSubmitted

	case ActionStartReview:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted && r.status != RightEvidenceRequired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		to = RightUnderReview

	case ActionRequestEvidence:
		if r.status != RightUnderReview {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		to = RightEvidenceRequired

	case ActionRecordAssessment:
		if r.status != RightUnderReview || cmd.Assessment == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Assessment.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		if cmd.Assessment.AssessedAt.After(cmd.OccurredAt) {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment cannot occur after command time", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		assessment := cloneAssessment(*cmd.Assessment)
		r.assessment = &assessment
		to = RightExternallyAssessed

	case ActionReject:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted &&
			r.status != RightUnderReview &&
			r.status != RightEvidenceRequired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		to = RightRejected

	case ActionSuspend:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted &&
			r.status != RightUnderReview &&
			r.status != RightEvidenceRequired &&
			r.status != RightExternallyAssessed {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		r.statusBeforeSuspension = r.status
		to = RightSuspended

	case ActionResume:
		if r.status != RightSuspended || r.statusBeforeSuspension == "" {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		to = r.statusBeforeSuspension
		r.statusBeforeSuspension = ""

	case ActionWithdraw:
		if r.status == RightDraft || r.status == RightSuspended ||
			r.status == RightSubmitted || r.status == RightUnderReview ||
			r.status == RightEvidenceRequired || r.status == RightExternallyAssessed {
			to = RightWithdrawn
		} else {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}

	case ActionExpire:
		if r.status == RightDraft || r.status == RightRejected ||
			r.status == RightWithdrawn || r.status == RightExpired {
			return RightSnapshotInvalid(), false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if !cmd.OccurredAt.After(r.terms.EffectiveUntil) &&
			!cmd.OccurredAt.Equal(r.terms.EffectiveUntil) {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: right has not expired", ErrInvalidTransition)
		}
		to = RightExpired

	default:
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported right action", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	r.status = to
	r.revision++
	r.updatedAt = cmd.OccurredAt.UTC()
	r.idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint

	r.history = append(r.history, RightTransition{
		Revision:      r.revision,
		Action:        cmd.Action,
		From:          from,
		To:            to,
		ActorID:       cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID: cmd.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        strings.TrimSpace(cmd.Reason),
		OccurredAt:    r.updatedAt,
	})

	return r.snapshotLocked(), false, nil
}

func RightSnapshotInvalid() RightClaimSnapshot {
	return RightClaimSnapshot{}
}

func (r *RightClaim) Snapshot() RightClaimSnapshot {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.snapshotLocked()
}

func (r *RightClaim) snapshotLocked() RightClaimSnapshot {
	out := RightClaimSnapshot{
		ID:               r.id,
		PropertyID:       r.propertyID,
		PropertyRevision: r.propertyRevision,
		Type:             r.rightType,
		Terms:            cloneTerms(r.terms),
		Status:           r.status,
		Revision:         r.revision,
		Contracts:        append([]ContractReference(nil), r.contracts...),
		Evidence:         make([]EvidenceReference, len(r.evidence)),
		History:          append([]RightTransition(nil), r.history...),
		CreatedAt:        r.createdAt,
		UpdatedAt:        r.updatedAt,
	}

	for i, evidence := range r.evidence {
		out.Evidence[i] = cloneEvidence(evidence)
	}

	if r.assessment != nil {
		a := cloneAssessment(*r.assessment)
		out.Assessment = &a
	}

	return out
}

func rightCommandFingerprint(cmd RightCommand) (string, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("marshal right command: %w", err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func cloneTerms(t RightTerms) RightTerms {
	return t
}

func cloneEvidence(e EvidenceReference) EvidenceReference {
	out := e
	if e.ValidUntil != nil {
		v := *e.ValidUntil
		out.ValidUntil = &v
	}
	return out
}

func cloneAssessment(a ExternalAssessment) ExternalAssessment {
	out := a
	if a.ValidUntil != nil {
		v := *a.ValidUntil
		out.ValidUntil = &v
	}
	return out
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidInput        = errors.New("invalid input")
	ErrNotFound            = errors.New("not found")
	ErrConflict            = errors.New("revision conflict")
	ErrInvalidTransition   = errors.New("invalid lifecycle transition")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrTerminalState       = errors.New("entity is in a terminal state")
)

func requiredText(value, field string, maxRunes int) error {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)

	if value == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is required", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not valid UTF-8", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	return nil
}

func optionalText(value, field string, maxRunes int) error {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)

	if value == "" {
		return nil
	}

	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not valid UTF-8", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	return nil
}

func validTime(value interface{ IsZero() bool }) bool {
	return !value.IsZero()
}

func validateActor(actor string) error {
	return requiredText(actor, "actor_id", 128)
}

func validateCorrelation(value string) error {
	return requiredText(value, "correlation_id", 128)
}

func validateIdempotency(value string) error {
	return requiredText(value, "idempotency_key", 200)
}

func validateRevision(expected, actual uint64) error {
	if expected != actual {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"%w: expected revision %d, actual revision %d",
			ErrConflict,
			expected,
			actual,
		)
	}

	return nil
}

package marketbridge

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type AssetKind string

const (
	AssetCommodity  AssetKind = "COMMODITY"
	AssetRealEstate AssetKind = "REAL_ESTATE"
)

type EligibilityStatus string

const (
	EligibilityQualified    EligibilityStatus = "QUALIFIED"
	EligibilityNotQualified EligibilityStatus = "NOT_QUALIFIED"
	EligibilityPending      EligibilityStatus = "PENDING"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidArgument       = errors.New("marketbridge: invalid argument")
	ErrMissingDependency     = errors.New("marketbridge: missing dependency")
	ErrConfigurationMismatch = errors.New("marketbridge: configuration mismatch")
	ErrNotQualified          = errors.New("marketbridge: asset or actor is not qualified")
	ErrPendingQualification  = errors.New("marketbridge: qualification is pending")
	ErrReferenceMismatch     = errors.New("marketbridge: reference mismatch")
	ErrExpired               = errors.New("marketbridge: request expired")
	ErrInvalidProviderResult = errors.New("marketbridge: invalid provider result")
	ErrUnsupportedAssetKind  = errors.New("marketbridge: unsupported asset kind")
)

// AssetReference is a reference to a specialized domain object.
// It is deliberately not an ownership, inventory, or legal-title record.
type AssetReference struct {
	Kind              AssetKind `json:"kind"`
	DomainID          string    `json:"domain_id"`
	DomainRevision    uint64    `json:"domain_revision"`
	DomainFingerprint string    `json:"domain_fingerprint"`
}

func (r AssetReference) Validate() error {
	if r.Kind != AssetCommodity && r.Kind != AssetRealEstate {
		return ErrUnsupportedAssetKind
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.DomainID) == "" ||
		r.DomainRevision == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.DomainFingerprint) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: incomplete specialized asset reference", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	return nil
}

// ConfigurationReference pins the exact ruleset version used by an offer.
type ConfigurationReference struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Version uint64 `json:"version"`
}

func (r ConfigurationReference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ID) == "" || r.Version == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid configuration reference", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	return nil
}

type ListingRequest struct {
	RequestID      string                 `json:"request_id"`
	IdempotencyKey string                 `json:"idempotency_key"`
	CorrelationID  string                 `json:"correlation_id"`
	ActorID        string                 `json:"actor_id"`
	Asset          AssetReference         `json:"asset"`
	Configuration  ConfigurationReference `json:"configuration"`
	MarketID       string                 `json:"market_id"`
	RequestedAt    time.Time              `json:"requested_at"`
	ExpiresAt      time.Time              `json:"expires_at"`
	Attributes     map[string]string      `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
}

func (r ListingRequest) Validate(now time.Time) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RequestID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.MarketID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: missing listing identity fields", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	if r.RequestedAt.IsZero() || r.ExpiresAt.IsZero() ||
		!r.ExpiresAt.After(r.RequestedAt) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid listing time range", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	if !now.IsZero() && !now.Before(r.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrExpired
	}
	if err := r.Asset.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := r.Configuration.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// Fingerprint binds all semantically relevant request fields.
// The idempotency key is not used as a substitute for the fingerprint.
func (r ListingRequest) Fingerprint() (string, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(r)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("marshal listing request: %w", err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

type MatchingValidationCommand struct {
	RequestID     string                `json:"request_id"`
	CorrelationID string                `json:"correlation_id"`
	Order         OrderValidationResult `json:"order"`
	Asset         AssetReference        `json:"asset"`
	MarketID      string                `json:"market_id"`
	At            time.Time             `json:"at"`
}

type MatchingValidationResult struct {
	Accepted     bool   `json:"accepted"`
	ValidationID string `json:"validation_id"`
	RuleVersion  string `json:"rule_version"`
}

type TradeValidationCommand struct {
	RequestID     string                   `json:"request_id"`
	CorrelationID string                   `json:"correlation_id"`
	Order         OrderValidationResult    `json:"order"`
	Matching      MatchingValidationResult `json:"matching"`
	Asset         AssetReference           `json:"asset"`
	At            time.Time                `json:"at"`
}

type TradeValidationResult struct {
	Accepted     bool   `json:"accepted"`
	ValidationID string `json:"validation_id"`
}

type ExecutionPolicyCommand struct {
	RequestID     string                 `json:"request_id"`
	CorrelationID string                 `json:"correlation_id"`
	Asset         AssetReference         `json:"asset"`
	MarketID      string                 `json:"market_id"`
	Configuration ConfigurationReference `json:"configuration"`
	Trade         TradeValidationResult  `json:"trade"`
	At            time.Time              `json:"at"`
}

type ExecutionPolicyResult struct {
	PolicyID      string `json:"policy_id"`
	PolicyVersion uint64 `json:"policy_version"`
	Available     bool   `json:"available"`
}

type OrdersPort interface {
	ValidateSpecializedOrder(context.Context, OrderValidationCommand) (OrderValidationResult, error)
}

type MatchingPort interface {
	ValidateSpecializedMatching(context.Context, MatchingValidationCommand) (MatchingValidationResult, error)
}

type TradesPort interface {
	ValidateSpecializedTrade(context.Context, TradeValidationCommand) (TradeValidationResult, error)
}

type ExecutionPort interface {
	ResolveSpecializedExecutionPolicy(context.Context, ExecutionPolicyCommand) (ExecutionPolicyResult, error)
}

type Ports struct {
	Configurations ConfigurationPort
	Eligibility    EligibilityPort
	External       ExternalReferencePort
	Catalogue      CataloguePort
	Offers         OfferLifecyclePort
	Orders         OrdersPort
	Matching       MatchingPort
	Trades         TradesPort
	Execution      ExecutionPort
}

func (p Ports) ValidateListingDependencies() error {
	if p.Configurations == nil || p.Eligibility == nil ||
		p.External == nil || p.Catalogue == nil || p.Offers == nil {
		return ErrMissingDependency
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Ports) ValidateOrderDependencies() error {
	if p.Orders == nil || p.Matching == nil ||
		p.Trades == nil || p.Execution == nil {
		return ErrMissingDependency
	}
	return nil
}

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

type SystemClock struct{}

func (SystemClock) Now() time.Time {
	return time.Now().UTC()
}

type Service struct {
	ports Ports
	clock Clock
}

func NewService(ports Ports, clock Clock) (*Service, error) {
	if clock == nil {
		clock = SystemClock{}
	}
	return &Service{ports: ports, clock: clock}, nil
}

type ListingResult struct {
	RequestFingerprint string                  `json:"request_fingerprint"`
	Asset              AssetReference          `json:"asset"`
	Configuration      ConfigurationReference  `json:"configuration"`
	Eligibility        EligibilityResult       `json:"eligibility"`
	ExternalCheck      ExternalReferenceResult `json:"external_check"`
	Catalogue          CatalogueReference      `json:"catalogue"`
	Offer              OfferReference          `json:"offer"`
	ReadyForReview     bool                    `json:"ready_for_review"`
}

func validateConfigurationSnapshot(expected ConfigurationReference, got ConfigurationSnapshot, at time.Time) error {
	if got.Reference != expected || !got.Active {
		return ErrConfigurationMismatch
	}
	if !got.ValidFrom.IsZero() && at.Before(got.ValidFrom) {
		return ErrConfigurationMismatch
	}
	if !got.ValidUntil.IsZero() && !at.Before(got.ValidUntil) {
		return ErrConfigurationMismatch
	}
	return nil
}

func validateEligibilityResult(result EligibilityResult, at time.Time) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.DecisionID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(result.RuleVersion) == "" ||
		result.EvaluatedAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}
	switch result.Status {
	case EligibilityQualified:
		if !result.ValidUntil.IsZero() && !at.Before(result.ValidUntil) {
			return ErrExpired
		}
		return nil
	case EligibilityNotQualified:
		return ErrNotQualified
	case EligibilityPending:
		return ErrPendingQualification
	default:
		return ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}
}

func validateExternalResult(result ExternalReferenceResult, at time.Time) error {
	if !result.Verified ||
		strings.TrimSpace(result.VerificationID) == "" ||
		result.VerifiedAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrReferenceMismatch
	}
	if !result.ValidUntil.IsZero() && !at.Before(result.ValidUntil) {
		return ErrExpired
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Service) PrepareListing(ctx context.Context, request ListingRequest) (ListingResult, error) {
	var zero ListingResult

	if ctx == nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("%w: nil context", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	if err := s.ports.ValidateListingDependencies(); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	now := s.clock.Now().UTC()
	if err := request.Validate(now); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	fingerprint, err := request.Fingerprint()
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	config, err := s.ports.Configurations.ResolveConfiguration(ctx, request.Configuration, now)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("resolve configuration: %w", err)
	}
	if err := validateConfigurationSnapshot(request.Configuration, config, now); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	eligibility, err := s.ports.Eligibility.EvaluateEligibility(ctx, EligibilityRequest{
		RequestID:     request.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:       request.ActorID,
		Asset:         request.Asset,
		MarketID:      request.MarketID,
		Config:        request.Configuration,
		At:            now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("evaluate eligibility: %w", err)
	}
	if err := validateEligibilityResult(eligibility, now); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	external, err := s.ports.External.VerifySpecializedReferences(ctx, ExternalReferenceCheck{
		RequestID:     request.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Asset:         request.Asset,
		Config:        request.Configuration,
		ActorID:       request.ActorID,
		At:            now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("verify specialized references: %w", err)
	}
	if err := validateExternalResult(external, now); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	catalogue, err := s.ports.Catalogue.EnsureSpecializedItem(ctx, CatalogueCommand{
		RequestID:       request.RequestID,
		IdempotencyKey:  request.IdempotencyKey + ":catalogue",
		CorrelationID:   request.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:         request.ActorID,
		MarketID:        request.MarketID,
		Asset:           request.Asset,
		Configuration:   request.Configuration,
		EligibilityID:   eligibility.DecisionID,
		ExternalCheckID: external.VerificationID,
		Fingerprint:     fingerprint,
		Attributes:      request.Attributes,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("ensure catalogue item: %w", err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(catalogue.ItemID) == "" || catalogue.Revision == 0 {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	offer, err := s.ports.Offers.PrepareSpecializedDraft(ctx, OfferDraftCommand{
		RequestID:       request.RequestID,
		IdempotencyKey:  request.IdempotencyKey + ":offer",
		CorrelationID:   request.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:         request.ActorID,
		MarketID:        request.MarketID,
		Asset:           request.Asset,
		Configuration:   request.Configuration,
		Catalogue:       catalogue,
		EligibilityID:   eligibility.DecisionID,
		ExternalCheckID: external.VerificationID,
		Fingerprint:     fingerprint,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("prepare offer draft: %w", err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(offer.OfferID) == "" || offer.Revision == 0 ||
		!strings.EqualFold(offer.Status, "DRAFT") {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	return ListingResult{
		RequestFingerprint: fingerprint,
		Asset:              request.Asset,
		Configuration:      request.Configuration,
		Eligibility:        eligibility,
		ExternalCheck:      external,
		Catalogue:          catalogue,
		Offer:              offer,
		ReadyForReview:     true,
	}, nil
}

type OrderRouteRequest struct {
	RequestID      string                 `json:"request_id"`
	IdempotencyKey string                 `json:"idempotency_key"`
	CorrelationID  string                 `json:"correlation_id"`
	ActorID        string                 `json:"actor_id"`
	OrderID        string                 `json:"order_id"`
	Asset          AssetReference         `json:"asset"`
	Configuration  ConfigurationReference `json:"configuration"`
	MarketID       string                 `json:"market_id"`
	At             time.Time              `json:"at"`
}

func (r OrderRouteRequest) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RequestID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.OrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(r.MarketID) == "" ||
		r.At.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidArgument
	}
	if err := r.Asset.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return r.Configuration.Validate()
}

type OrderRouteResult struct {
	Order             OrderValidationResult    `json:"order"`
	Matching          MatchingValidationResult `json:"matching"`
	Trade             TradeValidationResult    `json:"trade"`
	Execution         ExecutionPolicyResult    `json:"execution"`
	CorrelationID     string                   `json:"correlation_id"`
	ReadyForExecution bool                     `json:"ready_for_execution"`
}

// ValidateOrderRoute performs validations only. It does not create an order,
// execute a match, create a trade, reserve assets, sign a contract, or settle.
func (s *Service) ValidateOrderRoute(ctx context.Context, request OrderRouteRequest) (OrderRouteResult, error) {
	var zero OrderRouteResult

	if ctx == nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("%w: nil context", ErrInvalidArgument)
	}
	if err := s.ports.ValidateOrderDependencies(); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	order, err := s.ports.Orders.ValidateSpecializedOrder(ctx, OrderValidationCommand{
		RequestID:      request.RequestID,
		IdempotencyKey: request.IdempotencyKey + ":order-validation",
		CorrelationID:  request.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:        request.ActorID,
		OrderID:        request.OrderID,
		Asset:          request.Asset,
		MarketID:       request.MarketID,
		Configuration:  request.Configuration,
		At:             request.At,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("validate order: %w", err)
	}
	if !order.Accepted || order.OrderID != request.OrderID ||
		order.Revision == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(order.ValidationID) == "" {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	matching, err := s.ports.Matching.ValidateSpecializedMatching(ctx, MatchingValidationCommand{
		RequestID:     request.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Order:         order,
		Asset:         request.Asset,
		MarketID:      request.MarketID,
		At:            request.At,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("validate matching: %w", err)
	}
	if !matching.Accepted || strings.TrimSpace(matching.ValidationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(matching.RuleVersion) == "" {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	trade, err := s.ports.Trades.ValidateSpecializedTrade(ctx, TradeValidationCommand{
		RequestID:     request.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Order:         order,
		Matching:      matching,
		Asset:         request.Asset,
		At:            request.At,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("validate trade context: %w", err)
	}
	if !trade.Accepted || strings.TrimSpace(trade.ValidationID) == "" {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	policy, err := s.ports.Execution.ResolveSpecializedExecutionPolicy(ctx, ExecutionPolicyCommand{
		RequestID:     request.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Asset:         request.Asset,
		MarketID:      request.MarketID,
		Configuration: request.Configuration,
		Trade:         trade,
		At:            request.At,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return zero, fmt.Errorf("resolve execution policy: %w", err)
	}
	if !policy.Available || strings.TrimSpace(policy.PolicyID) == "" ||
		policy.PolicyVersion == 0 {
		return zero, ErrInvalidProviderResult
	}

	return OrderRouteResult{
		Order:             order,
		Matching:          matching,
		Trade:             trade,
		Execution:         policy,
		CorrelationID:     request.CorrelationID,
		ReadyForExecution: true,
	}, nil
}

func TestPrepareListingCommodity(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	catalogue := &fakeCatalogue{result: CatalogueReference{ItemID: "catalogue-1", Revision: 1}}
	offers := &fakeOffers{result: OfferReference{OfferID: "offer-1", Revision: 1, Status: "DRAFT"}}

	service, err := NewService(listingPorts(now, catalogue, offers), fixedClock{now: now})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	result, err := service.PrepareListing(context.Background(), validListingRequest(now))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !result.ReadyForReview || result.Offer.OfferID != "offer-1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %+v", result)
	}
	if catalogue.calls != 1 || offers.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one call per downstream port, got catalogue=%d offers=%d", catalogue.calls, offers.calls)
	}
	if result.RequestFingerprint == "" {
		t.Fatal("request fingerprint must be populated")
	}
}

func TestValidateOrderRouteRejectsUnavailableExecutionPolicy(t *testing.T) {

		PolicyID:      "policy-1",
		PolicyVersion: 1,
		Available:     false,
	}}
	service, err := NewService(ports, fixedClock{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)

	_, err = service.ValidateOrderRoute(context.Background(), validOrderRouteRequest())

}

package specialized

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"strings"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidQuantity  = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrUnitMismatch     = errors.New("quantity unit mismatch")
	ErrScaleMismatch    = errors.New("quantity scale mismatch")
	ErrQuantityOverflow = errors.New("quantity arithmetic overflow")
)

// Quantity stores a fixed-point value.
// Value=12345, Scale=2 means 123.45 units.
// No implicit unit conversion is performed.
type Quantity struct {
	Value int64
	Scale uint8
	Unit  string
}

func NewQuantity(value int64, scale uint8, unit string) (Quantity, error) {
	q := Quantity{Value: value, Scale: scale, Unit: strings.TrimSpace(unit)}
	if err := q.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	return q, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Validate() error {
	if q.Value <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: value must be positive", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Scale > 9 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: scale exceeds supported precision", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Unit == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit is required", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) ValidateNonNegative() error {
	if q.Value < 0 || q.Scale > 9 || strings.TrimSpace(q.Unit) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compatible(other Quantity) error {
	if q.Unit != other.Unit {
		return ErrUnitMismatch
	}
	if q.Scale != other.Scale {
		return ErrScaleMismatch
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Add(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > 0 && q.Value > math.MaxInt64-other.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrQuantityOverflow
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value + other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Subtract(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > q.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value - other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compare(other Quantity) (int, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	switch {
	case q.Value < other.Value:
		return -1, nil
	case q.Value > other.Value:
		return 1, nil
	default:
		return 0, nil
	}
}

func (q Quantity) IsZero() bool {
	return q.Value == 0
}

package specialized

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidReference = errors.New("invalid external reference")
	ErrInvalidVersion   = errors.New("invalid reference version")
)

// Reference identifies data owned by another bounded context.
// It deliberately does not copy the referenced service's authoritative data.
type Reference struct {
	Service       string
	ResourceType  string
	ResourceID    string
	Version       string
	CorrelationID string
}

func (r Reference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Service) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: service is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource type is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource ID is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Version) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidVersion
	}
	return nil
}

func (r Reference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Service),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Version),
	}, ":")
}

// SubjectReference identifies the specialized subject of a market offer.
// The market stores this reference and its version, not legal ownership.
type SubjectReference struct {
	Domain               string
	SubjectType          string
	SubjectID            string
	SpecificationVersion string
}

func (s SubjectReference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion) == "" {
		return errors.New("incomplete specialized subject reference")
	}
	return nil
}

func (s SubjectReference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion),
	}, ":")
}

package requests

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

var (
	ErrRequestExists = errors.New("supply request already exists")
)

type Repository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, requestID string) (SupplyRequest, error)

	Create(ctx context.Context, request SupplyRequest) error

	Save(
		ctx context.Context,
		request SupplyRequest,
		expectedRevision uint64,
	) error
}

type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(
		ctx context.Context,
		fn func(context.Context) error,
	) error
}

type AuditSink interface {
	Append(
		ctx context.Context,
		events []Event,
	) error
}

// Repository implementations must enforce optimistic concurrency using
// expectedRevision. Request and proposal changes must be persisted as
// one aggregate operation.
//
// TransactionManager must commit request state, proposal state and audit
// events atomically.
//
// AuditSink must preserve event order and must not silently discard events.
//
// These are integration contracts only. No storage adapter is provided.

package requests

import (
	"errors"

type RequestStatus string

const (
	RequestDraft     RequestStatus = "draft"
	RequestOpen      RequestStatus = "open"
	RequestFulfilled RequestStatus = "fulfilled"
	RequestCancelled RequestStatus = "cancelled"
	RequestExpired   RequestStatus = "expired"
)

type ProposalStatus string

const (
	ProposalSubmitted ProposalStatus = "submitted"
	ProposalAccepted  ProposalStatus = "accepted"
	ProposalRejected  ProposalStatus = "rejected"
	ProposalWithdrawn ProposalStatus = "withdrawn"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidRequest        = errors.New("invalid supply request")
	ErrInvalidProposal       = errors.New("invalid proposal")
	ErrInvalidCommand        = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidActor          = errors.New("invalid actor")
	ErrInvalidTransition     = errors.New("invalid lifecycle transition")
	ErrRevisionConflict      = errors.New("revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict   = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrCommandAlreadyApplied = errors.New("command already applied")
	ErrRequestNotFound       = errors.New("request not found")
	ErrProposalNotFound      = errors.New("proposal not found")
	ErrRequestNotOpen        = errors.New("request is not open")

	ErrRequestNotExpired     = errors.New("request has not expired")
	ErrProposalMismatch      = errors.New("proposal does not satisfy request")
	ErrProposalAlreadyChosen = errors.New("a proposal has already been selected")
	ErrReasonRequired        = errors.New("reason is required")
	ErrDuplicateProposal     = errors.New("duplicate proposal ID")
	ErrNoEligibleProposal    = errors.New("no eligible proposal")

type CommandContext struct {

	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string

type RequestTerms struct {

	Description string

	MaxQuantity int64

	MaxUnitPrice int64

	DeliveryDeadline time.Time
	ProposalDeadline time.Time

	ConfigVersion uint64

	Quantity int64
	Unit     string

	Currency  string

	Description string

	EntityID   string

	SubmittedAt time.Time

	Issues   []string

func normalizeTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
	return value.UTC()
}

func validateCommand(command CommandContext) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.ActorID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidActor
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.CommandID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.CorrelationID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: correlation ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateTerms(terms RequestTerms) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.ConfigID) == "" || terms.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration reference is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: title is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.Unit) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(terms.Currency) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit and currency are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.MinQuantity <= 0 || terms.MaxQuantity < terms.MinQuantity {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid quantity bounds", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.MaxUnitPrice <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: maximum unit price must be positive", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.DeliveryDeadline.IsZero() || terms.ProposalDeadline.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: deadlines are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if !terms.ProposalDeadline.Before(terms.DeliveryDeadline) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: proposal deadline must precede delivery deadline", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateProposalInput(input ProposalInput) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: provider ID is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(input.ConfigID) == "" || input.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration reference is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if input.Quantity <= 0 || input.UnitPrice <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: quantity and unit price must be positive", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(input.Unit) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.Currency) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit and currency are required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if input.DeliveryAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: delivery time is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	return nil
}

func cloneTime(source *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if source == nil {
		return nil
	}

	value := *source
	return &value
}

func cloneProposal(source Proposal) Proposal {
	result := source
	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)
	return result
}

func cloneRequest(source SupplyRequest) SupplyRequest {
	result := source

	result.PublishedAt = cloneTime(source.PublishedAt)
	result.SelectedAt = cloneTime(source.SelectedAt)
	result.CancelledAt = cloneTime(source.CancelledAt)
	result.ExpiredAt = cloneTime(source.ExpiredAt)

	result.Proposals = make([]Proposal, len(source.Proposals))
	for index, proposal := range source.Proposals {
		result.Proposals[index] = cloneProposal(proposal)
	}

	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)

	return result
}

func NewSupplyRequest(
	id string,
	ownerID string,
	terms RequestTerms,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) (SupplyRequest, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(ownerID) == "" {
		return SupplyRequest{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if err := validateTerms(terms); err != nil {
		return SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return SupplyRequest{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)
	terms.DeliveryDeadline = normalizeTime(terms.DeliveryDeadline)
	terms.ProposalDeadline = normalizeTime(terms.ProposalDeadline)
	terms.ConfigID = strings.TrimSpace(terms.ConfigID)
	terms.Title = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Title)
	terms.Description = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Description)
	terms.Unit = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Unit)
	terms.Currency = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(terms.Currency))

	request := SupplyRequest{
		ID:        strings.TrimSpace(id),
		OwnerID:   strings.TrimSpace(ownerID),
		Status:    RequestDraft,
		Terms:     terms,
		Revision:  1,
		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
		Proposals: []Proposal{},
	}

	request.History = []Event{{
		EntityType:    "request",
		EntityID:      request.ID,
		To:            string(RequestDraft),
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      request.Revision,
	}}

	return request, nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) Snapshot() SupplyRequest {
	return cloneRequest(r)
}

func (r SupplyRequest) Events() []Event {
	return append([]Event(nil), r.History...)
}

func (r SupplyRequest) IsTerminal() bool {
	return r.Status == RequestFulfilled ||
		r.Status == RequestCancelled ||
		r.Status == RequestExpired
}

func (r SupplyRequest) HasCommand(commandID string) bool {
	for _, event := range r.History {
		if event.CommandID == commandID {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected == 0 || expected != r.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) checkIdempotency(
	command CommandContext,
	entityType string,
	entityID string,
	target string,
) error {
	for _, event := range r.History {
		if event.CommandID != command.CommandID {
			continue
		}

		if event.EntityType == entityType &&
			event.EntityID == entityID &&
			event.To == target &&
			event.ActorID == command.ActorID &&
			event.CorrelationID == command.CorrelationID &&
			event.Reason == command.Reason {
			return ErrCommandAlreadyApplied
		}

		return ErrIdempotencyConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) record(
	entityType string,
	entityID string,
	from string,
	to string,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) {
	r.Revision++
	r.UpdatedAt = now

	r.History = append(r.History, Event{
		EntityType:    entityType,
		EntityID:      entityID,
		From:          from,
		To:            to,
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      r.Revision,
	})
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) Publish(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestOpen)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	if err := validateTerms(r.Terms); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	r.Status = RequestOpen
	r.record("request", r.ID, string(RequestDraft), string(RequestOpen), command, now)

	value := now
	r.PublishedAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) AddProposal(
	proposalID string,
	input ProposalInput,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(proposalID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidProposal
	}

	if err := validateProposalInput(input); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "proposal", proposalID, string(ProposalSubmitted)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	for _, existing := range r.Proposals {
		if existing.ID == proposalID {
			return ErrDuplicateProposal
		}
	}

	proposal := Proposal{
		ID:            strings.TrimSpace(proposalID),
		RequestID:     r.ID,
		ProviderID:    strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderID),
		Status:        ProposalSubmitted,
		ConfigID:      strings.TrimSpace(input.ConfigID),
		ConfigVersion: input.ConfigVersion,
		Quantity:      input.Quantity,
		Unit:          strings.TrimSpace(input.Unit),
		UnitPrice:     input.UnitPrice,
		Currency:      strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Currency)),
		DeliveryAt:    normalizeTime(input.DeliveryAt),
		Description:   strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
		SubmittedAt:   now,
		UpdatedAt:     now,
		Revision:      1,
	}

	proposal.History = []Event{{
		EntityType:    "proposal",
		EntityID:      proposal.ID,
		To:            string(ProposalSubmitted),
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      proposal.Revision,
	}}

	r.Proposals = append(r.Proposals, proposal)

	r.record(
		"proposal",
		proposal.ID,
		"",
		string(ProposalSubmitted),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) ValidateProposal(proposal Proposal) []string {
	issues := make([]string, 0)

	if proposal.RequestID != r.ID {
		issues = append(issues, "request_id_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.ConfigID != r.Terms.ConfigID ||
		proposal.ConfigVersion != r.Terms.ConfigVersion {
		issues = append(issues, "configuration_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.Quantity < r.Terms.MinQuantity ||
		proposal.Quantity > r.Terms.MaxQuantity {
		issues = append(issues, "quantity_out_of_range")
	}

	if proposal.Unit != r.Terms.Unit {
		issues = append(issues, "unit_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.Currency != r.Terms.Currency {
		issues = append(issues, "currency_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.UnitPrice > r.Terms.MaxUnitPrice {
		issues = append(issues, "price_exceeds_limit")
	}

	if proposal.DeliveryAt.IsZero() ||
		proposal.DeliveryAt.After(r.Terms.DeliveryDeadline) {
		issues = append(issues, "delivery_deadline_exceeded")
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(proposal.ProviderID) == "" {
		issues = append(issues, "provider_missing")
	}

	return issues
}

func (r SupplyRequest) CompareProposals() []ProposalComparison {
	result := make([]ProposalComparison, 0, len(r.Proposals))

	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		issues := r.ValidateProposal(proposal)

		result = append(result, ProposalComparison{
			ProposalID:  proposal.ID,
			ProviderID:  proposal.ProviderID,
			Quantity:    proposal.Quantity,
			Unit:        proposal.Unit,
			UnitPrice:   proposal.UnitPrice,
			Currency:    proposal.Currency,
			DeliveryAt:  proposal.DeliveryAt,
			SubmittedAt: proposal.SubmittedAt,
			Eligible:    len(issues) == 0 && proposal.Status == ProposalSubmitted,
			Issues:      issues,
		})
	}

	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if result[i].Eligible != result[j].Eligible {
			return result[i].Eligible
		}

		if result[i].UnitPrice != result[j].UnitPrice {
			return result[i].UnitPrice < result[j].UnitPrice
		}

		if !result[i].DeliveryAt.Equal(result[j].DeliveryAt) {
			return result[i].DeliveryAt.Before(result[j].DeliveryAt)
		}

		if !result[i].SubmittedAt.Equal(result[j].SubmittedAt) {
			return result[i].SubmittedAt.Before(result[j].SubmittedAt)
		}

		return result[i].ProposalID < result[j].ProposalID
	})

	return result
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) SelectProposal(
	proposalID string,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	proposalID = strings.TrimSpace(proposalID)

	if proposalID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidProposal
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestFulfilled)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	selectedIndex := -1

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		if r.Proposals[index].ID == proposalID {
			selectedIndex = index
			break
		}
	}

	if selectedIndex < 0 {
		return ErrProposalNotFound
	}

	selected := r.Proposals[selectedIndex]

	if selected.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if issues := r.ValidateProposal(selected); len(issues) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrProposalMismatch, strings.Join(issues, ","))
	}

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		from := proposal.Status

		if proposal.ID == proposalID {
			proposal.Status = ProposalAccepted
		} else {
			proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
			proposal.RejectionReason = "another proposal was selected"
		}

		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(from),
			To:            string(proposal.Status),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.Status = RequestFulfilled
	r.SelectedProposalID = proposalID

	value := now
	r.SelectedAt = &value

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(RequestOpen),
		string(RequestFulfilled),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) RejectProposal(
	proposalID string,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "proposal", proposalID, string(ProposalRejected)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.ID != proposalID {
			continue
		}

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			return ErrInvalidTransition
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = command.Reason
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})

		r.record(
			"proposal",
			proposal.ID,
			string(ProposalSubmitted),
			string(ProposalRejected),
			command,
			now,
		)

		return nil
	}

	return ErrProposalNotFound
}

	command CommandContext,

	if r == nil {

func (r *SupplyRequest) Cancel(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestCancelled)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestDraft && r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	from := r.Status
	r.Status = RequestCancelled
	r.CancellationReason = command.Reason

	value := now
	r.CancelledAt = &value

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = "request cancelled"
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(from),
		string(RequestCancelled),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) Expire(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestExpired)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestNotExpired
	}

	from := r.Status
	r.Status = RequestExpired

	value := now
	r.ExpiredAt = &value

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = "request expired"
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(from),
		string(RequestExpired),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) ProposalByID(id string) (Proposal, error) {
	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		if proposal.ID == id {
			return cloneProposal(proposal), nil
		}
	}

	return Proposal{}, ErrProposalNotFound
}

func (r SupplyRequest) EligibleProposals() []Proposal {
	result := make([]Proposal, 0)

	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		if proposal.Status == ProposalSubmitted &&
			len(r.ValidateProposal(proposal)) == 0 {
			result = append(result, cloneProposal(proposal))
		}
	}

	return result
}

	return time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
}

	return CommandContext{
		ActorID:       "actor-1",

		CorrelationID: "corr-1",
	}
}

				value,
				command("create-"+test.name),
				baseTime(),
			)

			}
		})
	}
}

func TestSelectionIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	request := openRequest(t)

	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-1", "provider-1", 300)

	commandValue := command("select-1")
	now := baseTime().Add(5 * time.Minute)

	if err := request.SelectProposal(
		"proposal-1",
		commandValue,
		request.Revision,
		now,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	revision := request.Revision
	historyLength := len(request.History)

	if err := request.SelectProposal(
		"proposal-1",
		commandValue,
		1,
		now,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("idempotent retry failed: %v", err)
	}

	if request.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry changed revision")
	}

	if len(request.History) != historyLength {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry duplicated history")
	}
}

package workflowruntime

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrHardeningInvalidInput     = errors.New("workflowruntime: invalid hardening input")
	ErrHardeningLeaseExpired     = errors.New("workflowruntime: lease expired")
	ErrHardeningLeaseMismatch    = errors.New("workflowruntime: lease proof mismatch")
	ErrHardeningUnknownOutcome   = errors.New("workflowruntime: external outcome is unknown")
	ErrHardeningAuditUnavailable = errors.New("workflowruntime: mandatory audit sink unavailable")
	ErrHardeningAuditRejected    = errors.New("workflowruntime: mandatory audit event rejected")
	ErrHardeningDependencyCycle  = errors.New("workflowruntime: dependency cycle")
)

type HardeningLeaseProof struct {
	Owner     string
	Token     string
	Attempt   uint32
	ExpiresAt time.Time
}

func ValidateHardeningLease(proof HardeningLeaseProof, now time.Time) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(proof.Owner) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(proof.Token) == "" ||
		proof.Attempt == 0 ||
		proof.ExpiresAt.IsZero() ||
		now.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: incomplete lease proof", ErrHardeningInvalidInput)
	}
	if !proof.ExpiresAt.After(now) {
		return ErrHardeningLeaseExpired
	}
	return nil
}

func VerifyHardeningLease(expected, presented HardeningLeaseProof, now time.Time) error {
	if err := ValidateHardeningLease(expected, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := ValidateHardeningLease(presented, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if expected.Owner != presented.Owner ||
		expected.Token != presented.Token ||
		expected.Attempt != presented.Attempt {
		return ErrHardeningLeaseMismatch
	}
	return nil
}

type HardeningExternalOutcome uint8

const (
	HardeningOutcomeUnspecified HardeningExternalOutcome = iota
	HardeningOutcomeConfirmedSuccess
	HardeningOutcomeConfirmedFailure
	HardeningOutcomeConfirmedNotFound
	HardeningOutcomeAmbiguous
)

type HardeningRecoveryDisposition uint8

const (
	HardeningRecoveryHold HardeningRecoveryDisposition = iota
	HardeningRecoveryComplete
	HardeningRecoveryFail
	HardeningRecoveryRetryPermitted
)

type HardeningRetryPolicy struct {
	Idempotent bool
	RetrySafe  bool
}

func DecideHardeningRecovery(
	outcome HardeningExternalOutcome,
	policy HardeningRetryPolicy,
) (HardeningRecoveryDisposition, error) {
	switch outcome {
	case HardeningOutcomeConfirmedSuccess:
		return HardeningRecoveryComplete, nil
	case HardeningOutcomeConfirmedFailure:
		return HardeningRecoveryFail, nil
	case HardeningOutcomeConfirmedNotFound:
		if policy.Idempotent && policy.RetrySafe {
			return HardeningRecoveryRetryPermitted, nil
		}
		return HardeningRecoveryHold, nil
	case HardeningOutcomeAmbiguous, HardeningOutcomeUnspecified:
		return HardeningRecoveryHold, ErrHardeningUnknownOutcome
	default:
		return HardeningRecoveryHold, fmt.Errorf(
			"%w: unsupported external outcome %d",
			ErrHardeningInvalidInput,
			outcome,
		)
	}
}

type HardeningAuditEvent struct {
	EventID       string
	CorrelationID string
	AggregateID   string
	EventType     string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	ActorID       string
	Details       string
}

type HardeningAuditSink interface {
	Append(context.Context, HardeningAuditEvent) error
}

func AppendHardeningAudit(
	ctx context.Context,
	sink HardeningAuditSink,
	event HardeningAuditEvent,
) error {
	if sink == nil {
		return ErrHardeningAuditUnavailable
	}
	if ctx == nil ||
		strings.TrimSpace(event.EventID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(event.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(event.AggregateID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(event.EventType) == "" ||
		event.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: incomplete audit event", ErrHardeningInvalidInput)
	}
	if err := sink.Append(ctx, event); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrHardeningAuditRejected, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func FingerprintHardeningRequest(
	providerID string,
	operation string,
	resourceID string,
	payload []byte,
) (string, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(providerID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(operation) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(resourceID) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: provider, operation and resource are required", ErrHardeningInvalidInput)
	}

	hash := sha256.New()
	fields := [][]byte{
		[]byte(providerID),
		[]byte(operation),
		[]byte(resourceID),
		payload,
	}

	var length [8]byte
	for _, field := range fields {
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(field)))
		_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
		_, _ = hash.Write(field)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
}

type HardeningDependencyStep struct {
	ID                string
	DependsOn         []string
	NeedsCompensation bool
}

func BuildHardeningCompensationOrder(
	input []HardeningDependencyStep,
) ([]string, error) {
	steps := make(map[string]HardeningDependencyStep, len(input))
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(input))

	for _, step := range input {
		id := strings.TrimSpace(step.ID)
		if id == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: empty step ID", ErrHardeningInvalidInput)
		}
		if _, exists := steps[id]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate step %q", ErrHardeningInvalidInput, id)
		}
		step.ID = id
		steps[id] = step
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)

	for id, step := range steps {
		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(step.DependsOn))
		for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
			dependency = strings.TrimSpace(dependency)
			if dependency == "" || dependency == id {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid dependency for %q", ErrHardeningInvalidInput, id)
			}
			if _, exists := steps[dependency]; !exists {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %q depends on unknown step %q", ErrHardeningInvalidInput, id, dependency)
			}
			if _, duplicate := seen[dependency]; duplicate {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate dependency %q for %q", ErrHardeningInvalidInput, dependency, id)
			}
			seen[dependency] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	const (
		unvisited uint8 = iota
		visiting
		visited
	)
	state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))
	topological := make([]string, 0, len(steps))

	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(id string) error {
		switch state[id] {
		case visiting:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w at %q", ErrHardeningDependencyCycle, id)
		case visited:
			return nil
		}

		state[id] = visiting
		dependencies := append([]string(nil), steps[id].DependsOn...)
		sort.Strings(dependencies)

		for _, dependency := range dependencies {
			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		state[id] = visited
		topological = append(topological, id)
		return nil
	}

	for _, id := range ids {
		if err := visit(id); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	result := make([]string, 0, len(topological))
	for i := len(topological) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		id := topological[i]
		if steps[id].NeedsCompensation {
			result = append(result, id)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

package workflowruntime

import (

type hardeningTestAuditSink struct {
	err    error
	events []HardeningAuditEvent
}

func (s *hardeningTestAuditSink) Append(
	_ context.Context,
	event HardeningAuditEvent,
) error {
	if s.err != nil {
		return s.err
	}
	s.events = append(s.events, event)
	return nil
}

func TestValidateHardeningLease(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	valid := HardeningLeaseProof{
		Owner: "worker-1", Token: "lease-1", Attempt: 1,
		ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Minute),
	}
	if err := ValidateHardeningLease(valid, now); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid lease rejected: %v", err)
	}

	expired := valid
	expired.ExpiresAt = now
	if err := ValidateHardeningLease(expired, now); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningLeaseExpired) {
		t.Fatalf("expected expired lease error, got %v", err)
	}

	invalid := valid
	invalid.Token = ""
	if err := ValidateHardeningLease(invalid, now); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningInvalidInput) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid proof error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestVerifyHardeningLeaseFencesStaleWorkers(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	expected := HardeningLeaseProof{
		Owner: "worker-a", Token: "token-new", Attempt: 3,
		ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Minute),
	}
	presented := expected
	if err := VerifyHardeningLease(expected, presented, now); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("matching lease rejected: %v", err)
	}

	presented.Token = "token-old"
	if err := VerifyHardeningLease(expected, presented, now); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningLeaseMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected fencing error, got %v", err)
	}

	presented = expected
	presented.Attempt--
	if err := VerifyHardeningLease(expected, presented, now); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningLeaseMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected attempt fencing error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDecideHardeningRecoveryNeverRetriesAmbiguousOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	disposition, err := DecideHardeningRecovery(
		HardeningOutcomeAmbiguous,
		HardeningRetryPolicy{Idempotent: true, RetrySafe: true},
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningUnknownOutcome) {
		t.Fatalf("expected unknown outcome error, got %v", err)
	}
	if disposition != HardeningRecoveryHold {
		t.Fatalf("ambiguous outcome must be held, got %v", disposition)
	}
}

func TestDecideHardeningRecoveryRequiresExplicitRetrySafety(t *testing.T) {
	disposition, err := DecideHardeningRecovery(
		HardeningOutcomeConfirmedNotFound,
		HardeningRetryPolicy{Idempotent: true, RetrySafe: true},
	)
	if err != nil || disposition != HardeningRecoveryRetryPermitted {
		t.Fatalf("safe retry not permitted: disposition=%v err=%v", disposition, err)
	}

	disposition, err = DecideHardeningRecovery(
		HardeningOutcomeConfirmedNotFound,
		HardeningRetryPolicy{Idempotent: false, RetrySafe: true},
	)
	if err != nil || disposition != HardeningRecoveryHold {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe retry must be held: disposition=%v err=%v", disposition, err)
	}
}

func TestAppendHardeningAuditRequiresSinkAndPropagatesFailure(t *testing.T) {
	event := HardeningAuditEvent{
		EventID: "event-1", CorrelationID: "corr-1",
		AggregateID: "trade-1", EventType: "workflow.completed",
		OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}

	if err := AppendHardeningAudit(context.Background(), nil, event); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningAuditUnavailable) {
		t.Fatalf("expected missing sink error, got %v", err)
	}

	sinkFailure := errors.New("journal unavailable")
	sink := &hardeningTestAuditSink{err: sinkFailure}
	if err := AppendHardeningAudit(context.Background(), sink, event); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningAuditRejected) {
		t.Fatalf("expected audit rejection, got %v", err)
	}

	sink = &hardeningTestAuditSink{}
	if err := AppendHardeningAudit(context.Background(), sink, event); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid audit event rejected: %v", err)
	}
	if len(sink.events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one persisted audit event, got %d", len(sink.events))
	}
}

func TestFingerprintHardeningRequestBindsSemanticIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{"amount":10}`)
	first, err := FingerprintHardeningRequest("provider-a", "reserve", "asset-1", payload)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	repeat, err := FingerprintHardeningRequest("provider-a", "reserve", "asset-1", payload)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first != repeat {
		t.Fatal("same semantic request produced different fingerprints")
	}

	otherProvider, _ := FingerprintHardeningRequest("provider-b", "reserve", "asset-1", payload)
	otherOperation, _ := FingerprintHardeningRequest("provider-a", "release", "asset-1", payload)
	otherResource, _ := FingerprintHardeningRequest("provider-a", "reserve", "asset-2", payload)
	if first == otherProvider || first == otherOperation || first == otherResource {
		t.Fatal("fingerprint did not bind the full request identity")
	}

	if _, err := FingerprintHardeningRequest("", "reserve", "asset-1", payload); !errors.Is(err, ErrHardeningInvalidInput) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid identity error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestBuildHardeningCompensationOrderReversesDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	steps := []HardeningDependencyStep{
		{ID: "prepare", NeedsCompensation: true},
		{ID: "reserve", DependsOn: []string{"prepare"}, NeedsCompensation: true},
		{ID: "execute", DependsOn: []string{"reserve"}, NeedsCompensation: true},
		{ID: "notify", DependsOn: []string{"execute"}, NeedsCompensation: false},
	}
	got, err := BuildHardeningCompensationOrder(steps)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{"execute", "reserve", "prepare"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected compensation order: got %v want %v", got, want)
	}
}

func TestBuildHardeningCompensationOrderRejectsInvalidGraphs(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		steps []HardeningDependencyStep
	}{
		{
			name: "cycle",
			steps: []HardeningDependencyStep{
				{ID: "a", DependsOn: []string{"b"}},
				{ID: "b", DependsOn: []string{"a"}},
			},
		},
		{
			name: "unknown dependency",
			steps: []HardeningDependencyStep{
				{ID: "a", DependsOn: []string{"missing"}},
			},
		},
		{
			name: "duplicate ID",
			steps: []HardeningDependencyStep{
				{ID: "a"},
				{ID: "a"},
			},
		},
		{
			name: "self dependency",
			steps: []HardeningDependencyStep{
				{ID: "a", DependsOn: []string{"a"}},
			},
		},
		{
			name: "duplicate dependency",
			steps: []HardeningDependencyStep{
				{ID: "a"},
				{ID: "b", DependsOn: []string{"a", "a"}},
			},
		},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := BuildHardeningCompensationOrder(test.steps); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected invalid graph to be rejected")
			}
		})
	}
}
