// APPLICATION_PACKAGE_01_HARDENING_V1

type package01Transaction struct {
    afterCallbackError error
    calls              int
}

func (f *package01Transaction) WithinTransaction(
    ctx context.Context,
    callback func(context.Context) error,
) error {
    f.calls++

    if err := callback(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    return f.afterCallbackError
}

type package01Clock struct {
    now time.Time
}

func (f package01Clock) Now() time.Time {
    return f.now
}

type package01IDs struct{}

func (package01IDs) NewID(
    _ context.Context,
    namespace string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    return marketflow.ID(namespace + "-test-id"), nil
}

type package01Identity struct {
    verifyError    error
    authorizeError error
}

func (f package01Identity) VerifyIdentity(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
) error {
    return f.verifyError
}

func (f package01Identity) Authorize(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ string,
) error {
    return f.authorizeError
}

type package01Audit struct {
    events []marketflow.AuditEvent
    err    error
}

func (f *package01Audit) Append(
    _ context.Context,
    event marketflow.AuditEvent,
) error {
    if f.err != nil {
        return f.err
    }

    f.events = append(f.events, event)
    return nil
}

func (f *package01Audit) ListByAggregate(
    _ context.Context,
    _ string,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ int,
) ([]marketflow.AuditEvent, error) {
    return append([]marketflow.AuditEvent(nil), f.events...), nil
}

type package01OrderValidator struct {
    err   error
    calls int
}

func (f *package01OrderValidator) ValidateOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.Order,
) error {
    f.calls++
    return f.err
}

type package01Resources struct {
    reservationID marketflow.ID
    reserveError  error
    releaseError  error
    reserveCalls  int
    releaseCalls  int
}

func (f *package01Resources) ReserveForOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.Order,
    _ int64,
    _ string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    f.reserveCalls++

    if f.reserveError != nil {
        return "", f.reserveError
    }

    return f.reservationID, nil
}

func (f *package01Resources) ReleaseOrderResources(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ string,
) error {
    f.releaseCalls++
    return f.releaseError
}

type package01OrderRepository struct {
    orders     map[string]marketflow.Order
    getCalls   int
    getErrors  map[int]error
    createErr  error
    createCall int
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) GetByIdempotencyKey(
    _ context.Context,
    key string,
) (marketflow.Order, bool, error) {
    f.getCalls++

    if err := f.getErrors[f.getCalls]; err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, false, err
    }

    order, found := f.orders[key]
    return order, found, nil
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) CreateOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    order marketflow.Order,
    key string,
    _ marketflow.ID,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
    f.createCall++

    if f.createErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, f.createErr
    }

    if _, exists := f.orders[key]; exists {
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
    }

    if f.orders == nil {
        f.orders = make(map[string]marketflow.Order)
    }

    f.orders[key] = order
    return order, nil
}

func TestPackage01PlaceOrderReplaysExistingOrderWithoutReservation(t *testing.T) {
    order := package01Order()
    order.State = marketflow.OrderOpen
    order.Version = 2

    repo := &package01OrderRepository{
        orders: map[string]marketflow.Order{
            "order-idempotency-1": order,
        },
        getErrors: make(map[int]error),
    }

    resources := &package01Resources{
        reservationID: "reservation-1",
    }

    tx := &package01Transaction{}
    service := package01OrderService(tx, repo, resources)

    result, err := service.Place(
        context.Background(),
        package01PlaceCommand(package01Order()),
    )

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    if result.ID != order.ID {
        t.Fatalf("expected existing order %s, got %s", order.ID, result.ID)
    }

    if resources.reserveCalls != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("reservation must not be repeated; calls=%d", resources.reserveCalls)
    }

    if tx.calls != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("transaction must not run for a completed replay; calls=%d", tx.calls)
    }
}

}

    sell := package01OpenOrder("sell-1", marketflow.Sell, 100)

    buy.MarketID = "another-market"
    sell.MarketID = "another-market"

    book := &package01Book{
        buy:  buy,
        sell: sell,
    }

    service := &MatchingService{
        Transactions: &package01Transaction{},
        Book:         book,
        IDs:          package01IDs{},
        Clock:        package01Clock{now: package01Now()},
    }

    _, err := service.MatchNext(
        context.Background(),
        "market-1",
        "offer-1",
    )

    if !errors.Is(err, ErrRepositoryContractViolation) {
        t.Fatalf("expected repository contract violation, got %v", err)
    }

    if book.saveOrders != 0 || book.saveMatches != 0 {
        t.Fatal("invalid repository pair must not be persisted")
    }
}

func (f *package01ProgressRepository) Save(
    _ context.Context,
    progress marketflow.ExecutionProgress,
    expected uint64,

    if expected != f.revision {
        return ErrVersionConflict

    f.progress = progress

    }
}

$BackupRoot = Join-Path $ProjectRoot ".backups"

function Write-Step {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE-07-08] $Message" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-GoFile {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Path = Join-Path $PackageDir $Name
    $Utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $Utf8)
}

function Invoke-Go {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)

    & go @Arguments
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Go command failed: go $($Arguments -join ' ')"
    }
}

    throw "Run this script from the general-market-backend project root."

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) {

    }

package workflowruntime

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "time"
)

var (
    ErrNotFound          = errors.New("workflow not found")
    ErrConflict          = errors.New("workflow conflict")
    ErrInvalid           = errors.New("invalid workflow")
    ErrNotReady          = errors.New("workflow step not ready")
    ErrLeaseLost         = errors.New("workflow lease lost")
    ErrUnknownOutcome    = errors.New("operation outcome unknown")
    ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key reused with different request")
    ErrAlreadyCompleted  = errors.New("operation already completed")
    ErrUnauthorized      = errors.New("operation not authorized")
)

type WorkflowStatus string

const (
    WorkflowPending             WorkflowStatus = "PENDING"
    WorkflowRunning             WorkflowStatus = "RUNNING"
    WorkflowWaiting             WorkflowStatus = "WAITING"
    WorkflowFailed              WorkflowStatus = "FAILED"
    WorkflowCancelled           WorkflowStatus = "CANCELLED"
    WorkflowCompensating        WorkflowStatus = "COMPENSATING"
    WorkflowCompensationFailed  WorkflowStatus = "COMPENSATION_FAILED"
    WorkflowCompensated         WorkflowStatus = "COMPENSATED"
    WorkflowCompleted           WorkflowStatus = "COMPLETED"
)

type StepStatus string

const (
    StepPending              StepStatus = "PENDING"
    StepRunning              StepStatus = "RUNNING"
    StepSucceeded            StepStatus = "SUCCEEDED"
    StepFailed               StepStatus = "FAILED"
    StepUnknown              StepStatus = "UNKNOWN"
    StepCompensating         StepStatus = "COMPENSATING"
    StepCompensated          StepStatus = "COMPENSATED"
    StepCompensationUnknown  StepStatus = "COMPENSATION_UNKNOWN"
    StepCompensationFailed   StepStatus = "COMPENSATION_FAILED"
)

type StepSpec struct {
    ID                    string
    Operation             string
    CompensationOperation string
    Dependencies           []string
    Required               bool
    Timeout                time.Duration
    MaxAttempts            int
}

type Step struct {
    Spec          StepSpec
    Status        StepStatus
    Attempts      int
    LeaseToken    string
    LeaseUntil    time.Time
    LastError     string
    ExternalID    string
    ResultHash    string
    UpdatedAt     time.Time
}

type Workflow struct {
    ID          string
    Revision    uint64
    Status      WorkflowStatus
    Steps       map[string]Step
    CreatedAt   time.Time
    UpdatedAt   time.Time
    Failure     string
    CancelReason string
}

type WorkflowSnapshot struct {
    Workflow Workflow
}

type WorkflowStore interface {
    Get(context.Context, string) (WorkflowSnapshot, error)

    // Transact MUST provide an atomic read-modify-write operation.
    // It MUST enforce optimistic concurrency or equivalent serialization.
    // The callback must not perform network or external service calls.
    Transact(context.Context, string, func(*Workflow) error) error
}

type Clock interface {
    Now() time.Time
}

type IDGenerator interface {
    NewID() (string, error)
}

type StepClaim struct {
    WorkflowID string
    StepID     string
    Operation  string
    Attempt    int
    LeaseToken string
    LeaseUntil time.Time
}

type CompensationClaim struct {
    WorkflowID string
    StepID     string
    Operation  string
    Attempt    int
    LeaseToken string
    LeaseUntil time.Time
}

type StepOutcome struct {
    Success      bool
    Unknown      bool
    ExternalID   string
    ResultHash   string
    Error        string
}

type CompensationOutcome struct {
    Success    bool
    Unknown    bool
    ExternalID string
    Error      string
}

type WorkflowEngine interface {
    Create(context.Context, string, []StepSpec) error
    ClaimNext(context.Context, string, time.Duration) (*StepClaim, error)
    Finish(context.Context, StepClaim, StepOutcome) error
    BeginCompensation(context.Context, string, string) error
    ClaimCompensation(context.Context, string, time.Duration) (*CompensationClaim, error)
    FinishCompensation(context.Context, CompensationClaim, CompensationOutcome) error
    ResolveCompensation(context.Context, CompensationClaim, bool, string) error
}

type AccessGrant struct {
    ActorID   string
    ProviderID string
    Operation string
    Resource  string
    ExpiresAt time.Time
}

type AccessController interface {
    Authorize(context.Context, AccessGrant) error
}

type ProviderCapabilities struct {
    Operations           map[string]bool
    IdempotentOperations map[string]bool
    SupportsLookup       bool
    MaximumPayloadBytes  int
    RequiresSignature    bool
}

type IntegrationRequest struct {
    ProviderID      string
    Operation       string
    Resource        string
    ActorID         string
    RequestID       string
    CorrelationID   string
    IdempotencyKey  string
    Payload         []byte
    PayloadHash     string
    Deadline        time.Time
    RetrySafe       bool
    Signature       string
}

type ProviderResponse struct {
    RequestID      string
    CorrelationID  string
    ExternalID     string
    Payload        []byte
    PayloadHash    string
    Completed      bool
    Failed         bool
    Unknown        bool
}

type ProviderError struct {
    Code       string
    Message    string
    Retryable  bool
    Definitive bool
}

func (e *ProviderError) Error() string {
    if e == nil {
        return ""
    }
    return e.Code + ": " + e.Message
}

type Provider interface {
    ID() string
    Capabilities() ProviderCapabilities
    Execute(context.Context, IntegrationRequest) (ProviderResponse, error)
    Lookup(context.Context, IntegrationRequest, string) (ProviderResponse, error)
}

type ProviderRegistry interface {
    Get(string) (Provider, error)
}

type RequestSigner interface {
    Sign(context.Context, IntegrationRequest) (string, error)
}

type IdempotencyState string

const (
    IdempotencyInProgress IdempotencyState = "IN_PROGRESS"
    IdempotencyCompleted  IdempotencyState = "COMPLETED"
    IdempotencyPending    IdempotencyState = "PENDING"
    IdempotencyFailed     IdempotencyState = "FAILED"
)

type IdempotencyRecord struct {
    ProviderID     string
    Operation      string
    Key            string
    Fingerprint    string
    State          IdempotencyState
    Response       ProviderResponse
    Error          string
    UpdatedAt      time.Time
}

type BeginDisposition string

const (
    BeginNew      BeginDisposition = "NEW"
    BeginReplay   BeginDisposition = "REPLAY"
    BeginPending  BeginDisposition = "PENDING"
    BeginConflict BeginDisposition = "CONFLICT"
)

type IntegrationStore interface {
    // Begin must atomically reserve the idempotency key and compare fingerprints.
    Begin(context.Context, IdempotencyRecord) (BeginDisposition, IdempotencyRecord, error)
    Complete(context.Context, IdempotencyRecord, ProviderResponse) error
    MarkPending(context.Context, IdempotencyRecord, string) error
    MarkFailed(context.Context, IdempotencyRecord, string) error
    Get(context.Context, string, string, string) (IdempotencyRecord, error)
}

type IntegrationJournal interface {
    Append(context.Context, string, string, string, string) error
}

type IntegrationExecutor interface {
    Execute(context.Context, IntegrationRequest) (ProviderResponse, error)
    Reconcile(context.Context, IntegrationRequest) (ProviderResponse, error)
}

type RuntimeConfig struct {
    DefaultLease time.Duration
    MaxLease     time.Duration
    MaxPayload   int
}
'@

    Write-GoFile "contracts.go" $Contracts

    Write-Step "Writing transactional workflow engine"

    $Workflow = @'
package workflowruntime

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "sort"
    "time"
)

type Engine struct {
    Store WorkflowStore
    Clock Clock
    IDs   IDGenerator
}

func (e *Engine) validate() error {
    if e.Store == nil || e.Clock == nil || e.IDs == nil {
        return ErrInvalid
    }
    return nil
}

func (e *Engine) Create(ctx context.Context, id string, specs []StepSpec) error {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if id == "" || len(specs) == 0 {
        return ErrInvalid
    }

    steps := make(map[string]Step, len(specs))
    for _, spec := range specs {
        if spec.ID == "" || spec.Operation == "" || spec.MaxAttempts < 1 {
            return ErrInvalid
        }
        if _, exists := steps[spec.ID]; exists {
            return ErrInvalid
        }
        steps[spec.ID] = Step{Spec: spec, Status: StepPending}
    }

    for _, step := range steps {
        for _, dependency := range step.Spec.Dependencies {
            if _, ok := steps[dependency]; !ok || dependency == step.Spec.ID {
                return ErrInvalid
            }
        }
    }

    if hasCycle(steps) {
        return ErrInvalid
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    workflow := Workflow{
        ID: id,
        Revision: 1,
        Status: WorkflowPending,
        Steps: steps,
        CreatedAt: now,
        UpdatedAt: now,
    }

    return e.Store.Transact(ctx, id, func(current *Workflow) error {
        if current.ID != "" {
            return ErrConflict
        }
        *current = workflow
        return nil
    })
}

func hasCycle(steps map[string]Step) bool {
    visiting := map[string]bool{}
    visited := map[string]bool{}

    var visit func(string) bool
    visit = func(id string) bool {
        if visiting[id] {
            return true
        }
        if visited[id] {
            return false
        }
        visiting[id] = true
        for _, dep := range steps[id].Spec.Dependencies {
            if visit(dep) {
                return true
            }
        }
        visiting[id] = false
        visited[id] = true
        return false
    }

    for id := range steps {
        if visit(id) {
            return true
        }
    }
    return false
}

func dependenciesSucceeded(w Workflow, step Step) bool {
    for _, dep := range step.Spec.Dependencies {
        if w.Steps[dep].Status != StepSucceeded {
            return false
        }
    }
    return true
}

func (e *Engine) ClaimNext(ctx context.Context, workflowID string, lease time.Duration) (*StepClaim, error) {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    if lease <= 0 {
        return nil, ErrInvalid
    }

    var claim *StepClaim
    now := e.Clock.Now()

    err := e.Store.Transact(ctx, workflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        if w.ID == "" {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if w.Status == WorkflowFailed || w.Status == WorkflowCancelled ||
            w.Status == WorkflowCompensating || w.Status == WorkflowCompensated ||
            w.Status == WorkflowCompensationFailed || w.Status == WorkflowCompleted {
            return ErrNotReady
        }

        // An expired execution lease is an unknown outcome, never an automatic retry.
        for id, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepRunning && !step.LeaseUntil.After(now) {
                step.Status = StepUnknown
                step.LeaseToken = ""
                step.LastError = "execution lease expired; outcome requires reconciliation"
                step.UpdatedAt = now
                w.Steps[id] = step
            }
        }

        for _, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepUnknown {
                w.Status = WorkflowWaiting
                w.UpdatedAt = now
                return nil
            }
        }

        ids := make([]string, 0, len(w.Steps))
        for id := range w.Steps {
            ids = append(ids, id)
        }
        sort.Strings(ids)

        for _, id := range ids {
            step := w.Steps[id]
            if step.Status != StepPending || !dependenciesSucceeded(*w, step) {
                continue
            }

            token, err := e.IDs.NewID()
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            step.Status = StepRunning
            step.Attempts++
            step.LeaseToken = token
            step.LeaseUntil = now.Add(lease)
            step.UpdatedAt = now
            w.Steps[id] = step

            w.Status = WorkflowRunning
            w.UpdatedAt = now

            claim = &StepClaim{
                WorkflowID: workflowID,
                StepID: id,
                Operation: step.Spec.Operation,
                Attempt: step.Attempts,
                LeaseToken: token,
                LeaseUntil: step.LeaseUntil,
            }
            return nil
        }

        refreshWorkflow(w, now)
        return nil
    })

    return claim, err
}

func (e *Engine) Finish(ctx context.Context, claim StepClaim, outcome StepOutcome) error {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    return e.Store.Transact(ctx, claim.WorkflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        step, ok := w.Steps[claim.StepID]
        if !ok {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if step.Status != StepRunning || step.LeaseToken == "" ||
            step.LeaseToken != claim.LeaseToken {
            return ErrLeaseLost
        }

        step.LeaseToken = ""
        step.LeaseUntil = time.Time{}
        step.UpdatedAt = now

        switch {
        case outcome.Unknown:
            step.Status = StepUnknown
            step.LastError = outcome.Error
        case outcome.Success:
            step.Status = StepSucceeded
            step.ExternalID = outcome.ExternalID
            step.ResultHash = outcome.ResultHash
            step.LastError = ""
        default:
            step.Status = StepFailed
            step.LastError = outcome.Error
            if step.LastError == "" {
                step.LastError = "step failed"
            }
            if step.Spec.Required {
                w.Failure = step.Spec.ID + ": " + step.LastError
            }
        }

        w.Steps[claim.StepID] = step
        refreshWorkflow(w, now)
        return nil
    })
}

func refreshWorkflow(w *Workflow, now time.Time) {
    active := false
    unknown := false
    pending := false
    failedRequired := false
    allTerminal := true

    for _, step := range w.Steps {
        switch step.Status {
        case StepRunning, StepCompensating:
            active = true
            allTerminal = false
        case StepUnknown, StepCompensationUnknown:
            unknown = true
            allTerminal = false
        case StepPending:
            pending = true
            allTerminal = false
        case StepFailed:
            if step.Spec.Required {
                failedRequired = true
            }
        }
    }

    if failedRequired || w.Failure != "" {
        w.Status = WorkflowFailed
    } else if unknown || active {
        w.Status = WorkflowWaiting
    } else if pending {
        w.Status = WorkflowPending
    } else if allTerminal {
        w.Status = WorkflowCompleted
    }

    w.UpdatedAt = now
}

func (e *Engine) BeginCompensation(ctx context.Context, workflowID, reason string) error {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if reason == "" {
        return ErrInvalid
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    return e.Store.Transact(ctx, workflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        if w.ID == "" {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if w.Status != WorkflowFailed && w.Status != WorkflowCancelled {
            return ErrNotReady
        }

        for _, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepRunning || step.Status == StepUnknown ||
                step.Status == StepCompensating || step.Status == StepCompensationUnknown {
                return ErrUnknownOutcome
            }
        }

        for id, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepSucceeded && step.Spec.CompensationOperation == "" {
                step.Status = StepCompensated
                step.UpdatedAt = now
                w.Steps[id] = step
            }
        }

        w.CancelReason = reason
        w.Status = WorkflowCompensating
        w.UpdatedAt = now
        return nil
    })
}

func hasUncompensatedDependent(w Workflow, stepID string) bool {
    for _, other := range w.Steps {
        if other.Status != StepSucceeded {
            continue
        }
        for _, dependency := range other.Spec.Dependencies {
            if dependency == stepID {
                return true
            }
        }
    }
    return false
}

func (e *Engine) ClaimCompensation(ctx context.Context, workflowID string, lease time.Duration) (*CompensationClaim, error) {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    if lease <= 0 {
        return nil, ErrInvalid
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    var claim *CompensationClaim

    err := e.Store.Transact(ctx, workflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        if w.ID == "" {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
            return ErrNotReady
        }

        for id, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepCompensating && !step.LeaseUntil.After(now) {
                step.Status = StepCompensationUnknown
                step.LeaseToken = ""
                step.LastError = "compensation lease expired; reconciliation required"
                step.UpdatedAt = now
                w.Steps[id] = step
            }
            if step.Status == StepCompensationUnknown {
                return ErrUnknownOutcome
            }
            if step.Status == StepCompensationFailed {
                w.Status = WorkflowCompensationFailed
                return nil
            }
        }

        ids := make([]string, 0, len(w.Steps))
        for id := range w.Steps {
            ids = append(ids, id)
        }
        sort.Strings(ids)

        for _, id := range ids {
            step := w.Steps[id]
            if step.Status != StepSucceeded || step.Spec.CompensationOperation == "" {
                continue
            }
            if hasUncompensatedDependent(*w, id) {
                continue
            }

            token, err := e.IDs.NewID()
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            step.Status = StepCompensating
            step.LeaseToken = token
            step.LeaseUntil = now.Add(lease)
            step.Attempts++
            step.UpdatedAt = now
            w.Steps[id] = step

            claim = &CompensationClaim{
                WorkflowID: workflowID,
                StepID: id,
                Operation: step.Spec.CompensationOperation,
                Attempt: step.Attempts,
                LeaseToken: token,
                LeaseUntil: step.LeaseUntil,
            }
            w.UpdatedAt = now
            return nil
        }

        for _, step := range w.Steps {
            if step.Status == StepSucceeded || step.Status == StepCompensating ||
                step.Status == StepCompensationUnknown {
                return ErrNotReady
            }
        }

        w.Status = WorkflowCompensated
        w.UpdatedAt = now
        return nil
    })

    return claim, err
}

func (e *Engine) FinishCompensation(ctx context.Context, claim CompensationClaim, outcome CompensationOutcome) error {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    return e.Store.Transact(ctx, claim.WorkflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        step, ok := w.Steps[claim.StepID]
        if !ok {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if step.Status != StepCompensating || step.LeaseToken != claim.LeaseToken {
            return ErrLeaseLost
        }

        step.LeaseToken = ""
        step.LeaseUntil = time.Time{}
        step.UpdatedAt = now

        switch {
        case outcome.Unknown:
            step.Status = StepCompensationUnknown
            step.LastError = outcome.Error
        case outcome.Success:
            step.Status = StepCompensated
            step.ExternalID = outcome.ExternalID
            step.LastError = ""
        default:
            step.Status = StepCompensationFailed
            step.LastError = outcome.Error
            if step.LastError == "" {
                step.LastError = "compensation failed"
            }
            w.Status = WorkflowCompensationFailed
        }

        w.Steps[claim.StepID] = step
        w.UpdatedAt = now
        return nil
    })
}

// ResolveCompensation is called only after an authoritative provider lookup.
// It does not repeat the external operation.
func (e *Engine) ResolveCompensation(ctx context.Context, claim CompensationClaim, succeeded bool, externalID string) error {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    now := e.Clock.Now()
    return e.Store.Transact(ctx, claim.WorkflowID, func(w *Workflow) error {
        step, ok := w.Steps[claim.StepID]
        if !ok {
            return ErrNotFound
        }
        if step.Status != StepCompensationUnknown {
            return ErrNotReady
        }

        if succeeded {
            step.Status = StepCompensated
            step.ExternalID = externalID
            step.LastError = ""
        } else {
            step.Status = StepCompensationFailed
            step.LastError = "provider confirmed compensation did not complete"
            w.Status = WorkflowCompensationFailed
        }

        step.UpdatedAt = now
        w.Steps[claim.StepID] = step
        w.UpdatedAt = now
        return nil
    })
}

func ValidateWorkflow(w Workflow) error {
    if w.ID == "" || len(w.Steps) == 0 {
        return ErrInvalid
    }
    if hasCycle(w.Steps) {
        return ErrInvalid
    }

    for id, step := range w.Steps {
        if id == "" || step.Spec.ID != id || step.Spec.Operation == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid step %q", ErrInvalid, id)
        }
        switch step.Status {
        case StepPending, StepRunning, StepSucceeded, StepFailed, StepUnknown,
            StepCompensating, StepCompensated, StepCompensationUnknown, StepCompensationFailed:
        default:
            return ErrInvalid
        }
        if step.Status == StepRunning || step.Status == StepCompensating {
            if step.LeaseToken == "" || step.LeaseUntil.IsZero() {
                return ErrInvalid
            }
        }
    }
    return nil
}

var _ WorkflowEngine = (*Engine)(nil)
var _ = errors.Is
'@

    Write-GoFile "workflow.go" $Workflow

    Write-Step "Writing integration executor and recovery contracts"

    $Integration = @'
package workflowruntime

import (
    "context"
    "crypto/sha256"
    "encoding/hex"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "time"
)

type Executor struct {
    Access    AccessController
    Providers ProviderRegistry
    Signer    RequestSigner
    Store     IntegrationStore
    Journal   IntegrationJournal
    Clock     Clock
    Config    RuntimeConfig
}

func (e *Executor) validate() error {
    if e.Access == nil || e.Providers == nil || e.Store == nil || e.Clock == nil {
        return ErrInvalid
    }
    return nil
}

func Fingerprint(payload []byte) string {
    sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
    return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (e *Executor) Execute(ctx context.Context, request IntegrationRequest) (ProviderResponse, error) {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }

    if request.ProviderID == "" || request.Operation == "" ||
        request.ActorID == "" || request.RequestID == "" ||
        request.CorrelationID == "" || request.IdempotencyKey == "" {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
    }

    if !request.Deadline.IsZero() && !e.Clock.Now().Before(request.Deadline) {
        return ProviderResponse{}, context.DeadlineExceeded
    }

    if request.PayloadHash == "" {
        request.PayloadHash = Fingerprint(request.Payload)
    } else if request.PayloadHash != Fingerprint(request.Payload) {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
    }

    if e.Config.MaxPayload > 0 && len(request.Payload) > e.Config.MaxPayload {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
    }

    grant := AccessGrant{
        ActorID: request.ActorID,
        ProviderID: request.ProviderID,
        Operation: request.Operation,
        Resource: request.Resource,
        ExpiresAt: request.Deadline,
    }

    if err := e.Access.Authorize(ctx, grant); err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrUnauthorized, err)
    }

    provider, err := e.Providers.Get(request.ProviderID)
    if err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }

    capabilities := provider.Capabilities()
    if !capabilities.Operations[request.Operation] {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnauthorized
    }
    if capabilities.MaximumPayloadBytes > 0 &&
        len(request.Payload) > capabilities.MaximumPayloadBytes {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
    }

    record := IdempotencyRecord{
        ProviderID: request.ProviderID,
        Operation: request.Operation,
        Key: request.IdempotencyKey,
        Fingerprint: request.PayloadHash,
        State: IdempotencyInProgress,
        UpdatedAt: e.Clock.Now(),
    }

    disposition, existing, err := e.Store.Begin(ctx, record)
    if err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }

    switch disposition {
    case BeginReplay:
        if existing.Fingerprint != record.Fingerprint {
            return ProviderResponse{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
        }
        if existing.State == IdempotencyCompleted {
            return existing.Response, nil
        }
        if existing.State == IdempotencyPending ||
            existing.State == IdempotencyInProgress {
            return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
        }
        return ProviderResponse{}, errors.New(existing.Error)

    case BeginPending:
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome

    case BeginConflict:
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict

    case BeginNew:
    default:
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
    }

    if capabilities.RequiresSignature {
        if e.Signer == nil {
            _ = e.Store.MarkFailed(ctx, record, "signature provider unavailable")
            return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalid
        }
        signature, signErr := e.Signer.Sign(ctx, request)
        if signErr != nil {
            _ = e.Store.MarkFailed(ctx, record, "request signing failed")
            return ProviderResponse{}, signErr
        }
        request.Signature = signature
    }

    response, callErr := provider.Execute(ctx, request)

    if callErr != nil {
        var providerErr *ProviderError
        if errors.As(callErr, &providerErr) &&
            providerErr.Definitive && !providerErr.Retryable {
            if markErr := e.Store.MarkFailed(ctx, record, callErr.Error()); markErr != nil {
                return ProviderResponse{}, errors.Join(callErr, markErr)
            }
            return ProviderResponse{}, callErr
        }

        if markErr := e.Store.MarkPending(ctx, record, callErr.Error()); markErr != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, errors.Join(ErrUnknownOutcome, callErr, markErr)
        }
        e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "PENDING", callErr.Error())
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.RequestID != request.RequestID ||
        response.CorrelationID != request.CorrelationID {
        markErr := e.Store.MarkPending(ctx, record, "provider response identity mismatch")
        e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "PENDING", "provider response identity mismatch")
        if markErr != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, errors.Join(ErrUnknownOutcome, markErr)
        }
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.Unknown || (!response.Completed && !response.Failed) {
        if markErr := e.Store.MarkPending(ctx, record, "provider reported pending outcome"); markErr != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, errors.Join(ErrUnknownOutcome, markErr)
        }
        e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "PENDING", "provider reported pending outcome")
        return response, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.Failed {
        if err := e.Store.MarkFailed(ctx, record, "provider confirmed failure"); err != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, err
        }
        e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "FAILED", "provider confirmed failure")
        return response, errors.New("provider confirmed operation failure")
    }

    if err := e.Store.Complete(ctx, record, response); err != nil {
        // A successful provider response with a failed local commit is ambiguous.
        pendingErr := e.Store.MarkPending(ctx, record, "provider succeeded but local completion persistence failed")
        e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "PENDING", "local completion persistence failed")
        if pendingErr != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, errors.Join(ErrUnknownOutcome, err, pendingErr)
        }
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "COMPLETED", response.ExternalID)
    return response, nil
}

func (e *Executor) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, request IntegrationRequest) (ProviderResponse, error) {
    if err := e.validate(); err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }

    provider, err := e.Providers.Get(request.ProviderID)
    if err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }
    if !provider.Capabilities().SupportsLookup {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrNotReady
    }

    record, err := e.Store.Get(ctx, request.ProviderID, request.Operation, request.IdempotencyKey)
    if err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, err
    }
    if record.Fingerprint != request.PayloadHash {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
    }
    if record.State == IdempotencyCompleted {
        return record.Response, nil
    }
    if record.State != IdempotencyPending && record.State != IdempotencyInProgress {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrNotReady
    }

    response, err := provider.Lookup(ctx, request, "")
    if err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.RequestID != request.RequestID ||
        response.CorrelationID != request.CorrelationID {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.Unknown || (!response.Completed && !response.Failed) {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }

    if response.Failed {
        if err := e.Store.MarkFailed(ctx, record, "provider lookup confirmed failure"); err != nil {
            return ProviderResponse{}, err
        }
        return response, errors.New("provider lookup confirmed failure")
    }

    if err := e.Store.Complete(ctx, record, response); err != nil {
        return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnknownOutcome
    }
    e.appendJournal(ctx, request, "RECONCILED", response.ExternalID)
    return response, nil
}

func (e *Executor) appendJournal(ctx context.Context, request IntegrationRequest, event, detail string) {
    if e.Journal != nil {
        _ = e.Journal.Append(ctx, request.ProviderID, request.RequestID, event, detail)
    }
}

var _ IntegrationExecutor = (*Executor)(nil)

type testClock struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    now time.Time
}
func (c *testClock) Now() time.Time {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    return c.now
}

type testIDs struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    n int
}
func (g *testIDs) NewID() (string, error) {
    g.mu.Lock()
    defer g.mu.Unlock()
    g.n++
    return "lease-" + string(rune('a'+g.n)), nil
}

type memoryStore struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    items map[string]Workflow
}
func newMemoryStore() *memoryStore {
    return &memoryStore{items: map[string]Workflow{}}
}
func cloneWorkflow(w Workflow) Workflow {
    cp := w
    cp.Steps = make(map[string]Step, len(w.Steps))
    for k, v := range w.Steps {
        v.Spec.Dependencies = append([]string(nil), v.Spec.Dependencies...)
        cp.Steps[k] = v
    }
    return cp
}
func (s *memoryStore) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (WorkflowSnapshot, error) {
    s.mu.Lock()
    defer s.mu.Unlock()
    w, ok := s.items[id]
    if !ok { return WorkflowSnapshot{}, ErrNotFound }
    return WorkflowSnapshot{Workflow: cloneWorkflow(w)}, nil
}
func (s *memoryStore) Transact(_ context.Context, id string, fn func(*Workflow) error) error {
    s.mu.Lock()
    defer s.mu.Unlock()
    current := cloneWorkflow(s.items[id])
    if err := fn(&current); err != nil { return err }
    if current.ID != "" {
        if err := ValidateWorkflow(current); err != nil { return err }
        current.Revision++
        s.items[id] = cloneWorkflow(current)
    }
    return nil
}

func TestWorkflowDependenciesAndCompletion(t *testing.T) {
    x := newTestEngine()
    ctx := context.Background()
    specs := []StepSpec{
        {ID:"a", Operation:"A", Required:true, MaxAttempts:2},
        {ID:"b", Operation:"B", Dependencies:[]string{"a"}, Required:true, MaxAttempts:2},
    }
    if err := x.engine.Create(ctx, "w1", specs); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    first, err := x.engine.ClaimNext(ctx, "w1", time.Minute)
    if err != nil || first == nil || first.StepID != "a" { t.Fatalf("first claim: %#v %v", first, err) }

    if err := x.engine.Finish(ctx, *first, StepOutcome{Success:true}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    second, err := x.engine.ClaimNext(ctx, "w1", time.Minute)
    if err != nil || second == nil || second.StepID != "b" { t.Fatalf("second claim: %#v %v", second, err) }

    if err := x.engine.Finish(ctx, *second, StepOutcome{Success:true}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    snap, err := x.engine.Store.Get(ctx, "w1")
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if snap.Workflow.Status != WorkflowCompleted { t.Fatalf("status = %s", snap.Workflow.Status) }
}

func TestCompensationReverseDependencyOrder(t *testing.T) {
    x := newTestEngine()
    ctx := context.Background()
    specs := []StepSpec{
        {ID:"a", Operation:"A", CompensationOperation:"UndoA", Required:true, MaxAttempts:2},
        {ID:"b", Operation:"B", CompensationOperation:"UndoB", Dependencies:[]string{"a"}, Required:true, MaxAttempts:2},
        {ID:"c", Operation:"C", Dependencies:[]string{"b"}, Required:true, MaxAttempts:2},
    }
    if err := x.engine.Create(ctx, "w3", specs); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    for _, expected := range []string{"a","b","c"} {
        claim, err := x.engine.ClaimNext(ctx, "w3", time.Minute)
        if err != nil || claim == nil || claim.StepID != expected { t.Fatalf("claim %s: %#v %v", expected, claim, err) }
        success := expected != "c"
        if err := x.engine.Finish(ctx, *claim, StepOutcome{Success:success, Error:"deliberate failure"}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    }

    if err := x.engine.BeginCompensation(ctx, "w3", "required step failed"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    comp, err := x.engine.ClaimCompensation(ctx, "w3", time.Minute)
    if err != nil || comp == nil || comp.StepID != "b" { t.Fatalf("expected b first: %#v %v", comp, err) }

    if err := x.engine.FinishCompensation(ctx, *comp, CompensationOutcome{Success:true}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    comp, err = x.engine.ClaimCompensation(ctx, "w3", time.Minute)
    if err != nil || comp == nil || comp.StepID != "a" { t.Fatalf("expected a second: %#v %v", comp, err) }

    if err := x.engine.FinishCompensation(ctx, *comp, CompensationOutcome{Success:true}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

    comp, err = x.engine.ClaimCompensation(ctx, "w3", time.Minute)
    if err != nil || comp != nil { t.Fatalf("expected no remaining compensation: %#v %v", comp, err) }

    snap, _ := x.engine.Store.Get(ctx, "w3")
    if snap.Workflow.Status != WorkflowCompensated { t.Fatalf("status = %s", snap.Workflow.Status) }
}

$CreatedFiles = @()

function Write-GoFile {
    param(
        [string]$RelativePath,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $Root $RelativePath
    $Parent = Split-Path -Parent $FullPath

    if (-not (Test-Path $Parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Parent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    if (Test-Path $FullPath) {
        throw "Refusing to overwrite existing file: $RelativePath"
    }

    $Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($FullPath, $Content, $Encoding)

    $CreatedFiles += $FullPath
    Write-Host "Created: $RelativePath" -ForegroundColor Green
}

package application

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "math"
    "strings"
    "time"

    cataloguedomain "github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/catalogue/domain"

var (
    ErrDependencyMissing = errors.New("application dependency missing")
    ErrVersionConflict = errors.New("application version conflict")
    ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
    ErrNoCrossingOrders = errors.New("no crossing orders")
    ErrNotSettlementReady = errors.New("trade is not ready for settlement")
    ErrInvalidPolicyGraph = errors.New("invalid execution policy dependency graph")
    ErrInvalidTradeDimension = errors.New("invalid trade status dimension")
)

type MarketCatalogueGuard struct {
    Markets   MarketReader
    Categories CategoryReader
    Mappings  CategoryMappingReader
}

func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(ctx context.Context, offer marketflow.Offer) error {
    if g.Markets == nil || g.Categories == nil || g.Mappings == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    market, err := g.Markets.GetMarket(ctx, marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID))
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if market == nil || !market.IsOperational() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    publicCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    specializedCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if publicCategory == nil ||
        specializedCategory == nil ||
        !publicCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        !specializedCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        publicCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindGeneral ||
        specializedCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindSpecialized {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    mapping, err := g.Mappings.GetMapping(
        ctx,
        marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if mapping == nil || !mapping.IsUsable() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    return nil
}

type OfferReadiness interface {
    ValidateOffer(context.Context, marketflow.Offer) error
}

type CompositeOfferReadiness struct {
    Catalogue MarketCatalogueGuard
    Business  OfferBusinessValidator
}

func (v CompositeOfferReadiness) ValidateOffer(
    ctx context.Context,
    offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
    if v.Business == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if err := v.Catalogue.ValidateOffer(ctx, offer); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    return v.Business.ValidateConfigurationAndEligibility(ctx, offer)
}

type OfferCommand struct {
    ActorID         marketflow.ID
    OfferID         marketflow.ID
    ExpectedVersion uint64
    CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type OfferLifecycleService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Offers       marketflow.OfferRepository
    Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
    Readiness    OfferReadiness
    Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
    IDs          IDGenerator
    Clock        Clock
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) SubmitForReview(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.submit", "submit_for_review")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Approve(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.approve", "approve")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Publish(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.publish", "publish")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd OfferCommand,
    permission string,
    action string,
) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Offers == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil || s.Readiness == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil || s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.OfferID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }
    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, permission); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.Offer

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        offer, err := s.Offers.GetOffer(txctx, cmd.OfferID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if offer.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
            return ErrVersionConflict
        }

        previousVersion := offer.Version
        now := s.Clock.Now().UTC()

        switch action {
        case "submit_for_review":
            if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                return err
            }
            err = offer.SubmitForReview(now)
        case "approve":
            err = offer.Approve(now)
        case "publish":
            if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                return err
            }
            err = offer.Publish(now)
        default:
            return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        if err := s.Offers.SaveOffer(txctx, offer, previousVersion); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
            ID:              eventID,
            AggregateType:   "offer",
            AggregateID:     offer.ID,
            Action:          action,
            ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
            CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
            PreviousVersion: previousVersion,
            NewVersion:      offer.Version,
            OccurredAt:      now,
        }
        if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        result = offer
        return nil
    })

    return result, err
}

// Supply request selection.

type SelectProposalCommand struct {
    ActorID         marketflow.ID
    RequestID       marketflow.ID
    ProposalID      marketflow.ID
    ExpectedVersion uint64
    CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type SupplyRequestService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Requests     SupplyRequestCommandRepository
    Proposals    ProposalCommandRepository
    Validator    ProposalValidator
    Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
    Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
    IDs          IDGenerator
    Clock        Clock
}

func (s *SupplyRequestService) SelectProposal(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd SelectProposalCommand,
) (marketflow.SupplyRequest, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Requests == nil ||
        s.Proposals == nil || s.Validator == nil || s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil || s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.RequestID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ProposalID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }
    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, "supply_requests.select_proposal"); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.SupplyRequest

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        request, requestRevision, err := s.Requests.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.RequestID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if requestRevision != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
            return ErrVersionConflict
        }

        proposal, proposalRevision, err := s.Proposals.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.ProposalID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        if err := s.Validator.ValidateProposal(txctx, request, proposal); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if err := marketflow.SelectProposal(&request, proposal); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        proposal.State = marketflow.ProposalAccepted

        if err := s.Proposals.Save(txctx, proposal, proposalRevision); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if err := s.Requests.Save(txctx, request, requestRevision); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, marketflow.AuditEvent{
            ID:              eventID,
            AggregateType:   "supply_request",
            AggregateID:     request.ID,
            Action:          "proposal_selected",
            ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
            CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
            PreviousVersion: requestRevision,
            NewVersion:      requestRevision + 1,
            OccurredAt:      s.Clock.Now().UTC(),
            Metadata: map[string]string{
                "proposal_id": string(proposal.ID),
            },
        }); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        result = request
        return nil
    })

    return result, err
}

// Order admission and resource reservation.

type PlaceOrderCommand struct {
    ActorID        marketflow.ID
    Order          marketflow.Order
    IdempotencyKey string
    CorrelationID  marketflow.ID
}

type OrderAdmissionService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Orders       OrderCommandRepository
    Validator    OrderAdmissionValidator
    Resources    OrderResourceGateway
    Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
    Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
    IDs          IDGenerator
    Clock        Clock
}

func CalculateOrderNotional(order marketflow.Order) (int64, error) {
    if order.Side != marketflow.Buy {
        return 0, nil
    }
    if order.Price <= 0 || order.Quantity <= 0 {
        return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }
    if order.Price > math.MaxInt64/order.Quantity {
        return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return order.Price * order.Quantity, nil
}

func sameOrderIntent(a, b marketflow.Order) bool {
    return a.ID == b.ID &&
        a.OfferID == b.OfferID &&
        a.MarketID == b.MarketID &&
        a.UserID == b.UserID &&
        a.Side == b.Side &&
        a.Price == b.Price &&
        a.Quantity == b.Quantity &&
        a.CreatedAt.Equal(b.CreatedAt)
}

func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd PlaceOrderCommand,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Orders == nil ||
        s.Validator == nil || s.Resources == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil || s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    key := strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey)
    if key == "" || len(key) > 200 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    order := cmd.Order
    if err := order.Validate(); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }
    if order.UserID != cmd.ActorID || order.State != marketflow.OrderPending {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }
    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, "orders.place"); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }
    if err := s.Validator.ValidateOrder(ctx, order); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    // Fast idempotency check avoids repeating an external reservation.
    existing, found, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }
    if found {
        if !sameOrderIntent(existing, order) {
            return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
        }
        return existing, nil
    }

    notional, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    reservationID, err := s.Resources.ReserveForOrder(ctx, order, notional, key)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(reservationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result marketflow.Order
    replayed := false

    txErr := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        current, exists, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(txctx, key)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if exists {
            if !sameOrderIntent(current, order) {
                return ErrIdempotencyConflict
            }
            replayed = true
            result = current
            return nil
        }

        orderToSave := order
        if err := orderToSave.Open(); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        created, err := s.Orders.CreateOrder(
            txctx,
            orderToSave,
            key,
            reservationID,
        )
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, marketflow.AuditEvent{
            ID:              eventID,
            AggregateType:   "order",
            AggregateID:     created.ID,
            Action:          "placed",
            ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
            CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
            PreviousVersion: order.Version,
            NewVersion:      created.Version,
            OccurredAt:      s.Clock.Now().UTC(),
            Metadata: map[string]string{
                "reservation_id": string(reservationID),
                "idempotency_key": key,
            },
        }); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        result = created
        return nil
    })

    if txErr != nil && !replayed {
        releaseErr := s.Resources.ReleaseOrderResources(
            ctx,
            reservationID,
            key,
        )
        if releaseErr != nil {
            return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
                txErr,
                fmt.Errorf("reservation compensation failed: %w", releaseErr),
            )
        }
        return marketflow.Order{}, txErr
    }

    return result, txErr
}

// Matching is performed only inside a transaction that locks both orders.
// MatchOrders mutates local copies; those copies are persisted atomically here.

type MatchingService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Book         OrderBookCommandRepository
    IDs          IDGenerator
    Clock        Clock
}

func (s *MatchingService) MatchNext(
    ctx context.Context,
    marketID marketflow.ID,
    offerID marketflow.ID,
) (MatchRecord, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Book == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(marketID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(offerID)) == "" {
        return MatchRecord{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result MatchRecord

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        buy, sell, err := s.Book.LockBestCrossingPair(txctx, marketID, offerID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        originalBuyVersion := buy.Version
        originalSellVersion := sell.Version

        match, err := marketflow.MatchOrders(&buy, &sell)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        matchID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "match")
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }

        now := s.Clock.Now().UTC()

        record := MatchRecord{
            ID:          matchID,
            MarketID:    buy.MarketID,
            OfferID:     buy.OfferID,
            BuyOrderID:  match.BuyOrderID,
            SellOrderID: match.SellOrderID,
            BuyerID:     buy.UserID,
            SellerID:    sell.UserID,
            Quantity:    match.Quantity,
            Price:       match.Price,
            CreatedAt:   now,
        }

        if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(txctx, buy, originalBuyVersion); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(txctx, sell, originalSellVersion); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if err := s.Book.SaveMatch(txctx, record, "match:"+string(matchID)); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        result = record
        return nil
    })

    if errors.Is(err, ErrNoCrossingOrders) {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrNoCrossingOrders
    }
    return result, err
}

// Trade state dimensions are updated independently.
// An external contract/service/delivery response must be verified before
// the corresponding status update is submitted.

type TradeDimension string

const (
    DimensionContract TradeDimension = "contract"
    DimensionServices TradeDimension = "services"
    DimensionDelivery TradeDimension = "delivery"
)

type TradeStatusCommand struct {
    TradeID         marketflow.ID
    ExpectedVersion uint64
    Dimension       TradeDimension
    Value           string
}

type TradeWorkflowService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Trades       TradeCommandRepository
    Clock        Clock
}

func (s *TradeWorkflowService) UpdateStatus(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd TradeStatusCommand,
) (marketflow.Trade, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Trades == nil || s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result marketflow.Trade

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        trade, err := s.Trades.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.TradeID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if trade.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
            return ErrVersionConflict
        }

        switch cmd.Dimension {
        case DimensionContract:
            value := marketflow.ContractState(cmd.Value)
            switch value {
            case marketflow.ContractPending,
                marketflow.ContractCreated,
                marketflow.ContractFailed,
                marketflow.ContractNotRequired:
                trade.Contract = value
            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

        case DimensionServices:
            value := marketflow.ServiceState(cmd.Value)
            switch value {
            case marketflow.ServicePending,
                marketflow.ServiceInProgress,
                marketflow.ServiceCompleted,
                marketflow.ServiceFailed,
                marketflow.ServiceNotRequired:
                trade.Services = value
            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

        case DimensionDelivery:
            value := marketflow.DeliveryState(cmd.Value)
            switch value {
            case marketflow.DeliveryPending,
                marketflow.DeliveryConfirmed,
                marketflow.DeliveryFailed,
                marketflow.DeliveryNotRequired:
                trade.Delivery = value
            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

        default:
            return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
        }

        trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
        trade.Version++
        trade.UpdatedAt = s.Clock.Now().UTC()

        if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if err := s.Trades.Save(txctx, trade, cmd.ExpectedVersion); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        result = trade
        return nil
    })

    return result, err
}

func RequireSettlementReadiness(trade marketflow.Trade) error {
    if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
    if trade.SettlementReadiness != marketflow.SettlementReady {
        return ErrNotSettlementReady
    }
    return nil
}

// Execution policy validation includes cycle detection and ordering checks.

func ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy) error {
    if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    steps := make(map[string]marketflow.ExecutionStep, len(policy.Steps))
    orders := make(map[int]bool, len(policy.Steps))

    for _, step := range policy.Steps {
        if orders[step.Order] {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }
        orders[step.Order] = true
        steps[step.Code] = step
    }

    state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))

    var visit func(string) error
    visit = func(code string) error {
        switch state[code] {
        case 1:
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        case 2:
            return nil
        }

        step, exists := steps[code]
        if !exists {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        state[code] = 1

        for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
            dependencyStep, exists := steps[dependency]
            if !exists || dependencyStep.Order >= step.Order {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }
            if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }

        state[code] = 2
        return nil
    }

    for code := range steps {
        if err := visit(code); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }

    return nil
}

type CompleteExecutionStepCommand struct {
    TradeID         marketflow.ID
    StepCode        string
    ExpectedRevision uint64
}

type ExecutionProgressService struct {
    Transactions TransactionManager
    Progress     ExecutionProgressCommandRepository
}

func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(
    ctx context.Context,
    policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy,
    cmd CompleteExecutionStepCommand,
) error {
    if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Progress == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(cmd.StepCode) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedRevision == 0 {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }
    if !policy.Active {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }
    if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    return s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
        progress, revision, err := s.Progress.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.TradeID)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
        if revision != cmd.ExpectedRevision {
            return ErrVersionConflict
        }

        if progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] {
            return nil
        }
        if err := progress.CanComplete(policy, cmd.StepCode); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        if progress.CompletedSteps == nil {
            progress.CompletedSteps = make(map[string]bool)
        }
        progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] = true

        return s.Progress.Save(txctx, progress, revision)
    })
}

// Overflow-safe aggregation. The source marketflow function remains unchanged
// for backward compatibility; application use cases should call this function.

func AggregateCommoditySafe(
    id marketflow.ID,
    lots []marketflow.CommodityLot,
    minimumQuantity int64,
    now time.Time,
) (marketflow.CommodityAggregation, error) {
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" ||
        len(lots) == 0 ||
        minimumQuantity <= 0 ||
        now.IsZero() {
        return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    first := lots[0]
    if strings.TrimSpace(first.CommodityCode) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(first.Unit) == "" {
        return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    result := marketflow.CommodityAggregation{
        ID:            id,
        CommodityCode: first.CommodityCode,
        Unit:          first.Unit,
        CreatedAt:     now.UTC(),
    }

    seen := make(map[marketflow.ID]struct{}, len(lots))

    for _, lot := range lots {
        if strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.ID)) == "" ||
            strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.OfferID)) == "" ||
            lot.Quantity <= 0 ||
            lot.CommodityCode != first.CommodityCode ||
            lot.Unit != first.Unit ||
            !lot.Verified ||
            !lot.AggregationAllowed {
            return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
        }

        if _, exists := seen[lot.ID]; exists {
            return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrConflict
        }
        seen[lot.ID] = struct{}{}

        if lot.Quantity > math.MaxInt64-result.TotalQuantity {
            return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        result.TotalQuantity += lot.Quantity
        result.LotIDs = append(result.LotIDs, lot.ID)
    }

    if result.TotalQuantity < minimumQuantity {
        return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    return result, nil
}

// External legal requests require identity, permission and explicit scopes.
// The concrete LegalGateway adapter must enforce idempotency at the provider boundary.

type LegalRequestService struct {
    Identity marketflow.IdentityGateway
    Gateway  LegalGateway
}

func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(
    ctx context.Context,
    actorID marketflow.ID,
    request marketflow.ExternalRequest,
    grantedScopes []string,
) (string, error) {
    if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }
    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, actorID, "legal.external.submit"); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }
    if err := request.ValidateAuthorization(grantedScopes); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    return s.Gateway.SubmitAuthorizedRequest(ctx, request)
}

// Platform position is deliberately independent from legal registration.

func RecordPlatformPosition(
    workflow *marketflow.PropertyWorkflow,
    confirmedTradeID marketflow.ID,
    now time.Time,
) error {
    if workflow == nil {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    legalStateBefore := workflow.LegalRegistration

    if err := workflow.RecordPlatformPosition(confirmedTradeID, now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if workflow.LegalRegistration != legalStateBefore {
        return fmt.Errorf("%w: platform position changed legal state", marketflow.ErrPolicyViolation)
    }

    return nil
}

package application

func TestValidateExecutionPolicyAcceptsOrderedDependencies(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{
        ID:              "policy-1",
        Name:            "Physical delivery",
        Version:         1,
        OfferCategoryID: "category-1",
        Active:          true,
        CreatedAt:       now,
        Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
            {
                Code:        "contract",
                Order:       1,
                Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
            },
            {
                Code:        "delivery",
                Order:       2,
                Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
                DependsOn:   []string{"contract"},
            },
            {
                Code:        "settlement",
                Order:       3,
                Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
                DependsOn:   []string{"delivery"},
            },
        },
    }

    if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("expected valid policy, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestValidateExecutionPolicyRejectsCycle(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{
        ID:              "policy-2",
        Name:            "Invalid cycle",
        Version:         1,
        OfferCategoryID: "category-1",
        Active:          true,
        CreatedAt:       now,
        Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
            {
                Code:        "a",
                Order:       1,
                Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
                DependsOn:   []string{"b"},
            },
            {
                Code:        "b",
                Order:       2,
                Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
                DependsOn:   []string{"a"},
            },
        },
    }

    if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPolicyGraph) {
        t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidPolicyGraph, got %v", err)
    }
}

    policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{

        Version:         1,

        CreatedAt:       now,
        Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
            {Code: "a", Order: 1, Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired},
            {Code: "b", Order: 1, Requirement: marketflow.StepOptional},

    }

func TestAggregateCommoditySafe(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    result, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
        "aggregation-1",
        []marketflow.CommodityLot{
            {
                ID:                 "lot-1",
                OfferID:            "offer-1",
                CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
                Quantity:           100,
                Unit:               "kg",
                Verified:           true,
                AggregationAllowed: true,
            },
            {
                ID:                 "lot-2",
                OfferID:            "offer-2",
                CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
                Quantity:           200,
                Unit:               "kg",
                Verified:           true,
                AggregationAllowed: true,
            },
        },
        250,
        now,
    )

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected aggregation error: %v", err)
    }
    if result.TotalQuantity != 300 {
        t.Fatalf("expected total 300, got %d", result.TotalQuantity)
    }
    if len(result.LotIDs) != 2 {
        t.Fatalf("expected 2 lots, got %d", len(result.LotIDs))
    }
}

func TestAggregateCommodityRejectsOverflow(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    _, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
        "aggregation-2",
        []marketflow.CommodityLot{
            {
                ID:                 "lot-1",
                OfferID:            "offer-1",
                CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
                Quantity:           math.MaxInt64,
                Unit:               "kg",
                Verified:           true,
                AggregationAllowed: true,
            },
            {
                ID:                 "lot-2",
                OfferID:            "offer-2",
                CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
                Quantity:           1,
                Unit:               "kg",
                Verified:           true,
                AggregationAllowed: true,
            },
        },
        1,
        now,
    )

    if err == nil {
        t.Fatal("expected overflow rejection")
    }
}

func TestAggregateCommodityRejectsDuplicateLot(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    lot := marketflow.CommodityLot{
        ID:                 "lot-1",
        OfferID:            "offer-1",
        CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
        Quantity:           100,
        Unit:               "kg",
        Verified:           true,
        AggregationAllowed: true,
    }

    _, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
        "aggregation-3",
        []marketflow.CommodityLot{lot, lot},
        1,
        now,
    )

    if !errors.Is(err, marketflow.ErrConflict) {
        t.Fatalf("expected conflict, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestCalculateOrderNotional(t *testing.T) {
    order := marketflow.Order{
        Side:     marketflow.Buy,
        Price:    250,
        Quantity: 4,
    }

    amount, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if amount != 1000 {
        t.Fatalf("expected 1000, got %d", amount)
    }
}

func TestCalculateOrderNotionalRejectsOverflow(t *testing.T) {
    order := marketflow.Order{
        Side:     marketflow.Buy,
        Price:    math.MaxInt64,
        Quantity: 2,
    }

    if _, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order); err == nil {
        t.Fatal("expected overflow rejection")
    }
}

    }
}
