$Capabilities = @'
package marketflow

import (
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "sort"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

var (
    ErrInvalidInput       = errors.New("invalid input")
    ErrInvalidTransition  = errors.New("invalid state transition")
    ErrNotEligible        = errors.New("operation is not eligible")
    ErrNotFound           = errors.New("entity not found")
    ErrConflict           = errors.New("conflict")
    ErrPolicyViolation    = errors.New("execution policy violation")
    ErrExternalNotAllowed = errors.New("external operation is not authorized")
)

type ID string

func validID(id ID) bool {
    return strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) != ""
}

func validTime(t time.Time) bool {
    return !t.IsZero()
}

// ============================================================
// MARKET AND OFFER CONFIGURATION
// ============================================================

type MarketState string

const (
    MarketDraft     MarketState = "draft"
    MarketActive    MarketState = "active"
    MarketSuspended MarketState = "suspended"
    MarketClosed    MarketState = "closed"
)

type OfferState string

const (
    OfferDraft      OfferState = "draft"
    OfferReview     OfferState = "pending_review"
    OfferApproved   OfferState = "approved"
    OfferPublished  OfferState = "published"
    OfferSuspended  OfferState = "suspended"
    OfferRejected   OfferState = "rejected"
    OfferExpired    OfferState = "expired"
    OfferClosed     OfferState = "closed"
)

type ParameterType string

const (
    ParamString  ParameterType = "string"
    ParamNumber  ParameterType = "number"
    ParamBoolean ParameterType = "boolean"
)

type ParameterDefinition struct {
    Code       string
    Type       ParameterType
    Required   bool
    Min        *float64
    Max        *float64
    Allowed    []string
}

type OfferConfiguration struct {
    ID          ID
    CategoryID  ID
    Version     uint64
    Parameters  []ParameterDefinition
    RequiredDocs []string
    Active      bool
    CreatedAt   time.Time
}

type OfferParameters map[string]any

func (c OfferConfiguration) Validate(values OfferParameters) error {
    if !validID(c.ID) || !validID(c.CategoryID) ||
        c.Version == 0 || !validTime(c.CreatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }

    for _, definition := range c.Parameters {
        value, exists := values[definition.Code]

        if !exists {
            if definition.Required {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: missing parameter %s",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }
            continue
        }

        switch definition.Type {
        case ParamString:
            if _, ok := value.(string); !ok {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s must be string",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }

        case ParamBoolean:
            if _, ok := value.(bool); !ok {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s must be boolean",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }

        case ParamNumber:
            number, ok := value.(float64)
            if !ok {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s must be number",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }
            if definition.Min != nil && number < *definition.Min {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s below minimum",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }
            if definition.Max != nil && number > *definition.Max {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s above maximum",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }

        default:
            return ErrInvalidInput
        }

        if len(definition.Allowed) > 0 {
            text, ok := value.(string)
            if !ok {
                return ErrInvalidInput
            }

            allowed := false
            for _, candidate := range definition.Allowed {
                if candidate == text {
                    allowed = true
                    break
                }
            }
            if !allowed {
                return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter %s is not allowed",
                    ErrInvalidInput, definition.Code)
            }
        }
    }

    return nil
}

// ============================================================
// COMPANY ELIGIBILITY
// ============================================================

type QualificationState string

const (
    QualificationPending  QualificationState = "pending"
    QualificationApproved QualificationState = "approved"
    QualificationRejected QualificationState = "rejected"
    QualificationExpired  QualificationState = "expired"
)

type CompanyQualification struct {
    CompanyID ID
    CategoryID ID
    ActivityCode string
    State QualificationState
    Documents []string
    ValidUntil time.Time
    Version uint64
}

func (q CompanyQualification) IsEligible(
    categoryID ID,
    activityCode string,
    requiredDocuments []string,
    now time.Time,
) error {
    if !validID(q.CompanyID) || !validID(categoryID) ||
        !validTime(now) || q.Version == 0 {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if q.State != QualificationApproved ||
        q.CategoryID != categoryID ||
        q.ActivityCode != activityCode {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }

    if !q.ValidUntil.IsZero() && now.After(q.ValidUntil) {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }

    available := make(map[string]bool, len(q.Documents))
    for _, document := range q.Documents {
        available[document] = true
    }

    for _, document := range requiredDocuments {
        if !available[document] {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: missing document %s",
                ErrNotEligible, document)
        }
    }

    return nil
}

// ============================================================
// OFFER LIFECYCLE
// ============================================================

type Offer struct {
    ID ID
    MarketID ID
    OwnerID ID
    PublicCategoryID ID
    SpecializedCategoryID ID
    ConfigurationID ID
    ConfigurationVersion uint64
    Title string
    Description string
    Quantity int64
    Remaining int64
    Unit string
    Price int64
    Currency string
    State OfferState
    ValidUntil time.Time
    Version uint64
    CreatedAt time.Time
    UpdatedAt time.Time
}

func (o *Offer) Validate() error {
    if o == nil || !validID(o.ID) || !validID(o.MarketID) ||
        !validID(o.OwnerID) || !validID(o.PublicCategoryID) ||
        !validID(o.SpecializedCategoryID) ||
        !validID(o.ConfigurationID) ||
        o.ConfigurationVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(o.Title) == "" ||
        o.Quantity <= 0 || o.Remaining < 0 ||
        o.Remaining > o.Quantity || o.Price < 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(o.Unit) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(o.Currency) == "" ||
        o.Version == 0 || !validTime(o.CreatedAt) ||
        !validTime(o.UpdatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) SubmitForReview(now time.Time) error {
    if err := o.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if o.State != OfferDraft || !validTime(now) {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OfferReview
    o.touch(now)
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Approve(now time.Time) error {
    if o.State != OfferReview || !validTime(now) {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OfferApproved
    o.touch(now)
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Publish(now time.Time) error {
    if o.State != OfferApproved || !validTime(now) {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    if o.Remaining <= 0 {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }
    if !o.ValidUntil.IsZero() && !now.Before(o.ValidUntil) {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }
    o.State = OfferPublished
    o.touch(now)
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Suspend(now time.Time) error {
    if o.State != OfferPublished || !validTime(now) {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OfferSuspended
    o.touch(now)
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Close(now time.Time) error {
    if o.State == OfferClosed || !validTime(now) {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OfferClosed
    o.touch(now)
    return nil
}

func (o *Offer) touch(now time.Time) {
    o.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
    o.Version++
}

// ============================================================
// SUPPLY REQUESTS AND PROPOSALS
// ============================================================

type RequestState string

const (
    RequestOpen     RequestState = "open"
    RequestSelected RequestState = "selected"
    RequestClosed   RequestState = "closed"
    RequestCancelled RequestState = "cancelled"
)

type SupplyRequest struct {
    ID ID
    RequesterID ID
    CategoryID ID
    Quantity int64
    Unit string
    MaxPrice int64
    Currency string
    State RequestState
    SelectedProposalID ID
    CreatedAt time.Time
}

type ProposalState string

const (
    ProposalSubmitted ProposalState = "submitted"
    ProposalAccepted  ProposalState = "accepted"
    ProposalRejected  ProposalState = "rejected"
    ProposalWithdrawn ProposalState = "withdrawn"
)

type SupplyProposal struct {
    ID ID
    RequestID ID
    SupplierID ID
    OfferID ID
    Quantity int64
    UnitPrice int64
    Currency string
    DeliveryTerms string
    State ProposalState
    CreatedAt time.Time
}

func (r SupplyRequest) Validate() error {
    if !validID(r.ID) || !validID(r.RequesterID) ||
        !validID(r.CategoryID) || r.Quantity <= 0 ||
        r.Unit == "" || r.Currency == "" ||
        !validTime(r.CreatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return nil
}

func (p SupplyProposal) IsCompatible(r SupplyRequest) bool {
    return p.RequestID == r.ID &&
        p.Quantity >= r.Quantity &&
        p.UnitPrice > 0 &&
        p.Currency == r.Currency &&
        p.State == ProposalSubmitted
}

func SelectProposal(
    request *SupplyRequest,
    proposal SupplyProposal,
) error {
    if request == nil || request.State != RequestOpen {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    if !validID(proposal.ID) || !proposal.IsCompatible(*request) {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }
    if request.MaxPrice > 0 && proposal.UnitPrice > request.MaxPrice {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }

    request.SelectedProposalID = proposal.ID
    request.State = RequestSelected
    return nil
}

// ============================================================
// ORDERS AND ORDER BOOK
// All prices are integer minor units. No float arithmetic.
// ============================================================

type OrderSide string

const (
    Buy  OrderSide = "buy"
    Sell OrderSide = "sell"
)

type OrderState string

const (
    OrderPending  OrderState = "pending"
    OrderOpen     OrderState = "open"
    OrderPartial  OrderState = "partially_filled"
    OrderFilled   OrderState = "filled"
    OrderCancelled OrderState = "cancelled"
    OrderRejected OrderState = "rejected"
)

type Order struct {
    ID ID
    OfferID ID
    MarketID ID
    UserID ID
    Side OrderSide
    Price int64
    Quantity int64
    Filled int64
    State OrderState
    CreatedAt time.Time
    Version uint64
}

func (o Order) Validate() error {
    if !validID(o.ID) || !validID(o.OfferID) ||
        !validID(o.MarketID) || !validID(o.UserID) ||
        (o.Side != Buy && o.Side != Sell) ||
        o.Price <= 0 || o.Quantity <= 0 ||
        o.Filled < 0 || o.Filled > o.Quantity ||
        !validTime(o.CreatedAt) || o.Version == 0 {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return nil
}

func (o *Order) Open() error {
    if err := o.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if o.State != OrderPending {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OrderOpen
    o.Version++
    return nil
}

func (o *Order) Cancel() error {
    if o.State != OrderOpen && o.State != OrderPartial {
        return ErrInvalidTransition
    }
    o.State = OrderCancelled
    o.Version++
    return nil
}

func (o *Order) Remaining() int64 {
    return o.Quantity - o.Filled
}

type MatchResult struct {
    BuyOrderID ID
    SellOrderID ID
    Quantity int64
    Price int64
}

func MatchOrders(buy, sell *Order) (MatchResult, error) {
    if buy == nil || sell == nil {
        return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidInput
    }
    if err := buy.Validate(); err != nil {
        return MatchResult{}, err
    }
    if err := sell.Validate(); err != nil {
        return MatchResult{}, err
    }

    if buy.Side != Buy || sell.Side != Sell ||
        buy.State != OrderOpen && buy.State != OrderPartial ||
        sell.State != OrderOpen && sell.State != OrderPartial {
        return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidTransition
    }

    if buy.MarketID != sell.MarketID ||
        buy.OfferID != sell.OfferID ||
        buy.UserID == sell.UserID ||
        buy.Price < sell.Price {
        return MatchResult{}, ErrNotEligible
    }

    quantity := buy.Remaining()
    if sell.Remaining() < quantity {
        quantity = sell.Remaining()
    }
    if quantity <= 0 {
        return MatchResult{}, ErrNotEligible
    }

    // Price-time rule: older order is the maker.
    executionPrice := buy.Price
    if sell.CreatedAt.Before(buy.CreatedAt) ||
        sell.CreatedAt.Equal(buy.CreatedAt) {
        executionPrice = sell.Price
    }

    buy.Filled += quantity
    sell.Filled += quantity

    if buy.Remaining() == 0 {
        buy.State = OrderFilled
    } else {
        buy.State = OrderPartial
    }

    if sell.Remaining() == 0 {
        sell.State = OrderFilled
    } else {
        sell.State = OrderPartial
    }

    buy.Version++
    sell.Version++

    return MatchResult{
        BuyOrderID: buy.ID,
        SellOrderID: sell.ID,
        Quantity: quantity,
        Price: executionPrice,
    }, nil
}

func SortOrderBook(orders []Order) {
    sort.SliceStable(orders, func(i, j int) bool {
        a, b := orders[i], orders[j]

        if a.Side != b.Side {
            return a.Side == Buy
        }
        if a.Price != b.Price {
            if a.Side == Buy {
                return a.Price > b.Price
            }
            return a.Price < b.Price
        }
        return a.CreatedAt.Before(b.CreatedAt)
    })
}

// ============================================================
// TRADE - independent status dimensions
// ============================================================

type TradeState string
type ContractState string
type ServiceState string
type DeliveryState string
type SettlementReadiness string
type SettlementState string

const (
    TradeCreated   TradeState = "created"
    TradeConfirmed TradeState = "confirmed"
    TradeExecuting TradeState = "executing"
    TradeCompleted TradeState = "completed"
    TradeCancelled TradeState = "cancelled"

    ContractNotRequired ContractState = "not_required"
    ContractPending     ContractState = "pending"
    ContractCreated     ContractState = "created"
    ContractFailed      ContractState = "failed"

    ServiceNotRequired ServiceState = "not_required"
    ServicePending     ServiceState = "pending"
    ServiceInProgress  ServiceState = "in_progress"
    ServiceCompleted   ServiceState = "completed"
    ServiceFailed      ServiceState = "failed"

    DeliveryNotRequired DeliveryState = "not_required"
    DeliveryPending     DeliveryState = "pending"
    DeliveryConfirmed   DeliveryState = "confirmed"
    DeliveryFailed      DeliveryState = "failed"

    SettlementNotReady SettlementReadiness = "not_ready"
    SettlementReady    SettlementReadiness = "ready"

    SettlementPending SettlementState = "pending"
    SettlementDone    SettlementState = "completed"
    SettlementFailed  SettlementState = "failed"
)

type Trade struct {
    ID ID
    MatchID ID
    BuyOrderID ID
    SellOrderID ID
    BuyerID ID
    SellerID ID
    OfferID ID
    Quantity int64
    Price int64

    State TradeState
    Contract ContractState
    Services ServiceState
    Delivery DeliveryState
    SettlementReadiness SettlementReadiness
    Settlement SettlementState

    CreatedAt time.Time
    UpdatedAt time.Time
    Version uint64
}

func (t Trade) Validate() error {
    if !validID(t.ID) || !validID(t.BuyOrderID) ||
        !validID(t.SellOrderID) || !validID(t.BuyerID) ||
        !validID(t.SellerID) || !validID(t.OfferID) ||
        t.BuyerID == t.SellerID || t.Quantity <= 0 ||
        t.Price <= 0 || !validTime(t.CreatedAt) ||
        !validTime(t.UpdatedAt) || t.Version == 0 {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return nil
}

func (t *Trade) RecalculateSettlementReadiness() {
    if t.Contract == ContractFailed ||
        t.Services == ServiceFailed ||
        t.Delivery == DeliveryFailed {
        t.SettlementReadiness = SettlementNotReady
        return
    }

    contractOK := t.Contract == ContractNotRequired ||
        t.Contract == ContractCreated
    servicesOK := t.Services == ServiceNotRequired ||
        t.Services == ServiceCompleted
    deliveryOK := t.Delivery == DeliveryNotRequired ||
        t.Delivery == DeliveryConfirmed

    if contractOK && servicesOK && deliveryOK {
        t.SettlementReadiness = SettlementReady
    } else {
        t.SettlementReadiness = SettlementNotReady
    }
}

// ============================================================
// VERSIONED EXECUTION POLICIES
// ============================================================

type StepRequirement string

const (
    StepRequired StepRequirement = "required"
    StepOptional StepRequirement = "optional"
    StepConditional StepRequirement = "conditional"
)

type ExecutionStep struct {
    Code string
    Order int
    Requirement StepRequirement
    RequiredDocuments []string
    DependsOn []string
}

type ExecutionPolicy struct {
    ID ID
    Name string
    Version uint64
    OfferCategoryID ID
    Steps []ExecutionStep
    Active bool
    CreatedAt time.Time
}

func (p ExecutionPolicy) Validate() error {
    if !validID(p.ID) || !validID(p.OfferCategoryID) ||
        strings.TrimSpace(p.Name) == "" ||
        p.Version == 0 || !validTime(p.CreatedAt) ||
        len(p.Steps) == 0 {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }

    seen := make(map[string]bool)
    for _, step := range p.Steps {
        if strings.TrimSpace(step.Code) == "" ||
            step.Order < 1 || seen[step.Code] {
            return ErrInvalidInput
        }
        if step.Requirement != StepRequired &&
            step.Requirement != StepOptional &&
            step.Requirement != StepConditional {
            return ErrInvalidInput
        }
        seen[step.Code] = true
    }

    for _, step := range p.Steps {
        for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
            if !seen[dependency] || dependency == step.Code {
                return ErrPolicyViolation
            }
        }
    }

    return nil
}

type ExecutionProgress struct {
    TradeID ID
    PolicyID ID
    PolicyVersion uint64
    CompletedSteps map[string]bool
}

func (p ExecutionProgress) CanComplete(
    policy ExecutionPolicy,
    stepCode string,
) error {
    if p.PolicyID != policy.ID ||
        p.PolicyVersion != policy.Version {
        return ErrConflict
    }

    var selected *ExecutionStep
    for i := range policy.Steps {
        if policy.Steps[i].Code == stepCode {
            selected = &policy.Steps[i]
            break
        }
    }
    if selected == nil {
        return ErrNotFound
    }

    for _, dependency := range selected.DependsOn {
        if !p.CompletedSteps[dependency] {
            return fmt.Errorf("%w: dependency %s",
                ErrPolicyViolation, dependency)
        }
    }
    return nil
}

// ============================================================
// PHYSICAL COMMODITY AGGREGATION
// ============================================================

type CommodityLot struct {
    ID ID
    OfferID ID
    CommodityCode string
    Quantity int64
    Unit string
    Verified bool
    AggregationAllowed bool
}

type CommodityAggregation struct {
    ID ID
    CommodityCode string
    Unit string
    LotIDs []ID
    TotalQuantity int64
    CreatedAt time.Time
}

func AggregateCommodity(
    id ID,
    lots []CommodityLot,
    minimumQuantity int64,
    now time.Time,
) (CommodityAggregation, error) {
    if !validID(id) || len(lots) == 0 ||
        minimumQuantity <= 0 || !validTime(now) {
        return CommodityAggregation{}, ErrInvalidInput
    }

    first := lots[0]
    if first.CommodityCode == "" || first.Unit == "" {
        return CommodityAggregation{}, ErrInvalidInput
    }

    result := CommodityAggregation{
        ID: id,
        CommodityCode: first.CommodityCode,
        Unit: first.Unit,
        CreatedAt: now.UTC(),
    }

    seen := make(map[ID]bool)

    for _, lot := range lots {
        if !validID(lot.ID) || lot.Quantity <= 0 ||
            lot.CommodityCode != first.CommodityCode ||
            lot.Unit != first.Unit ||
            !lot.Verified || !lot.AggregationAllowed ||
            seen[lot.ID] {
            return CommodityAggregation{}, ErrNotEligible
        }

        seen[lot.ID] = true
        result.LotIDs = append(result.LotIDs, lot.ID)
        result.TotalQuantity += lot.Quantity
    }

    if result.TotalQuantity < minimumQuantity {
        return CommodityAggregation{}, ErrNotEligible
    }

    return result, nil
}

// ============================================================
// REAL ESTATE - platform position != legal ownership
// ============================================================

type PropertyWorkflowState string
type PlatformPositionState string
type LegalRegistrationState string

const (
    PropertyPending PropertyWorkflowState = "pending"
    PropertyTrading PropertyWorkflowState = "trading"
    PropertyContracting PropertyWorkflowState = "contracting"
    PropertyRegistration PropertyWorkflowState = "registration"
    PropertyCompleted PropertyWorkflowState = "completed"

    PositionNotRecorded PlatformPositionState = "not_recorded"
    PositionRecorded PlatformPositionState = "recorded"
    PositionRejected PlatformPositionState = "rejected"

    LegalNotRequired LegalRegistrationState = "not_required"
    LegalPending LegalRegistrationState = "pending"
    LegalSubmitted LegalRegistrationState = "submitted"
    LegalConfirmed LegalRegistrationState = "confirmed"
    LegalRejected LegalRegistrationState = "rejected"
)

type PropertyWorkflow struct {
    ID ID
    OfferID ID
    TradeID ID
    PropertyReference string
    PlatformPosition PlatformPositionState
    LegalRegistration LegalRegistrationState
    State PropertyWorkflowState
    UpdatedAt time.Time
}

func (p *PropertyWorkflow) RecordPlatformPosition(
    confirmedTradeID ID,
    now time.Time,
) error {
    if p == nil || !validID(confirmedTradeID) ||
        confirmedTradeID != p.TradeID ||
        !validTime(now) {
        return ErrNotEligible
    }

    p.PlatformPosition = PositionRecorded
    p.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
    return nil
}

func (p PropertyWorkflow) IsLegallyRegistered() bool {
    return p.LegalRegistration == LegalConfirmed
}

// ============================================================
// LEGAL / EXTERNAL INTEGRATION TRACKING
// ============================================================

type ExternalRequestState string

const (
    ExternalPending ExternalRequestState = "pending"
    ExternalSent ExternalRequestState = "sent"
    ExternalSucceeded ExternalRequestState = "succeeded"
    ExternalFailed ExternalRequestState = "failed"
)

type ExternalRequest struct {
    ID ID
    CorrelationID ID
    IdempotencyKey string
    InstitutionCode string
    Purpose string
    Scope []string
    PayloadReference string
    State ExternalRequestState
    ExternalTrackingID string
    ResponseReference string
    Attempt int
    CreatedAt time.Time
    UpdatedAt time.Time
}

func (r ExternalRequest) ValidateAuthorization(
    grantedScopes []string,
) error {
    if !validID(r.ID) || !validID(r.CorrelationID) ||
        strings.TrimSpace(r.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(r.InstitutionCode) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(r.Purpose) == "" ||
        len(r.Scope) == 0 || !validTime(r.CreatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }

    allowed := make(map[string]bool)
    for _, scope := range grantedScopes {
        allowed[scope] = true
    }

    for _, scope := range r.Scope {
        if !allowed[scope] {
            return ErrExternalNotAllowed
        }
    }
    return nil
}

// ============================================================
// AUDIT
// ============================================================

type AuditEvent struct {
    ID ID
    AggregateType string
    AggregateID ID
    Action string
    ActorID ID
    CorrelationID ID
    PreviousVersion uint64
    NewVersion uint64
    OccurredAt time.Time
    Metadata map[string]string
}

func (e AuditEvent) Validate() error {
    if !validID(e.ID) || !validID(e.AggregateID) ||
        !validID(e.ActorID) || !validID(e.CorrelationID) ||
        strings.TrimSpace(e.AggregateType) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(e.Action) == "" ||
        !validTime(e.OccurredAt) ||
        e.NewVersion < e.PreviousVersion {
        return ErrInvalidInput
    }
    return nil
}

func TestExecutionPolicyDependencies(t *testing.T) {
    policy := ExecutionPolicy{
        ID: "policy-1",
        Name: "Property transaction",
        Version: 1,

        Active: true,
        CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
        Steps: []ExecutionStep{
            {Code: "contract", Order: 1, Requirement: StepRequired},
            {Code: "position", Order: 2, Requirement: StepRequired, DependsOn: []string{"contract"}},
        },
    }

    if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    progress := ExecutionProgress{
        TradeID: "trade-1",
        PolicyID: policy.ID,

        t.Fatalf("expected dependency failure, got %v", err)

        t.Fatal(err)
    }

function Write-AtomicText {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Path,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Parent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    $Temp = "$Path.tmp-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"

    $Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    $Bytes = $Encoding.GetBytes($Content)

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Temp, $Bytes)

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) {
        [System.IO.File]::Replace($Temp, $Path, $null)
    }
    else {
        [System.IO.File]::Move($Temp, $Path)
    }
}

function Save-Backup {
    param([string]$RelativePath)

    $Source = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Source) {
        $Destination = Join-Path $BackupRoot $RelativePath
        $DestinationParent = Split-Path -Parent $Destination

        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DestinationParent -Force | Out-Null

        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(
            $Destination,
            [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Source)
        )

        $BackedUpFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }
}

function Install-SourceFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$RelativePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Target = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) {
        Save-Backup -RelativePath $RelativePath
    }
    else {
        $CreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
    }

    Write-AtomicText -Path $Target -Content $Content
    $WrittenFiles.Add($RelativePath)
}

function Invoke-NativeChecked {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Executable,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string[]]$Arguments
    )

    $Output = & $Executable @Arguments 2>&1
    $ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($Output) {
        $Output | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
    }

    if ($ExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "$Executable failed with exit code $ExitCode."
    }
}

function Restore-Package02 {
    Write-Host "Restoring Package 02 changes..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

    foreach ($RelativePath in $BackedUpFiles) {
        $Backup = Join-Path $BackupRoot $RelativePath
        $Target = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath

            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Parent -Force | Out-Null

            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(
                $Target,
                [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Backup)
            )
        }
    }

    foreach ($RelativePath in $CreatedFiles) {
        $Target = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Target -Force
        }
    }

    Write-Host "Rollback completed." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

$OfferConfigSource = @'
package parameterized

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidInput       = errors.New("invalid input")
	ErrInvalidTransition  = errors.New("invalid configuration transition")
	ErrImmutableVersion   = errors.New("published configuration is immutable")
	ErrVersionOverflow    = errors.New("configuration version overflow")
	ErrRevisionOverflow   = errors.New("configuration revision overflow")
	ErrNotFound           = errors.New("configuration not found")
	ErrConflict           = errors.New("configuration revision conflict")
	ErrDependencyMissing  = errors.New("required dependency is missing")
	ErrUnauthorized       = errors.New("configuration operation is not authorized")
)

type ConfigurationID string
type CategoryID string
type ParameterCode string
type DocumentCode string
type EligibilitySchemeID string

type ConfigurationStatus string

const (
	StatusDraft     ConfigurationStatus = "draft"
	StatusInReview  ConfigurationStatus = "in_review"
	StatusApproved  ConfigurationStatus = "approved"
	StatusRejected  ConfigurationStatus = "rejected"
	StatusPublished ConfigurationStatus = "published"
	StatusSuspended ConfigurationStatus = "suspended"
)

type DataType string

const (
	DataString  DataType = "string"
	DataInteger DataType = "integer"
	DataDecimal DataType = "decimal"
	DataBoolean DataType = "boolean"
	DataDate    DataType = "date"
	DataEnum    DataType = "enum"
)

type Classification struct {
	ID          CategoryID
	ParentID    CategoryID
	Code        string
	Name        string
	Description string
	Active      bool
}

type ParameterDefinition struct {
	Code        ParameterCode
	Name        string
	Description string
	Type        DataType
	Required    bool

	Unit        string
	MinNumber   *float64
	MaxNumber   *float64
	MinLength   *int
	MaxLength   *int
	Pattern     string
	Allowed     []string

	// If true, a value must be supplied by the offer owner.
	OwnerEditable bool
}

type DocumentRequirement struct {
	Code        DocumentCode
	Name        string
	Description string
	Required    bool
	AppliesTo   []string
	// Examples: person, company, both.
}

type Configuration struct {
	ID          ConfigurationID
	Category    Classification
	Name        string
	Description string

	Parameters []ParameterDefinition
	Documents  []DocumentRequirement

	EligibilitySchemeID      EligibilitySchemeID
	EligibilitySchemeVersion uint64

	Version  uint64
	Revision uint64
	Status   ConfigurationStatus

	CreatedAt   time.Time
	UpdatedAt   time.Time
	SubmittedAt *time.Time
	ApprovedAt  *time.Time
	PublishedAt *time.Time

	CreatedBy  string
	ApprovedBy string
	RejectedBy string
	RejectReason string
}

type ValidationIssue struct {
	Code      string
	Field     string
	Message   string
	Parameter ParameterCode
}

type ValidationResult struct {
	Valid  bool
	Issues []ValidationIssue
}

func validCode(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') &&
			!(r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') &&
			!(r >= '0' && r <= '9') &&
			r != '_' && r != '-' && r != '.' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validateParameterDefinition(p ParameterDefinition) error {
	if !validCode(string(p.Code)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid parameter code", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(p.Name) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: parameter name is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch p.Type {
	case DataString, DataInteger, DataDecimal, DataBoolean, DataDate, DataEnum:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported parameter type %q", ErrInvalidInput, p.Type)
	}

	if p.MinNumber != nil && p.MaxNumber != nil && *p.MinNumber > *p.MaxNumber {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum exceeds maximum for %s", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
	}

	if p.MinLength != nil && *p.MinLength < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative minimum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if p.MaxLength != nil && *p.MaxLength < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative maximum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if p.MinLength != nil && p.MaxLength != nil && *p.MinLength > *p.MaxLength {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum length exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if p.Pattern != "" {
		if _, err := regexp.Compile(p.Pattern); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid regular expression for %s: %v", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code, err)
		}
	}

	if p.Type == DataEnum && len(p.Allowed) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: enum parameter %s has no allowed values", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
	}
	if p.Type != DataEnum && len(p.Allowed) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: allowed values are only valid for enum parameters", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(p.Allowed))
	for _, value := range p.Allowed {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: empty enum value", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate enum value %q", ErrInvalidInput, value)
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
	}

	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) ValidateDefinition() error {
	if !validCode(string(c.ID)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid configuration ID", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !validCode(string(c.Category.ID)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid category ID", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !validCode(c.Category.Code) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid category code", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.Category.Name) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(c.Name) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: category name and configuration name are required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.Version == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: version must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.Revision == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: revision must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if c.EligibilitySchemeID == "" || c.EligibilitySchemeVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: eligibility scheme and version are required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	parameterCodes := make(map[ParameterCode]struct{}, len(c.Parameters))
	for _, p := range c.Parameters {
		if err := validateParameterDefinition(p); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, exists := parameterCodes[p.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate parameter code %s", ErrInvalidInput, p.Code)
		}
		parameterCodes[p.Code] = struct{}{}
	}

	documentCodes := make(map[DocumentCode]struct{}, len(c.Documents))
	for _, d := range c.Documents {
		if !validCode(string(d.Code)) || strings.TrimSpace(d.Name) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid document requirement", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if _, exists := documentCodes[d.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate document code %s", ErrInvalidInput, d.Code)
		}
		documentCodes[d.Code] = struct{}{}

		for _, subject := range d.AppliesTo {
			if subject != "person" && subject != "company" && subject != "both" {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported document subject %q", ErrInvalidInput, subject)
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func numericValue(value any) (float64, bool) {
	var n float64

	switch v := value.(type) {
	case int:
		n = float64(v)
	case int8:
		n = float64(v)
	case int16:
		n = float64(v)
	case int32:
		n = float64(v)
	case int64:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint8:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint16:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint32:
		n = float64(v)
	case uint64:
		n = float64(v)
	case float32:
		n = float64(v)
	case float64:
		n = v
	case jsonNumber:
		parsed, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(v), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, false
		}
		n = parsed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}

	if math.IsNaN(n) || math.IsInf(n, 0) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return n, true
}

// jsonNumber is a small explicit wrapper; callers do not need encoding/json.
type jsonNumber string

func validateValue(p ParameterDefinition, value any) error {
	if value == nil {
		if p.Required {
			return fmt.Errorf("required value is missing")
		}
		return nil
	}

	switch p.Type {
	case DataString:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected string")
		}
		if p.MinLength != nil && len([]rune(v)) < *p.MinLength {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is shorter than minimum length")
		}
		if p.MaxLength != nil && len([]rune(v)) > *p.MaxLength {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum length")
		}
		if p.Pattern != "" {
			re, err := regexp.Compile(p.Pattern)
			if err != nil || !re.MatchString(v) {
				return fmt.Errorf("value does not match required pattern")
			}
		}

	case DataInteger:
		n, ok := numericValue(value)
		if !ok || math.Trunc(n) != n {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected integer")
		}
		if p.MinNumber != nil && n < *p.MinNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is below minimum")
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil && n > *p.MaxNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum")
		}

	case DataDecimal:
		n, ok := numericValue(value)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected finite decimal number")
		}
		if p.MinNumber != nil && n < *p.MinNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is below minimum")
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil && n > *p.MaxNumber {
			return fmt.Errorf("value exceeds maximum")
		}

	case DataBoolean:
		if _, ok := value.(bool); !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected boolean")
		}

	case DataDate:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected ISO date string")
		}
		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", v); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("date must use YYYY-MM-DD")
		}

	case DataEnum:
		v, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected enum string")
		}
		found := false
		for _, allowed := range p.Allowed {
			if v == allowed {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return fmt.Errorf("value is not in allowed values")
		}

	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported data type")
	}

	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) ValidateValues(values map[string]any) ValidationResult {
	issues := make([]ValidationIssue, 0)

	known := make(map[string]struct{}, len(c.Parameters))

	for _, p := range c.Parameters {
		code := string(p.Code)
		known[code] = struct{}{}

		value, exists := values[code]
		if !exists {
			value = nil
		}

		if err := validateValue(p, value); err != nil {
			issues = append(issues, ValidationIssue{
				Code:      "invalid_parameter_value",
				Field:     code,
				Message:   err.Error(),
				Parameter: p.Code,
			})
		}
	}

	for key := range values {
		if _, exists := known[key]; !exists {
			issues = append(issues, ValidationIssue{
				Code:    "unknown_parameter",
				Field:   key,
				Message: "parameter is not defined by this configuration version",
			})
		}
	}

	sort.Slice(issues, func(i, j int) bool {
		if issues[i].Field == issues[j].Field {
			return issues[i].Code < issues[j].Code
		}
		return issues[i].Field < issues[j].Field
	})

	return ValidationResult{
		Valid:  len(issues) == 0,
		Issues: issues,
	}
}

func (c *Configuration) SubmitForReview(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if err := c.ValidateDefinition(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusInReview
	c.SubmittedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Approve(actor string, now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusInReview {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(actor) == "" {
		return ErrUnauthorized
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusApproved
	c.ApprovedBy = actor
	c.ApprovedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Reject(actor, reason string, now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusInReview {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(actor) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusRejected
	c.RejectedBy = actor
	c.RejectReason = reason
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Publish(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusApproved {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Version == 0 || c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrVersionOverflow
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.PublishedAt = &t
	c.UpdatedAt = t
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Suspend(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusPublished {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	c.Status = StatusSuspended
	c.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c *Configuration) Resume(now time.Time) error {
	if c == nil || c.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if c.Revision == ^uint64(0) {
		return ErrRevisionOverflow
	}
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	c.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (c Configuration) Clone() Configuration {
	out := c

	out.Parameters = make([]ParameterDefinition, len(c.Parameters))
	for i, p := range c.Parameters {
		out.Parameters[i] = p
		out.Parameters[i].Allowed = append([]string(nil), p.Allowed...)

		if p.MinNumber != nil {
			v := *p.MinNumber
			out.Parameters[i].MinNumber = &v
		}
		if p.MaxNumber != nil {
			v := *p.MaxNumber
			out.Parameters[i].MaxNumber = &v
		}
		if p.MinLength != nil {
			v := *p.MinLength
			out.Parameters[i].MinLength = &v
		}
		if p.MaxLength != nil {
			v := *p.MaxLength
			out.Parameters[i].MaxLength = &v
		}
	}

	out.Documents = make([]DocumentRequirement, len(c.Documents))
	for i, d := range c.Documents {
		out.Documents[i] = d
		out.Documents[i].AppliesTo = append([]string(nil), d.AppliesTo...)
	}

	if c.SubmittedAt != nil {
		v := *c.SubmittedAt
		out.SubmittedAt = &v
	}
	if c.ApprovedAt != nil {
		v := *c.ApprovedAt
		out.ApprovedAt = &v
	}
	if c.PublishedAt != nil {
		v := *c.PublishedAt
		out.PublishedAt = &v
	}

	return out
}

func NewNextDraft(previous Configuration, newID ConfigurationID, now time.Time) (Configuration, error) {
	if previous.Status != StatusPublished && previous.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return Configuration{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !validCode(string(newID)) {
		return Configuration{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if previous.Version == ^uint64(0) {
		return Configuration{}, ErrVersionOverflow
	}

	next := previous.Clone()
	next.ID = newID
	next.Version = previous.Version + 1
	next.Revision = 1
	next.Status = StatusDraft
	next.CreatedAt = now.UTC()
	next.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	next.SubmittedAt = nil
	next.ApprovedAt = nil
	next.PublishedAt = nil
	next.ApprovedBy = ""
	next.RejectedBy = ""
	next.RejectReason = ""

	return next, nil
}

type PublishedSnapshot struct {
	ConfigurationID ConfigurationID
	CategoryID      CategoryID
	Version         uint64
	Configuration   Configuration
	PublishedAt     time.Time
}

func SnapshotOf(c Configuration) (PublishedSnapshot, error) {
	if c.Status != StatusPublished || c.PublishedAt == nil {
		return PublishedSnapshot{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if err := c.ValidateDefinition(); err != nil {
		return PublishedSnapshot{}, err
	}

	return PublishedSnapshot{
		ConfigurationID: c.ID,
		CategoryID:      c.Category.ID,
		Version:         c.Version,
		Configuration:   c.Clone(),
		PublishedAt:     c.PublishedAt.UTC(),
	}, nil
}

// ValidateReference prevents an offer from silently using a different
// configuration version than the one it originally accepted.
func ValidateReference(snapshot PublishedSnapshot, configurationID ConfigurationID, version uint64) error {
	if snapshot.ConfigurationID != configurationID || snapshot.Version != version {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration version mismatch", ErrConflict)
	}
	return nil
}

// Application ports. These are contracts only; no storage adapter is supplied.
type Repository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, id ConfigurationID) (Configuration, uint64, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, configuration Configuration, expectedRevision uint64) error
	SavePublishedSnapshot(ctx context.Context, snapshot PublishedSnapshot) error
}

type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

type AuditEvent struct {
	ActorID     string
	Action      string
	EntityID    string
	OldRevision uint64
	NewRevision uint64
	OccurredAt  time.Time
	Reason      string
}

type AuditAppender interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event AuditEvent) error
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ELIGIBILITY / QUALIFICATION DOMAIN
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$EligibilitySource = @'
package qualification

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidScheme = errors.New("invalid eligibility scheme")
	ErrInvalidEvidence = errors.New("invalid eligibility evidence")
	ErrUnsupportedSubject = errors.New("unsupported subject type")
)

type SchemeID string

type SubjectType string

const (
	SubjectPerson  SubjectType = "person"
	SubjectCompany SubjectType = "company"
)

type CriterionType string

const (
	CriterionDocument       CriterionType = "document"
	CriterionRegistration   CriterionType = "registration"
	CriterionLicense        CriterionType = "license"
	CriterionJurisdiction   CriterionType = "jurisdiction"
	CriterionExperience    CriterionType = "experience_months"
)

type Criterion struct {
	Code             string
	Name             string
	Type             CriterionType
	Required         bool
	DocumentCode     string
	RegistrationCode string
	LicenseCode      string
	JurisdictionCode string
	MinimumMonths    uint64
}

type Scheme struct {
	ID          SchemeID
	Version     uint64
	Name        string
	Subjects    []SubjectType
	Criteria    []Criterion
	Active      bool
	EffectiveAt time.Time
	ExpiresAt   *time.Time
}

type EvidenceStatus string

const (
	EvidenceSubmitted EvidenceStatus = "submitted"
	EvidenceVerified  EvidenceStatus = "verified"
	EvidenceRejected  EvidenceStatus = "rejected"
	EvidenceExpired   EvidenceStatus = "expired"
)

type DocumentEvidence struct {
	Code      string
	Status    EvidenceStatus
	ExpiresAt *time.Time
}

type RegistrationEvidence struct {
	Code   string
	Status EvidenceStatus
}

type LicenseEvidence struct {
	Code   string
	Status EvidenceStatus
}

type Evidence struct {
	Subject       SubjectType
	Documents     []DocumentEvidence
	Registrations []RegistrationEvidence
	Licenses      []LicenseEvidence
	Jurisdictions []string
	ExperienceMonths uint64
}

type ResultStatus string

const (
	ResultEligible   ResultStatus = "eligible"
	ResultIneligible ResultStatus = "ineligible"
	ResultReview     ResultStatus = "needs_review"
)

type Issue struct {
	CriterionCode string
	Code          string
	Message       string
}

type Evaluation struct {
	SchemeID SchemeID
	Version  uint64
	Subject  SubjectType
	Status   ResultStatus
	Issues   []Issue
	EvaluatedAt time.Time
}

func validCode(s string) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(s) != s {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') &&
			!(r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') &&
			!(r >= '0' && r <= '9') &&
			r != '_' && r != '-' && r != '.' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (s Scheme) Validate() error {
	if !validCode(string(s.ID)) || s.Version == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(s.Name) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidScheme
	}

	if len(s.Subjects) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: no supported subject types", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	subjects := make(map[SubjectType]struct{})
	for _, subject := range s.Subjects {
		if subject != SubjectPerson && subject != SubjectCompany {
			return ErrUnsupportedSubject
		}
		if _, exists := subjects[subject]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate subject type", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
		subjects[subject] = struct{}{}
	}

	criteria := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, c := range s.Criteria {
		if !validCode(c.Code) || strings.TrimSpace(c.Name) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid criterion", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
		if _, exists := criteria[c.Code]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate criterion %s", ErrInvalidScheme, c.Code)
		}
		criteria[c.Code] = struct{}{}

		switch c.Type {
		case CriterionDocument:
			if !validCode(c.DocumentCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: document code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionRegistration:
			if !validCode(c.RegistrationCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: registration code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionLicense:
			if !validCode(c.LicenseCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: license code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionJurisdiction:
			if !validCode(c.JurisdictionCode) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: jurisdiction code is required", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		case CriterionExperience:
			if c.MinimumMonths == 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum experience must be positive", ErrInvalidScheme)
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported criterion type", ErrInvalidScheme)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func containsSubject(subjects []SubjectType, target SubjectType) bool {
	for _, s := range subjects {
		if s == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func verifiedDocument(e Evidence, code string, now time.Time) (bool, bool) {
	for _, d := range e.Documents {
		if d.Code != code {
			continue
		}
		if d.Status == EvidenceVerified {
			if d.ExpiresAt != nil && !d.ExpiresAt.After(now) {
                return false, false
            }
			return true, false
		}
		if d.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
			return false, true
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func verifiedRegistration(e Evidence, code string) (bool, bool) {
	for _, r := range e.Registrations {
		if r.Code == code {
			if r.Status == EvidenceVerified {
				return true, false
			}
			if r.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
				return false, true
			}
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func verifiedLicense(e Evidence, code string) (bool, bool) {
	for _, l := range e.Licenses {
		if l.Code == code {
			if l.Status == EvidenceVerified {
				return true, false
			}
			if l.Status == EvidenceSubmitted {
				return false, true
			}
		}
	}
	return false, false
}

func hasJurisdiction(e Evidence, code string) bool {
	for _, jurisdiction := range e.Jurisdictions {
		if jurisdiction == code {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func Evaluate(s Scheme, evidence Evidence, now time.Time) (Evaluation, error) {
	if err := s.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Evaluation{}, err
	}

	if !s.Active {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme is inactive", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	if evidence.Subject != SubjectPerson && evidence.Subject != SubjectCompany {
		return Evaluation{}, ErrUnsupportedSubject
	}

	if !containsSubject(s.Subjects, evidence.Subject) {
		return Evaluation{}, ErrUnsupportedSubject
	}

	now = now.UTC()

	if !s.EffectiveAt.IsZero() && now.Before(s.EffectiveAt.UTC()) {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme is not yet effective", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}
	if s.ExpiresAt != nil && !now.Before(s.ExpiresAt.UTC()) {
		return Evaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: scheme has expired", ErrInvalidScheme)
	}

	issues := make([]Issue, 0)
	reviewRequired := false

	for _, c := range s.Criteria {
		if !c.Required {
			continue
		}

		satisfied := false
		pending := false

		switch c.Type {
		case CriterionDocument:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedDocument(evidence, c.DocumentCode, now)
		case CriterionRegistration:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedRegistration(evidence, c.RegistrationCode)
		case CriterionLicense:
			satisfied, pending = verifiedLicense(evidence, c.LicenseCode)
		case CriterionJurisdiction:
			satisfied = hasJurisdiction(evidence, c.JurisdictionCode)
		case CriterionExperience:
			satisfied = evidence.ExperienceMonths >= c.MinimumMonths
		}

		if satisfied {
			continue
		}

		code := "criterion_not_met"
		message := "required criterion has not been satisfied"

		if pending {
			code = "evidence_pending"
			message = "evidence has been submitted but is not verified"
			reviewRequired = true
		}

		issues = append(issues, Issue{
			CriterionCode: c.Code,
			Code:          code,
			Message:       message,
		})
	}

	sort.Slice(issues, func(i, j int) bool {
		return issues[i].CriterionCode < issues[j].CriterionCode
	})

	status := ResultEligible
	if len(issues) > 0 {
		status = ResultIneligible
		if reviewRequired {
			status = ResultReview
		}
	}

	return Evaluation{
		SchemeID:    s.ID,
		Version:     s.Version,
		Subject:     evidence.Subject,
		Status:      status,
		Issues:      issues,
		EvaluatedAt: now,
	}, nil
}

// A result is only reusable for the exact scheme version that produced it.
func ValidateEvaluationReference(result Evaluation, schemeID SchemeID, version uint64) error {
	if result.SchemeID != schemeID || result.Version != version {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: eligibility scheme version mismatch", ErrInvalidEvidence)
	}
	return nil
}

// Qualification is not legal ownership, identity verification,
// account authorization, or settlement approval.
type QualificationReference struct {
	SchemeID SchemeID
	Version  uint64
	Status   ResultStatus
}
'@

# 5. TESTS - PARAMETERIZED CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$OfferConfigTests = @'
package parameterized

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func testConfiguration() Configuration {
	min := 1.0
	max := 100.0

	return Configuration{
		ID: "cfg-test",
		Category: Classification{
			ID: "category-test",
			Code: "commodity",
			Name: "Commodity",
			Active: true,
		},
		Name: "Test configuration",
		Parameters: []ParameterDefinition{
			{
				Code: "weight",
				Name: "Weight",
				Type: DataDecimal,
				Required: true,
				Unit: "kg",
				MinNumber: &min,
				MaxNumber: &max,
			},
			{
				Code: "grade",
				Name: "Grade",
				Type: DataEnum,
				Required: true,
				Allowed: []string{"A", "B"},
			},
		},

func TestConfigurationLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	if err := c.SubmitForReview(now); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusInReview || c.Revision != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected review state: %+v", c)
	}

	if err := c.Approve("reviewer-1", now.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusApproved {
		t.Fatal("configuration was not approved")
	}

	if err := c.Publish(now.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Status != StatusPublished || c.PublishedAt == nil {
		t.Fatal("configuration was not published")
	}

	snapshot, err := SnapshotOf(c)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := ValidateReference(snapshot, c.ID, c.Version); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := ValidateReference(snapshot, c.ID, c.Version+1); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("expected version conflict")
	}
}

func TestConfigurationCannotSkipReview(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()

	if err := c.Publish(time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTransition) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid transition, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestConfigurationNextDraftDoesNotMutatePublishedVersion(t *testing.T) {
	c := testConfiguration()
	c.Status = StatusPublished
	c.PublishedAt = ptrTime(time.Now())
	c.Version = 4

	next, err := NewNextDraft(c, "cfg-next", time.Now())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if next.Version != 5 || next.Status != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected next draft: %+v", next)
	}
	if c.Version != 4 || c.Status != StatusPublished {
		t.Fatal("original published configuration was modified")
	}

	next.Parameters[0].Allowed = append(next.Parameters[0].Allowed, "mutated")
	if len(c.Parameters[0].Allowed) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("clone shares mutable parameter slices")
	}
}

func ptrTime(t time.Time) *time.Time {
	return &t
}

		t.Fatal("expected duplicate parameter code error")
	}
}

	}

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Locate project root
# ------------------------------------------------------------

function Find-ProjectRoot {
    $current = (Get-Location).Path

    while ($true) {
        $goMod = Join-Path $current 'go.mod'

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $goMod -PathType Leaf) {
            $moduleContent = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($goMod)

            if ($moduleContent -match 'module\s+github\.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend') {
                return $current
            }
        }

        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $current) {
            break
        }

        $current = $parent
    }

    throw 'General Market backend project root was not found. Run this script from the general-market-backend directory or one of its subdirectories.'
}

$ProjectRoot = Find-ProjectRoot
$PackageDirectory = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'internal\offer\lifecycle'

package lifecycle

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Status string

const (
	StatusDraft      Status = "draft"
	StatusInReview   Status = "in_review"
	StatusApproved   Status = "approved"
	StatusRejected   Status = "rejected"
	StatusPublished  Status = "published"
	StatusSuspended  Status = "suspended"
	StatusExpired    Status = "expired"
	StatusClosed     Status = "closed"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidOffer          = errors.New("invalid offer")
	ErrInvalidCommand        = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidTransition     = errors.New("invalid offer status transition")
	ErrRevisionConflict      = errors.New("offer revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict   = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrOfferNotExpired       = errors.New("offer has not expired")
	ErrOfferExpired          = errors.New("offer has expired")
	ErrReasonRequired        = errors.New("reason is required")
	ErrInvalidConfiguration  = errors.New("invalid configuration reference")
	ErrInvalidValidityPeriod = errors.New("invalid offer validity period")
	ErrInvalidActor          = errors.New("invalid actor")
	ErrCommandAlreadyApplied = errors.New("command already applied")
)

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string
}

type Draft struct {
	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Title       string
	Description string

	StartsAt time.Time
	EndsAt   time.Time

	Attributes map[string]string
}

type Event struct {
	OfferID string

	From Status
	To   Status

	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string

	Reason string

	At       time.Time
	Revision uint64
}

type Offer struct {
	ID      string
	OwnerID string

	Status Status

	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Title       string
	Description string

	StartsAt time.Time
	EndsAt   time.Time

	Attributes map[string]string

	Revision uint64

	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time

	SubmittedAt *time.Time
	ApprovedAt  *time.Time
	RejectedAt  *time.Time
	PublishedAt *time.Time
	SuspendedAt *time.Time
	ExpiredAt   *time.Time
	ClosedAt    *time.Time

	RejectionReason  string
	SuspensionReason string
	ClosureReason    string

	History []Event
}

func normalizeTime(t time.Time) time.Time {
	return t.UTC()
}

func validateCommand(c CommandContext) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidActor
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(c.CommandID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(c.CorrelationID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: correlation ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateDraft(d Draft) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(d.ConfigID) == "" || d.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidConfiguration
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(d.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: title is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if d.StartsAt.IsZero() || d.EndsAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: start and end timestamps are required", ErrInvalidValidityPeriod)
	}

	if !d.EndsAt.After(d.StartsAt) {
		return ErrInvalidValidityPeriod
	}

	for key := range d.Attributes {
		if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: attribute keys cannot be empty", ErrInvalidOffer)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func cloneAttributes(source map[string]string) map[string]string {
	if source == nil {
		return map[string]string{}
	}

	result := make(map[string]string, len(source))

	for key, value := range source {
		result[key] = value
	}

	return result
}

func cloneTime(source *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if source == nil {
		return nil
	}

	value := *source
	return &value
}

func cloneOffer(source Offer) Offer {
	result := source

	result.Attributes = cloneAttributes(source.Attributes)
	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)

	result.SubmittedAt = cloneTime(source.SubmittedAt)
	result.ApprovedAt = cloneTime(source.ApprovedAt)
	result.RejectedAt = cloneTime(source.RejectedAt)
	result.PublishedAt = cloneTime(source.PublishedAt)
	result.SuspendedAt = cloneTime(source.SuspendedAt)
	result.ExpiredAt = cloneTime(source.ExpiredAt)
	result.ClosedAt = cloneTime(source.ClosedAt)

	return result
}

func NewOffer(
	id string,
	ownerID string,
	draft Draft,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) (Offer, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: offer ID is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(ownerID) == "" {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: owner ID is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return Offer{}, err
	}

	if err := validateDraft(draft); err != nil {
		return Offer{}, err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return Offer{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: creation time is required", ErrInvalidOffer)
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	offer := Offer{
		ID:      strings.TrimSpace(id),
		OwnerID: strings.TrimSpace(ownerID),

		Status: StatusDraft,

		ConfigID:      strings.TrimSpace(draft.ConfigID),
		ConfigVersion: draft.ConfigVersion,

		Title:       strings.TrimSpace(draft.Title),
		Description: strings.TrimSpace(draft.Description),

		StartsAt: normalizeTime(draft.StartsAt),
		EndsAt:   normalizeTime(draft.EndsAt),

		Attributes: cloneAttributes(draft.Attributes),

		Revision: 1,

		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
	}

	offer.History = []Event{
		{
			OfferID:       offer.ID,
			From:          "",
			To:            StatusDraft,
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      offer.Revision,
		},
	}

	return offer, nil
}

func (o Offer) Snapshot() Offer {
	return cloneOffer(o)
}

func (o Offer) IsTerminal() bool {
	return o.Status == StatusExpired ||
		o.Status == StatusClosed
}

func (o Offer) IsCurrentlyValid(now time.Time) bool {
	if o.Status != StatusPublished {
		return false
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return !now.Before(o.StartsAt) && now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) IsWithinValidityPeriod(now time.Time) bool {
	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return !now.Before(o.StartsAt) && now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) CanBePublished(now time.Time) bool {
	if o.Status != StatusApproved {
		return false
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	return now.Before(o.EndsAt)
}

func (o Offer) Events() []Event {
	return append([]Event(nil), o.History...)
}

func (o Offer) HasCommand(commandID string) bool {
	for _, event := range o.History {
		if event.CommandID == commandID {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

func (o *Offer) UpdateDraft(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	draft Draft,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := validateDraft(draft); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusDraft, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	o.ConfigID = strings.TrimSpace(draft.ConfigID)
	o.ConfigVersion = draft.ConfigVersion

	o.Title = strings.TrimSpace(draft.Title)
	o.Description = strings.TrimSpace(draft.Description)

	o.StartsAt = normalizeTime(draft.StartsAt)
	o.EndsAt = normalizeTime(draft.EndsAt)

	o.Attributes = cloneAttributes(draft.Attributes)

	return o.record(
		StatusDraft,
		command,
		normalizeTime(now),
	)
}

func (o *Offer) SubmitForReview(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusDraft,
		StatusInReview,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Approve(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusInReview,
		StatusApproved,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Reject(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusInReview,
		StatusRejected,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) ReopenRejected(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	return o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusRejected,
		StatusDraft,
		now,
		false,
	)
}

func (o *Offer) Publish(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusPublished, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusApproved {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferExpired
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(o.ConfigID) == "" || o.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidConfiguration
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusPublished, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.PublishedAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Suspend(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := o.transition(
		command,
		expectedRevision,
		StatusPublished,
		StatusSuspended,
		now,
		false,
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := normalizeTime(now)
	o.SuspendedAt = &value
	o.SuspensionReason = command.Reason

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Resume(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusPublished, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != StatusSuspended {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferExpired
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusPublished, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Expire(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusExpired, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	switch o.Status {
	case StatusInReview, StatusApproved, StatusPublished, StatusSuspended:
		// These states may expire.
	default:
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if now.Before(o.EndsAt) {
		return ErrOfferNotExpired
	}

	if err := o.record(StatusExpired, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.ExpiredAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) Close(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, StatusClosed, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	switch o.Status {
	case StatusApproved, StatusPublished, StatusSuspended:
		// These states may be closed explicitly.
	default:
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if err := o.record(StatusClosed, command, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	value := now
	o.ClosedAt = &value
	o.ClosureReason = command.Reason

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) transition(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	from Status,
	to Status,
	now time.Time,
	requireReason bool,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if requireReason && strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := o.checkIdempotency(command, to, command.Reason); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if o.Status != from {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := o.record(to, command, normalizeTime(now)); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	switch to {
	case StatusInReview:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.SubmittedAt = &value

	case StatusApproved:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.ApprovedAt = &value

	case StatusRejected:
		value := normalizeTime(now)
		o.RejectedAt = &value
		o.RejectionReason = command.Reason
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected == 0 || expected != o.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (o *Offer) checkIdempotency(
command CommandContext,
target Status,
reason string,
) error {
for _, event := range o.History {
if event.CommandID != command.CommandID {
continue
}

if event.To == target &&
event.ActorID == command.ActorID &&
event.Reason == reason &&
event.CorrelationID == command.CorrelationID {
return ErrCommandAlreadyApplied
}

return ErrIdempotencyConflict
}

return nil
}

func (o *Offer) record(
	target Status,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if o == nil {
		return ErrInvalidOffer
	}

	from := o.Status

	o.Status = target
	o.Revision++
	o.UpdatedAt = now

	event := Event{
		OfferID:       o.ID,
		From:          from,
		To:            target,
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      o.Revision,
	}

	o.History = append(o.History, event)

	return nil
}
'@

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. contracts.go
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $ContractsSource = @'
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

var (
	ErrOfferNotFound = errors.New("offer not found")
	ErrOfferExists   = errors.New("offer already exists")
)

type Repository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, offerID string) (Offer, error)

	Create(ctx context.Context, offer Offer) error

	Save(
		ctx context.Context,
		offer Offer,
		expectedRevision uint64,
	) error
}

type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(
		ctx context.Context,
		fn func(context.Context) error,
	) error
}

type AuditSink interface {
	Append(
		ctx context.Context,
		events []Event,
	) error
}

// Repository is responsible for persistence and optimistic concurrency.
// It must reject writes whose expected revision does not match the stored
// aggregate revision.
//
// TransactionManager must guarantee that repository writes and audit
// records are committed or rolled back together when used by an adapter.
//
// AuditSink must preserve event ordering and must not silently discard
// lifecycle events.
//
// These interfaces are contracts only. This package intentionally does
// not provide an in-memory or database-backed production adapter.
'@

    # 6. lifecycle_test.go
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $TestsSource = @'
package lifecycle

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func testTime() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
}

func testCommand(id string) CommandContext {
	return CommandContext{
		ActorID:       "actor-1",
		CommandID:     id,
		CorrelationID: "correlation-1",
	}
}

func testDraft() Draft {
	return Draft{
		ConfigID:      "config-1",
		ConfigVersion: 3,
		Title:         "Test offer",
		Description:   "Offer lifecycle test",
		StartsAt:      testTime().Add(-time.Hour),
		EndsAt:        testTime().Add(24 * time.Hour),
		Attributes: map[string]string{
			"category": "commodity",
			"quality":  "standard",
		},
	}
}

func newTestOffer(t *testing.T) Offer {
	t.Helper()

	offer, err := NewOffer(
		"offer-1",
		"owner-1",
		testDraft(),
		testCommand("create-1"),
		testTime(),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewOffer failed: %v", err)
	}

	return offer
}

func TestNewOffer(t *testing.T) {
	offer := newTestOffer(t)

	if offer.Status != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("expected draft, got %s", offer.Status)
	}

	if offer.Revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision 1, got %d", offer.Revision)
	}

	if offer.ConfigVersion != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected config version: %d", offer.ConfigVersion)
	}

	if len(offer.History) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one creation event, got %d", len(offer.History))
	}

	if offer.History[0].To != StatusDraft {
		t.Fatal("creation event must lead to draft status")
	}
}

	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		draft Draft
	}{

			},
		},
		{

			draft: Draft{
				ConfigID:      "config-1",
				ConfigVersion: 1,
				StartsAt:      testTime(),
				EndsAt:        testTime().Add(time.Hour),
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid period",
			draft: Draft{
				ConfigID:      "config-1",
				ConfigVersion: 1,
				Title:         "Offer",
				StartsAt:      testTime(),
				EndsAt:        testTime(),
			},
		},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {

				"offer-1",
				"owner-1",
				test.draft,
				testCommand("create-"+test.name),
				testTime(),
			)

			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected validation error")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCompleteSuccessfulLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	offer := newTestOffer(t)

	err := offer.SubmitForReview(
		testCommand("submit-1"),
		offer.Revision,
		testTime().Add(time.Minute),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitForReview failed: %v", err)
	}

	err = offer.Approve(
		testCommand("approve-1"),
		offer.Revision,
		testTime().Add(2*time.Minute),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Approve failed: %v", err)
	}

	err = offer.Publish(
		testCommand("publish-1"),
		offer.Revision,
		testTime().Add(3*time.Minute),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Publish failed: %v", err)
	}

	if offer.Status != StatusPublished {
		t.Fatalf("expected published, got %s", offer.Status)
	}

	if !offer.IsCurrentlyValid(testTime().Add(4 * time.Minute)) {
		t.Fatal("published offer should be currently valid")
	}

	if len(offer.History) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected four lifecycle events, got %d", len(offer.History))
	}

	if offer.Revision != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision 4, got %d", offer.Revision)
	}
}

func TestIdempotentCommand(t *testing.T) {
	offer := newTestOffer(t)

	command := testCommand("submit-1")
	now := testTime()

	if err := offer.SubmitForReview(
		command,
		offer.Revision,
		now,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	revision := offer.Revision
	historyLength := len(offer.History)

	err := offer.SubmitForReview(
		command,
		1,
		now,
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("idempotent retry should succeed: %v", err)
	}

	if offer.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry changed revision")
	}

	if len(offer.History) != historyLength {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry created duplicate event")
	}
}

		offer.Revision,
		testTime(),
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := offer.Expire(
		testCommand("expire-1"),
		offer.Revision,
		offer.EndsAt,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if offer.Status != StatusExpired {
		t.Fatalf("expected expired, got %s", offer.Status)
	}

	if !offer.IsTerminal() {
		t.Fatal("expired offer must be terminal")
	}
}

function Find-GeneralMarketRoot {
    $current = (Get-Location).Path

    while ($true) {
        $goMod = Join-Path $current 'go.mod'

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $goMod -PathType Leaf) {
            $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($goMod)

            if ($content -match 'module\s+github\.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend') {
                return $current
            }
        }

        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $current) {
            break
        }

        $current = $parent
    }

    throw 'General Market backend root was not found.'
}
