package requests

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type RequestStatus string

const (
	RequestDraft     RequestStatus = "draft"
	RequestOpen      RequestStatus = "open"
	RequestFulfilled RequestStatus = "fulfilled"
	RequestCancelled RequestStatus = "cancelled"
	RequestExpired   RequestStatus = "expired"
)

type ProposalStatus string

const (
	ProposalSubmitted ProposalStatus = "submitted"
	ProposalAccepted  ProposalStatus = "accepted"
	ProposalRejected  ProposalStatus = "rejected"
	ProposalWithdrawn ProposalStatus = "withdrawn"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidRequest       = errors.New("invalid supply request")
	ErrInvalidProposal      = errors.New("invalid proposal")
	ErrInvalidCommand       = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidActor         = errors.New("invalid actor")
	ErrInvalidTransition    = errors.New("invalid lifecycle transition")
	ErrRevisionConflict     = errors.New("revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict  = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrCommandAlreadyApplied = errors.New("command already applied")
	ErrRequestNotFound      = errors.New("request not found")
	ErrProposalNotFound     = errors.New("proposal not found")
	ErrRequestNotOpen       = errors.New("request is not open")
	ErrRequestExpired       = errors.New("request has expired")
	ErrRequestNotExpired    = errors.New("request has not expired")
	ErrProposalMismatch     = errors.New("proposal does not satisfy request")
	ErrProposalAlreadyChosen = errors.New("a proposal has already been selected")
	ErrReasonRequired       = errors.New("reason is required")
	ErrDuplicateProposal    = errors.New("duplicate proposal ID")
	ErrNoEligibleProposal   = errors.New("no eligible proposal")
)

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string
}

type RequestTerms struct {
	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Title       string
	Description string

	Unit     string
	Currency string

	MinQuantity int64
	MaxQuantity int64

	MaxUnitPrice int64

	DeliveryDeadline time.Time
	ProposalDeadline time.Time
}

type ProposalInput struct {
	ProviderID string

	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Quantity int64
	Unit     string

	UnitPrice int64
	Currency  string

	DeliveryAt time.Time

	Description string
}

type Event struct {
	EntityType string
	EntityID   string

	From string
	To   string

	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string

	At       time.Time
	Revision uint64
}

type Proposal struct {
	ID        string
	RequestID string
	ProviderID string

	Status ProposalStatus

	ConfigID      string
	ConfigVersion uint64

	Quantity int64
	Unit     string

	UnitPrice int64
	Currency  string

	DeliveryAt time.Time
	Description string

	SubmittedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt   time.Time

	Revision uint64

	RejectionReason string

	History []Event
}

type SupplyRequest struct {
	ID      string
	OwnerID string

	Status RequestStatus

	Terms RequestTerms

	Revision uint64

	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time
	PublishedAt *time.Time
	SelectedAt  *time.Time
	CancelledAt *time.Time
	ExpiredAt   *time.Time

	SelectedProposalID string
	CancellationReason string

	Proposals []Proposal
	History   []Event
}

type ProposalComparison struct {
	ProposalID string
	ProviderID string

	Quantity int64
	Unit     string

	UnitPrice int64
	Currency  string

	DeliveryAt time.Time
	SubmittedAt time.Time

	Eligible bool
	Issues   []string
}

func normalizeTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
	return value.UTC()
}

func validateCommand(command CommandContext) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(command.ActorID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidActor
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.CommandID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.CorrelationID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: correlation ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateTerms(terms RequestTerms) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.ConfigID) == "" || terms.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration reference is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: title is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(terms.Unit) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(terms.Currency) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit and currency are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.MinQuantity <= 0 || terms.MaxQuantity < terms.MinQuantity {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid quantity bounds", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.MaxUnitPrice <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: maximum unit price must be positive", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if terms.DeliveryDeadline.IsZero() || terms.ProposalDeadline.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: deadlines are required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	if !terms.ProposalDeadline.Before(terms.DeliveryDeadline) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: proposal deadline must precede delivery deadline", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateProposalInput(input ProposalInput) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: provider ID is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(input.ConfigID) == "" || input.ConfigVersion == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: configuration reference is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if input.Quantity <= 0 || input.UnitPrice <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: quantity and unit price must be positive", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(input.Unit) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.Currency) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit and currency are required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	if input.DeliveryAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: delivery time is required", ErrInvalidProposal)
	}

	return nil
}

func cloneTime(source *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if source == nil {
		return nil
	}

	value := *source
	return &value
}

func cloneProposal(source Proposal) Proposal {
	result := source
	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)
	return result
}

func cloneRequest(source SupplyRequest) SupplyRequest {
	result := source

	result.PublishedAt = cloneTime(source.PublishedAt)
	result.SelectedAt = cloneTime(source.SelectedAt)
	result.CancelledAt = cloneTime(source.CancelledAt)
	result.ExpiredAt = cloneTime(source.ExpiredAt)

	result.Proposals = make([]Proposal, len(source.Proposals))
	for index, proposal := range source.Proposals {
		result.Proposals[index] = cloneProposal(proposal)
	}

	result.History = append([]Event(nil), source.History...)

	return result
}

func NewSupplyRequest(
	id string,
	ownerID string,
	terms RequestTerms,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) (SupplyRequest, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(ownerID) == "" {
		return SupplyRequest{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if err := validateTerms(terms); err != nil {
		return SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return SupplyRequest{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)
	terms.DeliveryDeadline = normalizeTime(terms.DeliveryDeadline)
	terms.ProposalDeadline = normalizeTime(terms.ProposalDeadline)
	terms.ConfigID = strings.TrimSpace(terms.ConfigID)
	terms.Title = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Title)
	terms.Description = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Description)
	terms.Unit = strings.TrimSpace(terms.Unit)
	terms.Currency = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(terms.Currency))

	request := SupplyRequest{
		ID:        strings.TrimSpace(id),
		OwnerID:   strings.TrimSpace(ownerID),
		Status:    RequestDraft,
		Terms:     terms,
		Revision:  1,
		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
		Proposals: []Proposal{},
	}

	request.History = []Event{{
		EntityType:    "request",
		EntityID:      request.ID,
		To:            string(RequestDraft),
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      request.Revision,
	}}

	return request, nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) Snapshot() SupplyRequest {
	return cloneRequest(r)
}

func (r SupplyRequest) Events() []Event {
	return append([]Event(nil), r.History...)
}

func (r SupplyRequest) IsTerminal() bool {
	return r.Status == RequestFulfilled ||
		r.Status == RequestCancelled ||
		r.Status == RequestExpired
}

func (r SupplyRequest) HasCommand(commandID string) bool {
	for _, event := range r.History {
		if event.CommandID == commandID {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected == 0 || expected != r.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) checkIdempotency(
	command CommandContext,
	entityType string,
	entityID string,
	target string,
) error {
	for _, event := range r.History {
		if event.CommandID != command.CommandID {
			continue
		}

		if event.EntityType == entityType &&
			event.EntityID == entityID &&
			event.To == target &&
			event.ActorID == command.ActorID &&
			event.CorrelationID == command.CorrelationID &&
			event.Reason == command.Reason {
			return ErrCommandAlreadyApplied
		}

		return ErrIdempotencyConflict
	}

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) record(
	entityType string,
	entityID string,
	from string,
	to string,
	command CommandContext,
	now time.Time,
) {
	r.Revision++
	r.UpdatedAt = now

	r.History = append(r.History, Event{
		EntityType:    entityType,
		EntityID:      entityID,
		From:          from,
		To:            to,
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      r.Revision,
	})
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) Publish(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestOpen)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	if err := validateTerms(r.Terms); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	r.Status = RequestOpen
	r.record("request", r.ID, string(RequestDraft), string(RequestOpen), command, now)

	value := now
	r.PublishedAt = &value

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) AddProposal(
	proposalID string,
	input ProposalInput,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(proposalID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidProposal
	}

	if err := validateProposalInput(input); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "proposal", proposalID, string(ProposalSubmitted)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	for _, existing := range r.Proposals {
		if existing.ID == proposalID {
			return ErrDuplicateProposal
		}
	}

	proposal := Proposal{
		ID:          strings.TrimSpace(proposalID),
		RequestID:   r.ID,
		ProviderID:  strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderID),
		Status:      ProposalSubmitted,
		ConfigID:    strings.TrimSpace(input.ConfigID),
		ConfigVersion: input.ConfigVersion,
		Quantity:    input.Quantity,
		Unit:        strings.TrimSpace(input.Unit),
		UnitPrice:   input.UnitPrice,
		Currency:    strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Currency)),
		DeliveryAt:  normalizeTime(input.DeliveryAt),
		Description: strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
		SubmittedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt:   now,
		Revision:    1,
	}

	proposal.History = []Event{{
		EntityType:    "proposal",
		EntityID:      proposal.ID,
		To:            string(ProposalSubmitted),
		ActorID:       command.ActorID,
		CommandID:     command.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        command.Reason,
		At:            now,
		Revision:      proposal.Revision,
	}}

	r.Proposals = append(r.Proposals, proposal)

	r.record(
		"proposal",
		proposal.ID,
		"",
		string(ProposalSubmitted),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) ValidateProposal(proposal Proposal) []string {
	issues := make([]string, 0)

	if proposal.RequestID != r.ID {
		issues = append(issues, "request_id_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.ConfigID != r.Terms.ConfigID ||
		proposal.ConfigVersion != r.Terms.ConfigVersion {
		issues = append(issues, "configuration_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.Quantity < r.Terms.MinQuantity ||
		proposal.Quantity > r.Terms.MaxQuantity {
		issues = append(issues, "quantity_out_of_range")
	}

	if proposal.Unit != r.Terms.Unit {
		issues = append(issues, "unit_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.Currency != r.Terms.Currency {
		issues = append(issues, "currency_mismatch")
	}

	if proposal.UnitPrice > r.Terms.MaxUnitPrice {
		issues = append(issues, "price_exceeds_limit")
	}

	if proposal.DeliveryAt.IsZero() ||
		proposal.DeliveryAt.After(r.Terms.DeliveryDeadline) {
		issues = append(issues, "delivery_deadline_exceeded")
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(proposal.ProviderID) == "" {
		issues = append(issues, "provider_missing")
	}

	return issues
}

func (r SupplyRequest) CompareProposals() []ProposalComparison {
	result := make([]ProposalComparison, 0, len(r.Proposals))

	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		issues := r.ValidateProposal(proposal)

		result = append(result, ProposalComparison{
			ProposalID:  proposal.ID,
			ProviderID:  proposal.ProviderID,
			Quantity:    proposal.Quantity,
			Unit:        proposal.Unit,
			UnitPrice:   proposal.UnitPrice,
			Currency:    proposal.Currency,
			DeliveryAt:  proposal.DeliveryAt,
			SubmittedAt: proposal.SubmittedAt,
			Eligible:    len(issues) == 0 && proposal.Status == ProposalSubmitted,
			Issues:      issues,
		})
	}

	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if result[i].Eligible != result[j].Eligible {
			return result[i].Eligible
		}

		if result[i].UnitPrice != result[j].UnitPrice {
			return result[i].UnitPrice < result[j].UnitPrice
		}

		if !result[i].DeliveryAt.Equal(result[j].DeliveryAt) {
			return result[i].DeliveryAt.Before(result[j].DeliveryAt)
		}

		if !result[i].SubmittedAt.Equal(result[j].SubmittedAt) {
			return result[i].SubmittedAt.Before(result[j].SubmittedAt)
		}

		return result[i].ProposalID < result[j].ProposalID
	})

	return result
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) SelectProposal(
	proposalID string,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	proposalID = strings.TrimSpace(proposalID)

	if proposalID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidProposal
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestFulfilled)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if !now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestExpired
	}

	selectedIndex := -1

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		if r.Proposals[index].ID == proposalID {
			selectedIndex = index
			break
		}
	}

	if selectedIndex < 0 {
		return ErrProposalNotFound
	}

	selected := r.Proposals[selectedIndex]

	if selected.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if issues := r.ValidateProposal(selected); len(issues) > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrProposalMismatch, strings.Join(issues, ","))
	}

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		from := proposal.Status

		if proposal.ID == proposalID {
			proposal.Status = ProposalAccepted
		} else {
			proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
			proposal.RejectionReason = "another proposal was selected"
		}

		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(from),
			To:            string(proposal.Status),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.Status = RequestFulfilled
	r.SelectedProposalID = proposalID

	value := now
	r.SelectedAt = &value

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(RequestOpen),
		string(RequestFulfilled),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) RejectProposal(
	proposalID string,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "proposal", proposalID, string(ProposalRejected)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.ID != proposalID {
			continue
		}

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			return ErrInvalidTransition
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = command.Reason
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})

		r.record(
			"proposal",
			proposal.ID,
			string(ProposalSubmitted),
			string(ProposalRejected),
			command,
			now,
		)

		return nil
	}

	return ErrProposalNotFound
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) WithdrawProposal(
	proposalID string,
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "proposal", proposalID, string(ProposalWithdrawn)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrRequestNotOpen
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.ID != proposalID {
			continue
		}

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			return ErrInvalidTransition
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalWithdrawn
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{

			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalWithdrawn),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,

			At:            now,

		r.record(
			"proposal",
			proposal.ID,
			string(ProposalSubmitted),
			string(ProposalWithdrawn),
			command,
			now,
		)

		return nil
	}

	return ErrProposalNotFound
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) Cancel(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(command.Reason) == "" {
		return ErrReasonRequired
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestCancelled)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestDraft && r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	from := r.Status
	r.Status = RequestCancelled
	r.CancellationReason = command.Reason

	value := now
	r.CancelledAt = &value

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = "request cancelled"
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(from),
		string(RequestCancelled),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r *SupplyRequest) Expire(
	command CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if r == nil {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	if err := validateCommand(command); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := r.checkIdempotency(command, "request", r.ID, string(RequestExpired)); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrCommandAlreadyApplied) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}

	if r.Status != RequestOpen {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if err := r.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	now = normalizeTime(now)

	if now.Before(r.Terms.ProposalDeadline) {
		return ErrRequestNotExpired
	}

	from := r.Status
	r.Status = RequestExpired

	value := now
	r.ExpiredAt = &value

	for index := range r.Proposals {
		proposal := &r.Proposals[index]

		if proposal.Status != ProposalSubmitted {
			continue
		}

		proposal.Status = ProposalRejected
		proposal.RejectionReason = "request expired"
		proposal.Revision++
		proposal.UpdatedAt = now

		proposal.History = append(proposal.History, Event{
			EntityType:    "proposal",
			EntityID:      proposal.ID,
			From:          string(ProposalSubmitted),
			To:            string(ProposalRejected),
			ActorID:       command.ActorID,
			CommandID:     command.CommandID,
			CorrelationID: command.CorrelationID,
			Reason:        command.Reason,
			At:            now,
			Revision:      proposal.Revision,
		})
	}

	r.record(
		"request",
		r.ID,
		string(from),
		string(RequestExpired),
		command,
		now,
	)

	return nil
}

func (r SupplyRequest) ProposalByID(id string) (Proposal, error) {
	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		if proposal.ID == id {
			return cloneProposal(proposal), nil
		}
	}

	return Proposal{}, ErrProposalNotFound
}

func (r SupplyRequest) EligibleProposals() []Proposal {
	result := make([]Proposal, 0)

	for _, proposal := range r.Proposals {
		if proposal.Status == ProposalSubmitted &&
			len(r.ValidateProposal(proposal)) == 0 {
			result = append(result, cloneProposal(proposal))
		}
	}

	return result
}
'@

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # contracts.go
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $ContractsSource = @'
package requests

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

var (
	ErrRequestExists = errors.New("supply request already exists")
)

type Repository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, requestID string) (SupplyRequest, error)

	Create(ctx context.Context, request SupplyRequest) error

	Save(
		ctx context.Context,
		request SupplyRequest,
		expectedRevision uint64,
	) error
}

type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(
		ctx context.Context,
		fn func(context.Context) error,
	) error
}

type AuditSink interface {
	Append(
		ctx context.Context,
		events []Event,
	) error
}

// Repository implementations must enforce optimistic concurrency using
// expectedRevision. Request and proposal changes must be persisted as
// one aggregate operation.
//
// TransactionManager must commit request state, proposal state and audit
// events atomically.
//
// AuditSink must preserve event order and must not silently discard events.
//
// These are integration contracts only. No storage adapter is provided.
'@

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # requests_test.go
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $TestsSource = @'
package requests

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func baseTime() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
}

func command(id string) CommandContext {
	return CommandContext{
		ActorID:       "actor-1",
		CommandID:     id,
		CorrelationID: "corr-1",
	}
}

func terms() RequestTerms {
	return RequestTerms{
		ConfigID:         "config-1",
		ConfigVersion:    2,
		Title:            "Supply request",
		Description:      "Test request",
		Unit:             "kg",
		Currency:         "IRR",
		MinQuantity:      100,
		MaxQuantity:      1000,
		MaxUnitPrice:     500,
		DeliveryDeadline: baseTime().Add(72 * time.Hour),
		ProposalDeadline: baseTime().Add(24 * time.Hour),
	}
}

func newRequest(t *testing.T) SupplyRequest {
	t.Helper()

	request, err := NewSupplyRequest(
		"request-1",
		"owner-1",
		terms(),
		command("create-1"),
		baseTime(),
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewSupplyRequest: %v", err)
	}

	return request
}

	return ProposalInput{
		ProviderID:    provider,
		ConfigID:      "config-1",
		ConfigVersion: 2,
		Quantity:      500,
		Unit:          "kg",
		UnitPrice:     price,
		Currency:      "IRR",
		DeliveryAt:    baseTime().Add(48 * time.Hour),
		Description:   "Valid proposal",
	}
}

	t.Helper()

	request := newRequest(t)

	if err := request.Publish(
		command("publish-1"),
		request.Revision,
		baseTime().Add(time.Minute),
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Publish: %v", err)
	}

	return request

		request.Revision,
		baseTime().Add(2*time.Minute),
	)

		t.Fatalf("AddProposal %s: %v", id, err)
	}
}

func TestNewSupplyRequest(t *testing.T) {
	request := newRequest(t)

	if request.Status != RequestDraft {
		t.Fatalf("expected draft, got %s", request.Status)
	}

	if request.Revision != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision 1, got %d", request.Revision)
	}

	if len(request.History) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one creation event, got %d", len(request.History))
	}
}

func TestInvalidTerms(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		edit func(*RequestTerms)
	}{
		{"missing config", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.ConfigID = "" }},
		{"zero version", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.ConfigVersion = 0 }},
		{"missing title", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.Title = "" }},
		{"invalid quantity", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.MinQuantity = 0 }},
		{"max below min", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.MaxQuantity = 10 }},
		{"invalid price", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.MaxUnitPrice = 0 }},
		{"deadline order", func(v *RequestTerms) { v.ProposalDeadline = v.DeliveryDeadline }},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			value := terms()
			test.edit(&value)

			_, err := NewSupplyRequest(
				"request-1",
				"owner-1",
				value,
				command("create-"+test.name),
				baseTime(),
			)

			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected validation error")
			}
		})
	}
}

	if request.Status != RequestOpen {
		t.Fatalf("expected open, got %s", request.Status)

		t.Fatalf("expected revision 2, got %d", request.Revision)
	}
}

	request := newRequest(t)

	err := request.Publish(
		command("publish-1"),
		request.Revision,
		request.Terms.ProposalDeadline,
	)

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRequestExpired) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrRequestExpired, got %v", err)
	}

	if request.Status != RequestDraft {
		t.Fatal("failed publication changed status")
	}
}

		t.Fatalf("expected one proposal, got %d", len(request.Proposals))

	if request.Proposals[0].Status != ProposalSubmitted {
		t.Fatal("proposal must be submitted")

	if request.Revision != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision 3, got %d", request.Revision)
	}
}

	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-1", "provider-1", 300)

	err := request.AddProposal(
		"proposal-1",

		command("submit-duplicate"),
		request.Revision,
		baseTime().Add(3*time.Minute),
	)

		t.Fatalf("expected duplicate proposal error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestProposalValidation(t *testing.T) {
	request := openRequest(t)

	input := proposalInput("provider-1", 600)
	input.Quantity = 2000
	input.Currency = "USD"
	input.Unit = "ton"
	input.ConfigVersion = 99
	input.DeliveryAt = request.Terms.DeliveryDeadline.Add(time.Hour)

	if err := request.AddProposal(
		"proposal-1",
		input,
		command("submit-1"),
		request.Revision,
		baseTime().Add(2*time.Minute),
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	issues := request.ValidateProposal(request.Proposals[0])

	if len(issues) < 5 {
		t.Fatalf("expected multiple validation issues, got %v", issues)
	}
}

func TestCompareProposals(t *testing.T) {
	request := openRequest(t)

	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-expensive", "provider-1", 450)
	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-cheap", "provider-2", 250)
	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-middle", "provider-3", 350)

	comparison := request.CompareProposals()

	if len(comparison) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected three comparison rows, got %d", len(comparison))
	}

	if comparison[0].ProposalID != "proposal-cheap" {
		t.Fatalf("expected cheapest proposal first, got %s", comparison[0].ProposalID)
	}

	if !comparison[0].Eligible {
		t.Fatal("valid proposal must be eligible")
	}
}

func TestSelectProposal(t *testing.T) {
	request := openRequest(t)

	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-1", "provider-1", 300)

	}

	if second.Status != ProposalRejected {
		t.Fatalf("expected rejected, got %s", second.Status)
	}
}

func TestSelectionIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	request := openRequest(t)

	addProposal(t, &request, "proposal-1", "provider-1", 300)

	commandValue := command("select-1")
	now := baseTime().Add(5 * time.Minute)

	if err := request.SelectProposal(
		"proposal-1",
		commandValue,
		request.Revision,
		now,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	revision := request.Revision
	historyLength := len(request.History)

	if err := request.SelectProposal(
		"proposal-1",
		commandValue,
		1,
		now,
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("idempotent retry failed: %v", err)
	}

	if request.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry changed revision")
	}

	if len(request.History) != historyLength {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry duplicated history")
	}
}

func TestIdempotencyConflict(t *testing.T) {

function Write-SourceFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content
    )

    $Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $Encoding)
}

function Restore-PackageFiles {
    foreach ($Target in $script:CreatedFiles) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Target -Force
        }
    }

    foreach ($Entry in $script:OriginalFiles.GetEnumerator()) {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Entry.Key, $Entry.Value)
    }

package orders

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidOrder             = errors.New("invalid order")
	ErrInvalidSide              = errors.New("invalid order side")
	ErrInvalidStatus            = errors.New("invalid order status")
	ErrInvalidQuantity           = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrInvalidPrice              = errors.New("invalid price")
	ErrInvalidReservation        = errors.New("invalid asset reservation")
	ErrReservationRequired       = errors.New("active reservation is required")
	ErrOrderNotOpen              = errors.New("order is not open")
	ErrOrderNotCancellable       = errors.New("order cannot be cancelled")
	ErrOrderAlreadyClosed        = errors.New("order is already closed")
	ErrRevisionConflict          = errors.New("order revision conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict       = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrInvalidCommand            = errors.New("invalid command context")
	ErrInvalidExecution          = errors.New("invalid execution")
	ErrDuplicateExecution        = errors.New("execution already applied")
	ErrOverfill                  = errors.New("execution exceeds remaining quantity")
	ErrInvalidTimeInForce        = errors.New("invalid time in force")
	ErrInvalidBookQuery          = errors.New("invalid order book query")
	ErrOrderNotFound             = errors.New("order not found")
	ErrReservationAlreadySet     = errors.New("reservation is already assigned")
	ErrInvalidExpiration         = errors.New("invalid expiration time")
	ErrInvalidReservationRelease = errors.New("reservation release is not permitted")
)

type Side string

const (
	Buy  Side = "buy"
	Sell Side = "sell"
)

type Status string

const (
	StatusPendingReservation Status = "pending_reservation"
	StatusOpen               Status = "open"
	StatusPartiallyFilled    Status = "partially_filled"
	StatusFilled             Status = "filled"
	StatusCancelled          Status = "cancelled"
	StatusExpired            Status = "expired"
	StatusRejected           Status = "rejected"
)

type TimeInForce string

const (
	GTC TimeInForce = "good_till_cancelled"
	GTD TimeInForce = "good_till_date"
)

type ReservationStatus string

const (
	ReservationNone     ReservationStatus = "none"
	ReservationActive   ReservationStatus = "active"
	ReservationReleased ReservationStatus = "released"
)

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	Reason        string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
}

func (c CommandContext) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(c.CommandID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(c.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		c.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	return nil
}

type CreateInput struct {
	OrderID          string
	OwnerID          string
	MarketID         string
	InstrumentID     string
	OfferID          string
	ConfigurationID string
	ConfigVersion    uint64
	Side             Side
	Quantity         int64
	LimitPrice       int64
	Unit             string
	Currency         string
	TimeInForce      TimeInForce
	ExpiresAt        *time.Time
	CreatedAt        time.Time
}

type Reservation struct {
	ReferenceID string
	Status      ReservationStatus
	ReservedFor int64
	Currency    string
	ExpiresAt   *time.Time
}

type Event struct {
	EventID       string
	CommandID     string
	CorrelationID string
	ActorID       string
	OrderID       string
	Type          string
	FromStatus    Status
	ToStatus      Status
	Quantity      int64
	ExecutionID   string
	Reason        string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	Revision      uint64
}

type CommandRecord struct {
	CommandID  string
	Fingerprint string
}

type ExecutionRecord struct {
	ExecutionID string
	Quantity    int64
	OccurredAt  time.Time
}

type Order struct {
	ID               string
	OwnerID          string
	MarketID         string
	InstrumentID     string
	OfferID          string
	ConfigurationID  string
	ConfigVersion    uint64
	Side             Side
	Quantity         int64
	Remaining        int64
	Filled           int64
	LimitPrice       int64
	Unit             string
	Currency         string
	TimeInForce      TimeInForce
	Status           Status
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
	ExpiresAt        *time.Time
	Revision         uint64
	Reservation      Reservation
	History          []Event
	Commands         []CommandRecord
	Executions       []ExecutionRecord
}

func NewOrder(in CreateInput) (*Order, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(in.OrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.OwnerID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.MarketID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.InstrumentID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.OfferID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.ConfigurationID) == "" ||
		in.ConfigVersion == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.Unit) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(in.Currency) == "" ||
		in.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidOrder
	}

	if in.Side != Buy && in.Side != Sell {
		return nil, ErrInvalidSide
	}
	if in.Quantity <= 0 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	if in.LimitPrice <= 0 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidPrice
	}
	if in.TimeInForce != GTC && in.TimeInForce != GTD {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTimeInForce
	}
	if in.TimeInForce == GTD {
		if in.ExpiresAt == nil || !in.ExpiresAt.After(in.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidExpiration
		}
	}
	if in.TimeInForce == GTC && in.ExpiresAt != nil {
		return nil, ErrInvalidExpiration
	}

	o := &Order{
		ID:              strings.TrimSpace(in.OrderID),
		OwnerID:         strings.TrimSpace(in.OwnerID),
		MarketID:        strings.TrimSpace(in.MarketID),
		InstrumentID:    strings.TrimSpace(in.InstrumentID),
		OfferID:         strings.TrimSpace(in.OfferID),
		ConfigurationID: strings.TrimSpace(in.ConfigurationID),
		ConfigVersion:   in.ConfigVersion,
		Side:            in.Side,
		Quantity:        in.Quantity,
		Remaining:       in.Quantity,
		LimitPrice:      in.LimitPrice,
		Unit:            strings.TrimSpace(in.Unit),
		Currency:        strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(in.Currency)),
		TimeInForce:     in.TimeInForce,
		Status:          StatusPendingReservation,
		CreatedAt:       in.CreatedAt.UTC(),
		UpdatedAt:       in.CreatedAt.UTC(),
		Revision:        1,
		Reservation: Reservation{
			Status: ReservationNone,
		},
	}

	if in.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := in.ExpiresAt.UTC()
		o.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	return o, nil
}

func (o *Order) Clone() *Order {
	if o == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c := *o
	if o.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := *o.ExpiresAt
		c.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	if o.Reservation.ExpiresAt != nil {
		t := *o.Reservation.ExpiresAt
		c.Reservation.ExpiresAt = &t
	}
	c.History = append([]Event(nil), o.History...)
	c.Commands = append([]CommandRecord(nil), o.Commands...)
	c.Executions = append([]ExecutionRecord(nil), o.Executions...)
	return &c
}

func (o *Order) record(ctx CommandContext, eventType string, from, to Status, quantity int64, executionID, reason string) {
	o.Revision++
	o.UpdatedAt = ctx.OccurredAt.UTC()

	e := Event{
		EventID:       fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", o.ID, o.Revision),
		CommandID:     ctx.CommandID,
		CorrelationID: ctx.CorrelationID,
		ActorID:       ctx.ActorID,
		OrderID:       o.ID,
		Type:          eventType,
		FromStatus:    from,
		ToStatus:      to,
		Quantity:      quantity,
		ExecutionID:   executionID,
		Reason:        reason,
		OccurredAt:    ctx.OccurredAt.UTC(),
		Revision:      o.Revision,
	}
	o.History = append(o.History, e)
}

func (o *Order) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected != o.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) checkCommand(ctx CommandContext, fingerprint string) (bool, error) {
	if err := ctx.Validate(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, old := range o.Commands {
		if old.CommandID == ctx.CommandID {
			if old.Fingerprint != fingerprint {
				return false, ErrIdempotencyConflict
			}
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

func (o *Order) saveCommand(ctx CommandContext, fingerprint string) {
	o.Commands = append(o.Commands, CommandRecord{
		CommandID: ctx.CommandID,
		Fingerprint: fingerprint,
	})
}

func (o *Order) AttachReservation(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reservation Reservation) error {
	fp := fmt.Sprintf("attach|%s|%s|%d|%s", o.ID, reservation.ReferenceID, reservation.ReservedFor, reservation.Currency)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusPendingReservation {
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reservation.ReferenceID) == "" ||
		reservation.Status != ReservationActive ||
		reservation.ReservedFor <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if reservation.ReservedFor < o.Quantity {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if o.Side == Buy && !strings.EqualFold(reservation.Currency, o.Currency) {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}
	if o.Reservation.Status != ReservationNone {
		return ErrReservationAlreadySet
	}
	if reservation.ExpiresAt != nil && !reservation.ExpiresAt.After(ctx.OccurredAt) {
		return ErrInvalidReservation
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Reservation = reservation
	o.Reservation.Currency = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(reservation.Currency))
	o.Status = StatusOpen
	o.record(ctx, "order.opened", from, o.Status, o.Quantity, "", "")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Reject(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reason string) error {
	fp := "reject|" + o.ID + "|" + strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusPendingReservation {
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusRejected
	o.record(ctx, "order.rejected", from, o.Status, 0, "", reason)
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) ApplyExecution(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, executionID string, quantity int64) error {
	executionID = strings.TrimSpace(executionID)
	fp := fmt.Sprintf("execution|%s|%s|%d", o.ID, executionID, quantity)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if executionID == "" || quantity <= 0 {
		return ErrInvalidExecution
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		return ErrOrderNotOpen
	}
	for _, old := range o.Executions {
		if old.ExecutionID == executionID {
			return ErrDuplicateExecution
		}
	}
	if quantity > o.Remaining {
		return ErrOverfill
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Remaining -= quantity
	o.Filled += quantity
	if o.Remaining == 0 {
		o.Status = StatusFilled
	} else {
		o.Status = StatusPartiallyFilled
	}
	o.Executions = append(o.Executions, ExecutionRecord{
		ExecutionID: executionID,
		Quantity: quantity,
		OccurredAt: ctx.OccurredAt.UTC(),
	})
	o.record(ctx, "order.execution_applied", from, o.Status, quantity, executionID, "")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Cancel(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64, reason string) error {
	fp := "cancel|" + o.ID + "|" + strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		if o.Status == StatusFilled || o.Status == StatusCancelled || o.Status == StatusExpired || o.Status == StatusRejected {
			return ErrOrderAlreadyClosed
		}
		return ErrOrderNotCancellable
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusCancelled
	o.record(ctx, "order.cancelled", from, o.Status, o.Remaining, "", reason)
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) Expire(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64) error {
	fp := "expire|" + o.ID
	replayed, err := o.checkCommand(ctx, fp)
	if err != nil || replayed {
		return err
	}
	if err := o.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if o.TimeInForce != GTD || o.ExpiresAt == nil || ctx.OccurredAt.Before(*o.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidExpiration
	}
	if o.Status != StatusOpen && o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled {
		if o.Status == StatusFilled || o.Status == StatusCancelled || o.Status == StatusExpired || o.Status == StatusRejected {
			return ErrOrderAlreadyClosed
		}
		return ErrOrderNotOpen
	}
	from := o.Status
	o.Status = StatusExpired
	o.record(ctx, "order.expired", from, o.Status, o.Remaining, "", "time_in_force_expired")
	o.saveCommand(ctx, fp)
	return nil
}

func (o *Order) IsVisibleInBook() bool {
	return o != nil && (o.Status == StatusOpen || o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled) && o.Remaining > 0
}

func (o *Order) IsExpired(at time.Time) bool {
	return o != nil && o.ExpiresAt != nil && !at.Before(*o.ExpiresAt)
}

func (o *Order) ValidateInvariant() error {
	if o == nil || o.ID == "" || o.OwnerID == "" || o.MarketID == "" ||
		o.InstrumentID == "" || o.OfferID == "" || o.ConfigurationID == "" ||
		o.ConfigVersion == 0 || o.Quantity <= 0 || o.LimitPrice <= 0 ||
		o.Remaining < 0 || o.Filled < 0 || o.Filled+o.Remaining != o.Quantity {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	if o.Side != Buy && o.Side != Sell {
		return ErrInvalidSide
	}
	switch o.Status {
	case StatusPendingReservation, StatusOpen, StatusPartiallyFilled, StatusFilled, StatusCancelled, StatusExpired, StatusRejected:
	default:
		return ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if o.Status == StatusOpen || o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled || o.Status == StatusFilled {
		if o.Reservation.Status != ReservationActive && o.Reservation.Status != ReservationReleased {
			return ErrInvalidReservation
		}
		if o.Reservation.ReferenceID == "" {
			return ErrInvalidReservation
		}
	}
	if o.Status == StatusFilled && o.Remaining != 0 {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	if o.Status == StatusPartiallyFilled && (o.Filled <= 0 || o.Remaining <= 0) {
		return ErrInvalidOrder
	}
	return nil
}

type BookQuery struct {
	MarketID     string
	InstrumentID string
	Side         Side
	Limit        int
	AfterPrice   int64
	AfterTime    time.Time
	AfterOrderID string
}

type BookPage struct {
	Orders      []*Order
	NextCursor  *BookCursor
	HasMore     bool
}

type BookCursor struct {
	Price   int64
	CreatedAt time.Time
	OrderID string
}

func ValidateBookQuery(q BookQuery) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(q.MarketID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(q.InstrumentID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	if q.Side != Buy && q.Side != Sell {
		return ErrInvalidSide
	}
	if q.Limit < 1 || q.Limit > 500 {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	if q.AfterOrderID != "" && q.AfterTime.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidBookQuery
	}
	return nil
}

// SortBook applies price-time priority.
// Buy: higher price first. Sell: lower price first.
// Ties: earlier creation time, then lexicographically smaller order ID.
func SortBook(orders []*Order, side Side) ([]*Order, error) {
	if side != Buy && side != Sell {
		return nil, ErrInvalidSide
	}
	result := make([]*Order, 0, len(orders))
	for _, o := range orders {
		if o == nil || !o.IsVisibleInBook() || o.Side != side {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, o.Clone())
	}
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := result[i], result[j]
		if a.LimitPrice != b.LimitPrice {
			if side == Buy {
				return a.LimitPrice > b.LimitPrice
			}
			return a.LimitPrice < b.LimitPrice
		}
		if !a.CreatedAt.Equal(b.CreatedAt) {
			return a.CreatedAt.Before(b.CreatedAt)
		}
		return a.ID < b.ID
	})
	return result, nil
}

func PageBook(orders []*Order, q BookQuery) (BookPage, error) {
	if err := ValidateBookQuery(q); err != nil {
		return BookPage{}, err
	}
	sorted, err := SortBook(orders, q.Side)
	if err != nil {
		return BookPage{}, err
	}

	filtered := make([]*Order, 0, len(sorted))
	for _, o := range sorted {
		if o.MarketID != q.MarketID || o.InstrumentID != q.InstrumentID {
			continue
		}
		if q.AfterOrderID != "" && !isAfterCursor(o, q) {
			continue
		}
		filtered = append(filtered, o)
	}

	hasMore := len(filtered) > q.Limit
	if hasMore {
		filtered = filtered[:q.Limit]
	}
	page := BookPage{Orders: filtered, HasMore: hasMore}
	if hasMore && len(filtered) > 0 {
		last := filtered[len(filtered)-1]
		page.NextCursor = &BookCursor{
			Price: last.LimitPrice,
			CreatedAt: last.CreatedAt,
			OrderID: last.ID,
		}
	}
	return page, nil
}

func isAfterCursor(o *Order, q BookQuery) bool {
	if q.Side == Buy {
		if o.LimitPrice < q.AfterPrice {
			return true
		}
		if o.LimitPrice > q.AfterPrice {
			return false
		}
	} else {
		if o.LimitPrice > q.AfterPrice {
			return true
		}
		if o.LimitPrice < q.AfterPrice {
			return false
		}
	}
	if !o.CreatedAt.Equal(q.AfterTime) {
		return o.CreatedAt.After(q.AfterTime)
	}
	return o.ID > q.AfterOrderID
}
'@

    $ContractsGo = @'
package orders

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// AssetReservationRequest asks My Assets to reserve resources.
// The General Market service must not calculate or persist balances.
type AssetReservationRequest struct {
	OwnerID        string
	OrderID        string
	Side           Side
	Quantity       int64
	LimitPrice     int64
	Currency       string
	Unit           string
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  string
	ExpiresAt      *time.Time
}

// AssetReservationPort is an external-service contract.
// Implementations must provide idempotent reserve/release semantics.
type AssetReservationPort interface {
	Reserve(ctx context.Context, request AssetReservationRequest) (Reservation, error)
	Release(ctx context.Context, reservationReference string, idempotencyKey string, correlationID string) error
}

// OrderRepository is a persistence contract, not a storage implementation.
// Save must enforce optimistic revision checks.
type OrderRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, orderID string) (*Order, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, order *Order, expectedRevision uint64) error
}

// OrderTransactionRunner defines the transaction boundary for local
// General Market persistence only. It does not imply a distributed
// transaction with My Assets or any other external service.
type OrderTransactionRunner interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

// OrderBookRepository is a read contract for an order-book projection.
// Implementations must return only visible orders for the requested scope.
type OrderBookRepository interface {
	ListVisible(ctx context.Context, query BookQuery) (BookPage, error)
}

// ReservationReleaseCommand carries an explicit release request.
// The release operation is owned by My Assets.
type ReservationReleaseCommand struct {
	ReservationReference string
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CorrelationID        string
	Reason               string
}

// ReservationReleasePolicy documents when an order workflow should ask
// My Assets to release the remaining reservation.
type ReservationReleasePolicy interface {
	ReleaseAfterTerminalOrder(ctx context.Context, command ReservationReleaseCommand) error
}

	t.Helper()

		Quantity: quantity,

		TimeInForce: GTC,
		CreatedAt: created,

func TestNewOrderValidation(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	_, err := NewOrder(CreateInput{
		OrderID: "o1", OwnerID: "u1", MarketID: "m1",
		InstrumentID: "i1", OfferID: "f1", ConfigurationID: "c1",
		ConfigVersion: 1, Side: Buy, Quantity: 0, LimitPrice: 100,
		Unit: "kg", Currency: "IRR", TimeInForce: GTC, CreatedAt: now,
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidQuantity) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidQuantity, got %v", err)

		OrderID: "o1", OwnerID: "u1", MarketID: "m1",
		InstrumentID: "i1", OfferID: "f1", ConfigurationID: "c1",
		ConfigVersion: 1, Side: Buy, Quantity: 10, LimitPrice: 0,
		Unit: "kg", Currency: "IRR", TimeInForce: GTC, CreatedAt: now,
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPrice) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidPrice, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestReservationRequiredBeforeBookVisibility(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	o := newTestOrder(t, "o1", Buy, 100, 10, now)

	if o.IsVisibleInBook() {
		t.Fatal("pending order must not be visible")
	}
	if err := o.ValidateInvariant(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invariant: %v", err)
	}

	openTestOrder(t, o, now.Add(time.Second))
	if !o.IsVisibleInBook() {
		t.Fatal("reserved open order should be visible")
	}
}

func TestAttachReservationIdempotency(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	o := newTestOrder(t, "o1", Buy, 100, 10, now)
	ctx := testContext("reserve-1", now.Add(time.Second))
	reservation := Reservation{
		ReferenceID: "r1",
		Status: ReservationActive,
		ReservedFor: 10,
		Currency: "IRR",
	}

	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, o.Revision, reservation); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	revision := o.Revision

	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, 1, reservation); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("identical retry should be successful: %v", err)
	}
	if o.Revision != revision {
		t.Fatal("idempotent retry changed revision")
	}

	changed := reservation
	changed.ReferenceID = "different"
	if err := o.AttachReservation(ctx, 1, changed); !errors.Is(err, ErrIdempotencyConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected idempotency conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

}

func TestExecutionSupportsPartialFill(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	o := newTestOrder(t, "o1", Buy, 100, 10, now)
	openTestOrder(t, o, now.Add(time.Second))

	if err := o.ApplyExecution(testContext("exec-1", now.Add(2*time.Second)), o.Revision, "trade-1", 4); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if o.Status != StatusPartiallyFilled || o.Filled != 4 || o.Remaining != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected partial fill state: %#v", o)
	}

	if err := o.ApplyExecution(testContext("exec-2", now.Add(3*time.Second)), o.Revision, "trade-2", 6); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if o.Status != StatusFilled || o.Filled != 10 || o.Remaining != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected filled state: %#v", o)
	}
	if err := o.ValidateInvariant(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

	now := time.Now().UTC()

		t.Fatal(err)

	}
}

func TestRevisionConflict(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	o := newTestOrder(t, "o1", Buy, 100, 10, now)

	err := o.AttachReservation(
		testContext("reserve-1", now.Add(time.Second)),
		99,
		Reservation{ReferenceID: "r1", Status: ReservationActive, ReservedFor: 10, Currency: "IRR"},
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRevisionConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

	for i, id := range want {

			t.Fatalf("position %d: expected %s, got %s", i, id, sorted[i].ID)
		}
	}
}

func TestPageBookCursorAndScope(t *testing.T) {
	base := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	orders := []*Order{
		newTestOrder(t, "a", Buy, 100, 10, base),
		newTestOrder(t, "b", Buy, 100, 10, base.Add(time.Minute)),
		newTestOrder(t, "c", Buy, 90, 10, base.Add(2*time.Minute)),
	}
	for _, o := range orders {
		openTestOrder(t, o, base.Add(3*time.Minute))
	}
	other := newTestOrder(t, "other", Buy, 200, 10, base)
	other.MarketID = "another-market"
	openTestOrder(t, other, base.Add(3*time.Minute))
	orders = append(orders, other)

	first, err := PageBook(orders, BookQuery{
		MarketID: "market-1", InstrumentID: "instrument-1", Side: Buy, Limit: 2,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(first.Orders) != 2 || !first.HasMore || first.NextCursor == nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first page: %#v", first)
	}

	second, err := PageBook(orders, BookQuery{
		MarketID: "market-1", InstrumentID: "instrument-1", Side: Buy, Limit: 2,
		AfterPrice: first.NextCursor.Price,
		AfterTime: first.NextCursor.CreatedAt,
		AfterOrderID: first.NextCursor.OrderID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(second.Orders) != 1 || second.Orders[0].ID != "c" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected second page: %#v", second)
	}
}

	if o.History[0].Type == "changed" || len(o.Executions) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("clone mutation leaked into original")
	}
}

function Write-SourceFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content
    )

    $Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $Encoding)
}

function Restore-PackageFiles {
    foreach ($Target in $script:CreatedFiles) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Target -Force
        }
    }

    foreach ($Entry in $script:OriginalFiles.GetEnumerator()) {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Entry.Key, $Entry.Value)
    }
}

    Write-Host "GENERAL MARKET - PACKAGE 06" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "MATCHING ENGINE & TRADE MANAGEMENT" -ForegroundColor Cyan

package matching

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/orders"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidMatchRequest = errors.New("invalid match request")
	ErrOrderNotEligible    = errors.New("order is not eligible for matching")
	ErrOrdersDoNotCross    = errors.New("buy and sell prices do not cross")
	ErrSelfTrade           = errors.New("self trade is not permitted")
	ErrMarketMismatch      = errors.New("orders belong to different markets")
	ErrInstrumentMismatch = errors.New("orders refer to different instruments")
	ErrTermsMismatch       = errors.New("order terms are incompatible")
	ErrTradeNotFound       = errors.New("trade not found")
	ErrTradeAlreadyExists  = errors.New("trade already exists")
	ErrInvalidTradeState   = errors.New("invalid trade state")
	ErrMatchConflict       = errors.New("matching idempotency conflict")
	ErrInvalidTrade        = errors.New("invalid trade")
	ErrInvalidBook         = errors.New("invalid matching book")
)

type MatchStatus string

const (
	MatchCreated MatchStatus = "created"
	MatchApplied MatchStatus = "applied"
)

type TradeStatus string

const (
	TradeMatched TradeStatus = "matched"
	TradeVoided  TradeStatus = "voided"
)

type MatchRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey       string
	CorrelationID        string
	ActorID              string
	BuyOrderID           string
	SellOrderID          string
	ExpectedBuyRevision  uint64
	ExpectedSellRevision uint64
	OccurredAt           time.Time
}

type MatchRecord struct {
	ID             string
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  string
	BuyOrderID     string
	SellOrderID    string
	TradeID        string
	Quantity       int64
	Price          int64
	OccurredAt     time.Time
	Status         MatchStatus
}

type Trade struct {
	ID             string
	MatchID        string
	MarketID       string
	InstrumentID   string
	BuyOrderID     string
	SellOrderID    string
	BuyerID        string
	SellerID       string
	Quantity       int64
	Price          int64
	Unit           string
	Currency       string
	Status         TradeStatus
	MatchedAt      time.Time
	CorrelationID  string
	Revision       uint64
}

type MatchResult struct {
	Match       MatchRecord
	Trade       Trade
	BuyOrder    *orders.Order
	SellOrder   *orders.Order
	Replayed    bool
}

type MatchFingerprint struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	Fingerprint    string
	MatchID        string
	TradeID        string
}

type Engine struct{}

func NewEngine() *Engine {
	return &Engine{}
}

func (e *Engine) MatchPair(buy, sell *orders.Order, request MatchRequest) (MatchResult, error) {
	if e == nil || buy == nil || sell == nil {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidMatchRequest
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(request.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.CorrelationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.BuyOrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.SellOrderID) == "" ||
		request.OccurredAt.IsZero() ||
		request.ExpectedBuyRevision == 0 ||
		request.ExpectedSellRevision == 0 {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidMatchRequest
	}
	if request.BuyOrderID != buy.ID || request.SellOrderID != sell.ID {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidMatchRequest
	}
	if buy.ID == sell.ID {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrSelfTrade
	}

	if err := validateEligibleOrder(buy, orders.Buy); err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, err
	}
	if err := validateEligibleOrder(sell, orders.Sell); err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, err
	}

	if buy.MarketID != sell.MarketID {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrMarketMismatch
	}
	if buy.InstrumentID != sell.InstrumentID {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInstrumentMismatch
	}
	if !strings.EqualFold(buy.Currency, sell.Currency) ||
		!strings.EqualFold(buy.Unit, sell.Unit) {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrTermsMismatch
	}
	if buy.OwnerID == sell.OwnerID {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrSelfTrade
	}
	if buy.LimitPrice < sell.LimitPrice {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrOrdersDoNotCross
	}

	quantity := minInt64(buy.Remaining, sell.Remaining)
	if quantity <= 0 {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidTrade
	}

	price := executionPrice(buy, sell)
	fingerprint := requestFingerprint(request, quantity, price)
	matchID := stableID("match", request.IdempotencyKey, fingerprint)
	tradeID := stableID("match", "trade", matchID)

	buyCopy := buy.Clone()
	sellCopy := sell.Clone()

	buyCommand := orders.CommandContext{
		ActorID:       request.ActorID,
		CommandID:     "matching-" + matchID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        "matching_engine",
		OccurredAt:    request.OccurredAt.UTC(),
	}
	sellCommand := buyCommand

	if err := buyCopy.ApplyExecution(
		buyCommand,
		request.ExpectedBuyRevision,
		matchID+"-buy",
		quantity,
	); err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("apply execution to buy order: %w", err)
	}

	if err := sellCopy.ApplyExecution(
		sellCommand,
		request.ExpectedSellRevision,
		matchID+"-sell",
		quantity,
	); err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, fmt.Errorf("apply execution to sell order: %w", err)
	}

	trade := Trade{
		ID:            tradeID,
		MatchID:       matchID,
		MarketID:      buy.MarketID,
		InstrumentID:  buy.InstrumentID,
		BuyOrderID:    buy.ID,
		SellOrderID:   sell.ID,
		BuyerID:       buy.OwnerID,
		SellerID:      sell.OwnerID,
		Quantity:      quantity,
		Price:         price,
		Unit:          buy.Unit,
		Currency:      strings.ToUpper(buy.Currency),
		Status:        TradeMatched,
		MatchedAt:     request.OccurredAt.UTC(),
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		Revision:      1,
	}
	if err := trade.ValidateInvariant(); err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, err
	}

	match := MatchRecord{
		ID:             matchID,
		IdempotencyKey: request.IdempotencyKey,
		CorrelationID:  request.CorrelationID,
		BuyOrderID:     buy.ID,
		SellOrderID:    sell.ID,
		TradeID:        tradeID,
		Quantity:       quantity,
		Price:          price,
		OccurredAt:     request.OccurredAt.UTC(),
		Status:         MatchApplied,
	}

	return MatchResult{
		Match:     match,
		Trade:     trade,
		BuyOrder:  buyCopy,
		SellOrder: sellCopy,
	}, nil
}

func validateEligibleOrder(o *orders.Order, side orders.Side) error {
	if o == nil || o.Side != side {
		return ErrOrderNotEligible
	}
	if !o.IsVisibleInBook() {
		return ErrOrderNotEligible
	}
	if o.Status != orders.StatusOpen && o.Status != orders.StatusPartiallyFilled {
		return ErrOrderNotEligible
	}
	if o.Reservation.Status != orders.ReservationActive ||
		strings.TrimSpace(o.Reservation.ReferenceID) == "" {
		return ErrOrderNotEligible
	}
	if o.Remaining <= 0 || o.LimitPrice <= 0 || o.OwnerID == "" {
		return ErrOrderNotEligible
	}
	if err := o.ValidateInvariant(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrOrderNotEligible, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func executionPrice(buy, sell *orders.Order) int64 {
	if buy.CreatedAt.Before(sell.CreatedAt) {
		return buy.LimitPrice
	}
	if sell.CreatedAt.Before(buy.CreatedAt) {
		return sell.LimitPrice
	}
	if buy.ID < sell.ID {
		return buy.LimitPrice
	}
	return sell.LimitPrice
}

func minInt64(a, b int64) int64 {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func stableID(prefix, key, fingerprint string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key + "|" + fingerprint))
	return prefix + "_" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:16])
}

func requestFingerprint(r MatchRequest, quantity, price int64) string {
	raw := fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s|%s|%s|%d|%d|%d|%d",
		r.BuyOrderID,
		r.SellOrderID,
		r.CorrelationID,
		r.ExpectedBuyRevision,
		r.ExpectedSellRevision,
		quantity,
		price,
	)
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// MatchBest searches the supplied snapshots and selects the highest-priority
// compatible pair. The caller must persist the returned result atomically
// through the matching transaction boundary.
func (e *Engine) MatchBest(
	buyOrders []*orders.Order,
	sellOrders []*orders.Order,
	idempotencyKey string,
	correlationID string,
	actorID string,
	occurredAt time.Time,
) (MatchResult, error) {
	if e == nil || strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(correlationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(actorID) == "" || occurredAt.IsZero() {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidMatchRequest
	}

	buys, err := orders.SortBook(buyOrders, orders.Buy)
	if err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, err
	}
	sells, err := orders.SortBook(sellOrders, orders.Sell)
	if err != nil {
		return MatchResult{}, err
	}
	if len(buys) == 0 || len(sells) == 0 {
		return MatchResult{}, ErrInvalidBook
	}

	for _, buy := range buys {
		for _, sell := range sells {
			if buy.MarketID != sell.MarketID ||
				buy.InstrumentID != sell.InstrumentID ||
				!strings.EqualFold(buy.Currency, sell.Currency) ||
				!strings.EqualFold(buy.Unit, sell.Unit) {
				continue
			}
			if buy.LimitPrice < sell.LimitPrice {
				// Sell prices are ascending. Later sells cannot cross this buy.
				break
			}
			if buy.OwnerID == sell.OwnerID {
				continue
			}

			key := idempotencyKey + "|" + buy.ID + "|" + sell.ID
			return e.MatchPair(buy, sell, MatchRequest{
				IdempotencyKey:       key,
				CorrelationID:        correlationID,
				ActorID:              actorID,
				BuyOrderID:           buy.ID,
				SellOrderID:          sell.ID,
				ExpectedBuyRevision:  buy.Revision,
				ExpectedSellRevision: sell.Revision,
				OccurredAt:           occurredAt,
			})
		}
	}
	return MatchResult{}, ErrOrdersDoNotCross
}

func (t Trade) ValidateInvariant() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(t.ID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.MatchID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.MarketID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.InstrumentID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.BuyOrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.SellOrderID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.BuyerID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.SellerID) == "" ||
		t.BuyOrderID == t.SellOrderID ||
		t.BuyerID == t.SellerID ||
		t.Quantity <= 0 ||
		t.Price <= 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.Unit) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(t.Currency) == "" ||
		t.MatchedAt.IsZero() ||
		t.Revision == 0 {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	if t.Status != TradeMatched && t.Status != TradeVoided {
		return ErrInvalidTradeState
	}
	return nil
}

func (t *Trade) Void(reason string, expectedRevision uint64) error {
	if t == nil {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	if expectedRevision != t.Revision {
		return orders.ErrRevisionConflict
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	if t.Status != TradeMatched {
		return ErrInvalidTradeState
	}
	t.Status = TradeVoided
	t.Revision++
	return nil
}

// SortMatches gives deterministic chronological order for audit and display.
func SortMatches(records []MatchRecord) []MatchRecord {
	result := append([]MatchRecord(nil), records...)
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if !result[i].OccurredAt.Equal(result[j].OccurredAt) {
			return result[i].OccurredAt.Before(result[j].OccurredAt)
		}
		return result[i].ID < result[j].ID
	})
	return result
}

// ValidateMatchResult ensures the returned aggregate pair is internally aligned.
func ValidateMatchResult(result MatchResult) error {
	if result.BuyOrder == nil || result.SellOrder == nil {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	if err := result.Trade.ValidateInvariant(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if result.Match.ID == "" || result.Match.TradeID != result.Trade.ID ||
		result.Match.ID != result.Trade.MatchID ||
		result.Match.BuyOrderID != result.BuyOrder.ID ||
		result.Match.SellOrderID != result.SellOrder.ID ||
		result.Match.Quantity != result.Trade.Quantity ||
		result.Match.Price != result.Trade.Price {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	if result.BuyOrder.Filled < result.Trade.Quantity ||
		result.SellOrder.Filled < result.Trade.Quantity {
		return ErrInvalidTrade
	}
	return nil
}
'@

    $ContractsGo = @'
package matching

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/orders"
)

// MatchRepository stores matching records and provides idempotency lookup.
// A production adapter must enforce uniqueness for Match.ID and
// Match.IdempotencyKey within the applicable matching scope.
type MatchRepository interface {
	GetByID(ctx context.Context, matchID string) (*MatchRecord, error)
	GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx context.Context, key string) (*MatchRecord, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, record MatchRecord) error
}

// TradeRepository stores trade records independently from legal contracts
// and settlement records.
type TradeRepository interface {
	GetByID(ctx context.Context, tradeID string) (*Trade, error)
	Save(ctx context.Context, trade Trade, expectedRevision uint64) error
}

// MatchingOrderRepository loads current order aggregates and persists
// matched order snapshots using optimistic revision checks.
type MatchingOrderRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, orderID string) (*orders.Order, error)
	SaveMatchedPair(
		ctx context.Context,
		buy *orders.Order,
		expectedBuyRevision uint64,
		sell *orders.Order,
		expectedSellRevision uint64,
	) error
}

// MatchingTransactionRunner must atomically commit local General Market
// order changes, match record, and trade record.
// It does not provide a distributed transaction with external services.
type MatchingTransactionRunner interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

// MatchingCommand is the application-level request to match two orders.
type MatchingCommand struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  string
	ActorID        string
	BuyOrderID     string
	SellOrderID    string
	OccurredAt     time.Time
}

// MatchingService coordinates the domain engine and persistence ports.
// The concrete application service is implemented in a later integration
// step; this interface defines the stable application boundary.
type MatchingService interface {
	MatchPair(ctx context.Context, command MatchingCommand) (MatchResult, error)
	MatchBest(ctx context.Context, marketID, instrumentID string, command MatchingCommand) (MatchResult, error)
}

// MatchOutboxRecord is a contract for publishing committed match events.
// It is not an active queue or broker integration.
type MatchOutboxRecord struct {
	EventID       string
	AggregateID   string
	EventType     string
	CorrelationID string
	Payload       []byte
	OccurredAt    time.Time
}

// MatchOutboxRepository is a persistence contract for reliable event
// publication after the local transaction commits.
type MatchOutboxRepository interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event MatchOutboxRecord) error
}
'@

    $TestsGo = @'
package matching

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/orders"
)

func matchingOrder(t *testing.T, id, owner string, side orders.Side, price, quantity int64, created time.Time) *orders.Order {
	t.Helper()
	o, err := orders.NewOrder(orders.CreateInput{
		OrderID: id,
		OwnerID: owner,
		MarketID: "market-1",
		InstrumentID: "instrument-1",
		OfferID: "offer-1",
		ConfigurationID: "config-1",
		ConfigVersion: 1,
		Side: side,
		Quantity: quantity,
		LimitPrice: price,
		Unit: "kg",
		Currency: "IRR",
		TimeInForce: orders.GTC,
		CreatedAt: created,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewOrder: %v", err)
	}
	err = o.AttachReservation(orders.CommandContext{
		ActorID: "system",
		CommandID: "reserve-" + id,
		CorrelationID: "reserve-corr-" + id,
		OccurredAt: created.Add(time.Second),
	}, o.Revision, orders.Reservation{
		ReferenceID: "reservation-" + id,
		Status: orders.ReservationActive,
		ReservedFor: quantity,
		Currency: "IRR",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("AttachReservation: %v", err)
	}
	return o
}

func requestFor(buy, sell *orders.Order, key string, at time.Time) MatchRequest {
	return MatchRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: key,
		CorrelationID: "corr-" + key,
		ActorID: "matching-engine",
		BuyOrderID: buy.ID,
		SellOrderID: sell.ID,
		ExpectedBuyRevision: buy.Revision,
		ExpectedSellRevision: sell.Revision,
		OccurredAt: at,
	}
}

func TestMatchPairCreatesTradeAndUpdatesOrderCopies(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 120, 10, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 7, now.Add(time.Minute))

	result, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "request-1", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Trade.Quantity != 7 || result.Trade.Price != 120 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected trade values: quantity=%d price=%d", result.Trade.Quantity, result.Trade.Price)
	}
	if result.BuyOrder.Remaining != 3 || result.BuyOrder.Filled != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected buy order: %#v", result.BuyOrder)
	}
	if result.SellOrder.Remaining != 0 || result.SellOrder.Status != orders.StatusFilled {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected sell order: %#v", result.SellOrder)
	}
	if buy.Filled != 0 || sell.Filled != 0 {
		t.Fatal("MatchPair mutated caller-owned order objects")
	}
	if err := ValidateMatchResult(result); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ValidateMatchResult: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMakerPriceUsesOlderOrder(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 120, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	result, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "maker-buy", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Trade.Price != buy.LimitPrice {
		t.Fatalf("expected maker buy price %d, got %d", buy.LimitPrice, result.Trade.Price)
	}

	buy2 := matchingOrder(t, "buy-2", "buyer-2", orders.Buy, 120, 5, now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	sell2 := matchingOrder(t, "sell-2", "seller-2", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now)
	result2, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy2, sell2, requestFor(buy2, sell2, "maker-sell", now.Add(3*time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result2.Trade.Price != sell2.LimitPrice {
		t.Fatalf("expected maker sell price %d, got %d", sell2.LimitPrice, result2.Trade.Price)
	}
}

func TestMatchPairRejectsNonCrossingPrices(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 90, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	_, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "not-crossing", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrOrdersDoNotCross) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrOrdersDoNotCross, got %v", err)
	}
}

		t.Fatalf("expected ErrSelfTrade, got %v", err)
	}

func TestMatchPairRejectsMarketInstrumentAndTermMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	sell.MarketID = "another-market"

	_, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "market-mismatch", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrMarketMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrMarketMismatch, got %v", err)
	}

	sell.MarketID = buy.MarketID
	sell.InstrumentID = "another-instrument"
	_, err = NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "instrument-mismatch", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInstrumentMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInstrumentMismatch, got %v", err)
	}

	sell.InstrumentID = buy.InstrumentID
	sell.Currency = "USD"
	_, err = NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "currency-mismatch", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrTermsMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrTermsMismatch, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMatchPairRejectsWrongSideAndUnreservedOrder(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	buy.Side = orders.Sell
	_, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "wrong-side", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrOrderNotEligible) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrOrderNotEligible, got %v", err)
	}

	buy.Side = orders.Buy
	buy.Reservation.Status = orders.ReservationReleased
	_, err = NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "no-reservation", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrOrderNotEligible) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrOrderNotEligible for released reservation, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMatchPairUsesMinimumRemainingQuantity(t *testing.T) {

	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 10, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 4, now.Add(time.Minute))
