func TestStableMatchAndTradeIDs(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	req := requestFor(buy, sell, "stable-key", now.Add(2*time.Minute))

	first, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.Match.ID != second.Match.ID || first.Trade.ID != second.Trade.ID {
		t.Fatal("same request must produce stable match and trade IDs")
	}
}

func TestMatchPairRevisionConflict(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	req := requestFor(buy, sell, "revision-conflict", now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	req.ExpectedBuyRevision++

	_, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, req)
	if !errors.Is(err, orders.ErrRevisionConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMatchBestSelectsBestCrossingPair(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	buy1 := matchingOrder(t, "buy-low", "buyer-1", orders.Buy, 105, 5, now)
	buy2 := matchingOrder(t, "buy-high", "buyer-2", orders.Buy, 120, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	sell1 := matchingOrder(t, "sell-high", "seller-1", orders.Sell, 110, 5, now)
	sell2 := matchingOrder(t, "sell-low", "seller-2", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	result, err := NewEngine().MatchBest(
		[]*orders.Order{buy1, buy2},
		[]*orders.Order{sell1, sell2},
		"batch-1",
		"corr-batch-1",
		"matching-engine",
		now.Add(2*time.Minute),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Match.BuyOrderID != "buy-high" || result.Match.SellOrderID != "sell-low" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected selected pair: buy=%s sell=%s", result.Match.BuyOrderID, result.Match.SellOrderID)
	}
}

func TestMatchBestSkipsSelfTradeCandidate(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buySelf := matchingOrder(t, "buy-self", "same-owner", orders.Buy, 120, 5, now)
	buyOther := matchingOrder(t, "buy-other", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	sellSelf := matchingOrder(t, "sell-self", "same-owner", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now)
	sellOther := matchingOrder(t, "sell-other", "seller", orders.Sell, 105, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	result, err := NewEngine().MatchBest(
		[]*orders.Order{buySelf, buyOther},
		[]*orders.Order{sellSelf, sellOther},
		"batch-self",
		"corr-self",
		"matching-engine",
		now.Add(2*time.Minute),
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Match.BuyOrderID == buySelf.ID && result.Match.SellOrderID == sellSelf.ID {
		t.Fatal("self-trade candidate must be skipped")
	}
	if result.Trade.BuyerID == result.Trade.SellerID {
		t.Fatal("self-trade was produced")
	}
}

func TestTradeVoidUsesRevisionAndReason(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	result, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "void-test", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := result.Trade.Void("administrative_review", 99); !errors.Is(err, orders.ErrRevisionConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision conflict, got %v", err)
	}
	if err := result.Trade.Void("", result.Trade.Revision); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTrade) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid trade, got %v", err)
	}
	if err := result.Trade.Void("administrative_review", result.Trade.Revision); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Trade.Status != TradeVoided || result.Trade.Revision != 2 {
		t.Fatal("trade was not voided correctly")
	}
}

func TestSortMatchesIsDeterministic(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	input := []MatchRecord{
		{ID: "b", OccurredAt: now},
		{ID: "a", OccurredAt: now},
		{ID: "c", OccurredAt: now.Add(time.Second)},
	}
	sorted := SortMatches(input)
	if sorted[0].ID != "a" || sorted[1].ID != "b" || sorted[2].ID != "c" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected sorted matches: %#v", sorted)
	}
	if input[0].ID != "b" {
		t.Fatal("SortMatches must not mutate input")
	}
}

func TestValidateMatchResultRejectsMismatchedReferences(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))
	result, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "validate-result", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result.Match.TradeID = "wrong-trade"
	if err := ValidateMatchResult(result); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTrade) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidTrade, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMatchPairDoesNotMutateInputsWhenSecondExecutionFails(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	buy := matchingOrder(t, "buy-1", "buyer", orders.Buy, 110, 5, now)
	sell := matchingOrder(t, "sell-1", "seller", orders.Sell, 100, 5, now.Add(time.Minute))

	// Force the sell aggregate to fail its own invariant after construction.
	sell.Remaining = 4

	_, err := NewEngine().MatchPair(buy, sell, requestFor(buy, sell, "atomic-copy", now.Add(2*time.Minute)))
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid sell order to fail")
	}
	if buy.Filled != 0 || buy.Remaining != 5 {
		t.Fatal("buy input was mutated despite failed matching")
	}
}

const (
	StepContract   StepKind = "contract"
	StepService    StepKind = "service"
	StepPosition   StepKind = "position"
	StepSettlement StepKind = "settlement"
	StepCustom     StepKind = "custom"
)

type StepDefinition struct {
	Key              string
	Kind             StepKind
	DependsOn        []string
	Required         bool
	MaxAttempts      int
	CompensationKey  string
}

type ExecutionPolicy struct {
	ID      string
	Version uint64
	Steps   []StepDefinition
}

type StepExecution struct {
	Key             string
	Kind            StepKind
	Status          StepStatus
	Attempt         int
	MaxAttempts     int
	AttemptToken    string
	ResultReference string
	ErrorCode       string
	ErrorMessage    string
	StartedAt       *time.Time
	CompletedAt     *time.Time
	DependsOn       []string
	Required        bool
	CompensationKey string
}

type HistoryEntry struct {
	Sequence  uint64
	Action    string
	StepKey   string
	Reference string
	Reason    string
	At        time.Time
}

type Workflow struct {
	ID             string
	TradeID        string
	PolicyID       string
	PolicyVersion  uint64
	Status         WorkflowStatus
	Revision       uint64
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	UpdatedAt      time.Time
	Steps          map[string]*StepExecution
	History        []HistoryEntry
	AppliedCommands map[string]struct{}
}

type CommandContext struct {
	ActorID    string
	TraceID    string
	IdempotencyKey string
	Now        time.Time
}

func (c CommandContext) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.ActorID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: actor ID is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.IdempotencyKey) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: idempotency key is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if c.Now.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: command time is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	return nil
}

func (p ExecutionPolicy) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(p.ID) == "" || p.Version == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: policy ID and version are required", ErrInvalidPolicy)
	}
	if len(p.Steps) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one step is required", ErrInvalidPolicy)
	}

	definitions := make(map[string]StepDefinition, len(p.Steps))

	for _, step := range p.Steps {
		key := strings.TrimSpace(step.Key)
		if key == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: empty step key", ErrInvalidPolicy)
		}
		if _, exists := definitions[key]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate step key %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		if !validStepKind(step.Kind) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported step kind %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.Kind)
		}
		if step.MaxAttempts < 1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: step %q must allow at least one attempt", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		definitions[key] = step
	}

	for _, step := range p.Steps {
		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
		for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
			if dependency == step.Key {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: step %q depends on itself", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.Key)
			}
			if _, exists := definitions[dependency]; !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: dependency %q of step %q does not exist", ErrInvalidPolicy, dependency, step.Key)
			}
			if _, duplicate := seen[dependency]; duplicate {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate dependency %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, dependency)
			}
			seen[dependency] = struct{}{}
		}

		if step.CompensationKey != "" {
			compensation, exists := definitions[step.CompensationKey]
			if !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: compensation step %q does not exist", ErrInvalidPolicy, step.CompensationKey)
			}
			if compensation.CompensationKey != "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: nested compensation is not supported", ErrInvalidPolicy)
			}
		}
	}

	visiting := make(map[string]bool)
	visited := make(map[string]bool)

	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(key string) error {
		if visiting[key] {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: dependency cycle detected at %q", ErrInvalidPolicy, key)
		}
		if visited[key] {
			return nil
		}

		visiting[key] = true
		for _, dependency := range definitions[key].DependsOn {
			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		visiting[key] = false
		visited[key] = true
		return nil
	}

	for key := range definitions {
		if err := visit(key); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func validStepKind(kind StepKind) bool {
	switch kind {
	case StepContract, StepService, StepPosition, StepSettlement, StepCustom:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func NewWorkflow(id, tradeID string, policy ExecutionPolicy, now time.Time) (*Workflow, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(tradeID) == "" || now.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: workflow ID, trade ID and creation time are required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	workflow := &Workflow{
		ID:              id,
		TradeID:         tradeID,
		PolicyID:        policy.ID,
		PolicyVersion:   policy.Version,
		Status:          WorkflowDraft,
		Revision:        1,
		CreatedAt:       now,
		UpdatedAt:       now,
		Steps:           make(map[string]*StepExecution, len(policy.Steps)),
		AppliedCommands: make(map[string]struct{}),
	}

	for _, definition := range policy.Steps {
		workflow.Steps[definition.Key] = &StepExecution{
			Key:             definition.Key,
			Kind:            definition.Kind,
			Status:          StepPending,
			MaxAttempts:     definition.MaxAttempts,
			DependsOn:       append([]string(nil), definition.DependsOn...),
			Required:        definition.Required,
			CompensationKey: definition.CompensationKey,
		}
	}

	workflow.addHistory("workflow_created", "", policy.ID, "", now)
	return workflow, nil
}

func (w *Workflow) Start(ctx CommandContext, expectedRevision uint64) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowDraft {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	w.Status = WorkflowRunning
	w.commit(ctx, "workflow_started", "", "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(attemptToken) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: attempt token is required", ErrInvalidCommand)
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepPending {
		if step.Status == StepRunning {
			return ErrStepAlreadyRunning
		}
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !w.dependenciesCompleted(step) {
		return ErrDependencyPending
	}

	step.Status = StepRunning
	step.Attempt++
	step.AttemptToken = attemptToken
	step.StartedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.CompletedAt = nil
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.commit(ctx, "step_started", stepKey, attemptToken, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	resultReference string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning {
		return ErrStepNotRunning
	}
	if step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepSucceeded
	step.ResultReference = resultReference
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.refreshStatus()
	w.commit(ctx, "step_succeeded", stepKey, resultReference, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) FailStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	errorCode string,
	errorMessage string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowRunning {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning {
		return ErrStepNotRunning
	}
	if step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepFailed
	step.ErrorCode = strings.TrimSpace(errorCode)
	step.ErrorMessage = strings.TrimSpace(errorMessage)
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.AttemptToken = ""

	if step.Attempt < step.MaxAttempts {
		w.Status = WorkflowPaused
	} else {
		w.Status = WorkflowFailed
	}

	w.commit(ctx, "step_failed", stepKey, "", step.ErrorCode)
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) RetryStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowPaused {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepFailed || step.Attempt >= step.MaxAttempts {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepPending
	step.AttemptToken = ""
	step.StartedAt = nil
	step.CompletedAt = nil
	step.ErrorCode = ""
	step.ErrorMessage = ""

	w.Status = WorkflowRunning
	w.commit(ctx, "step_retry_authorized", stepKey, "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginCompensation(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowFailed {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	hasCompensation := false
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		if step.Status == StepSucceeded && step.CompensationKey != "" {
			hasCompensation = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !hasCompensation {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}

	w.Status = WorkflowCompensating
	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_started", "", "", "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteCompensation(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepSucceeded || step.CompensationKey == "" {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}

	compensation, exists := w.Steps[step.CompensationKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrCompensationMissing
	}
	if compensation.Status != StepSucceeded {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepCompensated
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)

	allCompensated := true
	for _, candidate := range w.Steps {
		if candidate.Status == StepSucceeded && candidate.CompensationKey != "" {
			allCompensated = false
			break
		}
	}

	if allCompensated {
		w.Status = WorkflowCompensated
	}

	w.commit(ctx, "step_compensated", stepKey, step.CompensationKey, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) BeginCompensationStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(attemptToken) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.CompensationKey == "" || step.Status != StepPending {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step.Status = StepRunning
	step.Attempt++
	step.AttemptToken = attemptToken
	step.StartedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)

	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_step_started", stepKey, attemptToken, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) CompleteCompensationStep(
	ctx CommandContext,
	expectedRevision uint64,
	stepKey string,
	attemptToken string,
	resultReference string,
) error {
	if err := ctx.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := w.checkRevision(expectedRevision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if w.isApplied(ctx.IdempotencyKey) {
		return ErrAlreadyApplied
	}
	if w.Status != WorkflowCompensating {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	step, exists := w.Steps[stepKey]
	if !exists {
		return ErrStepNotFound
	}
	if step.Status != StepRunning || step.AttemptToken != attemptToken {
		return ErrAttemptMismatch
	}

	step.Status = StepSucceeded
	step.ResultReference = resultReference
	step.CompletedAt = timePointer(ctx.Now)
	step.AttemptToken = ""

	w.commit(ctx, "compensation_step_succeeded", stepKey, resultReference, "")
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) dependenciesCompleted(step *StepExecution) bool {
	for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
		dep, exists := w.Steps[dependency]
		if !exists || dep.Status != StepSucceeded {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (w *Workflow) refreshStatus() {
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		if step.Required && step.Status != StepSucceeded && step.Status != StepSkipped {
			return
		}
	}
	w.Status = WorkflowCompleted
}

func (w *Workflow) checkRevision(expected uint64) error {
	if expected != w.Revision {
		return ErrRevisionConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (w *Workflow) isApplied(key string) bool {
	_, exists := w.AppliedCommands[key]
	return exists
}

func (w *Workflow) commit(
	ctx CommandContext,
	action string,
	stepKey string,
	reference string,
	reason string,
) {
	w.Revision++
	w.UpdatedAt = ctx.Now
	w.AppliedCommands[ctx.IdempotencyKey] = struct{}{}
	w.addHistory(action, stepKey, reference, reason, ctx.Now)
}

func (w *Workflow) addHistory(
	action string,
	stepKey string,
	reference string,
	reason string,
	at time.Time,
) {
	w.History = append(w.History, HistoryEntry{
		Sequence:  uint64(len(w.History) + 1),
		Action:    action,
		StepKey:   stepKey,
		Reference: reference,
		Reason:    reason,
		At:        at,
	})
}

func (w *Workflow) OrderedSteps() []StepExecution {
	result := make([]StepExecution, 0, len(w.Steps))
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		copy := *step
		copy.DependsOn = append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
		result = append(result, copy)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		return result[i].Key < result[j].Key
	})
	return result
}

func (w *Workflow) Clone() *Workflow {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}

	clone := *w
	clone.Steps = make(map[string]*StepExecution, len(w.Steps))
	for key, step := range w.Steps {
		stepCopy := *step
		stepCopy.DependsOn = append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
		if step.StartedAt != nil {
			stepCopy.StartedAt = timePointer(*step.StartedAt)
		}
		if step.CompletedAt != nil {
			stepCopy.CompletedAt = timePointer(*step.CompletedAt)
		}
		clone.Steps[key] = &stepCopy
	}
	clone.History = append([]HistoryEntry(nil), w.History...)
	clone.AppliedCommands = make(map[string]struct{}, len(w.AppliedCommands))
	for key := range w.AppliedCommands {
		clone.AppliedCommands[key] = struct{}{}
	}
	return &clone
}

func timePointer(value time.Time) *time.Time {
	copy := value
	return &copy
}
'@

    $ContractsSource = @'
package execution

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

type WorkflowRepository interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, workflowID string) (*Workflow, error)
	Create(ctx context.Context, workflow *Workflow) error
	Save(ctx context.Context, workflow *Workflow, expectedRevision uint64) error
}

type WorkflowTransactionRunner interface {
	WithinTransaction(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context) error) error
}

type ExecutionPolicyProvider interface {
	GetPolicy(ctx context.Context, policyID string, version uint64) (ExecutionPolicy, error)
}

type StepExecutor interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, command StepCommand) (StepResult, error)
}

type CompensationExecutor interface {
	Compensate(ctx context.Context, command CompensationCommand) (StepResult, error)
}

type StepCommand struct {
	WorkflowID     string
	TradeID        string
	StepKey        string
	Kind           StepKind
	Attempt        int
	AttemptToken   string
	PolicyID       string
	PolicyVersion  uint64
	TraceID        string
	IdempotencyKey string
}

type CompensationCommand struct {
	WorkflowID     string
	TradeID        string
	StepKey        string
	OriginalStep   string
	AttemptToken   string
	PolicyID       string
	PolicyVersion  uint64
	TraceID        string
	IdempotencyKey string
}

type StepResult struct {
	Reference string
	OccurredAt time.Time
}

type ExecutionCoordinator interface {
	CreateWorkflow(ctx context.Context, workflowID, tradeID, policyID string, policyVersion uint64, now time.Time) (*Workflow, error)
	StartWorkflow(ctx context.Context, workflowID string, expectedRevision uint64, command CommandContext) error
	ExecuteStep(ctx context.Context, workflowID, stepKey, attemptToken string, expectedRevision uint64, command CommandContext) error
	RetryStep(ctx context.Context, workflowID, stepKey string, expectedRevision uint64, command CommandContext) error
	BeginCompensation(ctx context.Context, workflowID string, expectedRevision uint64, command CommandContext) error
}
'@

    $TestsSource = @'
package execution

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func testPolicy() ExecutionPolicy {
	return ExecutionPolicy{
		ID:      "policy-1",
		Version: 1,
		Steps: []StepDefinition{
			{Key: "contract", Kind: StepContract, Required: true, MaxAttempts: 2, CompensationKey: "contract-reversal"},
			{Key: "contract-reversal", Kind: StepCustom, MaxAttempts: 1},
			{Key: "service", Kind: StepService, Required: true, MaxAttempts: 2, DependsOn: []string{"contract"}},
			{Key: "position", Kind: StepPosition, Required: true, MaxAttempts: 2, DependsOn: []string{"service"}},
			{Key: "settlement", Kind: StepSettlement, Required: true, MaxAttempts: 2, DependsOn: []string{"position"}},
		},
	}
}

func testContext(key string, offset int) CommandContext {
	return CommandContext{
		ActorID:        "system",
		TraceID:        "trace-1",
		IdempotencyKey: key,
		Now:            time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 10, 0, offset, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestPolicyRejectsDependencyCycle(t *testing.T) {
	policy := ExecutionPolicy{
		ID: "cycle",
		Version: 1,
		Steps: []StepDefinition{
			{Key: "a", Kind: StepCustom, MaxAttempts: 1, DependsOn: []string{"b"}},
			{Key: "b", Kind: StepCustom, MaxAttempts: 1, DependsOn: []string{"a"}},
		},
	}

	if err := policy.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPolicy) {
		t.Fatalf("expected invalid policy, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowEnforcesDependenciesAndCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-1", "trade-1", testPolicy(), time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.Start(testContext("start", 1), workflow.Revision); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("service-early", 2), workflow.Revision, "service", "token-service"); !errors.Is(err, ErrDependencyPending) {
		t.Fatalf("expected dependency error, got %v", err)
	}

	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("contract-start", 3), workflow.Revision, "contract", "token-contract"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("contract-done", 4), workflow.Revision, "contract", "token-contract", "contract-ref"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("service-start", 5), workflow.Revision, "service", "token-service"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("service-done", 6), workflow.Revision, "service", "token-service", "service-ref"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("position-start", 7), workflow.Revision, "position", "token-position"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("position-done", 8), workflow.Revision, "position", "token-position", "position-ref"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("settlement-start", 9), workflow.Revision, "settlement", "token-settlement"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("settlement-done", 10), workflow.Revision, "settlement", "token-settlement", "settlement-ref"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if workflow.Status != WorkflowCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("expected completed workflow, got %s", workflow.Status)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowRetryAfterTransientFailure(t *testing.T) {
	policy := ExecutionPolicy{
		ID: "retry-policy",
		Version: 1,
		Steps: []StepDefinition{
			{Key: "first", Kind: StepCustom, Required: true, MaxAttempts: 2},
		},
	}
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-retry", "trade-retry", policy, time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.Start(testContext("retry-start", 1), workflow.Revision); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("retry-attempt-1", 2), workflow.Revision, "first", "attempt-1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.FailStep(testContext("retry-fail-1", 3), workflow.Revision, "first", "attempt-1", "TEMPORARY", "temporary failure"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if workflow.Status != WorkflowPaused {
		t.Fatalf("expected paused workflow, got %s", workflow.Status)
	}
	if err := workflow.RetryStep(testContext("retry-authorize", 4), workflow.Revision, "first"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("retry-attempt-2", 5), workflow.Revision, "first", "attempt-2"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("retry-complete", 6), workflow.Revision, "first", "attempt-2", "result"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if workflow.Status != WorkflowCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("expected completed workflow, got %s", workflow.Status)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowRejectsStaleRevision(t *testing.T) {
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-revision", "trade-revision", testPolicy(), time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := workflow.Start(testContext("revision-start", 1), workflow.Revision); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	err = workflow.BeginStep(testContext("revision-stale", 2), 1, "contract", "token")
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRevisionConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected revision conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowRejectsAttemptTokenMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-token", "trade-token", testPolicy(), time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.Start(testContext("token-start", 1), workflow.Revision); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := workflow.BeginStep(testContext("token-begin", 2), workflow.Revision, "contract", "correct-token"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	err = workflow.CompleteStep(testContext("token-complete", 3), workflow.Revision, "contract", "wrong-token", "ref")
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrAttemptMismatch) {
		t.Fatalf("expected attempt mismatch, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestWorkflowCloneIsIndependent(t *testing.T) {
	workflow, err := NewWorkflow("wf-clone", "trade-clone", testPolicy(), time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	clone := workflow.Clone()

	clone.Steps["contract"].Status = StepSucceeded
	clone.History[0].Action = "changed"
	clone.AppliedCommands["new"] = struct{}{}

	if workflow.Steps["contract"].Status == StepSucceeded {
		t.Fatal("step mutation leaked into original")
	}
	if workflow.History[0].Action == "changed" {
		t.Fatal("history mutation leaked into original")
	}
	if _, exists := workflow.AppliedCommands["new"]; exists {
		t.Fatal("idempotency mutation leaked into original")
	}
}

$integrationGo = @'
package integration

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	DefaultMaxPayloadBytes = 1 << 20
	MaxProviderIDLength    = 128
	MaxOperationLength     = 128
	MaxIdentifierLength    = 256
)

var (
	ErrInvalidRequest       = errors.New("integration: invalid request")
	ErrUnauthorized         = errors.New("integration: unauthorized")
	ErrProviderUnavailable  = errors.New("integration: provider unavailable")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict  = errors.New("integration: idempotency conflict")
	ErrOperationInProgress  = errors.New("integration: operation already in progress")
	ErrResponseMismatch     = errors.New("integration: provider response mismatch")
	ErrInvalidProviderReply = errors.New("integration: invalid provider response")
	ErrOutcomeUnknown       = errors.New("integration: external outcome is unknown")
	ErrAuditUnavailable     = errors.New("integration: audit recording unavailable")
	ErrJournalUnavailable   = errors.New("integration: journal recording unavailable")
	ErrPendingUnavailable   = errors.New("integration: pending operation recording unavailable")
	ErrUnsupportedOperation = errors.New("integration: unsupported provider operation")
	ErrInvalidGrant         = errors.New("integration: invalid authorization grant")
)

type ProviderID string
type Operation string
type OperationID string

type ResponseStatus string

const (
	ResponseSucceeded ResponseStatus = "SUCCEEDED"
	ResponseRejected  ResponseStatus = "REJECTED"
	ResponsePending   ResponseStatus = "PENDING"
)

type IdempotencyState string

const (
	IdempotencyAcquired   IdempotencyState = "ACQUIRED"
	IdempotencyReplay     IdempotencyState = "REPLAY"
	IdempotencyInProgress IdempotencyState = "IN_PROGRESS"
	IdempotencyConflict   IdempotencyState = "CONFLICT"
)

type ErrorCategory string

const (
	ErrorCategoryTransport  ErrorCategory = "TRANSPORT"
	ErrorCategoryTimeout    ErrorCategory = "TIMEOUT"
	ErrorCategoryBusiness   ErrorCategory = "BUSINESS"
	ErrorCategoryValidation ErrorCategory = "VALIDATION"
	ErrorCategorySecurity   ErrorCategory = "SECURITY"
	ErrorCategoryRateLimit  ErrorCategory = "RATE_LIMIT"
	ErrorCategoryInternal   ErrorCategory = "INTERNAL"
)

type Principal struct {
	ActorID string
}

type AuthorizationGrant struct {
	ActorID     string
	Operation   Operation
	ResourceID  string
	DecisionID  string
	GrantedAt   time.Time
	ExpiresAt   time.Time
	PolicyRef   string
}

type Request struct {
	ActorID       string
	Provider      ProviderID
	Operation     Operation
	ResourceID    string
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID string
	Payload       []byte
	Deadline      time.Time

	// RetrySafe must only be set for operations whose external contract
	// explicitly guarantees idempotent execution under the same key.
	RetrySafe bool
}

type Envelope struct {
	RequestID      string
	CorrelationID  string
	IdempotencyKey string
	ActorID        string
	Provider       ProviderID
	Operation      Operation
	ResourceID     string
	Payload        []byte
	PayloadHash    string
	Fingerprint    string
	Deadline       time.Time
	Attempt        int
	Signature      []byte
}

type ProviderError struct {
	Category       ErrorCategory
	Code           string
	Message        string
	Retryable      bool
	OutcomeUnknown bool
	RetryAfter     time.Duration
	Cause          error
}

func (e *ProviderError) Error() string {
	if e == nil {
		return "integration: provider error"
	}
	if e.Code != "" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("provider error [%s]: %s", e.Code, e.Message)
	}
	return "provider error: " + e.Message
}

func (e *ProviderError) Unwrap() error {
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e.Cause
}

type ProviderResponse struct {
	Provider            ProviderID
	RequestID           string
	CorrelationID       string
	ExternalOperationID string
	Status              ResponseStatus
	Payload             []byte
	ErrorCode           string
	ErrorMessage        string
	ReceivedAt          time.Time
}

type Result struct {
	RequestID           string
	CorrelationID       string
	Provider            ProviderID
	ExternalOperationID string
	Status              ResponseStatus
	Payload             []byte
	ErrorCode           string
	ErrorMessage        string
	Replayed            bool
}

type ProviderCapabilities struct {
	SupportedOperations map[Operation]bool
	IdempotentOperations map[Operation]bool
	RequiresSignature   bool
	SupportsLookup      bool
	MaximumPayloadBytes int
}

func (c ProviderCapabilities) Supports(op Operation) bool {
	return c.SupportedOperations[op]
}

func (c ProviderCapabilities) IsIdempotent(op Operation) bool {
	return c.IdempotentOperations[op]
}

type IdempotencyRecord struct {
	StorageKey  string
	Key         string
	Fingerprint string
	ActorID     string
	Provider    ProviderID
	Operation   Operation
	RequestID   string
	CreatedAt   time.Time
}

type IdempotencyBeginResult struct {
	State    IdempotencyState
	Response *ProviderResponse
}

type FailureRecord struct {
	Category ErrorCategory
	Code     string
	Message  string
	At       time.Time
}

type PendingOperation struct {
	ID                  OperationID
	StorageKey          string
	RequestID           string
	CorrelationID       string
	Provider            ProviderID
	ActorID             string
	Operation           Operation
	ResourceID          string
	IdempotencyKey      string
	Fingerprint         string
	ExternalOperationID string
	PayloadHash         string
	CreatedAt           time.Time
	UpdatedAt           time.Time
	NextAttemptAt       time.Time
	ExpiresAt           time.Time
	Attempts            int
	LastErrorCategory   ErrorCategory
	LastErrorCode       string
	State               ResponseStatus
}

type JournalEntry struct {
	RequestID           string
	CorrelationID       string
	Provider            ProviderID
	ActorID             string
	Operation           Operation
	ResourceID          string
	IdempotencyKey      string
	Fingerprint         string
	Attempt             int
	StartedAt           time.Time
	FinishedAt          time.Time
	Outcome             ResponseStatus
	ErrorCategory       ErrorCategory
	ErrorCode           string
	ExternalOperationID string
}

type AuditEvent struct {
	EventID       string
	OccurredAt    time.Time
	ActorID       string
	Action        string
	Provider      ProviderID
	Operation     Operation
	ResourceID    string
	RequestID     string
	CorrelationID string
	DecisionID    string
	Result        string
	PolicyRef     string
}

type ExecutorConfig struct {
	MaxAttempts       int
	InitialBackoff    time.Duration
	MaximumBackoff    time.Duration
	MaximumPayload    int
	PendingRetention  time.Duration
}

func DefaultExecutorConfig() ExecutorConfig {
	return ExecutorConfig{
		MaxAttempts:      3,
		InitialBackoff:   250 * time.Millisecond,
		MaximumBackoff:   3 * time.Second,
		MaximumPayload:   DefaultMaxPayloadBytes,
		PendingRetention: 24 * time.Hour,
	}
}

func (c ExecutorConfig) Validate() error {
	if c.MaxAttempts < 1 || c.MaxAttempts > 10 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: MaxAttempts must be between 1 and 10", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if c.InitialBackoff < 0 || c.MaximumBackoff < c.InitialBackoff {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid retry backoff", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if c.MaximumPayload <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: MaximumPayload must be positive", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if c.PendingRetention <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: PendingRetention must be positive", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	return nil
}

type Executor struct {
	Registry      ProviderRegistry
	Access        AccessController
	Idempotency   IdempotencyStore
	Pending       PendingRepository
	Journal       IntegrationJournal
	Audit         AuditRecorder
	Signer        RequestSigner
	Clock         Clock
	Config        ExecutorConfig
}

func NewExecutor(deps Executor, config ExecutorConfig) (*Executor, error) {
	if deps.Registry == nil || deps.Access == nil || deps.Idempotency == nil ||
		deps.Pending == nil || deps.Journal == nil || deps.Audit == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: missing mandatory dependency", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if deps.Clock == nil {
		deps.Clock = SystemClock{}
	}
	if err := config.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	deps.Config = config
	return &deps, nil
}

func (e *Executor) Execute(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
	if e == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if err := validateRequest(request, e.Config.MaximumPayload); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}

	now := e.Clock.Now().UTC()
	deadline := request.Deadline
	if deadline.IsZero() {
		if parentDeadline, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok {
			deadline = parentDeadline
		}
	}
	if !deadline.IsZero() && !deadline.After(now) {
		return Result{}, context.DeadlineExceeded
	}

	executionContext := ctx
	cancel := func() {}
	if !deadline.IsZero() {
		executionContext, cancel = context.WithDeadline(ctx, deadline)
	}
	defer cancel()

	provider, err := e.Registry.Resolve(executionContext, request.Provider)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrProviderUnavailable, err)
	}
	if provider == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrProviderUnavailable
	}

	identity := provider.Identity()
	if identity.ID == "" || identity.ID != request.Provider {
		return Result{}, ErrProviderUnavailable
	}

	capabilities := provider.Capabilities()
	if !capabilities.Supports(request.Operation) {
		return Result{}, ErrUnsupportedOperation
	}

	maxPayload := capabilities.MaximumPayloadBytes
	if maxPayload <= 0 || maxPayload > e.Config.MaximumPayload {
		maxPayload = e.Config.MaximumPayload
	}
	if len(request.Payload) > maxPayload {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: payload exceeds provider limit", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	grant, err := e.Access.Authorize(
		executionContext,
		Principal{ActorID: request.ActorID},
		request.Operation,
		request.ResourceID,
		request.Provider,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrUnauthorized, err)
	}
	if err := validateGrant(grant, request, now); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}

	requestID, err := newID()
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}

	payload := append([]byte(nil), request.Payload...)
	payloadHash := hashBytes(payload)
	fingerprint := requestFingerprint(request, payloadHash)
	storageKey := makeStorageKey(request)

	record := IdempotencyRecord{
		StorageKey:  storageKey,
		Key:         request.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint: fingerprint,
		ActorID:     request.ActorID,
		Provider:    request.Provider,
		Operation:   request.Operation,
		RequestID:   requestID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}

	begin, err := e.Idempotency.Begin(executionContext, record)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("idempotency begin: %w", err)
	}

	switch begin.State {
	case IdempotencyReplay:
		if begin.Response == nil {
			return Result{}, ErrInvalidProviderReply
		}
		return resultFromResponse(*begin.Response, true), nil
	case IdempotencyInProgress:
		return Result{}, ErrOperationInProgress
	case IdempotencyConflict:
		return Result{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
	case IdempotencyAcquired:
		// This process owns the idempotency claim.
	default:
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: unknown idempotency state", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}

	envelope := Envelope{
		RequestID:      requestID,
		CorrelationID:  request.CorrelationID,
		IdempotencyKey: request.IdempotencyKey,
		ActorID:        request.ActorID,
		Provider:       request.Provider,
		Operation:      request.Operation,
		ResourceID:    request.ResourceID,
		Payload:        payload,
		PayloadHash:    payloadHash,
		Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
		Deadline:       deadline,
	}

	if capabilities.RequiresSignature {
		if e.Signer == nil {
			return Result{}, e.failBeforeDispatch(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint,
				ErrorCategorySecurity, "SIGNER_UNAVAILABLE", "provider requires request signing")
		}
		signature, signErr := e.Signer.Sign(executionContext, identity, envelope)
		if signErr != nil {
			return Result{}, e.failBeforeDispatch(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint,
				ErrorCategorySecurity, "SIGNING_FAILED", signErr.Error())
		}
		if len(signature) == 0 {
			return Result{}, e.failBeforeDispatch(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint,
				ErrorCategorySecurity, "EMPTY_SIGNATURE", "signer returned an empty signature")
		}
		envelope.Signature = append([]byte(nil), signature...)
	}

	startEvent := AuditEvent{
		EventID:       requestID + ":authorized",
		OccurredAt:    now,
		ActorID:       request.ActorID,
		Action:        "EXTERNAL_OPERATION_AUTHORIZED",
		Provider:      request.Provider,
		Operation:     request.Operation,
		ResourceID:    request.ResourceID,
		RequestID:     requestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		DecisionID:    grant.DecisionID,
		Result:        "AUTHORIZED",
		PolicyRef:     grant.PolicyRef,
	}
	if err := e.Audit.Append(executionContext, startEvent); err != nil {
		return Result{}, e.failBeforeDispatch(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint,
			ErrorCategoryInternal, "AUDIT_START_FAILED", err.Error())
	}

	var response ProviderResponse
	var invokeErr error
	attempts := 0

	for attempt := 1; attempt <= e.Config.MaxAttempts; attempt++ {
		if err := executionContext.Err(); err != nil {
			invokeErr = err
			break
		}

		attempts = attempt
		envelope.Attempt = attempt

		started := e.Clock.Now().UTC()
		entry := JournalEntry{
			RequestID:      requestID,
			CorrelationID:  request.CorrelationID,
			Provider:       request.Provider,
			ActorID:        request.ActorID,
			Operation:      request.Operation,
			ResourceID:    request.ResourceID,
			IdempotencyKey: request.IdempotencyKey,
			Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
			Attempt:        attempt,
			StartedAt:      started,
		}
		if err := e.Journal.Append(executionContext, entry); err != nil {
			invokeErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrJournalUnavailable, err)
			break
		}

		response, invokeErr = provider.Invoke(executionContext, cloneEnvelope(envelope))
		if invokeErr == nil {
			break
		}

		var providerErr *ProviderError
		if !errors.As(invokeErr, &providerErr) {
			// An unclassified transport error may have happened after the
			// remote side committed. Never retry it blindly.
			break
		}

		if providerErr.OutcomeUnknown {
			break
		}
		if !providerErr.Retryable || !request.RetrySafe ||
			!capabilities.IsIdempotent(request.Operation) ||
			attempt == e.Config.MaxAttempts {
			break
		}

		delay := retryDelay(e.Config, attempt, providerErr.RetryAfter)
		if delay > 0 {
			timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
			select {
			case <-executionContext.Done():
				timer.Stop()
				invokeErr = executionContext.Err()
			case <-timer.C:
			}
		}
		if invokeErr != nil && executionContext.Err() != nil {
			break
		}
	}

	if invokeErr != nil {
		category := classifyError(invokeErr)
		var providerErr *ProviderError
		if errors.As(invokeErr, &providerErr) && !providerErr.OutcomeUnknown {
			failure := FailureRecord{
				Category: category,
				Code:     providerErr.Code,
				Message:  providerErr.Message,
				At:       e.Clock.Now().UTC(),
			}
			_ = e.Idempotency.MarkFailed(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint, failure)
			_ = e.appendFinalAudit(executionContext, request, requestID, grant, "FAILED", providerErr.Code)
			return Result{}, invokeErr
		}

		pending := e.newPending(request, requestID, storageKey, fingerprint, payloadHash, attempts, "")
		if err := e.savePending(executionContext, pending); err != nil {
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: original error: %v; persistence error: %v",
				ErrOutcomeUnknown, invokeErr, err)
		}
		return Result{
			RequestID:     requestID,
			CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
			Provider:      request.Provider,
			Status:        ResponsePending,
		}, ErrOutcomeUnknown
	}

	if err := validateResponse(identity.ID, envelope, response); err != nil {
		pending := e.newPending(request, requestID, storageKey, fingerprint, payloadHash, attempts,
			response.ExternalOperationID)
		if saveErr := e.savePending(executionContext, pending); saveErr != nil {
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: response validation: %v; pending persistence: %v",
				ErrOutcomeUnknown, err, saveErr)
		}
		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrOutcomeUnknown, err)
	}

	response.ReceivedAt = e.Clock.Now().UTC()
	response.Payload = append([]byte(nil), response.Payload...)

	switch response.Status {
	case ResponsePending:
		if response.ExternalOperationID == "" {
			return Result{}, ErrInvalidProviderReply
		}
		pending := e.newPending(request, requestID, storageKey, fingerprint, payloadHash, attempts,
			response.ExternalOperationID)
		if err := e.savePending(executionContext, pending); err != nil {
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrPendingUnavailable, err)
		}
		return resultFromResponse(response, false), nil

	case ResponseSucceeded, ResponseRejected:
		if err := e.appendFinalAudit(executionContext, request, requestID, grant,
			string(response.Status), response.ErrorCode); err != nil {
			pending := e.newPending(request, requestID, storageKey, fingerprint, payloadHash, attempts,
				response.ExternalOperationID)
			_ = e.savePending(executionContext, pending)
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrAuditUnavailable, err)
		}

		if err := e.Idempotency.Complete(executionContext, storageKey, fingerprint, response); err != nil {
			pending := e.newPending(request, requestID, storageKey, fingerprint, payloadHash, attempts,
				response.ExternalOperationID)
			_ = e.savePending(executionContext, pending)
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: idempotency completion: %v", ErrOutcomeUnknown, err)
		}

		if err := e.Journal.Append(executionContext, JournalEntry{
			RequestID:           requestID,
			CorrelationID:       request.CorrelationID,
			Provider:            request.Provider,
			ActorID:              request.ActorID,
			Operation:            request.Operation,
			ResourceID:           request.ResourceID,
			IdempotencyKey:       request.IdempotencyKey,
			Fingerprint:          fingerprint,
			Attempt:              attempts,
			FinishedAt:           e.Clock.Now().UTC(),
			Outcome:              response.Status,
			ExternalOperationID: response.ExternalOperationID,
		}); err != nil {
			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: final journal: %v", ErrJournalUnavailable, err)
		}

		return resultFromResponse(response, false), nil

	default:
		return Result{}, ErrInvalidProviderReply
	}
}

func (e *Executor) failBeforeDispatch(
	ctx context.Context,
	storageKey string,
	fingerprint string,
	category ErrorCategory,
	code string,
	message string,
) error {
	failure := FailureRecord{
		Category: category,
		Code:     code,
		Message:  message,
		At:       e.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := e.Idempotency.MarkFailed(ctx, storageKey, fingerprint, failure); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s; idempotency failure: %w", code, message, err)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, message)
}

func (e *Executor) newPending(
	request Request,
	requestID string,
	storageKey string,
	fingerprint string,
	payloadHash string,
	attempts int,
	externalID string,
) PendingOperation {
	now := e.Clock.Now().UTC()
	return PendingOperation{
		ID:                  OperationID(requestID),
		StorageKey:          storageKey,
		RequestID:           requestID,
		CorrelationID:       request.CorrelationID,
		Provider:            request.Provider,
		ActorID:              request.ActorID,
		Operation:            request.Operation,
		ResourceID:           request.ResourceID,
		IdempotencyKey:       request.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:          fingerprint,
		ExternalOperationID: externalID,
		PayloadHash:          payloadHash,
		CreatedAt:            now,
		UpdatedAt:            now,
		NextAttemptAt:        now,
		ExpiresAt:            now.Add(e.Config.PendingRetention),
		Attempts:             attempts,
		State:                ResponsePending,
	}
}

func (e *Executor) savePending(ctx context.Context, pending PendingOperation) error {
	if err := e.Pending.Save(ctx, pending); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := e.Idempotency.MarkPending(ctx, pending.StorageKey, pending.Fingerprint, pending); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return e.Journal.Append(ctx, JournalEntry{
		RequestID:           pending.RequestID,
		CorrelationID:       pending.CorrelationID,
		Provider:            pending.Provider,
		ActorID:              pending.ActorID,
		Operation:            pending.Operation,
		ResourceID:           pending.ResourceID,
		IdempotencyKey:       pending.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:          pending.Fingerprint,
		Attempt:              pending.Attempts,
		FinishedAt:           e.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		Outcome:              ResponsePending,
		ExternalOperationID: pending.ExternalOperationID,
	})
}

func (e *Executor) appendFinalAudit(
	ctx context.Context,
	request Request,
	requestID string,
	grant AuthorizationGrant,
	result string,
	code string,
) error {
	return e.Audit.Append(ctx, AuditEvent{
		EventID:       requestID + ":result",
		OccurredAt:    e.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		ActorID:       request.ActorID,
		Action:        "EXTERNAL_OPERATION_RESULT",
		Provider:      request.Provider,
		Operation:     request.Operation,
		ResourceID:    request.ResourceID,
		RequestID:     requestID,
		CorrelationID: request.CorrelationID,
		DecisionID:    grant.DecisionID,
		Result:        result + ":" + code,
		PolicyRef:     grant.PolicyRef,
	})
}

func validateRequest(request Request, maximumPayload int) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(request.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(request.Provider)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(request.Operation)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.ResourceID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(request.CorrelationID) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if len(request.ActorID) > MaxIdentifierLength ||
		len(request.ResourceID) > MaxIdentifierLength ||
		len(request.IdempotencyKey) > MaxIdentifierLength ||
		len(request.CorrelationID) > MaxIdentifierLength ||
		len(request.Provider) > MaxProviderIDLength ||
		len(request.Operation) > MaxOperationLength {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if maximumPayload <= 0 {
		maximumPayload = DefaultMaxPayloadBytes
	}
	if len(request.Payload) > maximumPayload {
		return ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	return nil
}

func validateGrant(grant AuthorizationGrant, request Request, now time.Time) error {
	if grant.ActorID != request.ActorID ||
		grant.Operation != request.Operation ||
		grant.ResourceID != request.ResourceID ||
		strings.TrimSpace(grant.DecisionID) == "" ||
		grant.GrantedAt.IsZero() ||
		grant.ExpiresAt.IsZero() ||
		!grant.ExpiresAt.After(now) ||
		grant.GrantedAt.After(now.Add(time.Minute)) ||
		!grant.ExpiresAt.After(grant.GrantedAt) {
		return ErrInvalidGrant
	}
	return nil
}

func validateResponse(
	expectedProvider ProviderID,
	envelope Envelope,
	response ProviderResponse,
) error {
	if response.Provider != expectedProvider {
		return ErrResponseMismatch
	}
	if response.RequestID != envelope.RequestID ||
		response.CorrelationID != envelope.CorrelationID {
		return ErrResponseMismatch
	}
	if response.ReceivedAt.IsZero() && response.Status == "" {
		// ReceivedAt is assigned by the caller after structural validation.
	}
	switch response.Status {
	case ResponseSucceeded, ResponseRejected:
		return nil
	case ResponsePending:
		if strings.TrimSpace(response.ExternalOperationID) == "" {
			return ErrInvalidProviderReply
		}
		return nil
	default:
		return ErrInvalidProviderReply
	}
}

func requestFingerprint(request Request, payloadHash string) string {
	canonical := strings.Join([]string{
		request.ActorID,
		string(request.Provider),
		string(request.Operation),
		request.ResourceID,
		payloadHash,
	}, "\x00")
	return hashBytes([]byte(canonical))
}

func makeStorageKey(request Request) string {
	canonical := strings.Join([]string{
		request.ActorID,
		string(request.Provider),
		string(request.Operation),
		request.IdempotencyKey,
	}, "\x00")
	return hashBytes([]byte(canonical))
}

func hashBytes(value []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(value)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func newID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("generate request ID: %w", err)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}

func retryDelay(config ExecutorConfig, attempt int, retryAfter time.Duration) time.Duration {
	if retryAfter > 0 {
		if retryAfter > config.MaximumBackoff {
			return config.MaximumBackoff
		}
		return retryAfter
	}
	delay := config.InitialBackoff
	for i := 1; i < attempt; i++ {
		if delay >= config.MaximumBackoff/2 {
			return config.MaximumBackoff
		}
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > config.MaximumBackoff {
		return config.MaximumBackoff
	}
	return delay
}

func classifyError(err error) ErrorCategory {
	var providerErr *ProviderError
	if errors.As(err, &providerErr) {
		if providerErr.Category != "" {
			return providerErr.Category
		}
	}
	if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		return ErrorCategoryTimeout
	}
	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		return ErrorCategoryTransport
	}
	return ErrorCategoryInternal
}

func cloneEnvelope(envelope Envelope) Envelope {
	envelope.Payload = append([]byte(nil), envelope.Payload...)
	envelope.Signature = append([]byte(nil), envelope.Signature...)
	return envelope
}

func resultFromResponse(response ProviderResponse, replayed bool) Result {
	return Result{
		RequestID:           response.RequestID,
		CorrelationID:       response.CorrelationID,
		Provider:            response.Provider,
		ExternalOperationID: response.ExternalOperationID,
		Status:              response.Status,
		Payload:             append([]byte(nil), response.Payload...),
		ErrorCode:           response.ErrorCode,
		ErrorMessage:        response.ErrorMessage,
		Replayed:            replayed,
	}
}

type RecoveryCoordinator struct {
	Registry    ProviderRegistry
	Pending     PendingRepository
	Idempotency IdempotencyStore
	Journal     IntegrationJournal
	Audit       AuditRecorder
	Clock       Clock
}

func (r *RecoveryCoordinator) Reconcile(
	ctx context.Context,
	pending PendingOperation,
) (ProviderResponse, error) {
	if r == nil || r.Registry == nil || r.Pending == nil ||
		r.Idempotency == nil || r.Journal == nil || r.Audit == nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if ctx == nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if pending.ID == "" || pending.StorageKey == "" ||
		pending.RequestID == "" || pending.Fingerprint == "" {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalidRequest
	}
	if !pending.ExpiresAt.IsZero() && !pending.ExpiresAt.After(r.now()) {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrOutcomeUnknown
	}

	provider, err := r.Registry.Resolve(ctx, pending.Provider)
	if err != nil || provider == nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrProviderUnavailable
	}
	identity := provider.Identity()
	if identity.ID != pending.Provider {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrProviderUnavailable
	}
	if !provider.Capabilities().SupportsLookup {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrUnsupportedOperation
	}

	response, err := provider.Lookup(ctx, pending.RequestID, pending.ExternalOperationID)
	if err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, err
	}

	envelope := Envelope{
		RequestID:     pending.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: pending.CorrelationID,
		Provider:      pending.Provider,
		Operation:     pending.Operation,
		ResourceID:    pending.ResourceID,
		Fingerprint:   pending.Fingerprint,
	}
	if err := validateResponse(identity.ID, envelope, response); err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, err
	}

	now := r.now()
	response.ReceivedAt = now
	response.Payload = append([]byte(nil), response.Payload...)

	if response.Status == ResponsePending {
		pending.ExternalOperationID = response.ExternalOperationID
		pending.UpdatedAt = now
		pending.NextAttemptAt = now.Add(time.Minute)
		pending.Attempts++
		if err := r.Pending.Save(ctx, pending); err != nil {
			return ProviderResponse{}, err
		}
		return response, nil
	}

	if response.Status != ResponseSucceeded && response.Status != ResponseRejected {
		return ProviderResponse{}, ErrInvalidProviderReply
	}

	if err := r.Audit.Append(ctx, AuditEvent{
		EventID:       pending.RequestID + ":reconciled",
		OccurredAt:    now,
		ActorID:       pending.ActorID,
		Action:        "EXTERNAL_OPERATION_RECONCILED",
		Provider:      pending.Provider,
		Operation:     pending.Operation,
		ResourceID:    pending.ResourceID,
		RequestID:     pending.RequestID,
		CorrelationID: pending.CorrelationID,
		Result:        string(response.Status),
	}); err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrAuditUnavailable, err)
	}

	if err := r.Idempotency.Complete(ctx, pending.StorageKey, pending.Fingerprint, response); err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, err
	}
	if err := r.Pending.Resolve(ctx, pending.ID, response.Status, now); err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, err
	}
	if err := r.Journal.Append(ctx, JournalEntry{
		RequestID:           pending.RequestID,
		CorrelationID:       pending.CorrelationID,
		Provider:            pending.Provider,
		ActorID:              pending.ActorID,
		Operation:            pending.Operation,
		ResourceID:           pending.ResourceID,
		IdempotencyKey:       pending.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:          pending.Fingerprint,
		Attempt:              pending.Attempts,
		FinishedAt:           now,
		Outcome:              response.Status,
		ExternalOperationID: response.ExternalOperationID,
	}); err != nil {
		return ProviderResponse{}, err
	}
	return response, nil
}

func (r *RecoveryCoordinator) now() time.Time {
	if r.Clock == nil {
		return time.Now().UTC()
	}
	return r.Clock.Now().UTC()
}

type SystemClock struct{}

func (SystemClock) Now() time.Time {
	return time.Now().UTC()
}

$contractsGo = @'
package integration

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// AccessController must validate the actor against the trusted Account
// boundary. Callers must never construct an authorization grant from raw
// client-provided roles or scopes.
type AccessController interface {
	Authorize(
		ctx context.Context,
		principal Principal,
		operation Operation,
		resourceID string,
		provider ProviderID,
	) (AuthorizationGrant, error)
}

type ProviderIdentity struct {
	ID            ProviderID
	DisplayName   string
	ContractVersion string
}

type Provider interface {
	Identity() ProviderIdentity
	Capabilities() ProviderCapabilities
	Invoke(ctx context.Context, envelope Envelope) (ProviderResponse, error)
	Lookup(ctx context.Context, requestID string, externalOperationID string) (ProviderResponse, error)
}

type ProviderRegistry interface {
	Resolve(ctx context.Context, provider ProviderID) (Provider, error)
}

// Begin MUST be atomic across concurrent callers. For the same StorageKey:
//   - absent key: create an in-progress claim and return ACQUIRED;
//   - same fingerprint, completed: return REPLAY and the original response;
//   - same fingerprint, active: return IN_PROGRESS;
//   - different fingerprint: return CONFLICT.
//
// The implementation must persist the claim before returning ACQUIRED.
type IdempotencyStore interface {
	Begin(ctx context.Context, record IdempotencyRecord) (IdempotencyBeginResult, error)
	Complete(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, response ProviderResponse) error
	MarkPending(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, pending PendingOperation) error
	MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, storageKey string, fingerprint string, failure FailureRecord) error
}

// PendingRepository must durably persist pending operations and support
// atomic resolution. Save must be idempotent by PendingOperation.ID.
type PendingRepository interface {
	Save(ctx context.Context, pending PendingOperation) error
	Get(ctx context.Context, id OperationID) (PendingOperation, error)
	ListDue(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, limit int) ([]PendingOperation, error)
	Resolve(ctx context.Context, id OperationID, status ResponseStatus, at time.Time) error
}

// IntegrationJournal is an append-only record of external attempts.
// Implementations should reject mutation of previously appended entries.
type IntegrationJournal interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, entry JournalEntry) error
}

// AuditRecorder records security-sensitive decisions and external outcomes.
// A durable implementation should participate in the same local transaction
// as the related state transition whenever possible.
type AuditRecorder interface {
	Append(ctx context.Context, event AuditEvent) error
}

// RequestSigner signs the canonical request envelope for providers that
// explicitly require cryptographic request authentication.
type RequestSigner interface {
	Sign(ctx context.Context, provider ProviderIdentity, envelope Envelope) ([]byte, error)
}

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// Service-specific operation names. These constants deliberately identify
// operations without transferring ownership of the underlying data.
const (
	ProviderAccount    ProviderID = "ACCOUNT"
	ProviderMyAssets   ProviderID = "MY_ASSETS"
	ProviderContracts  ProviderID = "CONTRACTS"
	ProviderServices   ProviderID = "SERVICES"
	ProviderSettlement ProviderID = "SETTLEMENT"
	ProviderRegulatory ProviderID = "REGULATORY"
)

const (
	OperationIdentityVerify       Operation = "IDENTITY_VERIFY"
	OperationPermissionCheck      Operation = "PERMISSION_CHECK"

	OperationBuyingPowerCheck     Operation = "BUYING_POWER_CHECK"
	OperationReserveResources     Operation = "RESERVE_RESOURCES"
	OperationReleaseResources     Operation = "RELEASE_RESOURCES"
	OperationRegisterPosition     Operation = "REGISTER_PLATFORM_POSITION"

	OperationCreateContract       Operation = "CREATE_CONTRACT"
	OperationGetContract          Operation = "GET_CONTRACT"
	OperationUpdateContract       Operation = "UPDATE_CONTRACT"

	OperationRequestService       Operation = "REQUEST_SERVICE"
	OperationGetServiceStatus     Operation = "GET_SERVICE_STATUS"
	OperationCancelService        Operation = "CANCEL_SERVICE"

	OperationPrepareSettlement    Operation = "PREPARE_SETTLEMENT"
	OperationFinalizeSettlement   Operation = "FINALIZE_SETTLEMENT"
	OperationGetSettlementStatus  Operation = "GET_SETTLEMENT_STATUS"

	OperationRegulatoryInquiry    Operation = "REGULATORY_INQUIRY"
	OperationRegulatorySubmission Operation = "REGULATORY_SUBMISSION"
)

type AccountGateway interface {
	VerifyIdentity(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	CheckPermission(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type MyAssetsGateway interface {
	CheckBuyingPower(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	ReserveResources(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	ReleaseResources(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	RegisterPlatformPosition(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type ContractsGateway interface {
	CreateContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	UpdateContract(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type ServicesGateway interface {
	RequestService(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetServiceStatus(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	CancelService(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type SettlementGateway interface {
	PrepareSettlement(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	FinalizeSettlement(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	GetSettlementStatus(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

type RegulatoryGateway interface {
	Inquire(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
	Submit(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error)
}

// Gateway implementations are thin typed facades over Executor. They must
// not implement business ownership, balance calculation, contract storage,
// service delivery, or settlement accounting inside General Market.

func TestExecuteSuccessfulResponse(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	provider := testProviderFor(ProviderResponse{
		Status:  ResponseSucceeded,
		Payload: []byte(`{"reservation_id":"r-1"}`),
	}, nil)
	idem := &testIdempotency{beginResult: IdempotencyBeginResult{State: IdempotencyAcquired}}
	pending := &testPending{}
	journal := &testJournal{}
	audit := &testAudit{}

	executor := newTestExecutor(t, provider, idem, pending, journal, audit,
		testAccess{grant: validGrant(now)})

	result, err := executor.Execute(context.Background(), validRequest())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Status != ResponseSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("expected success, got %s", result.Status)
	}
	if idem.completed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one idempotency completion, got %d", idem.completed)
	}
	if provider.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one provider call, got %d", provider.calls)
	}
}

func TestExecuteRejectsInvalidGrant(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	provider := testProviderFor(ProviderResponse{Status: ResponseSucceeded}, nil)
	idem := &testIdempotency{beginResult: IdempotencyBeginResult{State: IdempotencyAcquired}}

	executor := newTestExecutor(t, provider, idem, &testPending{}, &testJournal{}, &testAudit{},
		testAccess{grant: AuthorizationGrant{
			ActorID: "different-actor",
			Operation: OperationReserveResources,
			ResourceID: "order-1",
			DecisionID: "decision",
			GrantedAt: now.Add(-time.Minute),
			ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Hour),
		}})

	_, err := executor.Execute(context.Background(), validRequest())
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidGrant) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidGrant, got %v", err)
	}
	if provider.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("provider must not be called after invalid authorization")
	}

package specialized

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidReference = errors.New("invalid external reference")
	ErrInvalidVersion   = errors.New("invalid reference version")
)

// Reference identifies data owned by another bounded context.
// It deliberately does not copy the referenced service's authoritative data.
type Reference struct {
	Service       string
	ResourceType  string
	ResourceID    string
	Version       string
	CorrelationID string
}

func (r Reference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Service) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: service is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource type is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: resource ID is required", ErrInvalidReference)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.Version) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidVersion
	}
	return nil
}

func (r Reference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Service),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceType),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.ResourceID),
		strings.TrimSpace(r.Version),
	}, ":")
}

// SubjectReference identifies the specialized subject of a market offer.
// The market stores this reference and its version, not legal ownership.
type SubjectReference struct {
	Domain       string
	SubjectType  string
	SubjectID    string
	SpecificationVersion string
}

func (s SubjectReference) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion) == "" {
		return errors.New("incomplete specialized subject reference")
	}
	return nil
}

func (s SubjectReference) Key() string {
	return strings.Join([]string{
		strings.TrimSpace(s.Domain),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectType),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SubjectID),
		strings.TrimSpace(s.SpecificationVersion),
	}, ":")
}

$Files["internal/specialized/quantity.go"] = @'
package specialized

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"strings"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidQuantity = errors.New("invalid quantity")
	ErrUnitMismatch    = errors.New("quantity unit mismatch")
	ErrScaleMismatch   = errors.New("quantity scale mismatch")
	ErrQuantityOverflow = errors.New("quantity arithmetic overflow")
)

// Quantity stores a fixed-point value.
// Value=12345, Scale=2 means 123.45 units.
// No implicit unit conversion is performed.
type Quantity struct {
	Value int64
	Scale uint8
	Unit  string
}

func NewQuantity(value int64, scale uint8, unit string) (Quantity, error) {
	q := Quantity{Value: value, Scale: scale, Unit: strings.TrimSpace(unit)}
	if err := q.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	return q, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Validate() error {
	if q.Value <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: value must be positive", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Scale > 9 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: scale exceeds supported precision", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	if q.Unit == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unit is required", ErrInvalidQuantity)
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) ValidateNonNegative() error {
	if q.Value < 0 || q.Scale > 9 || strings.TrimSpace(q.Unit) == "" {
		return ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compatible(other Quantity) error {
	if q.Unit != other.Unit {
		return ErrUnitMismatch
	}
	if q.Scale != other.Scale {
		return ErrScaleMismatch
	}
	return nil
}

func (q Quantity) Add(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > 0 && q.Value > math.MaxInt64-other.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrQuantityOverflow
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value + other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Subtract(other Quantity) (Quantity, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return Quantity{}, err
	}
	if other.Value > q.Value {
		return Quantity{}, ErrInvalidQuantity
	}
	return Quantity{Value: q.Value - other.Value, Scale: q.Scale, Unit: q.Unit}, nil
}

func (q Quantity) Compare(other Quantity) (int, error) {
	if err := q.Compatible(other); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	switch {
	case q.Value < other.Value:
		return -1, nil
	case q.Value > other.Value:
		return 1, nil
	default:
		return 0, nil
	}
}

func (q Quantity) IsZero() bool {
	return q.Value == 0
}
'@

package aggregation

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

type Direction string

const (
	Supply Direction = "SUPPLY"
	Demand Direction = "DEMAND"
)

type AggregateStatus string

const (
	StatusDraft      AggregateStatus = "DRAFT"
	StatusActive     AggregateStatus = "ACTIVE"
	StatusPartial    AggregateStatus = "PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED"
	StatusAllocated  AggregateStatus = "ALLOCATED"
	StatusCancelled  AggregateStatus = "CANCELLED"
	StatusExpired    AggregateStatus = "EXPIRED"
)

type SourceStatus string

const (
	SourceValidated SourceStatus = "VALIDATED"
	SourceRejected  SourceStatus = "REJECTED"
	SourceSuspended SourceStatus = "SUSPENDED"
)

// CompatibilityKey contains only attributes that must be identical
// for sources to participate in one aggregate.
type CompatibilityKey struct {
	CommodityID       string
	SpecificationHash string
	Grade             string
	Standard          string
	Unit              string
	DeliveryLocation  string
	DeliveryWindow    string
	Currency          string
	CommercialTerms   string
	ServiceProfile    string

func (k CompatibilityKey) Equal(other CompatibilityKey) bool {
	return k == other
}

type SourceContribution struct {

	SourceReference   specialized.Reference
	Direction         Direction
	Status            SourceStatus
