$Files["internal/commodity/aggregation/aggregation.go"] = @'
package aggregation

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/specialized"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCommand       = errors.New("invalid aggregation command")
	ErrIncompatibleSource   = errors.New("source is incompatible with aggregate")
	ErrDuplicateSource      = errors.New("duplicate source contribution")
	ErrSourceNotEligible    = errors.New("source is not eligible")
	ErrAggregateNotActive   = errors.New("aggregate is not active")
	ErrAllocationTooLarge   = errors.New("allocation exceeds available quantity")
	ErrBelowMinimum         = errors.New("allocation is below minimum executable quantity")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict  = errors.New("idempotency key reused with different request")
	ErrAllocationNotFound   = errors.New("allocation not found")
	ErrInvalidTransition    = errors.New("invalid aggregate state transition")
	ErrExpired              = errors.New("aggregate has expired")
	ErrRevisionConflict     = errors.New("aggregate revision conflict")
)

type Aggregate struct {
	mu sync.Mutex

	ID              string
	Direction       Direction
	Status          AggregateStatus
	Compatibility   CompatibilityKey
	RuleSetVersion  string
	CreatedAt       time.Time
	ExpiresAt       time.Time
	ActorID         string
	CorrelationID   string
	Revision        uint64
	Total           specialized.Quantity
	Allocated       specialized.Quantity
	Contributions   []SourceContribution
	Allocations     []Allocation
	Idempotency     map[string]string
}

type CommercialProposal struct {
	ID                string
	AggregateID       string
	Direction         Direction
	Compatibility     CompatibilityKey
	TotalQuantity     specialized.Quantity
	AvailableQuantity specialized.Quantity
	RuleSetVersion    string
	ExpiresAt         time.Time
	SourceReferences  []specialized.Reference
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

// Build creates an immutable source composition for one compatible commodity group.
// It does not create an order, trade, inventory record, or ownership record.
func Build(cmd BuildCommand) (*Aggregate, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AggregateID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.RuleSetVersion) == "" ||
		(cmd.Direction != Supply && cmd.Direction != Demand) ||
		len(cmd.Contributions) == 0 ||
		cmd.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		!cmd.ExpiresAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
	}

	if err := validateCompatibilityKey(cmd.Compatibility); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sources := append([]SourceContribution(nil), cmd.Contributions...)
	sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool {
		return sources[i].SourceID < sources[j].SourceID
	})

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	var total specialized.Quantity

	for i, source := range sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceID) == "" ||
			source.Direction != cmd.Direction ||
			source.Status != SourceValidated ||
			strings.TrimSpace(source.SourceVersion) == "" ||
			source.ValidatedAt.IsZero() ||
			!source.ValidUntil.After(cmd.CreatedAt) ||
			source.ValidatedAt.After(cmd.CreatedAt) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source %q", ErrSourceNotEligible, source.SourceID)
		}

		if _, exists := seen[source.SourceID]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrDuplicateSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		seen[source.SourceID] = struct{}{}

		if err := source.SourceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if source.SourceReference.ResourceID != source.SourceID {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: source reference ID mismatch", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
		if source.Compatibility != cmd.Compatibility {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrIncompatibleSource, source.SourceID)
		}
		if err := source.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := source.MinimumExecutable.Validate(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: minimum quantity: %v", ErrInvalidCommand, err)
		}
		if _, err := source.Quantity.Compare(source.MinimumExecutable); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if source.MinimumExecutable.Value > source.Quantity.Value {
			return nil, ErrInvalidCommand
		}
		if source.EvidenceReference != nil {
			if err := source.EvidenceReference.Validate(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}

		if i == 0 {
			total = source.Quantity
		} else {
			var err error
			total, err = total.Add(source.Quantity)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}

	return &Aggregate{
		ID:             cmd.AggregateID,
		Direction:      cmd.Direction,
		Status:         StatusActive,
		Compatibility:  cmd.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      cmd.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      cmd.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       1,
		Total:          total,
		Allocated:      specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: total.Scale, Unit: total.Unit},
		Contributions:  sources,
		Idempotency:    map[string]string{cmd.IdempotencyKey: buildFingerprint(cmd)},
	}, nil
}

func validateCompatibilityKey(k CompatibilityKey) error {
	fields := []string{
		k.CommodityID, k.SpecificationHash, k.Grade, k.Standard,
		k.Unit, k.DeliveryLocation, k.DeliveryWindow, k.Currency,
		k.CommercialTerms, k.ServiceProfile,
	}
	for _, field := range fields {
		if strings.TrimSpace(field) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: compatibility key is incomplete", ErrInvalidCommand)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func buildFingerprint(cmd BuildCommand) string {
	parts := []string{
		cmd.AggregateID, string(cmd.Direction), cmd.RuleSetVersion,
		fmt.Sprintf("%v", cmd.Compatibility),
	}
	for _, source := range cmd.Contributions {
		parts = append(parts, source.SourceID, source.SourceVersion,
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", source.Quantity.Value, source.Quantity.Scale, source.Quantity.Unit))
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func allocationFingerprint(cmd AllocationCommand) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(
		"%s|%d|%d|%s|%s",
		cmd.AllocationID, cmd.Quantity.Value, cmd.Quantity.Scale,
		cmd.Quantity.Unit, cmd.ActorID,
	)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (a *Aggregate) Available() specialized.Quantity {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return specialized.Quantity{Value: 0, Scale: a.Total.Scale, Unit: a.Total.Unit}
	}
	return available
}

func (a *Aggregate) Allocate(cmd AllocationCommand) (Allocation, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(cmd.AllocationID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.ActorID) == "" ||
		cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if err := cmd.Quantity.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	fingerprint := allocationFingerprint(cmd)
	if previous, exists := a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return Allocation{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
			if allocation.IdempotencyKey == cmd.IdempotencyKey {
				return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
			}
		}
		return Allocation{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}

	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAggregateNotActive
	}
	if !cmd.OccurredAt.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return Allocation{}, ErrExpired
	}
	if _, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(a.Total); err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	cmp, err := cmd.Quantity.Compare(available)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}
	if cmp > 0 {
		return Allocation{}, ErrAllocationTooLarge
	}

	lines, err := a.planAllocation(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	nextAllocated, err := a.Allocated.Add(cmd.Quantity)
	if err != nil {
		return Allocation{}, err
	}

	allocation := Allocation{
		ID:             cmd.AllocationID,
		IdempotencyKey: cmd.IdempotencyKey,
		Fingerprint:    fingerprint,
		Quantity:       cmd.Quantity,
		Lines:          lines,
		ActorID:        cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  cmd.CorrelationID,
		OccurredAt:     cmd.OccurredAt,
	}

	a.Allocated = nextAllocated
	a.Allocations = append(a.Allocations, allocation)
	a.Idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint
	a.Revision++

	if a.Allocated.Value == a.Total.Value {
		a.Status = StatusAllocated
	} else {
		a.Status = StatusPartial
	}

	return cloneAllocation(allocation), nil
}

// planAllocation uses deterministic source ordering. It never allocates
// more than the remaining amount of an individual source.
func (a *Aggregate) planAllocation(requested specialized.Quantity) ([]AllocationLine, error) {
	remaining := requested.Value
	lines := make([]AllocationLine, 0, len(a.Contributions))

	used := make(map[string]int64, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		for _, line := range allocation.Lines {
			used[line.SourceID] += line.Quantity.Value
		}
	}

	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		if remaining == 0 {
			break
		}
		sourceAvailable := source.Quantity.Value - used[source.SourceID]
		if sourceAvailable <= 0 {
			continue
		}

		take := sourceAvailable
		if take > remaining {
			take = remaining
		}

		if take < source.MinimumExecutable.Value {
			continue
		}

		lines = append(lines, AllocationLine{
			SourceID: source.SourceID,
			Quantity: specialized.Quantity{
				Value: take,
				Scale: requested.Scale,
				Unit:  requested.Unit,
			},
		})
		remaining -= take
	}

	if remaining != 0 {
		return nil, ErrBelowMinimum
	}
	return lines, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Cancel(actorID, reason string, occurredAt time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if strings.TrimSpace(actorID) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" ||
		occurredAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusAllocated {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusCancelled
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Expire(now time.Time) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return ErrInvalidCommand
	}
	if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusPartial {
		return ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	a.Status = StatusExpired
	a.Revision++
	return nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Proposal(now time.Time) (CommercialProposal, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	if a.Status == StatusCancelled || a.Status == StatusExpired ||
		a.Status == StatusDraft {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrInvalidTransition
	}
	if !now.Before(a.ExpiresAt) {
		return CommercialProposal{}, ErrExpired
	}

	available, err := a.Total.Subtract(a.Allocated)
	if err != nil {
		return CommercialProposal{}, err
	}

	refs := make([]specialized.Reference, 0, len(a.Contributions))
	for _, source := range a.Contributions {
		refs = append(refs, source.SourceReference)
	}

	return CommercialProposal{
		ID:                a.ID + "-proposal-" + fmt.Sprint(a.Revision),
		AggregateID:       a.ID,
		Direction:         a.Direction,
		Compatibility:     a.Compatibility,
		TotalQuantity:     a.Total,
		AvailableQuantity: available,
		RuleSetVersion:    a.RuleSetVersion,
		ExpiresAt:         a.ExpiresAt,
		SourceReferences:  refs,
		CreatedAt:         now,
	}, nil
}

func (a *Aggregate) Snapshot() Aggregate {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()

	copyOf := Aggregate{
		ID:             a.ID,
		Direction:      a.Direction,
		Status:         a.Status,
		Compatibility:  a.Compatibility,
		RuleSetVersion: a.RuleSetVersion,
		CreatedAt:      a.CreatedAt,
		ExpiresAt:      a.ExpiresAt,
		ActorID:        a.ActorID,
		CorrelationID:  a.CorrelationID,
		Revision:       a.Revision,
		Total:          a.Total,
		Allocated:      a.Allocated,
		Contributions:  append([]SourceContribution(nil), a.Contributions...),
		Allocations:    make([]Allocation, len(a.Allocations)),
		Idempotency:    make(map[string]string, len(a.Idempotency)),
	}
	for i, allocation := range a.Allocations {
		copyOf.Allocations[i] = cloneAllocation(allocation)
	}
	for key, value := range a.Idempotency {
		copyOf.Idempotency[key] = value
	}
	return copyOf
}

func cloneAllocation(source Allocation) Allocation {
	result := source
	result.Lines = append([]AllocationLine(nil), source.Lines...)
	return result
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidInput       = errors.New("invalid input")
	ErrNotFound           = errors.New("not found")
	ErrConflict           = errors.New("revision conflict")
	ErrInvalidTransition  = errors.New("invalid lifecycle transition")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrTerminalState      = errors.New("entity is in a terminal state")
)

func requiredText(value, field string, maxRunes int) error {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)

	if value == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is required", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not valid UTF-8", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	return nil
}

func optionalText(value, field string, maxRunes int) error {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)

	if value == "" {
		return nil
	}

	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not valid UTF-8", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	if utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s exceeds maximum length", ErrInvalidInput, field)
	}

	return nil
}

func validTime(value interface{ IsZero() bool }) bool {
	return !value.IsZero()
}

func validateActor(actor string) error {
	return requiredText(actor, "actor_id", 128)
}

func validateCorrelation(value string) error {
	return requiredText(value, "correlation_id", 128)
}

func validateIdempotency(value string) error {
	return requiredText(value, "idempotency_key", 200)
}

func validateRevision(expected, actual uint64) error {
	if expected != actual {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"%w: expected revision %d, actual revision %d",
			ErrConflict,
			expected,
			actual,
		)
	}

	return nil
}

$Files["internal\realestate\domain\property.go"] = @'
package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type PropertyKind string

const (
	PropertyLand        PropertyKind = "land"
	PropertyResidential PropertyKind = "residential"
	PropertyCommercial  PropertyKind = "commercial"
	PropertyIndustrial  PropertyKind = "industrial"
	PropertyAgricultural PropertyKind = "agricultural"
	PropertyMixedUse    PropertyKind = "mixed_use"
	PropertyOther       PropertyKind = "other"
)

func (k PropertyKind) valid() bool {
	switch k {
	case PropertyLand,
		PropertyResidential,
		PropertyCommercial,
		PropertyIndustrial,
		PropertyAgricultural,
		PropertyMixedUse,
		PropertyOther:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// ExternalPropertyReference is only a pointer to an external registry or system.
// It is not proof of ownership or legal title.
type ExternalPropertyReference struct {
	SystemID string `json:"system_id"`
	Type     string `json:"type"`
	Value    string `json:"value"`
}

func (r ExternalPropertyReference) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(r.SystemID, "reference.system_id", 128); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.Type, "reference.type", 64); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.Value, "reference.value", 256); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ExternalPropertyReference) key() string {
	return strings.Join(
		[]string{
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.SystemID), r.SystemID),
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.Type), r.Type),
			fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", len(r.Value), r.Value),
		},
		"|",
	)
}

type PropertyDescriptor struct {
	Kind              PropertyKind               `json:"kind"`
	CountryCode       string                     `json:"country_code"`
	AdministrativeArea string                    `json:"administrative_area,omitempty"`
	City              string                     `json:"city,omitempty"`
	District          string                     `json:"district,omitempty"`
	Address           string                     `json:"address,omitempty"`
	ParcelNumber      string                     `json:"parcel_number,omitempty"`
	BuildingReference string                     `json:"building_reference,omitempty"`
	Latitude          *float64                   `json:"latitude,omitempty"`
	Longitude         *float64                   `json:"longitude,omitempty"`
	AreaSquareMeters  int64                      `json:"area_square_meters,omitempty"`
	ExternalReferences []ExternalPropertyReference `json:"external_references,omitempty"`
}

func (d PropertyDescriptor) Validate() error {
	if !d.Kind.valid() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported property kind", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if err := requiredText(d.CountryCode, "country_code", 2); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if len(d.CountryCode) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: country_code must contain two characters", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	for _, ch := range d.CountryCode {
		if ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z' {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: country_code must be uppercase ISO-style code", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
	}

	for _, item := range []struct {
		value string
		field string
	}{
		{d.AdministrativeArea, "administrative_area"},
		{d.City, "city"},
		{d.District, "district"},
		{d.Address, "address"},
		{d.ParcelNumber, "parcel_number"},
		{d.BuildingReference, "building_reference"},
	} {
		if err := optionalText(item.value, item.field, 512); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if d.AreaSquareMeters < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: area_square_meters cannot be negative", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if (d.Latitude == nil) != (d.Longitude == nil) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: latitude and longitude must be supplied together", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if d.Latitude != nil {
		if math.IsNaN(*d.Latitude) || math.IsInf(*d.Latitude, 0) ||
			math.IsNaN(*d.Longitude) || math.IsInf(*d.Longitude, 0) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid geographic coordinates", ErrInvalidInput)
		}

		if *d.Latitude < -90 || *d.Latitude > 90 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: latitude is out of range", ErrInvalidInput)
		}

		if *d.Longitude < -180 || *d.Longitude > 180 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: longitude is out of range", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(d.Address) == "" &&
		strings.TrimSpace(d.ParcelNumber) == "" &&
		strings.TrimSpace(d.BuildingReference) == "" &&
		d.Latitude == nil &&
		len(d.ExternalReferences) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one property locator is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(d.ExternalReferences))

	for _, ref := range d.ExternalReferences {
		if err := ref.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		key := ref.key()
		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate external property reference", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
	}

	return nil
}

type PropertyChange struct {
	Revision    uint64    `json:"revision"`
	ActorID     string    `json:"actor_id"`
	OccurredAt  time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
	CorrelationID string  `json:"correlation_id"`
}

type PropertySnapshot struct {
	ID          string                     `json:"id"`
	Descriptor  PropertyDescriptor         `json:"descriptor"`
	Revision    uint64                     `json:"revision"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time                  `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time                  `json:"updated_at"`
	History     []PropertyChange           `json:"history"`
}

type PropertyIdentity struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	id          string
	descriptor  PropertyDescriptor
	revision    uint64
	createdAt   time.Time
	updatedAt   time.Time
	history     []PropertyChange
}

func NewPropertyIdentity(
	id string,
	descriptor PropertyDescriptor,
	actorID string,
	correlationID string,
	createdAt time.Time,
) (*PropertyIdentity, error) {
	if err := requiredText(id, "property_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := descriptor.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(actorID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(correlationID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if createdAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: created_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	descriptor = clonePropertyDescriptor(descriptor)

	return &PropertyIdentity{
		id:         id,
		descriptor: descriptor,
		revision:   1,
		createdAt:  createdAt.UTC(),
		updatedAt:  createdAt.UTC(),
		history: []PropertyChange{
			{
				Revision:      1,
				ActorID:       actorID,
				OccurredAt:    createdAt.UTC(),
				CorrelationID: correlationID,
			},
		},
	}, nil
}

type UpdatePropertyCommand struct {
	ExpectedRevision uint64            `json:"expected_revision"`
	Descriptor       PropertyDescriptor `json:"descriptor"`
	ActorID          string            `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID    string            `json:"correlation_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time         `json:"occurred_at"`
}

func (p *PropertyIdentity) Update(cmd UpdatePropertyCommand) error {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()

	if err := validateRevision(cmd.ExpectedRevision, p.revision); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := cmd.Descriptor.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateActor(cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(cmd.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() || cmd.OccurredAt.Before(p.updatedAt) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid property update time", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	p.descriptor = clonePropertyDescriptor(cmd.Descriptor)
	p.revision++
	p.updatedAt = cmd.OccurredAt.UTC()
	p.history = append(p.history, PropertyChange{
		Revision:      p.revision,
		ActorID:       cmd.ActorID,
		OccurredAt:    p.updatedAt,
		CorrelationID: cmd.CorrelationID,
	})

	return nil
}

func (p *PropertyIdentity) Snapshot() PropertySnapshot {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()

	return PropertySnapshot{
		ID:         p.id,
		Descriptor: clonePropertyDescriptor(p.descriptor),
		Revision:   p.revision,
		CreatedAt:  p.createdAt,
		UpdatedAt:  p.updatedAt,
		History:    append([]PropertyChange(nil), p.history...),
	}
}

func clonePropertyDescriptor(d PropertyDescriptor) PropertyDescriptor {
	out := d

	if d.Latitude != nil {
		v := *d.Latitude
		out.Latitude = &v
	}
	if d.Longitude != nil {
		v := *d.Longitude
		out.Longitude = &v
	}

	out.ExternalReferences = append([]ExternalPropertyReference(nil), d.ExternalReferences...)

	sort.Slice(out.ExternalReferences, func(i, j int) bool {
		return out.ExternalReferences[i].key() < out.ExternalReferences[j].key()
	})

	return out
}

package domain

import (

type RightType string

const (

	RightExploitation    RightType = "exploitation"
	RightEasement        RightType = "easement"

)

func (t RightType) valid() bool {
	switch t {
	case RightLease,
		RightUsufruct,
		RightUse,
		RightExploitation,
		RightEasement,
		RightDevelopment,
		RightCommercialUse,
		RightAgriculturalUse,
		RightOther:

	default:

type RightTerms struct {
	Title             string    `json:"title"`
	Description       string    `json:"description"`
	Scope             string    `json:"scope"`
	EffectiveFrom     time.Time `json:"effective_from"`
	EffectiveUntil    time.Time `json:"effective_until"`
	Exclusive         bool      `json:"exclusive"`
	Transferable      bool      `json:"transferable"`
	SublettingAllowed bool      `json:"subletting_allowed"`
	AreaSquareMeters  int64     `json:"area_square_meters,omitempty"`
	Capacity          int64     `json:"capacity,omitempty"`
	CapacityUnit      string    `json:"capacity_unit,omitempty"`
}

func (t RightTerms) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(t.Title, "right.title", 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(t.Description, "right.description", 4000); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(t.Scope, "right.scope", 2000); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if t.EffectiveFrom.IsZero() || t.EffectiveUntil.IsZero() ||
		!t.EffectiveUntil.After(t.EffectiveFrom) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid right effective period", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if t.AreaSquareMeters < 0 || t.Capacity < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: negative right quantity", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if t.Capacity > 0 {
		if err := requiredText(t.CapacityUnit, "capacity_unit", 64); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type ContractReference struct {
	ContractID      string `json:"contract_id"`
	ContractVersion string `json:"contract_version"`

}

func (r ContractReference) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(r.ContractID, "contract_id", 128); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.ContractVersion, "contract_version", 64); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(r.Role, "contract_role", 64); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ContractReference) key() string {

}

type EvidenceStatus string

const (
	EvidencePending  EvidenceStatus = "pending"
	EvidenceAccepted EvidenceStatus = "accepted"
	EvidenceRejected EvidenceStatus = "rejected"
	EvidenceExpired  EvidenceStatus = "expired"
)

type EvidenceReference struct {
	ID           string         `json:"id"`
	ProviderID   string         `json:"provider_id"`
	DocumentType string         `json:"document_type"`
	ExternalID   string         `json:"external_id"`
	Version      string         `json:"version"`
	Status       EvidenceStatus `json:"status"`
	ValidUntil   *time.Time     `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
}

func (e EvidenceReference) Validate() error {
	for _, item := range []struct {
		value string
		field string
		limit int
	}{
		{e.ID, "evidence.id", 128},
		{e.ProviderID, "evidence.provider_id", 128},
		{e.DocumentType, "evidence.document_type", 128},
		{e.ExternalID, "evidence.external_id", 256},
		{e.Version, "evidence.version", 64},
	} {
		if err := requiredText(item.value, item.field, item.limit); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	switch e.Status {
	case EvidencePending, EvidenceAccepted, EvidenceRejected, EvidenceExpired:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid evidence status", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if e.ValidUntil != nil && e.ValidUntil.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid evidence valid_until", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return nil
}

type AssessmentOutcome string

const (
	AssessmentConfirmed    AssessmentOutcome = "confirmed"
	AssessmentNotConfirmed AssessmentOutcome = "not_confirmed"
	AssessmentInconclusive AssessmentOutcome = "inconclusive"
)

type AssessmentScope string

const (
	AssessmentPropertyIdentity AssessmentScope = "property_identity"
	AssessmentRightExistence   AssessmentScope = "right_existence"
	AssessmentRightScope       AssessmentScope = "right_scope"
	AssessmentDocumentValidity AssessmentScope = "document_validity"
)

type ExternalAssessment struct {
	AuthorityID   string            `json:"authority_id"`
	ReferenceID   string            `json:"reference_id"`
	Scope         AssessmentScope   `json:"scope"`
	Outcome       AssessmentOutcome `json:"outcome"`
	AssessedAt    time.Time         `json:"assessed_at"`
	ValidUntil    *time.Time        `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
	CorrelationID string            `json:"correlation_id"`
}

func (a ExternalAssessment) Validate() error {
	if err := requiredText(a.AuthorityID, "assessment.authority_id", 128); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requiredText(a.ReferenceID, "assessment.reference_id", 256); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(a.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if a.AssessedAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment.assessed_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch a.Scope {
	case AssessmentPropertyIdentity,
		AssessmentRightExistence,
		AssessmentRightScope,
		AssessmentDocumentValidity:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid assessment scope", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	switch a.Outcome {
	case AssessmentConfirmed, AssessmentNotConfirmed, AssessmentInconclusive:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid assessment outcome", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if a.ValidUntil != nil && !a.ValidUntil.After(a.AssessedAt) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment validity must end after assessment time", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return nil
}

type RightStatus string

const (
	RightDraft              RightStatus = "draft"
	RightSubmitted          RightStatus = "submitted"
	RightUnderReview        RightStatus = "under_review"
	RightEvidenceRequired   RightStatus = "evidence_required"
	RightExternallyAssessed RightStatus = "externally_assessed"
	RightRejected           RightStatus = "rejected"
	RightSuspended          RightStatus = "suspended"
	RightWithdrawn          RightStatus = "withdrawn"
	RightExpired            RightStatus = "expired"
)

func (s RightStatus) terminal() bool {
	return s == RightRejected || s == RightWithdrawn || s == RightExpired
}

type RightAction string

const (
	ActionAmendTerms     RightAction = "amend_terms"
	ActionLinkContract   RightAction = "link_contract"
	ActionAttachEvidence  RightAction = "attach_evidence"
	ActionSubmit         RightAction = "submit"
	ActionStartReview    RightAction = "start_review"
	ActionRequestEvidence RightAction = "request_evidence"
	ActionRecordAssessment RightAction = "record_assessment"
	ActionReject         RightAction = "reject"
	ActionSuspend        RightAction = "suspend"
	ActionResume         RightAction = "resume"
	ActionWithdraw       RightAction = "withdraw"
	ActionExpire         RightAction = "expire"
)

type RightCommand struct {
	Action           RightAction         `json:"action"`
	ExpectedRevision uint64              `json:"expected_revision"`
	IdempotencyKey   string              `json:"idempotency_key"`
	ActorID          string              `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID    string              `json:"correlation_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time           `json:"occurred_at"`
	Reason           string              `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	Terms            *RightTerms         `json:"terms,omitempty"`
	Contract         *ContractReference  `json:"contract,omitempty"`
	Evidence         *EvidenceReference  `json:"evidence,omitempty"`
	Assessment       *ExternalAssessment `json:"assessment,omitempty"`
}

type RightTransition struct {
	Revision       uint64      `json:"revision"`
	Action         RightAction `json:"action"`
	From           RightStatus `json:"from"`
	To             RightStatus `json:"to"`
	ActorID        string      `json:"actor_id"`
	CorrelationID  string      `json:"correlation_id"`
	Reason         string      `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	OccurredAt     time.Time   `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type RightClaimSnapshot struct {
	ID               string                `json:"id"`
	PropertyID       string                `json:"property_id"`
	PropertyRevision uint64                `json:"property_revision"`
	Type             RightType             `json:"type"`
	Terms            RightTerms             `json:"terms"`
	Status           RightStatus            `json:"status"`
	Revision         uint64                 `json:"revision"`
	Contracts        []ContractReference    `json:"contracts"`
	Evidence         []EvidenceReference    `json:"evidence"`
	Assessment       *ExternalAssessment    `json:"assessment,omitempty"`
	History          []RightTransition      `json:"history"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time              `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt        time.Time              `json:"updated_at"`
}

type RightClaim struct {
	mu               sync.Mutex
	id               string
	propertyID       string
	propertyRevision uint64
	rightType        RightType
	terms            RightTerms
	status           RightStatus
	statusBeforeSuspension RightStatus
	revision         uint64
	contracts        []ContractReference
	evidence         []EvidenceReference
	assessment       *ExternalAssessment
	history          []RightTransition
	idempotency      map[string]string
	createdAt        time.Time
	updatedAt        time.Time
}

func NewRightClaim(
	id string,
	propertyID string,
	propertyRevision uint64,
	rightType RightType,
	terms RightTerms,
	actorID string,
	correlationID string,
	createdAt time.Time,
) (*RightClaim, error) {
	if err := requiredText(id, "right_claim_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := requiredText(propertyID, "property_id", 128); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if propertyRevision == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: property_revision must be positive", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !rightType.valid() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported right type", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if err := terms.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(actorID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(correlationID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if createdAt.IsZero() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: created_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	now := createdAt.UTC()

	return &RightClaim{
		id:               id,
		propertyID:       propertyID,
		propertyRevision: propertyRevision,
		rightType:        rightType,
		terms:            cloneTerms(terms),
		status:           RightDraft,
		revision:         1,
		idempotency:      make(map[string]string),
		createdAt:        now,
		updatedAt:        now,
		history: []RightTransition{
			{
				Revision:      1,
				Action:        "created",
				From:          RightDraft,
				To:            RightDraft,
				ActorID:       actorID,
				CorrelationID: correlationID,
				OccurredAt:    now,
			},
		},
	}, nil
}

func (r *RightClaim) Apply(cmd RightCommand) (RightClaimSnapshot, bool, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	if err := validateIdempotency(cmd.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if err := validateActor(cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if err := validateCorrelation(cmd.CorrelationID); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}
	if cmd.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: occurred_at is required", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	fingerprint, err := rightCommandFingerprint(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}

	if previous, exists := r.idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey]; exists {
		if previous != fingerprint {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		return r.snapshotLocked(), true, nil
	}

	if err := validateRevision(cmd.ExpectedRevision, r.revision); err != nil {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
	}

	if cmd.OccurredAt.Before(r.updatedAt) {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: command time precedes last update", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	if r.status.terminal() {
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrTerminalState
	}

	from := r.status
	to := from

	switch cmd.Action {
	case ActionAmendTerms:
		if r.status != RightDraft || cmd.Terms == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Terms.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		r.terms = cloneTerms(*cmd.Terms)

	case ActionLinkContract:
		if r.status != RightDraft || cmd.Contract == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Contract.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		for _, existing := range r.contracts {
			if existing.key() == cmd.Contract.key() {
				return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: contract reference already linked", ErrConflict)
			}
		}
		r.contracts = append(r.contracts, *cmd.Contract)
		sort.Slice(r.contracts, func(i, j int) bool {
			return r.contracts[i].key() < r.contracts[j].key()
		})

	case ActionAttachEvidence:
		if r.status == RightRejected || r.status == RightWithdrawn || r.status == RightExpired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrTerminalState
		}
		if cmd.Evidence == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		if err := cmd.Evidence.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		for _, existing := range r.evidence {
			if existing.ID == cmd.Evidence.ID {
				return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: evidence id already exists", ErrConflict)
			}
		}
		r.evidence = append(r.evidence, cloneEvidence(*cmd.Evidence))
		sort.Slice(r.evidence, func(i, j int) bool {
			return r.evidence[i].ID < r.evidence[j].ID
		})

	case ActionSubmit:
		if r.status != RightDraft {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if len(r.contracts) == 0 {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one Contracts reference is required", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		if len(r.evidence) == 0 {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: at least one evidence reference is required", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		to = RightSubmitted

	case ActionStartReview:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted && r.status != RightEvidenceRequired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		to = RightUnderReview

	case ActionRequestEvidence:
		if r.status != RightUnderReview {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		to = RightEvidenceRequired

	case ActionRecordAssessment:
		if r.status != RightUnderReview || cmd.Assessment == nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := cmd.Assessment.Validate(); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		if cmd.Assessment.AssessedAt.After(cmd.OccurredAt) {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: assessment cannot occur after command time", ErrInvalidInput)
		}
		assessment := cloneAssessment(*cmd.Assessment)
		r.assessment = &assessment
		to = RightExternallyAssessed

	case ActionReject:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted &&
			r.status != RightUnderReview &&
			r.status != RightEvidenceRequired {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		to = RightRejected

	case ActionSuspend:
		if r.status != RightSubmitted &&
			r.status != RightUnderReview &&
			r.status != RightEvidenceRequired &&
			r.status != RightExternallyAssessed {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if err := requiredText(cmd.Reason, "reason", 1000); err != nil {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, err
		}
		r.statusBeforeSuspension = r.status
		to = RightSuspended

	case ActionResume:
		if r.status != RightSuspended || r.statusBeforeSuspension == "" {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		to = r.statusBeforeSuspension
		r.statusBeforeSuspension = ""

	case ActionWithdraw:
		if r.status == RightDraft || r.status == RightSuspended ||
			r.status == RightSubmitted || r.status == RightUnderReview ||
			r.status == RightEvidenceRequired || r.status == RightExternallyAssessed {
			to = RightWithdrawn
		} else {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}

	case ActionExpire:
		if r.status == RightDraft || r.status == RightRejected ||
			r.status == RightWithdrawn || r.status == RightExpired {
			return RightSnapshotInvalid(), false, ErrInvalidTransition
		}
		if !cmd.OccurredAt.After(r.terms.EffectiveUntil) &&
			!cmd.OccurredAt.Equal(r.terms.EffectiveUntil) {
			return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: right has not expired", ErrInvalidTransition)
		}
		to = RightExpired

	default:
		return RightClaimSnapshot{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported right action", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	r.status = to
	r.revision++
	r.updatedAt = cmd.OccurredAt.UTC()
	r.idempotency[cmd.IdempotencyKey] = fingerprint

	r.history = append(r.history, RightTransition{
		Revision:      r.revision,
		Action:        cmd.Action,
		From:          from,
		To:            to,
		ActorID:       cmd.ActorID,
		CorrelationID: cmd.CorrelationID,
		Reason:        strings.TrimSpace(cmd.Reason),
		OccurredAt:    r.updatedAt,
	})

	return r.snapshotLocked(), false, nil
}

func RightSnapshotInvalid() RightClaimSnapshot {
	return RightClaimSnapshot{}
}

func (r *RightClaim) Snapshot() RightClaimSnapshot {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.snapshotLocked()
}

func (r *RightClaim) snapshotLocked() RightClaimSnapshot {
	out := RightClaimSnapshot{
		ID:               r.id,
		PropertyID:       r.propertyID,
		PropertyRevision: r.propertyRevision,
		Type:             r.rightType,
		Terms:            cloneTerms(r.terms),
		Status:           r.status,
		Revision:         r.revision,
		Contracts:        append([]ContractReference(nil), r.contracts...),
		Evidence:         make([]EvidenceReference, len(r.evidence)),
		History:          append([]RightTransition(nil), r.history...),
		CreatedAt:        r.createdAt,
		UpdatedAt:        r.updatedAt,
	}

	for i, evidence := range r.evidence {
		out.Evidence[i] = cloneEvidence(evidence)
	}

	if r.assessment != nil {
		a := cloneAssessment(*r.assessment)
		out.Assessment = &a
	}

	return out
}

func rightCommandFingerprint(cmd RightCommand) (string, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("marshal right command: %w", err)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func cloneTerms(t RightTerms) RightTerms {
	return t
}

func cloneEvidence(e EvidenceReference) EvidenceReference {
	out := e
	if e.ValidUntil != nil {
		v := *e.ValidUntil
		out.ValidUntil = &v
	}
	return out
}

func cloneAssessment(a ExternalAssessment) ExternalAssessment {
	out := a
	if a.ValidUntil != nil {
		v := *a.ValidUntil
		out.ValidUntil = &v
	}
	return out
}

func TestRightClaimIdempotencyAndConflict(t *testing.T) {
	claim := newTestClaim(t)
	now := testTime().Add(time.Minute)

	cmd := command(ActionLinkContract, 1, "same-key", now)
	cmd.Contract = &ContractReference{
		ContractID:      "contract-1",
		ContractVersion: "v1",
		Role:            "supporting",
	}

	first, replayed, err := claim.Apply(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if replayed {
		t.Fatal("first command cannot be a replay")
	}

	second, replayed, err := claim.Apply(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !replayed {
		t.Fatal("expected idempotent replay")
	}
	if first.Revision != second.Revision {
		t.Fatal("replay changed aggregate revision")
	}

	cmd.Contract.ContractID = "different-contract"
	if _, _, err := claim.Apply(cmd); !errors.Is(err, ErrIdempotencyConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected idempotency conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

$TargetPaths = @()

foreach ($relativePath in $Files.Keys) {
    $target = Join-Path $Root $relativePath
    $TargetPaths += $target

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
        throw "Refusing to overwrite existing file: $target"
    }
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null

$CreatedFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

try {
    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE 09B] Creating real-estate domain files" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    foreach ($relativePath in $Files.Keys) {
        $target = Join-Path $Root $relativePath
        $directory = Split-Path -Parent $target

        if (-not (Test-Path $directory)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force | Out-Null
        }

        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $target,
            [string]$Files[$relativePath],
            $Utf8NoBom
        )

        $CreatedFiles.Add($target)
        Write-Host "[CREATED] $relativePath" -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    $manifest = @(
        "Package: 09B"
        "Timestamp: $Timestamp"
        "Module: github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend"
        "Files:"
    )

    foreach ($relativePath in $Files.Keys) {
        $manifest += $relativePath
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines(
        (Join-Path $BackupDir "manifest.txt"),
        $manifest,
        $Utf8NoBom
    )

    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE 09B] Running gofmt" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $GoFiles = @()
    foreach ($relativePath in $Files.Keys) {
        if ($relativePath.EndsWith(".go")) {
            $GoFiles += (Join-Path $Root $relativePath)
        }
    }

    & gofmt -w @GoFiles
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "gofmt failed."
    }

    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE 09B] Focused tests" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Go @("test", "-count=1", "./internal/realestate/domain")

    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE 09B] Full test suite" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Go @("test", "-count=1", "./...")

    Write-Host "`n[PACKAGE 09B] Static analysis" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Go @("vet", "./...")

    Write-Host "`n[SUCCESS] PACKAGE 09B IMPLEMENTED" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Backup manifest: $BackupDir\manifest.txt"
    Write-Host "Property identity domain: created"
    Write-Host "Contractual right claim domain: created"
    Write-Host "External evidence references: created"
    Write-Host "External assessment model: created"
    Write-Host "Lifecycle and idempotency: created"
    Write-Host "Repository and transaction contracts: created"
    Write-Host "Database/Migrations/Storage: NOT MODIFIED"
    Write-Host "Git commit/push: NOT PERFORMED"
}
catch {
    Write-Host "`n[ROLLBACK] $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red

    for ($i = $CreatedFiles.Count - 1; $i -ge 0; $i--) {
        $created = $CreatedFiles[$i]

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $created) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $created -Force
            Write-Host "[REMOVED] $created" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }

    Write-Host "[ROLLBACK] Only files created by this execution were removed." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "Backup/manifest directory: $BackupDir"
    throw
}

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]

# ============================================================
# GENERAL MARKET
# Market + Catalogue Domain Modeling
#
# Scope:
#   - Go domain models
#   - Domain invariants
#   - Lifecycle transitions
#   - Category classification and mapping
#   - Unit tests
#
# Explicitly excluded:
#   - PostgreSQL changes
#   - SQL migrations
#   - Redis
#   - HTTP handlers
#   - API DTOs
#   - External service calls
#   - Financial balance / reservation logic
# ============================================================

function Write-Section {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("=" * 72) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    Write-Host $Message -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ("=" * 72) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
}

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Gray
}

function Write-Success {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[OK] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function Write-WarningMessage {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[WARNING] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Stop-Script {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[STOP] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
    throw $Message
}

function Find-ProjectRoot {
    param([string]$InitialPath)

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($InitialPath)) {
        $candidate = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $InitialPath).Path

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "go.mod"))) {
            Stop-Script "go.mod در مسیر تعیین‌شده پیدا نشد: $candidate"
        }

        return $candidate
    }

    $current = (Get-Location).Path

    while (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($current)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $current "go.mod")) {
            return $current
        }

        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or $parent -eq $current) {
            break
        }

        $current = $parent
    }

    Stop-Script "پروژه Go پیدا نشد. اسکریپت را از ریشه پروژه اجرا کنید یا ProjectRoot بدهید."
}

function Resolve-ModuleDirectory {
    param(
        [string]$Root,
        [string[]]$Candidates,
        [string]$ModuleName
    )

    $found = @()

    foreach ($candidate in $Candidates) {
        $fullPath = Join-Path $Root $candidate

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fullPath -PathType Container) {
            $found += $fullPath
        }
    }

    if ($found.Count -eq 0) {
        Stop-Script "ماژول '$ModuleName' پیدا نشد. مسیرهای بررسی‌شده: $($Candidates -join ', ')"
    }

    if ($found.Count -gt 1) {
        Stop-Script "برای ماژول '$ModuleName' بیش از یک مسیر معتبر وجود دارد: $($found -join ', '). مسیر باید دستی تعیین تکلیف شود."
    }

    return $found[0]
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $encoding)
}

function Add-NewFile {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) {
        Stop-Script "فایل مقصد از قبل وجود دارد و برای جلوگیری از بازنویسی، اجرا متوقف شد: $Path"
    }

    if ($WhatIf) {
        Write-Host "[WHATIF] ایجاد فایل: $Path" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        return
    }

    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Content $Content
    Write-Success "ایجاد شد: $Path"
}

Write-Section "1. بررسی ساختار پروژه"

$Root = Find-ProjectRoot -InitialPath $ProjectRoot

Write-Info "Project root: $Root"

$GoModPath = Join-Path $Root "go.mod"
$GoModContent = Get-Content -LiteralPath $GoModPath -Raw

if ($GoModContent -notmatch '(?m)^\s*module\s+\S+') {
    Stop-Script "خط module در go.mod معتبر نیست."
}

$MarketModulePath = Resolve-ModuleDirectory `
    -Root $Root `
    -Candidates @("internal/market", "market") `
    -ModuleName "market"

$CatalogueModulePath = Resolve-ModuleDirectory `
    -Root $Root `
    -Candidates @("internal/catalogue", "catalogue") `
    -ModuleName "catalogue"

Write-Info "Market module: $MarketModulePath"
Write-Info "Catalogue module: $CatalogueModulePath"

$MarketDomainPath = Join-Path $MarketModulePath "domain"
$CatalogueDomainPath = Join-Path $CatalogueModulePath "domain"

$MarketFiles = @(
    (Join-Path $MarketDomainPath "market.go"),
    (Join-Path $MarketDomainPath "market_test.go")
)

$CatalogueFiles = @(
    (Join-Path $CatalogueDomainPath "category.go"),
    (Join-Path $CatalogueDomainPath "category_mapping.go"),
    (Join-Path $CatalogueDomainPath "category_test.go"),
    (Join-Path $CatalogueDomainPath "category_mapping_test.go")
)

$AllTargets = @($MarketFiles) + @($CatalogueFiles)

$ExistingTargets = @(
    $AllTargets | Where-Object {
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $_
    }
)

if ($ExistingTargets.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-WarningMessage "فایل‌های زیر از قبل وجود دارند:"
    $ExistingTargets | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host " - $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    Stop-Script "هیچ فایلی بازنویسی نشد. ابتدا باید مدل‌های موجود بررسی و با این بسته ادغام شوند."
}

if ($WhatIf) {
    Write-WarningMessage "حالت WhatIf فعال است؛ هیچ فایلی نوشته نمی‌شود."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Market domain model

$MarketGo = @'
package domain

import (
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

var (
    ErrInvalidMarketID       = errors.New("invalid market id")
    ErrInvalidMarketCode     = errors.New("invalid market code")
    ErrInvalidMarketName     = errors.New("invalid market name")
    ErrInvalidMarketTimezone = errors.New("invalid market timezone")
    ErrInvalidTimestamp      = errors.New("invalid timestamp")
    ErrInvalidMarketState    = errors.New("invalid market state")
    ErrMarketClosed          = errors.New("market is closed")
)

type MarketID string

type MarketStatus string

const (
    MarketStatusDraft     MarketStatus = "draft"
    MarketStatusActive    MarketStatus = "active"
    MarketStatusSuspended MarketStatus = "suspended"
    MarketStatusClosed    MarketStatus = "closed"
)

func (s MarketStatus) IsValid() bool {
    switch s {
    case MarketStatusDraft,
        MarketStatusActive,
        MarketStatusSuspended,
        MarketStatusClosed:
        return true
    default:
        return false
    }
}

type CreateMarketInput struct {
    ID          MarketID
    Code        string
    Name        string
    Description string
    Timezone    string
}

type Market struct {
    id          MarketID
    code        string
    name        string
    description string
    timezone    string

    status    MarketStatus
    version   uint64
    createdAt time.Time
    updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewMarket(input CreateMarketInput, now time.Time) (*Market, error) {
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
        return nil, ErrInvalidMarketID
    }

    code := normalizeMarketCode(input.Code)
    if !isValidMarketCode(code) {
        return nil, ErrInvalidMarketCode
    }

    name := strings.TrimSpace(input.Name)
    if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
        return nil, ErrInvalidMarketName
    }

    if now.IsZero() {
        return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    timezone := strings.TrimSpace(input.Timezone)
    if timezone == "" {
        timezone = "UTC"
    }

    if _, err := time.LoadLocation(timezone); err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalidMarketTimezone, timezone)
    }

    return &Market{
        id:          input.ID,
        code:        code,
        name:        name,
        description: strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
        timezone:    timezone,
        status:      MarketStatusDraft,
        version:     1,
        createdAt:   now.UTC(),
        updatedAt:   now.UTC(),
    }, nil
}

func normalizeMarketCode(value string) string {
    return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

func isValidMarketCode(value string) bool {
    if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 32 {
        return false
    }

    for _, r := range value {
        valid := (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') ||
            (r >= '0' && r <= '9') ||
            r == '-' ||
            r == '_'

        if !valid {
            return false
        }
    }

    return true
}

func (m *Market) ID() MarketID {
    return m.id
}

func (m *Market) Code() string {
    return m.code
}

func (m *Market) Name() string {
    return m.name
}

func (m *Market) Description() string {
    return m.description
}

func (m *Market) Timezone() string {
    return m.timezone
}

func (m *Market) Status() MarketStatus {
    return m.status
}

func (m *Market) Version() uint64 {
    return m.version
}

func (m *Market) CreatedAt() time.Time {
    return m.createdAt
}

func (m *Market) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
    return m.updatedAt
}

func (m *Market) UpdateDetails(
    name string,
    description string,
    timezone string,
    now time.Time,
) error {
    if m.status == MarketStatusClosed {
        return ErrMarketClosed
    }

    name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
    if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
        return ErrInvalidMarketName
    }

    timezone = strings.TrimSpace(timezone)
    if timezone == "" {
        timezone = "UTC"
    }

    if _, err := time.LoadLocation(timezone); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalidMarketTimezone, timezone)
    }

    if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    m.name = name
    m.description = strings.TrimSpace(description)
    m.timezone = timezone
    m.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (m *Market) Activate(now time.Time) error {
    switch m.status {
    case MarketStatusDraft, MarketStatusSuspended:
        if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        m.status = MarketStatusActive
        m.touch(now)
        return nil

    case MarketStatusActive:
        return ErrInvalidMarketState

    case MarketStatusClosed:
        return ErrMarketClosed

    default:
        return ErrInvalidMarketState
    }
}

func (m *Market) Suspend(now time.Time) error {
    if m.status != MarketStatusActive {
        return ErrInvalidMarketState
    }

    if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    m.status = MarketStatusSuspended
    m.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (m *Market) Close(now time.Time) error {
    if m.status == MarketStatusClosed {
        return ErrInvalidMarketState
    }

    if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    m.status = MarketStatusClosed
    m.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (m *Market) IsOperational() bool {
    return m.status == MarketStatusActive
}

func (m *Market) validateTimestamp(now time.Time) error {
    if now.IsZero() {
        return ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    if now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    return nil
}

func (m *Market) touch(now time.Time) {
    m.updatedAt = now.UTC()
    m.version++
}
'@

package domain

import (
    "errors"
    "testing"
    "time"
)

func testMarket(t *testing.T) *Market {
    t.Helper()

    now := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

    market, err := NewMarket(CreateMarketInput{
        ID:          MarketID("market-001"),
        Code:        "general-market",
        Name:        "General Market",
        Description: "Main general market",
        Timezone:    "UTC",
    }, now)

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("NewMarket() error = %v", err)
    }

    return market
}

func TestNewMarket(t *testing.T) {
    market := testMarket(t)

    if market.Status() != MarketStatusDraft {
        t.Fatalf("expected draft status, got %s", market.Status())
    }

    if market.Code() != "GENERAL-MARKET" {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected normalized code: %s", market.Code())
    }

    if market.Version() != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("expected version 1, got %d", market.Version())
    }
}

func TestNewMarketRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    tests := []struct {
        name  string
        input CreateMarketInput
        want  error
    }{
        {
            name: "missing id",
            input: CreateMarketInput{
                Code: "MKT",
                Name: "Market",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidMarketID,
        },
        {
            name: "invalid code",
            input: CreateMarketInput{
                ID:   "m-1",
                Code: "invalid code!",
                Name: "Market",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidMarketCode,
        },
        {
            name: "missing name",
            input: CreateMarketInput{
                ID:   "m-1",
                Code: "MKT",
                Name: " ",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidMarketName,
        },
        {
            name: "invalid timezone",
            input: CreateMarketInput{
                ID:       "m-1",
                Code:     "MKT",
                Name:     "Market",
                Timezone: "Not/A/Timezone",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidMarketTimezone,
        },
    }

    for _, tt := range tests {
        t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            _, err := NewMarket(tt.input, now)

            if !errors.Is(err, tt.want) {
                t.Fatalf("expected error %v, got %v", tt.want, err)
            }
        })
    }
}

func TestMarketLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
    market := testMarket(t)
    base := market.UpdatedAt()

    if err := market.Activate(base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
    }

    if !market.IsOperational() {
        t.Fatal("market should be operational")
    }

    if err := market.Suspend(base.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Suspend() error = %v", err)
    }

    if market.Status() != MarketStatusSuspended {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected status: %s", market.Status())
    }

    if err := market.Activate(base.Add(3 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("reactivation error = %v", err)
    }

    if err := market.Close(base.Add(4 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Close() error = %v", err)
    }

    if market.Status() != MarketStatusClosed {
        t.Fatalf("expected closed status, got %s", market.Status())
    }

    if err := market.Activate(base.Add(5 * time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrMarketClosed) {
        t.Fatalf("expected ErrMarketClosed, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestMarketRejectsInvalidTransitions(t *testing.T) {
    market := testMarket(t)
    now := market.UpdatedAt()

    if err := market.Suspend(now.Add(time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidMarketState) {
        t.Fatalf("expected invalid state error, got %v", err)
    }

    if err := market.Activate(now.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
    }

    if err := market.Activate(now.Add(2 * time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidMarketState) {
        t.Fatalf("expected invalid state error, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestMarketRejectsTimeRegression(t *testing.T) {
    market := testMarket(t)

    err := market.Activate(market.CreatedAt().Add(-time.Minute))

    if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidTimestamp) {
        t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidTimestamp, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestMarketVersionIncrementsOnMutation(t *testing.T) {
    market := testMarket(t)
    initialVersion := market.Version()
    now := market.UpdatedAt()

    if err := market.UpdateDetails(
        "Updated Market",
        "Updated description",
        "UTC",
        now.Add(time.Minute),
    ); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("UpdateDetails() error = %v", err)
    }

    if market.Version() != initialVersion+1 {
        t.Fatalf("expected version %d, got %d", initialVersion+1, market.Version())
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Catalogue category domain model

$CategoryGo = @'
package domain

import (
    "errors"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

var (
    ErrInvalidCategoryID       = errors.New("invalid category id")
    ErrInvalidCategoryCode     = errors.New("invalid category code")
    ErrInvalidCategoryName     = errors.New("invalid category name")
    ErrInvalidCategoryKind     = errors.New("invalid category kind")
    ErrInvalidCategoryStatus   = errors.New("invalid category status")
    ErrInvalidParentCategory   = errors.New("invalid parent category")
    ErrCategoryArchived        = errors.New("category is archived")
    ErrInvalidCategoryMutation = errors.New("invalid category mutation")
)

type CategoryID string

type CategoryKind string

type CategoryStatus string

const (
    CategoryKindGeneral    CategoryKind = "general"
    CategoryKindSpecialized CategoryKind = "specialized"
)

const (
    CategoryStatusDraft    CategoryStatus = "draft"
    CategoryStatusActive   CategoryStatus = "active"
    CategoryStatusArchived CategoryStatus = "archived"
)

func (k CategoryKind) IsValid() bool {
    return k == CategoryKindGeneral || k == CategoryKindSpecialized
}

func (s CategoryStatus) IsValid() bool {
    return s == CategoryStatusDraft ||
        s == CategoryStatusActive ||
        s == CategoryStatusArchived
}

type CreateCategoryInput struct {
    ID       CategoryID
    Code     string
    Name     string
    Kind     CategoryKind
    ParentID CategoryID
    SortOrder int
}

type Category struct {
    id        CategoryID
    code      string
    name      string
    kind      CategoryKind
    parentID  CategoryID
    sortOrder int

    status    CategoryStatus
    version   uint64
    createdAt time.Time
    updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewCategory(input CreateCategoryInput, now time.Time) (*Category, error) {
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryID
    }

    code := normalizeCategoryCode(input.Code)
    if !isValidCategoryCode(code) {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryCode
    }

    name := strings.TrimSpace(input.Name)
    if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryName
    }

    if !input.Kind.IsValid() {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryKind
    }

    if input.ParentID != "" && input.ParentID == input.ID {
        return nil, ErrInvalidParentCategory
    }

    if now.IsZero() {
        return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    return &Category{
        id:        input.ID,
        code:      code,
        name:      name,
        kind:      input.Kind,
        parentID:  input.ParentID,
        sortOrder: input.SortOrder,
        status:    CategoryStatusDraft,
        version:   1,
        createdAt: now.UTC(),
        updatedAt: now.UTC(),
    }, nil
}

func normalizeCategoryCode(value string) string {
    return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

func isValidCategoryCode(value string) bool {
    if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 64 {
        return false
    }

    for _, r := range value {
        valid := (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') ||
            (r >= '0' && r <= '9') ||
            r == '-' ||
            r == '_' ||
            r == '.'

        if !valid {
            return false
        }
    }

    return true
}

func (c *Category) ID() CategoryID {
    return c.id
}

func (c *Category) Code() string {
    return c.code
}

func (c *Category) Name() string {
    return c.name
}

func (c *Category) Kind() CategoryKind {
    return c.kind
}

func (c *Category) ParentID() CategoryID {
    return c.parentID
}

func (c *Category) SortOrder() int {
    return c.sortOrder
}

func (c *Category) Status() CategoryStatus {
    return c.status
}

func (c *Category) Version() uint64 {
    return c.version
}

func (c *Category) CreatedAt() time.Time {
    return c.createdAt
}

func (c *Category) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
    return c.updatedAt
}

func (c *Category) Rename(name string, now time.Time) error {
    if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
        return ErrCategoryArchived
    }

    name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
    if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
        return ErrInvalidCategoryName
    }

    if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if name == c.name {
        return nil
    }

    c.name = name
    c.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (c *Category) ChangeParent(parentID CategoryID, now time.Time) error {
    if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
        return ErrCategoryArchived
    }

    if parentID != "" && parentID == c.id {
        return ErrInvalidParentCategory
    }

    if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if parentID == c.parentID {
        return nil
    }

    c.parentID = parentID
    c.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (c *Category) ChangeSortOrder(sortOrder int, now time.Time) error {
    if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
        return ErrCategoryArchived
    }

    if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if sortOrder == c.sortOrder {
        return nil
    }

    c.sortOrder = sortOrder
    c.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (c *Category) Activate(now time.Time) error {
    switch c.status {
    case CategoryStatusDraft:
        if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
            return err
        }

        c.status = CategoryStatusActive
        c.touch(now)
        return nil

    case CategoryStatusActive:
        return ErrInvalidCategoryMutation

    case CategoryStatusArchived:
        return ErrCategoryArchived

    default:
        return ErrInvalidCategoryStatus
    }
}

func (c *Category) Archive(now time.Time) error {
    if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
        return ErrInvalidCategoryMutation
    }

    if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    c.status = CategoryStatusArchived
    c.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (c *Category) IsSelectable() bool {
    return c.status == CategoryStatusActive
}

func (c *Category) validateTimestamp(now time.Time) error {
    if now.IsZero() || now.Before(c.updatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    return nil
}

func (c *Category) touch(now time.Time) {
    c.updatedAt = now.UTC()
    c.version++
}
'@

func TestNewCategoryRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
    now := time.Now().UTC()

    tests := []struct {
        name  string
        input CreateCategoryInput
        want  error
    }{
        {
            name: "missing id",
            input: CreateCategoryInput{
                Code: "CAT",
                Name: "Category",
                Kind: CategoryKindGeneral,
            },
            want: ErrInvalidCategoryID,
        },
        {
            name: "invalid code",
            input: CreateCategoryInput{
                ID:   "cat-1",
                Code: "bad code",
                Name: "Category",
                Kind: CategoryKindGeneral,
            },
            want: ErrInvalidCategoryCode,
        },
        {
            name: "invalid kind",
            input: CreateCategoryInput{
                ID:   "cat-1",
                Code: "CAT",
                Name: "Category",
                Kind: "unknown",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidCategoryKind,
        },
        {
            name: "self parent",
            input: CreateCategoryInput{
                ID:       "cat-1",
                Code:     "CAT",
                Name:     "Category",
                Kind:     CategoryKindGeneral,
                ParentID: "cat-1",
            },
            want: ErrInvalidParentCategory,
        },
    }

    for _, tt := range tests {
        t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
            _, err := NewCategory(tt.input, now)

            if !errors.Is(err, tt.want) {
                t.Fatalf("expected %v, got %v", tt.want, err)
            }
        })
    }
}

func TestCategoryLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
    category := newTestCategory(
        t,
        "cat-1",
        "CAT",
        CategoryKindGeneral,
    )

    base := category.UpdatedAt()

    if err := category.Activate(base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
    }

    if !category.IsSelectable() {
        t.Fatal("active category should be selectable")
    }

    if err := category.Archive(base.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Archive() error = %v", err)
    }

    if category.IsSelectable() {
        t.Fatal("archived category must not be selectable")
    }

    if err := category.Activate(base.Add(3 * time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrCategoryArchived) {
        t.Fatalf("expected ErrCategoryArchived, got %v", err)
    }
}

func TestCategoryMutation(t *testing.T) {
    category := newTestCategory(
        t,
        "cat-1",
        "CAT",
        CategoryKindGeneral,
    )

    base := category.UpdatedAt()

    if err := category.Rename("New Name", base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("Rename() error = %v", err)
    }

    if category.Name() != "New Name" {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected name: %s", category.Name())
    }

    if err := category.ChangeParent("parent-1", base.Add(2*time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("ChangeParent() error = %v", err)
    }

    if category.ParentID() != "parent-1" {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected parent: %s", category.ParentID())
    }

    if err := category.ChangeSortOrder(20, base.Add(3*time.Minute)); err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("ChangeSortOrder() error = %v", err)
    }

    if category.SortOrder() != 20 {
        t.Fatalf("unexpected sort order: %d", category.SortOrder())
    }

    if category.Version() != 4 {
        t.Fatalf("expected version 4, got %d", category.Version())
    }
}

$CategoryMappingGo = @'
package domain

import (
    "errors"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

var (
    ErrInvalidCategoryMappingID = errors.New("invalid category mapping id")
    ErrInvalidCategoryMapping   = errors.New("invalid category mapping")
    ErrCategoryMappingArchived  = errors.New("category mapping is archived")
    ErrCategoryMappingState     = errors.New("invalid category mapping state")
    ErrCategoryKindsMismatch    = errors.New("category kinds do not match mapping direction")
    ErrCategoryNotActive        = errors.New("both categories must be active")
)

type CategoryMappingID string

type CategoryMappingStatus string

const (
    CategoryMappingStatusDraft    CategoryMappingStatus = "draft"
    CategoryMappingStatusActive   CategoryMappingStatus = "active"
    CategoryMappingStatusArchived CategoryMappingStatus = "archived"
)

type CreateCategoryMappingInput struct {
    ID                    CategoryMappingID
    PublicCategoryID      CategoryID
    SpecializedCategoryID CategoryID
    MarketID              string
    Description           string
}

type CategoryMapping struct {
    id                    CategoryMappingID
    publicCategoryID      CategoryID
    specializedCategoryID CategoryID
    marketID              string
    description           string

    status    CategoryMappingStatus
    version   uint64
    createdAt time.Time
    updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewCategoryMapping(
    input CreateCategoryMappingInput,
    now time.Time,
) (*CategoryMapping, error) {
    if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryMappingID
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.PublicCategoryID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(input.SpecializedCategoryID)) == "" ||
        input.PublicCategoryID == input.SpecializedCategoryID {
        return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
    }

    if now.IsZero() {
        return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    return &CategoryMapping{
        id:                    input.ID,
        publicCategoryID:      input.PublicCategoryID,
        specializedCategoryID: input.SpecializedCategoryID,
        marketID:              strings.TrimSpace(input.MarketID),
        description:           strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
        status:                CategoryMappingStatusDraft,
        version:               1,
        createdAt:             now.UTC(),
        updatedAt:             now.UTC(),
    }, nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) ID() CategoryMappingID {
    return m.id
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) PublicCategoryID() CategoryID {
    return m.publicCategoryID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) SpecializedCategoryID() CategoryID {
    return m.specializedCategoryID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) MarketID() string {
    return m.marketID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Description() string {
    return m.description
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Status() CategoryMappingStatus {
    return m.status
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Version() uint64 {
    return m.version
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) CreatedAt() time.Time {
    return m.createdAt
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
    return m.updatedAt
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Activate(
    publicCategory *Category,
    specializedCategory *Category,
    now time.Time,
) error {
    if m.status == CategoryMappingStatusArchived {
        return ErrCategoryMappingArchived
    }

    if m.status != CategoryMappingStatusDraft {
        return ErrCategoryMappingState
    }

    if publicCategory == nil || specializedCategory == nil {
        return ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
    }

    if publicCategory.ID() != m.publicCategoryID ||
        specializedCategory.ID() != m.specializedCategoryID {
        return ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
    }

    if publicCategory.Kind() != CategoryKindGeneral ||
        specializedCategory.Kind() != CategoryKindSpecialized {
        return ErrCategoryKindsMismatch
    }

    if !publicCategory.IsSelectable() || !specializedCategory.IsSelectable() {
        return ErrCategoryNotActive
    }

    if now.IsZero() || now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    m.status = CategoryMappingStatusActive
    m.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Archive(now time.Time) error {
    if m.status == CategoryMappingStatusArchived {
        return ErrCategoryMappingState
    }

    if now.IsZero() || now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
        return ErrInvalidTimestamp
    }

    m.status = CategoryMappingStatusArchived
    m.touch(now)

    return nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) IsUsable() bool {
    return m.status == CategoryMappingStatusActive
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) touch(now time.Time) {
    m.updatedAt = now.UTC()
    m.version++
}
'@

function Get-ProjectRelativePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$BasePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $BaseFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BasePath).TrimEnd([char[]]@('\', '/'))
    $TargetFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($TargetPath)

    $Prefix = $BaseFull + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar

    if ($TargetFull.Equals($BaseFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return "."
    }

    if (-not $TargetFull.StartsWith($Prefix, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "Target path is outside project root: $TargetFull"
    }

    return $TargetFull.Substring($Prefix.Length).Replace('\', '/')
}

$MarketRelative = Get-ProjectRelativePath -BasePath $Root -TargetPath $MarketDomainPath
$CatalogueRelative = Get-ProjectRelativePath -BasePath $Root -TargetPath $CatalogueDomainPath

            Write-WarningMessage "نتیجه آزمون‌های هدفمند دو دامنه را جداگانه بررسی کنید."
