// VerifyWithProvider Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒÅ¡Ã‚Â© ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¹Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¦Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Âª Verification ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Â² ÃƒËœÃ‚Â·ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡ Provider ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¬ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¦Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€™ÃƒÅ¡Ã‚Â©Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¯.
func (s *Service) VerifyWithProvider(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	verificationType VerificationType,
	providerName string,
	data map[string]string,
) (*Verification, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification service is nil")
	}

	if s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification repository is nil")
	}

	if s.providers == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider manager is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if verificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	if providerName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("provider name is empty")
	}

	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	request := &ProviderRequest{
		UserID:           userID,
		VerificationType: verificationType,
		Data:             data,
	}

	result, err := provider.Verify(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if result == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider result is nil")
	}

	verification := &Verification{
		UserID:            userID,
		VerificationType:  verificationType,
		Provider:          providerName,
		Status:            result.Status,
		ReferenceID:       result.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: result.VerificationLevel,
		RejectionReason:   result.RejectionReason,
	}

	if result.Status == VerificationStatusVerified {
		now := time.Now()
		verification.VerifiedAt = &now
	}

	if err := s.repository.Create(ctx, verification); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return verification, nil
}

// ExecuteVerification Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒÅ¡Ã‚Â© ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¹Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¦Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¾Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Âª Ãƒâ„¢Ã‹â€ ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¹Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ Verification ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§
// ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Â² ÃƒËœÃ‚Â·ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡ ProviderManager ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¬ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¦Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€™ÃƒÅ¡Ã‚Â©Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¯ Ãƒâ„¢Ã‹â€  Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â ÃƒËœÃ‚ÂªÃƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¬Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¡ ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±ÃƒËœÃ‚Â§ ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¯ÃƒËœÃ‚Â± PostgreSQL ÃƒËœÃ‚Â°ÃƒËœÃ‚Â®Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒËœÃ‚Â±Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¡ Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â¦Ãƒâ€ºÃ…â€™ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€™ÃƒÅ¡Ã‚Â©Ãƒâ„¢Ã¢â‚¬Â ÃƒËœÃ‚Â¯.
func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	verificationType VerificationType,
	providerName string,
	data map[string]string,
) (*Verification, error) {

	if s == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification service is nil")
	}

	if s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification repository is nil")
	}

	if s.providers == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider manager is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if verificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	if providerName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("provider name is empty")
	}

	// Check whether a valid previous verification can be reused.
	existingVerification, err := s.GetLatestVerification(
		ctx,
		userID,
		verificationType,
	)

	if err == nil && existingVerification != nil {
		if existingVerification.IsValid(time.Now()) {
			return existingVerification, nil
		}
	}
	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	request := &ProviderRequest{
		UserID:           userID,
		VerificationType: verificationType,
		Data:             data,
	}

	result, err := provider.Verify(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if result == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider result is nil")
	}

	verification := &Verification{
		UserID:            userID,
		VerificationType:  verificationType,
		Provider:          providerName,
		Status:            result.Status,
		ReferenceID:       result.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: result.VerificationLevel,
		RejectionReason:   result.RejectionReason,
	}

	if result.Status == VerificationStatusVerified {
		now := time.Now()
		verification.VerifiedAt = &now
		expiresAt := now.Add(time.Hour)
		verification.ExpiresAt = &expiresAt
	}

	if err := s.repository.Create(ctx, verification); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return verification, nil
}

// Verify Ø¹Ù…Ù„ÛŒØ§Øª Verification Ø¢Ø²Ù…Ø§ÛŒØ´ÛŒ Ø±Ø§ Ø§Ù†Ø¬Ø§Ù… Ù…ÛŒâ€ŒØ¯Ù‡Ø¯.
func (p *TestProvider) Verify(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *ProviderRequest,
) (*ProviderResult, error) {

	if request == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider request is nil")
	}

	if request.UserID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if request.VerificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	default:
	}

	status := VerificationStatusVerified

	if request.Data != nil {
		switch request.Data["test_result"] {
		case "":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "verified":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "rejected":
			status = VerificationStatusRejected

		case "failed":
			status = VerificationStatusFailed

		case "manual_review":
			status = VerificationStatusManualReview

		case "pending":
			status = VerificationStatusPending

		default:
			return nil, errors.New("invalid test result")
		}
	}

	result := &ProviderResult{
		Status:            status,
		ReferenceID:       request.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: VerificationLevelBasic,
	}

	if status == VerificationStatusRejected {
		result.RejectionReason = "test rejection"
	}

	return result, nil
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_user_roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    role_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_roles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    scope_id UUID,

    assigned_by UUID
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_roles_dates_check
        CHECK (
            expires_at IS NULL
            OR expires_at > starts_at
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_user
    ON authorization_user_roles(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_role
    ON authorization_user_roles(role_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_scope
    ON authorization_user_roles(scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_active
    ON authorization_user_roles(is_active);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_expires
    ON authorization_user_roles(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_scopes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    scope_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    resource_type VARCHAR(100),

    resource_id UUID,

    parent_scope_id UUID
        REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    name VARCHAR(200),

    description TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_scope_type_check
        CHECK (
            scope_type IN (
                'global',
                'organization',
                'project',
                'asset',
                'contract',
                'self',
                'custom'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_resource_pair_check
        CHECK (
            (
                scope_type IN ('global', 'self')
                AND resource_type IS NULL
                AND resource_id IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                scope_type IN (
                    'organization',
                    'project',
                    'asset',
                    'contract',
                    'custom'
                )
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_scope_type
    ON authorization_scopes(scope_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_resource
    ON authorization_scopes(resource_type, resource_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_parent
    ON authorization_scopes(parent_scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_active
    ON authorization_scopes(is_active);

    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_authorization_user_permission_overrides_scope
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_id)
    REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL;

# ============================================================
# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-FileIfNotExists {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path $Directory)) {
        New-Item `
            -ItemType Directory `
            -Path $Directory `
            -Force | Out-Null
    }

    if (Test-Path $Path) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "File already exists:" `
            -ForegroundColor DarkYellow

        Write-Host $Path

        return $false
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Created:" `
        -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host $Path

    return $true
}

$RepositoryContent = @'
package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type EmailRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewEmailRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *EmailRepository {
	return &EmailRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *EmailRepository) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		INSERT INTO user_emails (
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary
		)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		RETURNING
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
	`

	var result UserEmail

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		email.UserID,
		email.Email,
		email.IsPrimary,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.UserID,
		&result.Email,
		&result.IsPrimary,
		&result.IsVerified,
		&result.VerifiedAt,
		&result.CreatedAt,
		&result.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to create user email: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return &result, nil
}

func (r *EmailRepository) GetByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		SELECT
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
		FROM user_emails
		WHERE user_id = $1
		ORDER BY is_primary DESC, created_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := r.db.Pool.Query(
		ctx,

	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	if email == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"email is required",
		)

	)

	email.Email = strings.ToLower(

# ============================================================
# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-File {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $Root $Path
    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $FullPath

    New-Item `
        -ItemType Directory `
        -Force `
        -Path $Directory `
        | Out-Null

    if (Test-Path $FullPath) {
        Write-Host "SKIP: $Path already exists" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
        return
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $FullPath,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "CREATE: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

CREATE TABLE user_phones (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL,

    phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    is_primary BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT user_phones_user_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_phones_user_id
    ON user_phones(user_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_phones_unique_number
    ON user_phones(phone_number);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_phones_primary
    ON user_phones(user_id)
    WHERE is_primary = TRUE;
'@

# 3. Repository

$Repository = @'
package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type PhoneRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewPhoneRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *PhoneRepository {
	return &PhoneRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *PhoneRepository) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	phone *UserPhone,
) (*UserPhone, error) {

	query := `
		INSERT INTO user_phones (
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary
		)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		RETURNING
			id,
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
	`

	var result UserPhone

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		phone.UserID,
		phone.PhoneNumber,
		phone.IsPrimary,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.UserID,
		&result.PhoneNumber,
		&result.IsPrimary,
		&result.IsVerified,
		&result.VerifiedAt,
		&result.CreatedAt,
		&result.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to create user phone: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return &result, nil
}

func (r *PhoneRepository) GetByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserPhone, error) {

	query := `
		SELECT
			id,
			user_id,
			phone_number,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
		FROM user_phones
		WHERE user_id = $1
		ORDER BY is_primary DESC, created_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := r.db.Pool.Query(
		ctx,
		query,
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to get user phones: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	defer rows.Close()

	var phones []UserPhone

	for rows.Next() {

		var phone UserPhone

		err := rows.Scan(
			&phone.ID,
			&phone.UserID,
			&phone.PhoneNumber,
			&phone.IsPrimary,
			&phone.IsVerified,
			&phone.VerifiedAt,
			&phone.CreatedAt,
			&phone.UpdatedAt,
		)

		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
				"failed to scan user phone: %w",
				err,
			)
		}

		phones = append(phones, phone)
	}

	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to iterate user phones: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return phones, nil
}
'@

Write-File `
    "internal/user/phone_repository.go" `
    $Repository

$providerCode = @'
package verification

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

// TestProvider یک Provider داخلی برای تست Verification است.
type TestProvider struct{}

// NewTestProvider یک TestProvider جدید ایجاد می‌کند.
func NewTestProvider() *TestProvider {
	return &TestProvider{}
}

// Name نام Provider را برمی‌گرداند.
func (p *TestProvider) Name() string {
	return "test-provider"
}

// Verify عملیات Verification آزمایشی را انجام می‌دهد.
func (p *TestProvider) Verify(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *ProviderRequest,
) (*ProviderResult, error) {

	if request == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider request is nil")
	}

	if request.UserID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if request.VerificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	default:
	}

	status := VerificationStatusVerified

	if request.Data != nil {
		switch request.Data["test_result"] {
		case "":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "verified":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "rejected":
			status = VerificationStatusRejected

		case "failed":
			status = VerificationStatusFailed

		case "manual_review":
			status = VerificationStatusManualReview

		case "pending":
			status = VerificationStatusPending

		default:
			return nil, errors.New("invalid test result")
		}
	}

	result := &ProviderResult{
		Status:            status,
		ReferenceID:       request.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: VerificationLevelBasic,
	}

	if status == VerificationStatusRejected {
		result.RejectionReason = "test rejection"
	}

	return result, nil
}
'@

    -Path $providerFile `
    -Value $providerCode `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[OK] Test Provider created."

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$serviceFile = ".\internal\verification\service.go"
$handlerFile = ".\internal\verification\handler.go"
$mainFile = ".\cmd\server\main.go"

$serviceBackup = ".\internal\verification\service.go.backup-before-execution"
$handlerBackup = ".\internal\verification\handler.go.backup-before-execution"
$mainBackup = ".\cmd\server\main.go.backup-before-execution"

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "========================================"
Write-Host "CONNECT VERIFICATION EXECUTION FLOW"
Write-Host "========================================"
Write-Host ""

# =========================================================
# 1. Check files
# =========================================================

foreach ($file in @($serviceFile, $handlerFile, $mainFile)) {

    if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
        throw "Required file not found: $file"
    }
}

# =========================================================
# 2. Create backups
# =========================================================

Copy-Item $serviceFile $serviceBackup -Force
Copy-Item $handlerFile $handlerBackup -Force
Copy-Item $mainFile $mainBackup -Force

Write-Host "[OK] Backups created."

# =========================================================
# 3. Add ExecuteVerification to Service
# =========================================================

$serviceContent = Get-Content $serviceFile -Raw

if ($serviceContent -notmatch 'func \(s \*Service\) ExecuteVerification') {

    $executeServiceCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات واقعی Verification را
// از طریق ProviderManager اجرا می‌کند و نتیجه را در PostgreSQL ذخیره می‌کند.
func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	verificationType VerificationType,
	providerName string,
	data map[string]string,
) (*Verification, error) {

	if s == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification service is nil")
	}

	if s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification repository is nil")
	}

	if s.providers == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider manager is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if verificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	if providerName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("provider name is empty")
	}

	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	request := &ProviderRequest{
		UserID:           userID,
		VerificationType: verificationType,
		Data:             data,
	}

	result, err := provider.Verify(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if result == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider result is nil")
	}

	verification := &Verification{
		UserID:            userID,
		VerificationType:  verificationType,
		Provider:          providerName,
		Status:            result.Status,
		ReferenceID:       result.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: result.VerificationLevel,
		RejectionReason:   result.RejectionReason,
	}

	if result.Status == VerificationStatusVerified {
		now := time.Now()
		verification.VerifiedAt = &now
	}

	if err := s.repository.Create(ctx, verification); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return verification, nil
}
'@

    $serviceContent = $serviceContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeServiceCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $serviceFile `
        -Value $serviceContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Service."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Service."
}

# =========================================================
# 4. Add ExecuteVerification to Handler
# =========================================================

$handlerContent = Get-Content $handlerFile -Raw

if ($handlerContent -notmatch 'func \(h \*Handler\) ExecuteVerification') {

    $executeHandlerCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات Verification را اجرا می‌کند.
func (h *Handler) ExecuteVerification(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	if h == nil || h.service == nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusInternalServerError,
			"verification service is unavailable",
		)
		return
	}

	var request ExecuteVerificationRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	verification, err := h.service.ExecuteVerification(
		r.Context(),
		request.UserID,
		request.VerificationType,
		request.Provider,
		request.Data,
	)

	if err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			err.Error(),
		)
		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusOK,
		verification,
	)
}

// ExecuteVerificationRequest بدنه درخواست اجرای Verification است.
type ExecuteVerificationRequest struct {
	UserID           string            `json:"user_id"`
	VerificationType VerificationType `json:"verification_type"`
	Provider         string            `json:"provider"`
	Data             map[string]string `json:"data,omitempty"`
}
'@

    $handlerContent = $handlerContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeHandlerCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $handlerFile `
        -Value $handlerContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Handler."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Handler."
}

# =========================================================

# =========================================================

$mainContent = Get-Content $mainFile -Raw

if ($mainContent -notmatch 'verificationHandler\.ExecuteVerification') {

    $routeCode = @'
        // Execute Verification
        mux.HandleFunc(
                "/api/v1/verifications/execute",
                verificationHandler.ExecuteVerification,
        )

'@

    $pattern = '(?m)^(\s*mux\.HandleFunc\(\s*"/api/v1/verifications"\s*,\s*verificationHandler\.CreateVerification\s*,\s*\))'

    if ($mainContent -notmatch $pattern) {

        Copy-Item $serviceBackup $serviceFile -Force
        Copy-Item $handlerBackup $handlerFile -Force
        Copy-Item $mainBackup $mainFile -Force

        throw "Verification create route not found in main.go."
    }

    $mainContent = [regex]::Replace(
        $mainContent,
        $pattern,
        '$1' + "`r`n`r`n" + $routeCode,
        1
    )

    Set-Content `
        -Path $mainFile `
        -Value $mainContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] Execute Verification route added."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] Execute Verification route already exists."
}

# =========================================================

# =========================================================

$serviceCheck = Get-Content $serviceFile -Raw
$handlerCheck = Get-Content $handlerFile -Raw
$mainCheck = Get-Content $mainFile -Raw

if ($serviceCheck -notmatch 'func \(s \*Service\) ExecuteVerification') {
    throw "Service validation failed."

if ($handlerCheck -notmatch 'func \(h \*Handler\) ExecuteVerification') {
    throw "Handler validation failed."

Write-Host "[OK] Validation passed."

            Write-Host ""

            $Response | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
        }

        throw "API test failed."

    Write-Host "$Step : OK" -ForegroundColor Green
}

    if ($content -notmatch $pattern) {
        throw "mux := http.NewServeMux() not found."
    }

    $verificationBlock = @'
        // =========================================================
        // Verification Module
        // =========================================================

        verificationRepository := verification.NewRepository(
                postgresClient,
        )

        verificationProviders := verification.NewProviderManager()

        verificationCache := verification.NewCache(
                redisWrapper,
        )

        verificationService := verification.NewService(
                verificationRepository,
                verificationProviders,
                verificationCache,
        )

        verificationHandler := verification.NewHandler(
                verificationService,
        )

'@

    $content = [regex]::Replace(
        $content,
        $pattern,
        $verificationBlock + '$1',
        1
    )

    Write-Host "[OK] Verification module initialized."

    Write-Host "[SKIP] Verification module initialization already exists."

$serviceFile = ".\internal\verification\service.go"

    exit 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------

)

    throw "ExecuteVerification method was not found."
}

$methodEnd = $content.IndexOf(
    "`n}",
    $methodStart
)

if ($methodEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "End of ExecuteVerification method was not found."
}

$methodContent = $content.Substring(
    $methodStart,
    $methodEnd - $methodStart
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------

$verifiedAssignment = 'verification.VerifiedAt = &now'

$assignmentPosition = $methodContent.IndexOf(
    $verifiedAssignment
)

if ($assignmentPosition -lt 0) {
    throw "VerifiedAt assignment inside ExecuteVerification was not found."
}

# Find the end of the line containing VerifiedAt assignment
$lineEnd = $methodContent.IndexOf(
    "`n",
    $assignmentPosition
)

if ($lineEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "End of VerifiedAt assignment line was not found."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Insert ExpiresAt immediately after VerifiedAt assignment
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$expirationCode = @"
		expiresAt := now.Add(time.Hour)
		verification.ExpiresAt = &expiresAt
"@

$absoluteInsertPosition = $methodStart + $lineEnd + 1

$content = `
    $content.Substring(0, $absoluteInsertPosition) +
    $expirationCode + "`r`n" +
    $content.Substring($absoluteInsertPosition)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$BaseUrl = "http://localhost:8080"

$Passed = 0
$Failed = 0

function Write-TestResult {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [bool]$Success
    )

    if ($Success) {
        Write-Host ("[PASS] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Green
        $script:Passed++
    }
    else {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Red
        $script:Failed++
    }
}

function Invoke-Api {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Url,
        [string]$Body = ""
    )

    try {
        if ($Body -ne "") {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -ContentType "application/json" `
                -Body $Body `
                -UseBasicParsing

        }
        else {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -UseBasicParsing
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $true
            StatusCode = [int]$Response.StatusCode
            Body       = $Response.Content
            Error      = ""
        }
    }
    catch {
        $StatusCode = 0
        $ResponseBody = ""

        if ($_.Exception.Response) {
            try {
                $StatusCode = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            catch {
                $StatusCode = 0
            }

            try {
                $Stream = $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

                if ($Stream) {
                    $Reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($Stream)
                    $ResponseBody = $Reader.ReadToEnd()
                    $Reader.Close()
                    $Stream.Close()
                }
            }
            catch {
                $ResponseBody = ""
            }
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $false
            StatusCode = $StatusCode
            Body       = $ResponseBody
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

function Assert-ApiSuccess {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        $Result,
        [int[]]$ExpectedStatusCodes
    )

    $Success = $false

    if ($Result.Success -and
        $ExpectedStatusCodes -contains $Result.StatusCode) {

        $Success = $true
    }

    Write-TestResult $Name $Success

    if (-not $Success) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "  HTTP Status : $($Result.StatusCode)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        if ($Result.Body -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Response:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Body)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        if ($Result.Error -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Error:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Error)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host ""
    }

    return $Success
}

# =========================================================
# 3. Test one verification status
# =========================================================

function Test-VerificationStatus {

    param (
        [string]$StatusName,
        [string]$VerificationType,
        [string]$ExpectedStatus
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"
    Write-Host "Testing status: $StatusName"
    Write-Host "Verification type: $VerificationType"
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"

    try {

        # Create a NEW user for every test.
        $userId = New-TestUser

        Write-Host "User ID: $userId"

        $body = @{
            user_id = $userId
            verification_type = $VerificationType
            provider = "test-provider"
            data = @{
                test_result = $ExpectedStatus
            }
        } | ConvertTo-Json

        $result = Invoke-RestMethod `
            -Uri $executeUrl `
            -Method Post `
            -ContentType "application/json" `
            -Body $body `
            -TimeoutSec 10

        Write-Host "[OK] Request completed."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Validate status
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($result.status -ne $ExpectedStatus) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] Status mismatch."
            Write-Host "Expected: $ExpectedStatus"
            Write-Host "Actual:   $($result.status)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] Status response validated."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Non-verified statuses must not expire
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($null -ne $result.expires_at) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] expires_at should be null."
            Write-Host "Actual: $($result.expires_at)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] expires_at is null."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Rejected must have rejection_reason
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($ExpectedStatus -eq "rejected") {

            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.rejection_reason)) {

                Write-Host ""
                Write-Host "[FAILED] rejection_reason is missing."

                return $false
            }

            Write-Host "[OK] rejection_reason exists."
        }

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Final result
        # -------------------------------------------------

        Write-Host "[OK] $StatusName PASSED."
        Write-Host "Verification ID: $($result.id)"

        return $true
    }
    catch {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[FAILED] $StatusName"
        Write-Host "HTTP ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)"

        if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "API RESPONSE:"
            Write-Host $_.ErrorDetails.Message
        }

        return $false
    }
}

# =========================================================
# 4. Run tests
# =========================================================

$passed = 0
$failed = 0

param(
    [string]$RepositoryPath = (Get-Location).Path,
    [string]$OutputFile = "migration-audit-report.txt"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepositoryPath = (Resolve-Path $RepositoryPath).Path
$OutputPath = if ([System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($OutputFile)) {
    $OutputFile
} else {
    Join-Path $RepositoryPath $OutputFile
}

# Directories that should not be scanned.
$ExcludedDirectories = @(
    ".git",
    "node_modules",
    "vendor",
    "bin",
    "obj",
    "dist",
    "build",
    ".next",
    "coverage"
)

# Relevant migration, schema and database file extensions.
$RelevantExtensions = @(
    ".sql", ".go", ".prisma", ".py", ".ts", ".js",
    ".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".xml",
    ".md", ".txt", ".ps1", ".sh", ".graphql"
)

# Include files based on their paths or filenames.
$PathPattern = '(?i)(^|[/\\])([^/\\]*(migration|migrations|migrate|schema|schemas|database|databases|db|seed|seeds|ddl|changelog)[^/\\]*[/\\]|[^/\\]*(migration|migrations|schema|seed|changelog|flyway|liquibase)[^/\\]*)'

$Content = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Add-ReportLine {
    param([AllowEmptyString()][string]$Text = "")
    $script:Content.Add($Text)
}

Add-ReportLine "IGD - MIGRATION AND DATABASE AUDIT REPORT"
Add-ReportLine "Generated: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"
Add-ReportLine "Repository: $RepositoryPath"
Add-ReportLine "Output: $OutputPath"
Add-ReportLine ("=" * 100)

# Git metadata.
Add-ReportLine "`r`n### 1. GIT STATUS"

if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    $GitRoot = git -C $RepositoryPath rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Add-ReportLine "Git root: $GitRoot"
        Add-ReportLine "`r`n--- Current branch ---"
        Add-ReportLine ((git -C $RepositoryPath branch --show-current 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())

        Add-ReportLine "`r`n--- Working tree status ---"
        Add-ReportLine ((git -C $RepositoryPath status --short 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())

        Add-ReportLine "`r`n--- Latest 20 commits ---"
        Add-ReportLine ((git -C $RepositoryPath log -20 --date=short --pretty=format:"%h %ad %s" 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())
    } else {
        Add-ReportLine "Git metadata unavailable; directory may not be a Git repository."
    }
} else {
    Add-ReportLine "Git executable not found."
}

# Collect files, excluding generated and dependency directories.
Add-ReportLine "`r`n### 2. FILE DISCOVERY"

$AllFiles = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $RepositoryPath -Recurse -File -Force |
    Where-Object {
        $FullName = $_.FullName
        $RelativePath = $FullName.Substring($RepositoryPath.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $Parts = $RelativePath -split '[/\\]'

        ($Parts | Where-Object { $ExcludedDirectories -contains $_ }).Count -eq 0 -and
        $FullName -ne $OutputPath -and
        $_.Name -ne "export-migrations-audit.ps1"
    }

$Candidates = @(
    $AllFiles | Where-Object {
        $RelativePath = $_.FullName.Substring($RepositoryPath.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $Extension = $_.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()

        $IsRelevantPath = $RelativePath -match $PathPattern
        $IsSQL = $Extension -eq ".sql"
        $IsRelevantExtension = $RelevantExtensions -contains $Extension

        $IsRelevantPath -or $IsSQL
    } | Sort-Object FullName -Unique
)

Add-ReportLine "Total files in repository (excluding ignored directories): $(@($AllFiles).Count)"
Add-ReportLine "Migration/schema/database candidates: $(@($Candidates).Count)"
Add-ReportLine "`r`n--- Candidate file inventory ---"

foreach ($File in $Candidates) {
    $RelativePath = $File.FullName.Substring($RepositoryPath.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
    $Hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $File.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

    Add-ReportLine ("{0} | {1} bytes | SHA256: {2}" -f $RelativePath, $File.Length, $Hash)
}

# Look for schema objects and migration operations in relevant files.
Add-ReportLine "`r`n### 3. STRUCTURAL KEYWORD INDEX"

$KeywordPattern = '(?i)\b(CREATE\s+TABLE|ALTER\s+TABLE|DROP\s+TABLE|CREATE\s+(UNIQUE\s+)?INDEX|DROP\s+INDEX|PRIMARY\s+KEY|FOREIGN\s+KEY|REFERENCES|UNIQUE|CHECK\s*\(|NOT\s+NULL|CREATE\s+TYPE|CREATE\s+SCHEMA|CREATE\s+EXTENSION|CREATE\s+SEQUENCE|CREATE\s+FUNCTION|CREATE\s+TRIGGER|INSERT\s+INTO|UPDATE\s+\w+|DELETE\s+FROM|BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK|migrate|migration|AutoMigrate|TableName|ForeignKey|OnDelete|OnUpdate)\b'

foreach ($File in $Candidates) {
    if ($File.Extension.ToLowerInvariant() -notin @(
        ".sql", ".go", ".prisma", ".py", ".ts", ".js", ".md", ".txt"
    )) {
        continue
    }

    try {
        $Lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName
        $RelativePath = $File.FullName.Substring($RepositoryPath.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $Matches = @()

        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Lines.Count; $i++) {
            if ($Lines[$i] -match $KeywordPattern) {
                $Matches += ("L{0}: {1}" -f ($i + 1), $Lines[$i].Trim())
            }
        }

        if ($Matches.Count -gt 0) {
            Add-ReportLine "`r`n--- $RelativePath ---"
            foreach ($Match in $Matches) {
                Add-ReportLine $Match
            }
        }
    } catch {
        Add-ReportLine "Could not index $($File.FullName): $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

# Full contents: preserve migration SQL and related schema definitions.
Add-ReportLine "`r`n### 4. FULL FILE CONTENTS"
Add-ReportLine "Candidate files are included in full where readable."
Add-ReportLine "Binary or unreadable files are reported but not decoded."
Add-ReportLine ("=" * 100)

foreach ($File in $Candidates) {
    $RelativePath = $File.FullName.Substring($RepositoryPath.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')

    Add-ReportLine "`r`n"
    Add-ReportLine ("FILE: " + $RelativePath)
    Add-ReportLine ("SIZE: " + $File.Length + " bytes")
    Add-ReportLine ("-" * 100)

    try {
        $RawContent = Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop

        if ($null -eq $RawContent) {
            Add-ReportLine "[EMPTY FILE]"
        } else {
            Add-ReportLine $RawContent
        }
    } catch {
        Add-ReportLine "[READ ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)]"
    }

    Add-ReportLine ("=" * 100)
}

# Write the final report only after collection is complete.
$ParentDirectory = Split-Path -Parent $OutputPath

if ($ParentDirectory -and !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ParentDirectory)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ParentDirectory -Force | Out-Null
}

$ReportText = $Content -join "`r`n"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
    $OutputPath,
    $ReportText,
    [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($true)
)

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Migration audit report created." -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "File: $OutputPath"
Write-Host "Candidate files: $(@($Candidates).Count)"
Write-Host "Report size: $((Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputPath).Length) bytes"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Review the report for secrets before sharing it." -ForegroundColor Yellow

# General Market Backend - Architecture Map

## Purpose

The General Market backend coordinates offers, supply requests, orders,
matching, trades, and trade execution workflows. It does not replace the
independent systems that own identity, balances, contracts, services,
ownership records, or financial settlement.

## Logical tree

Ã¢â€â€Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ docs/architecture/           Architecture documentation

## Systems of record

- Account: identity, authentication context, roles, and permissions.
- My Assets: free balance, buying power, reservation/release, asset positions.
- Contracts: legal contracts and obligations.
- Services: transport, storage, inspection, insurance, installation, delivery.
- Settlement: authoritative financial settlement execution and result.
- Official institutions: authoritative legal registration or official records,
  where applicable.
- General Market: market workflow, offers, orders, matching, trades, references,
  execution policy, and coordination states.

## Mandatory design constraints

1. The client is not authoritative for permissions, buying power, matching,
   or state transitions.
2. Financial and asset balances must not be independently duplicated here.
3. External operations require explicit contracts, timeouts, error handling,
   correlation identifiers, and safe retry behavior.
4. Concurrent order and matching operations require transactional safeguards
   and idempotency.
5. Published configuration and execution policy versions must be traceable.
6. Important transitions must be auditable without copying complete external
   records unnecessarily.
7. Database migrations must be versioned, reviewable, and non-destructive by
   default. Never rebuild or erase an existing database automatically.
8. Redis and message brokers are optional; introduce them only after a
   measured technical requirement.
9. A directory or README is not a completed feature. Each module needs code,
   API contracts where applicable, automated tests, and acceptance checks.
10. Infrastructure adapters must have a single clear location. If an older
    implementation exists under internal/database, review imports and behavior
    before consolidating or moving it to infrastructure/postgres.

## Implementation order

1. Inspect current repository, Go packages, migrations, configuration, and API.
2. Stabilize application bootstrap, PostgreSQL access, errors, logging, health,
   and test harness.
3. Implement catalogue and market/offer configuration.
4. Implement offers and eligibility.
5. Implement supply requests, orders, reservations, and matching.
6. Implement trades, state machines, execution policies, and workflows.
7. Add integrations, commodity aggregation, real-asset workflows, and audit
   coverage as required by the detailed specification.
8. Verify concurrency, security, performance, migrations, and recovery.

This document defines logical responsibilities, not separate deployable
services. Go package boundaries must remain simple and avoid circular imports.

# Eligibility

Responsibility:

FILE: README.md
SIZE: 760 bytes
# General Market Backend

Initial Go HTTP service for the General Market backend.

## Requirements

- Go 1.25 or newer
- PostgreSQL for database-backed readiness and migrations

## Go module mirror

The bootstrap script uses the Liara Go module mirror:
https://package-mirror.liara.ir/repository/go/

## Configuration

Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and set `DATABASE_URL`.

The application reads environment variables directly; it does not load `.env`
automatically. Do not commit credentials.

## Run

```powershell
go mod tidy
go test ./...
go vet ./...
go run ./cmd/server
```

## Health endpoints

- `GET /healthz`: process liveness
- `GET /readyz`: database readiness

The initial migration creates no business tables.

FILE: account-backend\migrations\001_create_users.sql
SIZE: 611 bytes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT users_user_type_check
        CHECK (user_type IN ('individual', 'legal')),

    CONSTRAINT users_status_check
        CHECK (status IN (
            'active',
            'limited',
            'suspended',
            'blocked',
            'closed'
        ))
);
====================================================================================================

CREATE TABLE user_profiles (
    user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

    first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    national_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    birth_date DATE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT user_profiles_user_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

FILE: account-backend\migrations\006_create_verifications.sql
SIZE: 1850 bytes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    verification_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',

    reference_id VARCHAR(255),

    verification_level VARCHAR(30),

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    rejection_reason TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_type_check
        CHECK (
            verification_type IN (
                'identity',
                'contact',
                'bank',
                'document',
                'biometric',
                'legal_entity',
                'official_document'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_status_check
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'verified',
                'rejected',
                'failed',
                'expired',
                'manual_review'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_level_check
        CHECK (
            verification_level IS NULL
            OR verification_level IN (
                'basic',
                'standard',
                'strong'
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_id
    ON verifications(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_type
    ON verifications(user_id, verification_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_status
    ON verifications(status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_reference_id
    ON verifications(reference_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_user_roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    role_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_roles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    scope_id UUID,

    assigned_by UUID
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_roles_dates_check
        CHECK (
            expires_at IS NULL
            OR expires_at > starts_at
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_user
    ON authorization_user_roles(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_role
    ON authorization_user_roles(role_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_scope
    ON authorization_user_roles(scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_active
    ON authorization_user_roles(is_active);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_expires
    ON authorization_user_roles(expires_at);

        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_scopes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    scope_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    resource_type VARCHAR(100),

    resource_id UUID,

    parent_scope_id UUID
        REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    name VARCHAR(200),

    description TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_scope_type_check
        CHECK (
            scope_type IN (
                'global',
                'organization',
                'project',
                'asset',
                'contract',
                'self',
                'custom'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_resource_pair_check
        CHECK (
            (
                scope_type IN ('global', 'self')
                AND resource_type IS NULL
                AND resource_id IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                scope_type IN (
                    'organization',
                    'project',
                    'asset',
                    'contract',
                    'custom'
                )
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_scope_type
    ON authorization_scopes(scope_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_resource
    ON authorization_scopes(resource_type, resource_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_parent
    ON authorization_scopes(parent_scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_active
    ON authorization_scopes(is_active);


-- ============================================================
-- Foreign-key links to scopes
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE authorization_user_roles
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_authorization_user_roles_scope
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_id)
    REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL;

ALTER TABLE authorization_user_permission_overrides
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_authorization_user_permission_overrides_scope
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_id)
    REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- General Market Backend
-- Migration: 000002_market_domain_foundation.sql
-- Additive, versioned and non-destructive.
--
-- Ownership boundaries:
-- * No account credentials or authoritative role database.
-- * No free-balance ledger or authoritative reservation ledger.
-- * No official property ownership register.
-- * No legal contract body owned by Contracts service.
-- * No service-delivery records owned by Services.
-- * No final settlement ledger owned by Settlement.
--
-- External identifiers are stored as references, not copied records.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS markets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    allowed_trade_methods JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    display_rules JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'paused', 'closed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_categories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    parent_id UUID REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS specialized_classifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    domain_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_mappings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    public_category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    specialized_classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    market_id UUID REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (public_category_id, specialized_classification_id, market_id),
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameter_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    data_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    unit_code VARCHAR(60),
    is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    validation_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (classification_id, code, version),
    CHECK (data_type IN ('string', 'integer', 'decimal', 'boolean', 'date', 'datetime', 'enum', 'object', 'array')),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_configurations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    current_version INTEGER,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'retired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_config_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    configuration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offer_configurations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    rules_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    calculation_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    qualification_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    document_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (configuration_id, version),
    CHECK (version > 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved', 'published', 'retired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_config_parameters (
    configuration_version_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    parameter_definition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES parameter_definitions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    overrides JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    PRIMARY KEY (configuration_version_id, parameter_definition_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_rules (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    configuration_version_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    rule_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    definition JSONB NOT NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (configuration_version_id, code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_documents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    offer_id UUID,
    configuration_version_id UUID REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    document_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    external_document_ref VARCHAR(240),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'required',
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('required', 'submitted', 'verified', 'rejected', 'expired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_qualifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    company_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    external_verification_ref VARCHAR(240),
    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended', 'expired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    public_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    market_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    public_category_id UUID REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    configuration_version_id UUID REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    owner_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,
    offer_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sale',
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    quantity_total NUMERIC(24,8),
    quantity_unit VARCHAR(60),
    attributes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'pending_review', 'approved', 'published', 'suspended', 'rejected', 'expired', 'closed')),
    CHECK (offer_type IN ('sale', 'purchase', 'service', 'physical_commodity', 'real_asset')),
    CHECK (price_amount IS NULL OR price_amount >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_total IS NULL OR quantity_total >= 0),
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from)
);

ALTER TABLE offer_documents
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_offer_documents_offer
    FOREIGN KEY (offer_id) REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    changed_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    change_reason TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (offer_id, version),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_approvals (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    configuration_version_id UUID REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    reviewer_ref VARCHAR(160),
    decision VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    rule_results JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (decision IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'changes_requested'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supply_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    request_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    requester_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    market_id UUID REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    classification_id UUID REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    quantity NUMERIC(24,8),
    quantity_unit VARCHAR(60),
    target_price NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    requirements JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    response_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published', 'receiving_proposals', 'evaluating', 'awarded', 'cancelled', 'expired')),
    CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity > 0),
    CHECK (target_price IS NULL OR target_price >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supply_proposals (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES supply_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    proposer_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    quantity NUMERIC(24,8),
    delivery_terms JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    terms JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn', 'expired')),
    CHECK (price_amount IS NULL OR price_amount >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    participant_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
    order_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'limit',
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_checks',
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    quantity_original NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    quantity_remaining NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    quantity_filled NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    external_reservation_ref VARCHAR(240),
    idempotency_key VARCHAR(160),
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (side IN ('buy', 'sell')),
    CHECK (order_type IN ('limit', 'market', 'offer_directed')),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending_checks', 'pending_reservation', 'open', 'partially_filled', 'filled', 'cancelled', 'rejected', 'expired', 'failed')),
    CHECK (quantity_original > 0),
    CHECK (quantity_remaining >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_filled >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_remaining + quantity_filled = quantity_original),
    CHECK (price_amount IS NULL OR price_amount >= 0),
    UNIQUE (participant_ref, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_matches (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    buy_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    sell_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    matched_quantity NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    matched_price NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (buy_order_id <> sell_order_id),
    CHECK (matched_quantity > 0),
    CHECK (matched_price >= 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('recorded', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'trade_created', 'failed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    trade_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    match_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES order_matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    buy_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    sell_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    buyer_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    seller_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    quantity NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
    execution_policy_version_id UUID,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CHECK (price_amount >= 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('created', 'in_execution', 'awaiting_contract', 'awaiting_services', 'awaiting_delivery', 'ready_for_settlement', 'settlement_pending', 'settled', 'cancelled', 'failed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_policies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    market_id UUID REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    offer_type VARCHAR(40),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'retired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_policy_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    policy_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_policies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    steps JSONB NOT NULL,
    conditions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (policy_id, version),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

ALTER TABLE trades
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trades_execution_policy_version
    FOREIGN KEY (execution_policy_version_id)
    REFERENCES execution_policy_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade_workflows (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    trade_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES trades(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    policy_version_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES execution_policy_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    current_step_code VARCHAR(120),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(100),
    last_error_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (trade_id),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting_external', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
    CHECK (retry_count >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade_state_history (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,

    state_domain VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    previous_state VARCHAR(40),
    new_state VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    actor_ref VARCHAR(160),
    reason TEXT,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_operations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    service_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    operation_code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    external_ref VARCHAR(240),
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key VARCHAR(160),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    request_metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    response_metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    error_code VARCHAR(100),
    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_retry_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'retry_wait', 'cancelled')),
    CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    UNIQUE (service_code, operation_code, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commodity_aggregation_jobs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    job_code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    commodity_classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    requested_quantity NUMERIC(24,8),
    quantity_unit VARCHAR(60),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    criteria JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    result_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'evaluating', 'proposed', 'accepted', 'cancelled', 'failed')),
    CHECK (requested_quantity IS NULL OR requested_quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commodity_aggregation_items (
    aggregation_job_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES commodity_aggregation_jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    eligible_quantity NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'included',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (aggregation_job_id, offer_id),
    CHECK (eligible_quantity > 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('included', 'excluded', 'reserved_externally', 'fulfilled'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS real_asset_workflows (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    workflow_code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    trade_id UUID REFERENCES trades(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    offer_id UUID REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    external_asset_ref VARCHAR(240),
    external_registry_ref VARCHAR(240),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    platform_position_ref VARCHAR(240),
    official_ownership_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'verification_pending', 'contract_pending', 'transfer_pending', 'completed', 'rejected', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
    CHECK (official_ownership_status IN ('unknown', 'not_applicable', 'pending', 'confirmed', 'rejected'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS institutional_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    institution_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    request_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    external_request_ref VARCHAR(240),
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    legal_basis_ref VARCHAR(240),
    access_scope JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    response_metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'authorized', 'rejected', 'submitted', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_events (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    event_code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    entity_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    actor_ref VARCHAR(160),
    outcome VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    reason_code VARCHAR(100),
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    rule_version_ref VARCHAR(160),
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_records (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    scope_code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    request_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress',
    response_status INTEGER,
    response_body JSONB,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (scope_code, idempotency_key),
    CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'failed'))
);

-- Indexes for public catalogue, lifecycle queues, matching and traceability.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_offers_public_catalogue
    ON offers (market_id, public_category_id, published_at DESC, id DESC)
    WHERE status = 'published';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_offers_classification_status
    ON offers (classification_id, status, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_offers_validity
    ON offers (valid_until)
    WHERE status = 'published' AND valid_until IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_category_mappings_public
    ON category_mappings (public_category_id, is_active);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_supply_requests_status_deadline
    ON supply_requests (status, response_deadline);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_supply_proposals_request_status
    ON supply_proposals (request_id, status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_offer_status
    ON orders (offer_id, status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_order_book
    ON orders (offer_id, side, price_amount, created_at)
    WHERE status IN ('open', 'partially_filled');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_matches_buy_order
    ON order_matches (buy_order_id, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_matches_sell_order
    ON order_matches (sell_order_id, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_status_created
    ON trades (status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trade_workflows_status
    ON trade_workflows (status, updated_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trade_state_history_trade
    ON trade_state_history (trade_id, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_integration_operations_retry
    ON integration_operations (status, next_retry_at)
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'retry_wait', 'failed');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_real_asset_workflows_status
    ON real_asset_workflows (status, updated_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_institutional_requests_correlation
    ON institutional_requests (correlation_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_events_entity
    ON audit_events (entity_type, entity_ref, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_events_correlation
    ON audit_events (correlation_id)
    WHERE correlation_id IS NOT NULL;

# سند معماری، جریان داده و روابط سرویس بازار کلی (General Market)

**عنوان:** دیاگرام معماری، جریان داده و روابط «سرویس بازار کلی» (General Market)  
**وضعیت:** نسخه اصلاح‌شده منطبق با معماری سرویس‌های مستقل پلتفرم مدیریت دارایی‌های واقعی  
**اصل معماری:** حفظ مرز مسئولیت بک‌اندها، یکپارچگی تجربه کاربر و قابلیت تنظیم فرایند اجرای معامله بر اساس نوع عرضه و معامله.
