FILE: test-clone\account-backend\migrations\006_create_verifications.sql
SIZE: 1850 bytes
------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    verification_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',

    reference_id VARCHAR(255),

    verification_level VARCHAR(30),

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    rejection_reason TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_type_check
        CHECK (
            verification_type IN (
                'identity',
                'contact',
                'bank',
                'document',
                'biometric',
                'legal_entity',
                'official_document'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_status_check
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'verified',
                'rejected',
                'failed',
                'expired',
                'manual_review'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_level_check
        CHECK (
            verification_level IS NULL
            OR verification_level IN (
                'basic',
                'standard',
                'strong'
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_id
    ON verifications(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_type
    ON verifications(user_id, verification_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_status
    ON verifications(status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_reference_id
    ON verifications(reference_id);

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_user_roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    role_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_roles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    scope_id UUID,

    assigned_by UUID
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_roles_dates_check
        CHECK (
            expires_at IS NULL
            OR expires_at > starts_at
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_user
    ON authorization_user_roles(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_role
    ON authorization_user_roles(role_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_scope
    ON authorization_user_roles(scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_active
    ON authorization_user_roles(is_active);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_roles_expires
    ON authorization_user_roles(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_user_permission_overrides (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    permission_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_permissions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    effect VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,

    scope_id UUID,

    assigned_by UUID
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    reason TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_permission_overrides_effect_check
        CHECK (
            effect IN (
                'allow',
                'deny'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_permission_overrides_dates_check
        CHECK (
            expires_at IS NULL
            OR expires_at > starts_at
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_user
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_permission
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(permission_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_scope
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_effect
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(effect);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_active
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(is_active);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_user_permission_overrides_expires
    ON authorization_user_permission_overrides(expires_at);

-- ============================================================
-- 019_create_authorization_scopes.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_scopes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    scope_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    resource_type VARCHAR(100),

    resource_id UUID,

    parent_scope_id UUID
        REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    name VARCHAR(200),

    description TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_scope_type_check
        CHECK (
            scope_type IN (
                'global',
                'organization',
                'project',
                'asset',
                'contract',
                'self',
                'custom'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_resource_pair_check
        CHECK (
            (
                scope_type IN ('global', 'self')
                AND resource_type IS NULL
                AND resource_id IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                scope_type IN (
                    'organization',
                    'project',
                    'asset',
                    'contract',
                    'custom'
                )
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_scope_type
    ON authorization_scopes(scope_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_resource
    ON authorization_scopes(resource_type, resource_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_parent
    ON authorization_scopes(parent_scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_active
    ON authorization_scopes(is_active);


-- ============================================================
-- Foreign-key links to scopes
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE authorization_user_roles
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_authorization_user_roles_scope
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_id)
    REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL;

ALTER TABLE authorization_user_permission_overrides
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_authorization_user_permission_overrides_scope
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_id)
    REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL;

# ============================================================
# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-FileIfNotExists {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path $Directory)) {
        New-Item `
            -ItemType Directory `
            -Path $Directory `
            -Force | Out-Null
    }

    if (Test-Path $Path) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "File already exists:" `
            -ForegroundColor DarkYellow

        Write-Host $Path

        return $false
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $Path,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Created:" `
        -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host $Path

    return $true
}

package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"account-backend/infrastructure/postgres"
)

type EmailRepository struct {
	db *postgres.Client
}

func NewEmailRepository(
	db *postgres.Client,
) *EmailRepository {
	return &EmailRepository{
		db: db,
	}
}

func (r *EmailRepository) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		INSERT INTO user_emails (
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary
		)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
		RETURNING
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
	`

	var result UserEmail

	err := r.db.Pool.QueryRow(
		ctx,
		query,
		email.UserID,
		email.Email,
		email.IsPrimary,
	).Scan(
		&result.ID,
		&result.UserID,
		&result.Email,
		&result.IsPrimary,
		&result.IsVerified,
		&result.VerifiedAt,
		&result.CreatedAt,
		&result.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to create user email: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return &result, nil
}

func (r *EmailRepository) GetByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserEmail, error) {

	query := `
		SELECT
			id,
			user_id,
			email,
			is_primary,
			is_verified,
			verified_at,
			created_at,
			updated_at
		FROM user_emails
		WHERE user_id = $1
		ORDER BY is_primary DESC, created_at ASC
	`

	rows, err := r.db.Pool.Query(
		ctx,
		query,
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to get user emails: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	defer rows.Close()

	var emails []UserEmail

	for rows.Next() {

		var email UserEmail

		err := rows.Scan(
			&email.ID,
			&email.UserID,
			&email.Email,
			&email.IsPrimary,
			&email.IsVerified,
			&email.VerifiedAt,
			&email.CreatedAt,
			&email.UpdatedAt,
		)

		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
				"failed to scan user email: %w",
				err,
			)
		}

		emails = append(
			emails,
			email,
		)
	}

	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"failed to iterate user emails: %w",
			err,
		)
	}

	return emails, nil
}

package user

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type EmailService struct {
	repository *EmailRepository
}

func NewEmailService(
	repository *EmailRepository,
) *EmailService {
	return &EmailService{
		repository: repository,
	}
}

func (s *EmailService) CreateEmail(
	ctx context.Context,
	email *UserEmail,
) (*UserEmail, error) {

	if email == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"email is required",
		)
	}

	email.UserID = strings.TrimSpace(
		email.UserID,
	)

	email.Email = strings.ToLower(
		strings.TrimSpace(
			email.Email,
		),
	)

	if email.UserID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"user id is required",
		)
	}

	if email.Email == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"email is required",
		)
	}

	if !strings.Contains(
		email.Email,
		"@",
	) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"invalid email address",
		)
	}

	return s.repository.Create(
		ctx,
		email,
	)
}

func (s *EmailService) GetEmailsByUserID(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
) ([]UserEmail, error) {

	userID = strings.TrimSpace(userID)

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
			"user id is required",
		)
	}

	return s.repository.GetByUserID(
		ctx,
		userID,
	)
}
'@

    -Content $ServiceContent | Out-Null

package user

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

type EmailHandler struct {
	service *EmailService
}

func NewEmailHandler(
	service *EmailService,
) *EmailHandler {
	return &EmailHandler{
		service: service,
	}
}

type createEmailRequest struct {
	UserID    string `json:"user_id"`
	Email     string `json:"email"`
	IsPrimary bool   `json:"is_primary"`
}

func (h *EmailHandler) CreateEmail(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {

	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			map[string]string{
				"error": "method not allowed",
			},
		)

		return
	}

	var request createEmailRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(
		r.Body,
	).Decode(&request); err != nil {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			map[string]string{
				"error": "invalid request body",
			},
		)

		return
	}

	email := &UserEmail{
		UserID:    request.UserID,
		Email:     request.Email,
		IsPrimary: request.IsPrimary,
	}

	result, err := h.service.CreateEmail(
		r.Context(),
		email,
	)

	if err != nil {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			map[string]string{
				"error": err.Error(),
			},
		)

		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusCreated,
		result,
	)
}

func (h *EmailHandler) GetEmailsByUserID(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {

	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			map[string]string{
				"error": "method not allowed",
			},
		)

		return
	}

	userID := strings.TrimPrefix(
		r.URL.Path,
		"/api/v1/users/",
	)

	userID = strings.TrimSuffix(
		userID,
		"/emails",
	)

	userID = strings.TrimSpace(
		userID,
	)

	if userID == "" {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			map[string]string{
				"error": "user id is required",
			},
		)

		return
	}

	emails, err := h.service.GetEmailsByUserID(
		r.Context(),
		userID,
	)

	if err != nil {

		writeJSON(
			w,
			http.StatusNotFound,
			map[string]string{
				"error": err.Error(),
			},
		)

		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusOK,
		emails,
	)
}
'@

# ============================================================
# Helper
# ============================================================

function Write-File {
    param (
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $Root $Path
    $Directory = Split-Path -Parent $FullPath

    New-Item `
        -ItemType Directory `
        -Force `
        -Path $Directory `
        | Out-Null

    if (Test-Path $FullPath) {
        Write-Host "SKIP: $Path already exists" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
        return
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $FullPath,
        $Content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "CREATE: $Path" -ForegroundColor Green
}

CREATE TABLE user_phones (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL,

    phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    is_primary BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT user_phones_user_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_phones_user_id
    ON user_phones(user_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_phones_unique_number
    ON user_phones(phone_number);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_phones_primary
    ON user_phones(user_id)
    WHERE is_primary = TRUE;
'@

// Verify عملیات Verification آزمایشی را انجام می‌دهد.
func (p *TestProvider) Verify(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *ProviderRequest,
) (*ProviderResult, error) {

	if request == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider request is nil")
	}

	if request.UserID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if request.VerificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, ctx.Err()
	default:
	}

	status := VerificationStatusVerified

	if request.Data != nil {
		switch request.Data["test_result"] {
		case "":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "verified":
			status = VerificationStatusVerified

		case "rejected":
			status = VerificationStatusRejected

		case "failed":
			status = VerificationStatusFailed

		case "manual_review":
			status = VerificationStatusManualReview

		case "pending":
			status = VerificationStatusPending

		default:
			return nil, errors.New("invalid test result")
		}
	}

	result := &ProviderResult{
		Status:            status,
		ReferenceID:       request.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: VerificationLevelBasic,
	}

	if status == VerificationStatusRejected {
		result.RejectionReason = "test rejection"
	}

	return result, nil
}

$serviceFile = ".\internal\verification\service.go"
$handlerFile = ".\internal\verification\handler.go"

Write-Host "========================================"

# =========================================================
# 1. Check files
# =========================================================

foreach ($file in @($serviceFile, $handlerFile, $mainFile)) {

    if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
        throw "Required file not found: $file"
    }

# 2. Create backups

Copy-Item $serviceFile $serviceBackup -Force
Copy-Item $handlerFile $handlerBackup -Force
Copy-Item $mainFile $mainBackup -Force

# =========================================================
# 3. Add ExecuteVerification to Service
# =========================================================

$serviceContent = Get-Content $serviceFile -Raw

if ($serviceContent -notmatch 'func \(s \*Service\) ExecuteVerification') {

    $executeServiceCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات واقعی Verification را
// از طریق ProviderManager اجرا می‌کند و نتیجه را در PostgreSQL ذخیره می‌کند.
func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification(
	ctx context.Context,
	userID string,
	verificationType VerificationType,
	providerName string,
	data map[string]string,
) (*Verification, error) {

	if s == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification service is nil")
	}

	if s.repository == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("verification repository is nil")
	}

	if s.providers == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider manager is nil")
	}

	if userID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("user id is empty")
	}

	if verificationType == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("verification type is empty")
	}

	if providerName == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("provider name is empty")
	}

	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	request := &ProviderRequest{
		UserID:           userID,
		VerificationType: verificationType,
		Data:             data,
	}

	result, err := provider.Verify(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if result == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("provider result is nil")
	}

	verification := &Verification{
		UserID:            userID,
		VerificationType:  verificationType,
		Provider:          providerName,
		Status:            result.Status,
		ReferenceID:       result.ReferenceID,
		VerificationLevel: result.VerificationLevel,
		RejectionReason:   result.RejectionReason,
	}

	if result.Status == VerificationStatusVerified {
		now := time.Now()
		verification.VerifiedAt = &now
	}

	if err := s.repository.Create(ctx, verification); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return verification, nil
}
'@

    $serviceContent = $serviceContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeServiceCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $serviceFile `
        -Value $serviceContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Service."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Service."
}

# =========================================================
# 4. Add ExecuteVerification to Handler
# =========================================================

$handlerContent = Get-Content $handlerFile -Raw

if ($handlerContent -notmatch 'func \(h \*Handler\) ExecuteVerification') {

    $executeHandlerCode = @'

// ExecuteVerification یک عملیات Verification را اجرا می‌کند.
func (h *Handler) ExecuteVerification(
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusMethodNotAllowed,
			"method not allowed",
		)
		return
	}

	if h == nil || h.service == nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusInternalServerError,
			"verification service is unavailable",
		)
		return
	}

	var request ExecuteVerificationRequest

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			"invalid request body",
		)
		return
	}

	verification, err := h.service.ExecuteVerification(
		r.Context(),
		request.UserID,
		request.VerificationType,
		request.Provider,
		request.Data,
	)

	if err != nil {
		writeJSONError(
			w,
			http.StatusBadRequest,
			err.Error(),
		)
		return
	}

	writeJSON(
		w,
		http.StatusOK,
		verification,
	)
}

// ExecuteVerificationRequest بدنه درخواست اجرای Verification است.
type ExecuteVerificationRequest struct {
	UserID           string            `json:"user_id"`
	VerificationType VerificationType `json:"verification_type"`
	Provider         string            `json:"provider"`
	Data             map[string]string `json:"data,omitempty"`
}
'@

    $handlerContent = $handlerContent.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $executeHandlerCode

    Set-Content `
        -Path $handlerFile `
        -Value $handlerContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] ExecuteVerification added to Handler."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] ExecuteVerification already exists in Handler."
}

# =========================================================
# 5. Add route to main.go
# =========================================================

$mainContent = Get-Content $mainFile -Raw

if ($mainContent -notmatch 'verificationHandler\.ExecuteVerification') {

    $routeCode = @'
        // Execute Verification
        mux.HandleFunc(
                "/api/v1/verifications/execute",
                verificationHandler.ExecuteVerification,
        )

'@

    $pattern = '(?m)^(\s*mux\.HandleFunc\(\s*"/api/v1/verifications"\s*,\s*verificationHandler\.CreateVerification\s*,\s*\))'

    if ($mainContent -notmatch $pattern) {

        Copy-Item $serviceBackup $serviceFile -Force
        Copy-Item $handlerBackup $handlerFile -Force
        Copy-Item $mainBackup $mainFile -Force

        throw "Verification create route not found in main.go."
    }

    $mainContent = [regex]::Replace(
        $mainContent,
        $pattern,
        '$1' + "`r`n`r`n" + $routeCode,
        1
    )

    Set-Content `
        -Path $mainFile `
        -Value $mainContent `
        -Encoding UTF8

    Write-Host "[OK] Execute Verification route added."
}
else {
    Write-Host "[SKIP] Execute Verification route already exists."
}

# =========================================================
# 6. Validate
# =========================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Validating..."

$serviceCheck = Get-Content $serviceFile -Raw
$handlerCheck = Get-Content $handlerFile -Raw
$mainCheck = Get-Content $mainFile -Raw

if ($serviceCheck -notmatch 'func \(s \*Service\) ExecuteVerification') {
    throw "Service validation failed."
}

if ($handlerCheck -notmatch 'func \(h \*Handler\) ExecuteVerification') {
    throw "Handler validation failed."
}

if ($mainCheck -notmatch 'verificationHandler\.ExecuteVerification') {
    throw "Route validation failed."
}

if ($mainCheck -notmatch '"/api/v1/verifications/execute"') {
    throw "Execute route path validation failed."
}

Write-Host "[OK] Validation passed."

# =========================================================
# 7. Format
# =========================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Running gofmt..."

gofmt -w `
    $serviceFile `
    $handlerFile `
    $mainFile

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

    Copy-Item $serviceBackup $serviceFile -Force
    Copy-Item $handlerBackup $handlerFile -Force
    Copy-Item $mainBackup $mainFile -Force

    throw "gofmt failed. Original files restored."
}

Write-Host "[OK] gofmt completed."

# =========================================================
# 8. Go tests
# =========================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Running Go tests..."
Write-Host ""

go test ./...

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[FAILED] go test ./..." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""

    Copy-Item $serviceBackup $serviceFile -Force
    Copy-Item $handlerBackup $handlerFile -Force
    Copy-Item $mainBackup $mainFile -Force

    Write-Host "[OK] Original files restored."

    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

        $Response,
        [int]$ActualStatus

    if ($ActualStatus -ne $ExpectedStatus) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "FAILED: $Step" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "Expected HTTP status: $ExpectedStatus" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "Actual HTTP status:   $ActualStatus" -ForegroundColor Red

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "Response:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            $Response | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
        }

        throw "API test failed."
    }

    Write-Host "$Step : OK" -ForegroundColor Green
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$serviceFile = ".\internal\verification\service.go"

if (-not (Test-Path $serviceFile)) {
    throw "File not found: $serviceFile"
}

$content = Get-Content $serviceFile -Raw

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Check whether expiration is already connected
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if ($content.Contains("verification.ExpiresAt = &expiresAt")) {
    Write-Host "[INFO] Verification expiration logic already exists."
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Locate ExecuteVerification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$methodStart = $content.IndexOf(
    "func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification("
)

if ($methodStart -lt 0) {
    throw "ExecuteVerification method was not found."
}

$methodEnd = $content.IndexOf(
    "`n}",
    $methodStart
)

if ($methodEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "End of ExecuteVerification method was not found."
}

$methodContent = $content.Substring(
    $methodStart,
    $methodEnd - $methodStart
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Locate VerifiedAt assignment inside ExecuteVerification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$verifiedAssignment = 'verification.VerifiedAt = &now'

$assignmentPosition = $methodContent.IndexOf(
    $verifiedAssignment
)

if ($assignmentPosition -lt 0) {
    throw "VerifiedAt assignment inside ExecuteVerification was not found."
}

# Find the end of the line containing VerifiedAt assignment
$lineEnd = $methodContent.IndexOf(
    "`n",
    $assignmentPosition
)

if ($lineEnd -lt 0) {
    throw "End of VerifiedAt assignment line was not found."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Insert ExpiresAt immediately after VerifiedAt assignment
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$expirationCode = @"
		expiresAt := now.Add(time.Hour)
		verification.ExpiresAt = &expiresAt
"@

$absoluteInsertPosition = $methodStart + $lineEnd + 1

$content = `
    $content.Substring(0, $absoluteInsertPosition) +
    $expirationCode + "`r`n" +
    $content.Substring($absoluteInsertPosition)

Set-Content `
    -Path $serviceFile `
    -Value $content `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[OK] Verification expiration logic added."

# ---------------------------------------------------------

}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Locate ExecuteVerification
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$methodStart = $content.IndexOf(
    "func (s *Service) ExecuteVerification("
)

if ($methodStart -lt 0) {
    throw "ExecuteVerification method was not found in service.go"
}

# Find the provider lookup only AFTER ExecuteVerification starts.
$providerText = @"
	provider, err := s.providers.Get(providerName)
"@

$providerStart = $content.IndexOf(
    $providerText,
    $methodStart
)

if ($providerStart -lt 0) {
    throw "Provider lookup inside ExecuteVerification was not found."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build reuse logic
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$reuseBlock = @"
	// Check whether a valid previous verification can be reused.
	existingVerification, err := s.GetLatestVerification(
		ctx,
		userID,
		verificationType,
	)

	if err == nil && existingVerification != nil {
		if existingVerification.IsValid(time.Now()) {
			return existingVerification, nil
		}
	}

"@

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Insert reuse logic immediately before provider lookup
# ---------------------------------------------------------

$content = `
    $content.Substring(0, $providerStart) +
    $reuseBlock +
    $content.Substring($providerStart)

Set-Content `
    -Path $serviceFile `
    -Value $content `
    -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "[OK] Verification reuse logic added."

}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$BaseUrl = "http://localhost:8080"

$Passed = 0
$Failed = 0

function Write-TestResult {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [bool]$Success
    )

    if ($Success) {
        Write-Host ("[PASS] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Green
        $script:Passed++
    }
    else {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] " + $Name) -ForegroundColor Red
        $script:Failed++
    }
}

function Invoke-Api {
    param(
        [string]$Method,
        [string]$Url,
        [string]$Body = ""
    )

    try {
        if ($Body -ne "") {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -ContentType "application/json" `
                -Body $Body `
                -UseBasicParsing

        }
        else {
            $Response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                -Uri $Url `
                -Method $Method `
                -UseBasicParsing
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $true
            StatusCode = [int]$Response.StatusCode
            Body       = $Response.Content
            Error      = ""
        }
    }
    catch {
        $StatusCode = 0
        $ResponseBody = ""

        if ($_.Exception.Response) {
            try {
                $StatusCode = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode
            }
            catch {
                $StatusCode = 0
            }

            try {
                $Stream = $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()

                if ($Stream) {
                    $Reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($Stream)
                    $ResponseBody = $Reader.ReadToEnd()
                    $Reader.Close()
                    $Stream.Close()
                }
            }
            catch {
                $ResponseBody = ""
            }
        }

        return @{
            Success    = $false
            StatusCode = $StatusCode
            Body       = $ResponseBody
            Error      = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

function Assert-ApiSuccess {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        $Result,
        [int[]]$ExpectedStatusCodes
    )

    $Success = $false

    if ($Result.Success -and
        $ExpectedStatusCodes -contains $Result.StatusCode) {

        $Success = $true
    }

    Write-TestResult $Name $Success

    if (-not $Success) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "  HTTP Status : $($Result.StatusCode)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        if ($Result.Body -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Response:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Body)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        if ($Result.Error -ne "") {
            Write-Host "  Error:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  $($Result.Error)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        Write-Host ""
    }

    return $Success
}

# =========================================================

function Test-VerificationStatus {

    param (
        [string]$StatusName,
        [string]$VerificationType,
        [string]$ExpectedStatus
    )

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"
    Write-Host "Testing status: $StatusName"
    Write-Host "Verification type: $VerificationType"
    Write-Host "----------------------------------------"

    try {

        # Create a NEW user for every test.
        $userId = New-TestUser

        Write-Host "User ID: $userId"

        $body = @{
            user_id = $userId
            verification_type = $VerificationType
            provider = "test-provider"
            data = @{
                test_result = $ExpectedStatus
            }
        } | ConvertTo-Json

        $result = Invoke-RestMethod `
            -Uri $executeUrl `
            -Method Post `
            -ContentType "application/json" `
            -Body $body `
            -TimeoutSec 10

        Write-Host "[OK] Request completed."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Validate status
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($result.status -ne $ExpectedStatus) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] Status mismatch."
            Write-Host "Expected: $ExpectedStatus"
            Write-Host "Actual:   $($result.status)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] Status response validated."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Non-verified statuses must not expire
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($null -ne $result.expires_at) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[FAILED] expires_at should be null."
            Write-Host "Actual: $($result.expires_at)"

            return $false
        }

        Write-Host "[OK] expires_at is null."

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Rejected must have rejection_reason
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if ($ExpectedStatus -eq "rejected") {

            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($result.rejection_reason)) {

                Write-Host ""
                Write-Host "[FAILED] rejection_reason is missing."

                return $false
            }

            Write-Host "[OK] rejection_reason exists."
        }

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Final result
        # -------------------------------------------------

        Write-Host "[OK] $StatusName PASSED."
        Write-Host "Verification ID: $($result.id)"

        return $true
    }
    catch {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[FAILED] $StatusName"
        Write-Host "HTTP ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)"

        if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) {

            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "API RESPONSE:"
            Write-Host $_.ErrorDetails.Message
        }

        return $false
    }
}

// TransactionManager is the atomic boundary for local market persistence.
//
// Contract:
//  1. Every repository receiving the callback context must use the same
//     transaction and must not silently fall back to a global connection.
//  2. The callback must not be invoked more than once by the adapter.
//  3. The adapter must not automatically retry a callback containing
//     application side effects.
//  4. A callback error must cause rollback.
//  5. A nil callback result may be returned only after a confirmed commit.
//  6. If commit outcome cannot be determined, return
//     ErrTransactionOutcomeUnknown. Never report an ordinary rollback
//     when the commit result is actually ambiguous.
//  7. External network calls must not be hidden inside this transaction.
//  8. Nested transaction behavior must be explicit and deterministic.
type TransactionManager interface {
	WithinTransaction(context.Context, func(context.Context) error) error
}

// Clock must be safe for concurrent use.
// Implementations may return local time; Application normalizes it to UTC.
// A zero timestamp is invalid for state-changing operations.
type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// IDGenerator must return a non-empty identifier unique within its namespace.
// Generation must respect context cancellation.
// Implementations used inside a database transaction must not perform
// unbounded external network calls.
type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID(context.Context, string) (marketflow.ID, error)
}

}

// OrderResourceGateway is an external boundary to My Assets.
//
// ReserveForOrder contract:
//   - The same idempotency key and same order intent must return the same
//     reservation, not create another reservation.
//   - The same key with a different intent must return a conflict.
//   - Buy orders reserve the required buying power.
//   - Sell orders reserve the relevant asset quantity.
//   - The returned reservation ID must never be empty.
//   - The gateway must enforce its own timeout and idempotency rules.
//
// ReleaseOrderResources contract:
//   - Release must be idempotent for the exact reservation ID and key.
//   - It must not release a reservation belonging to another order intent.
//   - An ambiguous result must be reported as an unknown external outcome.
//   - Application must not blindly release after an ambiguous DB commit.
type OrderResourceGateway interface {
	ReserveForOrder(context.Context, marketflow.Order, int64, string) (marketflow.ID, error)
	ReleaseOrderResources(context.Context, marketflow.ID, string) error
}

type OrderAdmissionValidator interface {
	ValidateOrder(context.Context, marketflow.Order) error
}

// OrderCommandRepository contract:
//   - Idempotency keys must be unique in the repository's defined scope.
//   - GetByIdempotencyKey must be strongly consistent after a completed
//     transaction.
//   - CreateOrder must atomically persist the order, idempotency key and
//     reservation reference.
//   - A duplicate key with a different intent must return a conflict.
//   - The repository must not create external reservations itself.
//   - The transaction context must be honored by every method.
type OrderCommandRepository interface {
	GetByIdempotencyKey(context.Context, string) (marketflow.Order, bool, error)
	CreateOrder(context.Context, marketflow.Order, string, marketflow.ID) (marketflow.Order, error)
}

// OrderBookCommandRepository methods must execute in the same transaction.
//
// LockBestCrossingPair must:
//   - Restrict both orders to the requested market and offer.
//   - Select only eligible open/partially-filled orders.
//   - Lock both rows using a deterministic lock order.
//   - Avoid returning the same order as both sides.
//   - Respect price-time priority.
//   - Return ErrNoCrossingOrders when no eligible crossing pair exists.
//
// SaveOrder and SaveMatch must participate in the same transaction.
// SaveMatch must enforce uniqueness of its idempotency key.
type OrderBookCommandRepository interface {
	LockBestCrossingPair(context.Context, marketflow.ID, marketflow.ID) (marketflow.Order, marketflow.Order, error)
	SaveOrder(context.Context, marketflow.Order, uint64) error
	SaveMatch(context.Context, MatchRecord, string) error
}

// APPLICATION_PACKAGE_01_HARDENING_V1

const applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength = 200

func validateApplicationContext(ctx context.Context) error {
	if ctx == nil {
		return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	return ctx.Err()
}

func applicationNowUTC(clock Clock) (time.Time, error) {
	if clock == nil {
		return time.Time{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	now := clock.Now()
	if now.IsZero() {
		return time.Time{}, ErrInvalidClock
	}

	return now.UTC(), nil
}

func applicationNewID(
	ctx context.Context,
	generator IDGenerator,
	namespace string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
	if generator == nil {
		return "", ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(namespace) == "" {
		return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	id, err := generator.NewID(ctx, namespace)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidGeneratedID
	}

	return id, nil
}

func applicationValidateAuditEvent(event marketflow.AuditEvent) error {
	if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf(
			"%w: invalid audit event: %v",
			ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
			err,
		)
	}

	return nil
}

type MarketCatalogueGuard struct {
	Markets    MarketReader
	Categories CategoryReader
	Mappings   CategoryMappingReader
}

func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(
	ctx context.Context,
	offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if g.Markets == nil || g.Categories == nil || g.Mappings == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	market, err := g.Markets.GetMarket(
		ctx,
		marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if market == nil || !market.IsOperational() {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	publicCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
		ctx,
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	specializedCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
		ctx,
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if publicCategory == nil ||
		specializedCategory == nil ||
		!publicCategory.IsSelectable() ||
		!specializedCategory.IsSelectable() ||
		publicCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindGeneral ||
		specializedCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindSpecialized {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	mapping, err := g.Mappings.GetMapping(
		ctx,
		marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if mapping == nil || !mapping.IsUsable() {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	return nil
}

type OfferReadiness interface {
	ValidateOffer(context.Context, marketflow.Offer) error
}

type CompositeOfferReadiness struct {
	Catalogue MarketCatalogueGuard
	Business  OfferBusinessValidator
}

func (v CompositeOfferReadiness) ValidateOffer(
	ctx context.Context,
	offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
	if v.Business == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if err := v.Catalogue.ValidateOffer(ctx, offer); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return v.Business.ValidateConfigurationAndEligibility(ctx, offer)
}

type OfferCommand struct {
	ActorID         marketflow.ID
	OfferID         marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type OfferLifecycleService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Offers       marketflow.OfferRepository
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Readiness    OfferReadiness
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) SubmitForReview(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.submit", "submit_for_review")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Approve(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.approve", "approve")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Publish(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.publish", "publish")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd OfferCommand,
	permission string,
	action string,
) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Offers == nil ||
		s.Identity == nil ||
		s.Readiness == nil ||
		s.Audit == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil ||
		s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.OfferID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" ||
		cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, err
	}

	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, permission); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, err
	}

	var result marketflow.Offer

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			offer, err := s.Offers.GetOffer(txctx, cmd.OfferID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if offer.ID != cmd.OfferID {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if offer.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
				return ErrVersionConflict
			}

			previousVersion := offer.Version

			now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			switch action {
			case "submit_for_review":
				if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
					return err
				}

				err = offer.SubmitForReview(now)

			case "approve":
				err = offer.Approve(now)

			case "publish":
				if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
					return err
				}

				err = offer.Publish(now)

			default:
				return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
			}

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Offers.SaveOffer(
				txctx,
				offer,
				previousVersion,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			eventID, err := applicationNewID(
				txctx,
				s.IDs,
				"audit",
			)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
				ID:              eventID,
				AggregateType:   "offer",
				AggregateID:     offer.ID,
				Action:          action,
				ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
				CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
				PreviousVersion: previousVersion,
				NewVersion:      offer.Version,
				OccurredAt:      now,
			}

			if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			result = offer
			return nil
		},
	)

	return result, err
}

// Supply request selection.

type SelectProposalCommand struct {
	ActorID         marketflow.ID
	RequestID       marketflow.ID
	ProposalID      marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type SupplyRequestService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Requests     SupplyRequestCommandRepository
	Proposals    ProposalCommandRepository
	Validator    ProposalValidator
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *SupplyRequestService) SelectProposal(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd SelectProposalCommand,
) (marketflow.SupplyRequest, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Requests == nil ||
		s.Proposals == nil ||
		s.Validator == nil ||
		s.Identity == nil ||
		s.Audit == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil ||
		s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.RequestID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ProposalID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
		ctx,
		cmd.ActorID,
		"supply_requests.select_proposal",
	); err != nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	var result marketflow.SupplyRequest

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			request, requestRevision, err :=
				s.Requests.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.RequestID)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if request.ID != cmd.RequestID || requestRevision == 0 {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if requestRevision != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
				return ErrVersionConflict
			}

			proposal, proposalRevision, err :=
				s.Proposals.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.ProposalID)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if proposalRevision == 0 ||
				proposal.ID != cmd.ProposalID ||
				proposal.RequestID != request.ID {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			if proposal.State != marketflow.ProposalSubmitted {
				return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
			}

			if err := s.Validator.ValidateProposal(
				txctx,
				request,
				proposal,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := marketflow.SelectProposal(
				&request,
				proposal,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			proposal.State = marketflow.ProposalAccepted

			if err := s.Proposals.Save(
				txctx,
				proposal,
				proposalRevision,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Requests.Save(
				txctx,
				request,
				requestRevision,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if requestRevision == ^uint64(0) {
				return ErrRevisionOverflow
			}

			now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			eventID, err := applicationNewID(
				txctx,
				s.IDs,
				"audit",
			)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
				ID:              eventID,
				AggregateType:   "supply_request",
				AggregateID:     request.ID,
				Action:          "proposal_selected",
				ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
				CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
				PreviousVersion: requestRevision,
				NewVersion:      requestRevision + 1,
				OccurredAt:      now,
				Metadata: map[string]string{
					"proposal_id": string(proposal.ID),
				},
			}

			if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			result = request
			return nil
		},
	)

	return result, err
}

// Order admission and resource reservation.

type PlaceOrderCommand struct {
	ActorID        marketflow.ID
	Order          marketflow.Order
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  marketflow.ID
}

type OrderAdmissionService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Orders       OrderCommandRepository
	Validator    OrderAdmissionValidator
	Resources    OrderResourceGateway
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func CalculateOrderNotional(order marketflow.Order) (int64, error) {
	switch order.Side {
	case marketflow.Buy:
		if order.Price <= 0 || order.Quantity <= 0 {
			return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}

		if order.Price > math.MaxInt64/order.Quantity {
			return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}

		return order.Price * order.Quantity, nil

	case marketflow.Sell:
		if order.Quantity <= 0 {
			return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}

		// Sell-side reservation is quantity-based and is handled by
		// My Assets. No monetary notional is sent for this side.
		return 0, nil

	default:
		return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}
}

func sameOrderIntent(a, b marketflow.Order) bool {
	return a.ID == b.ID &&
		a.OfferID == b.OfferID &&
		a.MarketID == b.MarketID &&
		a.UserID == b.UserID &&
		a.Side == b.Side &&
		a.Price == b.Price &&
		a.Quantity == b.Quantity &&
		a.CreatedAt.Equal(b.CreatedAt)
}

func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd PlaceOrderCommand,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Orders == nil ||
		s.Validator == nil ||
		s.Resources == nil ||
		s.Identity == nil ||
		s.Audit == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil ||
		s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	key := strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey)

	if key == "" ||
		len(key) > applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	order := cmd.Order

	if err := order.Validate(); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	if order.UserID != cmd.ActorID ||
		order.State != marketflow.OrderPending {
		return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
		ctx,
		cmd.ActorID,
		"orders.place",
	); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	// First idempotency read:
	// a completed order must be replayed without creating a new reservation.
	existing, found, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
	if err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	if found {
		if !sameOrderIntent(existing, order) {
			return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}

		return existing, nil
	}

	if err := s.Validator.ValidateOrder(ctx, order); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	notional, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
	if err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	// External reservation is deliberately outside the DB transaction.
	reservationID, err := s.Resources.ReserveForOrder(
		ctx,
		order,
		notional,
		key,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown) {
			return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
				err,
				ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
			)
		}

		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(reservationID)) == "" {
		// There is no safe identifier with which to release this reservation.
		// Treat this as a gateway contract violation and require reconciliation.
		return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
			ErrInvalidReservationID,
			ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
		)
	}

	var result marketflow.Order

	txErr := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			// Second idempotency read closes the race between the initial
			// read and the reservation operation.
			current, exists, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(
				txctx,
				key,
			)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if exists {
				if !sameOrderIntent(current, order) {
					return ErrIdempotencyConflict
				}

				result = current
				return nil
			}

			orderToSave := order

			if err := orderToSave.Open(); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			created, err := s.Orders.CreateOrder(
				txctx,
				orderToSave,
				key,
				reservationID,
			)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			// A repository must not silently mutate the admitted intent.
			if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"%w: invalid created order: %v",
					ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
					err,
				)
			}

			if !sameOrderIntent(created, order) ||
				created.State != marketflow.OrderOpen ||
				created.Version != orderToSave.Version {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			eventID, err := applicationNewID(
				txctx,
				s.IDs,
				"audit",
			)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
				ID:              eventID,
				AggregateType:   "order",
				AggregateID:     created.ID,
				Action:          "placed",
				ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
				CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
				PreviousVersion: order.Version,
				NewVersion:      created.Version,
				OccurredAt:      now,
				Metadata: map[string]string{
					"reservation_id":  string(reservationID),
					"idempotency_key": key,
				},
			}

			if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			result = created
			return nil
		},
	)

	if txErr == nil {
		return result, nil
	}

	// A commit error may be ambiguous. Releasing the reservation without
	// determining whether the order committed could release live resources.
	if errors.Is(txErr, ErrTransactionOutcomeUnknown) {
		return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
			txErr,
			ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
		)
	}

	// Reconcile against the authoritative order repository before compensation.
	// A committed order, even if the caller received a commit error, must retain
	// its reservation.
	persisted, exists, reconcileErr :=
		s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)

	if reconcileErr != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
			txErr,
			ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
			fmt.Errorf("order reconciliation read failed: %w", reconcileErr),
		)
	}

	if exists {
		if sameOrderIntent(persisted, order) {
			return persisted, nil
		}

		// The idempotency key belongs to another intent.
		// Do not release a reservation that may belong to that order.
		return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
	}

	// Compensation is allowed only after a completed transaction failure
	// and a successful authoritative read proving that no order exists.
	releaseErr := s.Resources.ReleaseOrderResources(
		ctx,
		reservationID,
		key,
	)

	if releaseErr != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
			txErr,
			ErrReservationCompensationFailed,
			ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
			fmt.Errorf("reservation compensation failed: %w", releaseErr),
		)
	}

	return marketflow.Order{}, txErr
}

// Matching is performed only inside a transaction that locks both orders.
// MatchOrders mutates local copies; those copies are persisted atomically here.

type MatchingService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Book         OrderBookCommandRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *MatchingService) MatchNext(
	ctx context.Context,
	marketID marketflow.ID,
	offerID marketflow.ID,
) (MatchRecord, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return MatchRecord{}, err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Book == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil ||
		s.Clock == nil {
		return MatchRecord{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(marketID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(offerID)) == "" {
		return MatchRecord{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	var result MatchRecord

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			buy, sell, err := s.Book.LockBestCrossingPair(
				txctx,
				marketID,
				offerID,
			)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := buy.Validate(); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"%w: invalid buy order: %v",
					ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
					err,
				)
			}

			if err := sell.Validate(); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"%w: invalid sell order: %v",
					ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
					err,
				)
			}

			if buy.ID == sell.ID ||
				buy.Side != marketflow.Buy ||
				sell.Side != marketflow.Sell ||
				buy.MarketID != marketID ||
				sell.MarketID != marketID ||
				buy.OfferID != offerID ||
				sell.OfferID != offerID {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			originalBuyVersion := buy.Version
			originalSellVersion := sell.Version

			match, err := marketflow.MatchOrders(&buy, &sell)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			matchID, err := applicationNewID(
				txctx,
				s.IDs,
				"match",
			)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			record := MatchRecord{
				ID:          matchID,
				MarketID:    buy.MarketID,
				OfferID:     buy.OfferID,
				BuyOrderID:  match.BuyOrderID,
				SellOrderID: match.SellOrderID,
				BuyerID:     buy.UserID,
				SellerID:    sell.UserID,
				Quantity:    match.Quantity,
				Price:       match.Price,
				CreatedAt:   now,
			}

			if record.Quantity <= 0 ||
				record.Price <= 0 ||
				record.BuyOrderID != buy.ID ||
				record.SellOrderID != sell.ID ||
				record.BuyerID == record.SellerID {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
				txctx,
				buy,
				originalBuyVersion,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
				txctx,
				sell,
				originalSellVersion,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Book.SaveMatch(
				txctx,
				record,
				"match:"+string(matchID),
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			result = record
			return nil
		},
	)

	if errors.Is(err, ErrNoCrossingOrders) {
		return MatchRecord{}, ErrNoCrossingOrders
	}

	return result, err
}

// Trade state dimensions are updated independently.
// An external contract/service/delivery response must be verified before
// the corresponding status update is submitted.

type TradeDimension string

const (
	DimensionContract TradeDimension = "contract"
	DimensionServices TradeDimension = "services"
	DimensionDelivery TradeDimension = "delivery"
)

type TradeStatusCommand struct {
	TradeID         marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	Dimension       TradeDimension
	Value           string
}

type TradeWorkflowService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Trades       TradeCommandRepository
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *TradeWorkflowService) UpdateStatus(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd TradeStatusCommand,
) (marketflow.Trade, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Trade{}, err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Trades == nil ||
		s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Trade{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.Trade{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	var result marketflow.Trade

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			trade, err := s.Trades.GetForUpdate(
				txctx,
				cmd.TradeID,
			)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if trade.ID != cmd.TradeID {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			var currentValue string

			switch cmd.Dimension {
			case DimensionContract:
				currentValue = string(trade.Contract)

			case DimensionServices:
				currentValue = string(trade.Services)

			case DimensionDelivery:
				currentValue = string(trade.Delivery)

			default:
				return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
			}

			// A repeated command that has already achieved its desired
			// state is a successful no-op, even if its original version
			// is now stale.
			if currentValue == cmd.Value {
				result = trade
				return nil
			}

			if trade.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
				return ErrVersionConflict
			}

			switch cmd.Dimension {
			case DimensionContract:
				value := marketflow.ContractState(cmd.Value)

				switch value {
				case marketflow.ContractPending,
					marketflow.ContractCreated,
					marketflow.ContractFailed,
					marketflow.ContractNotRequired:
					trade.Contract = value

				default:
					return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
				}

			case DimensionServices:
				value := marketflow.ServiceState(cmd.Value)

				switch value {
				case marketflow.ServicePending,
					marketflow.ServiceInProgress,
					marketflow.ServiceCompleted,
					marketflow.ServiceFailed,
					marketflow.ServiceNotRequired:
					trade.Services = value

				default:
					return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
				}

			case DimensionDelivery:
				value := marketflow.DeliveryState(cmd.Value)

				switch value {
				case marketflow.DeliveryPending,
					marketflow.DeliveryConfirmed,
					marketflow.DeliveryFailed,
					marketflow.DeliveryNotRequired:
					trade.Delivery = value

				default:
					return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
				}

			default:
				return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
			}

			if trade.Version == ^uint64(0) {
				return ErrRevisionOverflow
			}

			now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if now.Before(trade.UpdatedAt) {
				return ErrInvalidClock
			}

			trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
			trade.Version++
			trade.UpdatedAt = now

			if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if err := s.Trades.Save(
				txctx,
				trade,
				cmd.ExpectedVersion,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			result = trade
			return nil
		},
	)

	return result, err
}

func RequireSettlementReadiness(trade marketflow.Trade) error {
	if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
	if trade.SettlementReadiness != marketflow.SettlementReady {
		return ErrNotSettlementReady
	}
	return nil
}

// Execution policy validation includes cycle detection and ordering checks.

func ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy) error {
	if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	steps := make(map[string]marketflow.ExecutionStep, len(policy.Steps))
	orders := make(map[int]bool, len(policy.Steps))
	codes := make([]string, 0, len(policy.Steps))

	for _, step := range policy.Steps {
		if strings.TrimSpace(step.Code) != step.Code ||
			step.Code == "" {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}

		if orders[step.Order] {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}

		if _, exists := steps[step.Code]; exists {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}

		orders[step.Order] = true
		steps[step.Code] = step
		codes = append(codes, step.Code)
	}

	// A dependency may appear only once in a step.
	// Every dependency must precede the dependent step.
	for _, step := range policy.Steps {
		dependencies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(step.DependsOn))

		for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
			if _, duplicate := dependencies[dependency]; duplicate {
				return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
			}

			dependencies[dependency] = struct{}{}

			dependencyStep, exists := steps[dependency]

			if !exists ||
				dependency == step.Code ||
				dependencyStep.Order >= step.Order {
				return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
			}
		}
	}

	// Deterministic traversal makes failures reproducible.
	sort.Strings(codes)

	state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))

	var visit func(string) error

	visit = func(code string) error {
		switch state[code] {
		case 1:
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph

		case 2:
			return nil
		}

		step, exists := steps[code]
		if !exists {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}

		state[code] = 1

		dependencies := append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
		sort.Strings(dependencies)

		for _, dependency := range dependencies {
			if _, exists := steps[dependency]; !exists {
				return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
			}

			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		state[code] = 2
		return nil
	}

	for _, code := range codes {
		if err := visit(code); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

type CompleteExecutionStepCommand struct {
	TradeID          marketflow.ID
	StepCode         string
	ExpectedRevision uint64
}

type ExecutionProgressService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Progress     ExecutionProgressCommandRepository
}

func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(
	ctx context.Context,
	policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy,
	cmd CompleteExecutionStepCommand,
) error {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if s == nil ||
		s.Transactions == nil ||
		s.Progress == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.StepCode) == "" ||
		cmd.ExpectedRevision == 0 {
		return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if !policy.Active {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
		ctx,
		func(txctx context.Context) error {
			if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			progress, revision, err := s.Progress.GetForUpdate(
				txctx,
				cmd.TradeID,
			)

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if progress.TradeID != cmd.TradeID {
				return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
			}

			if progress.PolicyID != policy.ID ||
				progress.PolicyVersion != policy.Version {
				return marketflow.ErrConflict
			}

			if revision == 0 {
				return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
			}

			stepExists := false

			for _, step := range policy.Steps {
				if step.Code == cmd.StepCode {
					stepExists = true
					break
				}
			}

			if !stepExists {
				return marketflow.ErrNotFound
			}

			// Natural idempotency:
			// completing an already-completed step is a no-op.
			// This check intentionally precedes the revision comparison.
			if progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] {
				return nil
			}

			if revision != cmd.ExpectedRevision {
				return ErrVersionConflict
			}

			if err := progress.CanComplete(
				policy,
				cmd.StepCode,
			); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			if progress.CompletedSteps == nil {
				progress.CompletedSteps = make(map[string]bool)
			}

			progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] = true

			return s.Progress.Save(
				txctx,
				progress,
				revision,
			)
		},
	)
}

// Overflow-safe aggregation. The source marketflow function remains unchanged
// for backward compatibility; application use cases should call this function.

func AggregateCommoditySafe(
	id marketflow.ID,
	lots []marketflow.CommodityLot,
	minimumQuantity int64,
	now time.Time,
) (marketflow.CommodityAggregation, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" ||
		len(lots) == 0 ||
		minimumQuantity <= 0 ||
		now.IsZero() {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	first := lots[0]
	if strings.TrimSpace(first.CommodityCode) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(first.Unit) == "" {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	result := marketflow.CommodityAggregation{
		ID:            id,
		CommodityCode: first.CommodityCode,
		Unit:          first.Unit,
		CreatedAt:     now.UTC(),
	}

	seen := make(map[marketflow.ID]struct{}, len(lots))

	for _, lot := range lots {
		if strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.ID)) == "" ||
			strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.OfferID)) == "" ||
			lot.Quantity <= 0 ||
			lot.CommodityCode != first.CommodityCode ||
			lot.Unit != first.Unit ||
			!lot.Verified ||
			!lot.AggregationAllowed {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
		}

		if _, exists := seen[lot.ID]; exists {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrConflict
		}
		seen[lot.ID] = struct{}{}

		if lot.Quantity > math.MaxInt64-result.TotalQuantity {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}

		result.TotalQuantity += lot.Quantity
		result.LotIDs = append(result.LotIDs, lot.ID)
	}

	if result.TotalQuantity < minimumQuantity {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	return result, nil
}

// External legal requests require identity, permission and explicit scopes.
// The concrete LegalGateway adapter must enforce idempotency at the provider boundary.

type LegalRequestService struct {
	Identity marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Gateway  LegalGateway
}

func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(
	ctx context.Context,
	actorID marketflow.ID,
	request marketflow.ExternalRequest,
	grantedScopes []string,
) (string, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
		return "", ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" {
		return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
		ctx,
		actorID,
		"legal.external.submit",
	); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if err := request.ValidateAuthorization(grantedScopes); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	trackingID, err := s.Gateway.SubmitAuthorizedRequest(
		ctx,
		request,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
		return "", ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown
	}

	return trackingID, nil
}

// GetRequestResult retrieves a previously submitted request using the
// external tracking identifier. It does not create or resubmit a request.
func (s *LegalRequestService) GetRequestResult(
	ctx context.Context,
	actorID marketflow.ID,
	trackingID string,
) (string, error) {
	if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
		return "", ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
		return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
		ctx,
		actorID,
		"legal.external.read",
	); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return s.Gateway.GetRequestResult(ctx, trackingID)
}

// Platform position is deliberately independent from legal registration.

func RecordPlatformPosition(
	workflow *marketflow.PropertyWorkflow,
	confirmedTradeID marketflow.ID,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if workflow == nil {
		return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	legalStateBefore := workflow.LegalRegistration

	if err := workflow.RecordPlatformPosition(confirmedTradeID, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if workflow.LegalRegistration != legalStateBefore {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: platform position changed legal state", marketflow.ErrPolicyViolation)
	}

	return nil
}

type package01Transaction struct {
	afterCallbackError error
	calls              int
}

func (f *package01Transaction) WithinTransaction(
	ctx context.Context,
	callback func(context.Context) error,
) error {
	f.calls++

	if err := callback(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return f.afterCallbackError
}

	f.releaseCalls++

type package01OrderRepository struct {
	orders     map[string]marketflow.Order
	getCalls   int
	getErrors  map[int]error
	createErr  error
	createCall int
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) GetByIdempotencyKey(
	_ context.Context,
	key string,
) (marketflow.Order, bool, error) {
	f.getCalls++

	if err := f.getErrors[f.getCalls]; err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, false, err
	}

	order, found := f.orders[key]
	return order, found, nil
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) CreateOrder(
	_ context.Context,
	order marketflow.Order,
	key string,
	_ marketflow.ID,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
	f.createCall++

	if f.createErr != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, f.createErr
	}

	if _, exists := f.orders[key]; exists {
		return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
	}

	if f.orders == nil {
		f.orders = make(map[string]marketflow.Order)
	}

	f.orders[key] = order
	return order, nil
}

func TestPackage01MatchingRejectsPairOutsideRequestedMarket(t *testing.T) {

	sell := package01OpenOrder("sell-1", marketflow.Sell, 100)

	buy.MarketID = "another-market"
	sell.MarketID = "another-market"

	book := &package01Book{
		buy:  buy,
		sell: sell,
	}

	service := &MatchingService{
		Transactions: &package01Transaction{},
		Book:         book,
		IDs:          package01IDs{},
		Clock:        package01Clock{now: package01Now()},
	}

	_, err := service.MatchNext(
		context.Background(),
		"market-1",
		"offer-1",
	)

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRepositoryContractViolation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected repository contract violation, got %v", err)
	}

	if book.saveOrders != 0 || book.saveMatches != 0 {
		t.Fatal("invalid repository pair must not be persisted")
	}
}
