package application

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"time"

	cataloguedomain "github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/catalogue/domain"
	marketdomain "github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/market/domain"
	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/marketflow"
)

var (
	ErrDependencyMissing     = errors.New("application dependency missing")
	ErrVersionConflict       = errors.New("application version conflict")
	ErrIdempotencyConflict   = errors.New("idempotency key conflict")
	ErrNoCrossingOrders      = errors.New("no crossing orders")
	ErrNotSettlementReady    = errors.New("trade is not ready for settlement")
	ErrInvalidPolicyGraph    = errors.New("invalid execution policy dependency graph")
	ErrInvalidTradeDimension = errors.New("invalid trade status dimension")
)

type MarketCatalogueGuard struct {
	Markets    MarketReader
	Categories CategoryReader
	Mappings   CategoryMappingReader
}

func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(ctx context.Context, offer marketflow.Offer) error {
	if g.Markets == nil || g.Categories == nil || g.Mappings == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	market, err := g.Markets.GetMarket(ctx, marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if market == nil || !market.IsOperational() {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	publicCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
		ctx,
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	specializedCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
		ctx,
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if publicCategory == nil ||
		specializedCategory == nil ||
		!publicCategory.IsSelectable() ||
		!specializedCategory.IsSelectable() ||
		publicCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindGeneral ||
		specializedCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindSpecialized {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	mapping, err := g.Mappings.GetMapping(
		ctx,
		marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
		cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if mapping == nil || !mapping.IsUsable() {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	return nil
}

type OfferReadiness interface {
	ValidateOffer(context.Context, marketflow.Offer) error
}

type CompositeOfferReadiness struct {
	Catalogue MarketCatalogueGuard
	Business  OfferBusinessValidator
}

func (v CompositeOfferReadiness) ValidateOffer(
	ctx context.Context,
	offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
	if v.Business == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if err := v.Catalogue.ValidateOffer(ctx, offer); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return v.Business.ValidateConfigurationAndEligibility(ctx, offer)
}

type OfferCommand struct {
	ActorID         marketflow.ID
	OfferID         marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type OfferLifecycleService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Offers       marketflow.OfferRepository
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Readiness    OfferReadiness
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) SubmitForReview(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.submit", "submit_for_review")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Approve(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.approve", "approve")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) Publish(ctx context.Context, cmd OfferCommand) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	return s.transition(ctx, cmd, "offers.publish", "publish")
}

func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd OfferCommand,
	permission string,
	action string,
) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Offers == nil ||
		s.Identity == nil || s.Readiness == nil ||
		s.Audit == nil || s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.OfferID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" ||
		cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, err
	}
	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, permission); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Offer{}, err
	}

	var result marketflow.Offer

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		offer, err := s.Offers.GetOffer(txctx, cmd.OfferID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if offer.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
			return ErrVersionConflict
		}

		previousVersion := offer.Version
		now := s.Clock.Now().UTC()

		switch action {
		case "submit_for_review":
			if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			err = offer.SubmitForReview(now)
		case "approve":
			err = offer.Approve(now)
		case "publish":
			if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			err = offer.Publish(now)
		default:
			return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if err := s.Offers.SaveOffer(txctx, offer, previousVersion); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
			ID:              eventID,
			AggregateType:   "offer",
			AggregateID:     offer.ID,
			Action:          action,
			ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
			CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
			PreviousVersion: previousVersion,
			NewVersion:      offer.Version,
			OccurredAt:      now,
		}
		if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		result = offer
		return nil
	})

	return result, err
}

// Supply request selection.

type SelectProposalCommand struct {
	ActorID         marketflow.ID
	RequestID       marketflow.ID
	ProposalID      marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	CorrelationID   marketflow.ID
}

type SupplyRequestService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Requests     SupplyRequestCommandRepository
	Proposals    ProposalCommandRepository
	Validator    ProposalValidator
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *SupplyRequestService) SelectProposal(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd SelectProposalCommand,
) (marketflow.SupplyRequest, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Requests == nil ||
		s.Proposals == nil || s.Validator == nil || s.Identity == nil ||
		s.Audit == nil || s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.RequestID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ProposalID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
	}
	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, "supply_requests.select_proposal"); err != nil {
		return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
	}

	var result marketflow.SupplyRequest

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		request, requestRevision, err := s.Requests.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.RequestID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if requestRevision != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
			return ErrVersionConflict
		}

		proposal, proposalRevision, err := s.Proposals.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.ProposalID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if err := s.Validator.ValidateProposal(txctx, request, proposal); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := marketflow.SelectProposal(&request, proposal); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		proposal.State = marketflow.ProposalAccepted

		if err := s.Proposals.Save(txctx, proposal, proposalRevision); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.Requests.Save(txctx, request, requestRevision); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, marketflow.AuditEvent{
			ID:              eventID,
			AggregateType:   "supply_request",
			AggregateID:     request.ID,
			Action:          "proposal_selected",
			ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
			CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
			PreviousVersion: requestRevision,
			NewVersion:      requestRevision + 1,
			OccurredAt:      s.Clock.Now().UTC(),
			Metadata: map[string]string{
				"proposal_id": string(proposal.ID),
			},
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		result = request
		return nil
	})

	return result, err
}

// Order admission and resource reservation.

type PlaceOrderCommand struct {
	ActorID        marketflow.ID
	Order          marketflow.Order
	IdempotencyKey string
	CorrelationID  marketflow.ID
}

type OrderAdmissionService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Orders       OrderCommandRepository
	Validator    OrderAdmissionValidator
	Resources    OrderResourceGateway
	Identity     marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Audit        marketflow.AuditRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func CalculateOrderNotional(order marketflow.Order) (int64, error) {
	if order.Side != marketflow.Buy {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if order.Price <= 0 || order.Quantity <= 0 {
		return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if order.Price > math.MaxInt64/order.Quantity {
		return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}
	return order.Price * order.Quantity, nil
}

func sameOrderIntent(a, b marketflow.Order) bool {
	return a.ID == b.ID &&
		a.OfferID == b.OfferID &&
		a.MarketID == b.MarketID &&
		a.UserID == b.UserID &&
		a.Side == b.Side &&
		a.Price == b.Price &&
		a.Quantity == b.Quantity &&
		a.CreatedAt.Equal(b.CreatedAt)
}

func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd PlaceOrderCommand,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Orders == nil ||
		s.Validator == nil || s.Resources == nil ||
		s.Identity == nil || s.Audit == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}

	key := strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey)
	if key == "" || len(key) > 200 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	order := cmd.Order
	if err := order.Validate(); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}
	if order.UserID != cmd.ActorID || order.State != marketflow.OrderPending {
		return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}
	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, "orders.place"); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}
	if err := s.Validator.ValidateOrder(ctx, order); err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	// Fast idempotency check avoids repeating an external reservation.
	existing, found, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
	if err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}
	if found {
		if !sameOrderIntent(existing, order) {
			return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
		}
		return existing, nil
	}

	notional, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
	if err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}

	reservationID, err := s.Resources.ReserveForOrder(ctx, order, notional, key)
	if err != nil {
		return marketflow.Order{}, err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(reservationID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	var result marketflow.Order
	replayed := false

	txErr := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		current, exists, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(txctx, key)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if exists {
			if !sameOrderIntent(current, order) {
				return ErrIdempotencyConflict
			}
			replayed = true
			result = current
			return nil
		}

		orderToSave := order
		if err := orderToSave.Open(); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		created, err := s.Orders.CreateOrder(
			txctx,
			orderToSave,
			key,
			reservationID,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		eventID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "audit")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, marketflow.AuditEvent{
			ID:              eventID,
			AggregateType:   "order",
			AggregateID:     created.ID,
			Action:          "placed",
			ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
			CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
			PreviousVersion: order.Version,
			NewVersion:      created.Version,
			OccurredAt:      s.Clock.Now().UTC(),
			Metadata: map[string]string{
				"reservation_id":  string(reservationID),
				"idempotency_key": key,
			},
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		result = created
		return nil
	})

	if txErr != nil && !replayed {
		releaseErr := s.Resources.ReleaseOrderResources(
			ctx,
			reservationID,
			key,
		)
		if releaseErr != nil {
			return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
				txErr,
				fmt.Errorf("reservation compensation failed: %w", releaseErr),
			)
		}
		return marketflow.Order{}, txErr
	}

	return result, txErr
}

// Matching is performed only inside a transaction that locks both orders.
// MatchOrders mutates local copies; those copies are persisted atomically here.

type MatchingService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Book         OrderBookCommandRepository
	IDs          IDGenerator
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *MatchingService) MatchNext(
	ctx context.Context,
	marketID marketflow.ID,
	offerID marketflow.ID,
) (MatchRecord, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Book == nil ||
		s.IDs == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return MatchRecord{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(marketID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(offerID)) == "" {
		return MatchRecord{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	var result MatchRecord

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		buy, sell, err := s.Book.LockBestCrossingPair(txctx, marketID, offerID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		originalBuyVersion := buy.Version
		originalSellVersion := sell.Version

		match, err := marketflow.MatchOrders(&buy, &sell)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		matchID, err := s.IDs.NewID(txctx, "match")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		now := s.Clock.Now().UTC()

		record := MatchRecord{
			ID:          matchID,
			MarketID:    buy.MarketID,
			OfferID:     buy.OfferID,
			BuyOrderID:  match.BuyOrderID,
			SellOrderID: match.SellOrderID,
			BuyerID:     buy.UserID,
			SellerID:    sell.UserID,
			Quantity:    match.Quantity,
			Price:       match.Price,
			CreatedAt:   now,
		}

		if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(txctx, buy, originalBuyVersion); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(txctx, sell, originalSellVersion); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.Book.SaveMatch(txctx, record, "match:"+string(matchID)); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		result = record
		return nil
	})

	if errors.Is(err, ErrNoCrossingOrders) {
		return MatchRecord{}, ErrNoCrossingOrders
	}
	return result, err
}

// Trade state dimensions are updated independently.
// An external contract/service/delivery response must be verified before
// the corresponding status update is submitted.

type TradeDimension string

const (
	DimensionContract TradeDimension = "contract"
	DimensionServices TradeDimension = "services"
	DimensionDelivery TradeDimension = "delivery"
)

type TradeStatusCommand struct {
	TradeID         marketflow.ID
	ExpectedVersion uint64
	Dimension       TradeDimension
	Value           string
}

type TradeWorkflowService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Trades       TradeCommandRepository
	Clock        Clock
}

func (s *TradeWorkflowService) UpdateStatus(
	ctx context.Context,
	cmd TradeStatusCommand,
) (marketflow.Trade, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Trades == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return marketflow.Trade{}, ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" {
		return marketflow.Trade{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	var result marketflow.Trade

	err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		trade, err := s.Trades.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.TradeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if trade.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
			return ErrVersionConflict
		}

		switch cmd.Dimension {
		case DimensionContract:
			value := marketflow.ContractState(cmd.Value)
			switch value {
			case marketflow.ContractPending,
				marketflow.ContractCreated,
				marketflow.ContractFailed,
				marketflow.ContractNotRequired:
				trade.Contract = value
			default:
				return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
			}

		case DimensionServices:
			value := marketflow.ServiceState(cmd.Value)
			switch value {
			case marketflow.ServicePending,
				marketflow.ServiceInProgress,
				marketflow.ServiceCompleted,
				marketflow.ServiceFailed,
				marketflow.ServiceNotRequired:
				trade.Services = value
			default:
				return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
			}

		case DimensionDelivery:
			value := marketflow.DeliveryState(cmd.Value)
			switch value {
			case marketflow.DeliveryPending,
				marketflow.DeliveryConfirmed,
				marketflow.DeliveryFailed,
				marketflow.DeliveryNotRequired:
				trade.Delivery = value
			default:
				return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
			}

		default:
			return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
		}

		trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
		trade.Version++
		trade.UpdatedAt = s.Clock.Now().UTC()

		if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.Trades.Save(txctx, trade, cmd.ExpectedVersion); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		result = trade
		return nil
	})

	return result, err
}

func RequireSettlementReadiness(trade marketflow.Trade) error {
	if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
	if trade.SettlementReadiness != marketflow.SettlementReady {
		return ErrNotSettlementReady
	}
	return nil
}

// Execution policy validation includes cycle detection and ordering checks.

func ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy) error {
	if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	steps := make(map[string]marketflow.ExecutionStep, len(policy.Steps))
	orders := make(map[int]bool, len(policy.Steps))

	for _, step := range policy.Steps {
		if orders[step.Order] {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}
		orders[step.Order] = true
		steps[step.Code] = step
	}

	state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))

	var visit func(string) error
	visit = func(code string) error {
		switch state[code] {
		case 1:
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		case 2:
			return nil
		}

		step, exists := steps[code]
		if !exists {
			return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
		}

		state[code] = 1

		for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
			dependencyStep, exists := steps[dependency]
			if !exists || dependencyStep.Order >= step.Order {
				return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
			}
			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		state[code] = 2
		return nil
	}

	for code := range steps {
		if err := visit(code); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

type CompleteExecutionStepCommand struct {
	TradeID          marketflow.ID
	StepCode         string
	ExpectedRevision uint64
}

type ExecutionProgressService struct {
	Transactions TransactionManager
	Progress     ExecutionProgressCommandRepository
}

func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(
	ctx context.Context,
	policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy,
	cmd CompleteExecutionStepCommand,
) error {
	if s == nil || s.Transactions == nil || s.Progress == nil {
		return ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(cmd.StepCode) == "" ||
		cmd.ExpectedRevision == 0 {
		return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}
	if !policy.Active {
		return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}
	if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(ctx, func(txctx context.Context) error {
		progress, revision, err := s.Progress.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.TradeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if revision != cmd.ExpectedRevision {
			return ErrVersionConflict
		}

		if progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] {
			return nil
		}
		if err := progress.CanComplete(policy, cmd.StepCode); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if progress.CompletedSteps == nil {
			progress.CompletedSteps = make(map[string]bool)
		}
		progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] = true

		return s.Progress.Save(txctx, progress, revision)
	})
}

// Overflow-safe aggregation. The source marketflow function remains unchanged
// for backward compatibility; application use cases should call this function.

func AggregateCommoditySafe(
	id marketflow.ID,
	lots []marketflow.CommodityLot,
	minimumQuantity int64,
	now time.Time,
) (marketflow.CommodityAggregation, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" ||
		len(lots) == 0 ||
		minimumQuantity <= 0 ||
		now.IsZero() {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	first := lots[0]
	if strings.TrimSpace(first.CommodityCode) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(first.Unit) == "" {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	result := marketflow.CommodityAggregation{
		ID:            id,
		CommodityCode: first.CommodityCode,
		Unit:          first.Unit,
		CreatedAt:     now.UTC(),
	}

	seen := make(map[marketflow.ID]struct{}, len(lots))

	for _, lot := range lots {
		if strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.ID)) == "" ||
			strings.TrimSpace(string(lot.OfferID)) == "" ||
			lot.Quantity <= 0 ||
			lot.CommodityCode != first.CommodityCode ||
			lot.Unit != first.Unit ||
			!lot.Verified ||
			!lot.AggregationAllowed {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
		}

		if _, exists := seen[lot.ID]; exists {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrConflict
		}
		seen[lot.ID] = struct{}{}

		if lot.Quantity > math.MaxInt64-result.TotalQuantity {
			return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
		}

		result.TotalQuantity += lot.Quantity
		result.LotIDs = append(result.LotIDs, lot.ID)
	}

	if result.TotalQuantity < minimumQuantity {
		return marketflow.CommodityAggregation{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
	}

	return result, nil
}

// External legal requests require identity, permission and explicit scopes.
// The concrete LegalGateway adapter must enforce idempotency at the provider boundary.

type LegalRequestService struct {
	Identity marketflow.IdentityGateway
	Gateway  LegalGateway
}

func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(
	ctx context.Context,
	actorID marketflow.ID,
	request marketflow.ExternalRequest,
	grantedScopes []string,
) (string, error) {
	if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
		return "", ErrDependencyMissing
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" {
		return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, actorID, "legal.external.submit"); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := request.ValidateAuthorization(grantedScopes); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return s.Gateway.SubmitAuthorizedRequest(ctx, request)
}

// Platform position is deliberately independent from legal registration.

func RecordPlatformPosition(
	workflow *marketflow.PropertyWorkflow,
	confirmedTradeID marketflow.ID,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if workflow == nil {
		return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
	}

	legalStateBefore := workflow.LegalRegistration

	if err := workflow.RecordPlatformPosition(confirmedTradeID, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if workflow.LegalRegistration != legalStateBefore {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: platform position changed legal state", marketflow.ErrPolicyViolation)
	}

	return nil
}

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/marketflow"
)

func TestValidateExecutionPolicyAcceptsOrderedDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{
		ID:              "policy-1",
		Name:            "Physical delivery",
		Version:         1,
		OfferCategoryID: "category-1",
		Active:          true,
		CreatedAt:       now,
		Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
			{
				Code:        "contract",
				Order:       1,
				Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
			},
			{
				Code:        "delivery",
				Order:       2,
				Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
				DependsOn:   []string{"contract"},
			},
			{
				Code:        "settlement",
				Order:       3,
				Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
				DependsOn:   []string{"delivery"},
			},
		},
	}

	if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected valid policy, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateExecutionPolicyRejectsCycle(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{
		ID:              "policy-2",
		Name:            "Invalid cycle",
		Version:         1,
		OfferCategoryID: "category-1",
		Active:          true,
		CreatedAt:       now,
		Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
			{
				Code:        "a",
				Order:       1,
				Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
				DependsOn:   []string{"b"},
			},
			{
				Code:        "b",
				Order:       2,
				Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired,
				DependsOn:   []string{"a"},
			},
		},
	}

	if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPolicyGraph) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidPolicyGraph, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateExecutionPolicyRejectsDuplicateOrder(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	policy := marketflow.ExecutionPolicy{
		ID:              "policy-3",
		Name:            "Duplicate order",
		Version:         1,
		OfferCategoryID: "category-1",
		Active:          true,
		CreatedAt:       now,
		Steps: []marketflow.ExecutionStep{
			{Code: "a", Order: 1, Requirement: marketflow.StepRequired},
			{Code: "b", Order: 1, Requirement: marketflow.StepOptional},
		},
	}

	if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidPolicyGraph) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidPolicyGraph, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestAggregateCommoditySafe(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	result, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
		"aggregation-1",
		[]marketflow.CommodityLot{
			{
				ID:                 "lot-1",
				OfferID:            "offer-1",
				CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
				Quantity:           100,
				Unit:               "kg",
				Verified:           true,
				AggregationAllowed: true,
			},
			{
				ID:                 "lot-2",
				OfferID:            "offer-2",
				CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
				Quantity:           200,
				Unit:               "kg",
				Verified:           true,
				AggregationAllowed: true,
			},
		},
		250,
		now,
	)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected aggregation error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.TotalQuantity != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("expected total 300, got %d", result.TotalQuantity)
	}
	if len(result.LotIDs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 lots, got %d", len(result.LotIDs))
	}
}

func TestAggregateCommodityRejectsOverflow(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	_, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
		"aggregation-2",
		[]marketflow.CommodityLot{
			{
				ID:                 "lot-1",
				OfferID:            "offer-1",
				CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
				Quantity:           math.MaxInt64,
				Unit:               "kg",
				Verified:           true,
				AggregationAllowed: true,
			},
			{
				ID:                 "lot-2",
				OfferID:            "offer-2",
				CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
				Quantity:           1,
				Unit:               "kg",
				Verified:           true,
				AggregationAllowed: true,
			},
		},
		1,
		now,
	)

	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected overflow rejection")
	}
}

func TestAggregateCommodityRejectsDuplicateLot(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	lot := marketflow.CommodityLot{
		ID:                 "lot-1",
		OfferID:            "offer-1",
		CommodityCode:      "WHEAT",
		Quantity:           100,
		Unit:               "kg",
		Verified:           true,
		AggregationAllowed: true,
	}

	_, err := AggregateCommoditySafe(
		"aggregation-3",
		[]marketflow.CommodityLot{lot, lot},
		1,
		now,
	)

	if !errors.Is(err, marketflow.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCalculateOrderNotional(t *testing.T) {
	order := marketflow.Order{
		Side:     marketflow.Buy,
		Price:    250,
		Quantity: 4,
	}

	amount, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if amount != 1000 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1000, got %d", amount)
	}
}

func TestCalculateOrderNotionalRejectsOverflow(t *testing.T) {
	order := marketflow.Order{
		Side:     marketflow.Buy,
		Price:    math.MaxInt64,
		Quantity: 2,
	}

	if _, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected overflow rejection")
	}
}

func TestPlatformPositionDoesNotImplyLegalRegistration(t *testing.T) {
	workflow := &marketflow.PropertyWorkflow{
		ID:                "property-flow-1",
		OfferID:           "offer-1",
		TradeID:           "trade-1",
		PlatformPosition:  marketflow.PositionNotRecorded,
		LegalRegistration: marketflow.LegalPending,
		State:             marketflow.PropertyRegistration,
	}

	if err := RecordPlatformPosition(
		workflow,
		"trade-1",
		time.Now().UTC(),
	); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if workflow.PlatformPosition != marketflow.PositionRecorded {
		t.Fatal("platform position was not recorded")
	}
	if workflow.LegalRegistration != marketflow.LegalPending {
		t.Fatal("platform position must not imply legal registration")
	}
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCategoryID       = errors.New("invalid category id")
	ErrInvalidCategoryCode     = errors.New("invalid category code")
	ErrInvalidCategoryName     = errors.New("invalid category name")
	ErrInvalidCategoryKind     = errors.New("invalid category kind")
	ErrInvalidCategoryStatus   = errors.New("invalid category status")
	ErrInvalidParentCategory   = errors.New("invalid parent category")
	ErrCategoryArchived        = errors.New("category is archived")
	ErrInvalidCategoryMutation = errors.New("invalid category mutation")
)

type CategoryID string

type CategoryKind string

type CategoryStatus string

const (
	CategoryKindGeneral     CategoryKind = "general"
	CategoryKindSpecialized CategoryKind = "specialized"
)

const (
	CategoryStatusDraft    CategoryStatus = "draft"
	CategoryStatusActive   CategoryStatus = "active"
	CategoryStatusArchived CategoryStatus = "archived"
)

func (k CategoryKind) IsValid() bool {
	return k == CategoryKindGeneral || k == CategoryKindSpecialized
}

func (s CategoryStatus) IsValid() bool {
	return s == CategoryStatusDraft ||
		s == CategoryStatusActive ||
		s == CategoryStatusArchived
}

type CreateCategoryInput struct {
	ID        CategoryID
	Code      string
	Name      string
	Kind      CategoryKind
	ParentID  CategoryID
	SortOrder int
}

type Category struct {
	id        CategoryID
	code      string
	name      string
	kind      CategoryKind
	parentID  CategoryID
	sortOrder int

	status    CategoryStatus
	version   uint64
	createdAt time.Time
	updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewCategory(input CreateCategoryInput, now time.Time) (*Category, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryID
	}

	code := normalizeCategoryCode(input.Code)
	if !isValidCategoryCode(code) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryCode
	}

	name := strings.TrimSpace(input.Name)
	if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryName
	}

	if !input.Kind.IsValid() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryKind
	}

	if input.ParentID != "" && input.ParentID == input.ID {
		return nil, ErrInvalidParentCategory
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	return &Category{
		id:        input.ID,
		code:      code,
		name:      name,
		kind:      input.Kind,
		parentID:  input.ParentID,
		sortOrder: input.SortOrder,
		status:    CategoryStatusDraft,
		version:   1,
		createdAt: now.UTC(),
		updatedAt: now.UTC(),
	}, nil
}

func normalizeCategoryCode(value string) string {
	return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

func isValidCategoryCode(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 64 {
		return false
	}

	for _, r := range value {
		valid := (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') ||
			(r >= '0' && r <= '9') ||
			r == '-' ||
			r == '_' ||
			r == '.'

		if !valid {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

func (c *Category) ID() CategoryID {
	return c.id
}

func (c *Category) Code() string {
	return c.code
}

func (c *Category) Name() string {
	return c.name
}

func (c *Category) Kind() CategoryKind {
	return c.kind
}

func (c *Category) ParentID() CategoryID {
	return c.parentID
}

func (c *Category) SortOrder() int {
	return c.sortOrder
}

func (c *Category) Status() CategoryStatus {
	return c.status
}

func (c *Category) Version() uint64 {
	return c.version
}

func (c *Category) CreatedAt() time.Time {
	return c.createdAt
}

func (c *Category) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
	return c.updatedAt
}

func (c *Category) Rename(name string, now time.Time) error {
	if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
		return ErrCategoryArchived
	}

	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
		return ErrInvalidCategoryName
	}

	if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if name == c.name {
		return nil
	}

	c.name = name
	c.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (c *Category) ChangeParent(parentID CategoryID, now time.Time) error {
	if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
		return ErrCategoryArchived
	}

	if parentID != "" && parentID == c.id {
		return ErrInvalidParentCategory
	}

	if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if parentID == c.parentID {
		return nil
	}

	c.parentID = parentID
	c.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (c *Category) ChangeSortOrder(sortOrder int, now time.Time) error {
	if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
		return ErrCategoryArchived
	}

	if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if sortOrder == c.sortOrder {
		return nil
	}

	c.sortOrder = sortOrder
	c.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (c *Category) Activate(now time.Time) error {
	switch c.status {
	case CategoryStatusDraft:
		if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		c.status = CategoryStatusActive
		c.touch(now)
		return nil

	case CategoryStatusActive:
		return ErrInvalidCategoryMutation

	case CategoryStatusArchived:
		return ErrCategoryArchived

	default:
		return ErrInvalidCategoryStatus
	}
}

func (c *Category) Archive(now time.Time) error {
	if c.status == CategoryStatusArchived {
		return ErrInvalidCategoryMutation
	}

	if err := c.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	c.status = CategoryStatusArchived
	c.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (c *Category) IsSelectable() bool {
	return c.status == CategoryStatusActive
}

func (c *Category) validateTimestamp(now time.Time) error {
	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(c.updatedAt) {
		return ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	return nil
}

func (c *Category) touch(now time.Time) {
	c.updatedAt = now.UTC()
	c.version++
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCategoryMappingID = errors.New("invalid category mapping id")
	ErrInvalidCategoryMapping   = errors.New("invalid category mapping")
	ErrCategoryMappingArchived  = errors.New("category mapping is archived")
	ErrCategoryMappingState     = errors.New("invalid category mapping state")
	ErrCategoryKindsMismatch    = errors.New("category kinds do not match mapping direction")
	ErrCategoryNotActive        = errors.New("both categories must be active")
)

type CategoryMappingID string

type CategoryMappingStatus string

const (
	CategoryMappingStatusDraft    CategoryMappingStatus = "draft"
	CategoryMappingStatusActive   CategoryMappingStatus = "active"
	CategoryMappingStatusArchived CategoryMappingStatus = "archived"
)

type CreateCategoryMappingInput struct {
	ID                    CategoryMappingID
	PublicCategoryID      CategoryID
	SpecializedCategoryID CategoryID
	MarketID              string
	Description           string
}

type CategoryMapping struct {
	id                    CategoryMappingID
	publicCategoryID      CategoryID
	specializedCategoryID CategoryID
	marketID              string
	description           string

	status    CategoryMappingStatus
	version   uint64
	createdAt time.Time
	updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewCategoryMapping(
	input CreateCategoryMappingInput,
	now time.Time,
) (*CategoryMapping, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryMappingID
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.PublicCategoryID)) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(string(input.SpecializedCategoryID)) == "" ||
		input.PublicCategoryID == input.SpecializedCategoryID {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	return &CategoryMapping{
		id:                    input.ID,
		publicCategoryID:      input.PublicCategoryID,
		specializedCategoryID: input.SpecializedCategoryID,
		marketID:              strings.TrimSpace(input.MarketID),
		description:           strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
		status:                CategoryMappingStatusDraft,
		version:               1,
		createdAt:             now.UTC(),
		updatedAt:             now.UTC(),
	}, nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) ID() CategoryMappingID {
	return m.id
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) PublicCategoryID() CategoryID {
	return m.publicCategoryID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) SpecializedCategoryID() CategoryID {
	return m.specializedCategoryID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) MarketID() string {
	return m.marketID
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Description() string {
	return m.description
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Status() CategoryMappingStatus {
	return m.status
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Version() uint64 {
	return m.version
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) CreatedAt() time.Time {
	return m.createdAt
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
	return m.updatedAt
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Activate(
	publicCategory *Category,
	specializedCategory *Category,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if m.status == CategoryMappingStatusArchived {
		return ErrCategoryMappingArchived
	}

	if m.status != CategoryMappingStatusDraft {
		return ErrCategoryMappingState
	}

	if publicCategory == nil || specializedCategory == nil {
		return ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
	}

	if publicCategory.ID() != m.publicCategoryID ||
		specializedCategory.ID() != m.specializedCategoryID {
		return ErrInvalidCategoryMapping
	}

	if publicCategory.Kind() != CategoryKindGeneral ||
		specializedCategory.Kind() != CategoryKindSpecialized {
		return ErrCategoryKindsMismatch
	}

	if !publicCategory.IsSelectable() || !specializedCategory.IsSelectable() {
		return ErrCategoryNotActive
	}

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
		return ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	m.status = CategoryMappingStatusActive
	m.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) Archive(now time.Time) error {
	if m.status == CategoryMappingStatusArchived {
		return ErrCategoryMappingState
	}

	if now.IsZero() || now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
		return ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	m.status = CategoryMappingStatusArchived
	m.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) IsUsable() bool {
	return m.status == CategoryMappingStatusActive
}

func (m *CategoryMapping) touch(now time.Time) {
	m.updatedAt = now.UTC()
	m.version++
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func createMappingTestCategories(t *testing.T) (*Category, *Category, time.Time) {
	t.Helper()

	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	publicCategory, err := NewCategory(CreateCategoryInput{
		ID:   "public-1",
		Code: "PUBLIC",
		Name: "Public Category",
		Kind: CategoryKindGeneral,
	}, now)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create public category: %v", err)
	}

	specializedCategory, err := NewCategory(CreateCategoryInput{
		ID:   "special-1",
		Code: "SPECIAL",
		Name: "Specialized Category",
		Kind: CategoryKindSpecialized,
	}, now)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create specialized category: %v", err)
	}

	if err := publicCategory.Activate(now.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("activate public category: %v", err)
	}

	if err := specializedCategory.Activate(now.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("activate specialized category: %v", err)
	}

	return publicCategory, specializedCategory, now
}

func TestNewCategoryMapping(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	mapping, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      "public-1",
		SpecializedCategoryID: "special-1",
		MarketID:              "market-1",
		Description:           "Public to specialized mapping",
	}, now)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewCategoryMapping() error = %v", err)
	}

	if mapping.Status() != CategoryMappingStatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("expected draft status, got %s", mapping.Status())
	}

	if mapping.Version() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected version 1, got %d", mapping.Version())
	}
}

func TestNewCategoryMappingRejectsSameCategory(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      "same",
		SpecializedCategoryID: "same",
	}, time.Now().UTC())

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidCategoryMapping) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidCategoryMapping, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCategoryMappingActivation(t *testing.T) {
	publicCategory, specializedCategory, now := createMappingTestCategories(t)

	mapping, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      publicCategory.ID(),
		SpecializedCategoryID: specializedCategory.ID(),
		MarketID:              "market-1",
	}, now.Add(2*time.Minute))

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewCategoryMapping() error = %v", err)
	}

	activationTime := now.Add(3 * time.Minute)

	if err := mapping.Activate(publicCategory, specializedCategory, activationTime); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
	}

	if !mapping.IsUsable() {
		t.Fatal("mapping should be usable")
	}

	if mapping.Status() != CategoryMappingStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected status: %s", mapping.Status())
	}

	if mapping.Version() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected version 2, got %d", mapping.Version())
	}
}

func TestCategoryMappingRejectsWrongKinds(t *testing.T) {
	publicCategory, specializedCategory, now := createMappingTestCategories(t)

	mapping, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      publicCategory.ID(),
		SpecializedCategoryID: specializedCategory.ID(),
	}, now.Add(2*time.Minute))

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewCategoryMapping() error = %v", err)
	}

	err = mapping.Activate(specializedCategory, publicCategory, now.Add(3*time.Minute))

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidCategoryMapping) {
		// The IDs are deliberately reversed, so the mapping identity check
		// must reject the operation before category-kind validation.
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrInvalidCategoryMapping, got %v", err)
	}
}

		Name: "Public",

	specializedCategory, err := NewCategory(CreateCategoryInput{
		ID:   "special-1",
		Code: "SPECIAL",
		Name: "Specialized",
		Kind: CategoryKindSpecialized,
	}, now)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	mapping, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      publicCategory.ID(),
		SpecializedCategoryID: specializedCategory.ID(),
	}, now.Add(time.Minute))

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	err = mapping.Activate(publicCategory, specializedCategory, now.Add(2*time.Minute))

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrCategoryNotActive) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrCategoryNotActive, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCategoryMappingArchive(t *testing.T) {
	publicCategory, specializedCategory, now := createMappingTestCategories(t)

	mapping, err := NewCategoryMapping(CreateCategoryMappingInput{
		ID:                    "mapping-1",
		PublicCategoryID:      publicCategory.ID(),
		SpecializedCategoryID: specializedCategory.ID(),
	}, now.Add(2*time.Minute))

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := mapping.Activate(publicCategory, specializedCategory, now.Add(3*time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if err := mapping.Archive(now.Add(4 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Archive() error = %v", err)
	}

	if mapping.IsUsable() {
		t.Fatal("archived mapping must not be usable")
	}

	if err := mapping.Activate(publicCategory, specializedCategory, now.Add(5*time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrCategoryMappingArchived) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrCategoryMappingArchived, got %v", err)
	}
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func newTestCategory(
	t *testing.T,
	id CategoryID,
	code string,
	kind CategoryKind,
) *Category {
	t.Helper()

	now := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

	category, err := NewCategory(CreateCategoryInput{
		ID:        id,
		Code:      code,
		Name:      "Test Category",
		Kind:      kind,
		SortOrder: 10,
	}, now)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewCategory() error = %v", err)
	}

	return category
}

func TestNewCategory(t *testing.T) {
	category := newTestCategory(
		t,
		"category-001",
		"general.goods",
		CategoryKindGeneral,
	)

	if category.Status() != CategoryStatusDraft {
		t.Fatalf("expected draft, got %s", category.Status())
	}

	if category.Code() != "GENERAL.GOODS" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected code: %s", category.Code())
	}

	if category.Version() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected version 1, got %d", category.Version())
	}
}

func TestNewCategoryRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		input CreateCategoryInput
		want  error
	}{
		{
			name: "missing id",
			input: CreateCategoryInput{
				Code: "CAT",
				Name: "Category",
				Kind: CategoryKindGeneral,
			},
			want: ErrInvalidCategoryID,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid code",
			input: CreateCategoryInput{
				ID:   "cat-1",
				Code: "bad code",
				Name: "Category",
				Kind: CategoryKindGeneral,
			},
			want: ErrInvalidCategoryCode,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid kind",
			input: CreateCategoryInput{
				ID:   "cat-1",
				Code: "CAT",
				Name: "Category",
				Kind: "unknown",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidCategoryKind,
		},
		{
			name: "self parent",
			input: CreateCategoryInput{
				ID:       "cat-1",
				Code:     "CAT",
				Name:     "Category",
				Kind:     CategoryKindGeneral,
				ParentID: "cat-1",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidParentCategory,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := NewCategory(tt.input, now)

			if !errors.Is(err, tt.want) {
				t.Fatalf("expected %v, got %v", tt.want, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCategoryLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	category := newTestCategory(
		t,
		"cat-1",
		"CAT",
		CategoryKindGeneral,
	)

	base := category.UpdatedAt()

	if err := category.Activate(base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
	}

	if !category.IsSelectable() {
		t.Fatal("active category should be selectable")
	}

	if err := category.Archive(base.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Archive() error = %v", err)
	}

	if category.IsSelectable() {
		t.Fatal("archived category must not be selectable")
	}

	if err := category.Activate(base.Add(3 * time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrCategoryArchived) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrCategoryArchived, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCategoryMutation(t *testing.T) {
	category := newTestCategory(
		t,
		"cat-1",
		"CAT",
		CategoryKindGeneral,
	)

	base := category.UpdatedAt()

	if err := category.Rename("New Name", base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Rename() error = %v", err)
	}

	if category.Name() != "New Name" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected name: %s", category.Name())
	}

	if err := category.ChangeParent("parent-1", base.Add(2*time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ChangeParent() error = %v", err)
	}

	if category.ParentID() != "parent-1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parent: %s", category.ParentID())
	}

	if err := category.ChangeSortOrder(20, base.Add(3*time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ChangeSortOrder() error = %v", err)
	}

	if category.SortOrder() != 20 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected sort order: %d", category.SortOrder())
	}

	if category.Version() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected version 4, got %d", category.Version())
	}
}

package catalogue

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	defaultPageSize = 20
	maxPageSize     = 100
	maxSearchLength = 120
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

type OfferSummary struct {
	ID                 string          `json:"id"`
	Code               string          `json:"code"`
	MarketID           string          `json:"market_id"`
	MarketName         string          `json:"market_name"`
	PublicCategoryID   string          `json:"public_category_id,omitempty"`
	PublicCategoryName string          `json:"public_category_name,omitempty"`
	ClassificationID   string          `json:"classification_id"`
	Title              string          `json:"title"`
	Summary            string          `json:"summary,omitempty"`
	OfferType          string          `json:"offer_type"`
	PriceAmount        string          `json:"price_amount,omitempty"`
	CurrencyCode       string          `json:"currency_code,omitempty"`
	QuantityTotal      string          `json:"quantity_total,omitempty"`
	QuantityUnit       string          `json:"quantity_unit,omitempty"`
	Attributes         json.RawMessage `json:"attributes"`
	PublishedAt        time.Time       `json:"published_at"`
	ValidUntil         *time.Time      `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
}

type ListResponse struct {
	Data       []OfferSummary `json:"data"`
	Page       int            `json:"page"`
	PageSize   int            `json:"page_size"`
	Total      int64          `json:"total"`
	TotalPages int64          `json:"total_pages"`
}

type APIError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func (h Handler) Register(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers", h.ListOffers)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers/{id}", h.GetOffer)
}

func (h Handler) ListOffers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page"), 1, 1000000)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page", "page must be a positive integer.")
		return
	}

	pageSize, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page_size"), defaultPageSize, maxPageSize)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page_size", "page_size must be between 1 and 100.")
		return
	}

	search := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	if len(search) > maxSearchLength {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "search_too_long", "q must not exceed 120 characters.")
		return
	}

	categoryID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("category_id"))
	marketID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("market_id"))

	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	const filter = `
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
		  AND ($1 = '' OR o.title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(o.summary, '') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
		  AND ($2 = '' OR o.public_category_id::text = $2)
		  AND ($3 = '' OR o.market_id::text = $3)
	`

	var total int64
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) " + filter
	if err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), countQuery, search, categoryID, marketID).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
	const listSelect = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
	`
	rows, err := h.DB.QueryContext(
		r.Context(),
		listSelect+filter+`
			ORDER BY o.published_at DESC, o.id DESC
			LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
		`,
		search, categoryID, marketID, pageSize, offset,
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	data := make([]OfferSummary, 0, pageSize)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item OfferSummary
		var categoryIDValue string
		var categoryName string
		var validUntil sql.NullTime
		var attributes []byte

		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.Code,
			&item.MarketID,
			&item.MarketName,
			&categoryIDValue,
			&categoryName,
			&item.ClassificationID,
			&item.Title,
			&item.Summary,
			&item.OfferType,
			&item.PriceAmount,
			&item.CurrencyCode,
			&item.QuantityTotal,
			&item.QuantityUnit,
			&attributes,
			&item.PublishedAt,
			&validUntil,
		); err != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_scan_failed", "A catalogue record could not be read.")
			return
		}

		item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
		item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
		if validUntil.Valid {
			value := validUntil.Time
			item.ValidUntil = &value
		}
		if len(attributes) == 0 {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
		} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
		} else {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "A catalogue record contains invalid attributes.")
			return
		}
		data = append(data, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_read_failed", "The catalogue could not be read completely.")
		return
	}

	totalPages := int64(0)
	if total > 0 {
		totalPages = (total + int64(pageSize) - 1) / int64(pageSize)
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, ListResponse{
		Data:       data,
		Page:       page,
		PageSize:   pageSize,
		Total:      total,
		TotalPages: totalPages,
	})
}

func (h Handler) GetOffer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	id := strings.TrimSpace(r.PathValue("id"))
	if id == "" || len(id) > 64 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_offer_id", "A valid offer ID is required.")
		return
	}

	const query = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.id::text = $1
		  AND o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
	`

	var item OfferSummary
	var categoryIDValue string
	var categoryName string
	var validUntil sql.NullTime
	var attributes []byte

	err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), query, id).Scan(
		&item.ID,
		&item.Code,
		&item.MarketID,
		&item.MarketName,
		&categoryIDValue,
		&categoryName,
		&item.ClassificationID,
		&item.Title,
		&item.Summary,
		&item.OfferType,
		&item.PriceAmount,
		&item.CurrencyCode,
		&item.QuantityTotal,
		&item.QuantityUnit,
		&attributes,
		&item.PublishedAt,
		&validUntil,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "offer_not_found", "The published offer was not found.")
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The offer could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
	item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
	if validUntil.Valid {
		value := validUntil.Time
		item.ValidUntil = &value
	}
	if len(attributes) == 0 {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
	} else {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "The offer contains invalid attributes.")
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func parsePositiveInt(raw string, fallback, maximum int) (int, error) {
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || value < 1 || value > maximum {
		return 0, errors.New("out of range")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, APIError{Code: code, Message: message})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

type Config struct {
	URL             string
	MaxOpenConns    int
	MaxIdleConns    int
	ConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*sql.DB, error) {
	if cfg.URL == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", cfg.URL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open database: %w", err)
	}

	if cfg.MaxOpenConns > 0 {
		db.SetMaxOpenConns(cfg.MaxOpenConns)
	}
	if cfg.MaxIdleConns >= 0 {
		db.SetMaxIdleConns(cfg.MaxIdleConns)
	}
	if cfg.ConnMaxLifetime > 0 {
		db.SetConnMaxLifetime(cfg.ConnMaxLifetime)
	}

	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := db.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to database: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}

FILE: internal\database\migrate.go
SIZE: 3443 bytes
LAST MODIFIED: 11/04/2026 07:23:48
####################################################################################################
package database

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/migrations"
)

const migrationLockID int64 = 5270645408566230100

func Migrate(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	if db == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("database is not configured")
	}

	conn, err := db.Conn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration connection: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()

	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(
		ctx,
		"SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)",
		migrationLockID,
	); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration advisory lock: %w", err)
	}

	defer func() {
		unlockCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = conn.ExecContext(
			unlockCtx,
			"SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)",
			migrationLockID,
		)
	}()

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
			version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			checksum TEXT,
			applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("initialize migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		ALTER TABLE schema_migrations
		ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS checksum TEXT
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("upgrade migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	files, err := fs.Glob(migrations.Files, "*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list migration files: %w", err)
	}
	sort.Strings(files)

	for _, file := range files {
		if strings.Contains(file, "..") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid migration path: %s", file)
		}

		content, err := migrations.Files.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", file, err)
		}

		version := strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".sql")
		sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
		checksum := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])

		var stored sql.NullString
		err = conn.QueryRowContext(
			ctx,
			`SELECT checksum FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1`,
			version,
		).Scan(&stored)

		if err == nil {
			if !stored.Valid || stored.String == "" {
				// Existing installations created before checksum support:
				// adopt the currently deployed migration as the baseline.
				_, err = conn.ExecContext(
					ctx,
					`UPDATE schema_migrations
					 SET checksum = $1
					 WHERE version = $2 AND checksum IS NULL`,
					checksum,
					version,
				)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("adopt legacy checksum for %s: %w", version, err)
				}
				continue
			}

			if stored.String != checksum {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"migration checksum mismatch for %s: applied migration file was modified; restore the original file or create a new migration",
					version,
				)
			}
			continue
		}

		if err != sql.ErrNoRows {
			return fmt.Errorf("check migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		tx, err := conn.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if _, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, string(content)); err == nil {
			_, err = tx.ExecContext(
				ctx,
				`INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, checksum)
				 VALUES ($1, $2)`,
				version,
				checksum,
			)
		}

		if err != nil {
			_ = tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

package health

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

func (h Handler) Liveness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ok",
	})
}

func (h Handler) Readiness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_not_configured",
		})
		return
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := h.DB.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_unavailable",
		})
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ready",
	})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/catalogue"
)

func New(db *sql.DB) http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/live", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "alive",
		})
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/ready", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if db == nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		ctx, cancel := timeouts(r)
		defer cancel()

		if err := db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "ready",
		})
	})

	catalogue.Handler{DB: db}.Register(mux)

	return securityHeaders(mux)
}

func timeouts(r *http.Request) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	return context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
}

func writeHealthJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, body any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
}

func securityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
		w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidMarketID       = errors.New("invalid market id")
	ErrInvalidMarketCode     = errors.New("invalid market code")
	ErrInvalidMarketName     = errors.New("invalid market name")
	ErrInvalidMarketTimezone = errors.New("invalid market timezone")
	ErrInvalidTimestamp      = errors.New("invalid timestamp")
	ErrInvalidMarketState    = errors.New("invalid market state")
	ErrMarketClosed          = errors.New("market is closed")
)

type MarketID string

type MarketStatus string

const (
	MarketStatusDraft     MarketStatus = "draft"
	MarketStatusActive    MarketStatus = "active"
	MarketStatusSuspended MarketStatus = "suspended"
	MarketStatusClosed    MarketStatus = "closed"
)

func (s MarketStatus) IsValid() bool {
	switch s {
	case MarketStatusDraft,
		MarketStatusActive,
		MarketStatusSuspended,
		MarketStatusClosed:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

type CreateMarketInput struct {
	ID          MarketID
	Code        string
	Name        string
	Description string
	Timezone    string
}

type Market struct {
	id          MarketID
	code        string
	name        string
	description string
	timezone    string

	status    MarketStatus
	version   uint64
	createdAt time.Time
	updatedAt time.Time
}

func NewMarket(input CreateMarketInput, now time.Time) (*Market, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(input.ID)) == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidMarketID
	}

	code := normalizeMarketCode(input.Code)
	if !isValidMarketCode(code) {
		return nil, ErrInvalidMarketCode
	}

	name := strings.TrimSpace(input.Name)
	if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidMarketName
	}

	if now.IsZero() {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	timezone := strings.TrimSpace(input.Timezone)
	if timezone == "" {
		timezone = "UTC"
	}

	if _, err := time.LoadLocation(timezone); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalidMarketTimezone, timezone)
	}

	return &Market{
		id:          input.ID,
		code:        code,
		name:        name,
		description: strings.TrimSpace(input.Description),
		timezone:    timezone,
		status:      MarketStatusDraft,
		version:     1,
		createdAt:   now.UTC(),
		updatedAt:   now.UTC(),
	}, nil
}

func normalizeMarketCode(value string) string {
	return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

func isValidMarketCode(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 32 {
		return false
	}

	for _, r := range value {
		valid := (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') ||
			(r >= '0' && r <= '9') ||
			r == '-' ||
			r == '_'

		if !valid {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

func (m *Market) ID() MarketID {
	return m.id
}

func (m *Market) Code() string {
	return m.code
}

func (m *Market) Name() string {
	return m.name
}

func (m *Market) Description() string {
	return m.description
}

func (m *Market) Timezone() string {
	return m.timezone
}

func (m *Market) Status() MarketStatus {
	return m.status
}

func (m *Market) Version() uint64 {
	return m.version
}

func (m *Market) CreatedAt() time.Time {
	return m.createdAt
}

func (m *Market) UpdatedAt() time.Time {
	return m.updatedAt
}

func (m *Market) UpdateDetails(
	name string,
	description string,
	timezone string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if m.status == MarketStatusClosed {
		return ErrMarketClosed
	}

	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" || len([]rune(name)) > 160 {
		return ErrInvalidMarketName
	}

	timezone = strings.TrimSpace(timezone)
	if timezone == "" {
		timezone = "UTC"
	}

	if _, err := time.LoadLocation(timezone); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalidMarketTimezone, timezone)
	}

	if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	m.name = name
	m.description = strings.TrimSpace(description)
	m.timezone = timezone
	m.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (m *Market) Activate(now time.Time) error {
	switch m.status {
	case MarketStatusDraft, MarketStatusSuspended:
		if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		m.status = MarketStatusActive
		m.touch(now)
		return nil

	case MarketStatusActive:
		return ErrInvalidMarketState

	case MarketStatusClosed:
		return ErrMarketClosed

	default:
		return ErrInvalidMarketState
	}
}

func (m *Market) Suspend(now time.Time) error {
	if m.status != MarketStatusActive {
		return ErrInvalidMarketState
	}

	if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	m.status = MarketStatusSuspended
	m.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (m *Market) Close(now time.Time) error {
	if m.status == MarketStatusClosed {
		return ErrInvalidMarketState
	}

	if err := m.validateTimestamp(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	m.status = MarketStatusClosed
	m.touch(now)

	return nil
}

func (m *Market) IsOperational() bool {
	return m.status == MarketStatusActive
}

func (m *Market) validateTimestamp(now time.Time) error {
	if now.IsZero() {
		return ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	if now.Before(m.updatedAt) {
		return ErrInvalidTimestamp
	}

	return nil
}

func (m *Market) touch(now time.Time) {
	m.updatedAt = now.UTC()
	m.version++
}

func TestNewMarketRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		input CreateMarketInput
		want  error
	}{
		{
			name: "missing id",
			input: CreateMarketInput{
				Code: "MKT",
				Name: "Market",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidMarketID,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid code",
			input: CreateMarketInput{
				ID:   "m-1",
				Code: "invalid code!",
				Name: "Market",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidMarketCode,
		},
		{
			name: "missing name",
			input: CreateMarketInput{
				ID:   "m-1",
				Code: "MKT",
				Name: " ",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidMarketName,
		},
		{
			name: "invalid timezone",
			input: CreateMarketInput{
				ID:       "m-1",
				Code:     "MKT",
				Name:     "Market",
				Timezone: "Not/A/Timezone",
			},
			want: ErrInvalidMarketTimezone,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := NewMarket(tt.input, now)

			if !errors.Is(err, tt.want) {
				t.Fatalf("expected error %v, got %v", tt.want, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestMarketLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	market := testMarket(t)
	base := market.UpdatedAt()

	if err := market.Activate(base.Add(time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Activate() error = %v", err)
	}

	if !market.IsOperational() {
		t.Fatal("market should be operational")
	}

	if err := market.Suspend(base.Add(2 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Suspend() error = %v", err)
	}

	if market.Status() != MarketStatusSuspended {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected status: %s", market.Status())
	}

	if err := market.Activate(base.Add(3 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reactivation error = %v", err)
	}

	if err := market.Close(base.Add(4 * time.Minute)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Close() error = %v", err)
	}

	if market.Status() != MarketStatusClosed {
		t.Fatalf("expected closed status, got %s", market.Status())
	}

	if err := market.Activate(base.Add(5 * time.Minute)); !errors.Is(err, ErrMarketClosed) {
		t.Fatalf("expected ErrMarketClosed, got %v", err)
	}
}
