$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Project detection and preflight
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Root = (Get-Location).Path

if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $Root "go.mod"))) {
    $Nested = Join-Path $Root "general-market-backend"
    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $Nested "go.mod")) {
        $Root = $Nested
    }
    else {
        throw "Run from general-market-backend or its parent directory."
    }
}

$RequiredFiles = @(
    "go.mod",
    "internal\database\database.go",
    "internal\database\migrate.go",
    "cmd\server\main.go",
    "config\config.go",
    "migrations\migrations.go",
    "migrations\000001_initial.sql",
    "migrations\000002_market_domain_foundation.sql"
)

foreach ($Relative in $RequiredFiles) {
    if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $Root $Relative) -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Required file missing: $Relative. No changes made."
    }
}

$NewMigration = Join-Path $Root "migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql"

if (Test-Path $NewMigration) {
    throw "Migration 000003 already exists. Script stopped to prevent overwriting."
}

$GoVersion = (& go version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Go is not available."
}

Write-Host "Project: $Root" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host $GoVersion

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Backup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
$BackupDir = Join-Path $Root ".backups\migration-hardening-$Stamp"

$Targets = @(
    "internal\database\database.go",
    "internal\database\migrate.go",
    "migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql",
    "cmd\migrate\main.go"
)

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null

foreach ($Relative in $Targets) {
    $Source = Join-Path $Root $Relative

    if (Test-Path $Source -PathType Leaf) {
        $Destination = Join-Path $BackupDir $Relative
        $DestinationDir = Split-Path $Destination -Parent
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DestinationDir -Force | Out-Null
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Source -Destination $Destination
    }
}

$Utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$WrittenFiles = @()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. New database.go
#    Opening the application database no longer runs migrations.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$DatabaseGo = @'
package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

type Config struct {
	URL             string
	MaxOpenConns    int
	MaxIdleConns    int
	ConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*sql.DB, error) {
	if cfg.URL == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", cfg.URL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open database: %w", err)
	}

	if cfg.MaxOpenConns > 0 {
		db.SetMaxOpenConns(cfg.MaxOpenConns)
	}
	if cfg.MaxIdleConns >= 0 {
		db.SetMaxIdleConns(cfg.MaxIdleConns)
	}
	if cfg.ConnMaxLifetime > 0 {
		db.SetConnMaxLifetime(cfg.ConnMaxLifetime)
	}

	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := db.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to database: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. New migration runner
#    - PostgreSQL session advisory lock
#    - SHA-256 checksums
#    - Legacy checksum adoption
#    - One transaction per migration
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$MigrateGo = @'
package database

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/migrations"
)

const migrationLockID int64 = 5270645408566230100

func Migrate(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	if db == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("database is not configured")
	}

	conn, err := db.Conn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration connection: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()

	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(
		ctx,
		"SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)",
		migrationLockID,
	); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration advisory lock: %w", err)
	}

	defer func() {
		unlockCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = conn.ExecContext(
			unlockCtx,
			"SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)",
			migrationLockID,
		)
	}()

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
			version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			checksum TEXT,
			applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("initialize migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		ALTER TABLE schema_migrations
		ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS checksum TEXT
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("upgrade migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	files, err := fs.Glob(migrations.Files, "*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list migration files: %w", err)
	}
	sort.Strings(files)

	for _, file := range files {
		if strings.Contains(file, "..") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid migration path: %s", file)
		}

		content, err := migrations.Files.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", file, err)
		}

		version := strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".sql")
		sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
		checksum := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])

		var stored sql.NullString
		err = conn.QueryRowContext(
			ctx,
			`SELECT checksum FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1`,
			version,
		).Scan(&stored)

		if err == nil {
			if !stored.Valid || stored.String == "" {
				// Existing installations created before checksum support:
				// adopt the currently deployed migration as the baseline.
				_, err = conn.ExecContext(
					ctx,
					`UPDATE schema_migrations
					 SET checksum = $1
					 WHERE version = $2 AND checksum IS NULL`,
					checksum,
					version,
				)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("adopt legacy checksum for %s: %w", version, err)
				}
				continue
			}

			if stored.String != checksum {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"migration checksum mismatch for %s: applied migration file was modified; restore the original file or create a new migration",
					version,
				)
			}
			continue
		}

		if err != sql.ErrNoRows {
			return fmt.Errorf("check migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		tx, err := conn.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if _, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, string(content)); err == nil {
			_, err = tx.ExecContext(
				ctx,
				`INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, checksum)
				 VALUES ($1, $2)`,
				version,
				checksum,
			)
		}

		if err != nil {
			_ = tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. New additive SQL migration
#    No destructive data rewrite.
#    Existing inconsistent rows cause a safe migration failure.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$MigrationSQL = @'
-- General Market migration 000003.
-- Integrity hardening. Additive and transactional.
-- This file must never replace or modify an earlier migration.

-- 1. Specialized classification versioning.
ALTER TABLE specialized_classifications
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS specialized_classifications_code_key;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_specialized_classifications_code_version
    ON specialized_classifications (code, version);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_specialized_classifications_one_active_code
    ON specialized_classifications (code)
    WHERE is_active = TRUE;

-- 2. Global category mappings.
-- The original UNIQUE constraint already protects non-NULL market_id rows.
-- This partial index closes PostgreSQL's NULL uniqueness gap.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_category_mappings_global
    ON category_mappings (public_category_id, specialized_classification_id)
    WHERE market_id IS NULL;

-- 3. Store the offer identity on each match.
ALTER TABLE order_matches
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS offer_id UUID;

UPDATE order_matches AS om
SET offer_id = buy_order.offer_id
FROM orders AS buy_order
WHERE om.buy_order_id = buy_order.id
  AND om.offer_id IS NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM order_matches AS om
        JOIN orders AS buy_order ON buy_order.id = om.buy_order_id
        JOIN orders AS sell_order ON sell_order.id = om.sell_order_id
        WHERE buy_order.offer_id <> sell_order.offer_id
           OR om.offer_id IS NULL
           OR om.offer_id <> buy_order.offer_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Migration 000003 stopped: an order match references inconsistent offers';
    END IF;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE order_matches
    ALTER COLUMN offer_id SET NOT NULL;

-- 4. Composite unique keys used by referential integrity constraints.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_orders_id_offer_id
    ON orders (id, offer_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_order_matches_identity
    ON order_matches (id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id);

-- 5. Each side of a match must belong to the same offer recorded by the match.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'order_matches'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_match_buy_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE order_matches
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_match_buy_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (buy_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'order_matches'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_match_sell_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE order_matches
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_match_sell_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;
END
$$;

-- 6. A trade must reference the exact match and exact two orders.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_match_order_pair'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_match_order_pair
            FOREIGN KEY (match_id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES order_matches (id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_buy_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_buy_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (buy_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_sell_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_sell_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;
END
$$;
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Dedicated migration command
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$MigrateMain = @'
package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/config"
	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/database"
)

func main() {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("invalid configuration: %v", err)
	}

	if cfg.DatabaseURL == "" {
		log.Fatal("DATABASE_URL is required for migration execution")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	db, err := database.Open(ctx, database.Config{
		URL:             cfg.DatabaseURL,
		MaxOpenConns:    cfg.DBMaxOpenConns,
		MaxIdleConns:    cfg.DBMaxIdleConns,
		ConnMaxLifetime: cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime,
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("database connection failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	if err := database.Migrate(ctx, db); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("migration failed: %v", err)
	}

	log.Print("Database migrations completed successfully.")
	os.Exit(0)
}
'@

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Write files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

try {
    $FilesToWrite = @{
        "internal\database\database.go" = $DatabaseGo
        "internal\database\migrate.go" = $MigrateGo
        "migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql" = $MigrationSQL
        "cmd\migrate\main.go" = $MigrateMain
    }

    foreach ($Relative in $FilesToWrite.Keys) {
        $Path = Join-Path $Root $Relative
        $Directory = Split-Path $Path -Parent

        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Directory -Force | Out-Null
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $FilesToWrite[$Relative], $Utf8)
        $WrittenFiles += $Relative
    }

    Push-Location $Root
    try {
        Write-Host "`n--- gofmt ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan

        & gofmt -w `
            "internal\database\database.go" `
            "internal\database\migrate.go" `
            "cmd\migrate\main.go"

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "gofmt failed."
        }

        Write-Host "`n--- go test ./... ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & go test ./...

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Go tests failed."
        }

        Write-Host "`n--- go vet ./... ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & go vet ./...

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "go vet failed."
        }

        Write-Host "`n--- go build ./... ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & go build ./...

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Go build failed."
        }

        Write-Host "`nSUCCESS: source changes and Go checks completed." -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "Backup: $BackupDir"
        Write-Host "New migration: migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql"
        Write-Host "Database migration was NOT executed." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host "`nERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Restoring files from backup..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

    foreach ($Relative in $Targets) {
        $BackupFile = Join-Path $BackupDir $Relative
        $TargetFile = Join-Path $Root $Relative

        if (Test-Path $BackupFile -PathType Leaf) {
            $TargetDirectory = Split-Path $TargetFile -Parent
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $TargetDirectory -Force | Out-Null
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $BackupFile -Destination $TargetFile -Force
        }
        elseif ($Relative -in $WrittenFiles -and
                $Relative -eq "migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql") {
            if (Test-Path $TargetFile) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $TargetFile -Force
            }
        }
        elseif ($Relative -in $WrittenFiles -and
                $Relative -eq "cmd\migrate\main.go") {
            if (Test-Path $TargetFile) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $TargetFile -Force
            }
        }
    }

    Write-Host "Rollback of modified source files attempted." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "Backup directory: $BackupDir"
    throw
}

[CmdletBinding()]

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ============================================================
# General Market Backend - Architecture Completion
# Safe, additive, non-destructive PowerShell script.
# Does not move, delete, or overwrite existing files.
# Does not connect to PostgreSQL or run migrations.
# ============================================================

$ProjectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$ExpectedRootName = "general-market-backend"
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ProjectRoot -PathType Container)) {
    throw "Project root not found: $ProjectRoot"
}

if ((Split-Path -Leaf $ProjectRoot) -ne $ExpectedRootName) {
    throw "Wrong project root. Expected '$ExpectedRootName', got '$ProjectRoot'."
}

$CreatedDirectories = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$ExistingDirectories = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$CreatedFiles = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$ExistingFiles = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Ensure-Directory {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$RelativePath
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FullPath) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FullPath -PathType Container)) {
            throw "Cannot create directory because a file occupies this path: $FullPath"
        }

        $ExistingDirectories.Add($RelativePath)
        return
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $FullPath | Out-Null
    $CreatedDirectories.Add($RelativePath)
}

function Ensure-TextFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$RelativePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Content
    )

    $FullPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $RelativePath
    $ParentPath = Split-Path -Parent $FullPath

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ParentPath -PathType Container)) {
        throw "Parent directory does not exist: $ParentPath"
    }

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FullPath) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FullPath -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw "Cannot create file because a directory occupies this path: $FullPath"
        }

        $ExistingFiles.Add($RelativePath)
        return
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $FullPath,
        $Content.Trim() + [Environment]::NewLine,
        $Utf8NoBom
    )

    $CreatedFiles.Add($RelativePath)
}

- Services: transport, storage, inspection, insurance, installation, delivery.
- Settlement: authoritative financial settlement execution and result.
- Official institutions: authoritative legal registration or official records,
  where applicable.
- General Market: market workflow, offers, orders, matching, trades, references,
  execution policy, and coordination states.

## Mandatory design constraints

1. The client is not authoritative for permissions, buying power, matching,
   or state transitions.
2. Financial and asset balances must not be independently duplicated here.
3. External operations require explicit contracts, timeouts, error handling,
   correlation identifiers, and safe retry behavior.
4. Concurrent order and matching operations require transactional safeguards
   and idempotency.
5. Published configuration and execution policy versions must be traceable.
6. Important transitions must be auditable without copying complete external
   records unnecessarily.
7. Database migrations must be versioned, reviewable, and non-destructive by
   default. Never rebuild or erase an existing database automatically.
8. Redis and message brokers are optional; introduce them only after a
   measured technical requirement.
9. A directory or README is not a completed feature. Each module needs code,
   API contracts where applicable, automated tests, and acceptance checks.
10. Infrastructure adapters must have a single clear location. If an older
    implementation exists under internal/database, review imports and behavior
    before consolidating or moving it to infrastructure/postgres.

## Implementation order

1. Inspect current repository, Go packages, migrations, configuration, and API.
2. Stabilize application bootstrap, PostgreSQL access, errors, logging, health,
   and test harness.
3. Implement catalogue and market/offer configuration.
4. Implement offers and eligibility.
5. Implement supply requests, orders, reservations, and matching.
6. Implement trades, state machines, execution policies, and workflows.
7. Add integrations, commodity aggregation, real-asset workflows, and audit
   coverage as required by the detailed specification.
8. Verify concurrency, security, performance, migrations, and recovery.

This document defines logical responsibilities, not separate deployable
services. Go package boundaries must remain simple and avoid circular imports.
'@

Write-Host "[3/5] Creating architecture map if missing..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

Ensure-TextFile `
    -RelativePath "docs\architecture\GENERAL-MARKET-MODULE-MAP.md" `
    -Content $ArchitectureMap

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# Resolve the backend root from the current working directory.
$BackendRoot = (Get-Location).Path

if ((Split-Path -Leaf $BackendRoot) -ne "general-market-backend") {
    $Candidate = Join-Path $BackendRoot "general-market-backend"

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Candidate -PathType Container) {
        $BackendRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Candidate).Path
    }
    else {
        throw "Run this script from the general-market-backend directory."
    }
}

$ProjectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $BackendRoot
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $BackendRoot "scripts"
$Timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
$ReportPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "general-market-architecture-$Timestamp.txt"
$Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$Lines = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'

function Add-Line {
    param([string]$Text = "")
    $Lines.Add($Text)
}

function Get-RelativePath {
    param(
        [string]$BasePath,
        [string]$FullPath
    )

    $BaseFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BasePath).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
    $FileFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($FullPath)

    if ($FileFull.StartsWith($BaseFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $FileFull.Substring($BaseFull.Length)
    }

    return $FileFull
}

$ExcludedDirectories = @(
    ".git", "vendor", "node_modules", "bin", "dist", "build",
    ".idea", ".vscode", "coverage"
)

$Files = @(
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $BackendRoot -Recurse -File |
        Where-Object {
            $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $_.FullName
            $Parts = $Relative -split '[\\/]'
            -not ($Parts | Where-Object { $ExcludedDirectories -contains $_ })
        } |
        Sort-Object FullName
)

$Directories = @(
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $BackendRoot -Recurse -Directory |
        Where-Object {
            $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $_.FullName
            $Parts = $Relative -split '[\\/]'
            -not ($Parts | Where-Object { $ExcludedDirectories -contains $_ })
        } |
        Sort-Object FullName
)

Add-Line "GENERAL MARKET BACKEND - ARCHITECTURE AUDIT"
Add-Line "Generated: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"
Add-Line "Backend root: $BackendRoot"
Add-Line "Project root: $ProjectRoot"
Add-Line "Read-only report; source files and database were not modified."
Add-Line ""

Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "1. ACTUAL DIRECTORY TREE"
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "general-market-backend\"

foreach ($Directory in $Directories) {
    $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $Directory.FullName
    $Depth = ($Relative -split '[\\/]').Count
    Add-Line (("  " * $Depth) + "+ " + (Split-Path -Leaf $Directory.FullName) + "\")
}

foreach ($File in $Files) {
    $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
    if ($Relative -notmatch '[\\/]') {
        Add-Line ("  " + $Relative)
    }
}

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "2. GO SOURCE FILES"
Add-Line "============================================================"

$GoFiles = @($Files | Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq ".go" })

foreach ($File in $GoFiles) {
    $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
    Add-Line ""
    Add-Line "FILE: $Relative"
    Add-Line "SIZE: $($File.Length) bytes"

    $SourceLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName)
    foreach ($SourceLine in $SourceLines) {
        if ($SourceLine -match '^\s*package\s+\w+' -or
            $SourceLine -match '^\s*import\s*(\(|")' -or
            $SourceLine -match '^\s*(type\s+\w+|func\s+(\([^)]*\)\s*)?\w+|var\s+\(|const\s+\()') {
            Add-Line ("  " + $SourceLine.Trim())
        }
    }
}

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "3. SQL MIGRATIONS"
Add-Line "============================================================"

$SqlFiles = @($Files | Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq ".sql" })

if ($SqlFiles.Count -eq 0) {
    Add-Line "No SQL files found."
}

foreach ($File in $SqlFiles) {
    $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
    Add-Line ""
    Add-Line "FILE: $Relative"
    Add-Line "SIZE: $($File.Length) bytes"

    foreach ($SqlLine in Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName) {
        Add-Line $SqlLine
    }
}

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "4. IMPORTANT PROJECT FILES"
Add-Line "============================================================"

$ImportantNames = @(
    "go.mod", "README.md", "GENERAL-MARKET-MODULE-MAP.md",
    "Dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml", "compose.yml",
    ".env.example", ".gitignore", ".dockerignore"
)

foreach ($File in ($Files | Where-Object { $ImportantNames -contains $_.Name })) {
    $Relative = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $BackendRoot -FullPath $File.FullName
    Add-Line ""
    Add-Line "FILE: $Relative"
    Add-Line "SIZE: $($File.Length) bytes"

    foreach ($ContentLine in Get-Content -LiteralPath $File.FullName) {
        Add-Line $ContentLine
    }
}

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "5. INVENTORY"
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "Total files: $($Files.Count)"
Add-Line "Go files: $($GoFiles.Count)"
Add-Line "SQL files: $($SqlFiles.Count)"
Add-Line "Directories: $($Directories.Count)"

foreach ($Group in ($Files | Group-Object Extension | Sort-Object Name)) {
    $ExtensionName = if ($Group.Name) { $Group.Name } else { "(no extension)" }
    Add-Line ("{0}: {1}" -f $ExtensionName, $Group.Count)
}

Add-Line ""
Add-Line "============================================================"
Add-Line "6. GIT STATUS"
Add-Line "============================================================"

$Git = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if ($Git) {
    $GitRoot = & git -C $ProjectRoot rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Add-Line "Repository root: $GitRoot"
        Add-Line "git status --short:"
        foreach ($StatusLine in (& git -C $ProjectRoot status --short 2>&1)) {
            Add-Line ([string]$StatusLine)
        }
    }
    else {
        Add-Line "Git repository not detected."

else {
    Add-Line "Git is not installed or is not on PATH."
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$ProjectRoot = (Get-Location).Path

if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "go.mod"))) {
    $nested = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "general-market-backend"

    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $nested "go.mod")) {
        $ProjectRoot = $nested
    }
    else {
        throw "Run this script from general-market-backend or its parent directory."
    }
}

$File = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "internal\catalogue\handler.go"

if (!(Test-Path $File)) {
    throw "Handler file not found: $File"
}

$Source = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($File)

$oldBlock = '(?s)\tif h\.DB == nil \{\r?\n\t\twriteError\(w, http\.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable\."\)\r?\n\t\treturn\r?\n\t\}\r?\n\r?\n(?=\tpage, err := parsePositiveInt)'

$anchorPattern = '(?m)^\tcategoryID := strings\.TrimSpace\(r\.URL\.Query\(\)\.Get\("category_id"\)\)\r?\n\tmarketID := strings\.TrimSpace\(r\.URL\.Query\(\)\.Get\("market_id"\)\)'

$oldMatches = [regex]::Matches($Source, $oldBlock)

if ($oldMatches.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Expected database check block was not found exactly once. No changes written."
}

$Candidate = [regex]::Replace($Source, $oldBlock, "", 1)

$anchorMatches = [regex]::Matches($Candidate, $anchorPattern)

if ($anchorMatches.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Expected category and market query lines were not found exactly once. No changes written."
}

$anchorMatch = $anchorMatches[0]

$Newline = "`r`n"
if (!$Source.Contains("`r`n")) {
    $Newline = "`n"
}

$dbCheck = @'
    if h.DB == nil {
        writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
        return
    }
'@

$insert = $anchorMatch.Value + $Newline + $Newline + $dbCheck.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")

$Candidate = $Candidate.Remove(
    $anchorMatch.Index,
    $anchorMatch.Length
).Insert(
    $anchorMatch.Index,
    $insert
)

$Backup = "$File.backup-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')"
[System.IO.File]::Copy($File, $Backup, $false)

$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

Push-Location $ProjectRoot

try {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($File, $Candidate, $Utf8NoBom)

    & gofmt -w "internal\catalogue\handler.go"

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "gofmt failed."
    }

    Write-Host "`n--- Catalogue tests ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & go test ./internal/catalogue

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Catalogue tests failed."
    }

    Write-Host "`n--- All project tests ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & go test ./...

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Project tests failed."
    }

    Write-Host "`n--- Static analysis ---" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & go vet ./...

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "go vet failed."
    }

    Write-Host "Backup: $Backup"

$Files["config/config.go"] = @'
package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

type Config struct {
	HTTPAddr          string
	DatabaseURL       string
	DBMaxOpenConns    int
	DBMaxIdleConns    int
	DBConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Load() (Config, error) {
	cfg := Config{
		HTTPAddr:          env("HTTP_ADDR", ":8080"),
		DatabaseURL:       os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"),
		DBMaxOpenConns:    10,
		DBMaxIdleConns:    5,
		DBConnMaxLifetime: 5 * time.Minute,
	}

	var err error

	cfg.DBMaxOpenConns, err = intEnv("DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS", 10)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}

	cfg.DBMaxIdleConns, err = intEnv("DB_MAX_IDLE_CONNS", 5)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}

	if cfg.DBMaxOpenConns < 1 ||
		cfg.DBMaxIdleConns < 0 ||
		cfg.DBMaxIdleConns > cfg.DBMaxOpenConns {
		return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid database connection pool settings")
	}

	if value := os.Getenv("DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME"); value != "" {
		cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime, err = time.ParseDuration(value)
		if err != nil || cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime <= 0 {
			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME")
		}
	}

	return cfg, nil
}

func env(key, fallback string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func intEnv(key string, fallback int) (int, error) {
	value := os.Getenv(key)
	if value == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}

	n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s: %w", key, err)
	}

	return n, nil
}
'@

$Files["internal/database/database.go"] = @'
package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

type Config struct {
	URL             string
	MaxOpenConns    int
	MaxIdleConns    int
	ConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*sql.DB, error) {
	if cfg.URL == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", cfg.URL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open database: %w", err)
	}

	db.SetMaxOpenConns(cfg.MaxOpenConns)
	db.SetMaxIdleConns(cfg.MaxIdleConns)
	db.SetConnMaxLifetime(cfg.ConnMaxLifetime)

	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := db.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to database: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(ctx, db); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("run migrations: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}
'@

$Files["internal/database/migrate.go"] = @'
package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"__MODULE__/migrations"
)

func Migrate(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	if db == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("database is not configured")
	}

	_, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
			version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("initialize migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	files, err := fs.Glob(migrations.Files, "*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list migration files: %w", err)
	}

	sort.Strings(files)

	for _, file := range files {
		version := strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".sql")

		var exists bool
		err := db.QueryRowContext(
			ctx,
			`SELECT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1
			)`,
			version,
		).Scan(&exists)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("check migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if exists {
			continue
		}

		content, err := migrations.Files.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if _, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, string(content)); err == nil {
			_, err = tx.ExecContext(
				ctx,
				`INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES ($1)`,
				version,
			)
		}

		if err != nil {
			_ = tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}
'@

$Files["internal/health/health.go"] = @'
package health

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

func (h Handler) Liveness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ok",
	})
}

func (h Handler) Readiness(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_not_configured",
		})
		return
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := h.DB.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
			"status": "not_ready",
			"reason": "database_unavailable",
		})
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
		"status": "ready",
	})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}
'@

package httpapi

import (
	"database/sql"

	"__MODULE__/internal/health"

func New(db *sql.DB) http.Handler {

$Files["cmd/server/main.go"] = @'
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"__MODULE__/config"
	"__MODULE__/internal/database"
	"__MODULE__/internal/httpapi"
)

func main() {
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil))
	slog.SetDefault(logger)

	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		logger.Error("invalid configuration", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	startupCtx, startupCancel := context.WithTimeout(
		context.Background(), 10*time.Second,
	)

	db, err := database.Open(startupCtx, database.Config{
		URL:             cfg.DatabaseURL,
		MaxOpenConns:    cfg.DBMaxOpenConns,
		MaxIdleConns:    cfg.DBMaxIdleConns,
		ConnMaxLifetime: cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime,
	})
	startupCancel()

	if err != nil {
		logger.Error("database initialization failed", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	if db != nil {
		defer db.Close()
	}

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:              cfg.HTTPAddr,
		Handler:           httpapi.New(db),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:       60 * time.Second,
	}

	serverErrors := make(chan error, 1)

	go func() {
		logger.Info("HTTP server starting", "address", cfg.HTTPAddr)
		serverErrors <- server.ListenAndServe()
	}()

	signalCtx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(
		context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM,
	)
	defer stop()

	select {
	case err := <-serverErrors:
		if !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			logger.Error("HTTP server stopped unexpectedly", "error", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}

	case <-signalCtx.Done():
		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
			context.Background(), 10*time.Second,
		)
		defer cancel()

		if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
			logger.Error("graceful shutdown failed", "error", err)
			_ = server.Close()
		}
	}
}
'@

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

function Write-Step([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host "`n[STEP] $Message" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Write-OK([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host "[OK] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function Write-Warn([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host "[WARN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-TextNoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content
    )

    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if ($parent -and !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
    }

    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $utf8NoBom)
}

function Find-BackendRoot {
    $cwd = (Get-Location).Path

    $candidates = @(
        $cwd,
        (Join-Path $cwd "general-market-backend"),
        (Join-Path $cwd "Real-Asset-Management-Platform\general-market-backend"),
        (Join-Path $cwd "Real-Asset-Management-Platform")
    )

    foreach ($candidate in $candidates) {
        if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate)) {
            continue
        }

        $full = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $candidate).Path

        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $full "go.mod")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $full "cmd\server\main.go")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $full "migrations"))
        ) {
            return $full
        }

        $nested = Join-Path $full "general-market-backend"
        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $nested "go.mod")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $nested "cmd\server\main.go")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $nested "migrations"))
        ) {
            return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $nested).Path
        }
    }

    throw @"
Backend root was not found.
Run this script from general-market-backend or its parent project directory.
The script requires go.mod, cmd\server\main.go and migrations\.
"@
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Additive PostgreSQL migration.
#    This creates foundational tables across the domain.
#    It does not create balances, ownership ledgers, contracts or settlement
#    records owned by independent services.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Step "Writing the domain foundation migration"

$migration = @'
-- General Market Backend
-- Migration: 000002_market_domain_foundation.sql
-- Additive, versioned and non-destructive.
--
-- Ownership boundaries:
-- * No account credentials or authoritative role database.
-- * No free-balance ledger or authoritative reservation ledger.
-- * No official property ownership register.
-- * No legal contract body owned by Contracts service.
-- * No service-delivery records owned by Services.
-- * No final settlement ledger owned by Settlement.
--
-- External identifiers are stored as references, not copied records.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS markets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    allowed_trade_methods JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    display_rules JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'paused', 'closed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_categories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    parent_id UUID REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Implement the public catalogue read API.
#    This is intentionally read-only until the account/permission integration
#    contract is implemented. No untrusted identity headers are accepted.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Step "Writing the catalogue handler"

$catalogueHandler = @'
package catalogue

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	defaultPageSize = 20
	maxPageSize     = 100
	maxSearchLength = 120
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

type OfferSummary struct {
	ID                 string    `json:"id"`
	Code               string    `json:"code"`
	MarketID           string    `json:"market_id"`
	MarketName         string    `json:"market_name"`
	PublicCategoryID   string    `json:"public_category_id,omitempty"`
	PublicCategoryName string    `json:"public_category_name,omitempty"`
	ClassificationID   string    `json:"classification_id"`
	Title              string    `json:"title"`
	Summary            string    `json:"summary,omitempty"`
	OfferType          string    `json:"offer_type"`
	PriceAmount        string    `json:"price_amount,omitempty"`
	CurrencyCode       string    `json:"currency_code,omitempty"`
	QuantityTotal      string    `json:"quantity_total,omitempty"`
	QuantityUnit       string    `json:"quantity_unit,omitempty"`
	Attributes         json.RawMessage `json:"attributes"`
	PublishedAt        time.Time `json:"published_at"`
	ValidUntil         *time.Time `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
}

type ListResponse struct {
	Data       []OfferSummary `json:"data"`
	Page       int            `json:"page"`
	PageSize   int            `json:"page_size"`
	Total      int64          `json:"total"`
	TotalPages int64          `json:"total_pages"`
}

type APIError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func (h Handler) Register(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers", h.ListOffers)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers/{id}", h.GetOffer)
}

func (h Handler) ListOffers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	page, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page"), 1, 1000000)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page", "page must be a positive integer.")
		return
	}

	pageSize, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page_size"), defaultPageSize, maxPageSize)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page_size", "page_size must be between 1 and 100.")
		return
	}

	search := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	if len(search) > maxSearchLength {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "search_too_long", "q must not exceed 120 characters.")
		return
	}

	categoryID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("category_id"))
	marketID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("market_id"))

	const filter = `
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
		  AND ($1 = '' OR o.title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(o.summary, '') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
		  AND ($2 = '' OR o.public_category_id::text = $2)
		  AND ($3 = '' OR o.market_id::text = $3)
	`

	var total int64
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) " + filter
	if err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), countQuery, search, categoryID, marketID).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
	const listSelect = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
	`
	rows, err := h.DB.QueryContext(
		r.Context(),
		listSelect+filter+`
			ORDER BY o.published_at DESC, o.id DESC
			LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
		`,
		search, categoryID, marketID, pageSize, offset,
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	data := make([]OfferSummary, 0, pageSize)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item OfferSummary
		var categoryIDValue string
		var categoryName string
		var validUntil sql.NullTime
		var attributes []byte

		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.Code,
			&item.MarketID,
			&item.MarketName,
			&categoryIDValue,
			&categoryName,
			&item.ClassificationID,
			&item.Title,
			&item.Summary,
			&item.OfferType,
			&item.PriceAmount,
			&item.CurrencyCode,
			&item.QuantityTotal,
			&item.QuantityUnit,
			&attributes,
			&item.PublishedAt,
			&validUntil,
		); err != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_scan_failed", "A catalogue record could not be read.")
			return
		}

		item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
		item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
		if validUntil.Valid {
			value := validUntil.Time
			item.ValidUntil = &value
		}
		if len(attributes) == 0 {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
		} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
		} else {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "A catalogue record contains invalid attributes.")
			return
		}
		data = append(data, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_read_failed", "The catalogue could not be read completely.")
		return
	}

	totalPages := int64(0)
	if total > 0 {
		totalPages = (total + int64(pageSize) - 1) / int64(pageSize)
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, ListResponse{
		Data:       data,
		Page:       page,
		PageSize:   pageSize,
		Total:      total,
		TotalPages: totalPages,
	})
}

func (h Handler) GetOffer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	id := strings.TrimSpace(r.PathValue("id"))
	if id == "" || len(id) > 64 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_offer_id", "A valid offer ID is required.")
		return
	}

	const query = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.id::text = $1
		  AND o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
	`

	var item OfferSummary
	var categoryIDValue string
	var categoryName string
	var validUntil sql.NullTime
	var attributes []byte

	err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), query, id).Scan(
		&item.ID,
		&item.Code,
		&item.MarketID,
		&item.MarketName,
		&categoryIDValue,
		&categoryName,
		&item.ClassificationID,
		&item.Title,
		&item.Summary,
		&item.OfferType,
		&item.PriceAmount,
		&item.CurrencyCode,
		&item.QuantityTotal,
		&item.QuantityUnit,
		&attributes,
		&item.PublishedAt,
		&validUntil,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "offer_not_found", "The published offer was not found.")
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The offer could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
	item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
	if validUntil.Valid {
		value := validUntil.Time
		item.ValidUntil = &value
	}
	if len(attributes) == 0 {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
	} else {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "The offer contains invalid attributes.")
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func parsePositiveInt(raw string, fallback, maximum int) (int, error) {
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || value < 1 || value > maximum {
		return 0, errors.New("out of range")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, APIError{Code: code, Message: message})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

Write-Step "Integrating the API router"

$router = @'
package httpapi

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/catalogue"
)

func New(db *sql.DB) http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/live", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "alive",
		})
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("GET /health/ready", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if db == nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		ctx, cancel := timeouts(r)
		defer cancel()

		if err := db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
			writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{
				"status": "not_ready",
				"reason": "database_unavailable",
			})
			return
		}

		writeHealthJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{
			"status": "ready",
		})
	})

	catalogue.Handler{DB: db}.Register(mux)

	return securityHeaders(mux)
}

func timeouts(r *http.Request) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	return context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
}

func writeHealthJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, body any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
}

func securityHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
		w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}
'@

# Ensure context is imported; keep the generated source explicit.
$router = $router.Replace(
    '"database/sql"',
    '"context"' + "`r`n" + "`t" + '"database/sql"'
)

function Write-Section {
    param([string]$Message)

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    Write-Host $Message -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ("=" * 78) -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
}

function Write-Info {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[INFO] $Message" -ForegroundColor Gray
}

function Write-Success {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[OK] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function Write-WarningMessage {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[WARNING] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Stop-Script {
    param([string]$Message)
    throw $Message
}

function Read-Utf8Text {
    param([string]$Path)

    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)

    return $text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
}

function Write-AtomicUtf8 {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Content
    )

    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force |
            Out-Null
    }

    $temporaryPath = Join-Path $directory (
        "." + [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path) +
        "." + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N") +
        ".tmp"
    )

    $encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

    try {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $temporaryPath,
            $Content,
            $encoding
        )

        Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath `
            -Destination $Path -Force
    }
    finally {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporaryPath) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath -Force
        }
    }
}

function Write-AtomicBytes {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Path,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [byte[]]$Bytes
    )

    $directory = Split-Path -Parent $Path

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force |
            Out-Null
    }

    $temporaryPath = Join-Path $directory (
        "." + [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path) +
        "." + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N") +
        ".tmp"
    )

    try {
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($temporaryPath, $Bytes)
        Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath -Destination $Path -Force
    }
    finally {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporaryPath) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryPath -Force
        }
    }
}

function Replace-TextExactlyOnce {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Source,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$OldText,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$NewText,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Label
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OldText)) {
        Stop-Script "Empty source anchor is forbidden: $Label"
    }

    # Normalize line endings and indentation for comparison only.
    # The actual source outside the matched region remains unchanged.
    $Normalize = {
        param([string]$Value)

        $Value = $Value.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")

        $Lines = $Value -split "`n"

        $Lines = @(
            foreach ($Line in $Lines) {
                $Line.Trim()
            }
        )

        return ($Lines -join "`n").Trim()
    }

    $NormalizedSource = & $Normalize $Source
    $NormalizedOld = & $Normalize $OldText

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($NormalizedOld)) {
        Stop-Script "Normalized source anchor is empty: $Label"
    }

    $Index = $NormalizedSource.IndexOf(
        $NormalizedOld,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($Index -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "Source anchor not found after normalization: $Label"
    }

    $SecondIndex = $NormalizedSource.IndexOf(
        $NormalizedOld,
        $Index + $NormalizedOld.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($SecondIndex -ge 0) {
        Stop-Script "Source anchor is ambiguous after normalization: $Label"
    }

    # First attempt: exact replacement, preserving original behavior.
    $ExactIndex = $Source.IndexOf(
        $OldText,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($ExactIndex -ge 0) {
        $ExactSecond = $Source.IndexOf(
            $OldText,
            $ExactIndex + $OldText.Length,
            [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
        )

        if ($ExactSecond -ge 0) {
            Stop-Script "Exact source anchor is ambiguous: $Label"
        }

        return $Source.Substring(0, $ExactIndex) +
            $NewText +
            $Source.Substring($ExactIndex + $OldText.Length)
    }

    # If whitespace differs, locate the same logical lines in the
    # original source and replace only their complete line range.
    $SourceLines = $Source -split "`n", 0, "SimpleMatch"
    $OldLines = $OldText.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") -split "`n"

    $Expected = @(
        foreach ($Line in $OldLines) {
            $Line.Trim()
        }
    )

    $Matches = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[int]

    for ($Start = 0; $Start -le ($SourceLines.Count - $Expected.Count); $Start++) {
        $IsMatch = $true

        for ($Offset = 0; $Offset -lt $Expected.Count; $Offset++) {
            if ($SourceLines[$Start + $Offset].Trim() -cne $Expected[$Offset]) {
                $IsMatch = $false
                break
            }
        }

        if ($IsMatch) {
            $Matches.Add($Start)
        }
    }

    if ($Matches.Count -ne 1) {
        Stop-Script "Expected exactly one logical source anchor for '$Label'; found $($Matches.Count)."
    }

    $StartLine = $Matches[0]
    $EndLine = $StartLine + $Expected.Count - 1

    $Before = @()
    $After = @()

    if ($StartLine -gt 0) {
        $Before = @($SourceLines[0..($StartLine - 1)])
    }

    if ($EndLine -lt ($SourceLines.Count - 1)) {
        $After = @($SourceLines[($EndLine + 1)..($SourceLines.Count - 1)])
    }

    $NewLines = $NewText.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n") -split "`n"

    return (@($Before) + @($NewLines) + @($After)) -join "`n"
}

function Replace-GoSection {
    param(
        [string]$Source,
        [string]$StartMarker,
        [string]$EndMarker,
        [string]$Replacement,
        [string]$Label
    )

    $start = $Source.IndexOf(
        $StartMarker,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($start -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "Go function not found: $Label"
    }

    $duplicate = $Source.IndexOf(
        $StartMarker,
        $start + $StartMarker.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($duplicate -ge 0) {
        Stop-Script "Duplicate Go function marker: $Label"
    }

    $end = $Source.IndexOf(
        $EndMarker,
        $start + $StartMarker.Length,
        [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal
    )

    if ($end -lt 0) {
        Stop-Script "End boundary not found for: $Label"
    }

    return $Source.Substring(0, $start) +
        $Replacement.TrimEnd() +
        "`n`n" +
        $Source.Substring($end)
}

function Find-ProjectRoot {
    param([string]$InitialPath)

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($InitialPath)) {
        $resolved = Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $InitialPath
        $candidate = $resolved.Path

        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "go.mod")) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate "internal\application"))
        ) {
            return $candidate
        }

        Stop-Script "ProjectRoot is not a valid General Market project."
    }

    $current = (Get-Location).Path

    while (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($current)) {
        $goMod = Join-Path $current "go.mod"
        $application = Join-Path $current "internal\application"

        if (
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath $goMod -PathType Leaf) -and
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath $application -PathType Container)
        ) {
            return $current
        }

        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current

        if (
            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent) -or
            $parent -eq $current
        ) {
            break
        }

        $current = $parent
    }

    Stop-Script "General Market project root was not found."
}

function Invoke-CheckedNativeCommand {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Executable,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string[]]$Arguments,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$Label
    )

    Write-Section $Label

    $previousPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
    $output = @()
    $exitCode = -1
    $invocationError = $null

    try {
        # Windows PowerShell 5.1 can promote native stderr records to
        # terminating errors when ErrorActionPreference is Stop.
        # Continue only for this native invocation so stdout/stderr and
        # the real process exit code can both be collected.
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
        $output = @(& $Executable @Arguments 2>&1)
        $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    catch {
        $invocationError = $_
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $previousPreference
    }

    foreach ($line in $output) {
        Write-Host $line
    }

    if ($null -ne $invocationError) {
        Stop-Script ("$Executable invocation failed: " + $invocationError.Exception.Message)
    }

    if ($null -eq $exitCode -or [int]$exitCode -ne 0) {
        Stop-Script ("$Executable failed with exit code '$exitCode': " + ($Arguments -join " "))
    }

    Write-Success "Command passed."
}

function Invoke-GoCheck {
    param(
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [string]$Label
    )

    Invoke-CheckedNativeCommand -Executable "go" -Arguments $Arguments -Label $Label
}

function Get-ProtectedFileHashes {
    param([string]$Root)

    $relativePaths = @(
        "migrations",
        "internal/database",
        "docker",
        "docker-compose.yml",
        "Dockerfile",
        "go.mod",
        "go.sum"
    )

    $result = @{}

    foreach ($relative in $relativePaths) {
        $full = Join-Path $Root $relative

        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) {
            continue
        }

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full -PathType Leaf) {
            $hash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $full -Algorithm SHA256
            $result[$relative] = $hash.Hash
            continue
        }

        $files = @(
            Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $full -File -Recurse -Force
        )

        foreach ($file in $files) {
            $key = $file.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart("\")
            $hash = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Algorithm SHA256
            $result[$key] = $hash.Hash
        }
    }

    return $result
}

function Assert-ProtectedFilesUnchanged {
    param(
        [hashtable]$Before,
        [hashtable]$After
    )

    $allKeys = @(
        $Before.Keys + $After.Keys |
            Sort-Object -Unique
    )

    $differences = @()

    foreach ($key in $allKeys) {
        if (-not $Before.ContainsKey($key)) {
            $differences += "Unexpected protected file: $key"
            continue
        }

        if (-not $After.ContainsKey($key)) {
            $differences += "Protected file disappeared: $key"
            continue
        }

        if ($Before[$key] -ne $After[$key]) {
            $differences += "Protected file changed: $key"
        }
    }

    if ($differences.Count -gt 0) {
        Stop-Script (
            "Protected database/infrastructure files changed:`n" +
            ($differences -join "`n")
        )
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 02. ROLLBACK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

function Restore-OriginalFiles {
    Write-Section "ROLLBACK"

    foreach ($relative in $Script:OriginalFiles.Keys) {
        $target = Join-Path $Script:Root $relative
        $backup = Join-Path $Script:BackupRoot $relative

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup -PathType Leaf) {
            $originalBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($backup)
            Write-AtomicBytes -Path $target -Bytes $originalBytes

            Write-WarningMessage "Restored byte-exact original: $relative"
        }
    }

    foreach ($relative in $Script:NewFiles) {
        $target = Join-Path $Script:Root $relative

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force
            Write-WarningMessage "Removed generated file: $relative"
        }
    }

    Write-Success "Application changes rolled back."
}

// APPLICATION_PACKAGE_01_HARDENING_V1

const applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength = 200

func validateApplicationContext(ctx context.Context) error {
    if ctx == nil {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    return ctx.Err()
}

func applicationNowUTC(clock Clock) (time.Time, error) {
    if clock == nil {
        return time.Time{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    now := clock.Now()
    if now.IsZero() {
        return time.Time{}, ErrInvalidClock
    }

    return now.UTC(), nil
}

func applicationNewID(
    ctx context.Context,
    generator IDGenerator,
    namespace string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    if generator == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(namespace) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    id, err := generator.NewID(ctx, namespace)
    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(id)) == "" {
        return "", ErrInvalidGeneratedID
    }

    return id, nil
}

func applicationValidateAuditEvent(event marketflow.AuditEvent) error {
    if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf(
            "%w: invalid audit event: %v",
            ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
            err,
        )
    }

    return nil
}

type MarketCatalogueGuard struct {
'@

    $services = Replace-TextExactlyOnce `
        -Source $services `
        -OldText $helperAnchor `
        -NewText $helpers `
        -Label "Application helper insertion"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 08. MARKET / CATALOGUE GUARD
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(
    ctx context.Context,
    offer marketflow.Offer,
) error {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if g.Markets == nil || g.Categories == nil || g.Mappings == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    market, err := g.Markets.GetMarket(
        ctx,
        marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if market == nil || !market.IsOperational() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    publicCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    specializedCategory, err := g.Categories.GetCategory(
        ctx,
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if publicCategory == nil ||
        specializedCategory == nil ||
        !publicCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        !specializedCategory.IsSelectable() ||
        publicCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindGeneral ||
        specializedCategory.Kind() != cataloguedomain.CategoryKindSpecialized {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    mapping, err := g.Mappings.GetMapping(
        ctx,
        marketdomain.MarketID(offer.MarketID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.PublicCategoryID),
        cataloguedomain.CategoryID(offer.SpecializedCategoryID),
    )
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if mapping == nil || !mapping.IsUsable() {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    return nil
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (g MarketCatalogueGuard) ValidateOffer(" `
        -EndMarker "type OfferReadiness interface" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "MarketCatalogueGuard.ValidateOffer"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 09. OFFER LIFECYCLE
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd OfferCommand,
    permission string,
    action string,
) (marketflow.Offer, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Offers == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Readiness == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.OfferID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(ctx, cmd.ActorID, permission); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Offer{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.Offer

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            offer, err := s.Offers.GetOffer(txctx, cmd.OfferID)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if offer.ID != cmd.OfferID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := offer.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if offer.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            previousVersion := offer.Version

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            switch action {
            case "submit_for_review":
                if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                    return err
                }

                err = offer.SubmitForReview(now)

            case "approve":
                err = offer.Approve(now)

            case "publish":
                if err := s.Readiness.ValidateOffer(txctx, offer); err != nil {
                    return err
                }

                err = offer.Publish(now)

            default:
                return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
            }

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Offers.SaveOffer(
                txctx,
                offer,
                previousVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "offer",
                AggregateID:     offer.ID,
                Action:          action,
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: previousVersion,
                NewVersion:      offer.Version,
                OccurredAt:      now,
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = offer
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (s *OfferLifecycleService) transition(" `
        -EndMarker "// Supply request selection." `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "OfferLifecycleService.transition"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. SUPPLY REQUEST / PROPOSAL SELECTION
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *SupplyRequestService) SelectProposal(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd SelectProposalCommand,
) (marketflow.SupplyRequest, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Requests == nil ||
        s.Proposals == nil ||
        s.Validator == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.RequestID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ProposalID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        cmd.ActorID,
        "supply_requests.select_proposal",
    ); err != nil {
        return marketflow.SupplyRequest{}, err
    }

    var result marketflow.SupplyRequest

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            request, requestRevision, err :=
                s.Requests.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.RequestID)

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if request.ID != cmd.RequestID || requestRevision == 0 {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if requestRevision != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            proposal, proposalRevision, err :=
                s.Proposals.GetForUpdate(txctx, cmd.ProposalID)

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if proposalRevision == 0 ||
                proposal.ID != cmd.ProposalID ||
                proposal.RequestID != request.ID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if proposal.State != marketflow.ProposalSubmitted {
                return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
            }

            if err := s.Validator.ValidateProposal(
                txctx,
                request,
                proposal,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := marketflow.SelectProposal(
                &request,
                proposal,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            proposal.State = marketflow.ProposalAccepted

            if err := s.Proposals.Save(
                txctx,
                proposal,
                proposalRevision,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Requests.Save(
                txctx,
                request,
                requestRevision,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if requestRevision == ^uint64(0) {
                return ErrRevisionOverflow
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "supply_request",
                AggregateID:     request.ID,
                Action:          "proposal_selected",
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: requestRevision,
                NewVersion:      requestRevision + 1,
                OccurredAt:      now,
                Metadata: map[string]string{
                    "proposal_id": string(proposal.ID),
                },
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = request
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}
