    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. ORDER NOTIONAL
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func CalculateOrderNotional(order marketflow.Order) (int64, error) {
    switch order.Side {
    case marketflow.Buy:
        if order.Price <= 0 || order.Quantity <= 0 {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        if order.Price > math.MaxInt64/order.Quantity {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        return order.Price * order.Quantity, nil

    case marketflow.Sell:
        if order.Quantity <= 0 {
            return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
        }

        // Sell-side reservation is quantity-based and is handled by
        // My Assets. No monetary notional is sent for this side.
        return 0, nil

    default:
        return 0, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }
}
'@

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 12. ORDER ADMISSION / SAFE RESERVATION COMPENSATION
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd PlaceOrderCommand,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Orders == nil ||
        s.Validator == nil ||
        s.Resources == nil ||
        s.Identity == nil ||
        s.Audit == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    key := strings.TrimSpace(cmd.IdempotencyKey)

    if key == "" ||
        len(key) > applicationMaxIdempotencyKeyLength ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.ActorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.CorrelationID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    order := cmd.Order

    if err := order.Validate(); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if order.UserID != cmd.ActorID ||
        order.State != marketflow.OrderPending {
        return marketflow.Order{}, marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, cmd.ActorID); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        cmd.ActorID,
        "orders.place",
    ); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    // First idempotency read:
    // a completed order must be replayed without creating a new reservation.
    existing, found, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if found {
        if !sameOrderIntent(existing, order) {
            return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
        }

        return existing, nil
    }

    if err := s.Validator.ValidateOrder(ctx, order); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    notional, err := CalculateOrderNotional(order)
    if err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    // External reservation is deliberately outside the DB transaction.
    reservationID, err := s.Resources.ReserveForOrder(
        ctx,
        order,
        notional,
        key,
    )

    if err != nil {
        if errors.Is(err, ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown) {
            return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
                err,
                ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            )
        }

        return marketflow.Order{}, err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(reservationID)) == "" {
        // There is no safe identifier with which to release this reservation.
        // Treat this as a gateway contract violation and require reconciliation.
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            ErrInvalidReservationID,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
        )
    }

    var result marketflow.Order

    txErr := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            // Second idempotency read closes the race between the initial
            // read and the reservation operation.
            current, exists, err := s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(
                txctx,
                key,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if exists {
                if !sameOrderIntent(current, order) {
                    return ErrIdempotencyConflict
                }

                result = current
                return nil
            }

            orderToSave := order

            if err := orderToSave.Open(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            created, err := s.Orders.CreateOrder(
                txctx,
                orderToSave,
                key,
                reservationID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            // A repository must not silently mutate the admitted intent.
            if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid created order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if !sameOrderIntent(created, order) ||
                created.State != marketflow.OrderOpen ||
                created.Version != orderToSave.Version {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            eventID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "audit",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            event := marketflow.AuditEvent{
                ID:              eventID,
                AggregateType:   "order",
                AggregateID:     created.ID,
                Action:          "placed",
                ActorID:         cmd.ActorID,
                CorrelationID:   cmd.CorrelationID,
                PreviousVersion: order.Version,
                NewVersion:      created.Version,
                OccurredAt:      now,
                Metadata: map[string]string{
                    "reservation_id":  string(reservationID),
                    "idempotency_key": key,
                },
            }

            if err := applicationValidateAuditEvent(event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Audit.Append(txctx, event); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = created
            return nil
        },
    )

    if txErr == nil {
        return result, nil
    }

    // A commit error may be ambiguous. Releasing the reservation without
    // determining whether the order committed could release live resources.
    if errors.Is(txErr, ErrTransactionOutcomeUnknown) {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
        )
    }

    // Reconcile against the authoritative order repository before compensation.
    // A committed order, even if the caller received a commit error, must retain
    // its reservation.
    persisted, exists, reconcileErr :=
        s.Orders.GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx, key)

    if reconcileErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            fmt.Errorf("order reconciliation read failed: %w", reconcileErr),
        )
    }

    if exists {
        if sameOrderIntent(persisted, order) {
            return persisted, nil
        }

        // The idempotency key belongs to another intent.
        // Do not release a reservation that may belong to that order.
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
    }

    // Compensation is allowed only after a completed transaction failure
    // and a successful authoritative read proving that no order exists.
    releaseErr := s.Resources.ReleaseOrderResources(
        ctx,
        reservationID,
        key,
    )

    if releaseErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, errors.Join(
            txErr,
            ErrReservationCompensationFailed,
            ErrReservationReconciliationRequired,
            fmt.Errorf("reservation compensation failed: %w", releaseErr),
        )
    }

    return marketflow.Order{}, txErr
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func (s *OrderAdmissionService) Place(" `
        -EndMarker "// Matching is performed only inside a transaction" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "OrderAdmissionService.Place"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 13. MATCHING
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    $replacement = @'
func (s *MatchingService) MatchNext(
    ctx context.Context,
    marketID marketflow.ID,
    offerID marketflow.ID,
) (MatchRecord, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return MatchRecord{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Book == nil ||
        s.IDs == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(marketID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(offerID)) == "" {
        return MatchRecord{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result MatchRecord

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            buy, sell, err := s.Book.LockBestCrossingPair(
                txctx,
                marketID,
                offerID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := buy.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid buy order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if err := sell.Validate(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf(
                    "%w: invalid sell order: %v",
                    ErrRepositoryContractViolation,
                    err,
                )
            }

            if buy.ID == sell.ID ||
                buy.Side != marketflow.Buy ||
                sell.Side != marketflow.Sell ||
                buy.MarketID != marketID ||
                sell.MarketID != marketID ||
                buy.OfferID != offerID ||
                sell.OfferID != offerID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            originalBuyVersion := buy.Version
            originalSellVersion := sell.Version

            match, err := marketflow.MatchOrders(&buy, &sell)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            matchID, err := applicationNewID(
                txctx,
                s.IDs,
                "match",
            )
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            record := MatchRecord{
                ID:          matchID,
                MarketID:    buy.MarketID,
                OfferID:     buy.OfferID,
                BuyOrderID:  match.BuyOrderID,
                SellOrderID: match.SellOrderID,
                BuyerID:     buy.UserID,
                SellerID:    sell.UserID,
                Quantity:    match.Quantity,
                Price:       match.Price,
                CreatedAt:   now,
            }

            if record.Quantity <= 0 ||
                record.Price <= 0 ||
                record.BuyOrderID != buy.ID ||
                record.SellOrderID != sell.ID ||
                record.BuyerID == record.SellerID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
                txctx,
                buy,
                originalBuyVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveOrder(
                txctx,
                sell,
                originalSellVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Book.SaveMatch(
                txctx,
                record,
                "match:"+string(matchID),
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = record
            return nil
        },
    )

    if errors.Is(err, ErrNoCrossingOrders) {
        return MatchRecord{}, ErrNoCrossingOrders
    }

    return result, err
}

func (s *TradeWorkflowService) UpdateStatus(
    ctx context.Context,
    cmd TradeStatusCommand,
) (marketflow.Trade, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Trades == nil ||
        s.Clock == nil {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if cmd.ExpectedVersion == 0 ||
        strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" {
        return marketflow.Trade{}, marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    var result marketflow.Trade

    err := s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            trade, err := s.Trades.GetForUpdate(
                txctx,
                cmd.TradeID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if trade.ID != cmd.TradeID {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            var currentValue string

            switch cmd.Dimension {
            case DimensionContract:
                currentValue = string(trade.Contract)

            case DimensionServices:
                currentValue = string(trade.Services)

            case DimensionDelivery:
                currentValue = string(trade.Delivery)

            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

            // A repeated command that has already achieved its desired
            // state is a successful no-op, even if its original version
            // is now stale.
            if currentValue == cmd.Value {
                result = trade
                return nil
            }

            if trade.Version != cmd.ExpectedVersion {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            switch cmd.Dimension {
            case DimensionContract:
                value := marketflow.ContractState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.ContractPending,
                    marketflow.ContractCreated,
                    marketflow.ContractFailed,
                    marketflow.ContractNotRequired:
                    trade.Contract = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            case DimensionServices:
                value := marketflow.ServiceState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.ServicePending,
                    marketflow.ServiceInProgress,
                    marketflow.ServiceCompleted,
                    marketflow.ServiceFailed,
                    marketflow.ServiceNotRequired:
                    trade.Services = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            case DimensionDelivery:
                value := marketflow.DeliveryState(cmd.Value)

                switch value {
                case marketflow.DeliveryPending,
                    marketflow.DeliveryConfirmed,
                    marketflow.DeliveryFailed,
                    marketflow.DeliveryNotRequired:
                    trade.Delivery = value

                default:
                    return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
                }

            default:
                return ErrInvalidTradeDimension
            }

            if trade.Version == ^uint64(0) {
                return ErrRevisionOverflow
            }

            now, err := applicationNowUTC(s.Clock)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if now.Before(trade.UpdatedAt) {
                return ErrInvalidClock
            }

            trade.RecalculateSettlementReadiness()
            trade.Version++
            trade.UpdatedAt = now

            if err := trade.Validate(); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if err := s.Trades.Save(
                txctx,
                trade,
                cmd.ExpectedVersion,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            result = trade
            return nil
        },
    )

    return result, err
}
'@

func ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy) error {
    if err := policy.Validate(); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    steps := make(map[string]marketflow.ExecutionStep, len(policy.Steps))
    orders := make(map[int]bool, len(policy.Steps))
    codes := make([]string, 0, len(policy.Steps))

    for _, step := range policy.Steps {
        if strings.TrimSpace(step.Code) != step.Code ||
            step.Code == "" {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        if orders[step.Order] {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        if _, exists := steps[step.Code]; exists {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        orders[step.Order] = true
        steps[step.Code] = step
        codes = append(codes, step.Code)
    }

    // A dependency may appear only once in a step.
    // Every dependency must precede the dependent step.
    for _, step := range policy.Steps {
        dependencies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(step.DependsOn))

        for _, dependency := range step.DependsOn {
            if _, duplicate := dependencies[dependency]; duplicate {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }

            dependencies[dependency] = struct{}{}

            dependencyStep, exists := steps[dependency]

            if !exists ||
                dependency == step.Code ||
                dependencyStep.Order >= step.Order {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }
        }
    }

    // Deterministic traversal makes failures reproducible.
    sort.Strings(codes)

    state := make(map[string]uint8, len(steps))

    var visit func(string) error

    visit = func(code string) error {
        switch state[code] {
        case 1:
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph

        case 2:
            return nil
        }

        step, exists := steps[code]
        if !exists {
            return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
        }

        state[code] = 1

        dependencies := append([]string(nil), step.DependsOn...)
        sort.Strings(dependencies)

        for _, dependency := range dependencies {
            if _, exists := steps[dependency]; !exists {
                return ErrInvalidPolicyGraph
            }

            if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
                return err
            }
        }

        state[code] = 2
        return nil
    }

    for _, code := range codes {
        if err := visit(code); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }

    return nil
}
'@

    $services = Replace-GoSection `
        -Source $services `
        -StartMarker "func ValidateExecutionPolicy(" `
        -EndMarker "type CompleteExecutionStepCommand struct" `
        -Replacement $replacement `
        -Label "ValidateExecutionPolicy"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 16. EXECUTION PROGRESS

func (s *ExecutionProgressService) CompleteStep(
    ctx context.Context,
    policy marketflow.ExecutionPolicy,
    cmd CompleteExecutionStepCommand,
) error {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    if s == nil ||
        s.Transactions == nil ||
        s.Progress == nil {
        return ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(cmd.TradeID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(cmd.StepCode) == "" ||
        cmd.ExpectedRevision == 0 {
        return marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if !policy.Active {
        return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
    }

    if err := ValidateExecutionPolicy(policy); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    return s.Transactions.WithinTransaction(
        ctx,
        func(txctx context.Context) error {
            if err := validateApplicationContext(txctx); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            progress, revision, err := s.Progress.GetForUpdate(
                txctx,
                cmd.TradeID,
            )

            if err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if progress.TradeID != cmd.TradeID {
                return marketflow.ErrNotEligible
            }

            if progress.PolicyID != policy.ID ||
                progress.PolicyVersion != policy.Version {
                return marketflow.ErrConflict
            }

            if revision == 0 {
                return ErrRepositoryContractViolation
            }

            stepExists := false

            for _, step := range policy.Steps {
                if step.Code == cmd.StepCode {
                    stepExists = true
                    break
                }
            }

            if !stepExists {
                return marketflow.ErrNotFound
            }

            // Natural idempotency:
            // completing an already-completed step is a no-op.
            // This check intentionally precedes the revision comparison.
            if progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] {
                return nil
            }

            if revision != cmd.ExpectedRevision {
                return ErrVersionConflict
            }

            if err := progress.CanComplete(
                policy,
                cmd.StepCode,
            ); err != nil {
                return err
            }

            if progress.CompletedSteps == nil {
                progress.CompletedSteps = make(map[string]bool)
            }

            progress.CompletedSteps[cmd.StepCode] = true

            return s.Progress.Save(
                txctx,
                progress,
                revision,
            )
        },
    )
}
'@

        -EndMarker "// Overflow-safe aggregation." `
        -Replacement $replacement `

func (s *LegalRequestService) Submit(
    ctx context.Context,
    actorID marketflow.ID,
    request marketflow.ExternalRequest,
    grantedScopes []string,
) (string, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        actorID,
        "legal.external.submit",
    ); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := request.ValidateAuthorization(grantedScopes); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    trackingID, err := s.Gateway.SubmitAuthorizedRequest(
        ctx,
        request,
    )

    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
        return "", ErrExternalOutcomeUnknown
    }

    return trackingID, nil
}

// GetRequestResult retrieves a previously submitted request using the
// external tracking identifier. It does not create or resubmit a request.
func (s *LegalRequestService) GetRequestResult(
    ctx context.Context,
    actorID marketflow.ID,
    trackingID string,
) (string, error) {
    if err := validateApplicationContext(ctx); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if s == nil || s.Identity == nil || s.Gateway == nil {
        return "", ErrDependencyMissing
    }

    if strings.TrimSpace(string(actorID)) == "" ||
        strings.TrimSpace(trackingID) == "" {
        return "", marketflow.ErrInvalidInput
    }

    if err := s.Identity.VerifyIdentity(ctx, actorID); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    if err := s.Identity.Authorize(
        ctx,
        actorID,
        "legal.external.read",
    ); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    return s.Gateway.GetRequestResult(ctx, trackingID)
}

package application

import (
    "context"
    "errors"

// APPLICATION_PACKAGE_01_HARDENING_V1

type package01Transaction struct {
    afterCallbackError error
    calls              int
}

func (f *package01Transaction) WithinTransaction(
    ctx context.Context,
    callback func(context.Context) error,
) error {
    f.calls++

    if err := callback(ctx); err != nil {
        return err
    }

    return f.afterCallbackError
}

type package01Clock struct {
    now time.Time
}

func (f package01Clock) Now() time.Time {
    return f.now
}

type package01IDs struct{}

func (package01IDs) NewID(
    _ context.Context,
    namespace string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    return marketflow.ID(namespace + "-test-id"), nil
}

type package01Identity struct {
    verifyError    error
    authorizeError error
}

func (f package01Identity) VerifyIdentity(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
) error {
    return f.verifyError
}

func (f package01Identity) Authorize(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ string,
) error {
    return f.authorizeError
}

type package01Audit struct {
    events []marketflow.AuditEvent
    err    error
}

func (f *package01Audit) Append(
    _ context.Context,
    event marketflow.AuditEvent,
) error {
    if f.err != nil {
        return f.err
    }

    f.events = append(f.events, event)
    return nil
}

func (f *package01Audit) ListByAggregate(
    _ context.Context,
    _ string,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ int,
) ([]marketflow.AuditEvent, error) {
    return append([]marketflow.AuditEvent(nil), f.events...), nil
}

type package01OrderValidator struct {
    err   error
    calls int
}

func (f *package01OrderValidator) ValidateOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.Order,
) error {
    f.calls++
    return f.err
}

type package01Resources struct {
    reservationID marketflow.ID
    reserveError  error
    releaseError  error
    reserveCalls  int
    releaseCalls  int
}

func (f *package01Resources) ReserveForOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.Order,
    _ int64,
    _ string,
) (marketflow.ID, error) {
    f.reserveCalls++

    if f.reserveError != nil {
        return "", f.reserveError
    }

    return f.reservationID, nil
}

func (f *package01Resources) ReleaseOrderResources(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
    _ string,
) error {
    f.releaseCalls++
    return f.releaseError
}

type package01OrderRepository struct {
    orders     map[string]marketflow.Order
    getCalls   int
    getErrors  map[int]error
    createErr  error
    createCall int
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) GetByIdempotencyKey(
    _ context.Context,
    key string,
) (marketflow.Order, bool, error) {
    f.getCalls++

    if err := f.getErrors[f.getCalls]; err != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, false, err
    }

    order, found := f.orders[key]
    return order, found, nil
}

func (f *package01OrderRepository) CreateOrder(
    _ context.Context,
    order marketflow.Order,
    key string,
    _ marketflow.ID,
) (marketflow.Order, error) {
    f.createCall++

    if f.createErr != nil {
        return marketflow.Order{}, f.createErr
    }

    if _, exists := f.orders[key]; exists {
        return marketflow.Order{}, ErrIdempotencyConflict
    }

    if f.orders == nil {
        f.orders = make(map[string]marketflow.Order)
    }

    f.orders[key] = order
    return order, nil
}

    return time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func TestPackage01PlaceOrderReplaysExistingOrderWithoutReservation(t *testing.T) {
    order := package01Order()
    order.State = marketflow.OrderOpen
    order.Version = 2

    repo := &package01OrderRepository{
        orders: map[string]marketflow.Order{
            "order-idempotency-1": order,
        },
        getErrors: make(map[int]error),
    }

    resources := &package01Resources{
        reservationID: "reservation-1",
    }

    tx := &package01Transaction{}
    service := package01OrderService(tx, repo, resources)

    result, err := service.Place(
        context.Background(),
        package01PlaceCommand(package01Order()),
    )

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    if result.ID != order.ID {
        t.Fatalf("expected existing order %s, got %s", order.ID, result.ID)
    }

    if resources.reserveCalls != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("reservation must not be repeated; calls=%d", resources.reserveCalls)
    }

    if tx.calls != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("transaction must not run for a completed replay; calls=%d", tx.calls)
    }
}

func TestPackage01PlaceOrderCompensatesOnlyAfterConfirmedAbsence(t *testing.T) {
    createError := errors.New("order insert failed")

    repo := &package01OrderRepository{
        orders:    make(map[string]marketflow.Order),
        getErrors: make(map[int]error),
        createErr: createError,
    }

    resources := &package01Resources{
        reservationID: "reservation-1",
    }

    tx := &package01Transaction{}
    service := package01OrderService(tx, repo, resources)

    _, err := service.Place(
        context.Background(),
        package01PlaceCommand(package01Order()),
    )

    if !errors.Is(err, createError) {
        t.Fatalf("expected original create error, got %v", err)
    }

    if resources.reserveCalls != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("expected one reservation, got %d", resources.reserveCalls)
    }

    if resources.releaseCalls != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("expected one compensation, got %d", resources.releaseCalls)
    }
}

func TestPackage01MatchingRejectsPairOutsideRequestedMarket(t *testing.T) {
    buy := package01OpenOrder("buy-1", marketflow.Buy, 110)
    sell := package01OpenOrder("sell-1", marketflow.Sell, 100)

    buy.MarketID = "another-market"
    sell.MarketID = "another-market"

    book := &package01Book{
        buy:  buy,
        sell: sell,
    }

    service := &MatchingService{
        Transactions: &package01Transaction{},
        Book:         book,
        IDs:          package01IDs{},
        Clock:        package01Clock{now: package01Now()},
    }

    _, err := service.MatchNext(
        context.Background(),
        "market-1",
        "offer-1",
    )

    if !errors.Is(err, ErrRepositoryContractViolation) {
        t.Fatalf("expected repository contract violation, got %v", err)
    }

    if book.saveOrders != 0 || book.saveMatches != 0 {
        t.Fatal("invalid repository pair must not be persisted")
    }
}

type package01ProgressRepository struct {
    progress  marketflow.ExecutionProgress
    revision  uint64
    saveCalls int
}

func (f *package01ProgressRepository) GetForUpdate(
    _ context.Context,
    _ marketflow.ID,
) (marketflow.ExecutionProgress, uint64, error) {
    return f.progress, f.revision, nil
}

func (f *package01ProgressRepository) Save(
    _ context.Context,
    progress marketflow.ExecutionProgress,
    expected uint64,
) error {
    if expected != f.revision {
        return ErrVersionConflict
    }

    f.saveCalls++
    f.progress = progress
    f.revision++
    return nil
}

func TestPackage01ExecutionProgressIdempotentReplayPrecedesRevisionCheck(t *testing.T) {
    repo := &package01ProgressRepository{
        progress: marketflow.ExecutionProgress{
            TradeID:       "trade-1",
            PolicyID:      "policy-1",
            PolicyVersion: 1,
            CompletedSteps: map[string]bool{
                "delivery": true,
            },
        },
        revision: 5,
    }

    service := &ExecutionProgressService{
        Transactions: &package01Transaction{},
        Progress:     repo,
    }

    err := service.CompleteStep(
        context.Background(),
        package01Policy(),
        CompleteExecutionStepCommand{
            TradeID:          "trade-1",
            StepCode:         "delivery",
            ExpectedRevision: 4,
        },
    )

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("completed step replay should succeed: %v", err)
    }

    if repo.saveCalls != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("completed step replay must not write again")
    }
}

        trade: package01Trade(),
    }

    service := &TradeWorkflowService{
        Transactions: &package01Transaction{},
        Trades:       repo,
        Clock:        package01Clock{now: package01Now()},
    }

    result, err := service.UpdateStatus(
        context.Background(),
        TradeStatusCommand{
            TradeID:         "trade-1",
            ExpectedVersion: 2,
            Dimension:       DimensionContract,
            Value:           string(marketflow.ContractCreated),
        },
    )

    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    if result.Version != 3 {
        t.Fatalf("idempotent update changed version: %d", result.Version)
    }

    if repo.saveCalls != 0 {
        t.Fatal("same-value update must not write")
    }
}

# IgdFront

This project was generated using [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 22.2.6.

## Development server

To start a local development server, run:

```bash
ng serve
```

Once the server is running, open your browser and navigate to `http://localhost:4200/`. The application will automatically reload whenever you modify any of the source files.

## Code scaffolding

Angular CLI includes powerful code scaffolding tools. To generate a new component, run:

```bash
ng generate component component-name
```

For a complete list of available schematics (such as `components`, `directives`, or `pipes`), run:

```bash
ng generate --help
```

## Building

To build the project run:

```bash
ng build
```

This will compile your project and store the build artifacts in the `dist/` directory. By default, the production build optimizes your application for performance and speed.

## Running unit tests

To execute unit tests with the [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) test runner, use the following command:

```bash
ng test
```

## Running end-to-end tests

For end-to-end (e2e) testing, run:

```bash
ng e2e
```

Angular CLI does not come with an end-to-end testing framework by default. You can choose one that suits your needs.

## Additional Resources

For more information on using the Angular CLI, including detailed command references, visit the [Angular CLI Overview and Command Reference](https://angular.dev/tools/cli) page.

import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { MatButtonModule } from '@angular/material/button';
import { MatIconModule } from '@angular/material/icon';
import { MatTabsModule } from '@angular/material/tabs';
import { MatDividerModule } from '@angular/material/divider';

@Component({
  selector: 'igd-general-market',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    MatButtonModule,
    MatIconModule,
    MatTabsModule,
    MatDividerModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './general-market.html',
  styleUrl: './general-market.css',
})
export class GeneralMarketPage {
  orderBookCollapsed = false;
  detailsCollapsed = false;

  activeTool = 'market';

  toggleOrderBook(): void {
    this.orderBookCollapsed = !this.orderBookCollapsed;
  }

  toggleDetails(): void {
    this.detailsCollapsed = !this.detailsCollapsed;
  }

  selectTool(tool: string): void {
    this.activeTool = tool;
  }
}

import type { Route } from '@angular/router';

export function featurePageRoute(
  path: string,
  heading: string,
  description: string,
): Route {
  return {
    path,
    title: `${heading} | IGD`,
    data: {
      heading,
      description,
    },
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('../pages/feature-placeholder/feature-placeholder.page').then(
        (module) => module.FeaturePlaceholderPage,
      ),
  };
}

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$InstallRoot = 'D:\Program Files\IGD-Frontend'

$NodeExe = Join-Path $InstallRoot `
    'Runtimes\NodeJS\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe'

$NgJs = Join-Path $InstallRoot `
    'Libraries\IGD-Frontend\node_modules\@angular\cli\bin\ng.js'

$AppRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'app'

$env:TEMP = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'PackageCaches\temp'
$env:TMP = $env:TEMP
$env:NPM_CONFIG_CACHE = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'PackageCaches\npm'
$env:NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY = 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $NodeExe -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Node.js installation was not found.'
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $NgJs -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Workspace Angular CLI installation was not found.'
}

Push-Location $AppRoot

try {
    & $NodeExe $NgJs build

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw 'Angular production build failed.'
    }
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$HostAddress = '127.0.0.1',
    [int]$Port = 4200
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$InstallRoot = 'D:\Program Files\IGD-Frontend'

$NodeExe = Join-Path $InstallRoot `
    'Runtimes\NodeJS\node-v24.15.0-win-x64\node.exe'

$NgJs = Join-Path $InstallRoot `
    'Libraries\IGD-Frontend\node_modules\@angular\cli\bin\ng.js'

$AppRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'app'

$env:TEMP = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'PackageCaches\temp'
$env:TMP = $env:TEMP
$env:NPM_CONFIG_CACHE = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'PackageCaches\npm'
$env:NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY = 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $NodeExe -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Node.js installation was not found.'
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $NgJs -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Workspace Angular CLI installation was not found.'
}

Push-Location $AppRoot

try {
    & $NodeExe $NgJs serve --host $HostAddress --port $Port

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw 'Angular development server failed.'
    }
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}

import { MatDividerModule } from '@angular/material/divider';

@Component({
  selector: 'igd-general-market',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    MatButtonModule,
    MatIconModule,
    MatTabsModule,
    MatDividerModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './general-market.html',
  styleUrl: './general-market.css',
})
export class GeneralMarketPage {
  orderBookCollapsed = false;
  detailsCollapsed = false;

  activeTool = 'market';

    this.orderBookCollapsed = !this.orderBookCollapsed;
  }

  toggleDetails(): void {
    this.detailsCollapsed = !this.detailsCollapsed;
  }

  selectTool(tool: string): void {
    this.activeTool = tool;
  }
}

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT users_user_type_check
        CHECK (user_type IN ('individual', 'legal')),

    CONSTRAINT users_status_check
        CHECK (status IN (
            'active',
            'limited',
            'suspended',
            'blocked',
            'closed'
        ))
);

FILE: account-backend\migrations\006_create_verifications.sql
SIZE: 1850 bytes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    verification_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',

    reference_id VARCHAR(255),

    verification_level VARCHAR(30),

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    rejection_reason TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_type_check
        CHECK (
            verification_type IN (
                'identity',
                'contact',
                'bank',
                'document',
                'biometric',
                'legal_entity',
                'official_document'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_status_check
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'verified',
                'rejected',
                'failed',
                'expired',
                'manual_review'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT verifications_level_check
        CHECK (
            verification_level IS NULL
            OR verification_level IN (
                'basic',
                'standard',
                'strong'
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_id
    ON verifications(user_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_user_type
    ON verifications(user_id, verification_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_status
    ON verifications(status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_verifications_reference_id
    ON verifications(reference_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,

    role_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    default_scope_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    description TEXT,

    is_system_role BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_roles_role_type_check
        CHECK (
            role_type IN (
                'management',
                'operational',
                'base',
                'specialized',
                'general',
                'supervisory'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_roles_scope_type_check
        CHECK (
            default_scope_type IN (
                'global',
                'self',
                'organization',
                'project',
                'asset',
                'contract',
                'custom'
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_roles_role_type
    ON authorization_roles(role_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_roles_scope_type
    ON authorization_roles(default_scope_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_roles_active
    ON authorization_roles(is_active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_permissions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    code VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    resource VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,

    description TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_permissions_resource_action_unique
        UNIQUE (resource, action)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_permissions_resource
    ON authorization_permissions(resource);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_permissions_action
    ON authorization_permissions(action);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_permissions_active
    ON authorization_permissions(is_active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_role_permissions (
    role_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_roles(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    permission_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES authorization_permissions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_role_permissions_permission
    ON authorization_role_permissions(permission_id);

-- Seed: User Role
-- ============================================================

INSERT INTO authorization_role_permissions (role_id, permission_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_user_roles (

        ON DELETE CASCADE,

        REFERENCES users(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_user_roles_dates_check
        CHECK (
            expires_at IS NULL
            OR expires_at > starts_at
        )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_scopes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    scope_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    resource_type VARCHAR(100),

    resource_id UUID,

    parent_scope_id UUID
        REFERENCES authorization_scopes(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    name VARCHAR(200),

    description TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_scope_type_check
        CHECK (
            scope_type IN (
                'global',
                'organization',
                'project',
                'asset',
                'contract',
                'self',
                'custom'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT authorization_scopes_resource_pair_check
        CHECK (
            (
                scope_type IN ('global', 'self')
                AND resource_type IS NULL
                AND resource_id IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                scope_type IN (
                    'organization',
                    'project',
                    'asset',
                    'contract',
                    'custom'
                )
            )
        )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_scope_type
    ON authorization_scopes(scope_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_resource
    ON authorization_scopes(resource_type, resource_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_parent
    ON authorization_scopes(parent_scope_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authorization_scopes_active
    ON authorization_scopes(is_active);

    ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- General Market Backend
-- Migration: 000002_market_domain_foundation.sql
-- Additive, versioned and non-destructive.
--
-- Ownership boundaries:
-- * No account credentials or authoritative role database.
-- * No free-balance ledger or authoritative reservation ledger.
-- * No official property ownership register.
-- * No legal contract body owned by Contracts service.
-- * No service-delivery records owned by Services.
-- * No final settlement ledger owned by Settlement.
--
-- External identifiers are stored as references, not copied records.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS markets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    allowed_trade_methods JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    display_rules JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'paused', 'closed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_categories (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    parent_id UUID REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS specialized_classifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    domain_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS category_mappings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    public_category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    specialized_classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    market_id UUID REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (public_category_id, specialized_classification_id, market_id),
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameter_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    data_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    unit_code VARCHAR(60),
    is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    validation_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (classification_id, code, version),
    CHECK (data_type IN ('string', 'integer', 'decimal', 'boolean', 'date', 'datetime', 'enum', 'object', 'array')),
    CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_configurations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    current_version INTEGER,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'retired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_config_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    configuration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offer_configurations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    rules_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    calculation_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    qualification_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    document_schema JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_by_user_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (configuration_id, version),
    CHECK (version > 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved', 'published', 'retired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_config_parameters (
    configuration_version_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offer_config_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    parameter_definition_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES parameter_definitions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    is_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    overrides JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    PRIMARY KEY (configuration_version_id, parameter_definition_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offer_rules (

    CHECK (status IN ('required', 'submitted', 'verified', 'rejected', 'expired'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_qualifications (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    public_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    market_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES markets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    public_category_id UUID REFERENCES public_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    classification_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES specialized_classifications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    owner_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,
    offer_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sale',
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    quantity_total NUMERIC(24,8),
    quantity_unit VARCHAR(60),
    attributes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,

    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'pending_review', 'approved', 'published', 'suspended', 'rejected', 'expired', 'closed')),
    CHECK (offer_type IN ('sale', 'purchase', 'service', 'physical_commodity', 'real_asset')),
    CHECK (price_amount IS NULL OR price_amount >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_total IS NULL OR quantity_total >= 0),
    CHECK (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from)
);

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    participant_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
    order_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'limit',
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_checks',
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8),
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    quantity_original NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    quantity_remaining NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    quantity_filled NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    external_reservation_ref VARCHAR(240),
    idempotency_key VARCHAR(160),
    correlation_id VARCHAR(160),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK (side IN ('buy', 'sell')),
    CHECK (order_type IN ('limit', 'market', 'offer_directed')),
    CHECK (status IN ('pending_checks', 'pending_reservation', 'open', 'partially_filled', 'filled', 'cancelled', 'rejected', 'expired', 'failed')),
    CHECK (quantity_original > 0),
    CHECK (quantity_remaining >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_filled >= 0),
    CHECK (quantity_remaining + quantity_filled = quantity_original),
    CHECK (price_amount IS NULL OR price_amount >= 0),
    UNIQUE (participant_ref, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_matches (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    buy_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    sell_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    matched_price NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (buy_order_id <> sell_order_id),
    CHECK (matched_quantity > 0),
    CHECK (matched_price >= 0),
    CHECK (status IN ('recorded', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'trade_created', 'failed'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    trade_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    match_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES order_matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    offer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES offers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    buy_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    sell_order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    buyer_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    seller_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    quantity NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    price_amount NUMERIC(24,8) NOT NULL,
    currency_code VARCHAR(12),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
    execution_policy_version_id UUID,

FILE: migrations\000003_integrity_hardening.sql
==========================================================================================
-- General Market migration 000003.
-- Integrity hardening. Additive and transactional.
-- This file must never replace or modify an earlier migration.

-- 1. Specialized classification versioning.
ALTER TABLE specialized_classifications
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS specialized_classifications_code_key;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_specialized_classifications_code_version
    ON specialized_classifications (code, version);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_specialized_classifications_one_active_code
    ON specialized_classifications (code)
    WHERE is_active = TRUE;

-- 2. Global category mappings.
-- The original UNIQUE constraint already protects non-NULL market_id rows.
-- This partial index closes PostgreSQL's NULL uniqueness gap.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_category_mappings_global
    ON category_mappings (public_category_id, specialized_classification_id)
    WHERE market_id IS NULL;

-- 3. Store the offer identity on each match.
ALTER TABLE order_matches
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS offer_id UUID;

UPDATE order_matches AS om
SET offer_id = buy_order.offer_id
FROM orders AS buy_order
WHERE om.buy_order_id = buy_order.id
  AND om.offer_id IS NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM order_matches AS om
        JOIN orders AS buy_order ON buy_order.id = om.buy_order_id
        JOIN orders AS sell_order ON sell_order.id = om.sell_order_id
        WHERE buy_order.offer_id <> sell_order.offer_id
           OR om.offer_id IS NULL
           OR om.offer_id <> buy_order.offer_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Migration 000003 stopped: an order match references inconsistent offers';
    END IF;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE order_matches
    ALTER COLUMN offer_id SET NOT NULL;

-- 4. Composite unique keys used by referential integrity constraints.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_orders_id_offer_id
    ON orders (id, offer_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_order_matches_identity
    ON order_matches (id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id);

-- 5. Each side of a match must belong to the same offer recorded by the match.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'order_matches'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_match_buy_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE order_matches
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_match_buy_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (buy_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'order_matches'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_match_sell_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE order_matches
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_match_sell_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;
END
$$;

-- 6. A trade must reference the exact match and exact two orders.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_match_order_pair'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_match_order_pair
            FOREIGN KEY (match_id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES order_matches (id, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_buy_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_buy_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (buy_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conrelid = 'trades'::regclass
          AND conname = 'fk_trade_sell_order_offer'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE trades
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_trade_sell_order_offer
            FOREIGN KEY (sell_order_id, offer_id)
            REFERENCES orders (id, offer_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT;
    END IF;
END
$$;

package database

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
)

type Config struct {
	URL             string
	MaxOpenConns    int
	MaxIdleConns    int
	ConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*sql.DB, error) {
	if cfg.URL == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("pgx", cfg.URL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open database: %w", err)
	}

	if cfg.MaxOpenConns > 0 {
		db.SetMaxOpenConns(cfg.MaxOpenConns)
	}
	if cfg.MaxIdleConns >= 0 {
		db.SetMaxIdleConns(cfg.MaxIdleConns)
	}
	if cfg.ConnMaxLifetime > 0 {
		db.SetConnMaxLifetime(cfg.ConnMaxLifetime)
	}

	pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := db.PingContext(pingCtx); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to database: %w", err)
	}

	return db, nil
}


==========================================================================================
FILE: internal\database\migrate.go

package database

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/migrations"
)

const migrationLockID int64 = 5270645408566230100

func Migrate(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	if db == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("database is not configured")
	}

	conn, err := db.Conn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration connection: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()

	if _, err := conn.ExecContext(
		ctx,
		"SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)",
		migrationLockID,
	); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("acquire migration advisory lock: %w", err)
	}

	defer func() {
		unlockCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = conn.ExecContext(
			unlockCtx,
			"SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)",
			migrationLockID,
		)
	}()

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
			version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			checksum TEXT,
			applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
		)
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("initialize migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	_, err = conn.ExecContext(ctx, `
		ALTER TABLE schema_migrations
		ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS checksum TEXT
	`)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("upgrade migration tracking: %w", err)
	}

	files, err := fs.Glob(migrations.Files, "*.sql")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list migration files: %w", err)
	}
	sort.Strings(files)

	for _, file := range files {
		if strings.Contains(file, "..") {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid migration path: %s", file)
		}

		content, err := migrations.Files.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", file, err)
		}

		version := strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".sql")
		sum := sha256.Sum256(content)
		checksum := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])

		var stored sql.NullString
		err = conn.QueryRowContext(
			ctx,
			`SELECT checksum FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1`,
			version,
		).Scan(&stored)

		if err == nil {
			if !stored.Valid || stored.String == "" {
				// Existing installations created before checksum support:
				// adopt the currently deployed migration as the baseline.
				_, err = conn.ExecContext(
					ctx,
					`UPDATE schema_migrations
					 SET checksum = $1
					 WHERE version = $2 AND checksum IS NULL`,
					checksum,
					version,
				)
				if err != nil {
					return fmt.Errorf("adopt legacy checksum for %s: %w", version, err)
				}
				continue
			}

			if stored.String != checksum {
				return fmt.Errorf(
					"migration checksum mismatch for %s: applied migration file was modified; restore the original file or create a new migration",
					version,
				)
			}
			continue
		}

		if err != sql.ErrNoRows {
			return fmt.Errorf("check migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		tx, err := conn.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if _, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, string(content)); err == nil {
			_, err = tx.ExecContext(
				ctx,
				`INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, checksum)
				 VALUES ($1, $2)`,
				version,
				checksum,
			)
		}

		if err != nil {
			_ = tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("apply migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}

		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit migration %s: %w", version, err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/config"
	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/database"
)

func main() {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("invalid configuration: %v", err)
	}

	if cfg.DatabaseURL == "" {
		log.Fatal("DATABASE_URL is required for migration execution")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	db, err := database.Open(ctx, database.Config{
		URL:             cfg.DatabaseURL,
		MaxOpenConns:    cfg.DBMaxOpenConns,
		MaxIdleConns:    cfg.DBMaxIdleConns,
		ConnMaxLifetime: cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime,
	})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("database connection failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	if err := database.Migrate(ctx, db); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("migration failed: %v", err)
	}

	log.Print("Database migrations completed successfully.")
	os.Exit(0)
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/config"
	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/database"
	"github.com/igd-tesa/real-asset-management-platform/general-market-backend/internal/httpapi"
)

func main() {
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil))
	slog.SetDefault(logger)

	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		logger.Error("invalid configuration", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	startupCtx, startupCancel := context.WithTimeout(
		context.Background(), 10*time.Second,
	)

	db, err := database.Open(startupCtx, database.Config{
		URL:             cfg.DatabaseURL,
		MaxOpenConns:    cfg.DBMaxOpenConns,
		MaxIdleConns:    cfg.DBMaxIdleConns,
		ConnMaxLifetime: cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime,
	})
	startupCancel()

	if err != nil {
		logger.Error("database initialization failed", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	if db != nil {
		defer db.Close()
	}

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:              cfg.HTTPAddr,
		Handler:           httpapi.New(db),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:       60 * time.Second,
	}

	serverErrors := make(chan error, 1)

	go func() {
		logger.Info("HTTP server starting", "address", cfg.HTTPAddr)
		serverErrors <- server.ListenAndServe()
	}()

	signalCtx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(
		context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM,
	)
	defer stop()

	select {
	case err := <-serverErrors:
		if !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			logger.Error("HTTP server stopped unexpectedly", "error", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}

	case <-signalCtx.Done():
		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(
			context.Background(), 10*time.Second,
		)
		defer cancel()

		if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
			logger.Error("graceful shutdown failed", "error", err)
			_ = server.Close()
		}
	}
}

FILE: config\config.go

package config

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

type Config struct {
	HTTPAddr          string
	DatabaseURL       string
	DBMaxOpenConns    int
	DBMaxIdleConns    int
	DBConnMaxLifetime time.Duration
}

func Load() (Config, error) {
	cfg := Config{
		HTTPAddr:          env("HTTP_ADDR", ":8080"),
		DatabaseURL:       os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"),
		DBMaxOpenConns:    10,
		DBMaxIdleConns:    5,
		DBConnMaxLifetime: 5 * time.Minute,
	}

	var err error

	cfg.DBMaxOpenConns, err = intEnv("DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS", 10)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}

	cfg.DBMaxIdleConns, err = intEnv("DB_MAX_IDLE_CONNS", 5)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}

	if cfg.DBMaxOpenConns < 1 ||
		cfg.DBMaxIdleConns < 0 ||
		cfg.DBMaxIdleConns > cfg.DBMaxOpenConns {
		return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid database connection pool settings")
	}

	if value := os.Getenv("DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME"); value != "" {
		cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime, err = time.ParseDuration(value)
		if err != nil || cfg.DBConnMaxLifetime <= 0 {
			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME")
		}
	}

	return cfg, nil
}

func env(key, fallback string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return fallback
}

func intEnv(key string, fallback int) (int, error) {
	value := os.Getenv(key)
	if value == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}

	n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s: %w", key, err)
	}

	return n, nil
}

package catalogue

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	defaultPageSize = 20
	maxPageSize     = 100
	maxSearchLength = 120
)

type Handler struct {
	DB *sql.DB
}

type OfferSummary struct {
	ID                 string          `json:"id"`
	Code               string          `json:"code"`
	MarketID           string          `json:"market_id"`
	MarketName         string          `json:"market_name"`
	PublicCategoryID   string          `json:"public_category_id,omitempty"`
	PublicCategoryName string          `json:"public_category_name,omitempty"`
	ClassificationID   string          `json:"classification_id"`
	Title              string          `json:"title"`
	Summary            string          `json:"summary,omitempty"`
	OfferType          string          `json:"offer_type"`
	PriceAmount        string          `json:"price_amount,omitempty"`
	CurrencyCode       string          `json:"currency_code,omitempty"`
	QuantityTotal      string          `json:"quantity_total,omitempty"`
	QuantityUnit       string          `json:"quantity_unit,omitempty"`
	Attributes         json.RawMessage `json:"attributes"`
	PublishedAt        time.Time       `json:"published_at"`
	ValidUntil         *time.Time      `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
}

type ListResponse struct {
	Data       []OfferSummary `json:"data"`
	Page       int            `json:"page"`
	PageSize   int            `json:"page_size"`
	Total      int64          `json:"total"`
	TotalPages int64          `json:"total_pages"`
}

type APIError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func (h Handler) Register(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers", h.ListOffers)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/catalogue/offers/{id}", h.GetOffer)
}

func (h Handler) ListOffers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page"), 1, 1000000)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page", "page must be a positive integer.")
		return
	}

	pageSize, err := parsePositiveInt(r.URL.Query().Get("page_size"), defaultPageSize, maxPageSize)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_page_size", "page_size must be between 1 and 100.")
		return
	}

	search := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	if len(search) > maxSearchLength {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "search_too_long", "q must not exceed 120 characters.")
		return
	}

	categoryID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("category_id"))
	marketID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("market_id"))

	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	const filter = `
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
		  AND ($1 = '' OR o.title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(o.summary, '') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
		  AND ($2 = '' OR o.public_category_id::text = $2)
		  AND ($3 = '' OR o.market_id::text = $3)
	`

	var total int64
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) " + filter
	if err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), countQuery, search, categoryID, marketID).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
	const listSelect = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
	`
	rows, err := h.DB.QueryContext(
		r.Context(),
		listSelect+filter+`
			ORDER BY o.published_at DESC, o.id DESC
			LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
		`,
		search, categoryID, marketID, pageSize, offset,
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The catalogue could not be loaded.")
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	data := make([]OfferSummary, 0, pageSize)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item OfferSummary
		var categoryIDValue string
		var categoryName string
		var validUntil sql.NullTime
		var attributes []byte

		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.Code,
			&item.MarketID,
			&item.MarketName,
			&categoryIDValue,
			&categoryName,
			&item.ClassificationID,
			&item.Title,
			&item.Summary,
			&item.OfferType,
			&item.PriceAmount,
			&item.CurrencyCode,
			&item.QuantityTotal,
			&item.QuantityUnit,
			&attributes,
			&item.PublishedAt,
			&validUntil,
		); err != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_scan_failed", "A catalogue record could not be read.")
			return
		}

		item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
		item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
		if validUntil.Valid {
			value := validUntil.Time
			item.ValidUntil = &value
		}
		if len(attributes) == 0 {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
		} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
			item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
		} else {
			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "A catalogue record contains invalid attributes.")
			return
		}
		data = append(data, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_read_failed", "The catalogue could not be read completely.")
		return
	}

	totalPages := int64(0)
	if total > 0 {
		totalPages = (total + int64(pageSize) - 1) / int64(pageSize)
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, ListResponse{
		Data:       data,
		Page:       page,
		PageSize:   pageSize,
		Total:      total,
		TotalPages: totalPages,
	})
}

func (h Handler) GetOffer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.DB == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "database_unavailable", "Catalogue storage is unavailable.")
		return
	}

	id := strings.TrimSpace(r.PathValue("id"))
	if id == "" || len(id) > 64 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_offer_id", "A valid offer ID is required.")
		return
	}

	const query = `
		SELECT
			o.id::text,
			o.public_code,
			o.market_id::text,
			m.name,
			COALESCE(o.public_category_id::text, ''),
			COALESCE(pc.name, ''),
			o.classification_id::text,
			o.title,
			COALESCE(o.summary, ''),
			o.offer_type,
			COALESCE(o.price_amount::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.currency_code, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_total::text, ''),
			COALESCE(o.quantity_unit, ''),
			o.attributes,
			o.published_at,
			o.valid_until
		FROM offers o
		INNER JOIN markets m ON m.id = o.market_id
		LEFT JOIN public_categories pc ON pc.id = o.public_category_id
		WHERE o.id::text = $1
		  AND o.status = 'published'
		  AND m.status = 'active'
		  AND (o.valid_from IS NULL OR o.valid_from <= now())
		  AND (o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until > now())
	`

	var item OfferSummary
	var categoryIDValue string
	var categoryName string
	var validUntil sql.NullTime
	var attributes []byte

	err := h.DB.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), query, id).Scan(
		&item.ID,
		&item.Code,
		&item.MarketID,
		&item.MarketName,
		&categoryIDValue,
		&categoryName,
		&item.ClassificationID,
		&item.Title,
		&item.Summary,
		&item.OfferType,
		&item.PriceAmount,
		&item.CurrencyCode,
		&item.QuantityTotal,
		&item.QuantityUnit,
		&attributes,
		&item.PublishedAt,
		&validUntil,
	)

	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "offer_not_found", "The published offer was not found.")
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "catalogue_query_failed", "The offer could not be loaded.")
		return
	}

	item.PublicCategoryID = categoryIDValue
	item.PublicCategoryName = categoryName
	if validUntil.Valid {
		value := validUntil.Time
		item.ValidUntil = &value
	}
	if len(attributes) == 0 {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	} else if json.Valid(attributes) {
		item.Attributes = json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), attributes...))
	} else {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "invalid_catalogue_data", "The offer contains invalid attributes.")
		return
	}

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func parsePositiveInt(raw string, fallback, maximum int) (int, error) {
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || value < 1 || value > maximum {
		return 0, errors.New("out of range")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, APIError{Code: code, Message: message})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

func TestListOffersRejectsInvalidPage(t *testing.T) {
	handler := Handler{}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	handler.Register(mux)

	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/catalogue/offers?page=0", nil)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {

}
